377YE Autumn Equinox Synod judgements.d: Ynez of the League became Cardinal of Prosperity, Asher of Highguard Cardinal of Courage, Jared of Highguard Cardinal of Loyalty and Samson of Highguard Cardinal of Pride, each after the previous holder was removed or contested. The General Assembly vetoed the Senate's decision to give the Brilliant Shore Bourse resource to Wintermark. The Assembly of Prosperity condemned Xavier Cascade for heresy and blasphemy, 90 to 0. A Statement of Principle now requires an Exemplar to win both a Greater Majority of the relevant Virtue Assembly and a Lesser Majority of the General Assembly, and to name the signs shown. The Marches Hospital, Phoenix Spire, Celesti Coven and Caleb of the Cenotaph each received one and a half Thrones. Proposed rewards to Azmon and to Lazarus of the Shattered Tower were defeated.

Dawn.t: Abaddon De Rondell of Dawn held the post of Cardinal of Wisdom. Lady Josephine Novarrion of Dawn lost the contest for Cardinal of Pride narrowly, by 50 votes to 54, while Avery Armistead of Dawn received 10.

Highguard.t: Highborn priests won three Cardinal seats, with Asher taking Courage, Jared taking Loyalty and Samson taking Pride, and Ira of Highguard secured the Synod's backing for a monument at Anvil to the Empire's military dead. Proposed rewards to Azmon and Lazarus of the Shattered Tower, raised by Highborn priests, were both defeated.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Assembly of Pride formally called on the Imperial Orcs to form a National Assembly in the Synod to oversee the virtue of their elected Imperial office-holders. Gralka, an Imperial Orc, served as Conscience of the Way.

Navarr.t: Hywel Summercrow of the Navarr carried the Statement of Principle tightening the requirements for recognising Exemplars by 414 votes to 52, and Meurig Tystwarden was retained as Gatekeeper of Pride. Tockryn Nighthaven of the Navarr secured one and a half Thrones for the Phoenix Spire of Urizen.

Urizen.t: The Phoenix Spire of Urizen received one and a half Thrones from the Virtue Fund. Laelia Shatterspire of Urizen led the successful veto of the Brilliant Shore Bourse seat going to Wintermark, and Cyrus Cascade was retained as Gatekeeper of Courage. Linden of Endsmeet and Sejanus Shatterspire received visions of their past lives.

Varushka.t: Olga of Miekarova was recognised as an Exemplar of Vigilance by a Greater Majority, on a judgement raised by Irada-Catchie Bandsyna of Varushka. Petra of Varushka held the post of Cardinal of Vigilance.

Wintermark.t: The Synod vetoed the Senate's assignment of the Brilliant Shore Bourse resource to Wintermark, and a bid to recognise Horsa Monster-slayer as an Exemplar of Courage failed to reach a Greater Majority. Ingar Saker and Horsa Tyrshalt received visions of their past lives.

377YE Autumn Equinox Synod judgements.o: At the Autumn Equinox 377YE the Synod appointed new Cardinals of Prosperity, Courage, Loyalty and Pride, vetoed the Senate's assignment of the Brilliant Shore Bourse seat to Wintermark, and tightened the rules for recognising Exemplars. It also recognised Olga of Miekarova as an Exemplar of Vigilance and rewarded four causes from the Virtue Fund.

Miekarova/Srodkoja.t: Mentioned in passing: the page names Olga of Miekarova, recognised as an Exemplar of Vigilance, but says nothing about Srodkoja itself.

Miekarova.t: Olga of Miekarova was recognised by the Assembly of Vigilance as an Exemplar of Vigilance, bringing Synod recognition to one of the territory's own people.

377YE Winter Solstice Conclave sessions.d: On Friday the Conclave added the Cuckoo's Egg ritual, which lets non-citizens pass through the Sentinel Gate, to Imperial Lore and appointed Vaan of Auric Horizon as Warmage from eight candidates. On Saturday Evander Slack and Alex Lansdale of Bregasland were declared sorcerers, a Vallorn ritual was interdicted and Concordia became Conclave Liaison to the Senate. On Sunday a declaration of enmity against Carolinos Kade failed and drake's eggs were interdicted. Approved gambits funded war magic, including a Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae in Karsk, Winter's Ghosts on Reikos and battlefield healing against the Druj in the Barrens. Others funded scrying into the heart of Bas Celik and gifts to appease Kimus.

Dawn.t: Mentioned in passing: the Archmage of Spring had approved funding to cast Shadowed Glass of Sung to investigate the Spring Herald in Dawn.

Druj.t: The Conclave directed magic against the Druj. It funded Winter's Ghosts on Druj-held Reikos and battlefield healing for Imperial forces engaging the Druj in the Barrens.

Thule.t: The Archmage of Spring sought help with a plan to turn the forces of Llofir against the Thule rather than the Empire. The Conclave also approved raising a Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae in Thule-held Karsk.

377YE Winter Solstice Conclave sessions.o: Across three Conclave sessions at the 377YE Winter Solstice, Imperial magicians appointed Vaan of Auric Horizon as Warmage and Concordia as Conclave Liaison to the Senate. They added the Cuckoo's Egg ritual to Imperial Lore, interdicted a Vallorn ritual and drake's eggs, declared two sorcerers and approved numerous ritual gambits, many in support of the war effort.

Karsk.t: The Archmage of Summer won Conclave approval to raise a Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae in Karsk, then held by the Thule.

Reikos.t: The Archmage of Autumn received 20 mana to perform Winter's Ghosts on Druj-held Reikos.

The Barrens.t: The Archmage of Night received mana to provide battlefield healing for the Sunday engagement against the Druj in the Barrens.

377YE Winter Solstice winds of fortune.d: The Highborn invited all citizens to a candlelit procession remembering the fallen, followed by the Day of Rebirth. The League revived the Masquerade of the Reaper, with masks, competitions, a parade with a burning effigy and a grand party. A delegation from the Chambers of Issyk in Axos docked at Crown Quay in Necropolis and travelled to Anvil seeking parley and trade. The Magistrates stressed that the Axou were protected by Imperial law. Astronomancers foresaw a conjunction of the Three Sisters, last seen before Empress Giselle's death and the final retreat from Holberg, marking a winter of blood-ties and sorrow. The mercenary Iron Raptors, under Master Aryton Scalmere, offered dangerous contracts.

Druj.t: Mentioned in passing: the Druj are not named, but the page recalls the final Imperial retreat from Holberg, a territory they held at the time.

Highguard.t: The Highborn invited citizens of every nation to their camp for the Day of the Dead, a procession and stories honouring the fallen, followed by the Day of Rebirth. Escon, the Highborn egregore, was named as the one to answer questions about the tradition.

The League.t: The League revived the Masquerade of the Reaper, with masks, Bridge Fighting, the Hunt of Ambition, a cartas' remembrance and a parade with a burning effigy. A grand party in the League plaza followed.

Varushka.t: Mentioned in passing: the starwatchers of Void in Volodmartz were among those who agreed that a conjunction of the Three Sisters was coming.

377YE Winter Solstice winds of fortune.o: Ahead of the 377YE Winter Solstice, a set of early, short Winds of Fortune announced the Highborn Day of the Dead and the League's Masquerade of the Reaper. They also heralded an Axou trade delegation, a rare conjunction of the Three Sisters and the return of the Iron Raptors to Anvil.

Holberg.t: Mentioned in passing: the last major conjunction of the Three Sisters was recalled as occurring shortly before the final retreat from Holberg.

Necropolis.t: The crimson-sailed ship of the Axou delegation from the Chambers of Issyk docked at Crown Quay in Necropolis. The delegation then travelled overland to Anvil under a scarlet flag.

Volodmartz.t: Mentioned in passing: the starwatchers of Void in snow-dusted Volodmartz confirmed the coming conjunction of the Three Sisters.

377YE Winter Solstice winds of war.d: Imperial forces made progress in Holberg and Karsk, where the retreating Thule salted the earth. The Summer Storm drove the last Thule out of Skarsind into Otkodov, leaving devastation and restless dead behind. In Casinea and Bastion, Dawnish, Highborn and Navarr armies prepared to strike east into Druj-held lands. The ceasefire with the Jotun held in the west despite raiding by hot-heads on both sides. Rumours spoke of Lasambrian orcs moving north into Liathaven and of Druj slipping into eastern Therunin. In Segura the Red Wind Corsairs were slowly pushed back while the Lasambrians rose. In northern Hercynia, Harak the Red mustered Thulish auxiliaries and bandits for an unknown purpose.

Druj.t: The Druj were being driven back in Holberg, while their territories around Haros Water and Broken Ridge faced an imminent Imperial offensive. A Druj force out of High Chalcis was rumoured to be slipping into Therunin.

Highguard.t: Highborn armies gathered in Casinea and Bastion alongside Dawnish and Navarr forces, ready to drive east and reclaim the lands stolen from the Highborn.

Jotun.t: The ceasefire between the Jotun and the Empire held, with the borders observed by both sides' generals despite raids by enthusiasts on each side.

Navarr.t: Navarr armies stood ready to strike east against the Druj, but the weakened Navarr in Liathaven faced Lasambrian orcs moving north. Eastern Therunin was threatened by Druj incursions.

Thule.t: The Thule fell back in Karsk, salting the earth as they went, and fled Skarsind into Otkodov to regroup. Thulish auxiliaries also gathered under Harak the Red in Hercynia's Glen of Shadows.

Urizen.t: Mentioned in passing: the passes of Urizen's Morrow are described as eastern Therunin's precarious connection to the Empire.

Wintermark.t: Skarsind was freed from Thule occupation by the Summer Storm, though the returning Winterfolk found devastation and restless dead. The shield of Wintermark also helped push the Thule back in Karsk.

377YE Winter Solstice winds of war.o: At the Winter Solstice of 377YE, Imperial armies pressed the Thule back in Karsk, drove the Druj back in Holberg and freed Skarsind, while new threats gathered on several borders. These included Lasambrian orcs, Druj raiders and Harak the Red's forces in Hercynia.

Hercynia/The Glen of Shadows.t: The isolated orcs of the Glen of Shadows lit their war beacons and gathered under Harak the Red's banners, but made no move north or south.

Liathaven/Beacon Point.t: Rumours spoke of a well-armed mob of Lasambrian orcs moving north towards Beacon Point.

Liathaven/Western Scout.t: Western Scout was rumoured to be a target for Lasambrian orcs moving north to exploit Navarr weakness.

Reikos/Broken Ride.t: Unseen voices whispering "Soon" were heard through the ghost-haunted glades of Broken Ridge as Imperial armies prepared to strike.

Reikos/Haros Water.t: Winter winds howled across the walls of Haros Water while Imperial forces readied to sweep eastward.

Therunin/Lower Tarn Valley.t: Druj scouts were rumoured to be sneaking through the marshes of Lower Tarn, bringing fire and poison.

Therunin/Peakedge Song.t: A Druj force out of High Chalcis was rumoured to be slinking over the borders into Peakedge Song.

Bastion.t: Imperial forces massed in Bastion, ready to sweep east and reclaim Highborn lands from the Druj.

Casinea.t: Dawnish, Highborn and Navarr armies stood ready in Casinea to drive a spear into the heart of the Druj.

Hercynia.t: In northern Hercynia, the isolated orcs of the Glen of Shadows lit their war beacons and gathered under Harak the Red for an unknown purpose.

Holberg.t: The tide turned in Holberg as Imperial forces drove the Druj back, and its people could once again stand on their walls.

Karsk.t: The Thule fell back in Karsk before Marcher, Wintermark and Varushkan armies, salting the earth wherever they could.

Liathaven.t: A ceasefire with the Jotun held in Liathaven, but Lasambrian orcs were rumoured to be moving north to exploit the weakness of the last Navarr there.

Morrow.t: Mentioned in passing: the passes of Morrow are described as eastern Therunin's precarious link to the rest of the Empire.

Otkodov.t: The Thule armies driven out of Skarsind retreated across the mountains into Otkodov to lick their wounds and prepare their next assault.

Reikos.t: Druj-held Reikos lay in the path of the Imperial armies massing to the west, and whispers of "Soon" were heard at Haros Water and Broken Ridge.

Segura.t: The Red Wind Corsairs were slowly being pushed back in Segura, while the Freeborn army there barely held against two armies as the Lasambrian Hills grew stronger.

Skarsind.t: The last Thule forces were driven from Skarsind by the Summer Storm, but the returning Winterfolk found devastation, a lingering taint and restless dead.

Therunin.t: Eastern Therunin, connected to the Empire only by the passes of Morrow, faced rumours of Druj raiders crossing into Peakedge Song and creeping through the Tarn.

378YE Autumn Equinox winds of war.d: In Sermersuaq, four Imperial armies faced roughly equal Thule numbers, but Thule sorcery let them seize the Stonefields; they are expected to take the Silver Peaks by Spring. In Karsk, Varushkan armies allied with the Charnel Lord of the Broken Barrow, yet the Thule pushed toward the Frozen Citadel, and Nitrost is expected to fall by midwinter without help. Elsewhere Segura fell quiet pending diplomacy, Reikos went silent, and ettercap overran Brocéliande. At Holberg, more than thirty-five thousand defenders withstood siege engines, ogres and Druj-bound marshwalkers. The Druj, undone partly by their own Spring curse, retreated, while the Empire lost around three thousand troops.

Dawn.t: Dawnish forces at Drycastle helped resupply hidden outposts in the Barrens, and the Golden Sun sallied from Holberg to strike down marshwalkers and battering rams.

Druj.t: The Druj assault on Holfried under the scorpion banner failed, costing them perhaps ten thousand casualties, partly because their own Spring curse festered their wounds. They still hold Reikos and outer Holberg.

Grendel.t: The Grendel port of Apulus was devastated by the tempest, damaging their ability to supply their forces in Spiral. Their army avoided direct confrontation with the Highborn there.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Fist of the Mountain fought the Thule in the Silver Peaks, and the Summer Storm's discipline steadied Holberg's defenders and opened the path for the sally against the marshwalkers.

Jotun.t: The Jotun still held northern Liathaven and remained cautious in the Mournwold, where stories spread of lost Marcher folk returning home from their territory.

Navarr.t: The Navarr forests were largely quiet: Hercynia's last Thule were driven off from Treji and Therunin was safe again. Liathaven remained divided and Brocéliande was overrun by monstrous insects.

The Brass Coast.t: The Fire of the South fought the Thule in the Silver Peaks, while in Segura the Freeborn and Lasambrian orcs stopped fighting to await diplomacy.

The League.t: League forces including the Towerjacks and Wolves of War held the walls of Holfried. The Wolves of War's engines countered the Druj war machines and saved hundreds of lives.

The Marches.t: The Bounders sallied from Holberg against the marshwalkers. In the Mournwold the scarecrow ring was weakening, work began on an armoured garrison, and Marcher folk thought lost were reportedly returning home.

Thule.t: The Thule seized the Stonefields in Sermersuaq and pushed the Varushkans back toward the Frozen Citadel in Karsk, but their last forces in Hercynia were routed.

Urizen.t: The Citadel's sentinels and mages bore the brunt of Druj poison at Holberg, healing defenders and hurling orcs from the ramparts. Visten in Redoubt was also struck by the storms.

Varushka.t: Three Varushkan armies, aided by the Charnel Lord's banner of bone and raven feathers, were slowly forced back in Karsk. Nitrost is expected to fall to the Thule by midwinter unless reinforcements arrive.

Wintermark.t: The Green Shield and the Winter Sun, with a thousand husks from Holberg, fought the Thule in Sermersuaq but could only slow their advance as the Stonefields were lost.

378YE Autumn Equinox winds of war.o: In Autumn 378YE, Imperial forces in Holfried repelled a massive Druj siege of Holberg, inflicting perhaps ten thousand casualties. Meanwhile the Thule took the Stonefields in Sermersuaq and pressed the Varushkans back in Karsk, and a supernatural tempest wrecked the Grendel-held port of Apulus in Spiral.

Brocéliande/Dark Ranging.t: Monstrous insects swarmed out of Dark Ranging into the glades left empty by the orcs.

Brocéliande/Elerael.t: The orcs abandoned Elerael, and ettercap and giant insects quickly moved in to hunt there.

Brocéliande/Vale's Lament.t: Monstrous insects spread from Vale's Lament into neighbouring Elerael.

Holberg/Holfried.t: The unbreached walls of the upper city withstood the full Druj assault, including marshwalkers and ogre-drawn rams, until the orcs retreated.

Holberg/Holmauer.t: The ruined outer city remained in Druj hands, and stone from it was hurled at Holfried. The defeated orcs withdrew back beyond it.

Holberg/Rebeshof.t: The Druj built their great siege engines on the plains of Rebeshof and fell back there after their defeat.

Holberg/Utterlund.t: Retreating Druj withdrew into the forests and marshes of Utterlund.

Karsk/Branoc.t: The dark sovereign of the Broken Barrow allied with the Empire and sent its fog-shrouded Charnel Banner against the Thule.

Karsk/Krevsaty.t: Thule sorcery raised a citadel of orichalcum and bronze around the ruins of Oloy.

Karsk/Moresvah.t: Thule strikes hit Moresvah and targeted the supply train bound for Nitrost.

Karsk/Nitrost.t: The Thule attacked the Frozen Citadel and rebuilt vales, pushing the Varushkans back. Nitrost is expected to fall by midwinter without reinforcements.

Segura/Burnish.t: Lasambrian orcs held their positions in Burnish as the fighting paused for diplomacy.

Segura/Yellow Chase.t: Lasambrian orcs held Yellow Chase while warily watching the Freeborn without engaging.

Sermersuaq/East Floes.t: Hunters of the Thule Ice Shard Banner struck deep into East Floes.

Sermersuaq/Silver Peaks.t: The Thule claimed the Stonefields, and unless something changes they are expected to take the whole Silver Peaks by Spring.

Sermersuaq/Suaq Fount.t: Ice Shard Banner raiders struck deep into Suaq Fount.

Spiral/Apulus.t: Seven waterspouts reportedly shattered the Grendel docks and buildings, leaving the port even more ruined and hampering Grendel supply.

Bay of Catazar.t: A supernatural tempest made the western Bay treacherous all Summer, tearing sails and dragging ships near the Spiral coast into maelstroms.

Brocéliande.t: The orcs left Elerael, but monstrous insects and wicked ettercap swarmed into the empty glades.

Hercynia.t: The last Thule failed to break the thorns defending rebuilt Treji and retreated, badly outclassed, into the deep woods.

Holberg.t: The Druj siege of the upper city was repelled with immense orc losses, though around three thousand Imperial troops fell and the city remains overcrowded, diseased and close to riot.

Karsk.t: Magical citadels rose on both sides as the Thule tested Varushkan defences and then drove them back in Nitrost, threatening to retake the territory.

Liathaven.t: The Jotun still held the north and the vallorn its heart, while the southern Imperial settlements remained isolated by distance and bandits.

Mournwold.t: The scarecrow ring at Overton was weakening, so work began on an armoured garrison, and returning Marcher folk were reported.

Redoubt.t: Visten was battered by the storms, and the Ribbon of Salt regio briefly became a churning fountain raining debris on the docks.

Reikos.t: The territory fell ominously silent: resistance groups had not been heard from and scouts found camps emptied or did not return.

Segura.t: After nine months of war the fighting stopped, with Lasambrian orcs holding their positions while both sides waited on diplomacy.

Semmerholm.t: Mentioned in passing: fleeing citizens and refugees from Holberg headed west to Semmerholm and beyond.

Sermersuaq.t: The Thule took the Stonefields and raided deep into the territory, while Spring magic saved lives and promised healthy herds come Spring.

Spiral.t: The tempest reshaped the coastline and wrecked Apulus. The Valiant Pegasus sheltered in the Fist, and neither side sought battle.

The Barrens.t: With Dawnish help, Imperial scouts resupplied hidden outposts and began reporting orc fighting orc and the Spires of Dusk under siege.

Therunin.t: The forest was safe again with no Druj from Reikos, and the Feverwater dredgers recovered occasional treasures.

Upwold.t: Mentioned in passing: there were no large-scale engagements along the western front from Segura to Upwold, only skirmishes.

378YE Spring Equinox winds of war.d: In the east, Imperial forces took Kopevnost, Moresvah and Nitrost in Karsk but suffered heavy casualties. In Holberg, a Druj army under the Scorpion's Sting held Rebeshof and the Ennerlund mines, and only risen dead fighting beside the Winter Sun prevented disaster. The Druj fought each other in the Barrens. In Therunin, nearly a thousand Navarr fell as ten thousand orcs closed on Peakedge Stand. In Spiral, defenders held the Ossuary against orcs under no known Grendel banner. In the west, the Hounds of Glory struck Segura, and the Summer Storm freed Treji, though Harak the Red escaped. Lasambrians raided Liathaven, and Jotun raiders wore down the Greensward.

Dawn.t: Dawnish knights and war-witches marched with the Hounds of Glory to relieve Segura, and Dawn's scouts reported Druj banners burning in the Barrens.

Druj.t: The Druj held Holberg to a stalemate and pushed into Therunin, yet their armies fought one another in the Barrens, and orcs left Brocéliande to answer some call there.

Grendel.t: The orcs fighting in Spiral bore no known Grendel banner, and they were denied the Ossuary despite holding the advantage.

Highguard.t: Highborn forces helped turn back the orc assault on the Ossuary in Spiral, and Necropolis lay on the route of the army marching to Segura.

Jotun.t: The Jotun treaty in the Mournwold still held, but Jotun raiders were grinding down the Greensward, and their campaign of capture in the Mourn was reported complete.

Navarr.t: The Black Thorns were slowly driven back in Therunin with nearly a thousand Navarri dead, and Navarr in Liathaven were isolated against Lasambrian raiders. Navarr from three Hercynian regions helped liberate Treji.

The Brass Coast.t: An Imperial army came to the defence of the Brass Coast, relieving Anozel, burning Lasambrian camps and reclaiming farms across Segura.

The League.t: Two walls of Holberg were united under the Empire again, but the Imperial advance there was fought to a standstill, and Sarvos lay on the route to Segura.

The Marches.t: The folk of the Greensward were being slowly ground down by Jotun raiders, though the treaty in the Mournwold still held.

Thule.t: The Thule were driven out of Karsk and abandoned their Isember allies. In Hercynia, prisoners forced to make arms for the Thule were freed.

Urizen.t: Urizen's Granite Pillar and Quiet Step held Spiral, allowing work on the Fist to resume while Ateri's stone-crafters laboured on the fortress of Mezudan.

Varushka.t: Imperial armies retook Kopevnost, Moresvah and Nitrost in Karsk with the help of Moresvah's miners, though the cost in casualties was heavy.

Wintermark.t: Mentioned in passing: the Summer Storm struck into Hercynia from the hills of Skarsind.

378YE Spring Equinox winds of war.o: At the Spring Equinox of 378YE, Imperial armies drove the Thule from Karsk, broke the Lasambrian siege of Anozel in Segura and liberated Treji in Hercynia. Meanwhile Holberg was stalemated, Therunin lost ground to the Druj, and Lasambrian raiders moved unopposed through Liathaven.

Hercynia/Northpines.t: Mentioned in passing: the Navarr of Northpines supported the Imperial orcs in liberating Treji.

Hercynia/Old Ranging.t: Mentioned in passing: the Navarr of Old Ranging supported the Imperial orcs in liberating Treji.

Hercynia/Summersend.t: Mentioned in passing: the Navarr of Summersend supported the Imperial orcs in liberating Treji.

Holberg/Ennerlund.t: The Druj clung grimly to the Mines at Ennerlund.

Holberg/Holfried.t: A wailing wind swept across the battlefields of Holfried, and the dead rose from their graves to fight beneath the Winter Sun's banner.

Holberg/Rebeshof.t: Imperial assaults broke again and again against the Scorpion's Sting's fortifications at Rebeshof.

Karsk/Kopevnost.t: Kopevnost came under Imperial control after decisive victories over the Thule.

Karsk/Moresvah.t: Moresvah's grateful miners aided the Imperial armies, and the region came under Imperial control.

Karsk/Nitrost.t: Nitrost came under Imperial control as the Thule fell back eastward.

Liathaven/Beacon Point.t: Lasambrian hillborn barbarians worked their way northward through the trees of Beacon Point.

Liathaven/Western Scout.t: Lasambrian scouts pushed into Western Scout, where isolated Navarr faced burning steadings and theft.

Mournwold/Greensward.t: The folk of the Greensward were being slowly ground down by raiding barbarians.

Segura/Anozeseri.t: The Imperial campaign, joined by freedom fighters from Morajasse, drove the Lasambrians out of Anozeseri and reclaimed farm after farm.

Segura/Iron Plains.t: The Lasambrians attempted a desperate retreat across the Iron Plains, where the first engagements went to the Empire.

Segura/Sobral Grasses.t: The Lasambrian camps in the Sobral Grasses were burnt.

Spiral/Ateri.t: Ateri's stone-crafters' guild worked feverishly on the fortress of Mezudan, which might yet draw the barbarians' ire.

Spiral/Ossuary.t: The Imperial forces turned back the barbarians seeking to conquer the Ossuary and claimed the mithril mined from the Legacy.

Brocéliande.t: Large numbers of orcs left their hideaways in Brocéliande, slipping past patrols to cross east into the Barrens.

Hercynia.t: The Summer Storm caught the orcs in the Glade of Shadows unprepared and liberated the near-ruined Treji, freeing many prisoners, though Harak the Red escaped.

Holberg.t: Imperial attacks on Druj fortifications were repeatedly repulsed, and only an army of risen dead fighting with the Winter Sun prevented heavy losses, leaving the territory stalemated.

Karsk.t: The Thule were decisively defeated and driven east, leaving all three regions in Imperial control and the Isember traitors exposed.

Liathaven.t: A Lasambrian army moved northward unopposed, burning steadings and slaughtering stridings among Navarr who were cut off from the Empire.

Madruga.t: Mentioned in passing: the Imperial army passed through Madruga before crossing the Scorrero into Segura.

Mournwold.t: The Jotun treaty still held, but no more refugees were coming out of the Mourn, and the Jotun campaign there had entered a new phase.

Necropolis.t: Mentioned in passing: the army bound for Segura set out from Necropolis.

Reikos.t: Mentioned in passing: the two Druj armies attacking Therunin fought across the border from Reikos.

Sarvos.t: Mentioned in passing: Sarvos lay on the army's route from Necropolis to Segura.

Segura.t: The Imperial army relieved Anozel and drove the Lasambrians out of the Sobral Grasses and Anozeseri, leaving them retreating across the Iron Plains.

Skarsind.t: Mentioned in passing: the Summer Storm rampaged down from the hills of Skarsind into Hercynia.

Spiral.t: The Imperial defenders denied the orcs the Ossuary and claimed its mithril, while work resumed on the Fist and the fortress of Mezudan.

The Barrens.t: Druj armies fought pitched battles against each other, and watchers from Drycastle and the Towers of the Dawn saw Druj banners burning.

Therunin.t: Outnumbered two to one, the Black Thorns were slowly driven back with nearly a thousand dead, and ten thousand orcs were closing on the refugee haven of Peakedge Stand.

378YE Summer Solstice Announcements by t.d: Using the legal power to resupply armies granted by the Senate, the Quartermaster General approved four resupply announcements, each counting separately for the purposes of a Synod veto. After the solstice he provided 112 wains of mithril and weirwood: 49 to the Red Wind Corsairs, restoring fighting strength equal to 980 soldiers; 43 to the Strong Reeds, restoring 860; and 20 to the Drakes, restoring 400. The Fire of the South received no wains, because it was engaged by Thule forces in Sermersuaq at the time.

Thule.t: Thule forces in Sermersuaq kept the Fire of the South engaged, which meant the Freeborn army received none of the resupply allocated to it.

Wintermark.t: Mentioned in passing: Wintermark is not named, but the Fire of the South went unresupplied because it was fighting Thule forces in the Wintermark-held territory of Sermersuaq.

378YE Summer Solstice Announcements by t.o: At the Summer Solstice 378YE the Quartermaster General, Janusz Dalibor von Temeschwar, announced the resupply of four Imperial armies: the Freeborn Red Wind Corsairs and Fire of the South, and the Marcher Strong Reeds and Drakes.

Sermersuaq.t: The Fire of the South was engaged by Thule forces in Sermersuaq and so received no resupply wains, leaving it without reinforcement for that fight.

378YE Summer Solstice winds of war.d: In Segura three Imperial armies retook the Iron Plains at a cost of nearly two thousand soldiers, though three Lasambrian armies, aided by eternal emissaries under a golden lion banner, remain. Over ten thousand Thule invaded Sermersuaq and were checked but not expelled. In Karsk the Thule held their regions with potent sorcery. In Therunin Imperial magic and the Granite Pillar helped push the Druj back into Reikos. In Holberg the Druj broke Holmauer's walls, killing over four thousand Imperials. Jotun raids on the Greensward continued, the Virtue Crusade was destroyed in Reikos, and Imperial fleets disrupted Grendel shipping off Spiral.

Dawn.t: Dawnish forces fought on the Iron Plains and set up an armed camp near the ruins of Anduz, while Dawnish soldiers were among the defenders driven back into upper Holberg.

Druj.t: The Druj were pushed out of Therunin back into Reikos, but they overran Holmauer, besieged the Imperials in Holfried and slaughtered or enslaved the Virtue Crusade.

Grendel.t: The Grendel held their dug-in lines at Screed, but Imperial fleets sank their supply ships from Dubhtraig and captured treasure ships, disrupting links between Apulian and the Broken Shore.

Highguard.t: The Granite Pillar turned Druj terror back on them in Therunin, the Valiant Pegasus held Fort Mezudan, and the Virtue Crusade that marched from camps in Casinea and Bastion was destroyed.

Jotun.t: The Jotun still ruled Mournwold and Liathaven, and despite their ceasefire with the Empire their raiders kept attacking the Greensward.

Navarr.t: The Black Thorns and Quiet Step, joined by risen Navarr dead, helped drive the Druj from Therunin, while Navarr captains raided Grendel shipping off Spiral.

The Brass Coast.t: The Red Wind Corsairs and Eastern Sky reclaimed the Iron Plains for the Freeborn, Freeborn troops defended Holberg and Freeborn corsairs harried Grendel fleets, though the Senate had yet to decide who would take custody of Segura.

The League.t: Holberg's defences collapsed to the upper city and its citizens began thinking of fleeing to Sarvos, Temeschwar or Tassato, while a Temeschwari merchant-venturer's fleet raided Grendel shipping.

The Marches.t: Marcher troops were among Holberg's defenders, and in the Greensward the scarecrows of Overton and Greensward Abbey sheltered Marchers from continuing Jotun raids.

Thule.t: A Thule host under the white hound invaded Sermersuaq, while in Karsk over twenty thousand Thule used powerful sorcery to hold their regions without counter-attacking.

Urizen.t: Urizen sentinels manned Fort Mezudan and the Phoenix fleet prowled the Spiral coast, where looted Urizen goods were recaptured from Grendel ships; Morrow was named as a possible Druj target.

Varushka.t: The Northern Eagle and Golden Axe lost about a thousand soldiers in Karsk, gained no ground and were forced back to Nitrost and Kopvenost, though Imperial magic spared them worse losses.

Wintermark.t: Fresh from Varushka, the Green Shield and Fist of the Mountain met the Thule invasion of Sermersuaq, losing many Winterfolk but stopping the orcs from establishing themselves.

378YE Summer Solstice winds of war.o: At the Summer Solstice of 378YE the Empire reclaimed the Iron Plains of Segura and drove the Druj out of Therunin, but lost the suburbs of Holmauer to the Druj, fought the Thule to a standstill in Karsk and met a new Thule invasion of Sermersuaq.

Holberg/Holfried.t: The Imperial armies retreated behind the walls of Holfried, the upper city, where they were besieged and bombarded with the remains of their dead.

Holberg/Holmauer.t: The Druj broke Holmauer's walls in three places and retook its ruined suburbs and outer walls.

Holberg/Rebeshof.t: The Druj commanded the siege from their fortress at Rebeshof, from whose gates the Scorpion Sting launched the assault on Holmauer.

Karsk/Branoc.t: Most of the serious fighting in Karsk took place in Branoc's northern hills, beneath the Broken Barrow, held by a hostile host aiding neither side.

Karsk/Krevsaty.t: The Thule raised a citadel of ice and frozen stone in fallen Krevsaty, from which orc warlocks watched the battlefields.

Karsk/Nitrost.t: The Varushkan forces were pushed back to Nitrost after failing to dislodge the Thule.

Mournwold/Greensward.t: Jotun raiders kept attacking the Greensward, held back only by the scarecrows of Overton, its militia and the warded Greensward Abbey.

Otkodov/Sküld.t: Mentioned in passing: the Thule army that invaded Sermersuaq came partly out of Sküld.

Segura/Anduzjasse.t: Lasambrian forces escaped to Anduzjasse and held old Anduz, while Dawnish forces camped above the Longing Circle facing them.

Segura/Burnish.t: Burnish was one refuge for the retreating Lasambrian armies, which still remain in Segura.

Segura/Iron Plains.t: The Iron Plains were reclaimed for the Freeborn after a costly battle in which nearly two thousand Imperial soldiers fell.

Segura/Yellow Chase.t: Yellow Chase was one refuge for the retreating Lasambrian armies, which still remain in Segura.

Sermersuaq/East Floes.t: Thule raiding parties were reported as far south as the East Floes above Wreck.

Sermersuaq/Silver Peaks.t: The Thule occupied the northern passes of the Silver Peaks, claiming mines and Stonefields mana and scouting the Stonefield Ice Caves while Wintermark's armies fought them.

Spiral/Apulus.t: Imperial fleets blockaded Apulus's waters, sinking Grendel supply ships and capturing treasure ships, though some Imperial ships were said to trade at Apulian.

Spiral/Screed.t: Highborn and Urizen held Fort Mezudan in Screed, facing the dug-in Grendel Salt Dogs and Stone Gyre.

Therunin/Lower Tarn Valley.t: Shadow magic in the fens of the Lower Tarn Valley raised a castle of mist and enchanted the marsh against the Druj invaders.

Bastion.t: The Virtue Crusade camped on Bastion's borders before marching to its doom, and the Druj were said to have routes by which they could threaten Bastion.

Casinea.t: Refugees from Reikos gathered in camps on the borders of Casinea before marching out as the ill-fated Virtue Crusade.

Holberg.t: Druj forces broke the walls of Holmauer and penned around fifteen thousand Imperial defenders inside upper Holberg, killing over four thousand and spreading panic among its citizens.

Karsk.t: Imperial and Thule forces fought to a bloody standstill across Karsk, with neither side gaining ground and rival ice citadels raised in its hills.

Liathaven.t: Mentioned in passing: Liathaven was noted as still labouring under Jotun rule.

Morrow.t: Mentioned in passing: Morrow was named as one place the Druj might threaten after their retreat from Therunin.

Mournwold.t: The Jotun still held the Mournwold and kept raiding the Marcher redoubt of the Greensward, despite the ceasefire.

Otkodov.t: Mentioned in passing: part of the Thule army that invaded Sermersuaq marched out of western Otkodov.

Reikos.t: The defeated Druj armies fell back into Reikos, where Druj scouts also crushed the Virtue Crusade and enslaved its survivors.

Sarvos.t: Mentioned in passing: frightened Holbergers began wondering what the weather was like in sunny Sarvos.

Segura.t: The Battle of the Iron Plains returned Segura to the Empire, though three Lasambrian armies still held its outer regions against three Imperial armies.

Sermersuaq.t: Over ten thousand Thule invaded Sermersuaq, seizing mines and mana sites in the Silver Peaks and raiding deep into the territory, beginning a war for it.

Spiral.t: Land forces in Spiral stayed dug in around Screed while Imperial fleets disrupted Grendel shipping off its coast.

Tassato.t: Mentioned in passing: Holbergers considering flight wondered about rain-beaten Tassato.

Temeschwar.t: Mentioned in passing: Holbergers wondered about chilly Temeschwar, and a Temeschwari merchant-venturer's fleet joined the raids on Grendel shipping.

Therunin.t: Imperial magic and the combined Navarr and Highborn armies drove over ten thousand Druj out of Therunin and back into Reikos.

378YE Winter Solstice Announcements by t.d: The Minister for Historical Research approved four separate research commissions, carried out through the civil service: the runeforge at Gildenheim in Skarsind, the ancient Urizen spire known as the Claw of the Heavens, Emperor Barabbas' plans to invade the Grendel, and the origins of the Hallowing ceremony. Though announced together, each counted as a separate announcement for the purposes of a Synod veto. Progress was unknown at the time of recording; the expected outcome was that research reports would be compiled and presented to the Minister.

Grendel.t: Research was commissioned into Emperor Barabbas' plans to invade the Grendel, promising the Empire fresh insight into its historical designs on that foreign nation.

Urizen.t: The ancient Urizen spire called the Claw of the Heavens was made a subject of commissioned historical research.

Wintermark.t: The runeforge at Gildenheim, in the Wintermark territory of Skarsind, was among the four subjects of commissioned historical research.

378YE Winter Solstice Announcements by t.o: At the Winter Solstice of 378YE the Minister for Historical Research commissioned four pieces of historical research through the civil service, into the Gildenheim runeforge, the Claw of the Heavens spire, Emperor Barabbas' invasion plans against the Grendel, and the origins of the Hallowing ceremony.

Skarsind.t: Historical research was commissioned into the runeforge at Gildenheim in Skarsind, with a report to be presented to the Minister.

378YE Winter Solstice winds of fortune.d: Vermin from the realm of Night were sighted in Morrow and threatened its mana and herb production. Segura's full restoration prompted celebrations that the Synod, Senate and Bourse might capitalise on. A coordinated cult of Anarchists sabotaged military units in Miekarova. Soldiers of the two orc legions developed a friendly rivalry the Synod might exploit. In Miaren a Winter enchantment of magnitude 50 brought Navarr extra bounty, but also nightmares, deaths among the weak and troubles for the draughir. In Wintermark, The Strength of Tradition set Suaq, Kallavesi and Steinr against one another and strained its armies, possibly through Thule sorcery. Kallavesa's mana crystals grew sluggish and brittle.

Navarr.t: Navarr in Miaren enjoyed unexpected prosperity in their herb gardens, mines, forests, farms, businesses and mana sites, along with extra Synod votes from congregations. This came at the cost of nightmares among children, sleepless elders and draughir struggling to control their territorial instincts.

The Brass Coast.t: Celebrations swept the Brass Coast's Segura after its full restoration to the Empire, offering the Synod, Senate and Bourse a chance to capitalise on the popular mood.

Thule.t: Thule dark magic was named as the most likely cause of the influence dividing Wintermark, since the Thule have a vested interest in destabilising the nation's armies to speed their conquest.

Urizen.t: Boggarts from the realm of Night infested Urizen's territory of Morrow, threatening its mana and herb production and possibly that of surrounding territories.

Varushka.t: A coordinated cult of Anarchists carried out sabotage across Varushka's Miekarova, aimed chiefly at military units in order to disrupt the Imperial war effort.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark fell under The Strength of Tradition, which split Suaq, Kallavesi and Steinr into quarrelling factions and strained the Fist of the Mountain and Green Shield. Halls dominated by a single tradition prospered, while three distinct egregores fed fearful speculation.

378YE Winter Solstice winds of fortune.o: The Winter Solstice 378YE winds reported several opportunities for Imperial champions: boggarts in Morrow, celebrations in Segura, anarchist sabotage in Miekarova and rivalry between the orc legions. They also recorded a strange Winter-tinged prosperity in Miaren, a divisive influence spreading among Wintermark's three traditions, and failing mana in Kallavesa.

Kallavesa.t: Mana sites across the Kallavesa marshes grew sluggish, and their crystals formed slowly, looked dull or crumbled to dust. Mystics feared a separate threat, but spreading parochialism kept anyone beyond the Kallavesi from listening, and mana yields could fall significantly if the problem worsened.

Miaren.t: A Winter enchantment of magnitude 50 lay over Miaren for the three months after the Autumn Equinox, giving every Navarr resource there an extra rank. It also brought a cruel edge of dying weak plants and animals, nightmares and troubled draughir before it faded towards the Solstice.

Miekarova.t: Anarchist sabotage and disruption spread across Miekarova, targeting military units in a coordinated attempt to undermine the Imperial war effort.

Morrow.t: Boggarts from the realm of Night were sighted in Morrow and could harm its mana and herb production and that of neighbouring territories.

Segura.t: Segura celebrated its full restoration to the Empire, creating an opportunity for the Synod, Senate and Bourse to harness the public sentiment.

378YE Winter Solstice winds of war.d: In Karsk, Imperial forces aided by citadels, the Summer legion of Jaheris, Varushkan undead, Spring healing waters and the Golden Axe's strategic insight drove the Thule out of Nitrost and reclaimed the territory. In Sermersuaq, the Thule, allied with Summer knights, fought the Empire to near deadlock but took the upper foothills, controlling a little over half the Silver Peaks while failing to reach the Ice Caves; about a thousand Imperial soldiers died. The Granite Pillar and Quiet Step entered Reikos, found it ravaged under a fearful miasma, and barely took Tabernacle. Over 25,000 Imperial troops broke out of Holberg, took Holmauer and half of Rebeshof, and prepared to besiege the Druj castle as Druj reinforcements arrived.

Dawn.t: Dawnish armies fought on several fronts: the Eastern Sky cleared die-hard Lasambrian raiders from Segura, the Hounds of Glory were singled out by Summer knights in the Silver Peaks, and the Golden Sun camped before the walls of Rebeshof.

Druj.t: The Druj lost Holmauer and were driven back behind the walls of their castle in Rebeshof, though fresh banners of the snake, scorpion and crimson lizard arrived. In Reikos they held firm, harrying the Imperial advance under a dreadful miasma and a white toad clan banner.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: in an interlude at Spiral, a Highborn magister complains there is no fight in the Grendel, while his companion insists they will come in time.

Highguard.t: The Granite Pillar returned to Reikos to find its people slain or enslaved, its chapters' banners defiled and Highborn toiling at the Vigilant Swan, and won only a narrow foothold. Highborn soldiers also joined the successful breakout from Holberg.

Navarr.t: The Quiet Step fought beside the Granite Pillar in Reikos, and Navarr scouts spread across the ruined territory in small groups to report back to their general.

The Brass Coast.t: The Lasambrian orcs largely left Segura as agreed, and the Red Wind Corsairs and Fire of the South fought hard in the Silver Peaks, where Summer knights sought out the Freeborn.

The League.t: League soldiers were among the 25,000 Imperial troops who broke out of Holberg, and engineers who once marched under the Towerjacks' banner helped bring down Holmauer's last keep.

Thule.t: The Thule were driven out of Karsk despite their warlocks, but in Sermersuaq, aided by Summer knights and Otkodov-bred ogres, they took the upper foothills and now control a little over half the Silver Peaks.

Urizen.t: The Urizen Citadel Guard fought in Karsk alongside the Summer legion of Jaheris, and Urizen hosts kept a Highborn magister and his companions standing watch in a castle in Spiral.

Varushka.t: Karsk returned to Imperial hands thanks to the Golden Axe's strategic brilliance, the Black Thorns' walking dead and a draughir general commanding a ghostly legion, though it was unclear whether the Senate would uphold the Varushkan claim.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark suffered tremendous loss of life as the Winter Sun and its allies fought the Thule to a near standstill in Sermersuaq, keeping them from the Ice Caves but ceding the upper foothills.

378YE Winter Solstice winds of war.o: In Winter 378YE the Empire pushed forward in the east, retaking Karsk from the Thule with a host of magical aid, clearing Holmauer and besieging the Druj in Rebeshof, and gaining a bloody foothold in devastated Reikos. In the west, the Lasambrian orcs largely withdrew from Segura, while the Thule edged forward in the Silver Peaks at great cost to Wintermark.

Holberg/Holmauer.t: Holmauer fell to the Empire after fierce fighting across its broken walls, its last keep brought down by the Wolves of War's boulders. Its suburbs are now ruins.

Holberg/Rebeshof.t: The Empire consolidated its hold on half of Rebeshof, driving the Scorpion banner behind the castle walls, and its armies prepared to lay siege.

Karsk/Nitrost.t: The Thule were pushed back out of the hills of Nitrost at the end of the season.

Reikos/Riverwatch.t: The Granite Pillar and Quiet Step more or less drove the Druj from the trapped ruins of Tabernacle, but much remained to be done before Riverwatch was liberated.

Sermersuaq/East Floes.t: Mentioned in passing: East Floes was among the places whose waters teemed with fish and life under Spring magic.

Sermersuaq/Silver Peaks.t: The Thule took the upper foothills and now hold a little over half the Silver Peaks, stripping its resources, but were kept from the Ice Caves and their star metal.

Astolat.t: Mentioned in passing: the Strong Reeds were force-marched from distant Astolat to reinforce the armies in Holberg.

Bay of Catazar.t: Mentioned in passing: a brief interlude shows Captain Drummer unexpectedly facing three ships somewhere in the bay.

Holberg.t: Imperial armies poured out of the city, took Holmauer, secured half of Rebeshof and prepared to besiege the Druj castle, though Druj reinforcements meant the war for Holberg was not over.

Karsk.t: Karsk became Imperial territory again after a season of magical wonders and bloody fighting, with the Thule pushed back to makeshift defences in the east and north.

Otkodov.t: Mentioned in passing: ogres bred in the pits of Otkodov served as living battering rams, and the Empire sought to drive the Thule back towards it.

Reikos.t: Imperial forces found Reikos devastated, its people slain or enslaved, a Druj citadel standing where High Chalcis's gardens had been and a miasma of dread over everything. They gained only a small foothold.

Segura.t: All three Lasambrian forces withdrew as agreed, leaving a few hundred die-hards and some bandits from Anduz to the Scorrero for the Dawnish to root out over several months.

Sermersuaq.t: Thule banners nearly doubled in Sermersuaq, and Spring magic filled its waters with life, healing non-fatal wounds even as about a thousand Imperial soldiers died in the fighting.

Spiral.t: An interlude shows a restless Highborn magister standing watch in a Urizen castle in Spiral, troubled by dreams of something to the north-east and told the Grendel will come in time.

Tsirku.t: Mentioned in passing: the great aurora dancing above Tsirku lit the cold nights over Sermersuaq.

379YE Autumn Equinox Announcements by th.d: Palladius of Urizen commissioned further research through the civil service into the Skarsind Runeforge, following a suggestion by Peter of Hintown. The Minister for Historical Research approved the action, and 5 thrones were provided after the Autumn Equinox 379YE to fund it. As a result, a small expedition was sent to western Sermersuaq to investigate sites there that bear on Peter of Hintown's theory directly. The page records the dispatch of this expedition but gives no findings.

Imperial Orcs.t: The research concerns the Runeforge in Skarsind, a territory the Imperial Orcs held at the time, though the page says nothing of the orcs themselves.

Urizen.t: Palladius of Urizen commissioned the follow-up research, which led to an expedition being sent to western Sermersuaq.

Wintermark.t: An Imperial research expedition was sent into western Sermersuaq, Wintermark's territory, to investigate sites linked to Peter of Hintown's theory about the Runeforge.

379YE Autumn Equinox Announcements by th.o: At the Autumn Equinox 379YE, Palladius of Urizen commissioned follow-up historical research into the Skarsind Runeforge, building on a theory put forward by Peter of Hintown, and the Minister for Historical Research approved it.

Sermersuaq.t: A small expedition was dispatched to western Sermersuaq to investigate sites there relevant to Peter of Hintown's theory about the Skarsind Runeforge.

Skarsind.t: The Skarsind Runeforge is the subject of the commissioned research, though the expedition itself went to Sermersuaq rather than Skarsind.

379YE Autumn Equinox Imperial elections.d: New senators took the seats for Kahraman, Semmerholm, Upwold and Volodmartz. Incumbents held Casinea, Tassato, Therunin, Morrow and Hahnmark. Skarsind's seat was left vacant after the ratification of Relinquish Skarsind. The titles of Minister of Historical Research and Imperial Master of Works lapsed, and other Imperial titles went to new holders. Six generals were appointed, four of them incumbents. The Synod named Cardinals and Gatekeepers of Loyalty and Pride and several Virtue Inquisitors, though the Inquisitor of Prosperity post stayed vacant. Bourse seats were awarded for up to 500 Thrones. The Legacy remains held by the Grendel and must be allocated once Spiral is again Imperial.

Dawn.t: Dawn did well in the Synod, winning the Cardinal of Pride (Ozren de Orzel), the Gatekeeper of Pride (Lady Josephine Novarion) and the Virtue Inquisitor of Courage (Lady Eleanor de Rondell). Bohemond de Rondell became Senator for Semmerholm.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: the Grendel are noted as holding the Legacy, which will need allocating when Spiral is once again Imperial.

Highguard.t: Jared of the Suns of Courous of Highguard became Cardinal of Loyalty and Ephreal became Virtue Inquisitor of Pride. Zephram of Cantiarch's Hold kept Casinea's Senate seat.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Imperial Orcs lost their Senate seat for Skarsind, which was left vacant after Relinquish Skarsind was ratified.

Navarr.t: Navarr kept its voice for Therunin, with Caerwyn Summer Crow returned as incumbent senator.

The Brass Coast.t: Maher i Zaydan i Riqueza became Senator for Kahraman. Joaquim i Shartha i Riqueza was named Dhomiro of the Cinnabar Hills.

The League.t: The League kept Tassato's Senate seat through Cesare Sanguineo Rezia Di Tassato. Its citizens also won four Virtue Inquisitor posts: Ambition, Loyalty, Vigilance and Wisdom.

The Marches.t: The Marches gained a new Senator for Upwold, Silas.

Urizen.t: Ariadne was returned as Senator for Morrow. Anna-Valeria Cascade of Urizen became Gatekeeper of Loyalty.

Varushka.t: Juha the Cave Spider became Senator for Volodmartz. Simargl, the Empty One, of the Circle of Zulgan-Tash of Varushka became Dean of the Lyceum.

Wintermark.t: Hengest Dun kept Hahnmark's Senate seat, and Yarrick Ursan of Wintermark became Virtue Inquisitor of The Way.

379YE Autumn Equinox Imperial elections.o: The Autumn Equinox 379YE elections filled seats across the Senate, Military Council, Synod, Conclave and Bourse. Several incumbents kept their posts, while Skarsind's Senate seat fell vacant after Relinquish Skarsind was ratified.

Casinea.t: Zephram of Cantiarch's Hold was re-elected as Senator for Casinea.

Hahnmark.t: Hengest Dun was re-elected as Senator for Hahnmark.

Kahraman.t: Kahraman gained a new senator, Maher i Zaydan i Riqueza.

Morrow.t: Ariadne was re-elected as Senator for Morrow.

Semmerholm.t: Semmerholm gained a new senator, Bohemond de Rondell.

Skarsind.t: Skarsind's Senate seat was left vacant after the ratification of Relinquish Skarsind.

Spiral.t: The Legacy is held by the Grendel and will need to be allocated when Spiral is once again an Imperial territory. Damian was named Castellan of Spiral Castle.

Tassato.t: Cesare Sanguineo Rezia Di Tassato was re-elected as Senator for Tassato.

Therunin.t: Caerwyn Summer Crow was re-elected as Senator for Therunin.

Upwold.t: Upwold gained a new senator, Silas.

Volodmartz.t: Volodmartz gained a new senator, Juha the Cave Spider.

379YE Autumn Equinox winds of fortune.d: This summary page linked to many separate events. The vyig suffered setbacks in Sarvos. A briar demagogue spread lies in the Marches. Varushkans in Karsk sought closer ties with their cousins. The Fellowship of Purple Sails took a renewed interest in politics. Fog descended on the Bay of Catazar, and an ancient runeforge was found in Gildenheim. Salt Lord Suriad of the Grendel wrote to the Empire. There was talk of reviving the Hearth Tithe. Skarsind's miners grew restless and a curse struck Urizen. The herald Reed sought a Declaration of Amity. The Castle of Thorns appeared to be failing, vallorn transformations spread from Brocéliande, orcs entered Segura and Jotun raids were repelled. The Reikos flux continued, and exorcisms were ordered at Ennerlund and Reikos.

Dawn.t: Dawn's Castle of Thorns in Astolat, the old seat of its monarchs, appeared to be falling down, and vallorn transformations spilled into Astolat and Semmerholm. Ozren de Orzel of Dawn had been named to oversee the exorcism of the Great Pits at Ennerlund.

Druj.t: The Reikos flux cut a swathe through the Imperial armies fighting the Druj at Urith Barath, in a territory the Druj held.

Grendel.t: The Grendel Salt Lord Suriad sent a reasonably open letter to the Empire about recent treaty negotiations.

Highguard.t: Highguard's Casinea suffered odd transformations from vallorn activity spilling over from Brocéliande, and Highborn benefactors were among the backers of the Fellowship of Purple Sails.

Imperial Orcs.t: Skarsind was due to be handed over to the Imperial Orcs, prompting miners to strip it of metal and spreading dissatisfaction. The presence of Imperial Orc companies in Reikos showed that the flux appears to affect only humans.

Jotun.t: Jotun raids in the west of the Empire were decisively driven back by fortifications and Imperial armies, as the conflict with the Empire moved into an active phase.

The Brass Coast.t: A significant force of orcs crossed from the Lasambrian hills into Segura, and supernatural fog descended along the southern Imperial coast.

The League.t: The vyig suffered significant setbacks in Sarvos, opening an opportunity to dislodge them from the League's cities, while an exorcism of the Great Pits at Ennerlund in Holberg was under way.

Urizen.t: A powerful curse struck the mountains of Urizen, halving crystal mana from its mana sites and causing more than one catastrophic loss of poise.

Varushka.t: With hostilities in Karsk at an end, the Varushkan inhabitants of its northern vales were seeking closer ties with their estranged cousins.

Wintermark.t: With the Jotun conflict turning active, there was talk in Wintermark and the Marches of reviving the Hearth Tithe.

379YE Autumn Equinox winds of fortune.o: The Autumn Equinox 379YE winds of fortune brought news of many events across the Empire, among them setbacks for the vyig in Sarvos, a curse on Urizen's mountains, a supernatural fog over the Bay of Catazar, Jotun raids driven back in the west and orcs crossing into Segura.

Holberg/Ennerlund.t: The Great Pits at Ennerlund, haunted since the previous season, were being exorcised under the oversight of Ozren de Orzel of Dawn.

Astolat.t: Unsettling events struck the Castle of Thorns, the Empire's première academy for civil servants, which appeared to be falling down, and vallorn-driven transformations spilled into the territory.

Bay of Catazar.t: A bank of supernatural fog descended and seemed to stretch along the entire northern half of the bay.

Brocéliande.t: Vallorn activity along Brocéliande's borders spilled over into neighbouring territories, leaving a wave of odd transformations.

Casinea.t: Vallorn activity from Brocéliande spilled into Casinea, leaving odd transformations in its wake.

Holberg.t: The exorcism of the haunted Great Pits at Ennerlund continued under Ozren de Orzel, appointed by the Synod.

Karsk.t: Following the cessation of hostilities, the Varushkan inhabitants of Karsk's northern vales sought closer ties with their estranged cousins.

Reikos.t: The flux continued to rage, damaging resources and ravaging the armies at Urith Barath, while the Synod named High Exorcist Solas to cleanse the haunted Vigilant Swan.

Sarvos.t: The vyig suffered significant setbacks, creating an opportunity to finally dislodge them from the city.

Segura.t: A significant force of orcs crossed into Segura from the Lasambrian hills.

Semmerholm.t: Vallorn activity spilling over from Brocéliande left odd transformations across Semmerholm.

Skarsind.t: Ahead of the handover to the Imperial Orcs, miners were urged to extract as much metal as they could, and dissatisfaction spread.

379YE Autumn Equinox winds of war.d: The Thule left Crowslook and Branoc, which are now neutral, and occupied the Silver Peaks and Stonefield Ice Caves. The Black Thorns cut through Brocéliande and retook Elerael. The Barrens orcs made a confused attack on Drycastle and the Towers of the Dawn, then withdrew. In Holberg, animated trees battered the defences. The Granite Pillar and Quiet Step slowed but could not stop the Grendel in Ateri. In Reikos, Haros Water was cleared, but around 3,500 Imperial troops were lost at Urith Barath to battle and the Reikos flux, and the Winter-animated husks rotted away. Thirty Imperial captains could not stop the Jotun routing the Hierro. The Grendel left Feroz for Kalino.

Dawn.t: Dawnish defenders at Drycastle and the Towers of the Dawn rebuffed a half-hearted Barrens orc attack, and House de Cassilon hosted the Golden Sun at Spiral Castle after ending their decade behind the mists.

Druj.t: The Stone Toad were driven out of Haros Water but held Urith Barath against five Imperial armies, untouched by the flux, while scattered Druj remnants in Holberg turned to banditry.

Grendel.t: The Salt Lords won the first stage of the Siege of Fort Mezudan and took nearly half of Ateri, while their navy left Feroz and appears to have landed a major force in Kalino.

Highguard.t: The Granite Pillar led the defence of Fort Mezudan and bore the bulk of the damage, while the Valiant Pegasus led the costly assault on Urith Barath and fell first and worst to the Reikos flux.

Jotun.t: Jotun armies routed the Lasambrians and took more than half of Reinos, but their raiders on the Wintermark border were savagely beaten back, and they have sent no word to the Empire since warning against aiding the Lasambrians.

Navarr.t: The Black Thorns took losses forcing their way through the vallorn to reclaim Elerael, and Navarr scouts with the Quiet Step supported the defence of Fort Mezudan.

The Brass Coast.t: Imperial armies sent to Feroz found the Grendel gone and spent a peaceful season there, and Suranni merchants on the Brass Coast brought news of the fighting in Kalino.

The League.t: The Wolves of War and their Varushkan wagon-raiders joined the bloody siege of Urith Barath, while League-held Holberg was beset by animated trees.

Thule.t: Under the peace treaty the Thule left Crowslook and Branoc to expand their camp in Krevsaty, and took the Silver Peaks and the ilium-rich Stonefield Ice Caves unopposed.

Urizen.t: The Urizen garrison at Fort Mezudan, their last foothold in Spiral, was besieged by the Grendel, and an Urizen army took heavy losses to disease before Urith Barath.

Varushka.t: The Golden Axe held Karsk in uneasy peace, the Charnel Lord's forces kept to the Broken Barrow, and Varushkans made up much of the Imperial force in the Lasambrian Hills and the Wolves of War's mercenaries.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark's armies left the Silver Peaks to the Thule while the Green Shield guarded the plains, and they vented their frustration by nearly routing Jotun raiders, as many Wintermark captains fought in Reinos.

379YE Autumn Equinox winds of war.o: In the season after the Summer Solstice, the Thule peace treaty took effect, with the Thule leaving two regions of Karsk and the Empire ceding the Silver Peaks in Sermersuaq. Meanwhile the Grendel besieged Fort Mezudan in Spiral, five Imperial armies suffered heavily besieging the Druj citadel of Urith Barath in Reikos, and the Jotun overran much of Reinos despite Imperial captains aiding the Lasambrian orcs.

Brocéliande/Boar's Dell.t: Mentioned in passing: the Navarr who stayed behind there received word that the Black Thorns had reached Elerael.

Brocéliande/Dark Ranging.t: The Black Thorns skirted these vallorn-held woods at speed but still lost soldiers to husks, ettercaps and stranger horrors.

Brocéliande/Elerael.t: The Black Thorns drove out insect abominations and Druj bands so that the miasma receded, putting the region back in Imperial hands, though the army is now hemmed in by dangers on every side.

Holberg/Holfried.t: Marcher yeomen bought nearly every axe in Holfried's markets to fight the animated trees attacking Holberg's walls.

Karsk/Branoc.t: The Thule quietly left the hills of Branoc, leaving the region neutral and open to an Imperial army to claim, perhaps without resistance.

Karsk/Crowslook.t: The Thule quietly left the hills of Crowslook, leaving the region neutral and open to an Imperial army to claim, perhaps without resistance.

Karsk/Krevsaty.t: The withdrawing Thule massed here and greatly expanded their camp at the ruins of Oloy, to the alarm of the isolated defenders of the Krevsaty Yelta.

Karsk/Moresvah.t: Mentioned in passing: its miners profited from the Golden Axe's repairs and re-equipping.

Reikos/Haros Water.t: The last major Druj enclaves were rooted out of Haros Water, where the Valiant Pegasus had sheltered in the ruins of Haros, and the region is now in Imperial hands.

Sermersuaq/East Floes.t: The Green Shield watched from its open plains, ready to stop any Thule advance beyond the foothills, though none came.

Sermersuaq/Silver Peaks.t: The region was surrendered to the Thule, whose white dire-wolf banner now flies there and who expect an excellent bladeroot harvest from the fallen.

Sermersuaq/Suaq Fount.t: The Green Shield watched from its open plains, ready to stop any Thule advance beyond the foothills, though none came.

Spiral/Ateri.t: The Grendel overran the foothills and several spires and began the Siege of Fort Mezudan, which still stands but has been badly damaged.

The Barrens/Dawnguard.t: The Black Thorns set out through Dawnguard, after which the Barrens orcs launched sporadic attacks on Drycastle and the Towers of the Dawn, expecting a surrender that never came.

The Barrens/Murderdale.t: The Black Thorns passed safely through Murderdale with the aid of the Orcs of the Great Forest on their way into Brocéliande.

Brocéliande.t: The Black Thorns pushed past the vallorn to drive insect abominations and Druj bands out of the southern forests, returning Elerael to Imperial hands.

Casinea.t: Mentioned in passing: Fraser de Cassilon names it among the far places of the Empire he longs to see.

Feroz.t: The Grendel fleet had sailed south before the Imperial armies arrived, so the Seventh Wave, the Tusks and the Fire of the South spent a peaceful late Summer there.

Hercynia.t: Mentioned in passing: an Imperial orc legionnaire tells stories of a battle with the Thule there.

Holberg.t: Old Tom's Finest spent the Summer fighting animated trees left by Druj magic, while remnant Druj bands in the northern forests turned to brigandage.

Kalino.t: The Naguerro broke with their allies to defend Kalino and appear to be stalling a much larger Iron Confederacy army, even as a major Grendel force landed on the eastern coast.

Karsk.t: With peace, the Thule left Crowslook and Branoc as neutral ground and dug in at Krevsaty, while the Golden Axe held a wary defence and the Charnel Lord's forces waited at the Broken Barrow.

Morrow.t: Mentioned in passing: the Granite Pillar and the Quiet Step marched through its mountains on their way to Spiral.

Redoubt.t: Mentioned in passing: the Granite Pillar and the Quiet Step marched through its mountains on their way to Spiral.

Reikos.t: Five Imperial armies cleared Haros Water, so two regions are now Imperial, but lost thousands to battle and the Reikos flux besieging Urith Barath on the site of High Chalcis.

Reinos.t: The Jotun outnumbered the Lasambrians four to one and, despite some three thousand Imperial soldiers fighting with the Hierro, routed them and took more than half the territory.

Segura.t: Mentioned in passing: the Hierro chieftain is credited with forging the Lasambrian alliance that conquered Segura.

Sermersuaq.t: Imperial forces withdrew under the treaty and the Thule took the Silver Peaks and Stonefield Ice Caves without a fight, leaving an uneasy peace.

Spiral.t: The Grendel besieged Fort Mezudan, the last Urizen holding here, and now control nearly half of Ateri.

The Barrens.t: The Black Thorns crossed the Barrens with the help of the Orcs of the Great Forest, after which up to fifteen thousand Barrens orcs made a confused, failed attempt on Drycastle and the Towers of the Dawn.

The Semmerlak.t: The Golden Axe camped near the remains of Ivarsgard on its shores, now being reclaimed by forest, and cleared wolves from the ruins and old mines.

Volodmartz.t: Mentioned in passing: Fraser de Cassilon names it among the far places of the Empire he longs to see.

Weirwater.t: The Golden Sun were lavishly hosted and resupplied by House de Cassilon at Spiral Castle, which is to receive its first new Castellan in over a decade.

379YE Spring Equinox Announcements by th.d: The Crystal Architect commissioned two mana sinecures, each costing 10 wains of mithril and 20 crowns in labour, with no upkeep. Tiberius EchoStorm provided the full materials and labour for both after the Spring Equinox. When complete, the Caves of the Claw create the title of Custodian of the Claw, and the Tower of the Fall creates the Keeper of the Tower of the Fall. Both are national positions appointed by unanimous decision of the Urizen senators, serving for life or until revoked. The Caves were to be built in Morrow. Construction of the Tower had not begun, because the Crystal Architect had been unable to provide the relevant information.

Urizen.t: Urizen stands to gain two new national titles, the Custodian of the Claw and the Keeper of the Tower of the Fall, both appointed by unanimous vote of its senators, and Tiberius EchoStorm funded both projects in full.

379YE Spring Equinox Announcements by th.o: At the Spring Equinox 379YE the Crystal Architect of the Spires announced two mana sinecures for Urizen: the Caves of the Claw in Morrow and the Tower of the Fall in Zenith, each creating a new national title.

Morrow.t: The Caves of the Claw, a mana sinecure overseen by the Custodian of the Claw, were commissioned in Morrow and fully funded; the region was not specified.

Zenith.t: The Tower of the Fall, a mana sinecure for the Keeper of the Tower of the Fall, was commissioned for Zenith, but construction had not begun because the Crystal Architect could not supply the needed information.

379YE Spring Equinox Imperial elections.d: New senators were returned for Segura (Avisena i Ezmara i Guerra), Holberg (Rossalyn Jordan), Karsk (Radomir) and Skarsind (Thanmir Hrafn), alongside several Senate appointments including the Advisor on Orc Affairs and the Ambassador to Jarm. Generals were chosen for the Fire of the South, the Valiant Pegasus and the Summer Storm. The Synod elected Cardinals of Ambition, Prosperity and Vigilance, four Gatekeepers, the Auditor of Senatorial Accountability, the Imperial Inquisitor and the Chaplain Consular. Cyrus, son of Felix, became Imperial Magus. Bourse seats and national titles changed hands, including the Master of the Imperial Mint and the Steel Fist.

Dawn.t: Lady Josephine Novarion of Dawn was chosen as Gatekeeper of Pride in the Synod.

Highguard.t: Highborn took several religious and magical posts: Silas of the Suns of Couros became Cardinal of Vigilance, Seraiah Armand became Gatekeeper of Ambition, Sargon of Felix's Watch became Auditor of Senatorial Accountability and Cyrus, son of Felix, became Imperial Magus.

Imperial Orcs.t: The national title of the Steel Fist passed to Irontide Kul.

Navarr.t: Hywel Summercrow of Navarr was appointed Chaplain Consular.

The Brass Coast.t: The Brass Coast gained a new senator for Segura, and the Broken Shore Bounty went to Karlos i Shartha i Riqueza.

The League.t: League citizens took prominent offices: Olek La Maschera Sorridente de Temeschwar became Cardinal of Ambition, Severin Teyhard von Holberg became Imperial Inquisitor, Fererro became Master of the Imperial Mint and Rodrigo Barossa took the Regario Dossier.

Varushka.t: Varushkans took two Synod gatekeeper posts, with Wilhemina Maryenkovich Poltova for Prosperity and Nikolovich Drakov for Vigilance, and Radomir became senator for Karsk.

Wintermark.t: Edythe Dunne of Wintermark became Cardinal of Prosperity, Ogmundr Kaldrheim took the Stonefield Ice Caves and Thanmir Hrafn became senator for Skarsind.

379YE Spring Equinox Imperial elections.o: At the Spring Equinox of 379YE, the Empire filled a range of elected and appointed offices across the Senate, Military Council, Synod, Conclave and Bourse.

Holberg.t: Rossalyn Jordan was returned as senator for Holberg.

Karsk.t: Radomir was returned as senator for Karsk.

Segura.t: Avisena i Ezmara i Guerra was returned as senator for Segura.

Skarsind.t: Thanmir Hrafn was returned as senator for Skarsind.

379YE Spring Equinox winds of fortune.d: Two opportunities were noted: auras of Prosperity in Hahnmark's mines, which drew workers away from other businesses, and a fungus in Miaren that harmed herb gardens but was valued by farmers as a livestock medicine. In Wintermark, the Bane of Tradition set Suaq, Kallavesi and Steinr against one another and strained the Fist of the Mountains and Green Shield. Thule sorcery was the likely culprit. Kallavesa's crystal mana was halved by something separate, and Sermersuaq suffered storms and a Winter magnitude 15 effect that halved its mana. A Winter curse of magnitude 50 blighted Liathaven, Hercynia, Miaren and Therunin, damaging every kind of production before lifting. In Karsk, husk wolves gathered around a ruined fort.

Navarr.t: A Winter curse of magnitude 50 struck only the Navarr, damaging herbs, mines, forests, businesses, congregations, soldiers' equipment and mana sites in four of their territories. Only the draughir were left strangely untroubled.

Thule.t: The Thule were named as the most likely source of the Bane of Tradition, since dividing Wintermark served their invasion. They were also noted as fighting the Varushkans in Karsk.

Varushka.t: Varushka's war with the Thule in Karsk was complicated by reports of husk wolves gathering in western Lestazny, though so far they had not attacked.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark was beset by the Bane of Tradition, which turned its three traditions against one another and threatened the cohesion of its armies. Mana failures in Kallavesa and Sermersuaq added to the strain alongside the Thule invasion.

379YE Spring Equinox winds of fortune.o: The Spring Equinox 379YE winds of fortune reported a wave of troubles across the Empire's north. A supernatural rift was dividing Wintermark's three traditions, its mana in Kallavesa and Sermersuaq was failing, a cursed winter had struck the Navarr territories, and husk wolves were gathering in Karsk. Opportunities also arose from a Prosperity miracle in Hahnmark and a strange fungus in Miaren.

Sermersuaq/Silver Peaks.t: Battle continued in the Silver Peaks, and magicians accompanying the armies there were affected by the same restless, wintry malaise as the rest of Sermersuaq.

Brocéliande.t: Mentioned in passing: noted as the one Navarr territory that appeared to have been spared the cursed winter.

Hahnmark.t: Miraculous auras of Prosperity arose in Hahnmark's mines, boosting mining output but leaving local businesses short of labour. This was presented as an opportunity for a response.

Hercynia.t: Hercynia was battered by the cursed Navarr winter, suffering blight, accidents, ruined stores, sickness and reduced production across its resources.

Kallavesa.t: Roughly half of Kallavesa's crystal mana formed dull and useless, and portents suggested a cause separate from the rift between the traditions.

Karsk.t: Husk wolves made from recent and long-buried corpses gathered around a ruined fort on an old battlefield in western Lestazny. They had not yet attacked any settlements.

Liathaven.t: Liathaven suffered the cursed Navarr winter, with terrible weather, misfortune and sabotaged mana sites cutting its production.

Miaren.t: After an autumn of prosperity, Miaren was hit by the cursed winter. A rare fungus was also harming its herb gardens while being prized by farmers as a livestock remedy, which was presented as an opportunity.

Sermersuaq.t: Unseasonable storms and a Winter magnitude 15 effect halved Sermersuaq's mana production. Its magicians suffered depression, lethargy or bouts of aggression.

Therunin.t: Therunin was among the four Navarr territories struck by the cursed winter, losing production to bad weather, blight and supernatural misfortune.

379YE Spring Equinox winds of war.d: In Holberg, around 36,000 Imperial troops broke the siege of Rebeshof and razed the fortress. They then took Ennerlund and the Morass, despite Druj curses of pestilence and possessed trees. Nearly four thousand Imperial soldiers fell against some eight thousand Druj. A Senate motion of Assignment is now needed. In Karsk the Thule withdrew and both magical citadels were Imperial. In Reikos, Riverwatch, Haros Water and the Vigilant Swan were freed as the Druj fell back to High Chalcis under a pall of dread. In Sermersuaq, Thule sorcery and eternal knights gained ground slowly at the cost of about 1,500 Imperial dead. Fifty companies fought abroad in Faraden and Ipotavo, and storms battered Grendel shipping off Spiral.

Dawn.t: The Golden Sun hunted Druj agents across Holberg and lost about four hundred yeomen and nobles. Meanwhile the Hounds of Glory in Sermersuaq were cheered by rumours that Dawn would soon campaign into the Barrens after the destruction of the Spires of Dusk.

Druj.t: The Druj suffered a crushing defeat in Holberg: about eight thousand dead, the scorpion banner shattered and Rebeshof destroyed. In Reikos they fell back to their citadel at High Chalcis, though they still besiege Ipotavo with around ten thousand orcs.

Grendel.t: Massive storms off Spiral impeded Grendel shipping and prevented any naval reinforcement. Their scouts were spotted in Screed, and an interlude shows Kallavesi raiders attacking a Grendel ship despite the Senate's suggestion not to.

Highguard.t: The Granite Pillar and Valiant Pegasus led the liberation of Riverwatch, Haros Water and the Vigilant Swan, laying the remains of murdered Highborn to rest as they went. Two Highborn captains also joined the defence of Ipotavo.

Jotun.t: Thirty Imperial companies joined General Jekal Swordborn of House Ogudai to drive the Jotun from the hills of Tebukan in Faraden. The outcome remains to be seen.

Navarr.t: The Navarr suffered no significant casualties in Karsk, where the Black Thorns' unliving husks rotted away by the Equinox. In Reikos the Quiet Step suffered from festering wounds, and five Navarr captains fought at Ipotavo.

The Brass Coast.t: The Fire of the South withdrew from Sermersuaq. The Red Wind Corsairs raided Thule parties there, shielded by unliving allies and growing rich on plunder, to the scorn of the Winterfolk who called them maggots.

The League.t: The Wolves of War spearheaded the reconquest of Holberg, returning it to the Empire for the first time in thirty years amid cautious League rejoicing. Several hundred League miners died in the collapse of the Great Pits, and the Towerjacks met privately about taking the field again.

Thule.t: In Karsk the Thule avoided battle and fell back east and north, showing little of their magic. In Sermersuaq, eternal knights of Tykonus and Feresh, monstrous beasts and potent sorcery let them slowly claim another portion of the Silver Peaks.

Urizen.t: The Citadel Guard advised on Holberg's curses, and Urizen sentinels held the breach at Rebeshof. Ten Urizen captains joined the defence of Ipotavo, and in Spiral the Black Plateau stayed quiescent while Grendel scouts appeared in Screed.

Varushka.t: The Northern Eagle held Karsk without significant losses and was strengthened by weapons and recruits from the Moresvah miners. However, Varushka's backwoods allies in Branoc suffered defeat after defeat against the Thule, and two Varushkan captains fought at Ipotavo.

Wintermark.t: The Green Shield and Fist of the Mountains fought side by side in Sermersuaq, eight thousand Winterfolk defending their home. Tensions between the Steinr, Kallavesi and Suaq made it ever harder to keep the armies together.

379YE Spring Equinox winds of war.o: In the Spring Equinox 379YE winds of war, the Empire won a crushing victory in Holberg that returned the territory to the Empire after thirty years. Imperial forces also held Karsk, liberated more of Reikos, and were slowly pushed back by the Thule in Sermersuaq's Silver Peaks.

Holberg/Ennerlund.t: The Empire took Ennerlund after a vicious battle and found the Great Pits collapsed and trapped, with several hundred League miners buried alive. Civil servants are now reporting on whether the mines can be reopened.

Holberg/Holfried.t: Marchers passing through visited the war memorial at Holfried, and the surviving Towerjacks commanders held a closed meeting in its garrison about their future.

Holberg/Holmauer.t: Holmauer's remaining parks were closed and guarded against the possessed trees. A column of Autumn-realm mercenaries arrived through a regio here.
