Holberg/Misericorde.t: Misericorde's trees were infused with malignant spirits, and the fleeing Druj banners retreated into its deep northern forests, which remain beyond Imperial control.

Holberg/Rebeshof.t: After a three-week siege the Imperial armies breached Rebeshof and killed nearly two thousand Druj. The fortress was reduced to worse than rubble, and the region was claimed for the Empire.

Holberg/Utterlund.t: Utterlund's trees were cursed with malignant spirits, and the Druj fled into its deep forests after a costly pitched battle on the forest edge. The region remains beyond the Imperial line.

Karsk/Branoc.t: The backwoods folk of Branoc fought on against the Thule without Imperial army support and suffered heavy losses and repeated defeats.

Karsk/Kopevnost.t: The Black Thorns sheltered in the safe havens of Kopevnost, defending Imperial territory rather than seeking battle.

Karsk/Moresvah.t: An Imperial citadel of ice and ivory stood in southern Moresvah. The region's miners used the lull to deliver ten wagons of arms and new recruits to the Northern Eagle.

Karsk/Nitrost.t: The magical fortress of ice and granite in northern Nitrost belonged to the Empire, providing a safe haven for Imperial armies.

Reikos/Haros Water.t: Imperial forces pushed into Haros Water and fought for three nights in the ruins of Haros town before the retreating Druj set it ablaze.

Reikos/Riverwatch.t: The Empire seized the ruins of Tabernacle and claimed Riverwatch, purging the Druj ambushers left behind.

Sermersuaq/East Floes.t: Mentioned in passing: the roar of the fiery draconic sigil above the northern peaks was heard as far as East Floes.

Sermersuaq/Silver Peaks.t: The Silver Peaks bore the brunt of the Thule assault, and the barbarians claimed another portion of the region. The healing spring waters there lay frozen in ice, and a fiery draconic omen blazed over the northernmost peak.

Sermersuaq/Suaq Fount.t: Mentioned in passing: the roar of the fiery sigil over the northern peaks was heard in Suaq Fount.

Spiral/Screed.t: The night magician Causus reported Grendel scouts in Screed, suggesting the barbarians know the Black Plateau has been neutralised.

Casinea.t: An interlude showed Dawnish knights of the Eastern Sky, billeted in Casinea after their victory in Segura, comically berating a Highborn cook over steamed puddings and water.

Holberg.t: The Empire took Holfried, Holmauer, Rebeshof, Ennerlund and the Morass, though Druj curses of pestilence and possessed trees persist. A Senate motion of Assignment, and possibly one of Allocation for the Great Pits, must now follow.

Kallavesa.t: Mentioned in passing: a Kallavesi sea-raider in an interlude complains that the nights in Kallavesa are cold and they have no ilium.

Karsk.t: Karsk remained Imperial, with both magical citadels now held by the Empire and the hills running green under the spring enchantment. No significant territory changed hands as the Thule withdrew.

Otkodov.t: Mentioned in passing: great blind apes from caverns beneath the mountains of Otkodov fought alongside the Thule in Sermersuaq.

Reikos.t: Imperial forces pushed west as the Druj retreated to High Chalcis, freeing Riverwatch, Haros Water and the ruined Vigilant Swan quarry. A dread miasma and false stars continued to slow the liberation.

Segura.t: Mentioned in passing: Dawnish knights in an interlude are described as having come victorious from Segura.

Sermersuaq.t: The deadlock continued: about 20,000 Imperial defenders held against an overwhelming Thule assault, but were slowly pushed back in the Silver Peaks with some fifteen hundred dead.

Spiral.t: Storms off Spiral's coast blocked Grendel naval reinforcement, and the Black Plateau remained quiescent with some of its afflicted slowly recovering. Grendel scouts in Screed prompted the Urizen to begin preparations.

379YE Summer Solstice Announcements by t.d: The Crystal Architect of the Spires announced his intention to create the Storm Vault, a mana sinecure overseen by the Custodian of the Storm Vault. The project cost 10 wains of mithril and 2 crowns per wain in labour, with no upkeep. Tiberius EchoStorm provided the 10 wains of mithril and 20 crowns after the Summer Solstice. When complete, the Vault automatically creates the Imperial title of Custodian of the Storm Vault, a Urizen national position appointed by unanimous decision of the Urizen senators and held for life or until revoked.

Urizen.t: Urizen gains a new national title, the Custodian of the Storm Vault, which its senators will appoint by unanimous decision once the sinecure is complete.

379YE Summer Solstice Announcements by t.o: At the Summer Solstice 379YE the Crystal Architect of the Spires announced and commissioned the Storm Vault, a mana sinecure to be built in Proceris in Zenith, which would create the national title of Custodian of the Storm Vault.

Zenith/Proceris.t: Proceris was chosen as the site of the Storm Vault, the mana sinecure commissioned by the Crystal Architect of the Spires.

Zenith.t: The Storm Vault mana sinecure is to be constructed in Zenith, with the materials and labour costs paid by Tiberius EchoStorm.

379YE Summer Solstice Imperial elections.d: Senators were returned for Feroz, Astolat, Weirwater, Bastion, Sarvos, Mitwold, Miaren, Redoubt, Karov and Sermersuaq. Lukash Biessek von Temeschwar became Ambassador to the Iron Confederacy and Kellua Itsepainen of Wintermark became Imperial Consul. Ten generals were appointed to lead armies including the Red Wind Corsairs, Golden Sun, Granite Pillar and Citadel Guard. In the Synod, cardinals and gatekeepers of Courage and Wisdom were chosen, and Severin Teyhard von Holberg of the League became Imperial Inquisitor. Kyra of Halcyon Spire became Grandmaster of the Order of the Unfettered Mind. Bourse seats including the Arratan Gamble, Damatian Cliffs, Night Quarry and Sutton Stone Quarries were allocated, the most expensive going for 405 Thrones.

Dawn.t: Dawn's territories of Astolat and Weirwater returned Earl Gregoire De Gauvain and Valentin Ivarovich Orzel as senators, and Abaddon De Rondell of Dawn became Cardinal of Wisdom.

Highguard.t: Solomon was elected Senator for Bastion, and Asher of Felix's Watch in Highguard became Cardinal of Courage.

Navarr.t: Llewellyn Leafstalker was elected Senator for Miaren, Navarr's only territory named in these elections.

The Brass Coast.t: Liythos i Purjo i Guerra was elected Senator for Feroz, and Constanza i Kalamar i Guerra became Mistress of the Glass Parador.

The League.t: Mirislav was elected Senator for Sarvos, and Severin Teyhard von Holberg of the League was named Imperial Inquisitor.

The Marches.t: Bridget Eastville was elected Senator for Mitwold, Pride of the Marches.

Urizen.t: Probus of Shattered Spire was elected Senator for Redoubt, and Livia Cascade of Urizen became Gatekeeper of Wisdom.

Varushka.t: Maximov Strascovich was elected Senator for Karov, Agnieszka Katrinova Prochnost of Varushka became Gatekeeper of Courage, and Zlatimir Prochnost took the Granites of Veltsgorsk.

Wintermark.t: Atte was elected Senator for Sermersuaq, Kellua Itsepainen of Wintermark became Imperial Consul, and Joakim of Wintermark took the Brilliant Shore.

379YE Summer Solstice Imperial elections.o: The results of the Imperial elections at the 379YE Summer Solstice named new senators for ten territories, ten generals of the Military Council, and holders of Synod, Conclave and Bourse positions and several other Imperial titles.

Astolat.t: Earl Gregoire De Gauvain was elected to represent Astolat in the Senate.

Bastion.t: Solomon was elected to represent Bastion in the Senate.

Feroz.t: Liythos i Purjo i Guerra was elected to represent Feroz in the Senate.

Karov.t: Maximov Strascovich was elected to represent Karov in the Senate.

Miaren.t: Llewellyn Leafstalker was elected to represent Miaren in the Senate.

Mitwold.t: Bridget Eastville was elected Senator for Mitwold, Pride of the Marches.

Redoubt.t: Probus of Shattered Spire was elected to represent Redoubt in the Senate.

Sarvos.t: Mirislav was elected to represent Sarvos in the Senate.

Sermersuaq.t: Atte was elected to represent Sermersuaq in the Senate.

Weirwater.t: Valentin Ivarovich Orzel was elected to represent Weirwater in the Senate.

379YE Summer Solstice winds of fortune.d: Four civil servants were murdered before the summit. Delegations converged on Anvil: an Asavean Tarquinius emissary, a Grendel diplomat escorted by a major navy anchored off Feroz, Druj and Thule delegations, orcs from the Barrens crossing Brocéliande, and envoys from the Lasambrian Hills and the Iron Confederacy. Hirak the Huntsmaster announced the Drottningbjotha. The Jotun prepared punitive raids on the Marches, the League and Wintermark. Sickness struck Reikos, Brocéliande's vallorn stirred, Druj-slaughtered slaves' ghosts halted work at the Great Pits of Ennerlund and the Vigilant Swan, the League cities were cursed, Lashonar's heralds unsettled Dawn's soldiers, a treasure was found in Redoubt, and the Seventh Wave fought spring horrors in Casinea.

Dawn.t: Heralds of Lashonar the Loquacious mobbed the Golden Sun with an intoxicating ballad that was affecting Dawn's soldiers, and the situation was likely to escalate if left unchecked.

Druj.t: The Druj sent a diplomatic delegation to Anvil under the protection of the law, while their earlier slaughter of slaves left ghosts haunting Imperial resources and their meddling stirred the vallorn of Brocéliande.

Grendel.t: A major Grendel navy anchored off the southern coast of Feroz, ostensibly as escort for a diplomat coming to negotiate at Anvil, though the threat of violence was palpable.

Highguard.t: The Seventh Wave engaged twisted spring horrors in the Highborn territory of Casinea, and sickness spread among the remaining Highborn population of Reikos.

Jotun.t: The Jotun were about to launch punitive raids across the western border into the Marches, the League and Wintermark, and warned that interference with their conquest of the northern Lasambrian Hills would end the existing peace.

Navarr.t: A group of orcs from the Barrens appeared in the Navarr territory of Brocéliande, apparently bound for Anvil, while the vallorn there thrashed in response to tighter trods and Druj meddling.

The Brass Coast.t: A major Grendel navy dropped anchor off the southern coast of Feroz, posing a palpable threat even as it escorted a diplomat to Anvil.

The League.t: All four League cities were struck by curses harmful to magicians and mana sources, League territories faced impending Jotun raids, and ghosts haunted the Great Pits of Ennerlund in Holberg.

Thule.t: A Thule diplomatic delegation came down from Otkodov to parley with the Empire, and with the Varushkans in particular.

Urizen.t: A Torchbearer and her companion found a treasure with massive implications beneath a shattered tower in Redoubt.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark's people were dealing with a number of curses and blessings, and its territories were among the targets of impending Jotun raids.

379YE Summer Solstice winds of fortune.o: The Summer Solstice 379YE Winds of Fortune gathered news of nearly twenty events facing the Empire, from murdered civil servants and foreign delegations arriving at Anvil to curses, hauntings, sickness and threatened Jotun raids.

Holberg/Ennerlund.t: The Druj slaughter of slaves at the Great Pits of Ennerlund left scores of angry ghosts haunting the mine, preventing all progress on reopening it.

Brocéliande.t: The vallorn of Brocéliande stirred fitfully in response to tighter trods and Druj meddling, and a group of orcs from the Barrens appeared there on their way to Anvil.

Casinea.t: The Seventh Wave engaged twisted spring horrors in Casinea.

Feroz.t: A major Grendel navy dropped anchor off the southern coast of Feroz, escorting a diplomat but carrying a palpable threat of violence.

Holberg.t: Hate-filled ghosts of slaves slaughtered by the Druj haunted the Great Pits of Ennerlund, preventing progress on reopening the Bourse resource.

Otkodov.t: Mentioned in passing: the Thule delegation to Anvil came down from frozen Otkodov.

Redoubt.t: A Torchbearer and her companion found a treasure with massive implications under a shattered tower in Redoubt.

Reikos.t: Sickness struck Reikos, spreading through both the armies there and the remaining Highborn population.

The Barrens.t: Mentioned in passing: the orcs who appeared in Brocéliande on their way to Anvil had come out of the Barrens.

379YE Summer Solstice winds of war.d: Karsk stayed in an uneasy peace. In Reikos the Druj withdrew into Urith Barath (High Chalcis), leaving curses, traps and a miasma of dread, before a blood-red storm brought flooding and severe sickness. In Sermersuaq, Imperial forces repelled a Thule assault of over twenty thousand orcs, and Freeborn raids forced the Thule out of the southern Stonefields, at a cost of over a thousand Imperial dead. Jotun raiders were also destroyed. Holberg was liberated as the Druj fled across the river into the Mallum, though the Scorpion Sting lagged behind. A Grendel navy landed in Spiral, overran the Legacy and much of the territory, and demanded Fort Mezudan surrender or retreat.

Dawn.t: Dawnish knights of the Hounds of Glory swore to hold the Thule back in Sermersuaq, while the Eastern Sky and Golden Sun fought in Holberg and earned grudging respect from the Knights of Eleonaris.

Druj.t: The Druj abandoned most of Reikos for their citadel at High Chalcis, lost Holberg with around three thousand orcs killed or drowned, and remained engaged by Imperial troops besieging them at Ipotavo in Axos.

Grendel.t: The Grendel landed a fresh army from a red-sailed navy, seized the Legacy and much of Spiral, held captured Urizen children aboard their flagships, and demanded that Fort Mezudan surrender or withdraw.

Highguard.t: The Granite Pillar pushed into Haros Water in Reikos, and Highborn priests and magisters struggled to keep the spectre of dread in check among the armies.

Jotun.t: Two large Jotun warbands raiding into Stark and the Suaq Wastes were captured and destroyed by Imperial orc patrols, raising fears that the Jotun might join the fighting in Sermersuaq.

Navarr.t: The Quiet Step advanced cautiously in Reikos, its scouts facing Druj curses near Haros, while Navarr priests and vates fought against the dread and investigated the corrupted rain.

The League.t: Holberg was finally liberated after a thirty-year campaign, a day the League is expected to remember for years, though malignant tree spirits still cause destruction.

Thule.t: The Thule stayed silent in Karsk, but their massive assault in Sermersuaq failed, costing them losses reckoned at half again the Empire's and forcing them to cede the southern Stonefields.

Urizen.t: Urizen lost the Legacy in Ossuary and much of Spiral to the Grendel, its magicians captured or killed, its children taken aboard Grendel ships, and Fort Mezudan was given an ultimatum.

Varushka.t: Varushka kept its hold on western Karsk, sent a final mithril delivery from Moresvah and a gift of mithril to Branoc, while the Golden Axe and Varushkan magicians helped turn the tide in Sermersuaq.

Wintermark.t: The Fist of the Mountains refused to cede ground in Sermersuaq, rejoined the Green Shield in fellowship as the curse of tradition broke, and the Winterfolk turned scornful of the Freeborn and their undead allies.

379YE Summer Solstice winds of war.o: In Summer 379YE the Empire held the line against the Thule in Sermersuaq, completed the Liberation of Holberg and inched forward in Reikos, but a major Grendel offensive seized the Legacy in Ossuary and threatened all of Spiral.

Holberg/Ennerlund.t: Mentioned in passing: Imperial forces swept from the plains of Ennerlund into the forests to begin the final campaign.

Holberg/Misericorde.t: Misericorde was the scene of the campaign's most vicious fighting, with Druj burned out of their bolt-holes before breaking and fleeing across the river.

Holberg/Rebeshof.t: Mentioned in passing: the Scorpion Sting is described as the remnant of the army that once ruled from the fallen citadel of Rebeshof.

Holberg/Utterlund.t: The once-tamed woods of Utterlund, twisted by Druj magic into hostile thickets of living briars and trees, were one of the final battlefields of the liberation.

Karsk/Branoc.t: Forces loyal to the sovereign of Branoc kept their distance from the Thule, and the people of the Broken Hill received a Varushkan gift of mithril after sharing hospitality with the hillsfolk of Nitrost.

Karsk/Lestasny.t: A twisted fortress of trees watched over Lestasny, young people of Kosti and Veresk spoke of founding a new settlement there, and rumours of husks in its south-western forests came to nothing.

Karsk/Moresvah.t: The Malinov, Sloev and Pravin families of Moresvah sent their final delivery of mithril and volunteers to the Northern Eagle before turning to their own concerns.

Karsk/Nitrost.t: The unliving army of the accused faded into the hills of Nitrost and the citadel of ice and bone stood unmelted, its garrison idle as the Thule did not come.

Reikos/Haros Water.t: The Valiant Pegasus and Granite Pillar pushed into Haros Water against curses, poisoned land and traps, but made little real progress before the storms and sickness struck.

Sermersuaq/Silver Peaks.t: The Thule launched a huge assault to seize the last parts of the Silver Peaks they did not control, but the Imperial defences held.

Sermersuaq/Stark.t: Jotun warbands reaving into Stark were captured and destroyed by Imperial orc patrols.

Sermersuaq/Suaq Fount.t: The Winter Sun tracked and killed Thule raiding parties trying to slip into Suaq Fount to circle the Imperial line.

Sermersuaq/Suaq Wastes.t: Probing Jotun raids into the Suaq Wastes were intercepted and destroyed by Imperial orc patrols.

Spiral/Ankra.t: Grendel forces marching from the Legacy re-established uncontested control over Ankra.

Spiral/Apstrus.t: The newly landed Grendel army crushed all resistance in Apstrus.

Spiral/Apulus.t: The Grendel navy anchored off Apulus to land thousands of troops, crushed all resistance there, and set surrendered Urizen to building siege engines under the command of Garaigh the Gentle.

Spiral/Cinion.t: Grendel forces re-established uncontested control over Cinion as they advanced towards Fort Mezudan.

Spiral/Ossuary.t: A lightning Grendel strike overwhelmed the token Urizen force at the Legacy, which was plundered and fortified before reinforcements from Fort Mezudan could arrive.

Spiral/Screed.t: The Grendel struck Screed and the Black Plateau in force, rounding up Urizen magicians who were helping those freed from the Plateau's fading influence.

Holberg.t: The Druj were driven out of Holberg across the river into the Mallum, completing its liberation, though about a thousand Scorpion Sting troops still lingered near the river.

Karsk.t: Karsk remained an Imperial territory in a strained peace with the Thule occupying its east, with only minor scouting clashes and a promising harvest for Varushkan farms.

Redoubt.t: Mentioned in passing: the Grendel invited the garrison of Fort Mezudan to retreat westward to Redoubt as an alternative to surrender.

Reikos.t: Imperial armies made little progress against Druj curses, traps and pervasive dread before a blood-red storm flooded the territory and brought serious sickness.

Sermersuaq.t: The Empire held its positions for the first time in the war and reclaimed the southern Stonefields, but lost over a thousand troops while the Thule still held the upper passes.

Spiral.t: A Grendel landing and northern offensive overran much of Spiral, with the invaders appearing intent on taking the entire territory.

Zenith.t: Mentioned in passing: the Urizen sentinels retreated north into Zenith with the few survivors rescued from the Legacy.

379YE Winter Solstice Imperial elections.d: Ten territories were due to appoint senators, each by its own national custom, from Dawn's Tourney for Astolat to the largest purse for Madruga. Skarsind was to elect the first Imperial Orc senator. Generals were due for seven armies and an admiral for the Brass Coast navy, chosen unanimously by national senators or else by the Senate. The orc tradition of choosing generals by contest in the fighting pit was expected to face scrutiny. The Synod was to fill Cardinals of the Way and Prosperity, the Conscience of the Senate, the High Exorcist and the Voice of Barbs. The Bourse had five weirwood seats at auction, the Senate was to decide the Vigilant Swan's allocation, and several national ministries were open.

Dawn.t: Dawnish nobles whose houses held no Senate seat could compete in the Tourney for Astolat's seat, and the generalship of the Hounds of Glory was also to be filled.

Highguard.t: Chapters in Necropolis could put forward candidates for the Highborn senator, chosen by citizens with congregations.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Imperial Orcs were to elect their first ever senator, for Skarsind, and the Winter Sun needed a general, though the custom of choosing generals in the fighting pit was expected to come under scrutiny now the orcs had a senator.

Navarr.t: The Navarr were to elect a senator for Hercynia in an open-air vote, appoint the Voice of Barbs through their national assembly, and choose the holder of the Thimble from among herb garden holders.

The Brass Coast.t: Freeborn dhomiro could bid for the right to appoint Madruga's senator, an admiral was needed for the Freeborn navy, and fleet captains were to choose the Dhomiro of the Cinnabar Hills.

The League.t: Temeschwari business owners were to back candidates for their senator, and the Towerjacks needed a general.

The Marches.t: Bregasland farm owners were to align with stewards to name their senator, the Strong Reeds needed a general, and Marcher farmers could vote for the Bailiff of the Grand Market.

Urizen.t: Zenith's spires could put up candidates for senator, voted on by the territory's ritual magicians, while Urizen mana site owners were to choose the Provost of the Halls of Knowledge.

Varushka.t: Any Varushkan could stand for Miekarova's seat, with the wise ones judging the wisest candidate, and the Army of the Golden Axe needed a general.

Wintermark.t: Any Wintermark citizen could stand for Kallavesa's seat, decided by the Kallavesi alone, and the Green Shield Army needed a general.

379YE Winter Solstice Imperial elections.o: The page set out the Imperial titles up for election or appointment at the 379YE Winter Solstice, including ten Senate seats (among them the first Imperial Orc senator for Skarsind), seven Military Council posts, several Synod and Conclave titles, and a number of Bourse seats.

Astolat.t: Astolat's senator was to be decided by a Tourney open to nobles whose houses did not already hold a Senate seat.

Bregasland.t: Marchers owning farms in Bregasland were to align with stewards to compete for the right to name the territory's senator.

Hercynia.t: Any Navarr could stand for Hercynia's seat, but only those with resources in Hercynia could vote in the open-air election.

Kahraman.t: The Dhomiro of the Cinnabar Hills, chosen by Freeborn fleet captains, would take responsibility for looking after Kahraman along with the right to buy trade goods.

Kallavesa.t: Only the Kallavesi were to have a say in who would represent their marshy territory in the Senate.

Madruga.t: The Freeborn dhomiro who put in the largest purse would claim the right to appoint Madruga's senator.

Miekarova.t: Miekarova's senator was to be the candidate the wise ones judged the wisest.

Necropolis.t: Chapters in Necropolis could each put forward a candidate for senator, with Highborn citizens holding congregations selecting the best.

Skarsind.t: Skarsind was to elect the first Imperial Orc senator at this Solstice.

Temeschwar.t: Citizens running businesses in Temeschwar were to throw their weight behind their favoured candidate for senator.

Zenith.t: Each spire in Zenith could put forward a candidate, with the territory's ritual magicians voting on who would represent them.

379YE Winter Solstice Senate sessions.d: The treasury stood at 1534 thrones and 4 crowns, with no donations. Passed motions included creating the Seer of the Gateway, Trade Envoy to the Sarcophan Delves and Civilian Commissioners titles, constructing a mithril mine, the Tassato Mana Exchange, Mines of Gulhule, Torfast Trading Post and a shrine to Britta, fortifying the Ore Hills, raising the Imperial Guerdon and declaring war on the Barrens orcs. A disbursement to Senator Sarvos failed and the Ministry for Jarmish Slaves was withdrawn. The civil service asked whether the Brilliant Shore seat, held by the Steinr Joakim, should be reappointed by the Imperial Orcs now or remain with him until Summer 380YE or his death.

Imperial Orcs.t: With Skarsind now theirs, the Brilliant Shore automatically became an Imperial Orc national bourse seat, though the civil service asked the Senate whether the orcs should reappoint it this Solstice or leave it with its current holder.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark lost the Brilliant Shore as a national bourse resource with Skarsind's transfer, though the Steinr Joakim still held the seat pending the Senate's advice on whether he keeps it until Summer 380YE or his death.

379YE Winter Solstice Senate sessions.o: At the 379YE Winter Solstice the Senate passed a long slate of motions, including declaring war on the Barrens orcs, abrogating the Asavean trade ban and authorising numerous constructions, while the civil service sought guidance on the Brilliant Shore bourse seat now that Skarsind is Imperial Orc territory.

Skarsind.t: Skarsind's change of hands to the Imperial Orcs created an unprecedented question over its Brilliant Shore bourse seat, which the civil service referred to the Senate.

379YE Winter Solstice winds of fortune.d: The Senate's decision to relinquish Skarsind was ratified and the territory assigned to the Imperial Orcs, while Thane Dogri Thulebane claimed Crow's Ridge for Wintermark. Reikos was liberated. Curses blighted the Marcher harvest and Bastion, and a Summer enchantment settled over Varushka. Vigilance launched a crusade against the vyig. Druj, Thule, Grendel and Barrens orc delegations headed to Anvil. The Iron Confederacy finished conquering Kalino and sought a treaty. The Hierro camped near Anduz, and Britta's regalia was interred in Kallavesa. Opportunities included a Dawnish crusade on Dawnguard and a northern discovery. In Karsk the Thule withdrew, road rebuilding began, but no progress was made on mustering the Iron Helm.

Dawn.t: Troubadours urged Dawn to raise a fourth army and launch a major assault on Dawnguard and the Towers of the Dawn to conquer the Barrens; this was presented as an opportunity, not an action taken.

Druj.t: The Druj sent a delegation to Anvil and had been driven out of Holberg, though their legacy of ruins, marshes and killer trees remained there.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: a Grendel delegation was among the barbarian orcs travelling to Anvil for the Solstice.

Highguard.t: Highguard saw Reikos liberated and a preacher named Golan rise there, while a curse of hail, sleet and doubt struck at the faith of Bastion and Britta's regalia left the Necropolis.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Senate assigned Skarsind to the Imperial Orcs as their homeland, uniting the nation in one place for the first time. However, Winterfolk under Dogri Thulebane claimed Crow's Ridge, and groups of ambitious bonesetters offered the orcs opportunities.

Jotun.t: Mentioned in passing: the Hearth Tithe herbs grown in the Marches and Wintermark were intended to help the war against the Jotun.

The Brass Coast.t: The Hierro clan camped near Anduz in Segura, and a magical wind across four Freeborn territories summoned the hakima and the Kohan to a council.

The League.t: The Vigilance assembly launched a crusade against the vyig in Temeschwar, Tassato and Holberg, and Holberg continued to suffer the aftermath of Druj occupation.

The Marches.t: Serious curses devastated the Autumn harvest across Upwold, Mitwold and Bregasland, threatening military supplies and food prices. Marcher farms also set aside land for the Hearth Tithe, and peculiar births occurred near King's Stoke.

Thule.t: The Thule withdrew from most of Karsk under the peace treaty, received the Silver Peaks, and sent a delegation to Anvil.

Urizen.t: Urizen made its decision on how to use a trove of mage weapons and armour found beneath the Unmade Spire in Redoubt.

Varushka.t: A powerful Summer enchantment settled over the whole of Varushka. Meanwhile the Golden Axe reassured Karsk, roads were rebuilt, and colleges began construction in Volchitrava and Mieriada.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark's pride festered over the surrender of the Silver Peaks, and Dogri Thulebane claimed Crow's Ridge for the nation. The Hearth Tithe was reintroduced, Britta's regalia was interred in Kallavesa, and a far-northern discovery offered an opportunity.

379YE Winter Solstice winds of fortune.o: The Winter Solstice 379YE Winds of Fortune summarised the season's events across the Empire. These included the Senate assigning Skarsind to the Imperial Orcs, Reikos being liberated, curses on the Marches and Bastion, a crusade against the vyig, and barbarian delegations travelling to Anvil.

Holberg/Holmauer.t: The ruins of Holmauer remained as part of the Druj legacy in Holberg.

Holberg/The Morass.t: Mentioned in passing: the page refers generally to spreading marshes left by the Druj in Holberg.

Karsk/Branoc.t: The Golden Axe swept through Branoc, reassuring the Varushkan people that the orcs had gone.

Karsk/Crowslook.t: The Golden Axe swept through Crowslook, reassuring the Varushkan people that the orcs had gone.

Karsk/Krevsaty.t: Under the peace treaty, the Thule withdrew their Karsk forces to the north-eastern hills of Krevstay.

Karsk/Moresvah.t: The miners of Moresvah offered aid towards restoring the Iron Helm, but no progress had been made on mustering it.

Miekarova/Mieriada.t: Construction began in Mieriada on the Hearth of the Tempest, intended to aid the exploration of Spring magic.

Redoubt/Tomari.t: Mentioned in passing: the page names the Unmade Spire in Redoubt, where the trove was found, but does not name Tomari.

Sermersuaq/Silver Peaks.t: The Silver Peaks had been surrendered to the Thule, a loss that continued to wound Wintermark's pride.

Skarsind/Crow’s Ridge.t: Thane Dogri Thulebane declared Crow's Ridge part of Wintermark, and his followers took Crow's Keep as their base and drew in disgruntled Winterfolk.

The Barrens/Dawnguard.t: Dawnguard and the Towers of the Dawn were the proposed target of a major Dawnish crusade.

Upwold/Tower March.t: Half a dozen very peculiar births occurred near the town of King's Stoke in Tower March.

Astolat.t: Mentioned in passing: not named directly; the page refers only to a possible fourth army being raised in Dawn for a crusade.

Bastion.t: An insidious curse of hail, sleet and a malign aura encouraging doubt in faith lay over Bastion for three months.

Bregasland.t: Curses devastated Bregasland's Autumn harvest as part of the attack on the Marches' farms.

Casinea.t: Mentioned in passing: Casinea is not named directly on this page.

Feroz.t: A magical wind blew across Feroz calling the hakima and the Kohan to a council.

Holberg.t: Holberg was a target of Vigilance's crusade against the vyig, and the Druj legacy of ruins, spreading marshes and killer trees lingered after their expulsion.

Kahraman.t: A magical wind blew across Kahraman calling the hakima and the Kohan to a council.

Kalino.t: The Iron Confederacy had apparently finished conquering Kalino from the Lasambrians, giving them a land border with the Empire.

Kallavesa.t: The regalia of Empress Britta was interred alongside her body in the marshes of Kallavesa.

Karsk.t: Thule forces withdrew to the north-eastern hills under the peace treaty, and Senate-approved road rebuilding began. However, no progress was made on mustering the Iron Helm.

Madruga.t: A magical wind blew across Madruga calling the hakima and the Kohan to a council.

Miekarova.t: Construction began in Miekarova's Mieriada region on the Hearth of the Tempest, intended to aid the exploration of Spring magic.

Mitwold.t: Curses devastated Mitwold's Autumn harvest, damaging the Marches' farms.

Necropolis.t: The regalia of Empress Britta was removed from her shrine in the Necropolis and taken to Kallavesa.

Redoubt.t: Urizen decided how to use the trove of mage weapons and armour found beneath the Unmade Spire in Redoubt.

Reikos.t: Reikos was liberated and became Imperial territory again, though some barbarian orcs remained. The preacher Golan began calling there for Courage to be recognised as the most fundamental virtue.

Segura.t: Orcs of the Hierro clan camped close to the walls of Anduz, and Segura also felt the magical wind summoning the hakima and the Kohan.

Sermersuaq.t: The surrender of Sermersuaq's Silver Peaks to the Thule left a festering wound in Wintermark's pride.

Skarsind.t: Skarsind was assigned to the Imperial Orcs, but Dogri Thulebane's Winterfolk followers seized Crow's Keep and claimed Crow's Ridge for Wintermark.

Tassato.t: Tassato was a target of Vigilance's crusade against the vyig.

Temeschwar.t: Temeschwar was a target of Vigilance's crusade against the vyig.

The Barrens.t: Dawnish troubadours called for a major assault to conquer the Barrens, and the independent Barrens orcs sent a delegation to Anvil.

Upwold.t: Curses devastated Upwold's harvest, and peculiar births were reported near King's Stoke.

379YE Winter Solstice winds of war.d: A magical Spring storm levelled Fort Mezudan, killing seventy including Illuminate Nissea, before Imperial armies pushed the Grendel out of Ateri. With Urith Barath fallen, Dawnish and Navarr armies swept Longshire and Broken Ride, freeing slaves and making Reikos Imperial again, though orcs linger in Tamarbode and Grey Charge. Rahvin-led Barrens orcs badly damaged the Towers of the Dawn. Freeborn armies were roughly halfway to taking Liath's Ring, but around forty thousand Jotun overran Western Scout and Beacon Point, slaughtering Navarr and leaving all of Liathaven in Jotun hands. In the Mournwold, Marcher, Imperial Orc and Highborn armies retook the Ore Hills with an unfinished Jotun fortress and advanced into Freemoor.

Dawn.t: The Hounds of Glory and Eastern Sky crushed the orcs of Longshire and helped clear Exile, but at home the Rahvin-led Barrens orcs left the Towers of the Dawn badly damaged and Dawnguard under threat.

Druj.t: The Stone Toad clan was broken and scattered after the fall of Urith Barath, losing Reikos save for scattered remnants in Tamarbode, Grey Charge and the Great Forest.

Grendel.t: Grendel sorcery destroyed Fort Mezudan, but their armies lost perhaps three thousand orcs and were pushed out of Ateri, withdrawing in good order to Apulus and Screed while gathering mana and metal.

Highguard.t: Highborn chapter banners flew once more over Chalcis Mount as Reikos returned to Imperial hands, though the territory lies ruined and much of its population is dead or exiled; Highborn armies also fought in Spiral and the Mournwold.

Imperial Orcs.t: Both Imperial Orc armies joined the Mournwold offensive, the Summer Storm and Winter Sun helping take the Ore Hills before pushing north into Freemoor.

Jotun.t: The Jotun lost the Ore Hills and their unfinished fortress and fell back in Freemoor, but a vast force conquered southern Liathaven, giving them control of every region there.

Navarr.t: The Black Thorns liberated Broken Ride and around a hundred and fifty slaves, but the Navarr of southern Liathaven were butchered by the Jotun, with survivors fleeing or hiding.

The Brass Coast.t: The Red Wind Corsairs and Fire of the South pushed into northern Liathaven and were around halfway to taking Liath's Ring, poised to besiege Mournstead, as the Corsairs' husks finally collapsed.

The League.t: Mentioned in passing: the Fire of the South marched through Tassato, and the Mournwold advance may eventually shield Tassato from the Jotun.

The Marches.t: The Tusks and Bounders led the first Marcher advance into the Mournwold in a generation, retaking the Ore Hills, facing human collaborators and gaining a handful of local Marcher rebels in Freemoor.

Thule.t: Mentioned in passing: the peace treaty with the Thule appeared to be holding.

Urizen.t: Urizen lost Fort Mezudan and seventy people, including Illuminate Nissea and most of the stone-crafters guild, though Ateri was retaken and Urizeni tacticians estimate six months to conquer Screed.

Wintermark.t: Mentioned in passing: the Red Wind Corsairs marched south out of Wintermark, and Wintermark sellswords fought with the Wolves of War in Spiral.

379YE Winter Solstice winds of war.o: In late 379YE the Empire recaptured Reikos from the Druj and drove the Grendel out of Ateri in Spiral, though Grendel sorcery destroyed Fort Mezudan. Imperial armies also began retaking the Mournwold, while the Jotun conquered southern Liathaven and the Barrens orcs besieged the Towers of the Dawn.

Liathaven/Beacon Point.t: The Jotun took the region, and the Southern Bear burnt its fortified steading to the ground after a two-day siege.

Liathaven/Liath's Heart.t: Mentioned in passing: one of the vallorn-infested regions that any force must pass through to cross between northern and southern Liathaven.

Liathaven/Liath's Ring.t: The Freeborn armies are a little over halfway to taking the region and nearly ready to besiege the Jotun supply fort of Mournstead.

Liathaven/Western Scout.t: A huge Jotun force overran the region, capturing or burning steadings and killing the Navarr they caught.

Liathaven/Westwood.t: Mentioned in passing: one of the vallorn-infested regions that any force must pass through to cross between northern and southern Liathaven.

Mournwold/Freemoor.t: The Tusks and Imperial Orcs freed a little under half the region against strong resistance, joined by around two-score local Marcher rebels.

Mournwold/Greensward.t: The Imperial armies massed at Overton to launch the liberation, and Orchard's Watch was completed here as the Solstice began.

Mournwold/Ore Hills.t: Liberated after a brutal two-day battle; the captured, damaged Jotun fortress could be finished in six months for forty white granite and ten Thrones.

Mournwold/Southmoor.t: The region remains in Jotun hands, anchored by their white granite castle Hillstop in the ruins of Sarcombe, now mirrored by Orchard's Watch.

Reikos/Broken Ride.t: The Black Thorns destroyed the fleeing Druj and freed around a hundred and fifty slaves, though the overseer burnt the weirwood harvest; Dawn and Navarr then cleared the defiled ruins of Exile.

Reikos/Chalcis Mount.t: With Urith Barath torn down, High Chalcis was retaken and Highborn chapter banners were raised over the shattered ruin.

Reikos/Grey Charge.t: Still technically under orc control, but its orcs are scattered and weak with nowhere to flee.

Reikos/Longshire.t: The Hounds of Glory and Eastern Sky overwhelmed the region's scattered brigand orcs and swept it clean.

Reikos/Tamarbode.t: Still technically under orc control, but its orcs are scattered and weak with nowhere to flee.

Spiral/Apulus.t: Most of the retreating Grendel withdrew here, likely to draw on supplies from their naval forces.

Spiral/Ateri.t: Imperial armies drove the Grendel out over three months of bitter fighting, inflicting around three thousand casualties.

Spiral/Ossuary.t: Mentioned in passing: the Empire made no headway towards the Legacy in Ossuary, seen perhaps only by Quiet Step scouts.

Spiral/Screed.t: About a third of the retreating Grendel dug in around Screed, which Urizeni tacticians estimate could take six months to conquer near the Black Plateau.

The Barrens/Dawnguard.t: Barrens orcs besieged the Towers of the Dawn and raided manor houses, leaving the towers below half strength as the only bar to the region's swift conquest.

Bastion.t: Mentioned in passing: named as one place the remaining Reikos orcs cannot hope to escape to.

Bregasland.t: Mentioned in passing: the two Brass Coast armies joined forces here before pushing out of the marshes into Liathaven.

Brocéliande.t: Mentioned in passing: named as a possible refuge for fleeing Reikos orcs and a possible route for any new threat to Reikos.

Casinea.t: Mentioned in passing: the Silent Sentinel waits there should Reikos orcs flee west.

Feroz.t: Mentioned in passing: the Fire of the South marched north up the coast from Feroz.

Kahraman.t: Mentioned in passing: the Jotun fort of Hillstop watches the approach from Kahraman, and Navarr survivors from Liathaven may try to flee through its bandit-haunted mountains.

Liathaven.t: The Freeborn made slow progress in the north, but the Jotun conquered the south, butchered Navarr steadings and now control every region, with the vallorn dividing the two fronts.

Mitwold.t: Mentioned in passing: home to Marcher exiles who fled the Mournwold.

Mournwold.t: Imperial armies began liberating the territory, retaking the Ore Hills and nearly half of Freemoor, while Orchard's Watch was completed in Greensward opposite the Jotun castle in Southmoor.

Reikos.t: Reikos is Imperial again after Longshire and Broken Ride were liberated and magical rain cleansed the Flux, though the land is ruined, the miasma lingers and the Senate must assign it.

Reinos.t: Mentioned in passing: part of the Jotun host that invaded southern Liathaven came north out of the hills of Reinos.

Sermersuaq.t: Mentioned in passing: cited as an example of how costly a committed barbarian force can make reconquest.

Spiral.t: Fort Mezudan was destroyed by a Spring storm, but Imperial armies retook Ateri; the rest of Spiral remains firmly in Grendel hands.

Tassato.t: Mentioned in passing: the Fire of the South passed through, and the Mournwold campaign aims to place a barrier between the Jotun and the city.

The Barrens.t: The independent Barrens orcs, led by the Rahvin, launched a renewed assault from the wilds on Dawnguard, badly damaging the Towers of the Dawn while largely sparing civilians.

Upwold.t: Mentioned in passing: home to Marcher exiles who fled the Mournwold.

380YE Autumn Equinox Imperial elections.d: New senators took office for Kahraman, Semmerholm, Casinea, Upwold and Volodmartz. Incumbents were returned for Tassato, Therunin, Morrow and Hahnmark. Yelislaveta Syrnova Vlanich became Senator for Miekarova after the previous holder was executed. Generals were chosen for six armies, four of them incumbents. The Synod chose new Cardinals of Loyalty and Pride, gatekeepers, virtue inquisitors and a Dean of Laroc Cathedral. Bourse seats were allocated, with the Fortress of Salt going for 600 thrones. The Great Mine of Briante and an unnamed Sermersuaq region still needed allocating, and several posts were left unfilled. The page was updated throughout the event.

Dawn.t: Escalados de Carsenere became Senator for Semmerholm. Dawn also gained Rodrigo Whittington as Virtue Inquisitor of Courage and Lady Eleanor de Rondell as Dean of Laroc Cathedral.

Highguard.t: Barrabas became Senator for Casinea. Ephrael of Highguard was returned as Virtue Inquisitor of Pride, and Brother Luke of the Shattered Tower kept the post of Master of Ice and Darkness.

Navarr.t: Caerwyn Summer Crow was returned as Senator for Therunin, and Corwin Leafstalker of Navarr became Virtue Inquisitor of Loyalty.

The Brass Coast.t: Qusay i Kalamar i Guerra was elected Senator for Kahraman.

The League.t: Cesare Sanguineo Rezia Di Tassato kept his seat for Tassato. League citizens also took Synod posts: Oberon Di Tassato as Cardinal of Loyalty, and Astrid Fjellrevening Rezia di Tassato returned as Gatekeeper of Pride.

The Marches.t: Henry Ward became Senator for Upwold. Tess of the Marches became Gatekeeper of Loyalty, and Silas Merrick was named Civilian Commissioner for The Marches.

Urizen.t: Ariadne was returned as Senator for Morrow.

Varushka.t: Vuk the wolf-eater became Senator for Volodmartz and Yelislaveta Syrnova Vlanich took Miekarova after its previous senator was executed. Elka Nadayanova Gremani of Varushka became Cardinal of Pride.

Wintermark.t: Hengest Dun was returned as Senator for Hahnmark, and Tyr Brenna was named Civilian Commissioner for Wintermark.

380YE Autumn Equinox Imperial elections.o: At the 380YE Autumn Equinox, ten Imperial Senators were elected or returned, alongside new holders of Senate, Military Council, Synod, Conclave and Bourse positions.

Casinea.t: Casinea elected Barrabas as its senator.

Hahnmark.t: Hahnmark returned its incumbent senator, Hengest Dun.

Kahraman.t: Kahraman elected Qusay i Kalamar i Guerra as its senator.

Miekarova.t: Miekarova's previous senator had been executed, and Yelislaveta Syrnova Vlanich was elected to the seat.

Morrow.t: Morrow returned its incumbent senator, Ariadne.

Semmerholm.t: Semmerholm elected Escalados de Carsenere as its senator.

Tassato.t: Tassato returned its incumbent senator, Cesare Sanguineo Rezia Di Tassato.

Therunin.t: Therunin returned its incumbent senator, Caerwyn Summer Crow.

Upwold.t: Upwold elected Henry Ward as its senator.

Volodmartz.t: Volodmartz elected Vuk the wolf-eater as its senator.

380YE Autumn Equinox winds of fortune.d: An unnatural blizzard besieged the Icy Crag of the Eternal Sun, and a conjunction of the Web and the Chain strengthened emotional bonds. A Marcher friar urged citizens not to sell treasure to the Bourse, and a goat-footed spirit troubled the Imperial Orcs and Wintermark. Heralds of Lashonar sang against war, the Congregation of the First Empress grew, and mysterious hunters raided Sermersuaq. The orcs of the Great Forest entered Therunin as guests, and strange blessed weapons emerged from the fallen Mournwold. Sermersuaq's mithril mine neared completion and the Great Pits of Ennerlund resumed production. Tassato's Penumbral Veil faded, while Optarion's fortification and Holberg's lands remained under threat.

Dawn.t: Heralds of Lashonar visited Dawn singing songs of sorrow that cast war as a horror to be avoided. Dawn is also tagged in the storms and rumoured beasts troubling the Semmerlak.

Druj.t: Mentioned in passing: their earlier sabotage is blamed for the spreading Holberg marshes, and they are noted as past conquerors of the Great Pits of Ennerlund; the stars have also vanished over the Barrens.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: they are noted as remaining a significant threat in Spiral despite its reclamation.

Highguard.t: The Congregation of the First Empress, and the influence of the living Paragon Yael of Felix's Watch, continued to grow. Highguard's claim to Empress Giselle's sarcophagus remained unresolved, and the nation was tagged in the Mournwold developments.

Imperial Orcs.t: A bizarre shaggy beast seen around Pakaanan's Pass carried a cryptic, unsettling message for the Imperial Orcs. The stars vanished over Skarsind, and the nation was tagged in the Mournwold developments.

Jotun.t: Mentioned in passing: they are not named, but the Mournwold they hold is described as the lost Marcher territory from which eerie blessed weapons and strange ideas are emerging.

Navarr.t: The orcs of the Great Forest entered Therunin as guests of the Navarr, and intense negotiation is needed over what this means for the future.

The Brass Coast.t: Mentioned in passing: Segura is listed among the territories whose stars have vanished.

The League.t: Celebrations marked Empress Lisabetta's coronation, and the Penumbral Veil over Tassato finally faded. The League's dispute with Highguard over Empress Giselle's sarcophagus continued, and Holberg faced costly choices as its marshes spread.

The Marches.t: Friar Alyn of Hay toured the Marches urging citizens not to sell treasure to the Imperial Bourse. Eerie blessed weapons and strange ideas began emerging from the fallen Mournwold, and the stars vanished over Bregasland.

Urizen.t: Spiral was reclaimed for the Empire, though the Grendel remain a threat there. The Court of the White Fountain in Optarion continued to crumble under a winter curse.

Varushka.t: An unnatural blizzard besieged the castle on the Icy Crag of the Eternal Sun, while the Semmerlak was wracked by night storms and rumoured beasts. The stars vanished over Volodmartz, Karsk and Miekarova.

Wintermark.t: A strange spirit troubled the Winterfolk around Northspires, and mysterious hunters began bloodless raids in Sermersuaq. The new Sermersuaq mithril mine neared completion, and the Senate may decide whether it becomes an Imperial or a Wintermark national resource.

380YE Autumn Equinox winds of fortune.o: The Autumn Equinox 380YE Winds of Fortune gathered the season's developments across the Empire. They included celebrations for Empress Lisabetta's coronation, the reclamation of Spiral, the vanishing of the stars over ten territories, the impending fall of the Stalker comet, and the continuing spread of Holberg's marshes.

Hahnmark/Northspires.t: The bizarre, shaggy beast was occasionally sighted around Northspires.

Holberg/Ennerlund.t: The Great Pits of Ennerlund produced their first Imperial mithril since the Druj conquest, with the seat going to auction. Unless the Senate funds new dikes, the region will become a marsh by the Winter Solstice, raising the Pits' upkeep by 2 Thrones a season.

Holberg/Rebeshof.t: Large sections of Rebeshof reverted to sodden marsh, and the region was officially declared a marsh. It is now too late to prevent this.

Holberg/The Morass.t: The marshes of the Morass continued to spread unchecked after last season's enchantment, swallowing Rebeshof and threatening Ennerlund.

Miekarova/Srodkoja.t: An unnaturally strong, unrelenting blizzard roared around the castle on the Icy Crag of the Eternal Sun, leaving the vale and people of Volchitrava untouched.

Redoubt/Optarion.t: The Court of the White Fountain's fiery plume guttered and its white stone cracked under a winter curse. If the curse has not run its course by the Winter Solstice, it may prove permanent.

Skarsind/Pakaanan's Pass.t: There were multiple sightings of a bizarre, shaggy spirit around the pass, bearing a cryptic, unsettling message for the Imperial Orcs.

Bay of Catazar.t: Mentioned in passing: there are said to be developments with the eerie fog on the bay, detailed elsewhere.

Bregasland.t: Mentioned in passing: it is listed among the territories where the stars have vanished.

Hahnmark.t: A bizarre, shaggy spirit was occasionally sighted around Northspires, bearing an unsettling message for the Winterfolk and their orc neighbours.

Holberg.t: The marshes continued to spread, turning Rebeshof into marsh and permanently cutting Holberg's farm production by 18 rings. The Senate may pay 80 wains of weirwood and 20 Thrones either to save Ennerlund or to cultivate the marsh for herbs; the stars have also vanished here.

Kallavesa.t: Mentioned in passing: its marshes are the benchmark for healing herbs that a cultivated Holberg marsh might nearly rival.

Karsk.t: Mentioned in passing: it is listed among the territories where the stars have vanished.

Miekarova.t: The stars vanished over Miekarova, and an unnaturally strong blizzard roared around the castle on the Icy Crag of the Eternal Sun while leaving the vale of Volchitrava untouched.

Mournwold.t: Though the territory has fallen, eerie blessed weapons and strange ideas are emerging from parts of it. These have implications for the campaign, especially for the five armies camped in Tassato.

Necropolis.t: Mentioned in passing: it is listed among the territories where the stars have vanished.

Redoubt.t: The Court of the White Fountain in Optarion continued to crumble under a winter curse, opposed by magicians from the Spire of the Auric Horizon.

Segura.t: Mentioned in passing: it is listed among the territories where the stars have vanished.

Sermersuaq.t: Strangely dressed hunters gathered on the northern shores of Atkonaroq and began raids in which almost nobody was harmed and nothing of note was taken. The new mithril mine is completed at the Autumn Equinox, and the stars have vanished here.

Skarsind.t: The stars vanished over Skarsind, and a strange goat-footed spirit was repeatedly sighted around Pakaanan's Pass.

Spiral.t: The territory was reclaimed for the Empire, though the Grendel remain a significant threat there, and the civil service began reviewing opportunities in it.

Tassato.t: The Penumbral Veil that had twisted Tassato's night sky for a year faded entirely before the Equinox. The five armies camped here face implications from events in the Mournwold.

The Barrens.t: Mentioned in passing: it is listed among the territories where the stars have vanished.

The Semmerlak.t: The lake lay windless by day but was struck by violent storms at night, with rumours of unnatural beasts preying on fisherfolk, sailors and those who stray near its waters.

Therunin.t: The orcs of the Great Forest entered Therunin as guests of the Navarr, raising pressing questions about the territory's future.

Volodmartz.t: Mentioned in passing: it is listed among the territories where the stars have vanished.

380YE Autumn Equinox winds of war.d: The Black Thorns used terror tactics and risen Navarr dead to drive the Jotun from southern Liathaven, liberating Beacon Point and advancing into Western Scout. In Kahraman more than thirty-five thousand Imperial troops retook Serra Briante and the Great Mine, but the glacial citadel of Cathan Canae kept the Jotun in Serra Damata; about ten thousand warriors on both sides were lost. The Mournwold fell entirely, Orchard's Watch and Overton included. The Freeborn Storm lost nearly a fifth of the navy at Rebekah's Leap and the Pharos. The Citadel Guard took over half of Tamarbode. The Golden Axe repelled an unliving horde in Astolat, and Druj envoys offered to negotiate the Line.

Dawn.t: The Gryphon's Pride and Golden Sun took just over half of the Carmine Fields and received a Druj offer to negotiate the Line. The Hounds of Glory led the vanguard in Kahraman, and Astolat was defended against an unliving horde.

Druj.t: The Druj returned to the Barrens and exterminated the Rahvin, after half the Black Wind sought peace with them. Their envoys now wait in the Bitter Strand for a Senate diplomat to negotiate the Line before the Equinox ends.

Grendel.t: An armada more than twice the size of the Freeborn Storm defeated it at Rebekah's Leap and again off Necropolis. In Spiral the Grendel stood on the defensive, holding Apstrus, Apulus and Screed.

Highguard.t: The Valiant Pegasus could only watch the naval defeat off Necropolis, and the Granite Pillar fought in the lost defence of Orchard's Watch. The Seventh Wave resupplied in Sarvos, while Urizen forces pushed into Llofir's Tamarbode in Reikos.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Summer Storm helped liberate Serra Briante. The Tusks and Winter Sun shaped the Mournwold defence but were forced out with the other defenders, and a fleet from Skarsind sailed with the Freeborn Storm.

Jotun.t: The Jotun conquered the whole Mournwold, Orchard's Watch and the Singing Caves included, and still hold Serra Damata with Cathan Canae's aid. They lost Serra Briante, abandoned southern Liathaven in fear of the Navarr and withdrew from Kallavesa.

Navarr.t: The Black Thorns and their unliving allies liberated Beacon Point and are close to freeing all of southern Liathaven. The Jotun executed nearly a hundred Navarr prisoners at Briante, and the Great Forest orcs arrived in Therunin as Navarr guests.

The Brass Coast.t: Serra Briante and its Great Mine were retaken, and the Senate may now make the mine a Brass Coast national seat. Nearly a fifth of the Imperial navy was lost when the Freeborn Storm was defeated by the Grendel.

The League.t: The Seventh Wave searched Sarvos for a spy network without success, and the Mournwold's defenders retreated into Tassato. Holberg is recalled only for the moving trees that once besieged it.

The Marches.t: After three centuries the Mournwold was lost to the Jotun: Overton fell and Marcher rebels who had broken the thrall's oath now face likely execution. Bregasland, guarded by its citadel, saw no orc incursion.

Urizen.t: The Citadel Guard recaptured a little over half of Tamarbode against Llofir's supernatural defenders. Urizen magicians aided the Mournwold defenders, and the first naval battle was fought off Redoubt.

Varushka.t: The Golden Axe drove an unliving horde from Astolat but lost some two hundred soldiers, received no resupply and lost the benefit of Brotherhood of Tian. The horde itself came out of Karsk.

Wintermark.t: Jotun forces advancing into Kallavesa turned back, though a beachhead in West March remains. Wintermark forces supported the burial truce in Kahraman, and Winterfolk boarders crippled a Grendel warship.

380YE Autumn Equinox winds of war.o: In Autumn 380YE the Navarr liberated Beacon Point in Liathaven and the Empire recaptured Serra Briante in Kahraman, but the Jotun overran the last Imperial positions in the Mournwold. At sea a Grendel armada twice defeated the Freeborn Storm, and the Druj reappeared in the Barrens having wiped out the Rahvin.

Kahraman/Braydon's Jasse.t: The Fort Braydon garrison was cut off from the main Imperial force, but the Jotun made no attempt to invade the region.

Kahraman/Gambit.t: The Jotun aimed their strength at conquering Gambit, but the Imperial offensive blunted the push.

Kahraman/Jade Range.t: The Jotun sought to take Jade Range, but their advance was halted when the Empire went on the attack.

Kahraman/Serra Briante.t: After weeks of bloody fighting the Empire drove the Jotun out and recovered the Great Mine. Inside Briante town it found nearly a hundred executed Navarr prisoners.

Kahraman/Serra Damata.t: The Empire now dominates over half the Damatian hills, but Cathan Canae's citadel killed some two hundred attackers and keeps the Jotun foothold secure.

Liathaven/Beacon Point.t: Beacon Point was liberated by the Black Thorns within six weeks of the Solstice.

Liathaven/West Ranging.t: This is an opportunity rather than an event: once southern Liathaven is free, the Navarr could strike into West Ranging to cut the Jotun supply lines into the Mournwold.

Liathaven/Western Scout.t: The Black Thorns made significant gains here, and the Jotun held their own by day but died in the dark by night.

Mournwold/Greensward.t: Orchard's Watch, Overton and the Singing Caves fell to the Jotun, whose people will now be offered the Choice.

Mournwold/Ore Hills.t: Mentioned in passing: Jotun campfires spread across Ore Hills before the assault on Orchard's Watch.

Mournwold/Southmoor.t: Mentioned in passing: the Jotun host camped across Southmoor before the final assault.

Reikos/Chalcis Mount.t: The ruins of Chalcis Mount are gone, replaced by flourishing untouched greenery as the transforming magic fades.

Reikos/Haros Water.t: The Druj-era ruins of Haros Water have vanished beneath fast-growing but largely normal forest.

Reikos/Longshire.t: Longshire's ruins are gone and fresh greenery now flourishes in their place.

Reikos/Riverwatch.t: The ruins of Riverwatch have been replaced by new growth as the Spring magic recedes.

Reikos/Tamarbode.t: Spore-choked forest and hostile creatures slowed the Citadel Guard, which recaptured just over half the region amid growing resistance; it may finish by Winter if Llofir does not respond.

Spiral/Ankra.t: Ankra is defended by Imperial armies in the standoff with the Grendel.

Spiral/Apstrus.t: Apstrus remains in Grendel hands and is fervently defended.

Spiral/Apulus.t: Apulus remains held and defended by the Grendel.

Spiral/Ateri.t: Ateri is held by Imperial armies including the Eastern Sky, Green Shield and Northern Eagle.

Spiral/Cinion.t: Cinion is one of the four regions defended by Imperial forces.

Spiral/Ossuary.t: Ossuary and its mithril mine, captured from the Grendel at the Summer Solstice, are held by the Empire.

Spiral/Screed.t: The Grendel hold Screed, where the Black Plateau appears to be settling down though it has not fallen entirely silent.

Tassato/Tassato Mestra.t: The last Imperial soldiers were harried out of the Mournwold back across the border towards Tassato Mestra.

The Barrens/Bitter Strand.t: Druj envoys await a Senate diplomatic party on the eastern banks of the Kepahitân River, and scouting parties sent here failed to return.

The Barrens/Farweald.t: Mentioned in passing: the Rahvin used Farweald's magical defences in their failing resistance against Dawn.

The Barrens/Hope's Rest.t: Mentioned in passing: the Great Forest orcs left the Barrens through Hope's Rest into Therunin.

The Barrens/Saltmarsh.t: Half the Black Wind crossed the river east of the Saltmarsh to make peace with the Druj, and errants reported some five thousand orcs camped by the marshes.

Therunin/Lower Tarn Valley.t: A great camp was raised here for the Great Forest orcs, who were welcomed by representatives of Therunin's steadings and stridings.

Weirwater/Hawksmoor.t: The unliving horde marched west through Hawksmoor on its way to attack Astolat.

Weirwater/Weirmoor.t: The unliving army passed through Weirmoor towards Astolat and later retreated into the woods of south-western Weirwater.

Astolat.t: An unliving horde attacked near Weaving before the Golden Axe, Dawnish witches and the Castle of Thorns garrison drove it back into Weirwater.

Bay of Catazar.t: The unnatural fog persisted as rival Imperial and Grendel fleets came to share these waters; the Imperial Treasury's Auditor has prepared a report on the situation for the Admiral.

Bregasland.t: A magical citadel again guarded the marshes, but no orc forces entered Bregasland.

Holberg.t: Mentioned in passing: the trees of Tamarbode are compared with the mobile trees that once besieged Holberg.

Hordalant.t: Mentioned in passing: Jotun warbands fleeing Liathaven retreated into Hordalant and Reinos.

Kahraman.t: Imperial armies liberated Serra Briante and the Great Mine and now dominate over half the Damatian hills, but the Jotun still hold out beneath Cathan Canae's citadel after a campaign that cost about ten thousand warriors.

Kallavesa.t: A magical citadel protected the sacred lakes, and the advancing Jotun paused and marched back west, leaving only a beachhead in West March.

Karsk.t: Mentioned in passing: the unliving army that attacked Astolat is described as the haunted legion out of Karsk.

Liathaven.t: The Black Thorns liberated Beacon Point and gained ground in Western Scout, and are on course to free all of southern Liathaven and make it contested again by Winter.

Mournwold.t: The Jotun took the entire territory, including Overton, the Singing Caves and Orchard's Watch, so the Sheriff of Overton sinecure now yields nothing.

Necropolis.t: The Battle of the Pharos was fought below the cliffs and lost by the Empire; neither navy now fully controls these waters.

Redoubt.t: The Battle of Rebekah's Leap, the first major naval clash with the Grendel, was fought off Redoubt and ended in an Imperial retreat.

Reikos.t: Outside Tamarbode the transforming magic is fading and fresh greenery has replaced the ruins, while the Citadel Guard has recaptured just over half of Tamarbode itself.

Reinos.t: Mentioned in passing: the Jotun retreated towards Reinos from both Liathaven and Kahraman.

Sarvos.t: The Seventh Wave guarded against seaborne threats and resupplied unimpeded, while its scouts searched without success for an alleged spy network.

Segura.t: Mentioned in passing: a Red Wind Corsairs order urges the troops to 'remember Segura'.

Semmerholm.t: Mentioned in passing: the unliving army turned aside at the last minute rather than entering Semmerholm.

Skarsind.t: Mentioned in passing: one independent fleet sailing with the Freeborn Storm had a captain who calls Skarsind home.

Spiral.t: Spiral stays Imperial in an uneasy standoff, with the Empire holding four regions and the Grendel three, and the Black Plateau has grown quieter.

Tassato.t: The Mournwold's defenders retreated into Tassato, and the heroism shown at the Summer Solstice may have prevented a Jotun beachhead here.

The Barrens.t: Dawn took just over half of the Carmine Fields, the Rahvin were wiped out by the Druj, the Great Forest and half the Black Wind left, and a Druj presence of unknown size has arrived.

The Semmerlak.t: Mentioned in passing: the unliving army that attacked Astolat had earlier emerged from the Semmerlak.

Therunin.t: Some two thousand Great Forest orcs, with much of their people and some briar humans, camped in the Lower Tarn Valley as guests of the Navarr.

Weirwater.t: The unliving horde crossed Weirwater to attack Astolat and is now camped in its south-western woods, far from any major settlement.

380YE Spring Equinox Announcement by the.d: At the Spring Equinox of 380YE the Civilian Commissioner of Dawn, using the power to commission constructions delegated by the Senate, approved the Gardens of Tiberius' Bequest, a small sinecure in Laroc, Astolat, that will produce Cerulean Mazzarine. The announcement did not specify the sinecure's size, so standard costs apply. After the Spring Equinox, Morien provided 10 wains of white granite and 20 crowns towards the work. Once completed, the sinecure will automatically create the Dawnish national title of Healer of Dawn, to be assigned by the Dawnish Senators.

Dawn.t: Dawn gains a commissioned sinecure that, once completed, will create the national title of Healer of Dawn, appointed by its own Senators and supplied with Cerulean Mazzarine.

380YE Spring Equinox Announcement by the.o: The Dawnish Civilian Commissioner approved the construction of a small sinecure, the Gardens of Tiberius' Bequest, in Laroc in Astolat, to produce Cerulean Mazzarine and create the title of Healer of Dawn.

Astolat.t: The Gardens of Tiberius' Bequest are to be built in Laroc in Astolat, with Morien already contributing white granite and crowns towards their construction.

380YE Spring Equinox Announcement by the.d: Using the Senate's delegated power to commission constructions, the Highborn Civilian Commissioner approved Rhesa's announcement of a School of Exorcism in Tabernacle, Reikos. It cost 10 wains of white granite and 20 crowns in labour, both supplied by Rhesa after the Spring Equinox, and would take three months to build. Once complete it creates the national title of Master of the School of Exorcism, a liao-producing sinecure that exists only because of a specific opportunity. The announcement intended election through the Highguard National Assembly, but the Commissioner's limited powers mean the title cannot be appointed that way unless a Senator raises a motion amending its method of appointment.

Highguard.t: Highguard gains a new national title, the Master of the School of Exorcism, though its appointment by the Highguard National Assembly would need a Senate motion amending the title's method of appointment.

380YE Spring Equinox Announcement by the.o: Rhesa of the Scions of Ravensfell, Highguard's Civilian Commissioner, commissioned the School of Exorcism in Tabernacle, Reikos, a sinecure producing liao that would create the Highguard title of Master of the School of Exorcism.

Reikos.t: The School of Exorcism is to be built in Tabernacle, Reikos, using 10 wains of white granite and 20 crowns over three months, and will produce liao once complete.

380YE Spring Equinox Announcement by the.d: Using the power to commission constructions delegated to them by the Senate, the Imperial Orc Civilian Commissioner approved a series of great drums in Estermark to aid the raising of Skarsind's cattle herds. The resulting sinecure, the Great Eastern Herd, produces 216 rings a season and is administered by the Shepherd of the Great Herd, a title appointed by unanimous decision of the Imperial Orc senators. The work cost 10 wains of weirwood and 20 crowns in labour, taking three months to build. Yargol provided the materials and funds after the Spring Equinox 380YE, and the Great Herd has since been completed.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Imperial Orcs gained a new national title, the Shepherd of the Great Herd, appointed unanimously by their senators to oversee a sinecure worth 216 rings a season.

380YE Spring Equinox Announcement by the.o: The Imperial Orc Civilian Commissioner approved the construction of a series of great drums in Estermark, Skarsind, to assist in raising the Skarsind cattle herds, creating the sinecure known as the Great Eastern Herd.

Skarsind/Estermark.t: Estermark is the site of the great drums built to aid cattle-raising, now home to the completed Great Eastern Herd.

Skarsind.t: Skarsind's cattle herds are now supported by a series of great drums, forming the completed Great Eastern Herd sinecure.

380YE Spring Equinox Announcement by the.d: Using the power to commission constructions delegated by the Senate, the Marcher Civilian Commissioner approved a sinecure in Graven, Gravenmarch, Bregasland, to produce mana crystals. The post, titled the Keeper of the Dour Fens, was to be appointed by vote of the Marcher farmers and held for life. The announcement came after the maximum number of commissions for the season had already been authorised, and was made in case one of the earlier commissions was vetoed by the Synod. No veto was used, so this commission was not authorised and the sinecure was not created.

The Marches.t: The Marcher Civilian Commissioner tried to create a lifetime post, the Keeper of the Dour Fens, chosen by the Marcher farmers, but the commission failed for lack of an available slot.

380YE Spring Equinox Announcement by the.o: The Marcher Civilian Commissioner announced approval of a sinecure at Graven in Gravenmarch, Bregasland, to produce mana crystals, but the commission was never authorised because the maximum number of commissions had already been reached.

Bregasland/Gravenmarch.t: Graven in Gravenmarch was the proposed site of the Keeper of the Dour Fens sinecure, which went unbuilt because the commission was not authorised.

Bregasland.t: Bregasland was to gain a mana-producing sinecure, but the commission was not authorised and nothing was built.

380YE Spring Equinox Imperial elections.d: Five Senate seats were filled: Segura (incumbent), Karsk (Maarit), Reikos (Balthasar Suns of Couros), Holberg (Stern) and Feroz (Pedro i Taziel I Riqueza). Ambassadors, ministers and most national Civilian Commissioners were appointed. On the Military Council, Horsa Tyrshalt was revoked as General of the Fist of the Mountains for dereliction of duty and replaced by Erkenbrand. Several Synod positions changed hands. The incumbent Grandmaster of the Sevenfold Path was killed in battle and replaced by Zephaniah. In the Bourse, Syrene's Wisdom (155 thrones) and the Scorrero Nets (130 thrones) were auctioned, alongside other Imperial and national seats.

Dawn.t: Morien Stewart was named Civilian Commissioner of Dawn.

Highguard.t: Highguard's Reikos gained Balthasar Suns of Couros as senator, and Highborn took several Synod roles: Alys as Gatekeeper of Vigilance, Sariel as Virtue Inquisitor of Wisdom and Apollos as Curator of the White City Museum. The nation's Civilian Commissioner post was left unfilled.

Imperial Orcs.t: Bloodcrow Yargol was named Civilian Commissioner of the Imperial Orcs, and the incumbent Advisor on Orc Affairs kept the post.

Navarr.t: Bron Foxden was named Civilian Commissioner of Navarr.

The Brass Coast.t: The Brass Coast returned its incumbent senator for Segura, elected Pedro i Taziel I Riqueza for Feroz and saw Carlos I Guerra named Civilian Commissioner.

The League.t: Lisabetta Giacomi von Holberg of the League was listed as Empress. Stern took the Senate seat for Holberg and Lorenzo of the Butchers became Civilian Commissioner of the League.

Urizen.t: Mentioned in passing: the Civilian Commissioner of Urizen is listed with no holder named.

Varushka.t: Maarit became senator for Karsk, Nadya Gremani was named Civilian Commissioner of Varushka, and Wilhemina Maryenkovich Poltova of Varushka became Gatekeeper of Prosperity.

Wintermark.t: Thanmir Hrafnar was named Civilian Commissioner of Wintermark. Vauraus Korppitkotka became Virtue Inquisitor of Prosperity and Eldeen Wulfssdottir became Watcher of Britta's Pool.

380YE Spring Equinox Imperial elections.o: At the 380YE Spring Equinox, the Empire filled a wide range of titles across the Senate, Military Council, Synod, Conclave and Bourse, with Lisabetta Giacomi von Holberg of the League listed as Empress.

Feroz.t: Pedro i Taziel I Riqueza was elected senator for Feroz.

Holberg.t: Stern was elected senator for Holberg.

Karsk.t: Maarit was elected senator for Karsk.

Reikos.t: Balthasar Suns of Couros was elected senator for Reikos.

Segura.t: Segura's incumbent senator was returned to the seat.

380YE Spring Equinox winds of fortune.d: Grendel orcs invaded Sarvos and began coordinated pillaging. Holberg's angry trees fell still, opening reclamation opportunities. Golan's Courage of the First Empress movement kept growing in Highguard. The eternal Janon opened a regio in Astolat, and the Asavean Plenum petitioned to build a temple on the Bay of Catazar. A harsh winter brought near-starvation to Skarsind, and meltwater now threatens flooding in the south. Dogri Thulebane offered to treat at Crow's Ridge, and a Freemoor village sought to reconnect with the Marches. Karsk's roads were completed and a third Varushkan army began mustering. Work was ordered or begun on a Sermersuaq mithril mine, a Kallavesa shrine and a second Mournwold fortification.

Dawn.t: The eternal Janon opened a regio in the woodlands of Astolat that mundanes as well as magicians may visit, and Golan's courage movement may spread into Dawn.

Druj.t: Mentioned in passing: a Druj diplomatic delegation was delayed by the Winter Solstice storms and is expected to attend at the Spring Equinox.

Grendel.t: Grendel orcs invaded the southern League city of Sarvos and appear to be carrying out widespread, well-coordinated pillaging.

Highguard.t: The preacher Golan's Courage of the First Empress movement kept gathering strength across Highguard, despite the efforts of the priests Yael and Nina.

Imperial Orcs.t: Skarsind suffered a dreadful winter with real risk of starvation, empty skies, and Dogri Thulebane's continued hold on Crow's Ridge, while the Senate commissioned mining and trade projects there.

Jotun.t: Mentioned in passing: work on a second Mournwold fortification builds on a captured, partly finished Jotun fortification, and the Hearth Tithe herbs are meant to aid the war against them.

Navarr.t: A magical enchantment led Navarr ships into danger and rich booty. Trading posts were ordered for Hercynia, and Golan's courage movement may reach Navarr.

The Brass Coast.t: The Brass Coast faced storms, life-giving magical waters and the threat of spring flooding, and the Synod's dealings with the Hierro orcs in Segura changed significantly.

The League.t: The League saw Sarvos sacked by the Grendel and Holberg freed from its angry trees, with reclamation opportunities. Strange effects were reported around Tassato, floods threaten, and the vyig asset auction was rescheduled for Spring.

The Marches.t: After last year's failed harvest, the Marches faced a harsh winter, strange births and flooding along its rivers. A long-separated village in Freemoor reached out, and every farm continues the Hearth Tithe.

Thule.t: Mentioned in passing: a delayed Thule delegation is expected at the Spring Equinox, and the earlier peace treaty with the Thule enabled Varushkan public works.

Urizen.t: Urizen was tied to celestial omens and magical storms and waters. Covens of the Auric Horizon and Echostorm spire led Meraud's challenge with a fiftieth-magnitude ritual.

Varushka.t: Varushkan captains were drawn into enchanted voyages, and strange births were reported. Karsk's roads were completed and mustering of the Iron Helm army began, though the colleges in Volchitrava and Mieriada lagged.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark's assembly largely failed to dislodge Dogri Thulebane from Crow's Ridge. Meanwhile a mithril mine was ordered in Sermersuaq, a shrine to Empress Britta begun in Kallavesa, and the Hearth Tithe continues.

380YE Spring Equinox winds of fortune.o: The Spring Equinox 380YE Winds of Fortune gathered news from across the Empire, including the Grendel sack of Sarvos, an enchanted voyage for Navarr and Varushkan captains, a harsh winter giving way to flooding, and Dogri Thulebane's continued hold on Crow's Ridge. It also reported progress on public works and other ongoing events.

Miekarova/Mieriada.t: Construction has begun on the Hearth of the Tempest in Mieriada, but it is not believed to be operating as a college of spring magic yet.

Mournwold/Freemoor.t: The isolated village of Whittle in Freemoor reached out to its Marcher cousins after thirty years of separation, seeking to reconnect with the Empire.

Skarsind/Crow’s Ridge.t: Thane Dogri Thulebane continues to occupy Crow's Ridge despite Wintermark's efforts, and has offered a select few an invitation to treat with him.

Astolat.t: The eternal Janon, the Shadowed Flame, opened a regio in Astolat's woodlands and invited Imperial citizens, mundane and magician alike, to visit.

Bay of Catazar.t: Fog was reported on the brine, and the Asavean Plenum petitioned the Senate to build a temple on the Bay in exchange for an Imperial temple in Nemoria.

Casinea.t: Mentioned in passing: severe weather in Casinea at the Winter Solstice kept several foreign delegations away, and they are expected at the Spring Equinox.

Hercynia.t: The Senate resolved to open trading offices and trading posts in Hercynia to begin establishing the "crossroads of the north".

Holberg.t: The angry trees that had assaulted Holberg for a year fell still, and the civil service assembled opportunities to repair the damage. The skies over Holberg remain strangely empty.

Kallavesa.t: Construction began on a major shrine to Empress Britta and a great work to draw pilgrims to the marshes where Wintermark heroes are laid to rest.

Karsk.t: The rebuilding of Karsk's roads was completed, boosting all its mines and forests, and mustering of the new Iron Helm army began there, likely to finish by Winter.

Miekarova.t: Construction began on the Hearth of the Tempest in Mieriada, though its progress is unclear and it is not yet working as a college of spring magic.

Mournwold.t: Work began on a second fortification using a captured, partly finished Jotun fortification, due shortly before the Summer Solstice if the Empire keeps the site. A Freemoor village also reached out to the Marches.

Sarvos.t: The Grendel invaded Sarvos and appear to be pillaging the city in a widespread, well-coordinated way.

Segura.t: The Synod's efforts to deal with the Hierro clan orcs in Segura saw the situation change significantly over the season.

Sermersuaq.t: The Senate ordered work on a new mithril mine in Sermersuaq, expected to be completed by the Autumn Equinox.

Skarsind.t: Skarsind endured a winter of near-starvation and empty skies, with Dogri Thulebane still holding Crow's Ridge. The Senate commissioned a ministry for human miners at Gulhule and new trading posts.

Tassato.t: Tassato was named in a roundup of magical and unusual effects across the Empire, which included warped skies and a crumbling castle.

Upwold.t: Mentioned in passing: James Appleseeder of Upwold was named by the Marcher assembly to encourage the reintroduction of the Hearth Tithe.
