380YE Spring Equinox winds of war.d: In Spiral, Dawnish, Urizen and other armies, aided by Spring healing magic and three thousand knights of Eleonaris, captured Cinion and Ankra after an eldritch wildfire. They also advanced on Ossuary. In Reikos, Navarr, Highborn and League forces cleared Grey Charge and part of Tamarbode. A Dawnish crusade held Dawnguard under a corrupting miasma. In the Mournwold, Jotun under a mandowla-skull banner held the line against nearly forty thousand Imperial soldiers, at heavy cost to both sides. The Jotun also secured Liathaven, took half of West Marsh, and seized Serra Damata and part of Serra Briante. The Grendel, hidden by the Catazar fog, conquered Cigno, looted Sarvos and struck at Glass Point. Agents of the Queen of Silence gathered the fallen.

Dawn.t: The Hounds of Glory and Eastern Sky led the assaults that took Cinion and Ankra, joined by three thousand angry knights of Eleonaris whose presence magistrates are likely to investigate. The Golden Sun's crusade, swelled by some six thousand Dawnish troops, held Dawnguard against the Barrens orcs.

Druj.t: In Reikos, scattered barbarian orcs were driven from most of Grey Charge but still held parts of Tamarbode. The lingering aura of fear left by the Druj helped slow the Imperial advance.

Grendel.t: The Grendel lost Cinion and Ankra and were pushed back towards Ossuary, despite skilful, supernaturally coordinated defence. Their surprise naval invasion took Cigno and the city of Sarvos, looted its riches and pushed into Uccelini.

Highguard.t: The Granite Pillar helped clear Grey Charge in Reikos, clashing with League looters over the plunder. Highborn forces joined the failed assault on the Jotun castle at Sarcombe, and Jotun looting in Serra Damata took white granite that might have gone to Jeremiah of the Cenotaph.

Imperial Orcs.t: Imperial Orc forces fought savagely in the Mournwold, with the Winter Sun killing captured Jotun and the Summer Storm slaughtering all in their way, yet they gained no ground. One band of Imperial Orcs joined the crusade in Dawnguard.

Jotun.t: The Jotun held every inch of the Mournwold at a cost of at least six thousand warriors, secured Liathaven uncontested, and conquered about half of West Marsh. They also seized Serra Damata and a fifth of Serra Briante, smashing a frozen citadel and plundering mines.

Navarr.t: The Quiet Step led the overwhelming assault in Reikos, and Navarr raiders burned Barrens orc villages, likely ending any hope of a Navarr–Barrens alliance. Liathaven fell silent under Jotun control, and settlements of displaced Navarr in Kahraman were destroyed without mercy.

The Brass Coast.t: The Fire in the South fled Liathaven to fight in the Mournwold, while the Red Wind Corsairs plundered Jotun encampments there. At home, some thirty thousand Jotun invaded Kahraman, taking Serra Damata and part of Serra Briante.

The League.t: The League suffered a shock as Grendel seized Sarvos and looted its university, cathedral, banks and the tomb of Empress Giselle. They also struck at Glass Point. Elsewhere the Wolves of War plundered orc strongholds in Reikos, the Towerjacks helped defend Dawnguard, and work began on the College of the Liberated in Bocche.

The Marches.t: After a disastrous harvest the Marches endured a hungry winter. Its forces joined the assault on Sarcombe, but no Mournish soil was regained. The Marchers hold a fortification on the Greensward and have begun a second castle in Ore Hills.

Urizen.t: The Citadel Guard fought at the heart of the Spiral campaign without a single fatality and were untouched by the wildfire. The servants of the Queen of Silence found none to claim from among them. Redoubt was harried by Grendel guerrillas but protected by a healing enchantment.

Wintermark.t: A Jotun force from the west conquered about half of West Marsh, offering halls the choice of joining them or thraldom. They are now threatening Westerhal and potentially Rundahl beyond.

380YE Spring Equinox winds of war.o: In the winter before the 380YE Spring Equinox, Imperial armies took Cinion and Ankra in Spiral and Grey Charge in Reikos, held Dawnguard and were fought to a standstill in the Mournwold. Meanwhile the Jotun overran Liathaven and pushed into Kallavesa and Kahraman, and a Grendel naval invasion seized the city of Sarvos.

Kahraman/Serra Briante.t: A second ice-and-granite citadel, supported by troops from Fort Braydon, halted the Jotun short of the Great Mine and Briante. The Jotun still took about a fifth of the region.

Kahraman/Serra Damata.t: The Jotun smashed a frozen citadel and claimed the Damatian Cliffs, the town of Damata and the orichalcum mines. They also plundered white granite from the quarries.

Kallavesa/West Marsh.t: The Jotun conquered about half the region, giving each hall a choice of warrior service or thraldom. Westerhal is their next target.

Mournwold/Freemoor.t: Imperial forces struck at the Jotun in Freemoor but made no headway against the mandowla-banner line.

Mournwold/Greensward.t: Mentioned in passing: the Marchers control a fortification on the Greensward.

Mournwold/Ore Hills.t: Mentioned in passing: work has begun on a second Marcher castle here, following an earlier Jotun defeat in the region.

Mournwold/Southmoor.t: Highborn and Marcher forces brought siege engines against the Jotun castle in the ruins of Sarcombe but failed to take any ground.

Reikos/Grey Charge.t: Imperial armies cleared most of the orcs from the ruins of the fallen chapter houses and conquered the region.

Reikos/Tamarbode.t: Significant headway was made, but parts of the region, especially the Sign of Tamar, remain in barbarian hands.

Sarvos/Bocche.t: Work began near Trivento on the College of the Liberated, which some say is meant to revitalise the fading town.

Sarvos/Cigno.t: The Grendel conquered the island and the city of Sarvos within a week. They looted Diora University, the Capodomus cathedral and the tomb of Empress Giselle, but left the embassies alone.

Sarvos/Uccelini.t: Grendel forces bypassed fortified estates to fight for the docks of Glass Point, making significant headway towards conquering the isles.

Spiral/Ankra.t: After brutal fighting below Ossen's Spire, the Empire captured Ankra. The Spire was consumed by eldritch fire and Damakan's Forge badly damaged.

Spiral/Apulus.t: Mentioned in passing: great storm-driven waves battered its coast.

Spiral/Ateri.t: Storms beat against its cliffs while a frozen citadel garrisoned by one-eyed giants watched for Grendel aggression from its hills.

Spiral/Cinion.t: The Empire took Cinion after a wildfire killed nearly a thousand and stripped its slopes of trees and heather.

Spiral/Ossuary.t: Imperial forces made significant headway towards recapturing the mithril mines here.

Spiral/Screed.t: Mentioned in passing: the Dawnish avoided Screed and the black behemoth at its heart.

The Barrens/Dawnguard.t: The Golden Sun's crusade held Dawnguard against a desperate orc assault under a festering miasma. The Towers of the Dawn absorbed heavy damage, and the orcs still hold part of the region.

Bay of Catazar.t: Magical storms rolled off the bay without breaking its preternatural fog. That fog then cloaked the Grendel fleet that invaded Sarvos.

Holberg.t: Mentioned in passing: the Towerjacks of Holberg fought in Dawnguard, and Holberg's soldiers recognised the Barrens curse from long experience.

Kahraman.t: Some thirty thousand Jotun poured in from Liathaven, seizing Serra Damata and a fifth of Serra Briante. Magical citadels slowed their advance.

Kallavesa.t: Jotun forces landed on the western coast and conquered about half of West Marsh. They are establishing supply lines into the territory.

Liathaven.t: The Jotun secured the whole forest uncontested despite clashes with mysterious pale legionaries. A grim silence fell, and no more Navarr refugees came south.

Mournwold.t: Three months of slaughter against an unyielding Jotun line left the Empire with no gains. Nearly three thousand Imperial troops and at least twice as many Jotun fell.

Redoubt.t: Remnant Grendel guerrillas ambushed Imperial armies and wrecked roads and bridges. A Spring healing enchantment on the territory blunted the casualties.

Reikos.t: Imperial armies cleared most orcs from Grey Charge and advanced in Tamarbode, but at least another season is needed to complete the liberation.

Sarvos.t: A surprise Grendel invasion conquered Cigno and the jewelled city and looted its treasures. The Grendel also pushed into Uccelini, while work on the College of the Liberated began in Bocche.

Spiral.t: Under healing waters and sea-storms, the Empire retook Cinion and Ankra and advanced on Ossuary. A wildfire destroyed Ossen's Spire, and fleets based in Spiral suffered a small penalty from the storms.

The Barrens.t: In Dawnguard, Imperial defenders held off a desperate Barrens orc assault under a corrupting crimson miasma. The orcs still control a portion of the region.

380YE Summer Solstice Imperial elections.d: New senators included Oria for Feroz, Brother Ibrahim the South Paw for Bastion, Alessandra Serafini for Sarvos, Irena Arkady for Karov, Tanwyn Ankarien for Spiral and Edmundo of Endsmeet for Zenith. Aureliana Perpetua Nicasia Saverio di Sarvos became Imperial Consul and Zanferr i Ezmara i Erigo Imperial Fleet Master. New generals were Zoran Orzel, Sullik and Dietrich Nieschteri Rezia von Temeschwar. In the Synod, Levitia of Endsmeet became Cardinal of Courage and Ephron of Adina's Charge Imperial Inquisitor. Barthol de Rondell became Warmage and Finn Finnsson Imperial Seer. White granite went to holders including Meric Freysson (406T), and Azazel of Ravensfell took the Great Forest weirwood on a reduced term.

Dawn.t: Weirwater kept its incumbent senator, Zoran Orzel took command of the Golden Sun, Isabella de Rondell was appointed Healer of Dawn, and Abaddon De Rondell and Lady Eleanor de Rondell retained their Synod posts.

Highguard.t: Brother Ibrahim the South Paw became senator for Bastion, the Granite Pillar's general was returned, Sariel kept the post of Virtue Inquisitor of Wisdom and Ephron of Adina's Charge was elected Imperial Inquisitor.

Imperial Orcs.t: The incumbent general of the Summer Storm was returned to the Military Council.

Navarr.t: Miaren returned its incumbent senator, the Black Thorns kept their general, and Wyl Brackensong became Broker of Treji Wayhouse.

The Brass Coast.t: Oria became senator for Feroz, while the Red Wind Corsairs' general and the Mistress of the Glass Parador were returned.

The League.t: Alessandra Serafini became senator for Sarvos, Dietrich Nieschteri Rezia von Temeschwar took the Towerjacks, and Jan Von Schmied De Temeschwar became Northbound Trademaster.

The Marches.t: Mitwold kept its senator, the Drakes and the Tusks kept their generals, and Thomas Astwich became Sheriff of Overton.

Urizen.t: Tanwyn Ankarien and Edmundo of Endsmeet won Spiral and Zenith while Redoubt kept its senator; Levitia of Endsmeet became Cardinal of Courage and Juliana of Phoenix Reach Civilian Commissioner of Urizen.

Varushka.t: Irena Arkady became senator for Karov and Sullik took command of the Army of the Northern Eagle.

Wintermark.t: Sermersuaq kept its senator, the Fist of the Mountain its general, Jorma Steelhail and Girthwynn Frythsdottir Tokling kept their Gatekeeper posts, and Thanmir Whiteraven became Civilian Commissioner of Wintermark.

380YE Summer Solstice Imperial elections.o: The Summer Solstice 380YE elections filled Senate seats, Military Council generalships, Synod and Conclave titles, Senate sinecures and Bourse positions across the Empire, with many incumbents returned.

Miaren.t: The incumbent senator for Miaren was returned at the Summer Solstice.

380YE Summer Solstice winds of fortune.d: The red star grew, the Phoenix faded, and stars went out over Skarsind, Holberg, Bregasland, Segura and Necropolis. Curses struck Astolat, Tassato, Casinea and Redoubt. The Black Thorns fought for Liathaven. A decision was needed on where to inter Empress Giselle, whose body was saved from Grendel looters in Sarvos. The Wintermark Hallow of the Green World touched all nations, especially Holberg. Reikos saw Llofir's transformations, Yael's arrival and a possible miracle. The Marches' Spring planting failed. Nazares and a spreading sorrow threatened Zenith. The Icy Crag college was completed in Miekarova. Fog lingered on the Bay of Catazar, and veils faded over Madruga and Zenith but not Tassato.

Dawn.t: Inhabitants of Astolat, particularly those with military units, were warned that curses were affecting the territory.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: their earlier sneak attack on Sarvos, during which they robbed Empress Giselle's tomb, is recalled.

Highguard.t: Highguard faced Llofir's transformations, Yael's arrival and a possible miracle in Reikos, a curse on Casinea's farmers, stars going out over Necropolis, and a say in where Empress Giselle would be laid to rest.

Imperial Orcs.t: The stars began going out over Skarsind, one of the worrying celestial phenomena of the season.

Jotun.t: The Black Thorns were fighting to reclaim Liathaven from Jotun control.

Navarr.t: The Black Thorns' presence in Liathaven, fighting to retake it from the Jotun, was said to offer opportunities for the Navarr.

The Brass Coast.t: The Brass Coast saw stars going out over Segura, an Asavean temple invitation tied to Nemoria, lingering fog on the northern Bay of Catazar, and the veil over Madruga fading away.

The League.t: A League citizen, Lisabetta Giacomi von Holberg, was to be crowned Empress, while the League also dealt with Giselle's tomb, stars dimming and the Green World over Holberg, and a curse and persisting veil over Tassato.

The Marches.t: After the failed Autumn harvest and defeat in the Mournwold, the Spring planting also failed, bringing curses and opportunities, while stars went out over Bregasland.

Urizen.t: Zenith was threatened by Nazares's binding of Winter spirits into the dead and a spreading sorrow, Redoubt suffered a curse, and the veil over Zenith faded.

Varushka.t: Varushka was tagged in the omens of the red star, and the Summer college of the Icy Crag of the Eternal Sun was completed near Volchitrava in Miekarova.

Wintermark.t: The Sherard Hunters of Wintermark raised the Hallow of the Green World, whose touch was felt across all ten nations.

380YE Summer Solstice winds of fortune.o: The Summer Solstice 380YE Winds of Fortune gathered the season's news: the coming coronation of Empress Lisabetta Giacomi von Holberg, worsening celestial omens, curses on several territories, upheaval in Reikos, danger in Zenith and famine in the Marches.

Miekarova/Srodkoja.t: Mentioned in passing: Srodkoja is not named; the page only places the new Icy Crag college near Volchitrava in Miekarova.

Astolat.t: Astolat fell under curses, with military unit owners especially affected.

Bay of Catazar.t: The eerie fog over the northern waters of the bay persisted.

Bregasland.t: The stars began going out over Bregasland amid the Marches' failed harvests.

Casinea.t: Casinea suffered curses, with farmers particularly affected.

Holberg.t: Stars began going out over Holberg, the Hallow of the Green World had a particularly profound effect there, and its Empress Lisabetta von Holberg awaited coronation.

Liathaven.t: The Black Thorns were fighting in Liathaven to reclaim it from the Jotun.

Madruga.t: The strange shroud over Madruga's night skies faded and disappeared shortly before the Solstice.

Miekarova.t: The Icy Crag of the Eternal Sun, a Summer college near Volchitrava under Cathan Canae's patronage, was completed and began recruiting.

Mournwold.t: Mentioned in passing: the defeat in the Mournwold is cited as one of the Marches' recent woes.

Necropolis.t: The stars began going out over Necropolis.

Redoubt.t: Redoubt suffered curses, especially affecting castle owners, and its publishing house the Spider's Vantage Spire issued Livia Cascade's accounts of past-life visions.

Reikos.t: Reikos was transformed by the eternal Llofir, saw Yael and Brother Jared counter Golan's teachings amid a possible miracle, and needed Synod decisions on its esoteric plants and fungi.

Sarvos.t: The fog over Sarvos was seared away by Day magic, and the fate of Empress Giselle's body, saved from the Grendel raid on the Alivetti estates, awaited decision.

Segura.t: The stars began going out over Segura.

Skarsind.t: The stars began going out over Skarsind.

Tassato.t: Tassato suffered curses, especially affecting magicians, and the Penumbral Veil over its skies persisted.

Zenith.t: Nazares was binding Winter spirits into the newly dead and a pall of sorrow spread from a ruined spire, though the veil over Zenith faded.

380YE Summer Solstice winds of war.d: Dawnish and Varushkan armies cleared Dawnguard but made only slight inroads into the Carmine Fields. In Sarvos, under a new magical fog, citizens rose against the Grendel, who withdrew with their plunder before the Imperial armies arrived. Iron Confederacy slave mercenaries hired by the military council nearly sparked an incident, then left. In Spiral the Grendel narrowly held Ossuary, and Apulus sank into the sea. The Jotun came within a whisker of taking Serra Briante. In the Mournwold they retook Freemoor and Ore Hills, with its new fort, and half of Greensward. Elsewhere Llofir's servants overran Tamarbode, the Jotun stalled in Kallavesa, an undead host marched from Karsk through Weirwater, and the Hierro left Segura.

Dawn.t: The Golden Sun and the reborn Gryphon's Pride freed Dawnguard, while the Hounds of Glory helped secure Sarvos and the Eastern Sky and Green Shield fought in Spiral. An undead host is now heading for Semmerholm.

Druj.t: The Barrens orcs lost all their recent gains in Dawnguard despite Spring and Night magical defences, but held the Carmine Fields fiercely, especially under the Black Wind banner.

Grendel.t: The Grendel abandoned Sarvos and Uccelini with their plunder after the uprising and lost several ships. In Spiral they clung to Ossuary with reinforcements from the south-east, but lost Apulus and its unfinished fortifications to the sea.

Highguard.t: The Citadel Guard drove on Ossuary and the Granite Pillar held the Necropolis coast, while Highborn armies helped defend Kahraman. In Reikos, Highborn ruins and heritage were being unmade by the servants of Llofir.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Winter Sun harried the Jotun in Kahraman. The Summer Storm fought at the Battle of Ore Hills, where its orcs were seized by the voice of the Jotun ancestor Sjöfn of the Bittenblade. The few Hierro left in Segura asked to join the Imperial Orcs.

Jotun.t: The Jotun almost conquered Serra Briante and retook the Mournwold gains, Ore Hills fort included, while also taking half of Greensward. They advanced slowly into Kallavesa but were losing southern Liathaven to the Black Thorns.

Navarr.t: The Black Thorns slipped through Kahraman into Liathaven with warbands from across Navarr and began retaking Beacon Point, as survivors flocked to their standard. The Quiet Step fought in Freemoor and gave warning of the Jotun march on Greensward.

The Brass Coast.t: The Red Wind Corsairs raided Jotun baggage trains in Kahraman, where magic brought fertility along the Scorrero, and the Freeborn Storm sailed for Sarvos. The Hierro orcs left Segura for Jotun lands.

The League.t: Urged on by the Mayor of Caricomare and the League Assembly, the citizens of Sarvos rose against the Grendel and saved their city from fire. They suffered heavy losses and the theft of much of their wealth.

The Marches.t: The Tusks held against the Howling Night in Kahraman, and the Bounders and Drakes fought in the Mournwold, where Ore Hills, Freemoor and half of Greensward were lost. Orchard's Watch and the Singing Caves held; Marchers say Jonah Gold warned the miners.

Thule.t: Mentioned in passing: the dead rising in Karsk were casualties of the recent war with the Thule, and messages were exchanged between the Thule and the Varushkans.

Urizen.t: Urizen magic, including the Winter's Ghosts curse, harried Spiral. Any Urizen children held hostage at Apulus are believed lost when the town sank.

Varushka.t: The Golden Axe fought in the Barrens, and the Coven of the Indomitable Sun's ice castle helped save Serra Briante. Ushkans joined the Black Thorns, while thousands of the dead rose in Karsk and marched into the Semmerlak.

Wintermark.t: Winterfolk faced the strongest Jotun in Kahraman and exchanged their dead with them. Wintermark magic slowed the Jotun advance into Kallavesa and roused the forests of Highrod.

380YE Summer Solstice winds of war.o: At the Summer Solstice of 380YE the Empire fought on many fronts. It recaptured Dawnguard in the Barrens, saw Sarvos freed after a citizen uprising drove out the Grendel, and continued its slow push in Spiral. Meanwhile the Jotun all but took Serra Briante, threw the Empire back across the Mournwold, and the Black Thorns began retaking Liathaven.

Kahraman/Serra Briante.t: The Jotun besieged the frozen citadel near the Great Mine of Briante and came within a whisker of conquest, but the region stayed in Imperial hands.

Kahraman/Serra Damata.t: Held by the Jotun, who were supported by a tower of ice and iron over the ruins of Damata; the Navarr gave the region a wide berth on their way north.

Kallavesa/Kallavesa Marsh.t: Night magic swallowed Kallavesa Marsh in mists, sheltering those fleeing the Jotun and hiding those resisting them.

Kallavesa/Skymark.t: Mentioned in passing: the Jotun were forging routes towards Skymark.

Kallavesa/West Marsh.t: The Jotun spread cautiously across the West Marsh offering the Choice, but enchanted mists and disease meant they made no headway in conquering it.

Kallavesa/Wittal Grove.t: Jotun scouts were sighted, but the Sherard Hunters woke the trees to entrap them and aid the defenders.

Liathaven/Beacon Point.t: The Black Thorns rallied here and made significant headway; if nothing changes they will claim the region by the end of next season.

Liathaven/Western Scout.t: Messengers were sent to seek resistance groups here; if nothing changes, Western Scout should be liberated by the end of the year.

Mournwold/Freemoor.t: The Jotun drove the Empire out village by village, aided by Knights of the Crimson Fields, and retook all of Freemoor.

Mournwold/Greensward.t: The Tower of the North and the Corazón attacked, taking nearly half the region and damaging Orchard's Watch. Overton and the Singing Caves held.

Mournwold/Ore Hills.t: The Ore Hills were lost after a great battle, and the almost-finished Imperial fort fell to the Jotun, who call it 'The Tribute'.

Mournwold/Southmoor.t: Part of the Quiet Step raided Jotun supply trains in Southmoor and discovered the march on Greensward. The Jotun already hold a fortification here.

Necropolis/Highrod.t: The Sherard Hunters roused Highrod's forests around the ruins of the First Sentinel, which the Granite Pillar used as a base.

Reikos/Chalcis Mount.t: The Spring magic finally swirled across the ruined walls of High Chalcis and the Chalcis Mount.

Reikos/Grey Charge.t: The wellspring of Spring magic and the children of Llofir spread quickly through Grey Charge.

Reikos/Haros Water.t: The magic reached Haros Water and the ruins of Haros, bringing rot and regrowth.

Reikos/Longshire.t: The wave of Spring magic washed over Longshire, consuming ruins and renewing growth.

Reikos/Riverwatch.t: The wave of Spring magic washed over Riverwatch and eddied around the walls of Tabernacle.

Reikos/Tamarbode.t: The magic poured out from the Sign of Tamar, and Llofir's forces effectively conquered Tamarbode; the fate of the orcs left there is unclear.

Sarvos/Bocche.t: The new magical fog spread across Bocche during the uprising.

Sarvos/Cigno.t: Citizens rose against the Grendel in the city, saving it from fire before the Grendel withdrew by sea. A cleared site showed no sign of fortification work.

Sarvos/Foracci.t: The magical fog spread along the swollen Gancio to Foracci.

Sarvos/Riposi.t: The magical fog spread across southern Riposi.

Sarvos/Uccelini.t: Fog cloaked Uccelini, and the Grendel there also departed into the mists.

Spiral/Apulus.t: Potent Night magic and storms turned the coast into quicksand and sank the port and Grendel fortifications, killing many orc civilians and captives.

Spiral/Ossuary.t: The Empire drove hard on Ossuary and made gains, but the reinforced Grendel narrowly held it.

Spiral/Screed.t: A tempest of crimson lightning engulfed Screed around the Black Plateau, which Imperial troops avoided.

Weirwater/Garthmoor.t: As the Solstice dawned, the undead host was believed to be crossing Garthmoor towards Applefell.

Bay of Catazar.t: A new magical fog drifted down over the northern Bay. The fleeing Grendel vanished into it, while the Freeborn Storm sailed through it without meeting the enemy navy.

Brocéliande.t: Mentioned in passing: warbands from Brocéliande joined the Black Thorns on their march into Liathaven.

Hercynia.t: Mentioned in passing: warbands from Hercynia joined the Black Thorns on their march into Liathaven.

Holberg.t: Mentioned in passing: the Towerjacks relished fighting beside the warriors who had helped liberate Holberg from the Druj.

Kahraman.t: Around forty thousand Jotun pushed back the Imperial defenders, and four thousand fell. Serra Briante was left on a knife edge, saved only by an enchanted ice fortress.

Kallavesa.t: The Jotun slowly spread across the Westmarsh offering the Choice, but Night and Spring enchantments meant they made no headway in conquering it.

Karsk.t: Several thousand human and orc dead from the war with the Thule rose, gathered near the Dark Heart, and marched into the Semmerlak.

Liathaven.t: Some seven thousand Navarr under the Black Thorns raised their standard and began a merciless guerrilla campaign to free the south, while survivors rallied to them.

Madruga.t: Mentioned in passing: the Freeborn Storm sought payback for the Grendel attack on the Madruga shipyards, and the fleeing Grendel did not sail towards Madruga.

Miaren.t: Mentioned in passing: warbands from Miaren joined the Black Thorns on their march into Liathaven.

Miekarova.t: Mentioned in passing: two bands of Ushkans from Miekarova marched with the Black Thorns.

Mournwold.t: Eight thousand fell as the Jotun retook all the land the Empire had liberated and seized half of Greensward. Orchard's Watch and the Singing Caves held.

Necropolis.t: The Granite Pillar took defensive positions along the fog-shrouded coast with Wintermark's magical support, but saw no Grendel; the situation was unchanged.

Reikos.t: A wellspring of Spring magic from the Sign of Tamar brought Llofir's children across Reikos, unmaking ruins and restoring forest. Tamarbode was effectively conquered by them.

Reinos.t: The Hierro clan marched out of Segura into the red hills of Reinos to face the Choice of the Jotun.

Sarvos.t: A citizen uprising under magical fog drove out the Grendel, and the city was again unequivocally Imperial. It was left fire-scarred and stripped of much of its wealth, with little recovered.

Segura.t: The Hierro clan broke camp near Anduz and left peacefully for Jotun lands, their chieftain thanking the Freeborn. The few who stayed asked to join the Imperial Orcs.

Semmerholm.t: The undead host marching through Weirwater was expected to enter Semmerholm near the Semmerstones less than a week after the Solstice if it did not turn aside.

Spiral.t: Imperial armies made gains in Ossuary but no region changed hands; the Grendel kept the territory, only just. Spiral was wracked by curses, storms and the sinking of Apulus.

Tassato.t: Mentioned in passing: the mithril miners and wagon-drivers of the Singing Caves carry their bounty to Tassato.

The Barrens.t: Imperial armies recaptured Dawnguard and set up outposts on the northern edge of the Carmine Fields, which stayed firmly in orc hands amid red rivers and festering wounds.

Therunin.t: Mentioned in passing: warbands from Therunin joined the Black Thorns on their march into Liathaven.

Weirwater.t: An army-sized host of the walking dead emerged north of Culwich and marched south-west, overwhelming a garrison that tried to stop it and damaging villages and roads.

380YE Winter Solstice Imperial elections.d: New senators were chosen for Miekarova (Father Nikolovich Drakov), Sarvos (Magdelena di Sarvos), Karov (Ludmilla Koslov) and Therunin (Willa Farkus-Vigil), while other seats returned their incumbents. New generals were Nikolai Zakharovich Prochnost, Iron Osric, Natalia Barossa, Akstis Eigulys (a reduced term to Spring 381YE) and Cayleb. In the Synod, Ricardo Almieda Desmondo di Tassatto became Cardinal of Prosperity and Ingrid Sigeing Conscience of the Senate. The Conclave gained new Archmages of Night, Day and Spring and a new Grandmaster of the Rod and Shield. The Imperial Censor was open for election for the first time. Bourse seats went to various bidders, including Siliva Alcham, who paid 200 thrones for the Great Mine of Briante.

Dawn.t: Dawn returned its incumbents as Senator for Astolat and as General of the Hounds of Glory.

Highguard.t: Highguard kept its incumbent Senator for Necropolis, Cayleb became General of the Valiant Pegasus, and Nemuel of Ravensfell won the Great Forest at Reikos.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Imperial Orcs returned their incumbents as Senator for Skarsind and as General of the Winter Sun.

Navarr.t: Willa Farkus-Vigil became Senator for Therunin, Hercynia kept its incumbent, and Morgan Leafstalker of Navarr became Gatekeeper of Prosperity.

The Brass Coast.t: The Brass Coast returned its incumbents as Senator for Madruga and as Admiral of the Freeborn Storm navy.

The League.t: Magdelena di Sarvos became Senator for Sarvos and Natalia Barossa General of the Towerjacks, while Ricardo Almieda Desmondo di Tassatto of the League became Cardinal of Prosperity; Temeschwar kept its incumbent senator.

The Marches.t: The Marches returned their incumbents as Senator for Bregasland and as General of the Strong Reeds.

Urizen.t: Urizen's incumbent Senator for Zenith was returned.

Varushka.t: Varushka gained new senators for Miekarova and Karov, new generals for the Army of the Golden Axe and, for a reduced term, the Iron Helms, and Amris of Varushka became Gatekeeper of Wisdom.

Wintermark.t: Iron Osric became General of the Green Shield Army, Ingrid Sigeing of Wintermark became Conscience of the Senate, and Kallavesa kept its incumbent senator.

380YE Winter Solstice Imperial elections.o: At the 380YE Winter Solstice, elections were held across the Senate, Military Council, Synod, Conclave and Bourse, with many incumbents returned and new holders chosen for a number of senatorial seats, generalships, Synod and Conclave titles and Bourse positions.

Astolat.t: Astolat's incumbent senator was returned.

Bregasland.t: Bregasland's incumbent senator was returned.

Hercynia.t: Hercynia's incumbent senator was returned.

Kallavesa.t: Kallavesa's incumbent senator was returned.

Karov.t: Ludmilla Koslov was elected Senator for Karov.

Madruga.t: Madruga's incumbent senator was returned.

Miekarova.t: Father Nikolovich Drakov was elected Senator for Miekarova.

Necropolis.t: Necropolis's incumbent senator was returned.

Reikos.t: The Bourse seat for the Great Forest at Reikos went to Nemuel of Ravensfell for a bid of 56 thrones.

Sarvos.t: Magdelena di Sarvos was elected Senator for Sarvos.

Skarsind.t: Skarsind's incumbent senator was returned.

Temeschwar.t: Temeschwar's incumbent senator was returned.

Therunin.t: Willa Farkus-Vigil was elected Senator for Therunin.

Zenith.t: Zenith's incumbent senator was returned.

380YE Winter Solstice winds of fortune.d: The Synod faced a possible schism over the Congregation of the First Empress, and the stars vanished across the Empire. The Stalker was diverted from Miekarova and struck eastern Otkodov, where the Thule offered to share its ilium. The people of Whittle fled Jotun rule for Tassato Mestra. Gaunt figures haunted the Metri, the orcs of the Mallum offered peace talks over the Barrens, and Dogri Thulebane prepared something in Crow's Ridge. The Bourse private auction collapsed. Ennerlund became marsh, reducing Holberg's farms and raising upkeep on the Great Pits. The Court of the White Fountain's curse ended, and Lashonar's heralds were countered in Dawn.

Dawn.t: Dawn was tagged in the Druj offer to negotiate peace over the Barrens and faced bandits allied with renegade witches near Applefell. Lady Tamain Sepulchre's song The Heralds of Lashonar had entirely countered the eternal's influence on Dawn's armies by the Solstice.

Druj.t: The orcs of the Mallum offered to negotiate peace with the Empire over the Barrens and the situation in the east.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: a Grendel attack is named as one thing that could hinder the recovery of the Court of the White Fountain in Optarion.

Highguard.t: Highguard, especially its benefactors, was flagged as affected by the collapse of the Bourse private auction. It was also tagged in the transfer of Empress Giselle's sarcophagus to Temeschwar.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Imperial Orcs were tagged in the collapse of the Bourse private auction and in the Stalker's fall in Otkodov. They were also named as one possible holder of the Krampus's uncertain allegiance.

Jotun.t: Renewed Jotun domination of the Mourn drove the people of Whittle to abandon their homes en masse. The Jotun were also named as one possible holder of the Krampus's allegiance.

Navarr.t: The orcs of the Great Forest still occupied the Lower Tarn Valley in Therunin, and the question of land remained foremost for many Navarr of the south-east.

The Brass Coast.t: The Asavean temple in Oran neared completion, raising the question of the Asavean counter-offer to build a temple in Nemoria. The Brass Coast was also tagged in the collapse of the Bourse private auction.

The League.t: The League received the Whittle refugees in Tassato Mestra and faced gaunt figures in Temeschwar's Metri. Ennerlund's transformation into marsh permanently reduced Holberg's farms, while Giselle's sarcophagus lay beneath Ratibor's Gate and work on the Blood Red Roads continued.

The Marches.t: The Marches were tagged in the exodus of the people of Whittle in the Mourn, who fled south under renewed Jotun domination.

Thule.t: The Stalker crashed into eastern Otkodov, and the Thule offered the Empire an arrangement to share in its ilium, as previously agreed, though the Dragons' dealings were said never to be straightforward.

Urizen.t: The curse on the Court of the White Fountain in Optarion ran its course after one final season of damage, and its fire flared up again. Spiral's citizens were flagged as concerned by the season's magical effects.

Varushka.t: Varushka was tagged in the Stalker's diversion from Miekarova and was offered the golden hare as a new candidate Virtuous Animal. Disruptive weather kept the upkeep of the Icy Crag of the Eternal Sun artificially high.

Wintermark.t: Dogri Thulebane of Crow's Ridge was preparing something that could affect the northern Empire, and strange hunters kept raiding Sermersuaq. The Krampus behaved erratically with its allegiance unclear, and Wintermark was tagged in the Bourse auction's collapse.

380YE Winter Solstice winds of fortune.o: The Winter Solstice 380YE Winds of Fortune set out the season's developments across the Empire, from a looming schism in the Synod and the vanishing of the stars to the fall of the Stalker in Otkodov and a Druj offer to negotiate peace over the Barrens.

Feroz/Oranseri.t: The Asavean temple in Oran was largely complete, opening the question of an Asavean counter-offer to build a temple in Nemoria.

Holberg/Ennerlund.t: Ennerlund completed its slow transformation into marsh, and its Great Pits now need extra pumps and precautions that raise their upkeep by 2 Thrones a season.

Holberg/Rebeshof.t: Mentioned in passing: Rebeshof is part of the enlarged marsh that Ennerlund has now joined.

Holberg/The Morass.t: Mentioned in passing: the Morass is part of the enlarged marsh that Ennerlund has now joined.

Mournwold/Freemoor.t: The people of Whittle travelled south through the Freemoor hills with all their possessions on their way to Tassato Mestra.

Redoubt/Optarion.t: The curse on the Court of the White Fountain ended and its fire flared up again, though cracks in the tower's white stone still need repair.

Skarsind/Crow’s Ridge.t: Dogri Thulebane, renegade leader of the Winterfolk here, was preparing something whose impact may be felt across the northern Empire and beyond.

Tassato/Tassato Mestra.t: The people of Whittle arrived here seeking sanctuary after fleeing the Mourn.

Temeschwar/Metri.t: Something cold and dark settled over the woods, where gaunt figures slaughtered anyone bringing violence to another citizen, leaving the roads safer but the woods darker.

Therunin/Lower Tarn Valley.t: The orcs of the Great Forest, seeking sanctuary from the Barrens, continued to occupy the valley, with little change from the previous season.

Bregasland.t: Mentioned in passing: it is cited as one of the great marshes of the west, alongside which Holberg's enlarged marsh now ranks.

Feroz.t: The Asavean temple in Oran was nearing completion despite some opposition from the Synod, and its priest and builders were seeking a new challenge.

Holberg.t: Ennerlund finished turning into marsh, permanently reducing the territory's farm production by 36 rings and raising the Great Pits' upkeep by 2 Thrones a season.

Kallavesa.t: Mentioned in passing: it is cited as one of the great marshes of the west, alongside which Holberg's enlarged marsh now ranks.

Miekarova.t: The falling Stalker was diverted at the last moment away from Miekarova, striking Otkodov instead.

Mournwold.t: The people of Whittle left their homes en masse under renewed Jotun domination, travelling south with all their possessions.

Otkodov.t: The Stalker smashed into eastern Otkodov, its supernatural influence faded, and the Thule offered the Empire a share of the ilium it contains.

Redoubt.t: The curse on the Court of the White Fountain in Optarion ended after a last season of attack, leaving the tower's fire restored but its white stone still cracked.

Reikos.t: Mentioned in passing: its citizens are flagged as concerned by the season's round-up of magical effects, which is not detailed here.

Sermersuaq.t: Raids by strange hunters continued to disrupt businesses and farms, with Savik Summerstorm coordinating efforts to learn more.

Skarsind.t: Dogri Thulebane in Crow's Ridge was preparing something of wide impact. No progress was made on building a home for the Krampus in the territory.

Spiral.t: Mentioned in passing: its citizens are flagged as concerned by the season's round-up of magical effects, which is not detailed here.

Tassato.t: The people of Whittle arrived seeking sanctuary in Tassato Mestra after fleeing the Jotun-dominated Mourn.

Temeschwar.t: Gaunt figures in the Metri slaughtered anyone attempting violence against a citizen. Empress Giselle's sarcophagus was stored beneath Ratibor's Gate to await its new tomb.

The Barrens.t: The orcs of the Mallum offered to negotiate peace with the Empire over the Barrens and the situation in the east.

Therunin.t: The orcs of the Great Forest continued to occupy the Lower Tarn Valley. Senator Caerwyn Summer Crow provided them with money and supplies, but the question of land remained unresolved.

Weirwater.t: Bandits allied with renegade witches attacked a weirwood caravan near Applefell, the latest in an escalating series of problems with witches in southern Weirwater.

380YE Winter Solstice winds of war.d: Spiral, Necropolis, Reikos and Weirwater saw no major fighting, though the army of the dead lingered in Weirwater's forests. In the Mournwold both sides held their ground, and the Jotun freed branded Marcher 'oathbreakers' with a warning of no more mercy. Four Imperial armies stormed a Summer-realm citadel to free Serra Damata, losing around a hundred soldiers. The Golden Sun and Gryphon's Pride took Murderdale. Orcs seized about a third of Naris and sent raiders toward Elos and Evenstar. The Black Thorns lost Beacon Point and were boxed into Western Scout. Five Sentinel Gate conjunctions were identified in Redoubt, Liathaven and the Mournwold.

Dawn.t: The Golden Sun and Gryphon's Pride consolidated Carmine Fields and took Murderdale with few casualties, helped by a field hospital, while Dawnish knights errant fought the unliving host in Weirwater.

Druj.t: The Druj seemed to continue their conquest in the Barrens and possibly fought the briar heretics at Dourfell Keep, but avoided the Dawnish amid rumours of secret compacts.

Grendel.t: The Grendel held southern Spiral and the Black Plateau without seeking battle, and their mariners supported a landing of mostly Lasambrian orcs in southern Redoubt.

Highguard.t: The Highborn began rebuilding chapters among the new forests of Reikos, while the Quiet Step kept watch over Necropolis's coast against a Grendel assault that never came.

Jotun.t: The Jotun abandoned Kahraman behind a Summer citadel, then slaughtered three thousand Black Thorns in Liathaven and freed branded Mourn oathbreakers with a message that there would be no more mercy.

Navarr.t: The Black Thorns, swollen past seven thousand, lost three thousand soldiers and Beacon Point to the Jotun and were left trapped in Western Scout with only hard options for escape.

The Brass Coast.t: The Fire of the South helped liberate Serra Damata, restoring all of Kahraman and the Damatian Cliffs granite to the Empire, while the Red Wind Corsairs stood vigil in Necropolis.

The League.t: The Towerjacks joined the liberation of Serra Damata, while League generals urged their troops to rest and prepare for the war ahead.

The Marches.t: The Marches kept Greensward and buried their dead, while nearly a hundred Mourn folk branded as oathbreakers were released into Graven Marsh; the Singing Caves remained unallocated after a Throne veto.

Urizen.t: Spires in Ankra and Cinion began rebuilding, but in Redoubt the Heliopticon raised the alarm as orcs looted spires in Naris and threatened Elos and the hospital spire of Evenstar.

Varushka.t: Mentioned in passing: the army of the dead lingering in Weirwater originally emerged from Karsk.

380YE Winter Solstice winds of war.o: In Winter 380YE the eastern and western fronts were largely quiet, but Imperial armies liberated Serra Damata and advanced in the Barrens, while Lasambrian orcs backed by Grendel ships landed in southern Redoubt. In Liathaven a Jotun force from Kahraman fell on the Black Thorns, killing three thousand and trapping them in the west.

Kahraman/Serra Damata.t: Four Imperial armies stormed the Summer citadel and freed Damata, recovering the white granite of the Damatian Cliffs and finding a Jotun promise carved on the walls to return.

Liathaven/Beacon Point.t: The Jotun overran the Black Thorns left to hold Beacon Point and retook it within a month.

Liathaven/West Ranging.t: This Jotun-held region was a possible refuge for the Black Thorns if they crossed the vallorn by the Paths of Lan Thúven.

Liathaven/Western Scout.t: The Black Thorns retook ruined steadings here and still clung to parts of the region as a beachhead, though now under Jotun attack.

Mournwold/Greensward.t: Retaken by the Empire, Greensward was held without fighting as Marcher dead were buried in its south-eastern farms.

Redoubt/Naris.t: Invading orcs seized Rebekah's Leap and about a third of Naris, looting spires and sending raiders toward Elos and Evenstar.

Reikos/Broken Ride.t: Builders in western Broken Ride saw the faint glow of mushrooms beneath the trees at night.

Reikos/Grey Charge.t: Builders in northern Grey Charge saw an eerie mushroom glow beneath the trees under starless skies.

Reikos/Longshire.t: Builders in north-western Longshire saw the faint luminescent glow of mushrooms in the nearby forest.

Reikos/Tamarbode.t: Tamarbode stayed silent, with no woodcutting or quarrying in the dark forest claimed by Llofir.

Segura/Iron Plains.t: Mentioned in passing: the Black Thorns' losses were said to exceed those suffered on the Iron Plains.

Spiral/Ankra.t: Spires in Ankra began slowly to rebuild amid only scattered scout skirmishes.

Spiral/Cinion.t: Spires in Cinion began slowly to rebuild as the front stayed quiet.

The Barrens/Dawnguard.t: Mentioned in passing: Dawnguard remained among the Dawnish holdings in the Barrens.

The Barrens/Murderdale.t: Dawnish armies swept aside disorganised orc resistance and took Murderdale, leaving survivors to turn to banditry in the woods.

Weirwater/Hawksmoor.t: The unquiet dead still lurked in Hawksmoor's forests, where corpselights danced and travellers went missing.

Weirwater/Weirmoor.t: The undead host remained in Weirmoor's woods, drawing questing knights to deadly fights.

Astolat.t: Mentioned in passing: the unquiet dead had earlier been driven back from Astolat.

Bay of Catazar.t: Mentioned in passing: Quiet Step scouts watched the bay from the Necropolis cliffs for signs of a naval invasion.

Bregasland.t: Nearly a hundred branded Mourn folk crossed from Grey March into Graven Marsh, watched by five hundred silent Jotun on the hills above High Courage.

Kahraman.t: With Serra Damata liberated after a three-day siege of a Summer citadel, all of Kahraman was back under Imperial control.

Karsk.t: Mentioned in passing: the undead army now in Weirwater had emerged from Karsk six months earlier.

Liathaven.t: A Jotun host from Kahraman destroyed the Black Thorns' gains, retook Beacon Point and left the army trapped in the west of the territory.

Mournwold.t: No fighting took place; the Empire held Greensward, the Jotun held the rest, and a conjunction offered a chance to learn the Jotun's western plans.

Necropolis.t: The Quiet Step and Red Wind Corsairs guarded Sanctuary Sands and built an unlit warning beacon by the tomb of Atuman, but no Grendel attack came.

Redoubt.t: Lasambrian orcs backed by Grendel ships landed in the south, looted spires and threatened Elos and Evenstar, with two Sentinel Gate conjunctions opening to meet them.

Reikos.t: With the Spring magic subsided, Highborn rebuilding began among new forests, though Llofir's Tamarbode stayed silent and eerie mushroom light glowed beneath the trees.

Reinos.t: Mentioned in passing: an advance south into Reinos was one possible escape route for the trapped Black Thorns.

Segura.t: Mentioned in passing: Black Thorns losses were compared to the dead of the Iron Plains, and the Lasambrian invaders were said to come from beyond Segura.

Spiral.t: Imperial and Grendel forces each defended their own ground with only scout skirmishes, while Ankra and Cinion began to rebuild.

Tassato.t: Mentioned in passing: sentries on the walls of La Redotta Rezia kept a nervous watch for an orc return that did not come.

The Barrens.t: Dawnish armies now held Murderdale, Carmine Fields and Dawnguard, while the Druj moved elsewhere in the territory without engaging them.

The Semmerlak.t: Mentioned in passing: the undead host now in Weirwater had come out of the Semmerlak.

Weirwater.t: The army of the dead remained in the forests, drawing knights errant to fight it, while missing pedlars and woodcutters fuelled cries that someone must do something.

381YE Autumn Equinox Conclave sessions.d: The Golden Pyramid held precedence with 83 members. Gregor was re-appointed Grandmaster of the Shuttered Lantern and Raewynn Farkas became Grandmaster of the Silver Chalice. Rivers Run Red and Mountain Remembers Its Youth were interdicted, while Hallow of the Green World was reconciled. Concords thanked Lord Adamant and invited his koboldi to aid the Empire. Others sent magicians to teach the Great Forest orcs after the Druj's damage and affirmed the treaty with them. Rivers of Life and Blessing of New Spring were disseminated to those orcs. Richard of Holberg was asked to design a mana sinecure in Morrow and a magical structure in Tassato. Helios's candidacy for Autumn Archmage was defeated.

Dawn.t: Mentioned in passing: Kay Carter of Dawn provided the 10 thrones for disseminating Blessing of New Spring to the orcs of the Great Forest.

Druj.t: Mentioned in passing: a concord sent Conclave magicians to help the Great Forest orcs overcome the damage the Druj had done to them.

Highguard.t: The Conclave passed a concord inviting Gilean, herald of Llofir, to return to Highguard.

The League.t: League magicians of Tassato were active: Arsenio Rezia di Tassato carried the concord welcoming Lord Adamant's koboldi, and Erasmo di Tassato won support for a magical structure in Tassato.

Urizen.t: A concord seeking support to pursue the matter of horses and Medea of Urizen failed. Another passed asking Richard of Holberg to design a mana sinecure in Urizen-held Morrow.

381YE Autumn Equinox Conclave sessions.o: At the Autumn Equinox 381YE the Imperial Conclave appointed Pavel as Imperial Magus and Marcus Endsmeet as Archmage of Autumn. It also passed a string of declarations on interdictions, endowments, lore and aid to the Great Forest orcs.

Morrow.t: Gorion of Phoenix Reach's concord passed, calling for Richard of Holberg to design a mana sinecure in Morrow.

Tassato.t: Erasmo di Tassato's concord passed, calling for Richard of Holberg to design a magical structure in Tassato.

381YE Autumn Equinox Imperial elections.d: New senators were returned for Semmerholm, Casinea, Therunin and Volodmartz. Robert Dunlain took the Mournwold seat the Senate had allocated to the Marches. Redoubt and Zenith were contested after their previous senators were revoked; Redoubt elected Marissa of Shattered Spire and Zenith re-elected its previous incumbent. Veikko of Wintermark and Viviane de Coeurdefer of Dawn became Cardinals of Loyalty and Ambition, and Azekah of Highguard kept Pride. The four great Imperial Bourse seats sold for 350 to 375 thrones each. The Singing Caves in Mournwold, newly conquered, awaited Senate allocation as an Imperial or national title. The Legacy in Spiral was unavailable while Grendel held it.

Dawn.t: Lady Josline Arwood became senator for Semmerholm and Viviane de Coeurdefer was elected Cardinal of Ambition. Ranae de Rondell kept her post as Virtue Inquisitor of Ambition, and Dawnish military unit captains appointed Maryc Orzel unopposed as Castellan of Spiral Castle.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: the Legacy in Spiral could not be appointed this season because it was in Grendel hands.

Highguard.t: Nira of Cantiarch's Hold became senator for Casinea and Azekah of Highguard kept the seat of Cardinal of Pride. Sister Magdelana of the Shattered Tower was named Custodian of the Imperial War Memorial.

Navarr.t: Cybi Farkas was elected senator for Therunin, and Corwin Leafstalker of Navarr stayed on as Virtue Inquisitor of Loyalty.

The Brass Coast.t: The incumbent senator for Kahraman held the seat.

The League.t: The senator for Tassato kept the seat, and Astrid Fjellrevening Rezia di Tassato stayed on as Gatekeeper of Pride. Illaria Notturno di Sarvos of the League became Quaymaster of the Black Sails.

The Marches.t: Robert Dunlain took the Mournwold Senate seat allocated to the Marches, and the senator for Upwold kept the seat. Tess of the Marches stayed on as Gatekeeper of Loyalty, and the Singing Caves in Mournwold awaited Senate allocation after their conquest.

Urizen.t: After the previous senators for Redoubt and Zenith were revoked, Marissa of Shattered Spire won Redoubt and Zenith re-elected its previous incumbent; Morrow's senator kept the seat. Galene Netherwatch of Urizen became Virtue Inquisitor of Wisdom.

Varushka.t: Asya olya Vickentivich was elected senator for Volodmartz, and Varushkan mine owners returned Tomasz unopposed to the Eternal Shafts of Time.

Wintermark.t: Veikko of Wintermark became Cardinal of Loyalty, Rane Jorunsdottir kept the post of Virtue Inquisitor of Pride, and Gunnbrand Ironwill became Watcher of Britta's Pool. The senator for Hahnmark kept the seat, and military unit captains chose Algar of Ashenhall for the Pride of Ikka's Tears by 14 votes.

381YE Autumn Equinox Imperial elections.o: The Autumn Equinox elections of 381YE filled seats across the Senate, Military Council, Synod, Conclave and Bourse, including new senators for several territories and new holders of mithril and other Imperial titles.

Casinea.t: Nira of Cantiarch's Hold was elected senator for Casinea.

Hahnmark.t: The incumbent senator for Hahnmark held the seat.

Kahraman.t: The incumbent senator for Kahraman held the seat.

Morrow.t: The incumbent senator for Morrow held the seat.

Mournwold.t: The Senate allocated Mournwold's seat to the Marches, and Robert Dunlain was elected to it. The Singing Caves, newly conquered, could be made an Imperial or national title by the Senate.

Redoubt.t: The previous senator for Redoubt was revoked, and Marissa of Shattered Spire was elected in their place.

Semmerholm.t: Lady Josline Arwood was elected senator for Semmerholm.

Spiral.t: The Legacy in Spiral could not be appointed while Grendel held it, though Dawnish captains named Maryc Orzel Castellan of Spiral Castle.

Tassato.t: The incumbent senator for Tassato held the seat.

Therunin.t: Cybi Farkas was elected senator for Therunin.

Upwold.t: The incumbent senator for Upwold held the seat.

Volodmartz.t: Asya olya Vickentivich was elected senator for Volodmartz.

Zenith.t: The previous senator for Zenith was revoked but was then re-elected to the seat.

381YE Autumn Equinox winds of fortune.d: The national assemblies split over the Varushkan Iron Helms. Wintermark and the Freeborn rejected them, the League's priests spoke against fear as a weapon, and Dawn, Highguard and Urizen joined Navarr and Varushka in sanctioning cruelty. Highguard stood by Yael after the Synod executed her for heresy. Broken Shore orcs raided the Bay of Catazar and Imperial fleets struck back. Many eternals made offers or sought parley, and the Senate's Silver Chalice order neared establishment. Opportunities arose in the Mournwold, Sarvos and Therunin. Six Summer mandates took effect, including a ban on Marcher armies giving ground. Resources in Liathaven suffered the Conquered Territories penalty.

Dawn.t: Dawn's assembly sanctioned the Iron Helms' cruelty, and its mandate formally repudiated Yael's teachings. Meanwhile the eternal Eleonaris made her displeasure with the Dawnish clear, and an antique artefact of a famous Dawnish enchanter appeared at the Winter Market.

Druj.t: Mentioned in passing: the Great Forest orcs now in Therunin are described as exiles who fled the Druj.

Highguard.t: The Highborn alone stood by Yael after her execution, leaving the founding nation of the Way at doctrinal odds with the rest of the Empire. Their assembly also sanctioned battlefield cruelty, and Highborn resource owners in Highguard gained a production boost for as long as they do not reject the Land Without Tears.

Jotun.t: Mentioned in passing: the Jotun are not named, but Liathaven, which they held, saw Imperial resources there suffer the Conquered Territories penalty.

Navarr.t: The Navarr assembly's mandate gave the general of the Quiet Step the chance to make the army permanently cunning. Therunin's Navarr faced the repercussions of the Senate's treaty with the displaced Great Forest orcs.

The Brass Coast.t: The Freeborn assembly rejected the Iron Helms, and its mandate imposed penalties on that army when it fights alongside Freeborn armies. The Freeborn were also tagged in the orc pirate raids on the Bay of Catazar and a theft from Serra Briante.

The League.t: League priests spoke against using fear as a weapon, though not unanimously, and the assembly set out principles for rebuilding and securing Sarvos. Lorenzo 'La Volpe' von Temeschwar's name was on everyone's lips.

The Marches.t: The Marcher mandate means no Marcher general can ever again issue the Give Ground order. The nation also faced a double-length opportunity over the Mournwold and news of a fallen star in the Marches.

Urizen.t: The Urizen assembly joined those sanctioning the use of cruelty and fear on the battlefield, in support of the Iron Helms.

Varushka.t: The Varushkan mandate let the Iron Helms take the Terror in the Night order until the start of Spring 382YE, even as several nations rejected the army. The traditional Varushkan Winter Market drew rare goods to Anvil.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark's assembly rejected the Iron Helms, and its mandate gave Wintermark armies extra orders alongside them while the Iron Helms suffer penalties when fighting with Wintermark armies. The seal-folk of Sermersuaq and their blessing also featured in the season's magical news.

381YE Autumn Equinox winds of fortune.o: The 381YE Autumn Equinox Winds of Fortune gathered a season's worth of developments for the Empire, from Synod quarrels over the cruel Iron Helms army and Highguard's stand with the executed Yael to orc pirate raids on the Bay of Catazar, eternal envoys and a new Conclave order.

Kahraman/Serra Briante.t: A theft from Serra Briante was one of three Bourse-related situations raised this season.

Bay of Catazar.t: Broken Shore orc pirates raided the bay twice, first attacking its fisherfolk and then trying to enslave the people of the Isle of Zemress. Imperial fleet captains answered with counter-raids.

Holberg.t: Mentioned in passing: a grateful Holberg architect has an offer for the Conclave.

Kahraman.t: A theft from Serra Briante in Kahraman was one of three Bourse-related situations offering opportunities or threats.

Liathaven.t: Resources in Liathaven received the Conquered Territories penalty to their production.

Miekarova.t: Mentioned in passing: Miekarova is not named on the page, which concerns Varushka only through the Iron Helms and the Winter Market.

Mournwold.t: The complicated situation in the Mournwold produced a double-length opportunity over what could and should be done there.

Sarvos.t: The League assembly set out principles for rebuilding and securing Sarvos and condemned the Iron Helms, who had just spent three months in the city. There was also an update on the orcs at the College of the Liberated.

Sermersuaq.t: The seal-folk of Sermersuaq and their blessing featured in the season's magical roundup, which was especially relevant to the territory's people.

Temeschwar.t: Mentioned in passing: the territory appears in the name and titles of Lorenzo 'La Volpe' von Temeschwar, Treasurer of the Bloody Butchers of Temeschwar.

Therunin.t: The Great Forest orcs who fled the Druj into Therunin faced the repercussions of the treaty the Senate ratified at the Summer Solstice to define their relationship with the Empire.

381YE Autumn Equinox winds of war.d: In Spiral, League and Urizen armies drove the Grendel from Cinion, and the Wolves of War and Red Wind Corsairs plundered the Legacy's mithril caravan. The Grendel collapsed most passes from Redoubt, and the Black Plateau began to stir. The Golden Sun routed the husks in Weirwater. The Freeborn Storm was beaten back to Rebekah's Leap. Three Highborn armies lost over a thousand soldiers covering the evacuation of Zenith as the Druj and the cruel Black Wind advanced. Marcher-led armies liberated Ore Hills, Greensward and Alderly, returning the Mournwold to Imperial control. The Druj conquered Axmure and razed the Gate. Four Sentinel Gate conjunctions were identified.

Dawn.t: The Golden Sun and over forty captains crushed the husk host in Weirwater for around four hundred losses. Meanwhile the Druj overran Axmure and razed the Gate, raising fears that Dawn may struggle to support all four of its armies.

Druj.t: Druj armies conquered Axmure, destroyed the Gate and took Lustri and Occursion. In Proceris, their cruel Black Wind army pushed the Highborn back at heavy cost to both sides.

Grendel.t: The Grendel were driven from Cinion and lost the Legacy's mithril caravan to Imperial raiders. They collapsed most passes into Spiral, plundered its southern regions for wealth and slaves, and outfought the Freeborn Storm at sea.

Highguard.t: The Valiant Pegasus, Granite Pillar and Seventh Wave held Zenith in a disciplined fighting retreat, losing over a thousand soldiers to cover the Urizen evacuation. They now risk breaking under the Black Wind's merciless onslaught.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Winter Sun and Summer Storm fought in the Mournwold and helped distribute Senate aid to orc thralls, but met a frosty welcome from Mournwolders. Separately, an Imperial Orc trader was lynched in Semmerholm after being mistaken for a Druj spy.

Jotun.t: The Jotun lost the Tribute, Ore Hills, Greensward and Alderly, leaving only Green March and Southmoor. Their remaining forces are concentrated at Hillstop, while Navarr scouts kept them chasing shadows in Liathaven.

Navarr.t: Cloaked in Night magic, the Black Thorns slipped the Jotun noose in Liathaven and routed the Jotun in Alderly. The Quiet Step made a fifth of the progress needed to liberate Beacon Point.

The Brass Coast.t: With every Freeborn force in action, the Fire of the South held the Twilight Gate and the Red Wind Corsairs helped loot the Legacy. The Freeborn Storm suffered heavy losses and was driven back to Rebekah's Leap.

The League.t: The Wolves of War and Towerjacks helped clear Cinion, and the Wolves seized much of the Legacy's mithril as a reckoning for Sarvos. Holberg now faces being cut off if the Druj take Estmure.

The Marches.t: The Drakes, Strong Reeds, Tusks and Bounders retook three Mournwold regions, so the territory is again Imperial and can be assigned by the Senate. Marcher soldiers also distributed Imperial Breadbasket supplies to the liberated people.

Urizen.t: The Citadel Guard helped win back Cinion, but the Black Plateau is waking and the Grendel have sealed most passes. In Zenith, spires fell or were veiled, and civilians fled west as the Druj threatened the Golden Cascade.

Varushka.t: The Golden Axe fought in the Mournwold to a cool reception, and Varushkan wagon raiders joined the Wolves of War. Varushkan magicians wove the Night shroud that hid the Black Thorns.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark warriors fought alongside the Golden Sun in Weirwater. The Grape & The Grain coven wrapped Zenith in Autumn magic that aided refugees and defenders alike, though it helped the Druj too.

381YE Autumn Equinox winds of war.o: The Autumn Equinox 381YE Wind of War reported Imperial victories in Spiral, Weirwater and the Mournwold, a costly naval defeat for the Freeborn Storm, and a slow Highborn retreat before the Druj in Zenith. It also covered the Black Thorns' escape from Liathaven and the Druj invasion of Semmerholm that destroyed the Gate.

Holberg/Holmauer.t: Mentioned in passing: the dangerous mountains between Axmure and Holmauer are one of the only routes into Holberg other than the Walls.

Kahraman/Serra Damata.t: Mentioned in passing: the Quiet Step general's orders named an advance north from Serra Damata to Beacon Point.

Liathaven/Beacon Point.t: The Quiet Step entered Beacon Point, wiping out Jotun camps, and are perhaps a fifth of the way to liberating it.

Liathaven/Liath's Ring.t: The shrouded Black Thorns fled eastward through Liath's Ring, evading the Jotun on their way to the Mournwold.

Liathaven/Liaven's Glen.t: The Black Thorns passed through Liaven's Glen under their Night shroud before emerging into the Mournwold.

Liathaven/West Ranging.t: The Black Thorns began the season surrounded by the Jotun in West Ranging, then slipped out of the trap under a Varushkan Night shroud.

Mournwold/Alderly.t: Feni raids slowed the Empire in Alderly, until the Black Thorns surprised and routed the retreating Jotun. The region was secured, though its woods remain impassable to armies and its folk aloof.

Mournwold/Green March.t: Green March remains in Jotun hands, and the few survivors of the rout in Alderly fled there.

Mournwold/Greensward.t: The Greensward fell without a fight, and the Empire reclaimed the unworked Singing Caves mithril mine. The region is now largely deserted save for monks tending the dead beside a Jotun burial mound.

Mournwold/Ore Hills.t: The Empire besieged and stormed the Tribute after nearly a month, killing almost the entire Jotun garrison. The fort was left a ruin and the Ore Hills were liberated.

Mournwold/Southmoor.t: Probing attacks made some progress, but the Jotun are massed at Hillstop and refuse to parley. A Sentinel Gate conjunction offers heroes a skirmish near the castle.

Redoubt/Optarion.t: The Onyx Path from Optarion to Ateri, guarded by the Citadel of the Flame, remains one of only three passes into Spiral open to an army.

Redoubt/Willstone.t: The Crow Road from Willstone to Cinion remains open to armies. A Sunday conjunction near it offers a chance to intercept a flanking Grendel force.

Semmerholm/Axmure.t: The Druj conquered Axmure in under a month, overrunning secluded manors and scattering the houses of Rylas and de Lusignan.

Semmerholm/Estmure.t: The Gate held for over a month before falling to poison and assault, and the Druj butchered its defenders and burned the castle. Its ruins are the only ground they hold in Estmure, but the rest now lies undefended.

Semmerholm/Lacuve.t: Wealthy Lacuve now lies open to the Druj, and it is expected to fall in coming seasons unless something changes.

Spiral/Ankra.t: The Towerjacks and Citadel Guard pushed into Ankra and the Wolves of War seized its passes into Apstrus. A Grendel force based there may have collapsed the northern passes.

Spiral/Apstrus.t: The Wolves of War and Red Wind Corsairs ambushed the armoured mithril caravan from the Legacy in northern Apstrus, possibly seizing the mine's entire output.

Spiral/Ateri.t: The eastern end of the Onyx Path emerges in Ateri near Fort Mezudan, and the disastrous naval battle was fought in the waters south of it.

Spiral/Cinion.t: The western Imperial armies drove the Grendel out of Cinion entirely. The Crow Road links the region to Willstone.

Spiral/Ossuary.t: The Fire of the South held the Twilight Gate in northern Ossuary and fought cautious skirmishes with the Brine Turtles, but remain penned in by the Grendel.

Weirwater/Sandling.t: A Saturday Sentinel Gate conjunction opens near Sandling, offering a chance to strike the retreating husk army.

Zenith/Clypion.t: Urizen magicians gathered in a black ice citadel raised by the Blazing Sun coven, which became a refuge for fleeing residents. Highborn resistance spared the Halls of Knowledge from the torch.

Zenith/Iteri.t: Mentioned in passing: spires in Iteri welcomed evacuees fleeing the Druj advance.

Zenith/Lustri.t: The Druj took Lustri and raised a citadel of woven trees there, said to house ghulai who torture captured Urizen magicians for their lore.

Zenith/Occursion.t: Occursion fell to the Druj, who used it to launch their advance onto the plains of Proceris.

Zenith/Proceris.t: The Druj made gains in Proceris without taking the region, threatening the Golden Cascade and possibly the Twilight Gate. A Saturday conjunction offers a strike against the Black Wind there.

Bay of Catazar.t: The Freeborn Storm and over fifty independent captains sailed east to stop Grendel naval support in Spiral. They were outmanoeuvred by the Grendel armada, losing three ships for every Grendel vessel sunk.

Holberg.t: Refugees fled toward Holberg, which risks being cut off from the Empire if the Druj conquer Estmure. Only the Walls of Holberg and the dangerous mountains bar the orcs' way into the territory.

Kahraman.t: The Quiet Step marched through Kahraman into southern Liathaven. Some Mournwold yeomen fled south into the territory past Fort Braydon.

Karov.t: Mentioned in passing: the defeated husks retreated north from Culwich toward Karov.

Liathaven.t: The Black Thorns escaped encirclement under a Night shroud, and Quiet Step scouts harried Jotun supply lines in the north. The Quiet Step made early gains in Beacon Point.

Morrow.t: Mentioned in passing: a Saturday conjunction opens in northern Proceris not far from the border with Morrow.

Mournwold.t: Imperial armies liberated Ore Hills, Greensward and Alderly, returning the territory to Imperial control and opening it to a Senate motion of assignment. Anti-Imperial sentiment lingers, and the Jotun still hold Green March and Southmoor.

Redoubt.t: Grendel forces collapsed most army-sized passes from Redoubt into Spiral, leaving only the Onyx Path and the Crow Road on this side. The defeated Freeborn Storm retreated west into Redoubt's waters.

Reikos.t: Mentioned in passing: Highborn soldiers were spurred on by memories of what the Druj did to Reikos and its people.

Sarvos.t: Mentioned in passing: the general of the Wolves of War called the Spiral raid a reckoning for the Grendel's taking of Sarvos.

Semmerholm.t: The Druj invaded, conquered Axmure and destroyed the Gate after a month-long siege. Their raiders terrorised the territory, and nothing significant now stands between them and the rest of Semmerholm.

Spiral.t: The Empire drove the Grendel from Cinion, gained ground in Ankra and plundered the Legacy. Grendel pillaging cut personal resource production by a fifth, and the waking Black Plateau began adding to casualties.

Tassato.t: Mentioned in passing: the Quiet Step marched through Tassato, and some displaced Mournwold yeomen fled there.

The Semmerlak.t: Mentioned in passing: Holberg might be supplied by ship across the Semmerlak if cut off, and the Sandling conjunction opens near its shores.

Weirwater.t: The Golden Sun, the Knights of Glory and their allies defeated the husks in battles culminating outside Culwich. Much farmland was destroyed and smaller husk gangs remain at large.

Zenith.t: The Druj took Lustri and Occursion and advanced into Proceris, while Highguard armies covered the westward evacuation of spires. Rival citadels of black ice and woven trees were raised in Clypion and Lustri.

381YE Spring Equinox Imperial elections.d: New senators were chosen for Reikos and Holberg, and incumbents were returned for Segura and Karsk. Generals were appointed to the Valiant Pegasus, the Iron Helms and the Gryphon's Pride. The Fire of the South passed to Marciel i Riqueza after Vrael i Sol-Devorador i Erigo's appointment was revoked. The Synod appointed Cardinals of Ambition, Vigilance, Pride and Loyalty, though Frederik di Regario, the new Cardinal of Loyalty, died by the end of the summit. The Conclave named an Imperial Censor and Warmage, and Bourse seats were awarded. The Legacy lapsed into Grendel hands, the Sheriff of Overton was lost with Overton, and the Civilian Commissioners were abrogated.

Dawn.t: Dawnish citizens took several Synod posts: Viviane de Coeurdefer as Gatekeeper of Ambition, Ranae de Rondell as Virtue Inquisitor of Ambition, Odelina de Rondell as Dean of Laroc Cathedral and Kaywenn du Launcet as High Bard of the Empire. Garravaine de Rondell was named General of the Gryphon's Pride.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: the title of The Legacy is listed as lapsed or vacated because it is currently in Grendel hands.

Highguard.t: Highborn gained the Senate seat for Reikos through Cadeur of the Shattered Tower, along with three Synod posts: Azekah as Cardinal of Pride, Adamah as Virtue Inquisitor of Vigilance and Lucifer, Son of Cyrus as Virtue Inquisitor of Courage. Zephaniah was returned as Grandmaster of the Sevenfold Path.

Imperial Orcs.t: Bloodcrow Ergot of the Imperial Orcs became Chaplain Consular. Bloodcrow Yargol was named Advisor on Orc Affairs and Bloodcrow Losak took the Steel Fist.

Navarr.t: Mentioned in passing: Heilyn Bronwen's Rest of Navarr was appointed Warmage.

The Brass Coast.t: Avisena i Ezmara i Guerra was returned as Senator for Segura. Command of the Fire of the South passed to Marciel i Riqueza after Vrael i Sol-Devorador i Erigo's appointment was revoked.

The League.t: League citizens dominated the Synod results, taking the Cardinals of Ambition, Vigilance and Loyalty, the Gatekeeper of Pride and the Guardian of Giselle's Tomb, though the new Cardinal of Loyalty died by the end of the summit. Leaguers also won the Holberg Senate seat, the Grandmastery of the Golden Pyramid, the Mint and the Assayer's Guild.

Urizen.t: Two Urizeni took Imperial titles: Zeno, Stallion's Sibling as Auditor of Senatorial Accountability and Helios Bitter Chalice as Imperial Censor.

Varushka.t: Maarit was returned as Senator for Karsk. The Stonefield Ice Caves seat stayed unfilled because it is not currently under Imperial control.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark gained three Synod posts: Aarne Ceorling as Gatekeeper of Vigilance, Rane Jorunsdottir as Virtue Inquisitor of Pride and Nils Bardstrom as Crow Keeper of the Rest.

381YE Spring Equinox Imperial elections.o: At the 381YE Spring Equinox the Empire filled a wide range of Senate, Military Council, Synod, Conclave and Bourse titles, while several titles lapsed or were vacated, including the Senator for Spiral after that territory left Imperial hands.

Holberg.t: Irina Arkady Staryn Von Holberg was elected Senator for Holberg.

Karsk.t: The incumbent, Maarit, kept the Senate seat for Karsk.

Reikos.t: Cadeur of the Shattered Tower was elected Senator for Reikos.

Segura.t: The incumbent, Avisena i Ezmara i Guerra, was returned as Senator for Segura.

381YE Spring Equinox winds of fortune.d: Five nations had denounced Yael of Highguard's Congregation of the First Empress, deepening the threat of schism within the Way. In Oran, the Temple of Balo and the Black Bull opened and drew Asavean merchants and sailors. Sinister storms swept away roads and bridges in Redoubt. The orcs of the Great Forest, squatting in the Lower Tarn Valley, were bringing matters to a head. With Dogri Thulebane gone, the passes from Skarsind to Otkodov opened to the Thule. The Mournwold campaign left twenty thousand warriors dead. Other items covered the exiled Whittle folk in Tassato, the end of raids in Sermersuaq, and the Krampus settling into its Krampushall in Pakaanan's Pass.

Dawn.t: Dawn was named as especially concerned by the deepening Synod crisis over Yael of Highguard and her Congregation of the First Empress.

Druj.t: Mentioned in passing: the orcs of the Great Forest are described as having fled south from the Barrens with the Druj at their heels.

Highguard.t: Highguard's Yael and her Congregation of the First Empress stood at the centre of a growing schism, with five nations denouncing her and only one endorsing her.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Imperial Orcs saw their place in the Way cemented by the new Doctrines of the Howling Abyss and the Ancestors, though questions remained. They also gained the Thule as northern neighbours through the newly opened passes and the Krampus as a new neighbour in Pakaanan's Pass.

Jotun.t: The Jotun were among the four groups hardest hit by the especially bloody Mournwold campaign. Earlier, they had forced the folk of Whittle Hill from their land.

Navarr.t: Navarr faced an unsustainable situation in Therunin, where the orcs of the Great Forest they had invited were squatting in the Lower Tarn Valley and bringing matters to a head.

The Brass Coast.t: The Brass Coast saw the Temple of Balo and the Black Bull open in Oran, bringing an influx of Asavean merchants and sailors. The Freeborn assembly seemed less than thrilled with related developments.

The League.t: In the League, the Tassato Chamber of Commerce welcomed the exiled Marchers of Whittle Hill, who bought two streets for an enclave.

The Marches.t: The Marches suffered heavily in the bloody Mournwold campaign. The exiled folk of Whittle, now settled in Tassato, remained under Synod suspicion over their dealings with blasphemous powers.

Thule.t: With Dogri Thulebane removed, the Thule of Otkodov gained open passes into Skarsind. They seemed pleased and continued to offer a guarded hand of friendship to the Empire.

Urizen.t: Urizen was battered by malign storms that swept away key roads and bridges in Redoubt. Its magicians' Wondrous Forests of the Night ritual also produced unexpected effects across the Empire.

Varushka.t: Varushka was named among those with an interest in the improving détente with the Thule of Otkodov and the northern trade network.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark saw the hunter raids in Sermersuaq peter out, was affected by the Mournwold carnage, had an interest in the Otkodov détente, and was named in connection with the Krampushall.

381YE Spring Equinox winds of fortune.o: The Spring Equinox 381YE Winds of Fortune gathered the season's news across the Empire. It covered a deepening Synod schism over Yael of Highguard, malign storms in Redoubt, the opening of Oran's Temple of Balo and the Black Bull, a crisis with the orcs of the Great Forest in Therunin, newly opened passes to Otkodov, and the bloody aftermath of the Mournwold campaign.

Feroz/Oranseri.t: Oran's Temple of Balo and the Black Bull opened its doors, bringing an influx of Asavean merchants and sailors.

Mournwold/Alderly.t: The Feni of the forest of Alderly were among the four groups particularly affected by the carnage of the Mournwold campaign.

Skarsind/Pakaanan's Pass.t: The Krampus settled into its new Krampushall overlooking the Clattering Gulley and declared itself pleased, a possible double-edged sword given its association with bad luck.

Therunin/Lower Tarn Valley.t: The orcs of the Great Forest were squatting in the Lower Tarn Valley, and the arrangement was proving unsustainable as spring arrived.

Bregasland.t: Mentioned in passing: the Winds of Magic carried tales of a glimmering citadel in the marshes of Bregasland.

Casinea.t: Mentioned in passing: Casinea is not named on the page; Highguard's link comes through the Synod crisis over Yael of Highguard.

Feroz.t: The Temple of Balo and the Black Bull opened in Oran, drawing Asavean merchants and sailors seeking the blessings of their idols.

Mournwold.t: The Mournwold endured one of the bloodiest campaign seasons ever, with twenty thousand warriors and soldiers dead and untold losses among its citizens.

Otkodov.t: The northern passes linking Otkodov to Skarsind opened to the Thule orcs after the removal of Dogri Thulebane, improving relations with the Empire.

Redoubt.t: Malign storms, floods and high winds struck Redoubt as far inland as Cargo, sweeping away several key roads and bridges and raising questions about how armies can move through the territory.

Sermersuaq.t: The raids by odd hunters in Sermersuaq petered out, though it was unclear whether Savik Summerstorm had secured a lasting resolution.

Skarsind.t: The passes out of Skarsind to Otkodov opened to the Thule after the removal of Dogri Thulebane, and the Krampus took up residence in Pakaanan's Pass.

Tassato.t: The exiled Marchers of Whittle Hill bought two streets in Tassato and created an enclave, welcomed by the Chamber of Commerce despite the Synod's concerns about them.

The Barrens.t: Mentioned in passing: the orcs of the Great Forest are said to have fled south from the Barrens pursued by the Druj.

Therunin.t: The orcs of the Great Forest, invited into Therunin six months earlier, found their temporary situation unsustainable and were bringing matters to a head.

381YE Spring Equinox winds of war.d: The Grendel quit Redoubt but kept a foothold in Naris.
