The Black Thorns passed through the Westwood by the Paths of Lan Thúven and, with the Fire of the South, fell one victory point short of a beachhead in West Ranging, while the Jotun reconquered Western Scout. The Iron Helms took Crow's Keep and captured Dogri alive, giving Crow's Ridge to the Imperial Orcs. The Grendel overran Spiral, seizing the Legacy and raiding its spoils of war. In the Mournwold, Imperial curses killed thousands as the Jotun took most of the Greensward. The Druj claimed Murderdale and the Carmine Fields, and an unliving host lingered in Hawksmoor.

Dawn.t: The Eastern Sky supported the Urizen at the Court of the White Fountain, while the Golden Sun and Gryphon's Pride withdrew from the Barrens to Astolat, leaving Dawn holding only Dawnguard. The unliving host in Weirwater still threatened its yeofolk.

Druj.t: The Druj claimed Murderdale and the Carmine Fields, taking all of the Barrens except Dawnguard. Under the peace treaty they now count as foreigners under Imperial law.

Grendel.t: The Grendel left Redoubt but kept a foothold in Naris, then reconquered Spiral, capturing the Legacy, plundering mithril and spoils of war, and taking captives south.

Imperial Orcs.t: Crow's Ridge passed to Imperial Orc control after Crow's Keep fell. Orc garrisons at Hengesthal advised the Iron Helms, and an Imperial Orc magistrate went with the army.

Jotun.t: The Jotun were nearly driven out of West Ranging but reconquered Western Scout. They won a Pyrrhic victory in the Greensward, losing perhaps ten thousand at Orchard's Watch alone.

Navarr.t: The Black Thorns sacrificed two hundred thorns and unleashed a thousand bound dead before crossing the Westwood to strike West Ranging. No significant Navarr presence is now assumed to remain in Liathaven.

The Brass Coast.t: The Fire of the South made a gruelling march from Kahraman to Bregasland to attack West Ranging alongside the Navarr. Their general sought vengeance for the Jotun invasion of Kahraman.

The League.t: Mentioned in passing: the Fire of the South marched through Tassato, which was also the Imperial fallback point from the Mournwold.

The Marches.t: The Drakes refused to retreat and held the Singing Caves, but Orchard's Watch and Greensward Abbey were destroyed. A sixth of the Mournwold's people died from the curses, and the Sheriff of Overton's sinecure was lost.

Thule.t: Mentioned in passing: Dogri's supporters were said to hunger to strike at the Thule, and some Branoc warriors were rumoured to have fought both alongside and against them.

Urizen.t: Urizen lost Spiral, along with its Senate seat and the Legacy's Bourse seat. The spire of Evenstar in Naris remained in orc hands, though Elos was saved from burning.

Varushka.t: The Iron Helms took Crow's Keep and captured Dogri at a cost of over two hundred soldiers. The Northern Eagle was driven back in Spiral and the Golden Axe pinned Jotun forces in Freemoor.

Wintermark.t: Dogri Thulebane was captured and his army destroyed, and no significant Winterfolk population is now assumed to remain in Skarsind. The Green Shield was forced back in Spiral, where Winterfolk and Varushkan losses neared three thousand.

381YE Spring Equinox winds of war.o: In Spring 381YE the Black Thorns and the Fire of the South came within a whisker of taking West Ranging, the Iron Helms stormed Crow's Keep and captured Dogri Thulebane, and the Grendel retook Spiral. The Jotun won a ruinously costly victory in the cursed Mournwold, the Druj reclaimed most of the Barrens, and the Grendel withdrew from Redoubt.

Astolat.t: The Golden Sun and Gryphon's Pride withdrew from the Barrens to Astolat, where the unliving host had earlier been engaged before retreating.

Bay of Catazar.t: Mentioned in passing: the Fire of the South's soldiers were praised as soldiers of the Bay of Catazar.

Bregasland.t: The Fire of the South rested on the causeway east of Sallow, then entered West Ranging on the marshfolk's flat-bottomed boats.

Hahnmark.t: Mentioned in passing: a Suaq magistrate from Hahnmark accompanied the Iron Helms, and the Jotun held points on the route between Hahnmark and the Mournwold.

Kahraman.t: Mentioned in passing: the Fire of the South marched out of Kahraman, seeking vengeance for the Jotun invasion of it.

Karsk.t: Mentioned in passing: Karsk's artisans forged the Iron Helms' armour, and the unliving host had emerged from Karsk the previous year.

Liathaven.t: The Empire came within one victory point of a beachhead in West Ranging, while the Jotun retook Western Scout. With no Imperial-held region left, Navarr presence there is assumed gone.

381YE Summer Solstice Imperial elections.d: New or returning senators were chosen for nine territories. Most Military Council generals were re-elected, though new generals took the Tusks, Black Thorns, Army of the Northern Eagle and Bounders. The Wolves of War was left under the Throne after Gabriel Barossa was removed using the Throne's power as Defender of the Empire. The Synod appointed cardinals of Courage, Wisdom and Loyalty, and Martin Orchard became Imperial Inquisitor. Conclave grandmasters and the Archmage of Spring were named. The Damatian Cliffs went at auction for the highest bid of 355 thrones. The Sheriff of Overton was no longer in Imperial hands, and the Overseer of the Cavabianca Dock was held over to Autumn.

Dawn.t: Lady Eve of House Orzel became Senator for Weirwater and Zoran Orzel was returned as General of the Golden Sun. Abaddon De Rondell of Dawn was named Cardinal of Wisdom.

Highguard.t: Sammual took the Bastion Senate seat and Mathayus kept the Granite Pillar. Highborn also won the Cardinal of Loyalty (Caleb of Reumah's Redoubt) and the Virtue Inquisitor of Courage (Lucifer, Son of Cyrus), while Sariel provisionally retained the Wisdom inquisitorship.

Navarr.t: Llewellyn Leafstalker was returned as Senator for Miaren and Eira Pridestalker became General of the Black Thorns. Corwin Leafstalker provisionally retained the Virtue Inquisitor of Loyalty.

The Brass Coast.t: Chiara i Zaydan i Riqueza became Senator for Feroz and Estana i Mestiere i Guerra was returned as General of the Red Wind Corsairs. Safya i Kalamar i Guerra took the Glass Parador.

The League.t: Magdelena Alanga Di Sarvos held the Sarvos seat, Will Talbot kept the Drakes and a Sarvos citizen became Imperial Consul. The Wolves of War passed to the Throne after its general, Gabriel Barossa, was removed, and the Cavabianca Dock overseer was held over to Autumn.

The Marches.t: William Guildenstern became Senator for Mitwold and new generals took the Tusks and the Bounders. Martin Orchard of the Marches became Imperial Inquisitor, but the Sheriff of Overton was recorded as no longer in Imperial hands.

Urizen.t: Probus of Shattered Spire was returned as Senator for Redoubt and Nicassia Abicia kept the Citadel Guard. Alcuin of the Spire of Shattered Art was named Head Gardener of Urizen.

Varushka.t: Pipski of the Vor'ezi became Senator for Karov and Amris of Varushka was named Gatekeeper of Wisdom. Vtaly Grigorovich Dukov kept the Granites of Veltsgorsk.

Wintermark.t: Atte was returned as Senator for Sermersuaq and Irontide Skar kept the Summer Storm. Kai of Wintermark was named Guardian of Dunfrith.

381YE Summer Solstice Imperial elections.o: The Summer Solstice 381YE Imperial elections filled Senate seats, generalships, Synod titles, Conclave positions and Bourse seats across the Empire. Several incumbents were returned and a number of new title-holders appointed.

Bastion.t: Sammual was elected Senator for Bastion.

Feroz.t: Chiara i Zaydan i Riqueza was elected Senator for Feroz.

Karov.t: Pipski of the Vor'ezi was elected Senator for Karov.

Miaren.t: Incumbent Llewellyn Leafstalker was returned as Senator for Miaren.

Mitwold.t: William Guildenstern was elected Senator for Mitwold.

Redoubt.t: Incumbent Probus of Shattered Spire was returned as Senator for Redoubt.

Sarvos.t: Incumbent Magdelena Alanga Di Sarvos kept the Senate seat for Sarvos.

Sermersuaq.t: Incumbent Atte was returned as Senator for Sermersuaq.

Weirwater.t: Lady Eve of House Orzel was elected Senator for Weirwater.

381YE Summer Solstice winds of fortune.d: Dawn's National Assembly declared Empress Lisabetta Queen of Dawn, and the Throne addressed all citizens. Seven nations denounced Yael of Highguard as false, while Highguard and Dawn embraced her and the Imperial Orcs stood aside. A sinkhole swallowed parts of Temeschwar, Miaren, Upwold and Hahnmark, though a Navarr vates warning prevented major loss of life. Imperial magicians could no longer draw power from Spring regio. A fishing boom offered risky opportunities in the Bay of Catazar. The Grendel discovered the Freeborn lost colony on Zemress. The Mournwold situation worsened. Other entries covered the Iron Helms mandates, Winds of Magic, curiosities for sale in Anvil, eternal responses and trade.

Dawn.t: The Dawnish National Assembly recognised Empress Lisabetta as Queen of Dawn, with profound potential repercussions. Dawn also embraced Yael despite apparent internal doubt.

Grendel.t: Grendel threatened fisherfolk seeking the fishing boom in the Bay of Catazar, and they had discovered the Freeborn colony on the Isle of Zemress, whose people faced the salt mines of Dubhtraig.

Highguard.t: Highguard embraced Yael's claims to be the reborn First Empress as the schism neared its climax. Highguard was also among the nations tagged for the Catazar fishing opportunity.

Imperial Orcs.t: Mentioned in passing: the Imperial Orcs made clear they had no part in the conflict over Yael and Human destiny.

Jotun.t: Mentioned in passing: Jotun castles and armies were noted as part of the complicated and worsening situation in the Mournwold.

Navarr.t: Navarr sent priests to denounce Yael and was caught up in the Iron Helms controversy. A band of Navarr vates gave the timely warning that averted major loss of life in the sinkhole.

The Brass Coast.t: The Freeborn denounced Yael and were tagged for the Catazar fishing opportunity. They also faced the plight of their lost cousins on Zemress, now discovered by the Grendel.

The League.t: The League denounced Yael and was tagged for the Catazar fishing boom. League-held Temeschwar was struck by the great sinkhole.

The Marches.t: The Marches denounced Yael and were involved in the Iron Helms controversy. Marcher-held Upwold was partly swallowed by the sinkhole.

Urizen.t: Urizen denounced Yael and was tagged for the fishing opportunity. A burning plume of fire and shadows appeared in Urizen-held Redoubt.

Varushka.t: Varushka's new army, the Iron Helms, became the focus of controversial mandates following statements of principle about its role. Varushka also denounced Yael.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark denounced Yael and was drawn into the Iron Helms mandates. Wintermark-held Hahnmark was partly swallowed by the sinkhole.

381YE Summer Solstice winds of fortune.o: This was the index of Winds of Fortune for the 381YE Summer Solstice. It summarised a season of upheaval: the Yael schism reaching a climax, a great sinkhole in the north-west, Spring regio failing, Grendel threats at sea, and controversy over Varushka's Iron Helms.

Miaren/Goldglades.t: The great chasm left by the sinkhole stretched to the orchards of Goldglades.

Temeschwar/Vardstein Vale.t: The chasm ran from a point dangerously close to Eastern Guard deep into the wild hunting grounds of the Vardstein Vale.

Bay of Catazar.t: A boom in fish and sea creatures, credited to Spring magic and storms, offered Bay fisherfolk a lucrative but risky opportunity, given the Grendel threat.

Hahnmark.t: Part of Hahnmark was swallowed by the massive sinkhole that struck the north-western Empire.

Miaren.t: Part of Miaren was swallowed by the sinkhole, with the chasm stretching as far as the orchards of Goldglades.

Mournwold.t: The situation in the Mournwold grew increasingly complicated, with a storm brewing alongside Jotun castles and armies. Peculiar cauldron shenanigans there were also reported.

Redoubt.t: Mentioned in passing: the Winds of Magic noted a burning plume of fire and shadows in Redoubt.

Temeschwar.t: Part of Temeschwar was swallowed by the sinkhole, with the chasm running from near Eastern Guard deep into the Vardstein Vale.

Upwold.t: Part of Upwold was swallowed by the great sinkhole, though a Navarr warning prevented major loss of life.

381YE Summer Solstice winds of war.d: The Freeborn Storm retook the Grendel-held spires of Naris, but most of Evenstar's healers had already been enslaved. The Golden Sun won every clash with a growing unliving horde in Weirwater but could not destroy it, as fallen Dawnish rose to join it. In Spiral, the Towerjacks, Green Shield and Eastern Sky held Cinion while the Fire of the South pushed into Ossuary. The Black Thorns raided Hordalant, were driven back into Liathaven and are now surrounded. Marcher-led armies liberated two Mournwold regions and neared a third, but were shunned by local people. The Druj razed the Towers of Dawn, took Dawnguard, and seized Lustri and Occursion, burning Endsmeet.

Dawn.t: The Golden Sun fought a draining campaign against the unliving in Weirwater, while the Eastern Sky helped hold Cinion and the Hounds of Glory and Gryphon's Pride fought in the Mournwold. Dawnguard fell to the Druj, the Towers of Dawn were destroyed and noble houses including de Carsenere, Martel, Aurelius and Vexille were overrun.

Druj.t: Despite the peace treaty agreed six months earlier, Druj armies razed the Towers of Dawn and took Drycastle and Dawnguard. In Zenith they seized Lustri and Occursion, burned Endsmeet and raised a powerful Penumbral Veil over the territory.

Grendel.t: The Grendel lost their foothold in Naris and were held at Cinion. Their eastern turtle-banner force was driven back into Ossuary by the Fire of the South, although they still hold ground in Spiral.

Highguard.t: Mentioned in passing: the Fire of the South marched through Casinea and Bastion, and veterans of the liberation of Reikos are referred to.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Winter Sun joined the Mournwold offensive as the only army present from a nation that had not declared against the Land without Tears.

Jotun.t: The Jotun drove the Black Thorns out of Hordalant and surrounded them in Liathaven with a vastly larger force. In the Mournwold their much-reduced forces gave up Freemoor and the Chalkdowns, losing around three times as many troops as the Empire.

Navarr.t: The Black Thorns' raid into Hordalant disrupted Jotun resupply but ended with the army trapped and facing heavy losses in Liathaven. The Quiet Step fought brutally with poison, traps and assassinations in the Mournwold.

The Brass Coast.t: The Freeborn Storm liberated Naris and stormed Evenstar. The Fire of the South made a forced march across the Empire to surprise the Grendel in Ossuary.

The League.t: The Towerjacks, fighting under a potent enchantment, blunted the main Grendel thrust on Cinion from Ateri, though their refusal to give any ground cost many lives.

The Marches.t: All four Marcher armies fought together in the Mournwold for the first time and liberated much of the north-east. Local Marchers met them with sullen shunning and accusations of murder and cowardice.

Thule.t: Mentioned in passing: the Thule are listed among the barbarian nations the Empire has not seriously attacked at home since Empress Brannan's reign.

Urizen.t: Naris was freed, but Evenstar's healers were carried off as slaves. Imperial armies held Cinion, while in Zenith the Druj took Lustri and Occursion, gutted Endsmeet and attacked Proceris.

Varushka.t: The Northern Eagle half-repaired Redoubt's roads, while the Golden Axe and Iron Helms fought in the Mournwold, where the Iron Helms gained a reputation for mutilating fallen Jotun. Varushkan corpses also formed much of the unliving horde in Weirwater.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark warriors defending southern Cinion heard the stirring Black Plateau in their dreams. Conjunctions west of Sermersuaq offer a chance to skirmish with the Jotun.

381YE Summer Solstice winds of war.o: In the run-up to the Summer Solstice 381YE, Imperial armies liberated Naris from the Grendel, held Cinion and pushed into Ossuary, and drove the Jotun from Freemoor and the Chalkdowns. Meanwhile a Navarr raid into Hordalant ended in encirclement in Liathaven, the unliving rose across Weirwater, and the Druj broke their treaty to conquer Dawnguard and overrun eastern Zenith.

Holberg/Ennerlund.t: Mentioned in passing: the Druj demolition of the Great Pits of Ennerlund is recalled.

Holberg/Holmauer.t: A few nobles led a band of Dawnguard refugees through the mountains into Holmauer.

Hordalant/Vallorberg.t: The Black Thorns seized farmsteads here before Jotun forces drove them back across the Volg and out of the territory.

Liathaven/West Ranging.t: A massive Jotun force was waiting here for the retreating Black Thorns, and two conjunctions are expected to open here.

Liathaven/Western Scout.t: Escape south into Western Scout via the Paths of Lan Thúven is a costly option for the Black Thorns, as the Jotun now hold Silent Stand steading.

Mournwold/Alderly.t: The Empire is about three-quarters of the way to taking Alderly despite Feni ambushers. Villagers in Charcoal drove soldiers off with banging pans.

Mournwold/Chalkdowns.t: The Chalkdowns were liberated from the Jotun.

Mournwold/Freemoor.t: Freemoor was liberated, but locals, including Blackheath's tanners, shunned the Imperial armies.

Mournwold/Green March.t: Jotun forces fell back west to Green March, where a conjunction of uncertain advantage will open.

Mournwold/Greensward.t: During the Spring Equinox the Jotun completed driving Imperial armies out of the Greensward into Tassato.

Mournwold/Ore Hills.t: Retreating Jotun fell back to their castles in the Ore Hills.

Mournwold/Southmoor.t: Retreating Jotun fell back to their castles in Southmoor.

Redoubt/Naris.t: The Freeborn Storm retook the southern spires and stormed Evenstar, though most of its healers had already been enslaved.

Redoubt/Willstone.t: Mentioned in passing: the Eastern Sky marched through the passes of Willstone to Cinion.

Semmerholm/Axmure.t: Refugees fleeing the Druj conquest of Dawnguard escaped north into the forests of Axmure.

Spiral/Ateri.t: The main Grendel thrust from Ateri towards Damakan's Forge was countered by the Towerjacks.

Spiral/Cinion.t: Three Imperial armies held Cinion against the Grendel, though some Grendel presence remains on its eastern side.

Spiral/Ossuary.t: The Fire of the South surprised the Grendel and began pushing south through Ossuary. A conjunction offers a chance to fight Grendel soldiers here.

Spiral/Screed.t: The Grendel were repeatedly pushed back into Screed, and its Black Plateau is stirring amid the bloodshed.

Tassato/Madeiras.t: Mentioned in passing: Imperial armies marched north through the forests of Madeiras.

The Barrens/Murderdale.t: Mentioned in passing: one Druj force swept into Dawnguard from Murderdale.

Upwold/The Heath.t: The Imperial host made its armed camp on the Heath near Sutton Stone Quarries before invading the Mournwold.

Upwold/Tower March.t: Mentioned in passing: armies marched through Tower March on their way to Upwold.

Weirwater/Hawksmoor.t: The unliving horde gathered here, besieged Hawthorne, and was driven off by the Golden Sun at a terrible cost.

Weirwater/Weirmoor.t: Ancient dead rose from a battlefield in northern Weirmoor, and the Golden Sun entered Weirwater through its forests.

Zenith/Lustri.t: An overwhelming Druj force from the Mallum overran Lustri, silencing spires such as Gatherwood.

Zenith/Occursion.t: The Druj conquered Occursion, burning resisting spires and taking key sites, and Endsmeet was gutted.

Zenith/Proceris.t: Endsmeet's survivors fled into Proceris with the Druj close behind. A conjunction here may help refugees threatened by a Grendel advance force.

Astolat.t: Mentioned in passing: the Golden Sun marched from Astolat into Weirwater, and the unliving's earlier foray there is recalled.

Bastion.t: Mentioned in passing: the Fire of the South passed through Bastion on its forced march east.

Bay of Catazar.t: Mentioned in passing: Grendel pirate ships carried slaves from Evenstar across the Bay of Catazar.

Bregasland.t: Mentioned in passing: breaking north into Bregasland is one costly escape route open to the trapped Black Thorns.

Casinea.t: Mentioned in passing: the Fire of the South pressed through Casinea en route to Spiral.

Hahnmark.t: Mentioned in passing: Hordalant's roads and farms are compared to those of Hahnmark.

Holberg.t: Mentioned in passing: the Towerjacks recalled their defence of Holberg, and some Dawnguard refugees fled into Holmauer.

Hordalant.t: The Black Thorns made brief gains in Vallorberg and disrupted Jotun resupply before fortifications and armies drove them out, leaving Hordalant in Jotun hands.

Kahraman.t: Mentioned in passing: the Navarr's previous slip from Kahraman into Liathaven is recalled.

Liathaven.t: The retreating Black Thorns are surrounded by a Jotun force up to five times their size and face thousands of casualties. Two conjunctions may offer ways to help them.

Miaren.t: Mentioned in passing: the Fire of the South marched through Miaren.

Mitwold.t: Mentioned in passing: Hordalant is likened to Mitwold.

Morrow.t: Mentioned in passing: the Fire of the South passed through Morrow into Zenith.

Mournwold.t: A large Imperial host liberated Freemoor and the Chalkdowns and nearly took Alderly. Mournwold civilians are deeply angry with the Empire.

Redoubt.t: The Freeborn Storm liberated the Grendel-held spires of Naris. The Northern Eagle is halfway through restoring the storm-damaged roads, while the Granite Pillar guards the north.

Reikos.t: Mentioned in passing: veterans of Reikos's liberation fear for those left in Dawnguard.

Semmerholm.t: Hawthorne sent pleas for aid into Semmerholm, and Dawnguard refugees fled north into the forests of Axmure.

Sermersuaq.t: Mentioned in passing: small conjunctions lead to locations west of Sermersuaq, culminating in a Jotun skirmish.

Skarsind.t: Mentioned in passing: the Iron Helms came to the Mournwold fresh from a militia engagement in Skarsind.

Spiral.t: The Empire held Cinion against a three-pronged Grendel assault, and the Fire of the South began driving the orcs out of Ossuary. The Black Plateau in Screed is stirring.

Tassato.t: Imperial armies regrouped in Tassato after losing the Greensward, then marched north through Madeiras.

The Barrens.t: The Druj destroyed the Towers of Dawn, took Drycastle and conquered Dawnguard, leaving the Barrens a conquered territory.

The Semmerlak.t: Drowned fisherfolk and stranger things rose from the mud of the Semmerlak to attack Culwich.

Upwold.t: The Imperial host gathered in an armed camp on the Heath before invading the Mournwold.

Weirwater.t: The dead rose across Weirwater, killing hundreds and adding a thousand Dawnish husks to the horde. The Golden Sun saved Hawthorne but could not destroy the unliving.

Zenith.t: The Druj conquered Lustri and Occursion, gutted Endsmeet and are attacking Proceris under a Penumbral Veil, and the Starlight Drift, Tower of the Fall and Origen's Rest are lost.

381YE Winter Solstice Imperial elections.d: Most senators were returned or newly elected. Redoubt's senator resigned, Volodmartz's was revoked and Semmerholm's was murdered, and all three were replaced. Zenith's incumbent held the seat until the territory fell to barbarian orcs. Generals were confirmed or replaced, including after battlefield deaths in the Bounders and the Army of the Golden Axe. The Synod filled cardinal, inquisitor and other posts, and the Cardinal of Pride abdicated. Conclave archmages and grandmasters were chosen, and Bourse seats and ministries were auctioned or won by vote. No appointments were made for the Dean of Pilgrims, the Imperial Master of Works or the Crystal Architect. The Druj destroyed four Zenith titles and Grendel destroyed the Freeborn Storm.

Dawn.t: Bohemond de Rondell kept Astolat's Senate seat, and Lady Ailliena Devereux replaced Semmerholm's murdered senator.

Druj.t: Druj action in Zenith destroyed the Custodian of the Starlight Drift, the Keeper of the Tower of the Fall, the Custodian of the Storm Vault and Origen's Rest.

Grendel.t: Grendel action in Madruga destroyed the Freeborn Storm title.

Highguard.t: Jeconiah of Ravens Watch was elected senator for Necropolis.

Imperial Orcs.t: Irontide Vio was returned as senator for Skarsind, and Atla of the Imperial Orcs remained Cardinal of the Way.

Navarr.t: Rhisiart Dancewalker was elected senator for Hercynia.

The Brass Coast.t: Adan i Del-Tero i Riqueza became senator for Madruga, while the Freeborn Storm title there was destroyed by Grendel.

The League.t: Gant Archama was returned as senator for Temeschwar.

The Marches.t: Orrick Bolholt was returned as senator for Bregasland.

Urizen.t: Andronikos replaced Redoubt's resigning senator, and Zenith was lost to barbarian orcs, with four of its titles destroyed. Urizen's senators presented no unanimous choice for Crystal Architect of the Spires, though Solas of Urizen remained High Exorcist and Alcuin Shatterspire Head Gardener of Urizen.

Varushka.t: Father Nikolovich Drakov kept Miekarova, and Alexei Volostra replaced Volodmartz's revoked senator. After the Army of the Golden Axe's general died in battle, the Varushkan senators presented no unanimous replacement.

Wintermark.t: Edythe Dunne was elected senator for Kallavesa. Wintermark citizens also took the posts of Fallsheart Guardian (Breeta Dunning), Master Apothecary (Kai Dunning) and Virtue Inquisitor of the Way (Yarrick Ursan).

381YE Winter Solstice Imperial elections.o: The results of the Imperial elections and appointments held at the 381YE Winter Solstice were recorded, covering the Senate, Military Council, Synod, Conclave and Bourse, along with titles destroyed when the Druj took Zenith and Grendel struck in Madruga.

Astolat.t: Bohemond de Rondell was returned as Astolat's senator.

Bregasland.t: Orrick Bolholt was returned as Bregasland's senator.

Hercynia.t: Rhisiart Dancewalker was elected senator for Hercynia.

Kallavesa.t: Edythe Dunne was elected senator for Kallavesa.

Madruga.t: Adan i Del-Tero i Riqueza was elected Madruga's senator, and Grendel destroyed the Freeborn Storm title there.

Miekarova.t: Father Nikolovich Drakov was returned as senator for Miekarova.

Necropolis.t: Jeconiah of Ravens Watch was elected senator for Necropolis.

Redoubt.t: Redoubt's senator resigned and was replaced by Andronikos.

Semmerholm.t: Semmerholm's senator was murdered and replaced by Lady Ailliena Devereux.

Skarsind.t: Irontide Vio was returned as senator for Skarsind.

Temeschwar.t: Gant Archama was returned as Temeschwar's senator.

Volodmartz.t: Volodmartz's senator was revoked and replaced by Alexei Volostra.

Zenith.t: The incumbent senator served until Zenith was lost to barbarian orcs, and the Druj destroyed four titles there, including the Custodian of the Storm Vault and Origen's Rest.

381YE Winter Solstice Senate sessions.d: Passed motions included new ambassadors to Axos and Faraden, a general for the Strong Reeds, the Senate power of escalation, construction of mana exchanges in Temeschwar and Sarvos, the walls of Holberg, a gate in Semmerholm, Lorenzo's Legacy works, and funds for the Wintermark army. The Mournwold thralls were declared foreigners and the Verthandi spy network decommissioned. Amending the Advisor on the Vallorn's powers, the power of relinquishment and an arsenal in Sarvos failed. The Throne vetoed the Arcane Architect's summer mana sinecure in Reikos. Imperatrix Lisabetta exercised the Hand of the Chancellor for 473 thrones and announced an address to the Empire; 11 commissions were announced.

Highguard.t: The Arcane Architect's planned summer mana sinecure in Highguard-held Reikos was vetoed by the Throne, so it will not go ahead there.

Wintermark.t: The Senate passed a motion to disburse funds for the Wintermark army.

381YE Winter Solstice Senate sessions.o: The Senate met over the 381YE Winter Solstice with the Imperial treasury at 1433 thrones and 4 crowns, passing a long list of construction, appointment and funding motions while rejecting several others, including a constitutional power of relinquishment.

Reikos.t: A summer mana sinecure the Arcane Architect announced for Reikos was vetoed by the Throne, leaving the territory without it.

381YE Winter Solstice winds of fortune.d: The page indexed many events. A Synod judgement produced mandates to encourage the Way, and Jarm saw slave reforms and an offer of beloye zerno. Dawn kept Semmerholm despite losing Axmure and its Gate. The Winter Sun experimented with the relic Defiance in Casinea. Escaped slaves raided Kalino from Feroz. Orc former-thralls and resentful Mournwolders sought redress. The Liathaven vallorn threatened West Ranging. The Grendel turned on the trading fleet, and a great storm reshaped northern Varushka. The Blood Red Roads were completed, Zemress exiles settled in Segura, the Jotun dismantled the Hordalant spy network, and five Synod mandates were upheld.

Dawn.t: Dawn did not lose Semmerholm to the Druj despite the fall of Axmure and its Gate, and fervour swept the nation as its boast of never losing a territory to barbarians held.

Druj.t: Having taken Axmure and destroyed the Gate the season before, the Druj failed to complete the conquest of Semmerholm.

Grendel.t: After the destruction of the Freeborn Storm, the Grendel effectively dominate the Bay of Catazar, and their pirates, urged on by Siakha, now target the Imperial trading fleet. Interest is growing in locating them along the Bay.

Highguard.t: The Heirs of Lepidus showed that the Silent Sentinel is likely the dwelling of the paragon the Sentinel, offering a chance to celebrate it. A Highguard mandate rejecting the Land without Tears will heal the Yaelian Schism.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Winter Sun used the relic Defiance in an experimental ritual in Casinea. Imperial Orcs are also concerned with the orc former-thralls left in the Mournwold, and they chose the heroic path in the debate over cruelty and fear.

Jotun.t: The Jotun have fled the Mournwold, leaving many orc former-thralls behind, and over the season they dismantled the Hordalant spy network.

Navarr.t: The Liathaven vallorn threatens to consume West Ranging, a Navarr mandate sent herbs to aid the orcs of Therunin, and Navarr magicians were among those affected by the flood of Spring magic.

The Brass Coast.t: Some two hundred escaped slaves have camped in southern Feroz and are raiding Kalino. The Zemress exiles are settling in Segura, and a mandate will improve the quality of the Red Wind Corsairs.

The League.t: The League completed the Blood Red Roads, the Grand Park of Holberg and red stone mana monoliths in all four of its territories, inspiring its people. A potent new street drug has also appeared.

The Marches.t: With the Jotun gone, Mournwolders sent three representatives to Anvil seeking recompense, and the fate of the remaining orc former-thralls is unresolved. Strange mists bring fecund short-lived plants to Bregasland, and Feni raid Upwold.

Thule.t: Mentioned in passing: the Thule in Otkodov are named as one of three orc nations with recent developments in their relations with the Empire.

Urizen.t: Mentioned in passing: Urizen is among the nations tagged as interested in the return and flood of Spring regio power.

Varushka.t: A once-in-a-century storm reshaped the northern mountains of Varushka, opening four opportunities to build from the destruction. The Varushkans also have a chance to answer the Imperial Orcs in the debate over cruelty and fear.

Wintermark.t: A Wintermark mandate will change its armies' tactics for four seasons to seek heroic victory over the Jotun rather than slaughter, while drowned dead appeared in Sermersuaq and Feni raided Hahnmark.

381YE Winter Solstice winds of fortune.o: The Winter Solstice 381YE Winds of Fortune reported on a season of upheaval across the Empire. Dawn held Semmerholm against the Druj, the League completed the Blood Red Roads and other grand works, the Jotun left the Mournwold, Spring regio returned in flood, and the Liathaven vallorn began to spread.

Liathaven/West Ranging.t: The shifting Liathaven vallorn will consume all of West Ranging unless something is done before its aberrant vitality subsides.

Miaren/Holtford.t: Mentioned in passing: the Blood Red Roads were extended to Holt in Miaren.

Semmerholm/Axmure.t: Axmure, conquered by the Druj the previous season with the Gate destroyed, was the base for their push deeper into Semmerholm, which ultimately failed.

Bay of Catazar.t: The Grendel now effectively dominate the Bay, contested only by a few Imperial captains, and their pirates are turning on the trading fleet.

Bregasland.t: Eerie mists are bringing farmers the seeds of peculiar short-lived plants rich with fecund power.

Casinea.t: The Winter Sun spent the season here resupplying and performing an experimental ritual with the relic Defiance to seek a stronger connection with their ancestors.

Feroz.t: Around two hundred escaped slaves fleeing Duke Guiscard have built makeshift camps in southern Feroz and are raiding across the border into Kalino.

Hahnmark.t: Feni raiders have struck Hahnmark, linked to conjunctions of the Sentinel Gate.

Holberg.t: The long-delayed Grand Park of Holberg was completed, red stone monoliths now enhance its mana, and the Blood Red Roads connect it to the other League cities.

Hordalant.t: The Jotun dismantled the Hordalant spy network, and no military unit can be assigned to it any longer.

Kalino.t: Revolutionaries camped in Feroz are making periodic raids across the border into Kalino, creating a complex diplomatic situation with the Iron Confederacy.

Karov.t: Mentioned in passing: Karov is not named directly, though the storm that reshaped the northern mountains of Varushka is relevant to Varushkan lands.

Liathaven.t: The vallorn of Liathaven is moving and shifting, and if nothing is done it will consume all of West Ranging.

Madruga.t: Mentioned in passing: Madruga is not named directly, appearing only through Brass Coast matters such as the mandate improving the Red Wind Corsairs.

Miaren.t: Mentioned in passing: the Blood Red Roads have been extended to Holt in Miaren.

Mournwold.t: The Jotun have fled, but many orc former-thralls remain. Mournwolders still resentful of the magic used against the Jotun sent representatives to Anvil to seek recompense.

Otkodov.t: The Thule of Otkodov are among the orc nations whose relations with the Empire saw recent developments.

Sarvos.t: A collision struck Sarvos, linked to a conjunction of the Sentinel Gate. Red stone monoliths to enhance mana flows were also completed there.

Segura.t: Exiles from the Isle of Zemress have been establishing a home in Segura and are expected to be settled by the Spring Equinox.

Semmerholm.t: After losing Axmure and the Gate, Semmerholm did not fall to the Druj, and its survival sparked fervour across Dawn.

Sermersuaq.t: Drowned dead have appeared in Sermersuaq, linked to a conjunction of the Sentinel Gate.

Tassato.t: Mana-enhancing red stone monoliths were completed here, bearing the controversial personal stamp of the Asavean architect Almodin Oktístis.

Temeschwar.t: Temeschwar's monoliths, honouring Lorenzo Macelliao von Temeschwar, were completed with Almodin Oktístis's controversial touches, and the Blood Red Roads link it to the other League cities.

Therunin.t: The Great Forest Orcs in Therunin received aid through a Navarr mandate urging apothecaries and physicks to share spare herbs with them.

Upwold.t: Feni raiders struck Upwold among other territories, linked to conjunctions of the Sentinel Gate.

381YE Winter Solstice winds of war.d: A Druj marshwalker broke the Golden Cascade dam, ruining Zenith's farms. The Druj burned the Arch of the Sky and now hold nine-tenths of Proceris. Four Dawnish armies, nine thousand Summer knights and the Fist of the Mountains pushed the Druj into southern Axmure at a cost of some eight thousand casualties on both sides. The Jotun abandoned Mournwold entirely. In Spiral, Imperial armies made headway in Screed, but the Grendel kept the region and the Black Plateau drove soldiers to madness and suicide. The Grendel armada burned the Atalaya shipyard and the Freeborn Storm, and took Free Landing and eastern Lightsea. The civil service identified Sentinel Gate conjunctions for the coming summit.

Dawn.t: All four Dawnish armies fought together for the first time in over a century and, with three cohorts of Summer knights, drove the Druj back into southern Axmure. Some four and a half thousand Imperial citizens were lost in the campaign.

Druj.t: The Druj flooded Proceris and now hold nine-tenths of it, leaving Zenith on the brink. In Semmerholm they were pushed back to southern Axmure, though the Black Wind's atrocities and a guerrilla force in Ulvenholm remain.

Grendel.t: The Grendel armada destroyed the Freeborn Storm, took Free Landing and eastern Lightsea, and claimed the Bay of Catazar. In Screed the Grendel defended cautiously and kept control, and they fortified the port at Apulus.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Druj slaughtered as many Imperial Orcs at Estcastle as they could find, and the survivors sheltered in the Frozen Citadel. A large force of Imperial Orc reavers supported the Wolves of War in Screed.

Jotun.t: The Jotun retreated entirely from Mournwold, tearing down Hillstop as they went. Elite kirkja bands, the Ice Fishers of Ldansk in Sermersuaq and a flame-bird host in Segura, appear to be preparing the way for invasion.

Navarr.t: The Quiet Step, accompanied by vates and strange supernatural creatures, helped complete the liberation of Mournwold. The Black Thorns were severely mauled trying to defend Atalaya and Quzar, and the beacon at Rest was lit to warn of the Jotun in Sermersuaq.

The Brass Coast.t: The Freeborn lost the Freeborn Storm, the Atalaya shipyard and the birthplace of their nation, as well as Quzar and Midport, and their admiral lost the title. Meanwhile the Fire of the South and the Red Wind Corsairs fought and raided in Screed, and Jotun warriors entered Yellow Chase.

The League.t: Mentioned in passing: the Towerjacks withdrew toward Sarvos to resupply, and some League captains in Screed fell back in disarray, gripped by the Black Plateau's delusions.

The Marches.t: Marcher armies freed the last of the Mournwold, including old Sarcombe, and the Drakes were able to resupply from Mitwold. The political mood in the Mourn remains tense, with the Singing Caves still unallocated by the Senate.

Thule.t: Mentioned in passing: the Senate's peace with the Thule three years earlier is cited as the reason Sermersuaq had been relatively quiet.

Urizen.t: Urizen lost the Golden Cascade, the Arch of the Sky and several sinecures in Zenith, and Zenith's farms now suffer reduced production. In Spiral the Citadel Guard, aided by Axou skirmishers, pressed into Screed but could not take it.

Wintermark.t: The Fist of the Mountains protected western Semmerholm but was hammered by Druj flank attacks. The Green Shield's husks grew vicious in Screed, and the Ice Fishers of Ldansk began preparing for an invasion of Sermersuaq.

381YE Winter Solstice winds of war.o: At the 381YE Winter Solstice, the Druj flooded Proceris and stood poised to take Zenith, while Dawn and its allies drove them back in Semmerholm. The Marches completed the liberation of Mournwold, the Empire pushed into Screed under the Black Plateau's maddening influence, elite Jotun bands entered Sermersuaq and Segura, and the Grendel armada destroyed the Freeborn Storm and seized Atalaya.

Brocéliande/Boar's Dell.t: The Navarr of Boar's Dell reported Druj scouts from Ulvenholm crossing the border, apparently searching for something, before they withdrew.

Liathaven/Liath's Ring.t: A smaller conjunction will open to Mournstead, an old steading near the vallorn miasma, for a large skirmish against Navarr enemies that also concerns the Freeborn.

Liathaven/Liaven's Glen.t: Mentioned in passing: the Quiet Step's orders spoke of carving a new road to Liaven's Glen.

Madruga/Calvos Sound.t: Mentioned in passing: the Grendel armada bypassed Calvos Sound on its way to Free Landing.

Madruga/Free Landing.t: The whole region fell to the Grendel, including the Shining Pillar, Atalaya and Midport. The shipyard and the Freeborn Storm were burnt to the waterline.

Madruga/Lightsea.t: The Grendel conquered Lightsea's eastern coast and sacked the rich port of Quzar despite the Black Thorns' resistance, and are close to claiming the whole region.

Mournwold/Green March.t: Green March was freed as the last Jotun warbands withdrew, leaving behind only a few stubborn human and orc thralls.

Mournwold/Greensward.t: Mentioned in passing: the Quiet Step marched up through the Greensward to join the liberation.

Mournwold/Southmoor.t: Southmoor, the last region lost to the Jotun, was the last to be freed. Old Sarcombe was liberated as a ruin after the Jotun tore down Hillstop.

Redoubt/Willstone.t: The Crow Road pass linking Willstone and Cinion was kept open, allowing Imperial armies to resupply and reinforce Spiral.

Segura/Yellow Chase.t: Jotun warriors under a flame-bird banner reoccupied the old Lasambrian camp and are raising a palisade. A conjunction to Madera Viejo offers a chance to strike at them.

Semmerholm/Axmure.t: The Gryphon's Pride smashed the Druj defences, and the Druj now hold southern Axmure only tenuously. The region's woods are strewn with the dead.

Semmerholm/Estmure.t: The Druj assaulted Estcastle and damaged Lacre's cathedral, but a Frozen Citadel sheltered the defenders, and the Dawnish charge drove the orcs back after bloody fighting.

Semmerholm/Ulvenholm.t: A lizard-banner Druj force with Vikari made for the Pits of Brychel and a guerrilla force remains. A conjunction to the Chase of Arnet offers a chance to engage it.

Sermersuaq/Stark.t: The Ice Fishers of Ldansk are preparing an invasion route through Stark and camp a day from Rest. A conjunction to Kugaaruk Point offers a chance to engage them.

Spiral/Ankra.t: Imperial gains in Ankra have not been compromised so far, although the Grendel used it to flank the advance into Screed.

Spiral/Apulus.t: The Grendel rebuilt and heavily fortified the port with a castle raised at almost supernatural speed, and ships berthed there are protected from the coastal magic.

Spiral/Ateri.t: The Grendel concentrated forces in Ateri and used it to flank the Imperial advance after Imperial troops were withdrawn from there.

Spiral/Cinion.t: Cinion, at the far end of the Crow Road, served as the gathering point where the Freeborn armies rejoined the main Imperial force.

Spiral/Ossuary.t: The Fire of the South and the Red Wind Corsairs broke out of northern Ossuary. Imperial forces kept minor gains there while Grendel forces remain concentrated in the region.

Spiral/Screed.t: The Empire fought its first major campaign in Screed, taking Grendel camps but not the region, while the waking Black Plateau drove both sides to madness and suicide. A conjunction to Fulgentius' Solitary is planned.

Zenith/Clypion.t: The Granite Pillar's vigilance kept the Druj in Clypion to small bands of scouts and assassins, and the Highborn still hold it.

Zenith/Iteri.t: Iteri, shielded by Clypion, remained relatively safe, but its spires are overcrowded with refugees whom the Valiant Pegasus are housing in makeshift camps.

Zenith/Lustri.t: The Druj consolidated their hold on Lustri, and many of its fleeing refugees were caught by the flood or by the orcs.

Zenith/Occursion.t: The Druj tightened their grip on Occursion as its refugees fled west into the floodwaters.

Zenith/Proceris.t: The Golden Cascade was destroyed by flood, the Arch of the Sky was burned, and the Druj now hold nine-tenths of the region. A conjunction to the Plantation of Tall Ferns could stop monstrous Druj reinforcements.

Bay of Catazar.t: The Shining Pillar now burns purple, signalling that the Bay belongs to the Grendel. A hypnotic fog off the Spiral coast is crippling the production of any fleet based in Spiral.

Brocéliande.t: Druj scouts from Ulvenholm probed south into the northern forest but retreated as soon as they saw the steadings' defensive thorns.

Holberg.t: Mentioned in passing: the Black Wind led a Druj push toward the Semmerlak and Holberg.

Kahraman.t: Mentioned in passing: the Quiet Step passed through Kahraman to collect supplies provided by the Spider King, and the Cinnamon Road runs north to it.

Kalino.t: Mentioned in passing: Iron Confederacy soldiers from Kalino fought alongside Dawn, and the cleared pass into Reinos opens a road between Kalino and Segura.

Kallavesa.t: Mentioned in passing: the Jotun appear to have learned from their failed attempts to invade Kallavesa.

Liathaven.t: The last Jotun from Southmoor fell back into Liathaven. A Sentinel Gate conjunction to Mournstead offers the Navarr a chance to engage two of their hated enemies there.

Madruga.t: The Grendel took all of Free Landing and the eastern coast of Lightsea, burning the Atalaya shipyard and sacking Quzar, which cut Madruga's taxation. Siroc remains untouched for now.

Mitwold.t: Mentioned in passing: the Drakes drew on the wealth of Mitwold to rearm and re-equip.

Morrow.t: Mentioned in passing: many refugees from Zenith moved north into Morrow seeking shelter.

Mournwold.t: Mournwold is now entirely under Marcher and Imperial control, though its people are uneasy. The civil service is examining whether Hillstop, the Tribute and Orchard's Watch can be rebuilt.

Redoubt.t: Because the Crow Road pass was held open, Imperial armies could move through Redoubt to and from Spiral, and two Freeborn armies marched south through it.

Reinos.t: The landslip blocking the pass over Old Man's Ride from Reinos into Segura was cleared and the road repaired. A planned conjunction aims to force the invaders back into Reinos.

Sarvos.t: Mentioned in passing: the Towerjacks withdrew toward Sarvos to resupply, and a messenger from Glass Point warned of the Grendel armada.

Segura.t: Between one and two thousand Jotun warriors with Lasambrian ties are fortifying an old bandit camp in Yellow Chase. A conjunction offers a chance to drive them out.

Semmerholm.t: The Druj were halted and pushed back into southern Axmure after two months of bloody fighting, but they still hold the region and threaten Ulvenholm.

Sermersuaq.t: An elite Jotun force of around fifteen hundred warriors is building bridges, fortifications and supply caches in Stark to prepare for invasion, and the beacon at Rest has been lit.

Skallahn.t: Mentioned in passing: Winterfolk who accept the Jotun Choice are reportedly sent west to Tromsa, Skallahn and beyond.

Spiral.t: Imperial armies pushed deep into Screed while holding their gains in Ankra, but the Grendel kept control and the Black Plateau grew stronger. The Grendel also fortified Apulus.

Tassato.t: Mentioned in passing: the Jotun hall at Sarcombe once kept watch east toward Tassato.

The Barrens.t: Mentioned in passing: the Black Wind were once free orcs of the Barrens before returning to the Druj.

The Semmerlak.t: Mentioned in passing: the Black Wind led the Druj force pushing toward the Semmerlak.

Tromsa.t: Mentioned in passing: captives who accept the Choice are reportedly sent west to Tromsa.

Zenith.t: A catastrophic flood ruined the Golden Cascade and the Druj destroyed several sinecures. The Druj now hold almost all of Proceris, and one more victory would give them Zenith.

382YE Autumn Equinox winds of fortune.d: Dawn and the Golden Axe seized Bittershore and Galath Fields in Ossium, along with the town of Lomaa and the Crawling Depths mithril mine. The Highborn faced the ruinous cost of committing their nation against the vallorn. Other winds covered orc affairs, League city politics, troubles with feni in Hahnmark and the Mournwold, Mazo i Zabala i Erigo's call to raid Grendel, army opportunities for four nations, a road survey, Phaleron's return and an orphanage for the Mournwold. Eight Synod mandates were upheld, though two linked to the Temple of the Winds stalled after the Druj destroyed it in Peregro. The Conclave added Sutannir's Promise to Imperial lore.

Dawn.t: Dawn's armies, alongside the Golden Axe, captured Bittershore and Galath Fields in Ossium, while its troubadours named champions of virtue and the nation faced fundamental choices about its armies.

Druj.t: The Druj lost Bittershore and Galath Fields in Ossium to Imperial attack, but their destruction of the Temple of the Winds in Peregro stalled two Synod mandates.

Grendel.t: The Grendel appeared on the doorstep of Sarvos and were the subject of Mazo i Zabala i Erigo's call for the Freeborn to raid them and free their slaves, with the orcs of the Broken Shore described as overconfident and over-extended.

Highguard.t: The Highborn faced the ruinous cost of committing their entire nation against the vallorn, with Lilith of the Chantry's mandate setting citizens on radical pilgrimages along the trods and another urging virtuous trade in white granite.

Imperial Orcs.t: Irontide Lok's mandate means the Imperial Orcs will begin to build a new martial nation in Skarsind, and the nation was also tagged in the season's orc affairs report.

Jotun.t: Mentioned in passing: the former Jotun thralls living in the Mournwold are among the orc groups covered by the orc affairs report.

Navarr.t: Navarr was concerned with developments among the orcs of the Great Forest and with the state of the trods and the ebb and flow of the war against the vallorn.

The Brass Coast.t: The Freeborn raised the banner of the Burning Falcon, and Mazo i Zabala i Erigo called on them to raid Grendel and liberate its slaves, while a chill wind quieted the disruption in Segura.

The League.t: The League's cities faced the war against bite, renewed arguments over Empress Giselle's resting place, building work in Holberg and the arrival of the Grendel at Sarvos.

The Marches.t: The Marches faced feni troubles in the Mournwold, a call to build an orphanage for Mournwold orphans, army choices, developments among the former thralls, and a mandate to lay the ghosts of the Greensward to rest.

Thule.t: Developments with the Thule were covered in the orc affairs report, flagged for the Senate's attention.

Urizen.t: Urizen saw the Academy leave Canterspire, the return of the eternal Phaleron, and its mandate to restore the Temple of the Winds stalled by the temple's destruction in Peregro.

Varushka.t: The Golden Axe fought alongside Dawn to capture two regions of Ossium, and Varushka was tagged in the orc affairs report and in a road survey that cited the Roads of Karsk as a success.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark faced a feni band raising trouble in Hahnmark, restated its commitment to heroism in its armies, and appeared in the orc affairs report, the road survey and talk of joining the Northern trade network.

382YE Autumn Equinox winds of fortune.o: The Autumn Equinox 382YE Winds of Fortune gathered the season's major events and opportunities across the Empire, from Dawn and Varushka's capture of two regions of Druj-held Ossium to Highguard's ruinous commitment against the vallorn and the Academy's move to Astolat.

Morrow/Peregro.t: The Temple of the Winds was destroyed by the Druj; if Peregro is liberated before the Summer Solstice 383YE, construction can begin again from scratch without a new commission or Senate motion.

Mournwold/Alderly.t: The mysterious inhabitants of Alderly became involved in the escalating trouble with the feni.

Mournwold/Greensward.t: Albert Fugglestone-Copperhill's mandate means the ghosts haunting the ruins of Overton will be laid to rest.

Ossium/Bittershore.t: Bittershore was captured from the Druj by the armies of Dawn and the Golden Axe.

Ossium/Galath Fields.t: Galath Fields was captured from the Druj by the armies of Dawn and the Golden Axe.

Astolat.t: The Academy, the foremost school for future Imperial heroes, decided to leave Canterspire for a new home in Astolat.

Bay of Catazar.t: Mentioned in passing: Mazo i Zabala i Erigo's call to raid Grendel spread like wildfire along the Imperial coast of the Bay of Catazar.

Hahnmark.t: One of two troublesome feni bands headed north into Hahnmark, and the situation appeared to be coming to a head.

Holberg.t: Significant building work in Holberg featured among the season's League urban events.

Kallavesa.t: Mentioned in passing: Kallavesa is not named on this page and is touched only through Wintermark's wider concerns.

Karsk.t: Mentioned in passing: the Roads of Karsk were cited as a success in the civil service's road-building survey.

Morrow.t: The Druj destruction of the Temple of the Winds in Peregro left two Synod mandates without immediate effect until the region is retaken and the temple completed.

Mournwold.t: The Mournwold saw a feni band causing trouble, the involvement of Alderly's mysterious inhabitants, a call for an orphanage for its orphans, developments among the former Jotun thralls, and a mandate to lay the Greensward's ghosts to rest.

Ossium.t: Dawn and the Golden Axe captured Bittershore and Galath Fields, along with the town of Lomaa and the Crawling Depths mithril mine, and made first contact with the territory's inhabitants.

Sarvos.t: The Grendel turned up on the doorstep of Sarvos this season.

Segura.t: A chill wind, raised by the Winds of Magic, swept across Segura, quieting the disruption there and stealing its magic.

382YE Autumn Equinox winds of war.d: In Morrow, some 45,000 Druj overwhelmed three Highborn armies, taking Peregro and Caeli and destroying the Halls of Knowledge, the Glorious Fountain, the Gardens of Morrow, the Temple of the Winds and the central Heliopticon tower. They were held only at Operus, and four thousand Highborn were lost. After Imperial forces withdrew, the Jotun took all of Sermersuaq except the Thule-held Silver Peaks, while the recently dead rose there. In Kahraman, Marcher and Navarr armies expelled the Jotun into Reinos. A Grendel armada demanded 400 thrones to spare the southern coast. Four Dawnish armies crossed the Golden Causeway and, with Varushka's Golden Axe, conquered Bittershore and the Galath Fields, capturing Lomaa and its Crawling Depths mithril mine.

Dawn.t: Dawn's four armies crossed the Golden Causeway from Semmerholm into the Mallum. They routed a Druj levy of some twenty thousand on the Galath Fields for minimal losses and helped seize Lomaa and its mithril mine.

Druj.t: The Druj conquered Peregro and Caeli in Morrow and destroyed many Urizen treasures. In Ossium, however, the Bone Serpent clan was broken, losing Bittershore, the Galath Fields, Lomaa and the Crawling Depths to the Empire.

Grendel.t: The Salt Lords anchored a vast armada off Sarvos and delivered an ultimatum: pay four hundred thrones or see a southern territory sacked after the Autumn Equinox.

Highguard.t: The Highborn armies (the Granite Pillar, Seventh Wave and Valiant Pegasus) were outnumbered and driven back in Morrow, losing four thousand soldiers before holding at Operus. Necropolis and Reikos were named among the coastal lands the Grendel threatened.

Imperial Orcs.t: Imperial Orc captains marched across the Golden Causeway with the Dawnish host. Jotun raiders began pressing into Pakaanan's Pass in Skarsind shortly before the equinox.

Jotun.t: The Jotun took all of Sermersuaq save the Silver Peaks, offering the Winterfolk the Choice and fighting the risen dead, but they were driven entirely out of Kahraman back into Reinos.

Navarr.t: The Quiet Step, nearly doubled by Imperial captains, helped expel the Jotun from Kahraman. The Eternal Cathan Canae's frozen citadel was key to holding Operus in Morrow.

The Brass Coast.t: Kahraman was wholly recovered, though the town of Damata and its walls were badly damaged. The Grendel armada swept past the Coast, crushing Freeborn ships that came too close.

The League.t: Sarvos lay under the shadow of the Grendel armada, and its garrison at Our Lady of Pride stood watch as many citizens fled. League captains also joined the invasion of the Mallum.

The Marches.t: The Drakes and Strong Reeds, reinforced by many Imperial captains, led the campaign that drove the Jotun out of Kahraman. Marcher captains also marched with Dawn into Ossium.

Thule.t: Honouring the recent peace, Thule magicians laid healing Spring magic over Sermersuaq while keeping the Silver Peaks. They allowed the escaping mithril miners free passage without toll.

Urizen.t: Urizen suffered grievously: the Halls of Knowledge, the Glorious Fountain, the Temple of the Winds and the central Heliopticon tower were lost. With two Morrow regions fallen, the nation can no longer properly support its armies.

Varushka.t: The Golden Axe marched south from Karsk to join Dawn, helping capture Lomaa. Moresvah families offered to work the newly seized Crawling Depths mithril mine.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark lost Sermersuaq entirely to the Jotun, and its fallen heroes rose as ravening dead. Jotun raiders then began pressing into Northspires, Bruckland and Skymark.

382YE Autumn Equinox winds of war.o: In the season after the 382YE Summer Solstice the Druj overran much of eastern Morrow and burned the Halls of Knowledge, the Jotun completed their conquest of Sermersuaq amid a rising of the dead, and Imperial armies drove the Jotun out of Kahraman. A Grendel armada off Sarvos demanded tribute, and Dawn and Varushka invaded the Druj territory of Ossium, seizing a mithril mine.

Feroz/Oranseri.t: Mentioned in passing: rumour held that the Grendel might sail to Oran to sack the Temple of Balo and the Black Bull.

Hahnmark/Bruckland.t: Jotun raiders began pressing into Bruckland three weeks before the equinox.

Hahnmark/Northspires.t: Jotun raiders began pressing into Northspires three weeks before the equinox.

Kahraman/Gambit.t: The Jotun captured the town of Rojota, causing many to flee, before being driven out and hounded across Gambit's plains.

Kahraman/Serra Briante.t: A Dawnish-raised glacial citadel defended Briante and its mithril mine against a determined Jotun siege before the decisive Imperial push.

Kahraman/Serra Damata.t: Serra Damata was freed entirely, though Damata town and its walls were badly damaged. A conjunction opens at the Monachil Gorge against the Jotun rearguard.

Kallavesa/Skymark.t: Jotun raiders began pressing into Skymark three weeks before the equinox.

Karsk/Lestasny.t: Mentioned in passing: the Golden Axe marched south out of Lestasny along the Semmerlak.

Karsk/Moresvah.t: Mentioned in passing: Malinov, Sloev and Pravin families of Moresvah offered to help work the Crawling Depths mine.

Madruga/Free Landing.t: Mentioned in passing: rumour suggested the armada might rescue Innevia, captured by the Drakes during Free Landing's liberation.

Morrow/Altis.t: Mentioned in passing: professors and librarians fled west to Altis from the burning Halls of Knowledge.

Morrow/Caeli.t: Caeli fell to the Druj: the Seat of the Arbiter, its library and stele were destroyed, the Gardens of Morrow burned and the central Heliopticon tower lost.

Morrow/Operus.t: The Highborn finally held the Druj at Operus around the Cathan Canae citadel, though the orcs took a few spires on its south-eastern edge.

Morrow/Peregro.t: Peregro fell to the Druj, who destroyed the Glorious Fountain, the Temple of the Winds and the Halls of Knowledge.

Morrow/Ravion.t: Mentioned in passing: Druj scouts clashed with the Seventh Wave as far west as Ravion.

Ossium/Bittershore.t: The region where the Golden Causeway lands was conquered by Dawn and Varushka. They found Sand Fisher villages and enslaved humans and orcs under Bone Serpent rule.

Ossium/Bonewood.t: The Imperial advance pushed only a short way into this hostile northern forest, where scouts glimpsed pale, thirsty figures among the pines.

Ossium/Galath Fields.t: Dawn crushed a Druj levy here and the Empire captured Lomaa, the Bone Serpent seat, with its mithril mine. The Bleak Vein regio conjunction lies nearby.

Otkodov/Sküld.t: Mentioned in passing: scouts guessed the land beyond the Bonewood is Sküld's vallorn-haunted southern forest.

Sarvos/Foracci.t: Mentioned in passing: many Sarvosans fled to Foracci, whose inns did their best business in a decade.

Sarvos/Riposi.t: Mentioned in passing: many Sarvosans fled to Riposi, filling its inns.

Segura/Lucksprings.t: Mentioned in passing: refugees from Rojota sought refuge in Cerevado's gambling houses and paradors.

Semmerholm/Lacuve.t: The Dawnish host gathered at Lacuve and Lacre, where the white granite gate roused the Golden Causeway to launch the invasion.

Sermersuaq/East Floes.t: The Jotun swept through East Floes, completing their conquest.

Sermersuaq/Sealtoq.t: Sealtoq fell under Jotun control as part of the conquest of all Sermersuaq outside the Silver Peaks.

Sermersuaq/Silver Peaks.t: The Thule kept the Silver Peaks and sheltered the escaping mithril miners as guests.

Sermersuaq/Suaq Fount.t: The Jotun overran Suaq Fount and took the Pride of Ikka's Tears mine, though its miners escaped east with the season's mithril.

Sermersuaq/Suaq Wastes.t: Tens of thousands of Jotun swept through the Suaq Wastes, completing their conquest.

Skarsind/Crow’s Ridge.t: Mentioned in passing: the Thule let the miners' caravan pass through to Crow's Ridge without toll.

Skarsind/Pakaanan's Pass.t: Jotun raiders began pressing into Pakaanan's Pass three weeks before the equinox.

Skarsind/Solvihill.t: Mentioned in passing: the miners' caravan was bound via Crow's Ridge for Torfast.

Spiral/Apulus.t: Mentioned in passing: the Heliopticon's magicians were perhaps inspired by Hadrian of Apulian's example.

Zenith/Clypion.t: Druj forces pushed north from Clypion into Caeli. Clypion was the former site of the Halls of Knowledge before they moved to Morrow.

Zenith/Lustri.t: A major conjunction opens near the ruined Spire of Twisting Shadows, where the Druj supply lines run back to the Mallum.

Zenith/Proceris.t: Some twenty thousand Druj marched north from Proceris along the trod into Peregro, launching the invasion of Morrow.

Astolat.t: Mentioned in passing: some Imperial forces withdrew from Sermersuaq as far as Astolat, the Strong Reeds marched west from it, and the Academy chose to relocate there.

Bay of Catazar.t: The Grendel armada controlled the Bay, able to strike any Imperial territory along its shores unless tribute was paid.

Feroz.t: Fisherfolk and corsairs sighted the passing armada, and Feroz was named among the rich territories the Grendel threatened to sack.

Hahnmark.t: Refugees fled into Hahnmark from Sermersuaq, and Jotun raiders began pressing into Northspires and Bruckland.

Kahraman.t: After a season of back-and-forth fighting the Jotun were expelled entirely. The Damatian Cliffs were reclaimed, but the white granite quarry must be reallocated by the Senate.

Kallavesa.t: Imperial forces withdrew into Kallavesa from Sermersuaq, and Jotun raiders began pressing into Skymark.

Karsk.t: The Golden Axe marched south from Karsk along the Semmerlak to invade Ossium, and Moresvah families offered to work the captured mithril mine.

Liathaven.t: Mentioned in passing: former bandits from the heights between Kahraman and Liathaven fought for the Jotun under the firebird banner.

Madruga.t: The Drakes marched from Madruga to Kahraman, refugees from Rojota passed through, and the territory was named as a possible Grendel target.

Morrow.t: The Druj conquered Peregro and Caeli and gained a foothold in Operus, destroying great works across the east. One more lost region would hand Morrow to the Druj.

Mournwold.t: Mentioned in passing: some Imperial forces withdrawing from Sermersuaq went south into the Mournwold.

Necropolis.t: Mentioned in passing: named among the territories the Grendel threatened to sack.

Ossium.t: Dawn and Varushka conquered Bittershore and the Galath Fields and pushed into the Bonewood. They broke the Bone Serpent clan and seized Lomaa and its mithril mine.

Otkodov.t: Mentioned in passing: the Ambassador to Otkodov may know more about the Thule sheltering the escaped mithril miners.

Redoubt.t: Mentioned in passing: named among the territories the Grendel threatened to sack.

Reikos.t: Mentioned in passing: veterans of the Reikos campaign recognised the far heavier Druj miasma in Ossium.

Reinos.t: The defeated Jotun were driven out of Kahraman back into Reinos, with a kirkja rearguard at the Monachil Gorge on the border.

Sarvos.t: The Grendel armada anchored off Sarvos and its emissary delivered the tribute ultimatum at the docks. Many citizens fled while others armed themselves.

Segura.t: Mentioned in passing: refugees from Rojota sought shelter in Cerevado, welcomed by its gambling houses while their coin lasted.

Semmerholm.t: The Dawnish armies gathered at Lacre and Lacuve and marched across the Golden Causeway from Semmerholm into the Mallum.

Sermersuaq.t: The whole territory fell to orcs: the Jotun hold everything except the Thule-held Silver Peaks. The recently dead rose to attack orc and human alike.

Skarsind.t: Jotun raiders began pressing into Pakaanan's Pass, while the escaping miners' caravan was granted passage through Crow's Ridge towards Torfast.

Spiral.t: Mentioned in passing: named among the territories the Grendel might strike, and Hadrian of Apulian's example is cited.

Tassato.t: Mentioned in passing: some Sarvosan citizens fled as far as Tassato.

The Semmerlak.t: The Golden Causeway rose across the Semmerlak, carrying the Dawnish host into the Mallum in a single day, and red pillars remain on the far shore to recall it.

Therunin.t: Mentioned in passing: scholars from Therunin once travelled the trod the Druj now used to invade Morrow.

Upwold.t: Mentioned in passing: the Quiet Step came down past Fort Braydon from Upwold, joined by the garrison there.

Zenith.t: The Druj launched their invasion of Morrow from Proceris and Clypion, and a major conjunction opens in Lustri along their supply lines.

382YE Spring Equinox Imperial elections.d: New or returning senators were chosen for Segura, Reikos, Holberg, Mournwold, Karsk, Spiral and Temeschwar. Spiral's seat was allocated to Urizen in the Senate, and Temeschwar's senator resigned after the last session. The Ambassadors to Faraden and the Commonwealth both died in the Sunday battle, as did the new holder of the Scorrero Nets. Marciel i Riqueza took the Fire of the South after Gomez i Souza i Guerra's death. Theoderic Ulfarsson took the Fist of the Mountains after Axehind of Dunhearth Hall was revoked. Synod and Conclave posts were filled. The Grandmaster of the Rod and Shield died, and Bourse seats and titles were sold or voted.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: Grendel is not named, but Spiral, which it held that season, had its Senate seat allocated to Urizen.

Highguard.t: Cadeus of the Shattered Tower kept the Senate seat for Reikos, and Zephaniah of Highguard remained Grandmaster of the Sevenfold Path.

The Brass Coast.t: Avisena i Kharizmi i Guerra was returned as Senator for Segura for 5.5 thrones. Marciel i Riqueza became General of the Fire of the South after the death of Gomez i Souza i Guerra.

The League.t: Caerwyn von Holberg won Holberg's Senate seat and Temeschwar's senator resigned. Lisabetta Giacomi von Holberg became General of the Quiet Step using Defender of the Empire, and the League senators appoint the Steward of the Sarvos Mana Exchange.

The Marches.t: Robert Dunlain was returned as Senator for Mournwold.

Urizen.t: The Senate allocated Spiral's seat to Urizen, and Tanwyn Ankarien became Senator for Spiral.

Varushka.t: Maarit was returned as Senator for Karsk.

Wintermark.t: Mentioned in passing: Kai Dunning of Wintermark resigned as Master Apothecary.

382YE Spring Equinox Imperial elections.o: The 382YE Spring Equinox elections filled Imperial titles across the Senate, Military Council, Synod, Conclave and Bourse. Several holders resigned, were revoked, or died in the Sunday battle.

Holberg.t: Caerwyn von Holberg of the Feasting Crow was elected Senator for Holberg.

Karsk.t: The incumbent Maarit kept the Senate seat for Karsk.

Mournwold.t: The incumbent Robert Dunlain kept the Senate seat for Mournwold.

Reikos.t: Cadeus of the Shattered Tower, the incumbent, remained Senator for Reikos.

Segura.t: Avisena i Kharizmi i Guerra kept the Senate seat for Segura at a price of 5.5 thrones.

Spiral.t: Spiral's Senate seat was allocated to Urizen, and Tanwyn Ankarien became its senator.

Temeschwar.t: Giuseppe Sanguineo is listed as Senator for Temeschwar, and the page records that the senator resigned after the last Senate session.

382YE Spring Equinox Senate sessions.d: The Civil Service put the Imperial treasury at 1514 thrones and 4 crowns, and Imperatrix Lisabetta used the Hand of the Chancellor for 504 thrones and 4 crowns. The Senate appointed ambassadors to Faraden, Otkodov and Sumaah, and allocated Brilliant Shore, the Legacy and the Singing Caves. It also passed a law prohibiting Bite, created a Roll of Benefactors, abrogated the Bursar of the Academy and approved many commissions, among them a seminary in Reikos and the Golden Causeway. Motions to improve the House of Barbs and to increase the Grandmasters' stipend failed. The Imperial Guerdon went to the Wolves of War, the Fire of the South, the Bloodcloaks and the Tusks.

Highguard.t: The Senate passed a motion to raise a Highborn army and approved the construction of a seminary in Reikos, which Highguard held.

382YE Spring Equinox Senate sessions.o: The Senate met at the Spring Equinox 382YE and passed a long slate of motions, including several ambassador appointments, territorial allocations, the raising of a Highborn army and numerous construction commissions. Only two motions failed.

Reikos.t: The Senate approved the construction of a seminary in Reikos, and the Arcane Architect announced an intention to build a summer vis sinecure there.

382YE Spring Equinox winds of fortune.d: Zenith fell to the Druj, prompting rumours of a long-dead Throne's return. At the Ambassador's invitation, five thousand Suranni troops from Kalino crushed rebel slave camps in Feroz. The Zemress exiles settled in Segura. A curse settled over Therunin, while the Navarr checked the vallorn in Liathaven. Orc peace talks drew delegations, the bay was mapped, and Murit and Soghter transformed into a new eternal. Seven Synod mandates were upheld, including Severin von Holberg's sermon against religious conflict and the consecration of the Silent Sentinel. The Mournwold remained stable as fortifications began. The Blood Cloaks army was completed, and the Winter Sun became Freedom Fighters.

Dawn.t: A Dawn Assembly mandate celebrating the defence of Semmerholm gave every herb garden in Dawn bonus production for the season, and Lady Caewyn may submit a song to improve it. Dawn was also tagged in the orc peace talks and the magical round-up.

Druj.t: The Druj took Zenith amid eerie events and rumours of a dead Throne's return, while the Trade Winds discussed the imminent threat of a Druj invasion.

Grendel.t: Grendel menaced the city of Siroc in Madruga and dominated the Bay of Catazar, complicating Imperial sailing; the cats of Spiral also featured in the magical round-up.

Highguard.t: People unexpectedly emerged from a forest in northern Highguard, and the Synod consecrated the Silent Sentinel in Casinea as a site of pilgrimage.

Imperial Orcs.t: Bloodcrow Losak was sent with liao to preach the Way to the former Jotun thralls of the Mournwold, and the nation permanently changed the Winter Sun's quality to Freedom Fighters.

Jotun.t: Jotun delegations joined talk of peace treaties, and the Empire opened dialogue with the former Jotun thralls in the Mournwold, who were declared foreigners by the Senate.

Navarr.t: The Navarr stymied the vallorn's expansion in Liathaven, opening a rare chance to drive it back, while a troubling curse settled over Therunin.

The Brass Coast.t: The Zemress exiles settled in Segura and Suranni troops crushed rebel slave camps in Feroz. Grendel also threatened Siroc in Madruga, and Varushkan armies now suffer penalties when fighting alongside the Brass Coast.

The League.t: The bite trade fuelled a crisis on the streets of the four cities, Lorenzo la Volpe's growing legend divided opinion, and Severin von Holberg delivered an Empire-wide sermon on virtue.

The Marches.t: Sister Meredith was sent to preach the Way to the Mournwold orc thralls, fortifications began in Greensward and Freemoor, and Sarcombe was granted a charter should it be rebuilt.

Thule.t: Thule was one of three orc nations involved in the season's talk of peace treaties with the Empire.

Urizen.t: A new runeforge in Redoubt featured in the magical round-up, and Urizen was tagged in the Trade Winds' international developments.

Varushka.t: Following Bogdan Bogdanovich's mandate, all Varushkan armies suffer penalties for fighting alongside Wintermark and the Brass Coast, and their generals have choices to make about army qualities. Commissions following the epic storm in Varushka remain available.

Wintermark.t: The Blood Cloaks army was completed, giving Wintermark three armies. A rare Sentinel Gate conjunction opened to Kallavesa, and Kalpaheim weighed the opportunities of the Blood Red Roads.

382YE Spring Equinox winds of fortune.o: The Spring Equinox 382YE Winds of Fortune gathered the season's developments across the Empire. They included Zenith's fall to the Druj, a Suranni incursion into Feroz, Zemress exiles settling in Segura, a rare opportunity to strike the vallorn in Liathaven, and seven Synod mandates being upheld.

Liathaven/Liath's Heart.t: The vallorn's forces coiled in the depths of Liath's Heart were overextended and weakened, presenting an opportunity to strike against them.

Mournwold/Freemoor.t: Work began on fortifications in Freemoor.

Mournwold/Greensward.t: Work began on fortifications in Greensward.

Bay of Catazar.t: The Senate-commissioned mapping of the bay went ahead, amid the challenges facing sailors on Grendel-dominated waters.

Casinea.t: The Silent Sentinel was consecrated in the name of Vigilance, making fortifications easier to build and allowing a place of pilgrimage to be built.

Feroz.t: Five thousand Suranni troops crossed into Feroz and smashed the rebel slave camps along the border, executing most of the rebels or returning them to the Iron Confederacy in chains.

Hahnmark.t: Kalpaheim, Wintermark's "city", examined the opportunities offered by the Blood Red Roads' easy access to the whole Empire.

Holberg.t: As one of the League's four cities, Holberg faced the bite-trade crisis threatening their street life, as well as the constructions tied to Lorenzo la Volpe's growing legend.

Kalino.t: The Suranni Duke of Kalino sent five thousand troops into Feroz at the invitation of the Imperial Ambassador to the Iron Confederacy.

Kallavesa.t: An exceptionally rare Sentinel Gate conjunction led to the marshes of Kallavesa, signalling an opportunity for Winterfolk heroes.

Liathaven.t: Navarr efforts stymied the vallorn's spread, leaving its forces overextended and offering a once-in-a-generation chance to drive it back.

Madruga.t: The Grendel threat to Siroc, the city of sails, was a matter of great concern.

Mournwold.t: The territory remained stable as fortifications began, Sarcombe received a charter, and priests began bringing the Way to the former Jotun thralls. Everyone waited to see what would happen with the Singing Caves.

Redoubt.t: A new runeforge in Redoubt was among the season's magical developments.

Segura.t: The Zemress exiles settled here and were eager to reshape their new home, though integrating them proved far from straightforward.

Spiral.t: Mentioned in passing: the magical round-up included something about the cats of Spiral.

Therunin.t: A highly problematic curse settled over vallorn-haunted Therunin.

Zenith.t: Zenith fell to the Druj, followed by eerie unexplained events and rumours of the imminent return of a long-dead Throne.

382YE Spring Equinox winds of war.d: The Druj abandoned Semmerholm to Dawn's armies, aided by Varushkans and Summer knights, then overran Zenith, killing over 1,500 Highborn and destroying the Gardens of Pallas. Marcher armies drove the remaining Grendel raiders from Lightsea and most of Free Landing, though Atalaya held. Navarr and Marchers repelled the vallorn in West Ranging, losing nearly 1,500 soldiers, opening a chance to strike into Westwood. About eighteen thousand Jotun took Stark and half of Tanikipari. In Spiral, Imperial armies took Ankra, Ossuary, Screed and the Legacy, destroying three Grendel armies, but the Iron Helms' terror magic woke the Black Plateau, imposing heavy ongoing penalties. Eight Sentinel Gate conjunctions were identified for the Spring Equinox.

Dawn.t: Dawn's four armies, joined by Summer knights their witches summoned from Eleonaris, liberated all of Semmerholm without a major battle as the Druj withdrew; Dawnish magic also sent two further cohorts of knights to fight in Spiral.

Druj.t: The Druj quit Semmerholm for the Barrens but poured some thirty thousand orcs into Zenith, seizing the whole territory, beginning to turn Proceris into marsh and slaughtering prisoners where the Halls of Knowledge once stood.

Grendel.t: The Grendel abandoned most of Madruga with their plunder, keeping Atalaya and a few small islands, but in Spiral they lost Ankra, Ossuary, Screed and the Legacy, and three whole armies—the Salt Dogs, Sand Pipers and Stone Gyre—were destroyed.

Highguard.t: The Granite Pillar, Valiant Pegasus and Seventh Wave were driven out of Zenith, losing more than fifteen hundred Highborn while covering the Urizeni evacuation, before rallying at Cargo in Limus.

Jotun.t: Some eighteen thousand Jotun under the Queen in the North's champion invaded Sermersuaq, taking Stark and half of Tanikipari with unusual caution, while their raiders lingered in West Marsh and an envoy apparently went to the Thule.

Navarr.t: The Quiet Step, wielding the flame of Surut, led the campaign that turned back the vallorn in West Ranging, while the battered Black Thorns withdrew from Madruga to Miaren.

The Brass Coast.t: Madruga was largely freed of the Grendel with the help of Freeborn corsairs, though priceless relics from Atalaya's museums were carried off, and the Red Wind Corsairs raided profitably in Spiral and showed restraint amid the madness.

The League.t: The Towerjacks returned from furlough in Sarvos to fight in Spiral, where under the Black Plateau's influence they came to echo some of the Iron Helms' atrocities.

The Marches.t: The Drakes and Strong Reeds liberated Lightsea and most of Free Landing, while the Tusks and Bounders fought the vallorn in West Ranging, where some eight hundred yeomen fell and were denied burial in their homeland's soil.

Thule.t: Wintermark scouts reported a Jotun group received by the Thule in the Silver Peaks foothills, raising fears of an alliance, though the Thule took no part in the invasion.

Urizen.t: Urizen lost Zenith entirely, along with Spire Calator and the Gardens of Pallas, and its refugees fled to Morrow and Redoubt; Spiral is now Imperial, but the Citadel Guard remains at risk of disbanding unless another region of Spiral is taken.
