Varushka.t: The Golden Axe helped Dawn clear Semmerholm, while the Iron Helms' cabalists unleashed a terror in the night on the Grendel in Spiral that broke them but woke the Black Plateau, killing or driving mad the cabalists themselves.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark faced a Jotun invasion of Sermersuaq that took Stark and half of Tanikipari with little resistance, and feared further Jotun moves into West Marsh in Kallavesa and a Jotun pact with the Thule.

382YE Spring Equinox winds of war.o: In the Spring of 382YE the Empire liberated Semmerholm and most of Madruga, turned back the vallorn in West Ranging and conquered Spiral, but lost all of Zenith to the Druj while a Jotun host invaded Sermersuaq. The victory in Spiral woke the Black Plateau.

Bregasland/North Fens.t: Mentioned in passing: yeomen raised among the rushes of North Fens leapt at the chance to cross by boat to the islands of Free Landing.

Kallavesa/West Marsh.t: Jotun raiders still haunt northern West Marsh and were gathering at a Summer regio on the Westerhal Trail, where a Sentinel Gate conjunction offered the Empire a chance to strike.

Liathaven/West Ranging.t: The vallorn was prevented from seizing West Ranging, but the Empire holds only a partial beachhead; fire and Surut's immolation destroyed most of its Spring regio and stripped the region of its forested quality.

Liathaven/Westwood.t: Ettercaps emerged from Westwood during the fighting, and the weakened vallorn left an opportunity to push into the region and possibly cleanse it, though casualties would be high.

Madruga/Free Landing.t: Most islands of Free Landing were liberated, putting the Empire eight-tenths of the way to control, but Atalaya and a few smaller islands remain occupied and its museums were looted.

Madruga/Lightsea.t: The Marchers drove south along the Lightsea coast and retook the region, routing raiders at Quzar within hours.

Redoubt/Limus.t: The three Highborn armies rallied at Cargo in Limus, where a quarter of Zenith's population had gathered as refugees, now perilously near the Druj front.

Reikos/Haros Water.t: Mentioned in passing: Highborn recalled the earlier fall of Haros Water to the Druj.

Reikos/Riverwatch.t: Mentioned in passing: Highborn recalled the earlier fall of Riverwatch to the Druj.

Semmerholm/Axmure.t: The Druj forces that had fallen back into Axmure withdrew south without a fight, and Dawn's armies camped and feasted with their Summer allies beneath its trees.

Semmerholm/Ulvenholm.t: The orc bandit bands that had long harassed Ulvenholm left south with the Druj, to the relief of the yeofolk and Navarr there.

Sermersuaq/East Floes.t: Two Sentinel Gate conjunctions open into East Floes near the site of the Winter Solstice battles against the drowned dead.

Sermersuaq/Sealtoq.t: The Jarl of Aftanes' warband probed into Sealtoq in an apparent feint and was repulsed by the Suaq, though many Suaq fell.

Sermersuaq/Silver Peaks.t: Steinr wardens reported a Jotun group passing into the Silver Peaks foothills to be received by the Thule.

Sermersuaq/Stark.t: Stark fell quickly to the Jotun, who are now dug in there, using the village of Rest as their base and relighting the Sentinel's Rest beacon as a great bonfire.

Sermersuaq/Suaq Fount.t: Mentioned in passing: it is unknown whether Jotun scouts have learned of the new mine in Suaq Fount.

Sermersuaq/Tanikipari.t: The Jotun are halfway to controlling Tanikipari after taking the Hot Springs of Taniki, and a large Jotun force resting at the Spring Hills is a Sentinel Gate target.

Spiral/Ankra.t: Four Imperial armies crushed the Grendel in Ankra and liberated the region.

Spiral/Apstrus.t: The season's final battle was fought at Solen's Doubt on Apstrus, where the Black Plateau woke; the Empire withdrew, leaving the Grendel in control.

Spiral/Apulus.t: Retreating Grendel regrouped at Apulus, which remains in their hands along with the southern coast.

Spiral/Cinion.t: The Imperial Orc armies reinforced the assault on Ankra from Cinion, which, with Ankra, Ossuary and Screed, now gives the Empire Spiral.

Spiral/Ossuary.t: After a two-week siege the Empire took Ossuary and recaptured the Legacy mithril mine, which may be allocated at the Spring Equinox but now has doubled upkeep.

Spiral/Screed.t: The Iron Helms took Screed with savage cruelty and unleashed their terror ritual there, and a Sentinel Gate conjunction reaches the Gethern Expanse, where elite Grendel mercenaries are heading.

The Barrens/Dawnguard.t: The Druj armies leaving Semmerholm crossed back into the Barrens toward Dawnguard.

The Barrens/Murderdale.t: A Sentinel Gate conjunction leads to Lerrovac's Camp in Murderdale, where Imperial prisoners are held by a powerful Druj Tepel and a major orc force.

Zenith/Clypion.t: The Druj flooded Clypion, felling spire after spire and slaughtering prisoners at the empty site of the Halls of Knowledge.

Zenith/Iteri.t: The Highborn made their last stand in Iteri, losing hundreds at the Utique fords as Spire Calator and the Gardens of Pallas were burned.

Zenith/Proceris.t: The Druj overran the Highborn foothold in Proceris and, with miasma pillars, are turning it into marshland, giving it the marsh quality.

Bregasland.t: Mentioned in passing: the Quiet Step, Tusks and Bounders marched south out of Bregasland's marshes to fight the vallorn in West Ranging.

Holberg.t: Mentioned in passing: the Towerjacks' general urged them to charge 'like heroes of Holberg'.

Kahraman.t: Mentioned in passing: the defeated Navarr Black Thorns marched north through Kahraman on their way to Miaren.

Kallavesa.t: Jotun warriors still haunt northern West Marsh, close to the newly conquered Stark, and their raiding parties are gathering there, perhaps to tighten their hold on the region.

Karov.t: Mentioned in passing: the Iron Helms' cabalists drew on the darkness beneath the hills of Karov for their ritual in Spiral.

Karsk.t: Mentioned in passing: the Iron Helms' cabalists drew on the darkness beneath the hills of Karsk for their ritual in Spiral.

Liathaven.t: The vallorn's push into West Ranging was turned back at heavy cost, leaving the Empire building a beachhead in the north-west and a rare chance to strike at the vallorn in Westwood, though vast swathes of forest were burned.

Madruga.t: Marcher armies retook Lightsea and most of Free Landing almost unopposed, but Atalaya and a few small islands remain in Grendel hands, and much of the territory's wealth was carried off.

Miaren.t: Mentioned in passing: the battered Black Thorns withdrew toward the safety of Miaren.

Miekarova.t: Mentioned in passing: the Iron Helms' cabalists drew on the shadows beneath the trees of Miekarova for their ritual in Spiral.

Mitwold.t: Mentioned in passing: Mitwold is not named on the page and is linked only through the Marcher armies' wider campaigning.

Morrow.t: Urizeni refugees fleeing Zenith were evacuated to Morrow, and displaced Zenith Urizen were offered new holdings there.

Mournwold.t: Mentioned in passing: the Drakes' general declared the Mournwold won, and the Marcher armies marched down out of the Mourn into Madruga as the Navarr passed through northwards.

Otkodov.t: Mentioned in passing: a Jotun group was believed to be an envoy to the Thule orcs of Otkodov.

Redoubt.t: Redoubt took in refugees from Zenith, and the three Highborn armies rallied at Cargo in Limus, now dangerously close to the Druj front.

Reikos.t: Mentioned in passing: retreating Highborn recalled the earlier loss of Haros Water and Riverwatch to the same Druj foe.

Sarvos.t: Mentioned in passing: the Towerjacks returned to Spiral from their furlough in Sarvos.

Semmerholm.t: Semmerholm is once again entirely in Dawnish hands after the Druj withdrew, burning manors and villages and leaving raiders who were hunted down or driven into hiding.

Sermersuaq.t: The Jotun conquered Stark and half of Tanikipari, sending thralls west, and their raiders and scouts ranged across the territory while defenders were overwhelmed hall by hall.

Skallahn.t: Mentioned in passing: Winterfolk who chose thraldom were sent west to Skallahn.

Spiral.t: The Empire now controls Spiral and may assign it through the Senate, but the awakened Black Plateau brings heavier casualties, no natural resupply, reduced production and doubled upkeep at the Legacy.

The Barrens.t: The Druj armies retreated back into the Barrens toward Dawnguard, and a Sentinel Gate conjunction offered a chance to strike at Lerrovac's Camp in Murderdale.

Tromsa.t: Mentioned in passing: Winterfolk who chose thraldom were sent west to Tromsa.

Volodmartz.t: Mentioned in passing: the Iron Helms' cabalists drew on the shadows beneath the trees of Volodmartz for their ritual in Spiral.

Zenith.t: Zenith fell entirely to the Druj, who destroyed spires and the Gardens of Pallas and began turning Proceris into marsh; only a handful of spires shielded by Night magic remain protected.

382YE Summer Solstice winds of fortune.d: The roundup covered many matters. The Navarr weighed hard choices over fighting the vallorn in Liathaven. Gunnbrand Ironwill's mandate, the only one upheld in the Spring Synod, permanently changed how Wintermark makes war. Marcher friars sought help laying ghosts in the Greensward, and Feni raiders troubled Hahnmark and the Mournwold. The Brass Coast was unsettled by orc invasions and the Iron Confederacy's attack in Feroz. Urizen continued to endorse the Sword scholars gathering in Morrow. Highguard was offered white granite projects. The Imperial Orcs faced questions of identity. The Senate's ban on bite was enforced across the League, and a Thule party apparently found an ancient orichalcum mine in northern Varushka.

Highguard.t: The Highborn assembly's four statements of principle drew responses, and Highguard was offered three white granite opportunities: roads for pilgrims, the renewal of an old meeting hall, and a chance for benefactors to practise what they preach. Severin von Holberg's encyclical continued to be debated.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Imperial Orcs were described as approaching a crossroads, facing the unavoidable questions of who they are and what they want, with some possible answers explored.

Jotun.t: Mentioned in passing: Liathaven, which the Jotun held, was where the Navarr were weighing a fight against the vallorn, and former Jotun thralls settled in the Marches were noted.

Navarr.t: The Navarr faced hard choices over the opportunity to fight the vallorn in Liathaven, with their assembly's guidance producing mixed results. They were also concerned with developments among the orc nations.

The Brass Coast.t: Resilient after invasions by two barbarian orc nations, the Freeborn traded gossip about fiery skies over Madruga, earthquakes in Segura and the defence of the City of a Thousand Sails. The Iron Confederacy's attack on Suranni rebels in Feroz stirred growing concern.

The Marches.t: The Marchers faced hauntings in the Greensward, Feni raids in the Mournwold and Alderly, troubling Spring Equinox developments that angered the landskeepers, and stories of Good Walder linked to a stand of miraculous apple trees.

Thule.t: Scouts reported signs that a Thule adventuring party had briefly visited a storm-revealed site in northern Varushka, and the Thule are now likely aware of an ancient orichalcum mine there.

Urizen.t: The Urizen National Assembly continued to endorse the Sword scholars, an old heretical Wisdom sect following the proscribed paragon Sulemaine, who were gathering in Morrow and might yet be reconciled.

Varushka.t: A storm in northern Varushka had uncovered an ossuary, a possibly haunted cave in Brez, a Terunael orichalcum mine and old castle foundations, and the Thule now likely know of the mine. The Roads of Karsk were praised as a success.

Wintermark.t: Gunnbrand Ironwill's upheld mandate, together with the consecration of Kallavesa's marshes, permanently changed how Wintermark armies fight and opened opportunities for the Fist of the Mountain and the Green Shields. Feni raiders also troubled Hahnmark.

382YE Summer Solstice winds of fortune.o: The Summer Solstice 382YE Winds of Fortune gathered the season's developments across the Empire, from the Navarr fight against the vallorn in Liathaven and Feni raids in Wintermark and the Marches to unrest in the Brass Coast and new opportunities for Highguard and Wintermark.

Mournwold/Alderly.t: Feni were alleged to be living secretly in the forest of Alderly, their purpose unknown.

Mournwold/Greensward.t: Soured by the deaths of tens of thousands, the Greensward was beset by hauntings. Friars based at Honour's Rest were using liao to lay the ghosts to rest but needed help.

Feroz.t: The previous season's brutal Iron Confederacy attack on Suranni rebels sheltering in Feroz caused rising concern and debate across the Brass Coast.

Hahnmark.t: Feni raiders were active in Hahnmark, stealing perishable goods, and possible solutions were being discussed.

Kallavesa.t: The consecration of the marshes of Kallavesa, combined with Gunnbrand Ironwill's mandate, helped open opportunities for Wintermark's generals and change how its armies make war.

Karsk.t: Mentioned in passing: the Roads of Karsk were cited as a success that inspired a civil service survey of new road networks.

Liathaven.t: Liathaven offered the Navarr an opportunity to fight the vallorn there, prompting hard choices guided by their national assembly.

Madruga.t: Fiery displays in the skies over Madruga were among the subjects of Freeborn gossip.

Morrow.t: The Sword scholars, a heretical sect of Wisdom devotees following Sulemaine, were gathering in the foothills of Morrow.

Mournwold.t: The Mournwold was broadly improving, but Spring Equinox developments angered the landskeepers. The territory also suffered Feni raiding and hauntings in the Greensward.

Otkodov.t: Mentioned in passing: the Ambassador to Otkodov was among those tagged on news of the orc nations.

Segura.t: Earthquakes struck Segura, and the descendants of the paragon Zemress there were the first to voice concern over the Iron Confederacy's attack in Feroz.

382YE Summer Solstice winds of war.d: Fifty surrendered Grendel, including their commander Innevia, were penned on Mariposa awaiting a decision on their fate. Over fifteen thousand Jotun and Lasambrian orcs took most of Serra Damata, held back only by Fort Braydon, while the Corazón raided Kahraman's Bourse seats. In Spiral the Empire held Apstrus, Ateri and three-fifths of Apulus, and captured the Asavean Leri Tarquinius with fifteen wains of white granite. In Sermersuaq some sixty thousand Jotun defeated the Imperial armies at the Ford of Berusen, the shores of the Akonartoq and Atalaq. Around 2,500 Imperial soldiers died there and Senator Atte lost his seat. The Black Plateau's malign influence also grew stronger.

Dawn.t: Mentioned in passing: the Fire of the South marched to Sermersuaq from Astolat in the east.

Druj.t: Mentioned in passing: there was no news from Zenith or the Barrens this season.

Grendel.t: The Grendel lost Madruga and their fort at Apulian, and the Iron Helms hanged their surviving soldiers. Their last troops in Spiral clung to the Clavidian Wilds, and an Asavean Tarquinius was found to have been trading white granite and slaves to them.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Summer Storm secured Ateri and helped storm Apulian, though its orcs lost control in groups under the Plateau's influence. Imperial orcs also fought among the independent soldiers marching with the Bounders in Sermersuaq.

Jotun.t: The Jotun reinvaded Kahraman, taking most of Serra Damata. In Sermersuaq the King of Narkyst and the Jotun Queen led around sixty thousand orcs to victory, taking Sealtoq and Atalaq while honouring the Imperial dead.

Navarr.t: Two large conjunctions to the Green Maw, a Spring regio in Liathaven's Westwood, were detected for the Saturday evening of the Solstice, with skirmishes aimed at Navarr expected there.

The Brass Coast.t: Freeborn sailors ferried the Drakes to free Madruga, but the Jotun overran much of Serra Damata while the Corazón raided caravans, mines and mana sites across Kahraman. The Fire of the South fought and lost dead in Sermersuaq.

The League.t: The two League armies, the Wolves of War and the Towerjacks, helped push through Apstrus and Ateri to Apulus. The League was the only nation not represented among the independent soldiers fighting with the Bounders.

The Marches.t: The Drakes cleared the Grendel from Atalaya and now hold fifty prisoners. The Tusks and the Bounders marched from Liathaven to Sermersuaq and fought at the Ford of Berusen, the Akonartoq and Atalaq.

Thule.t: Mentioned in passing: the Thule hold the Silver Peaks of Sermersuaq, and their help may be needed to move mithril out if East Floes falls.

Urizen.t: Apstrus and Ateri were liberated and the Citadel Guard is no longer at risk of disbanding. However, freed slaves reported that Urizeni magicians had been shipped south to Grendel slave markets.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark lost Sermersuaq and the Suaq heartland of Atalaq, Senator Atte lost his seat, and the nation's ability to supply armies fell by one. The Bloodcloaks and the Fist of the Mountain fought the Jotun with conspicuous honour.

382YE Summer Solstice winds of war.o: In the Summer 382YE Winds of War the Drakes drove the last Grendel from Madruga, Imperial armies took most of Spiral including the Grendel fort at Apulian, and a huge Jotun host invaded Sermersuaq, seized Atalaq and ended its status as an Imperial territory. A fresh Jotun invasion struck Kahraman, and the civil service announced the Summer Solstice conjunctions.

Kahraman/Gambit.t: Mentioned in passing: without Fort Braydon's garrison the Jotun might have pushed on into Gambit.

Kahraman/Jade Range.t: Mentioned in passing: not named directly, though Corazón raiding bands ranged across the whole of Kahraman.

Kahraman/Serra Briante.t: Corazón raiders struck caravans from the Great Mine of Briante, costing it two wains of mithril next season. The region is judged the Jotun's likeliest next target.

Kahraman/Serra Damata.t: The Jotun claimed everything of note except Damata and the Damatian Cliffs, which lost four wains of white granite to raids. Competa del Bosque, a vital Jotun supply line in the south of the region, was named as a Solstice conjunction.

Liathaven/Westwood.t: Two conjunctions opening in quick succession to the Green Maw, a Spring regio deep in the Westwood, were detected for the Solstice's Saturday evening.

Madruga/Free Landing.t: Fifty Grendel prisoners, including their commander Innevia, are penned on the island of Mariposa. Innevia revealed they had been ordered to hold Atalaya and Free Landing for a returning armada that never came.

Sermersuaq/East Floes.t: The Imperial armies were driven back into East Floes and set up a base at Wreck. Here the Jotun Queen returned 270 Imperial dead, laid out with honour.

Sermersuaq/Sealtoq.t: The Jotun won the battles of the Ford of Berusen, the Akonartoq shores and Atalaq to conquer the region. Refugees trapped at Firehand's Taiga were named as a Solstice conjunction.

Sermersuaq/Silver Peaks.t: Mentioned in passing: the region remains in Thule hands, which matters for moving mithril should East Floes fall.

Sermersuaq/Stark.t: Mentioned in passing: Stark had already been captured by the Jotun before this season's fighting.

Sermersuaq/Suaq Fount.t: The Jotun Queen tried to flank Atalaq by marching via the Suaq Fount, but was met by the Bounders and the Fire of the South. The region remains in Imperial hands.

Sermersuaq/Suaq Wastes.t: Mentioned in passing: the Suaq Wastes is one of the three regions the Empire still holds in Sermersuaq.

Sermersuaq/Tanikipari.t: Jotun kirkja captured the Hot Springs of Taniki at the Spring Equinox and secured the whole region within a week.

Skarsind/Pakaanan's Pass.t: Mentioned in passing: withdrawing east through Pakaanan's Pass was discussed as the Jotun advanced.

Spiral/Apstrus.t: Imperial forces captured Solen's Doubt and the region. Apstrus is the only route by which an army can enter Mareave.

Spiral/Apulus.t: Apulian fell after a week-long siege, freeing slaves and an Asavean captive, but two-fifths of Apulus remains held by maddened bands. The last Grendel hold the Clavidian Wilds, a Solstice conjunction.

Spiral/Ateri.t: The Summer Storm secured the hills of Ateri, the ruins of Fort Mezudan and the eastern end of the Onyx Path.

Spiral/Screed.t: The horror at the heart of Screed continued to intensify, and the remnants of the howling maniacs once clustered there now roam southern Apulus.

Astolat.t: Mentioned in passing: the Fire of the South set out from Astolat on its march north to Sermersuaq.

Bay of Catazar.t: Mentioned in passing: Grendel soldiers at Apulian threw themselves into the Bay rather than face the Iron Helms.

Bregasland.t: Mentioned in passing: the Tusks and Bounders marched north through its fens, and Bregaslanders among the Bounders used the lake waters to their advantage.

Hahnmark.t: Mentioned in passing: the Fist of the Mountain marched out of Hahnmark, and the Jotun pursued the Imperial host onto the plains beneath its mountains.

Kahraman.t: Jotun, Hierro and other Lasambrian orcs captured all of Serra Damata except Damata and the Damatian Cliffs. The Corazón raided across the territory, cutting Bourse production and threatening all personal resources if the raids continue.

Kallavesa.t: Mentioned in passing: Imperial armies marched through its marshes, and recent events there let Wintermark sustain its three armies despite losing Sermersuaq.

Liathaven.t: The Tusks and Bounders left their battle against the vallorn here to march north. Two conjunctions to the Green Maw regio in the Westwood were detected for the Solstice.

Madruga.t: Madruga is entirely in Imperial hands again after the Grendel garrison of Atalaya surrendered, and fifty prisoners are being held at Imperial expense until dealt with.

Mareave.t: Grendel fleeing towards Mareave were slaughtered by maddened bands in Apulus. Imperial armies can only enter through Apstrus, but a spy network could be commissioned via the high passes.

Mitwold.t: Mentioned in passing: the Drakes' general ended his orders with the cry "Mitwold town Forever!"

Mournwold.t: Mentioned in passing: its haunted ruins are listed among the places where the Jotun have fought the Empire.

Otkodov.t: Mentioned in passing: the orcs of Otkodov were recalled as having contended with the Empire over the Silver Peaks three years ago.

Reinos.t: The Jotun invasion of Kahraman was launched from the hills of Reinos, with over fifteen thousand orcs crossing the border three weeks after the Spring Equinox.

Sermersuaq.t: The Jotun took Sealtoq and Atalaq and now hold three regions, leaving the Empire just East Floes, Suaq Fount and the Suaq Wastes. The territory is no longer Imperial and its Senate seat is lost.

Skarsind.t: Mentioned in passing: the Jotun drove the Empire towards the mountains of Skarsind, and withdrawal through Pakaanan's Pass was discussed.

Spiral.t: The Empire now controls Apstrus and Ateri and three-fifths of Apulus, but the Black Plateau's influence has intensified. Armies fighting there next season will suffer heavier casualties and attrition.

Temeschwar.t: Mentioned in passing: the Fire of the South passed through Temeschwar on its way to Sermersuaq.

The Barrens.t: Mentioned in passing: there was no news from the Barrens this season.

Zenith.t: Mentioned in passing: there was no news from Zenith this season.

382YE Winter Solstice winds of fortune.d: The Senate faced assigning newly conquered Ossium, which has virtually no native Imperial citizens. Morrow could be evacuated, though at least a fifth of its people would be left behind, and an alternative was proposed. Nearly two thousand slaves freed at Dubhtraig, mostly orcs, needed new homes, and another raid on Beoraidh was offered. The Navarr had a fleeting chance to reclaim Westwood while the vallorn surged in Brocéliande. Frederick di Sarvos offered to build one of four university projects. Gilah consecrated the Kraken's Bane in Calvos Sound as an inspirational memorial. Sixteen mandates were upheld, many urging nations to support Highborn pilgrims. New rituals and Druj-derived potions entered Imperial lore.

Dawn.t: Dawnish armies were hailed for victories at Semmerholm, Weirwater and Ossium, and Pelleas Thorne's mandate opened new chances to capitalise on them. The troubadours named Ser Isidore Ossienne and Lord Colwyn de Rondel as champions of Love and Glory, and Dawn was urged to aid pilgrims and perhaps Brocéliande.

Druj.t: The Druj were defeated in Ossium, the Empire's first new conquest in decades, and potions were translated from a captured Druj herbal. Their threat still loomed over Morrow and enslaved Zenith.

Grendel.t: The Grendel lost nearly two thousand slaves freed at Dubhtraig. An opportunity arose to raid the sinking city of Beoraidh and free an army of orc gladiators who hate the Salt Lords.

Highguard.t: Highguard's renewal continued as nine nations' mandates spread support for its pilgrims, and Able of the Shattered Tower called for a revival of the missionary tradition. Rebuilding the Lepidean Library in Bastion was one of four architectural proposals.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Imperial Orcs were the obvious home for the slaves freed from the Grendel, and the Winter Sun general was urged towards a raid on Beoraidh. Skywise Tulva's mandate called on orc citizens to support the pilgrims.

Jotun.t: Mentioned in passing: a conjunction to battle the Jotun in Sermersuaq was listed among the season's opportunities.

Navarr.t: The Navarr had a closing window to reclaim Westwood from a weakened vallorn while struggling to hold back its surge in Brocéliande. Corey Brackensong's mandate costs every Navarr herb garden two random herbs each season until Winter 383YE.

The Brass Coast.t: The Brass Coast was named as a possible home for freed orc slaves and gained an inspirational memorial at the Kraken's Bane, with a chance to build a Prosperity seminary. A new school in Siroc was also proposed.

The League.t: Expanding Holberg University and renovating Diora University in Sarvos were among Frederick di Sarvos's proposals. The League was also floated as a home for freed orc slaves and pledged support for the pilgrims.

The Marches.t: Marcher generals were celebrated, with children named after them, and Friar John of the Mourn's mandate pushed the yeomen to adapt Marcher ways of war to their heritage. Hrodin's mandate called on Marchers to aid the pilgrims.

Urizen.t: Urizen weighed evacuating Morrow, which would leave a fifth of its people behind, against a proposal to bring light back after the loss of the Halls of Knowledge. Further opportunities were offered against a curse rotting its food.

Varushka.t: Slaves were freed in Varushka amid looming territorial disputes with orcs. Father Drakov's mandate urged Varushkans to support the pilgrims.

Wintermark.t: Gunnbrand Ironwill's mandate turned Wintermark armies against the use of envenomed blades on anyone but the vallorn, and Rane Sherarding's mandate spread the burden of supporting pilgrims to Wintermark.

382YE Winter Solstice winds of fortune.o: The Winter Solstice 382YE Winds of Fortune gathered the season's events and opportunities across the Empire. Ossium's conquest raised the question of which nation should receive it, while crises, proposals and Synod mandates touched almost every nation.

Liathaven/Westwood.t: The Navarr had a fleeting chance to reclaim Westwood from the vallorn and reunite north and south for the first time since Terunael fell.

Madruga/Calvos Sound.t: Gilah used true liao to consecrate the Kraken's Bane at its dry dock in Calvos Sound as an inspirational memorial, raising the chance to build a Prosperity seminary there.

Bastion.t: Rebuilding Bastion's Lepidean Library was one of four proposals awaiting a decision by the Senate or a wayleave holder.

Bay of Catazar.t: Mentioned in passing: fleets on the Bay of Catazar were tagged in the orc affairs entry, which hinted at bloodthirsty pirates and a silent armada.

Brocéliande.t: The vallorn of Brocéliande stirred, sending ettercaps and vallornspawn against steadings the Navarr spent centuries liberating. A conjunction to fight it there was also identified.

Feroz.t: Mentioned in passing: residents of Feroz were tagged in the winds of magic entry.

Hahnmark.t: Mentioned in passing: the northern Feni left Hahnmark and crossed into Hercynia.

Hercynia.t: The northern Feni arrived in Hercynia from Hahnmark and showed no sign of vanishing peacefully into the forest.

Holberg.t: Expanding Holberg University was proposed as one of Frederick di Sarvos's four projects, and Holberg's residents were tagged in the winds of magic.

Liathaven.t: The weakened vallorn of western Liathaven gave the Navarr a short-lived chance of victory, while the Feni of the Woods that Fell disappeared into the forest.

Madruga.t: The Kraken's Bane in Madruga was consecrated as an inspirational memorial, raising the chance of a Prosperity seminary for Imperial and Sumaash pilgrims.

Morrow.t: The civil service judged that Morrow could be evacuated, though at least a fifth of its people would be left behind, and a rival proposal sought to restore hope. A conjunction to free slaves there was also identified.

Mournwold.t: Mentioned in passing: the Marcher generals were praised for having liberated the Mournwold.

Ossium.t: With Ossium conquered from the Druj and almost no native Imperial citizens, the Senate had to choose which of the ten nations should receive it. A conjunction to delve into its woods was also identified.

Redoubt.t: A conjunction was identified to challenge orc opportunists in Redoubt.

Sarvos.t: Renovating Diora University in Sarvos was one of the four proposals, and Sarvos residents were tagged in the winds of magic.

Semmerholm.t: Dawn had driven the Druj from Semmerholm, and a conjunction offered a chance to end the Eater-of-Hope, which had run to ground there.

Sermersuaq.t: A conjunction was identified to battle the Jotun in Sermersuaq.

Spiral.t: Mentioned in passing: the Grendel in Spiral was recalled as one of Urizen's recent losses.

Temeschwar.t: Mentioned in passing: residents of Temeschwar were tagged in the winds of magic entry.

The Semmerlak.t: Mentioned in passing: Dawnish armies crossed the Semmerlak with the aid of Summer eternals to surprise the Druj in Ossium.

Weirwater.t: Mentioned in passing: Dawnish armies were credited with crushing the unliving horrors assailing Weirwater.

Zenith.t: Mentioned in passing: the people of Zenith were described as enslaved by the Druj, and its residents were tagged in the winds of magic.

382YE Winter Solstice winds of war.d: Around 250 fleets and 300 warbands raided Tathar and sacked Dubhtraig. They gutted half its shipyard, ruined Salt Lord Suriad's palace and freed up to two thousand slaves. Lasambrian Jotun seized Anduzjasse, raided across Segura, exiled Freeborn who refused them, and offered peace only for Segura and Feroz. The Drakes destroyed the Feni settlement inside a Winter regio in Alderly but were cursed. At a crystal-transformed Canterspire, six Imperial armies drove the Druj from Operus. Wintermark-led armies retook nine-tenths of Sealtoq but not Atalaq. Dawnish and Varushkan armies, aided by the Thule and Summer knights, conquered Echofell and Webwood. That made Ossium the first new territory in two centuries.

Dawn.t: Dawnish knights spearheaded the breach of Suriad's palace and a Dawnish-Winterfolk fleet burned the weirwood ships of Balsagoth. Four Dawnish armies took the Tower of the Scorpion and conquered Echofell and Webwood in Ossium.

Druj.t: The Druj were turned back at Canterspire and lost Operus, and they were harried in Peregro and Caeli. In Ossium the Amber Scorpion lost their tower and thousands of orcs, and the survivors retreated into the southern forests.

Grendel.t: Dubhtraig was sacked, its shipyard more than half gutted and Suriad's palace left in ruins, with rumours that the Salt Lord fell. No navy can be built there for a year, and the Fort Fuil and Fort Salann garrisons were badly depleted.

Highguard.t: Highborn soldiers held Dubhtraig's western docks, and the burning beasts of Jachin's Legacy broke the palace gates. Highborn armies savaged in Morrow had already withdrawn to Astolat and Casinea.

Imperial Orcs.t: Imperial Orc warbands rallied enslaved orcs at Dubhtraig and fought in its mines, though Spring magic made some dangerously aggressive while they waited. The Winter Sun joined the steady conquest of Sealtoq.

Jotun.t: Lasambrian Jotun under the firebird banner conquered Anduzjasse, pressed into Anozeseri and offered terms for Segura and Feroz. In Sermersuaq the Jotun lost most of Sealtoq but held Atalaq, and Yrsa Jansdóttir is enraged by the destruction of the truce stone.

Navarr.t: Navarr runners carried the signal to sail and Navarr soldiers seized Dubhtraig's towers. The Black Thorns fought honourably in Sealtoq and the Quiet Step escorted the Feni exiles into Liathaven.

The Brass Coast.t: Freeborn lost Anduzjasse and saw raids across Segura, with penniless exiles fleeing east and southern trade choked off, and the Lasambrians now threaten Feroz. Freeborn corsairs blockaded Dubhtraig, and the Fire of the South and Red Wind Corsairs fought in Sermersuaq.

The League.t: League bravos excelled in Dubhtraig's streets while Sarvos stayed quiet under the watch of the Grendel armada. The Towerjacks and Wolves of War helped break the Druj at Canterspire.

The Marches.t: The Drakes destroyed the Feni village in Alderly, at the cost of 120 casualties, the deaths of Alderly Marchers who sided with the Feni, and a curse. Marcher soldiers guarded Dubhtraig's docks, and the Tusks and Bounders fought in Sealtoq.

Thule.t: Allied with the Military Council, the Thule conquered the Bonewood with rumoured heavy losses. They then delivered about 150 Imperial slaves freed from the Druj.

Urizen.t: Canterspire became a crystal citadel guarded by Phaleron's heralds, and the Druj were driven from Operus. However, Naeve's Twisting Blight lies over Morrow, Redoubt and Spiral, and the people of the Arbiter's Seat chose Kaela's gift.

Varushka.t: The Iron Helms and Northern Eagle fought at Canterspire, and the Golden Axe helped conquer Echofell and Webwood. Varushkans also seized towers and fought in the mines at Dubhtraig.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark's three armies, Winterfolk heroes and Summer knights led the retaking of nine-tenths of Sealtoq, though Atalaq remains Jotun. A few Suaq have taken the Choice and become Jotun.

382YE Winter Solstice winds of war.o: The 382YE Winter Solstice winds of war covered the Imperial armada's sack of the Grendel city of Dubhtraig, the Lasambrian Jotun conquest of Anduzjasse in Segura, the Drakes' destruction of the Feni village in Alderly, the turning back of the Druj in Morrow, the reconquest of most of Sealtoq, and the conquest of four regions of Ossium.

Feroz/Cazar Straits.t: Mentioned in passing: not named; the page refers only generally to Brass Coast ports along the Bay of Catazar gathering ships for the raid.

Feroz/Fontargenta.t: Mentioned in passing: not named; Feroz as a whole is threatened by the Lasambrians.

Hahnmark/Bruckland.t: Mentioned in passing: the Wintermark armies marched through Bruckland on their way into Sermersuaq.

Kahraman/Serra Briante.t: Mentioned in passing: earlier in the year the Fort Braydon garrison stopped the Jotun pushing into Serra Briante.

Kahraman/Serra Damata.t: Mentioned in passing: recalled as where the Jotun seized Damata after the Spring Equinox before being driven back.

Kallavesa/Skymark.t: Mentioned in passing: the armies marched north through Skymark.

Kallavesa/Wittal Grove.t: Mentioned in passing: the Fire of the South left its camp on the edges of the Wittal Grove to join the Wintermark armies.

Karsk/Krevsaty.t: The Thule crossed from Krevsaty into the Bonewood. A Thule warband later marched south from Krevsaty to hand over about 150 Imperials freed from the Druj.

Karsk/Moresvah.t: The three families of Moresvah hired wagon raiders to carry mining supplies to Lormaa, seeking to work its mithril mine with former Druj mine-slaves.

Liathaven/Liaven's Glen.t: The Feni exiles of the Woods-that-Fell were ushered into Liaven's Glen. A raven-masked figure later led a ragged band of Alderly Feni into its depths.

Liathaven/Westwood.t: Mentioned in passing: the Quiet Step's general says their assault on Westwood draws closer.

Morrow/Caeli.t: Imperial armies pushed into Caeli and liberated the Arbiter's Seat, only to find its people had all chosen death through Kaela's gift. A conjunction to Arbiter's Green has opened here.

Morrow/Operus.t: The Druj consolidated in Operus before Canterspire, then were pushed out entirely by the Imperial armies.

Morrow/Peregro.t: The Druj camped in Peregro after the Autumn Equinox and were later harried there by Imperial forces.

Mournwold/Alderly.t: The Drakes followed secret paths into a Winter regio and destroyed the Feni village and its great oak, fighting Marcher locals who had joined the Feni. They emerged cursed.

Mournwold/Chalkdowns.t: The Feni exiles were escorted down from the Chalkdowns, and the Drakes camped on its western edge before entering Alderly.

Mournwold/Green March.t: Mentioned in passing: fleeing Alderly Feni crossed the Green March towards Liathaven.

Mournwold/Southmoor.t: Mentioned in passing: the Feni exiles passed through Southmoor under Imperial escort.

Necropolis/Longbeach.t: Mentioned in passing: not named; the page mentions the Necropolis quayside and the docks of Sanctuary Sands, where Jachin's Legacy's burning beasts caused small fires.

Ossium/Bittershore.t: Already held, Bittershore counts among the four regions giving the Empire control of Ossium. Druj magic made the forests along its edges hostile.

Ossium/Bonewood.t: The Thule conquered the Bonewood and declared complete dominance there, while the Imperial armies deliberately avoided it.

Ossium/Echofell.t: The Imperial armies stormed the Amber Scorpion's Tower of the Scorpion and conquered the region, overcoming hidden rope-bridge ambushes and a final Druj counter-attack.

Ossium/Galath Fields.t: The five Imperial armies marched east out of the Galath Fields. It remains one of the four regions the Empire holds.

Ossium/Webwood.t: The Empire conquered the Webwood against Druj warbands and the spider-heralds of Arhallogen, though the hidden temple was never found.

Redoubt/Optarion.t: Mentioned in passing: not named; Redoubt as a whole suffers Naeve's Twisting Blight.

Segura/Anduzjasse.t: The Lasambrian Jotun took Anduz in a three-hour siege and now control the whole region, including Old Anduz and the Longing Circle. Freeborn there must submit or be exiled, and Faraden are barred.

Segura/Anozeseri.t: Lasambrians made significant progress conquering Anozeseri and the Corazón took the Golden Terraces. Their envoys delivered their terms at Anozel.

Segura/Burnish.t: Corazón raiders struck Sunsong Ranch in eastern Burnish. Losing its Towers of Anduz would end the great work's benefit.

Segura/Iron Plains.t: Corazón raiders destroyed the produce of the Red Fields on the Iron Plains.

Segura/Sobral Grasses.t: The Zemress refugees here were raided, and Lasambrian Jotun now occupy the Sobral Stand forest, the site of an upcoming conjunction.

Segura/Yellow Chase.t: The Zemress refugees settled in Yellow Chase suffered Corazón raids. Its Towers of Anduz are at risk if the orcs advance.

Sermersuaq/East Floes.t: The Jotun Shield of the Mountain left its position near Wreck on the East Floes to march south against the Imperial armies.

Sermersuaq/Sealtoq.t: About nine-tenths of Sealtoq was retaken, but Yrsa Jansdóttir still holds Atalaq. A conjunction will open on Atalaq Tasanko before its gates.

Sermersuaq/Stark.t: Mentioned in passing: named only as an objective in several generals' orders.

Astolat.t: Mentioned in passing: Highborn armies withdrew to Astolat from Morrow, and the Tusks' Summer allies marched from there.

Bastion.t: Mentioned in passing: home of several captains in the Dubhtraig raid, including members of Jachin's Legacy.

Bay of Catazar.t: The armada gathered at ports all along the Bay and crossed it to Tathar, dominating the waters off the Broken Shore during the raid.

Bregasland.t: Mentioned in passing: home of some Marcher captains listed in the Dubhtraig raid.

Casinea.t: Mentioned in passing: Highborn armies savaged in Morrow withdrew westward to Casinea.

Feroz.t: The Lasambrian Jotun declared that Feroz is their next target after Segura. For now the eastern trade route through Bramar remains open.

Hahnmark.t: Mentioned in passing: home of many Winterfolk captains in the Dubhtraig raid, and the armies marched north through it.

Hercynia.t: Mentioned in passing: home of some Navarr captains listed in the Dubhtraig raid.

Holberg.t: Mentioned in passing: League bravos raised on Holberg's walls fought in Dubhtraig's streets.

Kahraman.t: Earlier in the year the Jotun seized Damata before being driven out. The Lasambrians now threaten to help Narkyst reclaim Kahraman if the Empire rejects their offer.

Kallavesa.t: Wintermark's three armies gathered around Rundhal, joined by ten thousand Summer knights and the Fire of the South, before marching north. Jotun warbands had been raiding its north.

Karov.t: Mentioned in passing: wagon raiders from Karov fought with the League armies at Canterspire.

Karsk.t: The Thule crossed from Karsk into the Bonewood. Moresvah families sent wagon raiders with mining supplies to the mithril mine at Lormaa.

Liathaven.t: The Feni of the Woods-that-Fell were ushered into Liaven's Glen, where Alderly's fleeing Feni also vanished. The Quiet Step is preparing an assault on Westwood.

Madruga.t: Mentioned in passing: named among the lands the Lasambrians threaten to help Narkyst reclaim.

Miaren.t: Mentioned in passing: home of some Navarr captains listed in the Dubhtraig raid.

Miekarova.t: Mentioned in passing: home of some Varushkan captains listed in the Dubhtraig raid.

Mitwold.t: Mentioned in passing: home of some Marcher captains listed in the Dubhtraig raid.

Morrow.t: Six Imperial armies broke the Druj before a crystal-clad Canterspire and drove them from Operus into retreat in Caeli. The territory suffers Naeve's Twisting Blight, and the Arbiter's Seat lost its whole population to Kaela's gift.

Mournwold.t: Three armies passed through to deal with the Feni. The Drakes destroyed the hidden Feni village of Alderly while the other two escorted the Woods-that-Fell exiles out of the territory.

Necropolis.t: Burning stone beasts of Jachin's Legacy stood as living beacons on the docks of Sanctuary Sands, causing several small fires on the Necropolis quayside.

Ossium.t: The Empire conquered Echofell and Webwood and took the Tower of the Scorpion, holding four regions and the majority of the territory. The Senate may now assign it to a nation, though the Thule hold the Bonewood and the Druj still hold the south.

Redoubt.t: Naeve's Twisting Blight was reported to have been laid over Redoubt.

Reikos.t: Mentioned in passing: home of some Highborn captains listed in the Dubhtraig raid.

Reinos.t: Mentioned in passing: last winter the Jotun tried to smooth the passage from Reinos into Segura.

Sarvos.t: With the ransomed Grendel armada idling offshore, Sarvos kept up appearances while its ships slipped away to join the raid. Watchers then saw the Grendel admirals keep to the agreement after news of the attack arrived.

Segura.t: Lasambrian Jotun conquered Anduzjasse, seized seven Towers of Anduz and raided farms across the territory. They are also driving out Freeborn who refuse them and barring southern traders.

Semmerholm.t: Mentioned in passing: home of some Dawnish captains listed in the Dubhtraig raid.

Sermersuaq.t: Nine Imperial armies with Summer allies drove four Jotun armies and their reinforcements back to the walls of Atalaq, retaking most of Sealtoq. The Spring-infused waters healed both sides.

Skarsind.t: Mentioned in passing: Jotun warbands had raided western Skarsind, and the Winter Sun's general spoke of one day returning home there.

Spiral.t: Naeve's Twisting Blight was reported to have been brought to bear in Spiral.

Tassato.t: Mentioned in passing: League bravos raised in Tassato's alleys fought in Dubhtraig.

Tathar.t: Imperial raiders burned ports and supply lines, freed slaves and sacked Dubhtraig. The garrisons of Fort Fuil and Fort Salann suffered significant losses.

Temeschwar.t: Mentioned in passing: bravos from Temeschwar's backstreets fought in Dubhtraig, and Temeschwari mercenaries marched with the League armies in Morrow.

The Barrens.t: Mentioned in passing: Kaela's gift of painless death to captured Imperials extends into the Barrens.

Therunin.t: Mentioned in passing: home of some Navarr captains listed in the Dubhtraig raid.

Tsirku.t: Mentioned in passing: the reclaimed land is described as tiny beside the plains stretching towards the wasteland of Tsirku.

Upwold.t: Mentioned in passing: the Black Thorns marched north from distant Upwold.

Volodmartz.t: Mentioned in passing: wagon raiders from Volodmartz fought with the League armies at Canterspire.

Weirwater.t: Mentioned in passing: home of some Dawnish captains listed in the Dubhtraig raid.

Zenith.t: Mentioned in passing: recalled as where the Druj invasion began, and Kaela's gift extends there.

383YE Autumn Equinox Synod judgements.d: No change of doctrine or veto was sought. Statements condemned the sword scholars' obstruction, defended briars and lineaged citizens, and backed the painful ceding of Feroz to the Grendel. Several mandates failed for lack of a greater majority because the Wisdom assembly and sword scholars intervened, including pilgrimages to Zenith and Holberg. Enacted mandates included purifying Holberg's waters at a cost to Highborn businesses, the Crusading Storm order for Highborn armies, efforts to lift Wither the Seed from Brocéliande, and stronger sword scholar support in Urizen. Veikko Bondforger and Astrid Rezia di Tassato became Cardinals of Loyalty and Pride, and the Virtue Fund closed at 39 Thrones, 2 Crowns and 1 Ring.

Dawn.t: Dawn's assembly named its Champions of Virtue, Love and Glory, backed an Applefel market in Weirwater and urged its knights to keep fighting the vallorn. An enacted Highborn mandate lifted the penalty on Dawnish congregations and gave them extra liao and votes.

Druj.t: Urizen declared the Druj its greatest threat and called for them to be driven from Zenith. Varushka called on its Wagon Raiders to hunt the Druj in Ossium, and the Imperial Orcs invited tribes formerly subjugated by the Druj to join their legions in Skarsind.

Grendel.t: The Brass Coast and the Assembly of the Nine accepted the ceasefire that cedes Feroz to the Grendel for two years of peace. The Freeborn urged corsairs to strike the Drake Island shipyard if the treaty failed, or to help evacuate Feroz if it passed.

Highguard.t: An enacted mandate meant every Highborn business would suffer a one-rank penalty the next season so that Holberg's fouled waters could be purified. Another gave the Highborn armies the Crusading Storm order, while other judgements urged the nation to bear the League's curse and to root out the practice of Unveiling.

Imperial Orcs.t: The orc assembly declared its ambition to claim the Barrens and to become a crusading storm. It sent preachers to the orcs of Ossium, welcomed former Druj tribes into the legions in Skarsind, and asked Reavers to aid freed orcs in Axos, while Consul Skywise Fal was called to inquisition over his ambitions for the Throne.

Jotun.t: Wintermark's assembly rejected the Jotun notion of honour and invited former Jotun thralls home. It also honoured Raknar Ravenstorm's raid on Ikka's Tears and Osric's defeat of the Jotun in Atalaq, while the Marchers urged boat raids on the Jotun in Bregasland.

Navarr.t: An enacted Navarr mandate urged the nation to find the magical might to lift Wither the Seed from Brocéliande. The assembly also denounced agents of Yaw'nagrah, condemned the Arhallogen's alliance with the Druj and honoured Eirwen Brackensong's defence against the vallorn.

The Brass Coast.t: The Freeborn accepted the ceding of Feroz as the lesser evil but vowed it was only waiting and pledged to hold senators and generals to account to retake it. They also urged rebuilding the Justicars, exposing smugglers and translating Sumaah texts at the Zemress seminary.

Thule.t: Mentioned in passing: Wintermark prepared to welcome home people held in bondage by the Thule, and two magicians were vindicated over a treaty with the Thule.

Urizen.t: An enacted mandate entrenched support for the sword scholars, opening the way to more of their temples in Morrow and dulling Synod-wide statements in Urizen. The assembly also warned that the Citadel Army was starving, offered disbanded Citadel Guard soldiers homes in other spires and called for improvements to Cargo.

Varushka.t: Varushka's assembly urged its people to bring the ways of the hearth to the new territory of Ossium and called on the Wagon Raiders to protect it and hunt the Druj there. It also praised its preceptor Yevanshka, and Illya Nikovitch Volkov was appointed Guardian of the Maze of Zoria.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark prepared to welcome thralls returning from the Thule and Jotun, called for a trading hall in Valashal and asked Kallavesa to gather herbs for the head healer. It also added Raknar Ravenstorm to the Book of Heroes and stood with Iron Osric in the drive to reclaim Sermersuaq.

383YE Autumn Equinox Synod judgements.o: At the Autumn Equinox 383YE summit the Imperial Synod raised 140 judgements, ranging from responses to the Grendel ceasefire and the loss of Feroz to the fight against the vallorn and Druj, and the growing influence of Urizen's sword scholars.

Brocéliande.t: An enacted Navarr mandate urged the nation to find ways to remove the Wither the Seed curse from Brocéliande. Eirwen Brackensong was praised for sending the equivalent of 4,260 troops against its vallorn, and Highborn priests were urged to keep supporting the fight there.

Zenith.t: Urizen's assembly called for the Druj to be driven from Zenith. A General Assembly mandate urging pilgrimage to Zenith was upheld but blocked by the Wisdom assembly and the sword scholars.

383YE Autumn Equinox interlude.d: The Imperial Guerdon stood at 175 Thrones, shared among units supporting the Raid on Ikka's Tears, Green Shield, Red Wind Corsairs, Tusks, Granite Pillar, Strong Reeds and Northern Eagle. Units fighting in Segura earned 5 crowns from the Freeborn. New opportunities included slowing the vallorn in Brocéliande, a stealth raid on the Pride of Ikka's Tears and a spy network in Ossium. Fleets faced sanctions on Asavea and Nemoria, the closed Iron Confederacy and Jarmish tariffs, and could also evacuate refugees from Aracossa or Telios. Mandates removed the grey pilgrims' penalties in eight nations, but not in Dawn. Other mandates imposed costs to aid the Sand Fishers, let Tharim feast on Navarr lands, and boosted Varushkan mines and congregations opposing idolatry.

Dawn.t: Dawnish captains received extra rewards for helping to slow the vallorn in Brocéliande. Dawn alone kept the grey pilgrims' penalty of 2 votes and 1 liao on its congregations after its assembly chose a different course.

Grendel.t: Grendel pillaging in Feroz left every resource there 2 ranks down. Any further Grendel raids would now meet protective magic that prevented more losses.

Highguard.t: Highborn congregations lost 2 votes and 1 liao because of the Blade of the Pilgrims call to aid Brocéliande. The grey pilgrims' penalty on them was lifted.

Imperial Orcs.t: Following Skywise Rykana's mandate to aid the Sand Fishers, every Imperial Orc congregation, farm, business, herb garden, forest, mine, mana site and fleet suffered a one-rank production penalty until the Winter Solstice 383YE.

Jotun.t: Mentioned in passing: any plunder by the Lasambrian Jotun in Segura would have no effect on personal resources, thanks to protective magic.

Navarr.t: Every Navarr herb garden lost 2 random herbs per season for a year under the Blood and Gold mandate. Tharim's feast also struck herb gardens and forests in Miaren, Therunin and Hercynia, though the grey pilgrims' penalty was removed.

The Brass Coast.t: The Freeborn paid 5 crowns to each unit defending Segura, and Freeborn fleet captains who traded suffered a -1 production rank after a privateering mandate. Resources in Feroz were also 2 ranks down from Grendel raids, while the grey pilgrims' penalty was lifted.

The League.t: Holberg's citizens took a one-rank production penalty to aid the Sand Fishers, while congregations in Tassato and Temeschwar gained votes and liao from the Reject False Gods mandate. The grey pilgrims' penalty on League congregations was removed.

The Marches.t: The grey pilgrims' penalty on Marcher congregations was removed. Good Leaf Gardens were created in Upwold in recognition of the Marches' sacrifice against the Liathaven vallorn.

Urizen.t: The grey pilgrims' penalty on Urizeni congregations was lifted. Congregations in Redoubt gained two votes and one liao for as long as the Synod opposed idolatry.

Varushka.t: Varushkan mines and forests produced one rank higher until the Spring Equinox 384YE, and Karsk's congregations gained extra votes and liao. The grey pilgrims' penalty was removed.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark captains joining the raid on the Pride of Ikka's Tears gained courage and morale worth two extra ranks for two seasons. Hahnmark congregations gained votes and liao, and the grey pilgrims' penalty was lifted.

383YE Autumn Equinox interlude.o: A temporary out-of-character summary was published after the 383YE Summer Solstice, setting out the effects on military units, fleets and other personal resources ahead of the Autumn Equinox downtime. These effects stemmed from mandates, Senate decisions, foreign sanctions and magic.

Holberg/Misericorde.t: The Sand Fishers, the new inhabitants of Misericorde, gained significantly from Imperial Orc and Holberg support, which cemented good relations with the people of the city.

Brocéliande.t: Military units could help the steadings slow the vallorn's expansion here for a season, while Highborn congregations and Tharim's feast were both committed to the fight for the territory.

Feroz.t: All personal resources in Feroz suffered a 2-rank penalty from earlier Grendel pillaging, but protective magic now guarded against further losses. Its Asavean temple was noted as a symbol of cooperation.

Hahnmark.t: Congregations in Hahnmark gained two votes and one liao while the Synod clearly opposed idolatry, as the Asavean architect's buildings there were forcibly redesigned.

Hercynia.t: Every herb garden in Hercynia lost two random herbs and every forest two resources until the Winter Solstice 383YE, as Tharim feasted in return for aiding Brocéliande.

Holberg.t: Every congregation, farm, business, herb garden, forest, mine, mana site and fleet in Holberg suffered a one-rank penalty until the Winter Solstice 383YE to support the Sand Fishers.

Karsk.t: Congregations in Karsk received four extra votes and two extra liao for a year, then the same bonus as the other territories with redesigned buildings.

Liathaven.t: An Imperial spy network continued in Liathaven. Units that had helped remove its vallorn suffered a 2-rank penalty until the Winter Solstice 383YE.

Miaren.t: Herb gardens and forests in Miaren suffered reduced production until the Winter Solstice 383YE because of Tharim's feast.

Ossium.t: The Empire now had a spy network in Ossium, which any military unit could support in return for copies of its reports and maps.

Redoubt.t: Congregations in Redoubt gained two votes and one liao for as long as the Synod maintained a clear stance against idolatry.

Segura.t: Units supporting the armies engaged in Segura, namely the Bounders, the Tusks and the Strong Reeds, each received 5 crowns from the Freeborn. Protective magic continued to shield Segura from raids on personal resources.

Sermersuaq.t: Imperial captains could launch a stealthy raid on the Pride of Ikka's Tears mithril mine, freeing 50 thralls for every thousand points of strength committed.

Tassato.t: Congregations in Tassato gained two votes and one liao under the Reject False Gods mandate enacted by Rafael Barossa di Tassato.

Temeschwar.t: Congregations in Temeschwar gained two votes and one liao while the Synod stood against idolatry.

Therunin.t: Herb gardens and forests in Therunin suffered reduced production until the Winter Solstice 383YE as Tharim feasted on them.

Upwold.t: Good Leaf Gardens were created in Upwold to honour the Marches' sacrifice against the Liathaven vallorn, paid for by losses to Navarr herb gardens.

383YE Autumn Equinox winds of fortune.d: After the Summer Solstice the Throne and the Imperial Magus vanished, and the Constitutional Court declared both posts vacant. Skathe's agents shattered Sarvos's mirrors and ruined Holmauer Park in Holberg. In Brocéliande the vallorn tide was weathered and driven back, but the Heirs of Terunael are gathering in Therunin, Hercynia and Liathaven. The Grendel advanced in Feroz. The Marchers face the hateful Whittle folk, and Ossium is being settled while its foreign orcs' future is debated. Other news covers the Bourse, the sword scholars' return, the Three Watchers statues, Dawnish troubadours in Highguard, the Hylje, the Briar question, and trade and diplomacy with foreign powers.

Dawn.t: Dawnish troubadours travelled to Highguard to teach glory and love, giving Dawn its own answer to the grey pilgrims. The national assembly is also offered Bourse opportunities, and Dawn is tagged in the Fall of Brocéliande.

Druj.t: The Druj threaten the Sand Fishers in Holberg, and two more of their miasma pillars were found in Ossium. They failed to stop the Temple of the Winds being finished in Morrow.

Grendel.t: The Grendel made significant advances in Feroz. Freeborn corsairs have identified four possible targets for a raid against them.

Highguard.t: Highguard welcomed Dawnish troubadours, and Virtue's Rest was completed, though it needs the proposed White Roads to work at full effect. The Sign of Tamar in Reikos is being lost to the wilderness, and Koboldi carved three giant statues of Highborn soldiers in Urizen.

Imperial Orcs.t: Imperial Orc preachers have been invited to speak to the foreign orcs of Ossium, some of whom might be moved to Skarsind. The nation faces a range of pressing orc affairs and Bourse opportunities.

Jotun.t: The Marchers continue to bring the Jotun thralls of the Mournwold into their nation, while the Whittle folk refuse to celebrate the Wassail alongside them.

Navarr.t: The curse Wither the Seed now lies on both Liathaven and Brocéliande, and the vallorn was repelled in Brocéliande. The Heirs of Terunael are gathering to drive vallornspawn into a frenzy, and most Navarr remain uneasy about briars despite their assembly's statement.

The Brass Coast.t: The Segura defence scheme may be extended to Feroz after Grendel advances there, and corsairs await a raid target from the Freeborn Assembly. The Zemress seminary was completed.

The League.t: Skathe's curses struck Sarvos and Holberg, Temeschwar was spared direct harm, and Tassato's politicians brought forward proposals. The Imperatrix herself, Lisabetta Giacomi von Holberg, vanished.

The Marches.t: The Marcher assembly has demanded that the Hate-filled Whittle folk recant as part of efforts to unite with the Mournwold's former Jotun thralls, and a painful next step looms.

Thule.t: Mentioned in passing: the orcs of Otkodov are listed among the foreign orcs bordering the Empire, and an Ambassador to Otkodov is tagged.

Urizen.t: The sword scholars' Temple of the Winds was completed in Morrow, and the Three Watchers statues now honour the Highborn who died defending Urizen. A celestial alignment offers the nation opportunities for transformation.

Varushka.t: Varushkan vales are spreading across newly conquered Ossium, and the national assembly welcomed Imperial Orc preachers there. Varushkans are uneasy about the assembly's call for Loyalty to briars.

Wintermark.t: Suaq bands have reached out to the hylje, and a hylje representative is coming to Anvil to renew oaths of friendship with the people of Wintermark.

383YE Autumn Equinox winds of fortune.o: The Winds of Fortune for the 383YE Autumn Equinox gathered the season's news: the disappearance of Imperatrix Lisabetta and the Imperial Magus, the Hag Queen's curses on the League cities, the vallorn being driven back in Brocéliande, Grendel advances in Feroz and the settlement of newly conquered Ossium.

Brocéliande/Boar's Dell.t: The vallorn's push into Boar's Dell was weathered and driven back.

Brocéliande/Elerael.t: The vallorn's push into Elerael was weathered and driven back.

Holberg/Holmauer.t: Holmauer Park was ruined by a malignant curse unleashed by the Hag Queen's agents.

Holberg/Misericorde.t: The Sand Fishers of Misericorde are threatened by the Druj, and their fate will sway the orcs of Ossium.

Ossium/Bittershore.t: New Varushkan vales are being established here.

Ossium/Drownbark Forest.t: Only the most adventurous settlers are moving into the Drownbark Forest.

Ossium/Echofell.t: Few Varushkans are interested in settling in Echofell.

Ossium/Galath Fields.t: New Varushkan vales are being established across the Galath Fields.

Ossium/Nearweald.t: Few Varushkans are interested in settling in Nearweald.

Ossium/Webwood.t: The Conclave declared that the nest here belongs to Arhallogen, so settlers are advised to avoid the area around its temple.

Brocéliande.t: The vallorn's peak assault was weathered and driven back, giving a respite. The territory now lies under the long-lasting curse Wither the Seed, and briars there reported peculiar dreams.

Feroz.t: The Grendel have made significant advances here, and there is a proposal to extend the Segura defence scheme to Feroz.

Hercynia.t: The Silent Bell found the Heirs of Terunael gathering in force here, poised to drive vallornspawn into a murderous frenzy.

Holberg.t: A curse from the Hag Queen's agents ruined Holmauer Park, though the citizens see opportunity in the disaster. The Sand Fishers living here are threatened by the Druj.

Karsk.t: Mentioned in passing: Belakov, Wolf of Karsk, raised the Varushkan statement welcoming Imperial Orc preachers to Ossium.

Liathaven.t: The territory suffers under Wither the Seed, and the Heirs of Terunael are gathering here. A new weirwood grove has been discovered.

Madruga.t: The Zemress seminary in Calvos was completed, and Sumaah präster intend to supply copies of the exemplar's life and works.

Miaren.t: Mentioned in passing: its citizens are tagged in the Tassato news alongside those of Tassato.

Morrow.t: The sword scholars' Temple of the Winds was completed here. Three immense statues of Highborn soldiers now guard the pass from Morrow to Zenith.

Mournwold.t: The Marchers are working to bring in the Jotun thralls here, while the Hate-filled village of Whittle faces demands to recant or face the consequences.

Ossium.t: A spy network mapped the territory and found two more Druj miasma pillars, and settlement is spreading. The Senate must decide whether its foreign orcs stay or move, and the Bitter Vats in Lomaa burned.

Otkodov.t: Mentioned in passing: its orcs are listed among the foreign orcs bordering the Empire, and an Ambassador to Otkodov is tagged.

Reikos.t: The Sign of Tamar is being reclaimed by the wilderness and will be lost by Spring without further action. The White Roads would benefit those building homes here.

Sarvos.t: Skathe's agents shattered every mirror in the city, leaving its people fearing an imminent DOOM. A conjunction leads into the sewers.

Segura.t: Locals' contributions to defence succeeded in drawing military units, though no fighting took place and no more territory was lost.

Sermersuaq.t: Conjunctions arise here, and Suaq bands have discussed the territory's sorry state with the hylje.

Skarsind.t: The foreign orcs of Ossium could be encouraged to move here, escorted by the Eastern Sky, if the Senate so chooses.

Spiral.t: Mentioned in passing: conjunctions this season reach into the wild lands of Spiral.

Tassato.t: Tassato's politicians brought forward proposals on the Imperial Consul, Seren and the Whittle folk.

Temeschwar.t: The Hag Queen's agents did not directly harm the city, but its citizens feel the insult to the League.

Therunin.t: The Heirs of Terunael are gathering in force here to stir the vallornspawn into a frenzy.

Zenith.t: The three Highborn statues carved by koboldi stand guard over the pass from Morrow into Zenith, commemorating the fight against the Druj.

383YE Autumn Equinox winds of war.d: Three Marcher armies held Segura without a fight, and the Jotun withdrew from Serra Damata without contesting it. In Feroz, five Imperial armies clashed with Grendel marines, the Naguerro and the Iron Gulls, with heavy losses on both sides; Fontargenta fell and the territory with it. The Grendel took Apstrus and Apulian, so Spiral is no longer Imperial. Over twenty thousand Druj pressed into Utterlund, while the Jotun conquered North Fens and Grey Fens. The Ikka's Tears raid freed two hundred thralls, seized the mithril and collapsed the mine. Brocéliande held, aided by Druj warbands sent by Arhallogen. The Military Council must choose two of four Sentinel Gate opportunities: Bregasland, Brocéliande, Feroz or Holberg.

Dawn.t: Many Dawnish knights errant fought the vallorn in Brocéliande, though some turned away in disgust at fighting beside the Druj. Dawnish champions also formed a creditable part of the raid on Ikka's Tears.

Druj.t: A Druj force of more than twenty thousand invaded Holberg and came close to claiming Utterlund. The Druj still hold Screed and Ossuary in Spiral, while fifty Druj warbands sworn to Arhallogen fought the vallorn and now retreat exposed through Boar's Dell.

Grendel.t: The Grendel conquered Feroz, landed two fresh armies including the Naguerro and the Iron Gulls, and seized the Celesti Lighthouse. They also took Apstrus and Apulian in Spiral, although the Black Plateau took its toll on their troops.

Highguard.t: The Seventh Wave and the Granite Pillar fought in Feroz, where the Pillar repelled the assault on Mora's Rock. The Valiant Pegasus held Elerael against the vallorn, and Highborn champions joined the raid on Ikka's Tears.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Winter Sun and the Green Shield marched into Kahraman and found that the Jotun had already withdrawn. Imperial Orc warbands were among the most numerous defenders of Brocéliande, and the nation is helping the Sand Fishers settle in Holberg.

Jotun.t: The Jotun abandoned Serra Damata and made no push in Segura, but under the Southern Bear and the Bear-Who-Swims they conquered North Fens and Grey Fens in Bregasland. They lost a season's mithril and around two hundred thralls when the mine at Ikka's Tears was raided and collapsed.

Navarr.t: Brocéliande's steadings survived the vallorn's worst onslaught, and Dark Ranging may now be freed. The Black Thorns and the Quiet Step fought hard against the Grendel in Feroz.

The Brass Coast.t: The Freeborn lost Feroz to the Grendel but saw Kahraman made wholly Imperial again and Segura spared further loss. The hakima of Afar are seeking heroes to protect a Night working that could call thousands to fight for Feroz.

The League.t: Holberg was invaded by a vast Druj force. The city's great walls kept its people safe, but the surrounding regions are threatened and fouled by corrupt Spring rain.

The Marches.t: The Tusks, the Bounders and the Strong Reeds held Segura unopposed, but at home the Jotun took two regions of Bregasland. Defiant yeofolk are making a stand at Bill Sabbey, and saving it could rally a Marcher militia.

Urizen.t: Spiral is no longer Imperial and its senator has lost their seat. The Citadel Guard will decline and the Doyen of the Spires' rate of codification has fallen. Urizen warbands supported the Granite Pillar in Feroz.

Varushka.t: The Northern Eagle helped hold the line in Elerael against the vallorn at a heavy cost. Varushkan engineers helped collapse the mine at Ikka's Tears.

Wintermark.t: The Fist of the Mountains made the raid on Ikka's Tears a full success, freeing Winterfolk thralls and gaining an advantage in Suaq Fount. The Sussivari Frost Coven's Night magic kept the Jotun from taking more of Bregasland.

383YE Autumn Equinox winds of war.o: In the run-up to the 383YE Autumn Equinox, Feroz fell to the Grendel and Spiral ceased to be Imperial, while the Jotun seized two regions of Bregasland and a Druj host invaded Holberg. The Empire also liberated Kahraman, held Segura, raided the Jotun mithril mine at Ikka's Tears and threw back the vallorn's great surge in Brocéliande.

Bregasland/Grey Fens.t: Thinly populated and far from the protective Night magic, Grey Fens fell swiftly to more than thirty thousand Jotun.

Bregasland/North Fens.t: The Sussivari's Night magic and the marsh beasts stalled the Bear-Who-Swims. Then thirty thousand more Jotun arrived, Greywater fell and the region was conquered.

Bregasland/Ottermire.t: The yeofolk of Ottery, Sallow and Graven Rock are making a defiant stand at Bill Sabbey. Heroes may defend it through the Sentinel Gate to rally the Marches.

Brocéliande/Boar's Dell.t: Withering Winter magic was laid over the region, and five thousand Druj sworn to Arhallogen fought the vallorn here. Their retreat at the Gouged Oaks offers heroes a chance to strike.

Brocéliande/Dark Ranging.t: The vallorn's exhaustion has left Dark Ranging exposed. A swift strike might free it and open a corridor along Brocéliande's western border.

Brocéliande/Elerael.t: The Valiant Pegasus and the Northern Eagle held Elerael against the climactic onslaught, though nearly a thousand soldiers were lost.

Brocéliande/Greenweald.t: Mentioned in passing: Druj scouts and guerrillas were seen as far east as the Greenweald.

Brocéliande/Terunael.t: Mentioned in passing: Terunael appears only in references to the fallen nation, the Scions of Terunael and the vallorn that devoured it.

Feroz/Afarjasse.t: Iron Gulls and Naguerro magicians are marching on Afar to stop its hakima's Night working. Heroes may intercept them through the Sentinel Gate.

Feroz/Fontargenta.t: Grendel marines secured the last of Fontargenta, and its fall carried the whole territory with it.

Feroz/Morajasse.t: Imperial armies massed here, and the Granite Pillar drove off a Grendel assault on the newly built Mora's Rock. The Grendel now hold a fingerhold in the region.

Feroz/Oranseri.t: Grendel ships landed two new armies here. Brief Imperial gains in the region were lost within weeks.

Holberg/Ennerlund.t: Druj scouts and saboteurs probed Ennerlund's mines but fell back when resisted. The lone survivor of a lost patrol was found near the Great Pits.

Holberg/Holfried.t: People living outside the walls took refuge in the upper city of Holfried as the garrison mobilised.

Holberg/Holmauer.t: Residents of this district outside the walls abandoned their homes for the safety of Holfried.

Holberg/Misericorde.t: Elite Druj arkad are closing on the Sand Fisher settlements in Misericorde. A Sentinel Gate conjunction could put heroes in their way.

Holberg/Rebeshof.t: Stealthy Druj scouts were reported in Rebeshof's marshes, threatening its farmers and herbalists.

Holberg/Utterlund.t: The Druj are nearly three quarters of the way to claiming Utterlund, leaving the mutilated bodies of captured scouts along the forest edge.

Hordalant/Blutgahn.t: Mentioned in passing: Jotun champions raid out of the Blutgahn marshes into Grey Fens.

Kahraman/Braydon's Jasse.t: The Winter Sun and the Green Shield marched through a mountain pass here, and the cheering garrison of Fort Braydon greeted them as relief.

Kahraman/Serra Damata.t: The Jotun withdrew before eleven thousand Imperial troops arrived, leaving only a Bear-Who-Swims banner and taking no thralls.

Kallavesa/Kallavesa Marsh.t: Mentioned in passing: armies can only reach Kallavesa Marsh by going through Mitwold.

Kallavesa/West Marsh.t: Mentioned in passing: armies can travel from West Marsh into North Fens.

Liathaven/Liath's Ring.t: Mentioned in passing: a new beachhead here is one way for Imperial armies to reach western Liathaven.

Liathaven/Liaven's Glen.t: Mentioned in passing: a new beachhead here is one way for Imperial armies to reach western Liathaven.

Liathaven/West Ranging.t: With Grey Fens in Jotun hands, Imperial armies cannot reach West Ranging without crossing Jotun land or first establishing a new beachhead.

Liathaven/Westwood.t: With Grey Fens in Jotun hands, Imperial armies cannot reach Westwood without crossing Jotun land or first establishing a new beachhead.

Segura/Anduzjasse.t: The Lasambrian Jotun remained in Anduzjasse while Marcher armies planted their standards along its borders.

Segura/Anozeseri.t: The Jotun kept their hold on western Anozeseri's settlements and made some progress in conquering the contested region.

Segura/Iron Plains.t: A few minor, inconclusive skirmishes took place along the boundary of the Iron Plains.

Segura/Sobral Grasses.t: The Iron Qanat was raised in the Sobral Grasses, and caravans crossed the grasslands without interruption.

Segura/Yellow Chase.t: A few minor, inconclusive skirmishes took place along the boundary of Yellow Chase.

Sermersuaq/Suaq Fount.t: The raiders landed here with hylje help and sank their boats. The Empire now has a strategic advantage in Suaq Fount, including no beachhead penalty for attacking it.

Spiral/Ankra.t: Ankra remains in Imperial hands, and its people focus on defending their spires.

Spiral/Apstrus.t: The Grendel conquered the thinly peopled region unopposed, overrunning or besieging its remaining spires.

Spiral/Apulus.t: Grendel forces took Apulian and set up a command post there, forcing Imperial troops back. The Druj also contest the region.

Spiral/Ateri.t: Ateri remains in Imperial hands, and its people focus on defending their spires.

Spiral/Cinion.t: Cinion remains in Imperial hands, and its people focus on defending their spires.

Spiral/Ossuary.t: Ossuary remains under Druj control.

Spiral/Screed.t: Screed remains under Druj control. The Iron Gulls are survivors of the catastrophe that followed when its heart was roused.

The Barrens/Farweald.t: Mentioned in passing: the Druj crossed into Holberg over the river from Farweald.

Bay of Catazar.t: Mentioned in passing: a Corsair general's call to arms recalls the Empire bloodying the Grendel in the Bay of Catazar.

Bregasland.t: The Jotun conquered North Fens and Grey Fens. The territory remains Imperial but will fall if one more region is lost.

Brocéliande.t: The vallorn's final, most violent attempt to expand was broken, leaving Boar's Dell, Elerael and the Broch in Navarr hands. Dark Ranging may now be retaken, but every unit that fought here suffered grievous wounds.

Feroz.t: Feroz fell to the Grendel when Fontargenta was taken, and is no longer an Imperial territory. Heavy fighting cost both sides around three thousand dead.

Holberg.t: More than twenty thousand Druj invaded and nearly claimed Utterlund, held back only by the city's walls. They now hunt the Sand Fishers while a foul Spring rain poisons the territory.

Hordalant.t: Mentioned in passing: Jotun champions raiding out of its Blutgahn marshes help explain why few Bregas live in Grey Fens.

Kahraman.t: Imperial Orc armies relieved Fort Braydon, and the Jotun withdrew from Serra Damata, leaving Kahraman entirely Imperial once more.

Kalino.t: Mentioned in passing: the Naguerro once lived in Kalino before the Iron Confederacy defeated them.

Kallavesa.t: Mentioned in passing: half the Fist of the Mountains rested here, and its regions are named as army routes into Bregasland.

Liathaven.t: The Black Thorns marched out to Feroz. With Grey Fens lost, Imperial armies can no longer reach West Ranging or Westwood without crossing Jotun-held land or first establishing a new beachhead.

Madruga.t: Mentioned in passing: Imperial heroes stopped the Grendel seizing the Scorrero crossing between Madruga and Oranseri.

Mareave.t: Mentioned in passing: the Grendel set up a command post near a major pass from Spiral into Mareave.

Mitwold.t: Mentioned in passing: the Tusks marched from Mitwold, the breadbasket's bounty is to be spread there, and armies must pass through it to reach Ottermire.

Morrow.t: Mentioned in passing: worried messages from Spiral's remaining citizens reach their cousins in Morrow.

Mournwold.t: Mentioned in passing: the Red Wind Corsairs marched from Mournwold, and Mournwold orcs offered supplies to the Marchers in Bregasland.

Ossium.t: Mentioned in passing: the Druj seek to punish the Sand Fishers for leaving Ossium, and the orcs of Ossium will hear how the Empire responds.

Redoubt.t: Mentioned in passing: worried messages from Spiral's remaining citizens reach their cousins in Redoubt.

Reikos.t: Mentioned in passing: freeing Dark Ranging would open safer passage between Reikos and Semmerholm.

Reinos.t: Mentioned in passing: the Jotun withdrew from Serra Damata back into Reinos.

Segura.t: Three Marcher armies held Segura, but the Jotun did not attack, and only minor skirmishes followed. The Lasambrian Jotun keep Anduzjasse and have made progress in Anozeseri.

Semmerholm.t: Mentioned in passing: freeing Dark Ranging would open safer passage between Reikos and Semmerholm.

Sermersuaq.t: Imperial raiders crossed to Suaq Fount, sacked and collapsed the mithril mine at Ikka's Tears, freed two hundred thralls and mapped Jotun dispositions across the tundra.

Skarsind.t: Mentioned in passing: some raiders escaped Sermersuaq through the passes into Skarsind.

Spiral.t: The Grendel took Apstrus and Apulian, leaving only three regions in Imperial hands, so Spiral is no longer Imperial. Its remaining people huddle in their spires.

Tassato.t: Mentioned in passing: the spirits brewed at Bill Sabbey are popular as far afield as Tassato.

The Barrens.t: The Druj warbands aiding Brocéliande came from the armies camped in the Barrens. Striking them as they retreat could force those armies onto the defensive and inflict heavy casualties.

Upwold.t: Mentioned in passing: the Keeper of the Breadbasket will spread its bounty across Upwold among other Marcher territories.

Zenith.t: Mentioned in passing: the Druj had retreated into Zenith after their earlier push into Spiral.

383YE Spring Equinox Synod judgements.d: No change of doctrine, veto or recognition was sought. The General Assembly agreed not to uphold new recognitions or doctrinal changes for up to a year while talks with Sumaah continue. Many assemblies criticised or defended the Grey Pilgrims. Enacted mandates sent citizens to repurpose the idols of Almodin Oktístis, resettled Zenith's refugees, rewarded those guiding freed Dubhtraig orcs to Skarsind, and opened Marcher billets to Imperial armies. Medea Ruth was condemned for heresy. Several inquisitions were called, including one into the Senator for Temeschwar. Viviane de Coeurdefer and Ser Ancél Watcher became Cardinals of Ambition and Vigilance. The virtue fund closed at 36 Thrones, 6 Crowns and 15 Rings.
