Varushka.t: Raskylov's mandate raised Varushkan mine and forest production by one rank until the Spring Equinox 384YE. Congregations in Karsk received four extra votes and two liao for a year.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark units that raided the Pride of Ikka's Tears gained a two-rank effectiveness bonus for two seasons under Rafe's mandate. Hahnmark congregations gained votes and liao.

383YE Winter Solstice interlude.o: Ahead of the 383YE Winter Solstice, a summary set out the effects of the Autumn Equinox on military units, trade and national resources. These included Synod mandates, foreign trade conditions and the Imperial Guerdon.

Brocéliande.t: Although Brocéliande's vallorn had grown quiescent, Highborn congregations were called to keep opposing it. The Conclave also accepted Tharim's aid in defending the territory.

Feroz.t: The Grendel conquerors of Feroz claimed the Temple of Balo and the Black Bull there. Imperial traders lost the advantage it had given them with Asavean merchants.

Hahnmark.t: Congregations in Hahnmark gained two votes and one liao, swelled with pride by the anti-idolatry redesign of Asavean-built buildings.

Hercynia.t: Tharim was permitted to feast on Hercynia's herb gardens and forests, costing each two herbs or resources for the next year. Protect Hercynia was among the opportunities sharing the Guerdon.

Holberg.t: Highborn businesses took a production penalty to support purifying Holberg's waters, fouled by the curse that devastated its gardens. A mandate for Marcher pilgrimage there failed.

Karsk.t: Congregations in Karsk received four extra votes and two liao for a year, then the lesser anti-idolatry bonus thereafter.

Liathaven.t: Mentioned in passing: the Marchers' sacrifice in fighting the vallorn of Liathaven was the reason Good Leaf Gardens were supported in Upwold.

Miaren.t: Tharim was permitted to feast on Miaren's herb gardens and forests, costing each two herbs or resources for the next year.

Redoubt.t: Congregations in Redoubt gained two votes and one liao for as long as the Synod clearly stands against idolatry.

Tassato.t: Congregations in Tassato gained two votes and one liao for as long as the Synod clearly stands against idolatry.

Temeschwar.t: Congregations in Temeschwar gained two votes and one liao for as long as the Synod clearly stands against idolatry.

Therunin.t: Tharim was permitted to feast on Therunin's herb gardens and forests, costing each two herbs or resources for the next year.

Upwold.t: Good Leaf Gardens were created in Upwold, paid for by reduced Navarr herb production, in recognition of the Marchers' fight against the vallorn.

Zenith.t: Mentioned in passing: a judgement encouraging citizens to travel to Zenith and offer aid failed because of the Wisdom assembly's intervention.

383YE Winter Solstice winds of fortune.d: The ceding of Ankra, Cinion, Ateri, Morajasse and Afarjasse to the Grendel left Freeborn and Urizeni citizens facing hard choices, while the orcs pressed for trade despite Liberty Pact sanctions. The Wisdom assembly and the sword scholars continued to obstruct Synod mandates, and several failed as a result. Varushka was urged to settle Ossium, and the Imperial Orcs eyed the Barrens. The Thule approached Sealtoq with a proposition, and the Navarr sought to lift Wither the Seed. Sarvos became the City of Masks. The Synod rebuked prejudice against briars. The Dawnish Eastern Sky drove the Druj from Holberg, and vallornspawn ran rampant in Liathaven.

Dawn.t: Dawnish troubadours were offered a chapel and ways to support questing knights, and the Eastern Sky drove the last Druj out of Holberg. Dawn must also decide how to respond to the Imperial Orc claim on the Barrens, which it has long fought over.

Druj.t: The Druj were driven from Ennerlund back into the Mallum, and they are on the back foot in the Forest of Ulnak. They now face an Imperial Orc ambition to take the Barrens, though they still threaten Ossium.

Grendel.t: The Grendel consolidated uncontested control of Feroz and the ceded Spiral regions. Their governors made offers to the remaining Imperial citizens and the Citadel Guard, and their merchants sought trade despite Liberty Pact sanctions.

Highguard.t: Highguard's assembly weighed three memorial opportunities, including a new purpose for Empress Britta's shrine. Its three armies gained the Crusade order, and it shared inspiration with Dawn over freeing the Dark Ranging.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Imperial Orcs were offered ways to press their claim to the Barrens, and Ossean septs arriving in Skarsind hold the promise of a third army. Their interests also feature in the plight of the freed orcs of Axos.

Jotun.t: The Jotun rebuffed Imperial attempts to retake Sermersuaq, and the arrangement keeping them out of Sealtoq is running out. Heroes may face them through Sentinel Gate conjunctions in Bregasland and Sermersuaq.

Navarr.t: The vates answered the call to find ways of lifting Wither the Seed, which is withering the Navarr of Brocéliande. The nation also faces a chance to end the threat of the Heirs of Terunael once and for all.

The Brass Coast.t: The Freeborn of Afarjasse and Morajasse looked to the Synod on whether to stay, resist or flee Grendel rule. Priests visited the Isle of the Osseini, and the Freeborn Assembly declared solidarity with the sword scholars.

The League.t: Sarvos faced doom as it reinvented itself as the City of Masks. The College of Engineering offered the Chair of the Wolf, and the League was asked how it might further help the Sand Fishers of Holberg.

The Marches.t: Marchers debated what to do about Whittle and the Mournwold thralls, and how to protect the nation from future Imperial curses. A thresher concluded that the Singing Caves raiders were the Alderly feni, who were apparently defeated.

Thule.t: The Thule, who hold the Silver Peaks, abandoned their watchful stance and sent a delegation under a flag of truce to Sealtoq with a proposition for Wintermark.

Urizen.t: Urizeni groups offered rituals for Urizen lore in return for favours, and the Grendel governor of Spiral made offers to the remaining citizens and the faltering Citadel Guard. The Urizen Assembly backed the sword scholars and was given chances to work with the eternals of five realms.

Varushka.t: Varushka's national assembly called for settlers, wagon raiders and wardens to tame underdeveloped Ossium. The civil service surveyed the territory's wealth and its new sinecures, and a Varushkan market was proposed.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark sought more healing herbs through the grimnir's practical proposals, and a trading hall was proposed there. The nation also received a Thule offer at Sealtoq, and its stories hint at a magical horn behind the youthful growth spurts.

383YE Winter Solstice winds of fortune.o: The Winter Solstice 383YE Winds of Fortune gathered the season's news across the Empire. The fallout of the Grendel peace treaty in Spiral and Feroz, a memory-eroding fog, sudden ageing among the young, koboldi building offers, the settlement of Ossium and many national opportunities were all set out ahead of the summit.

Brocéliande/Dark Ranging.t: The Dawnish and Highborn assemblies backed efforts to free the Dark Ranging from the vallorn before it recovers its strength.

Feroz/Afarjasse.t: Ceded to the Grendel, Afarjasse's remaining Freeborn looked to the Synod on whether to cooperate, resist or flee.

Feroz/Cazar Straits.t: Corsair families of nearby Shantarim made an offer that may especially appeal to Brass Coast privateers.

Feroz/Morajasse.t: Ceded to the Grendel, Morajasse's remaining Freeborn sought the Synod's guidance on how to face their new orc overlords.

Holberg/Ennerlund.t: The Eastern Sky drove the Druj out of Ennerlund and rooted out their hidden camps, securing the region by the Solstice.

Holberg/Holmauer.t: Holmauer Park remained blighted and infested with large rats, and the situation there was among the League's building opportunities.

Mournwold/Alderly.t: The feni of Alderly who accepted Agramant's offer of vengeance were identified as the Singing Caves raiders, apparently defeated by Imperial heroes.

Ossium/Nearweald.t: The civil service proposed a barracks-armoury in Nearweald to defend Ossium's new vales.

Reikos/Tamarbode.t: Tamarbode's Spring regio, Tamar's Toes and every other mana site vanished when the Garden of Llofir was destroyed, leaving little of value at the Sign of Tamar.

Sermersuaq/Sealtoq.t: The Empire's foothold in Sealtoq is running out of time against the Jotun, and a Thule delegation arrived there under a flag of truce.

Sermersuaq/Silver Peaks.t: The Thule who hold the Silver Peaks are no longer content to watch and have made a proposition to Wintermark.

Spiral/Ankra.t: Ceded to the Grendel, Ankra's citizens have two seasons to relocate, or may accept the governor's offer to stay and keep out of her affairs.

Spiral/Ateri.t: Ceded to the Grendel, Ateri's citizens face the choice between relocating within two seasons and staying under Mahiri Kaliact.

Spiral/Cinion.t: Ceded to the Grendel, Cinion's citizens weigh leaving with their possessions against the governor's offer of shared Prosperity if they stay.

Astolat.t: New homes amid Astolat's splendour were offered to the ancient cousins of the Freeborn lands, and strange visions were seen in the night sky over the territory.

Bastion.t: The Basilica of the Little Mother in Bastion was destroyed, a tragedy that gave rise to a sorrowful opportunity for the Synod.

Bregasland.t: A Sentinel Gate conjunction offered heroes the chance to fight the Jotun in Bregasland.

Brocéliande.t: Wither the Seed continued to sap the vallorn while devastating Navarr births in Brocéliande. Ways to lift the curse, support the knights questing against the vallorn and free the Dark Ranging were all set out.

Casinea.t: Mentioned in passing: a curse on Casinea, home of Anvil, was listed among the season's magical events.

Feroz.t: The orcs of the Broken Shore consolidated uncontested control of Feroz, leaving its remaining Freeborn to seek the Synod's guidance. Opportunities arose on the Isle of the Osseini.

Forest of Ulnak.t: Mentioned in passing: the Druj are described as on the back foot in the Forest of Ulnak.

Hahnmark.t: Mentioned in passing: the people of Hahnmark are named among those relevant to the koboldi building opportunities.

Holberg.t: The Druj were driven out of Holberg and the Sand Fishers there sought ways to leave fear behind. Building opportunities included Holmauer Park and the unclaimed Memorial Orchard.

Liathaven.t: Liathaven remained under Wither the Seed as the Heirs and vallornspawn ran rampant, attacking the few remaining Navarr steadings. Its resources suffered a penalty for a year, and the vallornspawn threaten any army that enters.

Miaren.t: Mentioned in passing: the people of Miaren are named among those relevant to the koboldi building opportunities.

Miekarova.t: Mentioned in passing: the people of Miekarova are named among those relevant to the koboldi building opportunities.

Morrow.t: An opportunity arose to solidify the Urizen Assembly's support for the sword scholars in Morrow.

Mournwold.t: The Silent Bell was sent to investigate the Whittle sect, and Marchers debated the fate of Whittle and the Mournwold thralls. Opportunities were offered to address both.

Ossium.t: A year after joining Varushka, underdeveloped and underpopulated Ossium drew calls for settlers. The civil service catalogued Druj spoils that will become new titles and proposed a port, a barracks-armoury and an extension to the Iron Roads.

Reikos.t: Graciana i Lòpez i Guerra appraised the Sign of Tamar in Reikos and submitted proposals for how the site might be preserved and used.

Sarvos.t: After the Hag Queen's curse shattered every mirror in Sarvos, the city chose reinvention as the City of Masks, though a threatened doom must first be overcome.

Semmerholm.t: A chapel for the troubadours was proposed in Semmerholm, and the Druj unexpectedly delivered a hundred Imperial citizens there, apparently at the Emissary of Mazen's say-so.

Sermersuaq.t: Attempts to retake Sermersuaq from the Jotun failed and the Sealtoq foothold is under threat. The Thule approached with a proposition, and conjunctions offered fights against the Jotun there.

Skarsind.t: Ossean orcs settled across Skarsind and new villages sprang up. Three proud septs held out for more, offering the promise of a third Imperial Orc army.

Spiral.t: With Ankra, Cinion and Ateri ceded, the Grendel governor Mahiri Kaliact invited citizens to stay and offered the Citadel Guard a proposal for its survival.

Tassato.t: Mentioned in passing: Tassato is tagged as especially interested in the Marcher discussions of Tend to the Flame.

Temeschwar.t: The aura of Mellfort in Temeschwar offered opportunities for reflection, and its people were named among those relevant to the koboldi building offers.

Upwold.t: Mentioned in passing: the people of Upwold are named among those relevant to the koboldi building opportunities.

Weirwater.t: The legacy of storytellers and musicians was discussed in Weirwater, and a chapel for the troubadours was proposed.

Zenith.t: Mentioned in passing: a mandate urging citizens to travel to Zenith and offer aid failed because of opposition from the Wisdom assembly and the sword scholars.

383YE Winter Solstice winds of war.d: Heroes and magic defeated the Heirs of Terunael in Hercynia and Therunin, leaving them unable to threaten either for a year, but Liathaven suffered badly. In Segura the Jotun lost Anozeseri, while the Grendel took Afarjasse, Morajasse and Moras Rock under the peace treaty. In Bregasland the Jotun were turned back amid the emergence of Mathilda Fisher. In Ulnak the Empire claimed about half of Oerwealt. In Zenith a cautious advance escaped a Druj trap and withdrew to Morrow. In Skarsind the Jotun were repulsed at Clattering Gully but threatened to seal Pakaanan's Pass. Sentinel Gate conjunctions to the Caida, Miresend, the Halls of Lutum and Pakaanan's Pass were identified.

Dawn.t: The Golden Sun, Hounds of Glory and Gryphon's Pride led the grim invasion of the Forest of Ulnak alongside Varushka, and a troubadour made the first peaceful contact with local orcs. Dawnish captains also fought in great numbers in Hercynia and Therunin.

Druj.t: The Druj lost around half of Oerwealt in Ulnak to the Empire, but in Zenith they sprang a trap from Proceris and Iteri that forced the Imperial armies back into Morrow. They are also reportedly gathering Urizeni prisoners at the Halls of Lutum.

Grendel.t: Under the peace treaty the Iron Gulls took Afarjasse, Morajasse and Moras Rock, giving the Grendel all of Feroz. Lord Rahab was appointed governor and plans to reopen Oran as a trading port.

Highguard.t: The Valiant Pegasus formed the backbone of the defence of Therunin, and Highborn vigilance foiled a plot to poison the orcs building the Holt of the Oak.

Imperial Orcs.t: Skarsind was invaded through Pakaanan's Pass and the garrison of the Will was slowly pushed back, and Jotun executed many orcs who refused the Choice. Elsewhere the Winter Sun led the advance in Segura and the Summer Storm fought in Bregasland.

Jotun.t: The Jotun had mixed fortunes. They were turned back in Bregasland with heavy losses while backing Mathilda Fisher, and the Lasambrians were driven from Anozeseri. They were repulsed at Clattering Gully but are carving runes to bring down Pakaanan's Pass.

Navarr.t: Navarr captains and vates defended Hercynia and Therunin, defeating the Heirs of Terunael at the cost of lives and production. Liathaven's remaining steadings were badly hit, and suspicion of briars grew. The Black Thorns fought in Segura.

The Brass Coast.t: Segura is being won back from the Lasambrian Jotun, but Feroz passed wholly to the Grendel, its Freeborn largely in bondage. Over fifteen hundred Fire of the South soldiers died defending Skarsind.

The League.t: The Towerjacks and the Wolves of War fought in Zenith, briefly securing spires in Clypion before holding the line against the Druj during the withdrawal to Morrow.

The Marches.t: Four Marcher armies helped turn back the Jotun in Bregasland, with the Strong Reeds flooding Jotun camps. Mathilda Fisher, a claimed heir of an old anti-Imperial household, is now calling Marchers to rise against the Empire.

Thule.t: The Thule at Crow's Keep refused to aid either side in Skarsind, citing their oaths. They offered to raise Spring magic to reduce orc deaths if the Imperial Orcs request it through the Ambassador to Otkodov.

Urizen.t: The Citadel Guard led the failed attempt to liberate Zenith but rescued many Urizeni during the withdrawal, and several hundred captive sentinels await rescue at the Halls of Lutum. Urizeni traitors of Greenfountain Spire aided the Heirs in Therunin.

Varushka.t: The Golden Axe spearheaded the advance into Ulnak, while the Northern Eagle and the merciless Iron Helms fought in Zenith. Varushkan cabalists of the Cabal of the Green Mother aided the Heirs of Terunael.

Wintermark.t: The Fist of the Mountains and the Blood Cloaks fought with honour in Bregasland. The Sussivari Frost Coven and the Eternal Family's citadel aided defences elsewhere, and the Will helped slow the Jotun in Skarsind.

383YE Winter Solstice winds of war.o: In the season before the 383YE Winter Solstice, Imperial forces turned back the Heirs of Terunael in Hercynia and Therunin but not in Liathaven, and pushed the Lasambrian Jotun back in Segura while ceding Feroz to the Grendel. They also halted the Jotun in Bregasland, advanced into the Druj Forest of Ulnak, failed to gain ground in Zenith, and held off a Jotun attack on Skarsind.

Bregasland/Grey Fens.t: Imperial forces struck deep into Grey Fens and are just short of halfway to pushing the Jotun out.

Bregasland/North Fens.t: It remains under Jotun control. Mathilda Fisher has raised her call from Fisher's Rock, and a conjunction offers a strike on the Yegarra near Miresend.

Bregasland/Ottermire.t: The Jotun were forced out. Locals helped the Strong Reeds open sluice gates to flood enemy camps under Sussivari mist-fortifications.

Bregasland/The Rushes.t: The Strong Reeds and the Bounders intercepted Jotun incursions here and forced the orcs to give up their positions.

Feroz/Afarjasse.t: Ceded to the Iron Gulls, who occupy the Spice Gardens worked by orc slaves; citizens may leave until the Summer Solstice.

Feroz/Cazar Straits.t: Its Freeborn remain effectively slaves of the Grendel, with orc sentinels punishing any who try to flee.

Feroz/Fontargenta.t: Its Freeborn remain in Grendel bondage and are barred from fleeing north or west.

Feroz/Morajasse.t: Ceded to the Iron Gulls, who took over the newly completed Moras Rock; citizens may leave until the Summer Solstice.

Feroz/Oranseri.t: Its Freeborn stay under Grendel control while Lord Rahab meets Asavean envoys at Oran and plans to reopen its port.

Forest of Ulnak/Oerwealt.t: The haunted, cursed Trackless Forest of the last Woodcreeper villages is half to three-fifths in Imperial hands, despite resistance from the Cassad Ûln garrison.

Hercynia/Deer's Folly.t: The vallorn heart here was roused by the Heirs, and ettercaps and vallornspawn spilled out to attack the rest of Hercynia.

Hercynia/Northpines.t: The Navarr here faced Heirs' agents rather than vallornspawn, aided by the Eternal Family's citadel of white stone and black ice; Jotun scouts also probed the area.

Hercynia/Old Ranging.t: The Voice of the Quiet Forest raised a magical fortress from its woodlands to help contain the vallornspawn.

Hercynia/Summersend.t: Spring magic twined a woodland fortress here as the territory resisted the vallorn's incursion.

Mitwold/Oddmire.t: Mentioned in passing: the Drakes crossed out of Oddmire into Bregasland.

Morrow/Caeli.t: Five Imperial armies marched down its passes beneath the Three Watchers into Zenith, and later withdrew back through them.

Morrow/Peregro.t: Traitorous magicians and sentinels of Greenfountain Spire in Peregro aided the Heirs of Terunael in Therunin.

Mournwold/Alderly.t: Mentioned in passing: Jonathan Thresher of Alderly is listed among the defenders of Hercynia.

Ossium/Echofell.t: Mentioned in passing: the four armies crossed its far borders to invade Ulnak.

Segura/Anozeseri.t: The Lasambrian Jotun lost their foothold here and fell back towards Anduzjasse.

Segura/Yellow Chase.t: Scouts found a large orc force in the hills to its south, digging at the Caida battleground, now reachable by a Sentinel Gate conjunction.

Sermersuaq/East Floes.t: Two Jotun armies and allied Yegarra surged from East Floes through Pakaanan's Pass into Skarsind.

Sermersuaq/Silver Peaks.t: Mentioned in passing: the only other army route from Skarsind runs through Crow's Ridge into the Silver Peaks, unlikely to be opened by the Thule.

Skarsind/Crow’s Ridge.t: The Thule garrison at Crow's Keep stayed neutral, and its pass is now the only alternative route to Sermersuaq.

Skarsind/Estermark.t: Jotun warbands raided as far as Estermark.

Skarsind/Gildermark.t: Jotun warbands raided here. The Fire of the South arrived with Ossium emigrants, now camped outside Gildenheim, in time to defend Clattering Gully.

Skarsind/Pakaanan's Pass.t: The Jotun are a little shy of halfway to conquering it and are carving runes to bring down the mountains, which a Sentinel Gate conjunction may let heroes stop.

Skarsind/Skogei Glens.t: The Will based here blunted the Jotun attacks, though its garrison was pushed back towards the Glens and faced probing strikes.

Therunin/East Ashes.t: The Sussivari Frost Coven's living mist shielded defenders here as marsh beasts attacked its steadings.

Therunin/Eastring.t: The Voice of the Quiet Forest raised a wooden fastness here, though its steadings were still attacked.

Therunin/Greenheart.t: Spore-crazed dire beetles and other abominations poured from this vallorn region as the Heirs sought to overrun Therunin.

Therunin/Lower Tarn Valley.t: The Great Forest Orcs and the Spears of the Pine defended their homes, and a plot to poison the builders of the Holt of the Oak was foiled.

Therunin/Peakedge Song.t: Imperial Orc patrols foiled a ritual to breach Peakedge Stead's gates, protecting its hospital, though vallornspawn still assailed its walls.

Therunin/Sweetglades.t: Its vallorn abominations were roused by the Heirs and the Greenfountain traitors in their attempt to overrun the territory.

Zenith/Clypion.t: Imperial armies briefly reclaimed half a dozen spires before withdrawing. A conjunction now offers a chance to destroy its miasma pillars and free prisoners at the Halls of Lutum.

Zenith/Iteri.t: Imperial scouts vanished here, and a second massive Druj force emerged from Iteri to strike the Imperial flank.

Zenith/Lustri.t: The Druj roused its dark, twisted forests with magic to protect their conquest.

Zenith/Proceris.t: The Druj quickened its marshes and hid a huge army in a western vale, which surged out against the Imperial eastern flank.

Ayereed.t: Mentioned in passing: its salt mines are where the Grendel threaten to send Freeborn of Feroz in reprisal for attacks.

Bay of Catazar.t: Mentioned in passing: it is not named directly, though Lord Rahab plans to reopen Oran to Asavean, Sarcophan and Imperial shipping.

Bregasland.t: Imperial armies stopped the Jotun advance eastward and pushed into Grey Fens, losing nearly four thousand soldiers to perhaps twice as many Jotun. Mathilda Fisher's messengers now reach villages across the territory.

Brocéliande.t: Mentioned in passing: the Spears of the Pine and the Northern Eagle came from fighting the Heirs there, and its briars' earlier dreams are recalled.

Casinea.t: Mentioned in passing: the Towerjacks set out from Casinea with the Citadel Guard for Zenith.

Feroz.t: The whole territory is now held by the Grendel under Lord Rahab. Citizens in Afarjasse and Morajasse have until the Summer Solstice to leave, while Freeborn elsewhere live under harsh rule.

Forest of Ulnak.t: Four Imperial armies invaded and claimed about half of Oerwealt despite miasma, traps and ghosts. Druj from the citadel of Cassad Ûln slowed them, and a new Druj army is rumoured in the east.

Hahnmark.t: Mentioned in passing: armies can still reach it through Hercynia if Pakaanan's Pass is lost.

Hercynia.t: Its roused vallorn and Heirs' agents attacked steadings and the Heartwood of the Great Vale, but heroes and magic narrowly saved Treji and defeated the Heirs' plans for at least a year.

Holberg.t: Mentioned in passing: Holberg Spring magicians joined the Towerjacks, and the League armies' years fighting the Druj there are noted.

Hordalant.t: Mentioned in passing: the Fishers reportedly lived in its marshes for four centuries, and Hordalanter fishermen are among the Yegarra in Bregasland.

Kahraman.t: Mentioned in passing: the Green Shields marched from Kahraman to Bregasland.

Kallavesa.t: Mentioned in passing: Wintermark armies came from Kallavesa, and hunters familiar with its marshes were in demand in Bregasland.

Karov.t: The Fire of the South's great column of Ossium orcs crossed Karov, steering clear of its darker places, with only a handful lost to monsters.

Karsk.t: The refugee column crossed Karsk under Freeborn escort; some vales offered hospitality while others closed their doors.

Liathaven.t: Unopposed, the Heirs likely achieved their aims. Steadings suffered near-catastrophic damage, production is penalised for a year, extra Treasury support is diverted, and vallornspawn infest the territory.

Madruga.t: Mentioned in passing: the Moras Rock garrison withdrew north into Madruga after surrendering the fortress.

Mitwold.t: Mentioned in passing: the Drakes crossed into Bregasland from Oddmire.

Morrow.t: Imperial armies marched from Morrow into Zenith and withdrew back to it to regroup. Traitors from Greenfountain Spire in Peregro aided the Heirs in Therunin.

Mournwold.t: Mentioned in passing: former Mournwold Yegarra, including Steven of Sarcombe, fight with the Jotun in Bregasland and invoke the curses of the Mourn.

Ossium.t: Around eight thousand Ossium orcs left with the Fire of the South for Skarsind, and the invasion of Ulnak was launched from Ossium's eastern borders.

Otkodov.t: Mentioned in passing: the Ambassador to Otkodov's word could secure Thule Spring magic for Skarsind.

Redoubt.t: Mentioned in passing: it sheltered Zenith refugees and lies beyond the high passes by which freed Halls of Lutum prisoners could escape.

Reikos.t: Mentioned in passing: the Druj miasma there is recalled as a precedent for Ulnak.

Reinos.t: Mentioned in passing: Lasambrian orcs are camped near its border, and the Black Thorns aim to drive them back into it.

Sarvos.t: Mentioned in passing: the Wolves of War marched from Sarvos to Zenith.

Segura.t: The Black Thorns, Winter Sun and Red Wind Corsairs drove the Lasambrian Jotun from Anozeseri and are about halfway to expelling them. The orcs now hold Anduz and dig at the Caida.

Semmerholm.t: Mentioned in passing: it is not named, though Dawn's earlier crossing of the Semmerlak by the Golden Causeway is recalled.

Sermersuaq.t: The Jotun launched their Skarsind attack from East Floes. If they seal Pakaanan's Pass, Imperial armies will be unable to reach Sermersuaq from Skarsind without Thule permission.

Skarsind.t: About fifteen thousand Jotun invaded and executed many orcs who refused the Choice. They were repulsed at Clattering Gully but are close to taking Pakaanan's Pass, while Ossium emigrants camp near Gildenheim.

Spiral.t: Mentioned in passing: the Halls of Lutum were built to watch the borders with Redoubt and Spiral.

Tathar.t: Mentioned in passing: its salt mines are where resisting Freeborn of Feroz may be sent.

The Semmerlak.t: Mentioned in passing: Dawn's earlier crossing of it on the Golden Causeway is recalled.

Therunin.t: The Valiant Pegasus, captains, Great Forest Orcs and magic defeated the Heirs and Greenfountain traitors. The Thimble was saved at great cost, but its output is halved and all production is reduced for a season.

Zenith.t: Over thirty thousand Imperial troops entered but withdrew after narrowly escaping a Druj encirclement, losing about fifteen hundred soldiers.

384YE Autumn Equinox Conclave sessions.d: Precedence went to the Rod and Shield. Vas Radovanovna Esskivik became Gloaming Sentinel, Aleksander Zoravih Novosad Arcane Architect, Æsa Sigeling Imperial Magus and Ibiss Netherwatch Archmage of Spring. Dawn accepted Tharim's bargain, giving up mana and farm income for a year in return for 1000 knights. The Heralds of Tharim were invited to the Hall of Worlds. Rosalynne de Gauvain and Sidlore Edric Charge de Gauvain were declared sorcerers for provoking Hayaak, but Solene d'Alba was not. Attempts to condemn or interdict Thunderous Deluge failed, while a statement that Conclave had endorsed its casting passed. Support for persecuted Suranni magicians passed, and Eyes of the Soul's Past was shared with the Axou.

Dawn.t: Through the Black Frost concord, Dawn's mages and farmers accepted Tharim's bargain: for a year their sites yield one less mana crystal and their farms 36 fewer rings, in exchange for 1000 knights to aid them in the Barrens.

Druj.t: Mentioned in passing: the Druj are not named, but the Barrens they hold are where Tharim's knights, bargained for by Dawn, are meant to give assistance.

384YE Autumn Equinox Conclave sessions.o: At the 384YE Autumn Equinox Conclave the mages passed and rejected a long run of declarations, chief among them Dawn's acceptance of Tharim's bargain of 1000 knights and the declaration of two members of House de Gauvain as sorcerers. Several Conclave titles were also filled.

The Barrens.t: The bargain Dawn struck with Tharim concerned his offer of assistance in the Druj-held Barrens, bringing 1000 of the Bound King's knights to the fight there.

384YE Autumn Equinox Imperial elections.d: Senators were elected for Casinea, Hahnmark, Kahraman, Morrow, Semmerholm, Skarsind, Tassato, Therunin, Upwold, Volodmartz and Zenith. The Senate appointed generals for seven armies, two Advisors on Orc Affairs, the Imperial Administrator, the Ambassador to the Sarcophan Delves and others. The Synod chose Cardinals of Loyalty and Pride, two inquisitors, several champions and other religious titles, with vote counts recorded. The Military Council filled posts including Quartermaster General and Imperial Warcaster. The Conclave elected three Grandmasters, and candidates declared for titles such as Imperial Magus. The Bourse auctioned seats including the Great Pits of Ennerlund for 486 thrones and voted on others.

Dawn.t: Zadkiel de Coeurdefer was elected Senator for Semmerholm, the Dawnish-held territory.

Druj.t: Cadeus was named Senator for Zenith, a territory then held by the Druj.

Highguard.t: Solomon was elected Senator for Casinea, the Highborn-held territory.

Imperial Orcs.t: Bloodcrow Rasp was elected Senator for Skarsind. Stormcrow Skred and Atla were each appointed Advisor on Orc Affairs.

Navarr.t: Travid Longest Path was elected Senator for Therunin, the Navarr-held territory.

The Brass Coast.t: Delara i Fijadoz i Guerra was elected Senator for Kahraman, the Brass Coast territory.

The League.t: Cesare Sanguineo Rezia Di Tassato was elected Senator for Tassato, the League-held territory.

The Marches.t: Matilda Reaper was elected Senator for Upwold, the Marcher-held territory.

Urizen.t: Juliana was elected Senator for Morrow, the Urizen-held territory.

Varushka.t: Desilav Sergeyevich Jesen was elected Senator for Volodmartz, the Varushkan-held territory.

Wintermark.t: Hengest Dun was elected Senator for Hahnmark, the Wintermark-held territory.

384YE Autumn Equinox Imperial elections.o: At the 384YE Autumn Equinox summit, elections and appointments filled Senate seats, Imperial titles, Synod and Conclave positions and Bourse seats. They included eleven senators for territories across the Empire.

Casinea.t: Solomon was elected as Casinea's senator.

Hahnmark.t: Hengest Dun was elected as Hahnmark's senator.

Kahraman.t: Delara i Fijadoz i Guerra was elected as Kahraman's senator.

Morrow.t: Juliana was elected as Morrow's senator.

Semmerholm.t: Zadkiel de Coeurdefer was elected as Semmerholm's senator.

Skarsind.t: Bloodcrow Rasp was elected as Skarsind's senator.

Tassato.t: Cesare Sanguineo Rezia Di Tassato was elected as Tassato's senator.

Therunin.t: Travid Longest Path was elected as Therunin's senator.

Upwold.t: Matilda Reaper was elected as Upwold's senator.

Volodmartz.t: Desilav Sergeyevich Jesen was elected as Volodmartz's senator.

Zenith.t: Cadeus was listed as Senator for Zenith, though the territory was then held by the Druj.

384YE Autumn Equinox Senate sessions.d: The treasury stood at 1702 thrones and 2 crowns. The Senate gave Zenith to Urizen and ordered an appraisal of stabilising it. It created an Ambassador to the Grendel and funded the Grendel Embassy, and created a Synod Judgement of Virtuous Challenge. Disbursements funded the Burning Falcons, military resupply and the Imperial Seer's scrying. Commissions included the Black Canal, Boar's Market, the expanded Library of Hacynian, the Swords of Nearweald and improvements at Syrene's Wisdom. Several sinecures went to further scrutiny for missing details. Thornsong House failed. Title-holders announced a spy network west of Skallahn, a port at Bittershore and Giritane's Gaze.

Dawn.t: Weirwater's senator secured 50 thrones to build the Boar's Market in Astolat, letting Dawn buy bourse resources. Giritane's Gaze was announced for Weirwater, while the Laroc tourney grounds motion was withdrawn.

Druj.t: Mentioned in passing: the Druj are not named, but Zenith, listed as held by them, was assigned by the Senate to Urizen.

Grendel.t: The Senate created an Ambassador to the Grendel, taking ambassadorial powers from the Imperial Fleet Master, and disbursed 200 thrones to pay for the completed Grendel Embassy.

Highguard.t: Highborn senators won 40 thrones for the Imperial Seer's scrying and 100 thrones to modernise the pumps of Syrene's Wisdom. Necropolis's call to appraise foreign pilgrims of the Way failed.

Imperial Orcs.t: Mentioned in passing: a motion to abrogate the Advisor on Orc Affairs was withdrawn, and Skarsind's senator seconded the Captain of the Senate Guard appointment.

Jotun.t: The Imperial Spymaster announced a spy network west of Skallahn to supercharge the offensive against the Jotun. Researchers into Bregasland's sinking were warned of the danger from Jotun.

Navarr.t: Navarr won 250 thrones to expand the Library of Hacynian into a great library of vallorn lore, and 500 thrones for resupply went to Miaren. Thornsong House failed, and Arthur Bannerman of Navarr became Captain of the Senate Guard.

The Brass Coast.t: Madruga's senator received 400 thrones to raise the Burning Falcons and Segura's senator proposed the new Ambassador to the Grendel. No Imperial Throne was elected on Kahraman's motion.

The League.t: The League gained the Chair of the Wolf, Tender of the Blood Orchard and Reapers' Repose titles, 50 thrones for Tassato's flood repairs and a planned Scholars of the Sword Academy. The Curator of the Blood Red River will now be appointed by its National Assembly.

The Marches.t: Bridget Talbot of the Marches was elected Imperial Administrator and the Black Canal was commissioned to bring prosperity to Mournwold and Mitwold. The Breadbasket went to the Marches to ease the influx of Bregasland citizens, and the Happiston sinecure awaits scrutiny.

Thule.t: Recognising the Thule's abolition of slavery and the damage of Thunderous Deluge, the Senate lifted sanctions on Otkodov and granted its orcs free trade with the Empire.

Urizen.t: Urizen was given Zenith, which can now appoint a senator, to support the Citadel Guard. The Spiral Envoy will now be chosen by Tally of the Votes, and Thalia of Netherwatch became Ambassador to the Sarcophan Delves.

Varushka.t: Varushkan senators drove the ratified Faraden and Iron Confederacy treaties and the Swords of Nearweald barracks in Ossium. Kostjya announced a self-funded port, Kostjyas Respite, on the Bittershore.

Wintermark.t: The Hall of the Unbroken, a sanctuary for former slaves in East Floes, passed but is under further scrutiny. The Beacons of Kallavesa were named for Imperial guerdon.

384YE Autumn Equinox Senate sessions.o: At the Autumn Equinox 384YE the Senate assigned Zenith to Urizen, lifted sanctions on Thule-held Otkodov and granted it free trade, ratified treaties with the Faraden and the Iron Confederacy, and passed a wide range of commissions and disbursements. Bridget Talbot of the Marches was elected Imperial Administrator.

Holberg/Holmauer.t: The Secure Wunderkind Woods motion defined the status of Holmauer Park, recognising the Rebeshi Players as guardians and creating the Tender of the Blood Orchard.

Ossium/Bittershore.t: Cabal Lyktan and the people of Varushka announced a self-funded port and town, Kostjyas Respite, on the Bittershore, with a Merchant Boyar of the Bittershore.

Ossium/Nearweald.t: The Senate commissioned the Swords of Nearweald, a fortified barracks in Ossium, with 150 thrones disbursed.

Astolat.t: A market-fayre, the Boar's Market, is to be built at Boar's Hollow with a Reeve of the Boars Market elected by well worn path.

Bastion.t: Bastion's senator received 40 thrones so the Imperial Seer can use scrying magics. A failed motion would have looked at escalating Bastion to the challenge of Timoj.

Casinea.t: Casinea's senator received 100 thrones to modernise the pumps of Syrene's Wisdom for better ilium returns and safer miners.

Hahnmark.t: Mentioned in passing: Hahnmark's senator proposed the Captain of the Senate Guard appointment and seconded the Ambassador to the Sarcophan Delves.

Hercynia.t: The Library of Hacynian in Hercynia is to become a great library of vallorn lore and research ways to destroy the vallorn, with 250 thrones disbursed.

Holberg.t: The Holberg Guild of Engineers may expand under the new Chair of the Wolf, and a Scholars of the Sword Academy sinecure was announced for the city. Magdalena Teyhard von Holberg donated 28 thrones to the treasury.

Kahraman.t: Mentioned in passing: Kahraman's senator proposed appointing an Imperial Throne, but none was elected.

Kallavesa.t: Mentioned in passing: the Beacons of Kallavesa were named for Imperial guerdon, and its senator proposed and seconded other motions.

Karov.t: Mentioned in passing: Karov's senator seconded the Judgement of Virtuous Challenge and proposed the deferred Iron Confederacy ambassador election.

Karsk.t: Mentioned in passing: Karsk's senator proposed the Faraden treaty and seconded the lifting of sanctions on the Thule.

Madruga.t: Madruga's senator received 400 thrones to raise the Burning Falcons.

Miaren.t: Miaren's senator received 500 thrones for military and magical resupply.

Miekarova.t: Mentioned in passing: Miekarova's senator proposed the Iron Confederacy treaty and seconded the Faraden treaty.

Mitwold.t: The Black Canal commission aims to improve Mitwold's prosperity, and its senator proposed the passed motion to map the Sea of Snow.

Morrow.t: Mentioned in passing: Morrow's senator proposed assigning Zenith to Urizen and seconded the Zenith appraisal.

Mournwold.t: The Black Canal is to reach Mournwold, with Mournwold orcs working alongside Marchers. A Potato Fields mana sinecure at Happiston in the Chalkdowns passed but is under scrutiny.

Necropolis.t: Mentioned in passing: Necropolis's senator proposed the failed pilgrims appraisal and seconded the Tassato repairs.

Ossium.t: The Swords of Nearweald fortified barracks were commissioned in Ossium, and a self-funded port, Kostjyas Respite, was announced on the Bittershore.

Otkodov.t: Trade sanctions on Otkodov were removed and its orcs now enjoy free trade with minimal tariffs and quick access to Imperial markets.

Redoubt.t: Mentioned in passing: Redoubt's senator seconded the Zenith assignment and received 200 thrones for the Grendel Embassy and 150 for the Swords of Nearweald.

Reikos.t: Mentioned in passing: Reikos's senator proposed lifting sanctions on the Thule and seconded the Grendel Embassy funding.

Sarvos.t: Mentioned in passing: Sarvos's senator proposed the Chair of the Wolf, and Achille di Sarvos announced the Holberg academy.

Segura.t: Mentioned in passing: Segura's senator proposed the Ambassador to the Grendel and seconded the Imperial Throne motion.

Semmerholm.t: Mentioned in passing: Semmerholm's senator proposed the withdrawn Laroc tourney grounds motion and seconded the Reapers' Repose.

Sermersuaq.t: The Hall of the Unbroken, a mana sinecure for those who endured slavery, is to be built in East Floes, though it is under scrutiny for missing details.

Skallahn.t: Building on the successful Skallahn raid, the Imperial Spymaster announced a spy network in the territory west of Skallahn.

Skarsind.t: Mentioned in passing: Skarsind's senator seconded the Captain of the Senate Guard appointment.

Tassato.t: The Senate allocated 50 thrones to repair Tassato's flood damage, sparing its businesses notable loss of income this season.

Temeschwar.t: The Reapers' Repose sinecure was commissioned in Melfort, though the civil service awaits clarification from Temeschwar's senator.

Therunin.t: The motion to build Thornsong House, a hospital college for potion research in Therunin, failed.

Upwold.t: Mentioned in passing: Upwold's senator proposed the Black Canal and seconded mapping the Sea of Snow.

Volodmartz.t: Mentioned in passing: Volodmartz's senator proposed free trade with the Thule and seconded the Ambassador to the Grendel.

Weirwater.t: The Master of the Koboldi announced Giritane's Gaze, a great mandowla statue supporting Weirwater's miners funded by its senator. The senator also received 50 thrones for the Boar's Market.

Zenith.t: Zenith was assigned to Urizen and can appoint a senator, and an appraisal was ordered into stabilising it and supporting returning refugees.

384YE Autumn Equinox interlude.d: The 350-throne Imperial Guerdon was shared among units supporting the Green Shield, Fire of the South, Hounds of Glory and Iron Helms. Military units and fleets could join a second raid on Skallahn under Marshal Orrick Bolholt, a Senate-legalised raid on Chalonsio organised by the Sumaah Republic, or a Red Door expedition to protect the koboldi. They could also go Into the Twisted Woods. Storms mitigated the Great Drought in Imperial territories but halved farm and business production and penalised mines. The drought persisted in territories outside the Imperial regio. Mandates affected Highborn and Dawnish units, Highborn congregations, and congregations near the Asavean buildings. Two rituals entered Imperial lore.

Dawn.t: Dawnish units gained extra rewards for supporting Dawnish, Highborn or Navarr armies in Dark Ranging, and were among the most effective at Into the Twisted Woods. They also had special advantages on the Red Door raid, and horse-lovers in Weirwater shared a strange exhilarating dream.

Druj.t: Zenith, held by the Druj, remained under the Great Drought and its herb gardens were cursed by the Feast of Want.

Grendel.t: Feroz and Spiral, both held by the Grendel, still suffered the Great Drought, with farms there taking a production penalty.

Highguard.t: Highborn characters could upgrade military units for one fewer wain of mithril. Under the Blade of the Pilgrims mandate, Highborn congregations gave up two votes and one liao each to aid any opportunity to fight the vallorn.

Jotun.t: Jotun-held Skallahn faced a second Imperial raid, while their holdings of Bregasland and Liathaven remained in the grip of the Great Drought.

Navarr.t: Navarr armies engaged in Dark Ranging could draw extra-rewarded Dawnish support, and Navarr units had special advantages on the Red Door raid.

The League.t: Holberg's farms received herbs from the Sand Fisher orcs. Congregations in Tassato and Temeschwar gained votes and liao from Rafael Barossa di Tassato's Reject False Gods mandate.

Urizen.t: Congregations in Redoubt gained extra votes and liao from the anti-idolatry mandate, and several rituals were added to Urizen lore through the Gift of Knowledge.

Varushka.t: Varushkan units were among the most effective at Into the Twisted Woods, which could become permanent for them if the Tower of the Manticore were built in Ossium. Congregations in Karsk gained the anti-idolatry bonus.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark's assembly helped recognise Orrick Bolholt as Marshal of the Skallahn raid, in which its fleets avoid the outsider penalty. Its heroes could recover rune secrets for the Runegrott Runeforge if the Red Door raid reached the ancient tunnels, and Hahnmark's congregations gained the anti-idolatry bonus.

384YE Autumn Equinox interlude.o: Ahead of the 384YE Autumn Equinox, the interlude summarised the effects of the Summer Solstice on downtime. These included special raids on Skallahn, Chalonsio and Lorenzo's Deep Pockets, storms across Imperial territories, a lingering drought elsewhere, and several mandates and curses.

Brocéliande/Dark Ranging.t: Dawnish military units supporting Dawnish, Highborn or Navarr armies engaged in Dark Ranging earned an extra crown and two random herbs.

Redoubt/Willstone.t: Mentioned in passing: the name appears only in that of Lucius Ankarien Willstone, whose ritual Muffled Oar was added to Imperial lore.

Bregasland.t: Outside the Imperial regio, Bregasland escaped the storms but its farms still took a -2 penalty from the Great Drought.

Brocéliande.t: The vallorn here had become quiescent, but the territory remained under the Great Drought. Dawnish units supporting armies fighting the vallorn here earned extra rewards.

Feroz.t: Farms in Feroz still suffered a -2 production penalty from the Great Drought.

Hahnmark.t: Congregations in Hahnmark gained two votes and one liao while the Synod stood clearly against idolatry, and the territory was struck by the storms.

Holberg.t: Farms in Holberg received two random herbs each downtime through the Sand Fisher tithe.

Karsk.t: Congregations in Karsk gained two votes and one liao under the Reject False Gods mandate.

Liathaven.t: Liathaven remained in the Great Drought, with its farms taking a -2 penalty.

Ossium.t: Mentioned in passing: building the Tower of the Manticore here would make Into the Twisted Woods permanently available to Dawn and Varushka.

Redoubt.t: Congregations in Redoubt gained two votes and one liao for as long as the Synod maintained its anti-idolatry stance.

Skallahn.t: Skallahn was the target of a second Imperial raid by military units and fleets under Marshal Orrick Bolholt, with rewards depending on its success.

Spiral.t: Farms in Spiral continued to suffer the -2 penalty of the Great Drought.

Tassato.t: Congregations in Tassato gained two votes and one liao from the mandate against the Asavean architect's buildings.

Temeschwar.t: Congregations in Temeschwar gained two votes and one liao while the Synod opposed idolatry.

Weirwater.t: Those in Weirwater with an affinity for horses dreamt of riding a galloping horse on an unknown shore on a moonless night, and woke exhilarated.

Zenith.t: Zenith's farms suffered the Great Drought, and the Feast of Want cursed its herb gardens to yield three fewer true vervain and one fewer of each other herb.

384YE Autumn Equinox winds of fortune.d: The entries set out choices and opportunities rather than settled outcomes. These included a Temeschwar university appraisal, a remedy for cursed Holmauer Park, Prosperity proposals for Astolat, and Synod censure over Dawn's Barrens ambitions. Queen Rhianos offered aid to explore fallen Terunael, the Senate could map the Sea of Snow, and the Slave Lords of Rachensgrab's aerie was found. The Great Storm left Tassato badly damaged. The hylje gave the Mediator a means of contact, and Axou trade penalties continued to fade. Summer conjunction results were mixed. Koskinen and Oath-Heart were recovered and the Stone of Storms was claimed, but the Jotun kept the Spear of Bounty and Druj raiders escaped with an amulet and a text.

Dawn.t: Dawn's assembly faced Synod censure over its long dream of conquering the Barrens, while Astolat received Prosperity proposals and the enchantresses pursued Summer opportunities tied to the Eastern Sky. A Spring horror menacing the Dawnish armies in the Barrens was decisively defeated.

Druj.t: The Druj were trapped in Zenith by a Highborn crusade but unleashed an evil that threatened to taint the territory. Their raiders escaped with the Amulet of Truth and a magical text, while followers of Siakha lost the Stone of Storms and many of their number.

Grendel.t: A Grendel Waverider raiding party was stopped short of Cereva Hall in Segura after negotiations broke down. The port of Oran remained closed to Imperial fleets.

Highguard.t: The Highborn Assembly faced choices over the Druj evil in Zenith after three seasons of crusading, and was invited to pool resources with Navarr against the vallorn. Rhianos' heralds also came to Highguard seeking adventurers for Terunael.

Imperial Orcs.t: Despite valiant efforts, the Imperial Orcs failed to deny the Spear of Bounty to the Jotun, but the Pilgrim's Shield Oath-Heart was recovered in Bregasland. A Tamazi delegation came to Anvil to speak with them.

Jotun.t: The Jotun kept the Spear of Bounty and gained the favour of Hayaak, but lost the hylje hostage Koskinen, and House Greywater escaped their execution squad. The raid on Skallahn opened a chance for the Empire to map the seas around Jotun lands.

Navarr.t: Iniska Ashwood's Pride mandate opened opportunities against the vallorn, including joint work with the Highborn assembly. Rhianos offered aid to explore Terunael, a kidnapped Navarr and their relic were rescued in Karsk, and the Feverwater expedition returned safely.

The Brass Coast.t: Cardinal of Wisdom Hembeneth i Guerra's call bore fruit in a proposed solution for Holmauer Park. Waveriders were kept from Cereva Hall in Segura, and the citizens of Madruga were among those affected by the storm's aftermath.

The League.t: The League faced an appraisal for a university in Temeschwar and a proposed remedy for cursed Holmauer Park in Holberg. Tassato was badly damaged by the surging waters of the Vassa.

Thule.t: The matter of a Thule warlock captured by the Jotun was resolved to the Thule's satisfaction, and they commended the Ambassador to Otkodov. Mapping of the Sea of Snow might extend towards Thule lands.

Urizen.t: The Highborn crusade sought to free the Urizen people of Zenith while a Druj evil threatened to taint the territory, and the Conclave discussed new rituals in Urizen lore. Druj escaped with the Amulet of Truth from Golden Cascade.

Varushka.t: The robber-boyar of Isember was executed in Karsk, a dark spirit there was allowed to flee, and the Druj destroyed two of Ossium's Bone Hives. Varushkan residents of Karsk, Karov and Ossium were among those affected by the storm's aftermath, and trouble involving the Mir Mozga was reported.

Wintermark.t: The hylje gave the Mediator of Hyljehal, Raal Dunn, a way to contact them after Koskinen's rescue. The ghosts of Turelva in Hahnmark were laid to rest, and Wintermark fleet captains were invited to help map the Sea of Snow.

384YE Autumn Equinox winds of fortune.o: The Autumn Equinox 384YE Winds of Fortune gathered the season's developments facing the Empire. They covered the archmages' plenipotentiaries, proposals for Holberg, Astolat and Temeschwar, the Druj evil in Zenith, the aftermath of the Great Storm, new opportunities at sea and in the vallorn, and the outcomes of the Summer conjunctions.

Brocéliande/Terunael.t: Rhianos offered aid to those daring to find out what lies at the heart of the fallen city of Terunael.

Holberg/Holmauer.t: A practical solution, and an alternative suggestion, were put forward for the cursed Holmauer Park.

Madruga/Calvos Sound.t: Mentioned in passing: news of trouble involving the Mir Mozga and Calvos Sound was noted among the visitors to Anvil.

The Barrens/Saltmarsh.t: Imperial heroes invoked magic at Saltmaw to unleash the Barren Sea on the Fangs and the Saltmarsh, and the sea now rages against the land.

Astolat.t: Pilgrims of Prosperity drew up proposals with the yeofolk to build on the growing trade brought to Astolat's fayres by the Blood Red Roads.

Bay of Catazar.t: Mentioned in passing: its earlier successful mapping was cited as a precedent for mapping the Sea of Snow.

Bregasland.t: Dillion Fisher was dealt with and the shield Oath-Heart recovered. House Greywater escaped a Jotun execution squad into the marsh and now supports the Strong Reeds in resisting the Jotun.

Brocéliande.t: Queen Rhianos offered aid to anyone willing to discover what lies at the heart of the fallen city of Terunael in vallorn-infested Brocéliande.

Hahnmark.t: Every unquiet spirit haunting Turelva was laid to rest, and their stories were brought back to Anvil.

Holberg.t: The Wisdom assembly produced a practical solution to the curse on Holmauer Park, though not everyone in Holberg sees the cursed park as a problem.

Karov.t: Mentioned in passing: its Varushkan residents were named among those concerned with the lingering effects of the Great Storm.

Karsk.t: The self-styled Boyar of Isember was executed, a dark spirit was allowed to flee, and a kidnapped Navarr and relic were rescued from bandits. News also arrived of trouble involving the Mir Mozga.

Madruga.t: Its citizens were among those affected by the storm's aftermath, and trouble involving Calvos Sound was reported.

Ossium.t: The Druj destroyed two of the Bone Hives, which will produce nothing until after the Winter Solstice 384YE. Its residents were also affected by the storm's aftermath.

Otkodov.t: The Ambassador to Otkodov resolved the matter of the Thule warlock captured by the Jotun, earning the Thule's commendation.

Sarangrave.t: Imperial heroes could not reach the Bloodwater Spear orc held prisoner in the Dead Stone Woods, and Sarangrave's ghulai escaped Zenith with a mysterious text.

Sarvos.t: Mentioned in passing: the shattering of its mirrors was noted as happening at the same time as the cursing of Holmauer Park.

Sea of Snow.t: The raid on Skallahn opened an opportunity for the Senate to commission large-scale maps of the waters near Jotun, Faraden and perhaps Thule lands.

Segura.t: A Grendel Waverider raiding party was prevented from reaching Cereva Hall after negotiations broke down.

Semmerholm.t: A grand audience with Barien at the Semmerstones went without significant hitches, and its Dawnish residents faced the aftermath of the Great Storm.

Sermersuaq.t: The hylje deepened their friendship with the Suaq after Koskinen's rescue, and the Thule warlock matter was resolved. The Jotun, however, kept the Spear of Bounty at Spirax wood.

Skallahn.t: Mentioned in passing: the successful raid on Skallahn was cited as opening the Sea of Snow mapping opportunity and drawing Rhianos' attention.

Tassato.t: The city of Tassato was badly damaged by the surging waters of the Vassa during the Great Storm.

Temeschwar.t: An appraisal presented two extravagant possibilities for building a university in Temeschwar to increase the Empire's commissions.

The Barrens.t: Dawn's ambitions there drew Synod censure. Conjunctions claimed the Stone of Storms, saved Golden Axe soldiers and the Dawnish armies, cured the wagon raiders, and unleashed the Barren Sea.

The Semmerlak.t: The storm rains brought new opportunities to the Semmerlak.

Therunin.t: An expedition to an ancient wreck at the bottom of the Feverwater returned safely.

Weirwater.t: Mentioned in passing: it was tagged among the places affected by the storm's aftermath and by magical matters before the Conclave.

Zenith.t: The Highborn crusade trapped the Druj, but a Druj evil threatened to taint Zenith for years. The malaise at the Allied Groves was cured and the ex-prisoners restored, though Druj escaped with an amulet and a text.

384YE Autumn Equinox winds of war.d: In the west, Mathilda Fisher's orc allies took the Rushes and Gravenmarch in drought-stricken Bregasland. In Kahraman, Navarri armies forced the Lasambrian Jotun to retreat. An Imperial and Otkodov alliance broke the Jotun castles of Sermersuaq. Beyond the borders, heroes sealed the trogoni shaft beneath Lorenzo's Deep Pockets, a second raid ravaged Jotun Skallahn, and the Liberty Pact sacked Chalonsio. In the east, the Druj left Ossium for the Forest of Ulnak, the Barrens stayed quiet, and a hammer-and-anvil manoeuvre restored Zenith to Imperial hands, trapping the Druj in the south. Battle opportunities were offered in Kahraman, Sermersuaq and Zenith, alongside many conjunctions and military considerations.

Dawn.t: Dawn could field 40 force weight for the summit battles. Its armies remained barred from the Cautious Advance and Give Ground orders.

Druj.t: The Druj abandoned Ossium and lost Zenith to a decisive Imperial victory. Their armies there were trapped and cornered in the south, and their generals were gathering in Occursion.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: Grendel is not named, though a conjunction called Ash and Dust was offered in Screed in Spiral, a territory it shares with the Druj.

Highguard.t: Highborn armies could field 18 force weight and issue the Crusading Storm order. They gained bonuses when attacking into Zenith from Morrow or defending Morrow against attack from Zenith.

Imperial Orcs.t: Mentioned in passing: the Imperial Orcs are listed with a force weight of 7 for the summit battles.

Jotun.t: The Jotun completed their hold on Bregasland through Mathilda Fisher, but their Lasambrians retreated in Kahraman and they were driven from Sermersuaq. Skallahn was also ravaged by a second Imperial raid.

Navarr.t: Navarri armies drove the Lasambrian invaders back in Kahraman, and Navarr could field 40 force weight. A conjunction was offered to rescue Navarri vates from Sarangrave.

The Brass Coast.t: Imperial armies forced the Lasambrian Jotun to retreat from the Cinnabar Hills of Kahraman after six months held back only by Fort Braydon. Conjunctions were offered in Gambit and in Calvos Sound in Madruga.

The Marches.t: Bregasland remained under Mathilda Fisher's rule, though Marchers there resisted her. Former Mournwold Marchers fought for the Lasambrians in Kahraman, and Marcher armies remained barred from the Give Ground order.

Thule.t: The Thule of Otkodov were allied with the Empire in breaking the Jotun hold on Sermersuaq. A battle opportunity was offered to stop Jotun champions unleashing vengeance against the Thule.

Urizen.t: Zenith was once again in Imperial hands after a decisive victory over the Druj, though the campaign remained on a knife's edge. The Citadel Guard was set to deteriorate again.

Varushka.t: The Druj withdrew from Ossium, leaving ruins behind, and conjunctions were offered in Ossium, Karsk and Volodmartz. Varushkan armies generated fewer victory points when campaigning alongside Brass Coast or Wintermark armies.

Wintermark.t: With Otkodov, the Empire finally liberated Sermersuaq, and raiders from Westerhal and Odd's End ravaged Skallahn. Wintermark could field the largest force weight at 51.

384YE Autumn Equinox winds of war.o: The Autumn Equinox 384YE Winds of War summarised the Empire's campaigns. Jotun Lasambrians were driven back in Kahraman, Sermersuaq was finally liberated from the Jotun, Zenith was retaken from the Druj and the Druj withdrew from Ossium, while Bregasland stayed under Jotun-backed rule.

Bregasland/Gravenmarch.t: Gravenmarch was seized by Mathilda Fisher's orc allies.

Bregasland/Grey Fens.t: A conjunction to Jayne's Top Copse was offered to eliminate a Jotun outpost.

Bregasland/The Rushes.t: The Rushes were seized by Mathilda Fisher's orc allies.

Kahraman/Gambit.t: A conjunction to Talaeiros was offered to rescue the Damatian Cliffs forewoman, and a battle at Rojota Vantage to stop the Lasambrians recovering casualties.

Madruga/Calvos Sound.t: A conjunction to Calvos was offered to lift spirits and investigate.

Ossium/Drownbark Forest.t: A conjunction to Petka's Path was offered to protect vital roads and bridges.

Sarangrave/Whisperwood.t: A conjunction to Karliss was offered to rescue Navarri vates.

Sermersuaq/Silver Peaks.t: Mentioned in passing: thunder rolled through the Silver Peaks as the alliance faced the last Jotun castles.

Sermersuaq/Stark.t: Conjunctions were offered to recover the relic Tuuli's Eye at Avointaivas and to rescue Yanti the Storm Runner at Flat Hills.

Sermersuaq/Tanikipari.t: A battle at Jaelwif's Mound was offered to stop Jotun revenge on the Thule, and a conjunction at Kilpailuala Bay to send Jarl Snekmar to the Howling Abyss.

Spiral/Screed.t: A conjunction called Ash and Dust was offered at Kephalos' Delve.

The Barrens/Dawnguard.t: A conjunction to the Aurelius Estates was offered to summon Sorin's hungry wolves to the Barrens.

Volodmartz/Brez.t: A conjunction titled All is Fair, All is Permitted was offered at Urodli's Fall.

Zenith/Iteri.t: A conjunction to the Pallasian Steps was offered to destroy miasma pillars and exorcise tortured souls.

Zenith/Lustri.t: Conjunctions were offered to slay the Endless Stalker at the Rift in the Veil and to destroy miasma pillars at the Spire of Twisting Shadow.

Zenith/Occursion.t: A battle was offered against the gathering of Druj generals, with conjunctions at the Tower of the Fall and the Field of Celestial Mist.

Zenith/Proceris.t: A conjunction to the Plantation of Tall Ferns was offered to destroy miasma pillars and intercept marshlings.

Bregasland.t: Under the great drought, Mathilda Fisher's orc allies seized the Rushes and Gravenmarch and dominated the marshes, though Marchers resisted. A conjunction was offered to eliminate a Jotun outpost in the Grey Fens.

Forest of Ulnak.t: Mentioned in passing: the Druj faded back into the Forest of Ulnak as they left Ossium.

Kahraman.t: The Lasambrian invaders were forced to retreat before Navarri armies, relieving the exhausted Fort Braydon garrison. A battle opportunity was offered to stop them recovering their casualties.

Karsk.t: A conjunction to Pyotr's Square in Lestazny was offered to investigate why the Ketsov of the Mir Mozga were acting strangely.

Madruga.t: A conjunction to Calvos in Calvos Sound was offered to lift spirits and investigate.

Mitwold.t: Mentioned in passing: any Imperial army could take the Billet order in Mitwold.

Morrow.t: Mentioned in passing: Highborn or Urizen armies defending Morrow against attack from Zenith gained a defensive bonus.

Mournwold.t: Mentioned in passing: the Lasambrian warriors in the Kahraman battle opportunity were formerly of Mournwold.

Ossium.t: The Druj left Ossium, fading back into the Forest of Ulnak and leaving ruins behind. A conjunction was offered to protect vital roads and bridges.

Otkodov.t: Mentioned in passing: Otkodov was the Empire's ally in breaking the Jotun hold on Sermersuaq.

Sarangrave.t: A conjunction to Karliss in Whisperwood was offered to rescue Navarri vates.

Semmerholm.t: Mentioned in passing: the Adamant Gate in Semmerholm could not be reduced below 1,000 military strength.

Sermersuaq.t: The Empire and Otkodov were to break Olgafsdottirshal and the Fortress of Kalant and finally liberate the territory. A battle opportunity and several conjunctions were offered there.

Skallahn.t: Raiders from Westerhal and Odd's End ravaged the Jarl of Kierheim's heartlands to break Jotun war capacity, while ships reaved the southern shores of Kalsea.

Spiral.t: A conjunction called Ash and Dust, at Kephalos' Delve in Screed, was offered to the Archmage of Night.

The Barrens.t: The Steel Causeway remained, unattacked, and the season was eerily quiet. Most Imperial armies fighting there suffered a penalty to territory conquered.

Upwold.t: Mentioned in passing: any Imperial army could take the Billet order in Upwold.

Volodmartz.t: A conjunction titled All is Fair, All is Permitted was offered at Urodli's Fall in Brez.

Zenith.t: A hammer-and-anvil manoeuvre returned Zenith to Imperial hands and trapped the Druj armies in the south. A battle against gathering Druj generals and many conjunctions were offered.

384YE Spring Equinox Imperial elections.d: The national elections returned Flávio Capra Gláucio van Holberg for Holberg, Marya Zoranova Doubek for Karsk, Myshki Marishka Letuchaya for Miekarova, Alan Sheppard for Mournwold, Ianthe for Reikos and Avisena i Kharizmi i Guerra for Segura. The Senate appointed ambassadors, advisors, the Imperial Spymaster Bernard Dugdale and seven generals, as well as many market and resource stewards. The Synod filled cardinal, inquisitor and champion posts, with Clytemnestra of the House of the Wanderer becoming Cardinal of Wisdom on 288 votes. Ezro i Alvera i Erigo became Imperial Fleet Master. The Bourse auctioned and voted on its titles, including Master of the Imperial Mint, which went to Gancio for 86 thrones.

Highguard.t: Highguard's citizens elected Ianthe as Senator for Reikos.

The Brass Coast.t: The Brass Coast elected Avisena i Kharizmi i Guerra as Senator for Segura.

The League.t: Flávio Capra Gláucio van Holberg was elected Senator for Holberg, giving the city a voice in the Senate.

The Marches.t: The Marches elected Alan Sheppard as Senator for Mournwold.

Varushka.t: Varushka chose two senators: Marya Zoranova Doubek for Karsk and Myshki Marishka Letuchaya for Miekarova.

384YE Spring Equinox Imperial elections.o: At the 384YE Spring Equinox summit, Imperial titles were filled through elections and appointments across the Senate, Synod, Military Council, Conclave and Bourse. Six senators were also chosen, for Holberg, Karsk, Miekarova, Mournwold, Reikos and Segura.

Holberg/Misericorde.t: The Senate appointed Beatrix Amalia De Rondell zu Holberg as Merchant Prince of Misericorde Market.

Holberg.t: Holberg's new senator was Flávio Capra Gláucio van Holberg.

Karsk.t: Karsk's new senator was Marya Zoranova Doubek.

Miekarova.t: Miekarova's new senator was Myshki Marishka Letuchaya.

Mournwold.t: Mournwold's new senator was Alan Sheppard.

Reikos.t: Reikos's new senator was Ianthe.

Segura.t: Segura's new senator was Avisena i Kharizmi i Guerra.

384YE Spring Equinox Senate sessions.d: The treasury stood at 2612 thrones and 2 crowns. The Senate abrogated the Moonwater Hall in Upwold and criminalised membership of, or support for, the Hand of Dumon. It changed virtue assembly membership so that priests can move between assemblies, and raised the Burning Falcon army for 250 thrones. It also commissioned an appraisal of inciting slave uprisings in Sarangrave. Commissions included the Churnspire in Peregro, the Great Harbour of Elos, Hufi's Garden, a justicar sanctuary on the Isle of the Osseini, a Grendel embassy, an Iron Roads extension into Ossium and upgraded mana ministries. Bernard Dugdale became Imperial Spymaster, and ambassadors were appointed to Otkodov, the Commonwealth, Faraden and the Sumaah Republic.

Dawn.t: Astolat's senator received 140 thrones to improve the Towerjacks with the Engineer quality. Dawnish senators also seconded several motions, including the abrogation of Moonwater Hall and the expansion of the Skarsind College of Warcasting.

Druj.t: The Senate commissioned Graciana i Lopez i Guerra to appraise using the Sarangrave spy network to incite slave uprisings and raids, aiming to cause the Druj economic and military damage.

Grendel.t: An embassy to the Grendel is to be built in Cargo for the Imperial Fleetmaster. Imperial projects were also begun in Grendel-held Spiral and Feroz. A motion to appraise Imperial captives held by the Grendel failed.

Highguard.t: Highborn senators drove several motions, including the abrogation of Moonwater Hall, the Churnspire and 50 thrones for the Academy. Accalon of Felix's Watch was elected Ambassador to the Sumaah Republic.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Skarsind College of Warcasting gained a ministry, and its Preceptor is now chosen by the Imperial Orcs' Bourse voting style. The Legion Engineer commissioned the Twilight Demesne in Skarsind.

Navarr.t: Navarri senators secured the outlawing of the Hand of Dumon and the reform of virtue assembly membership. The Advisor on the Vallorn, Nathair Autumngale, commissioned research into the Feverwater and its docks of Terunael origin.

The Brass Coast.t: A new Freeborn army, the Burning Falcon, is to be raised, and its general will carry the Flame Rampant banner. The Master of the Koboldi, Sagua i'Ezmara, announced the improvement of the Court of the White Fountain.

The League.t: The mana ministries in Tassato, Sarvos and Temeschwar are to be upgraded for 200 thrones, and the Pelican Tower is to be built in Foracci. League citizens were elected Ambassador to the Commonwealth and Ambassador to Faraden.

The Marches.t: Bregasland received 400 thrones for resupply and the Breadbasket's prosperity, and a Bounders Hall was commissioned in Sarcombe. Upwold lost the Moonwater Hall, and Bernard Dugdale became Imperial Spymaster.

Thule.t: The Senate appointed Yevgeni Katzev of Varushka as Ambassador to Otkodov, the Empire's envoy to the Thule.

Urizen.t: Urizen gains the Churnspire in Peregro, a restored Great Harbour of Elos and an improved Court of the White Fountain. The Court's new Captain of the Fountain's Guard is to be chosen by Urizen's generals.

Varushka.t: The Ketsov family settled in Karsk around the Mir Mozga, and Ossium was given the wealth of the Lomaa in place of mine expansion. The Iron Roads are to be extended into Ossium and the Korotny docks expanded.

Wintermark.t: Hufi's Garden was commissioned, which will create the Woundbinder of the Mark, and 80 thrones went towards the Imperial Seer's scrying. The Grimnir of Wittal Grove title was kept, and the Talon of Kauppahall is now appointed by Tally of the Votes.

384YE Spring Equinox Senate sessions.o: At the Spring Equinox 384YE the Senate debated a long slate of motions. It raised a new Brass Coast army, outlawed the Hand of Dumon, appointed several ambassadors and an Imperial Spymaster, and commissioned many great works across the Empire.

Kallavesa/Wittal Grove.t: The Senate declined to abrogate the Grimnir of Wittal Grove title. The title was instead amended to state that it is intended to be held by a grimnir.

Morrow/Peregro.t: The Churnspire, a tower taller than Pakaanan's Pass, is to be built in Peregro and ceded to the eternal Meraud.

Ossium/Drownbark Forest.t: Sharing the wealth of the Lomaa removes the Underpopulated quality from the Drownbark Forest.

Redoubt/Naris.t: The Great Harbour of Elos in Naris is to be restored, which will create the Elosian Architect.

Sarvos/Foracci.t: The self-funded Pelican Tower sinecure is to be built in Foracci, creating the Custodian of the Pelican Tower.

Astolat.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator proposed the Towerjacks improvement and received the 140 thrones for it, and seconded the mana ministry upgrade.

Bastion.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator proposed the Churnspire and seconded the justicar sanctuary.

Bregasland.t: Bregasland's senator received 400 thrones for military and magical resupply. The Keeper of the Breadbasket allocated the Breadbasket's prosperity to Bregasland in recognition of its people's suffering.

Casinea.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator received 50 thrones for the Academy's training of children, and seconded funds for the Imperial Seer.

Feroz.t: A sanctuary for justicars is to be built on the Isle of the Osseini in Feroz, creating the Justicar of Osseini. The Imperial Guerdon was also assigned to the evacuation of Feroz.

Hahnmark.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator proposed Hufi's Garden and seconded the failed motion on Lepidean True Liao.

Hercynia.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator seconded the outlawing of the Hand of Dumon and proposed the Imperial Spymaster's appointment.

Holberg.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator's motion on the Butchers Bank debt was withdrawn, and Magdalena Teyhard von Holberg donated 28 thrones to the treasury.

Kahraman.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator proposed the justicar sanctuary and seconded the Grendel embassy.

Kallavesa.t: Kallavesa's senator received 80 thrones for the Imperial Seer's scrying. The Senate kept the Grimnir of Wittal Grove title for its healing house.

Karov.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator proposed inviting the Ketsov to establish a vale at Mir Mozga.

Karsk.t: The Ketsov family settled in Karsk around the Mir Mozga, opening dragonbone and forest resources to two titles. Pavel Novak announced an expansion of the Korotny docks, which will create the Harbourmaster of the Semmerlak.

Madruga.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator proposed raising the Burning Falcon and seconded the Axos treaty.

Miaren.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator proposed outlawing the Hand of Dumon and seconded the Burning Falcon.

Miekarova.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator proposed sharing the wealth of the Lomaa and seconded other motions.

Mitwold.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator proposed disseminating Lowther's Gaze and seconded the Ambassador to Faraden.

Morrow.t: A tower, the Churnspire, is to be built in Peregro and ceded to Meraud. It will create the Churnspire Adjutor, a title elected by Urizen's mages. Morrow's senator also proposed the change to the Imperial Magus title.

Mournwold.t: Mournwold's senator proposed the Bounders Hall in Sarcombe and seconded the Bregasland resupply. The Bounders Hall will create the Bailiff of the Downs.

Necropolis.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator's motion to appraise Grendel prisoners failed, and it seconded the Sumaah ambassador.

Ossium.t: Ossium gave up any expansion of the Crawling Depths in exchange for the Lomaa's wealth spreading prosperity across the territory. The Iron Roads are to be extended there, with labour costs raised by its under-developed state. The Ketsov family left Ossium to settle in Karsk.

Redoubt.t: The Great Harbour of Elos is to be restored for 300 thrones. The Court of the White Fountain is being made unbreakable, and a Captain of the Fountain's Guard will be created.

Reikos.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator proposed abrogating Moonwater Hall and seconded the Imperial Magus amendment.

Sarvos.t: Sarvos's mana ministry is to be upgraded, and Achille di Sarvos announced the Pelican Tower in Foracci. Its senator also proposed the Axos treaty, which drew constitutional reservations.

Segura.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator proposed electing the Ambassador to the Sumaah Republic.

Semmerholm.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator seconded the abrogation of Moonwater Hall.

Skarsind.t: The Warcaster College of Skarsind gained a ministry and a new method of appointment. The Legion Engineer commissioned the Twilight Demesne mana sinecure in Skarsind.

Spiral.t: The Imperial Spymaster commissioned a unique spy network at the Spire of Oblivion's Edge, ceded to the eternal Sung. The Constitutional Court has raised a concern about it for the Summer Solstice.

Tassato.t: Tassato's mana ministry is to be upgraded as part of the Grandmaster Ministries expansion its senator proposed.

Temeschwar.t: Temeschwar's mana ministry is to be upgraded. Its senator also proposed the Sarangrave slave uprising appraisal.

Therunin.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator proposed the virtue assembly reform and the Ambassador to the Commonwealth.

Upwold.t: The Faraden trade hub of Moonwater Hall in Upwold was abrogated.

Volodmartz.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator proposed the Great Harbour of Elos and seconded the Iron Roads extension.

Weirwater.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator seconded the expansion of the Skarsind College of Warcasting.

384YE Spring Equinox interlude.d: The Imperial Guerdon stood at 350 thrones, shared among units supporting the Strong Reeds, Bloodcloaks, Summer Storm and Wolves of War. Mandates gave Highborn units cheaper upgrades, boosted Wintermark raiders and rewarded Dawnish units supporting armies engaged in Dark Ranging in Brocéliande. Veterans of Hercynia and Therunin were still recovering. Units could raid, settle or explore Ossium. Trade suffered with Asavea and Issyk, Jarmish and Iron Confederacy ports were closed, and the Commonwealth and Sarcophan Delves offered extras. Fleets could carry freed orcs out of Axos. The magistrates' hunt for followers of Yaw'nagrah cost every mana site one crystal mana, and several mandates altered congregations' votes and liao.

Dawn.t: Dawnish military units supporting Dawnish, Highborn or Navarr armies engaged in Dark Ranging gained an extra crown and two herbs until the Winter Solstice 384YE, and Dawnish congregations gained one liao and two votes under the Love, Glory, and Virtue mandate.

Druj.t: Imperial units in Ossium were offered the chance to raid Druj insurgents and their resource caches, and to bring former Druj slaves and freed human settlements into Varushka.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: the temple in Grendel-held Feroz is noted as one of two Asavean temples whose presence might have offset the losses from trade sanctions.

Highguard.t: Highborn units could upgrade for one fewer wain of mithril until the Autumn Equinox 384YE. Highborn congregations gained liao and votes through cooperation with Dawn but lost two votes and one liao to the call to fight the vallorn.

Navarr.t: Units that fought to protect the Navarr territories of Hercynia and Therunin were still recovering until the Summer Solstice, and Navarr armies engaged in Dark Ranging could draw Dawnish units with extra rewards.

The League.t: Congregations in Temeschwar and Tassato gained two votes and one liao under the anti-idolatry mandate enacted by Rafael Barossa di Tassato, for as long as the Synod clearly opposes idolatry.

Urizen.t: Congregations in Redoubt gained two votes and one liao under the Reject False Gods mandate, and fourteen rituals were added to Urizen lore during the Winter Solstice.

Varushka.t: Units were invited to cement Imperial control of Ossium by raiding, settling or exploring it, and Varushkan mine and forest production rose by one rank until the Spring Equinox under Raskylov's mandate.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark units that raided the Jotun-held Pride of Ikka's Tears gained a two-rank morale bonus from Rafe's mandate, and Hahnmark congregations gained two votes and one liao.

384YE Spring Equinox interlude.o: The Spring Equinox 384YE interlude set out the effects carried into downtime from the Winter Solstice, covering military bonuses and penalties, a special campaign to secure Ossium, changed trade conditions with foreign nations, and nationwide magical and religious effects.

Brocéliande/Dark Ranging.t: Dawnish military units supporting Dawnish, Highborn or Navarr armies engaged in Dark Ranging gained one extra crown and two random herbs until the Winter Solstice 384YE.

Brocéliande.t: Although the vallorn here had become quiescent, Highborn congregations were urged to keep opposing it, and Dawnish units supporting armies engaged in Dark Ranging earned extra rewards.

Feroz.t: Mentioned in passing: the temple in Feroz is named as one of two Asavean temples that could have offset the losses from trade sanctions.

Hahnmark.t: Congregations in Hahnmark gained two votes and one liao while the Synod clearly opposes idolatry, because of the forced redesign of buildings by the Asavean architect.

Hercynia.t: Units that fought in the campaign to protect Hercynia suffered a two-rank penalty until the start of the Summer Solstice 384YE.
