Karsk.t: Congregations in Karsk received four extra votes and two liao until the Spring Equinox, then the standard anti-idolatry bonus, and units settling Ossium could guard Varushkan traders heading east from Karsk.

Ossium.t: Military units could raid Druj insurgents, help freed slaves establish vales, or explore dark places and contact non-Druj orcs, each action contributing to firmer Imperial control.

Redoubt.t: Congregations in Redoubt gained two votes and one liao for as long as the Synod clearly stands against idolatry.

Tassato.t: Congregations in Tassato gained two votes and one liao for as long as the Synod clearly stands against idolatry.

Temeschwar.t: Congregations in Temeschwar gained two votes and one liao for as long as the Synod clearly stands against idolatry.

Therunin.t: Units that fought in the campaign to protect Therunin suffered a one-rank penalty until the start of the Summer Solstice 384YE.

384YE Spring Equinox winds of fortune.d: Feroz's borders closed after the treaty's six months, leaving many Freeborn trapped unless rescued by sea. Spiral's cooperation with the Salt Lord halted the Citadel Guard's decline. Three Highborn armies attacked in Zenith, where some two thousand freed Winter spirits lingered. Ossium became indelibly Varushkan, except the Bonewood and Webwood ceded to the Thule. Sarvos became the City of Masks, the Holmauer Gate was consecrated in Holberg, and the Lepidean University in Bastion was completed. The koboldi warned of trogoni beneath Lorenzo's Deep Pockets, requiring a Red Iron Door. Navarr marched to Liathaven seeking the Heirs of Terunael, and the Brass Coast's Tally of the Votes was opened to all fleet owners.

Dawn.t: The Highborn accepted the Dawnish gauntlet and announced a grand cathleon to conquer the Barrens, giving Dawnish priests a chance to respond, while Dawnish knights joined the settlement of Ossium.

Druj.t: Three Highborn armies returned to Zenith to drive the Druj out, and the proposed Urizen fortifications in Zenith remained largely theoretical while the Druj held it.

Grendel.t: The Grendel closed Feroz's borders, still traded through Oran and continued repatriating Imperial slaves, while cooperating warily with the Urizen of Spiral despite lingering ill feeling over traders robbed at Anvil.

Highguard.t: Three Highborn armies attacked in Zenith with unwavering Courage, and the Highborn National Assembly declared a grand cathleon for the Barrens and was due to appoint the first Lepidean Librarian in Bastion.

Imperial Orcs.t: Imperial Orcs were among the invited guests to a plenipotentiary parley, faced a Constitutional Court ruling on orc membership of the virtue assemblies, and learned how the mission to bring Axou orcs to the Empire had fared.

Jotun.t: The Marchers, aided by Navarr and Wintermark scouts, prepared a raid into Jotun-held Skallahn, and a large Navarr force set out for Jotun-held Liathaven to hunt the Heirs of Terunael.

Navarr.t: Navarr scouts helped identify raid targets in Skallahn, a large Navarr force volunteered to search Liathaven for the Heirs of Terunael, and Navarr Miaren lay near the threatened sinkhole.

The Brass Coast.t: With Feroz's borders closed, many Freeborn remained trapped awaiting an evacuation by sea, and the Tally of the Votes for Freeborn titles was changed to include all fleet owners rather than only privateers.

The League.t: Sarvos was remade as the City of Masks, Holberg saw the consecration of the Holmauer Gate, and League Temeschwar was among the territories threatened by trogoni from the sinkhole.

The Marches.t: Marcher folk prepared to take the fight to the Jotun with a raid on Skallahn, the Marcher Assembly faced a choice over the threshers, and Upwold lay near the threatened sinkhole.

Thule.t: Mentioned in passing: the Bonewood and Webwood in Ossium are noted as ceded by the Senate to the allied Thule orcs.

Urizen.t: Urizen saw fortifications appraised for all four of its territories, cooperation with the Grendel in Spiral that halted the Citadel Guard's decline, Highborn armies fighting alongside it in Zenith, and a new Broken Shore Mithril Market completed in Redoubt.

Varushka.t: Ossium became indelibly Varushkan with vales spreading across the territory, though a canker lurked in Karsk, and Varushka was named among the nations facing opportunities and challenges in Zenith.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark folk were among the invited guests to a plenipotentiary, Wintermark scouts aided the Skallahn raid, Hahnmark lay near the threatened sinkhole, and Wintermark fleets favoured the Grendel port of Oran.

384YE Spring Equinox winds of fortune.o: The Spring Equinox 384YE winds of fortune set out the season's developments across the Empire: the replies to six archmages' plenipotentiaries, an evacuation opportunity in Grendel-held Feroz, cautious cooperation with the Grendel in Spiral, a planned Marcher raid on Jotun Skallahn, a Highborn offensive in Zenith, Varushkan settlement of Ossium and a threat beneath Lorenzo's Deep Pockets.

Feroz/Afarjasse.t: The six months the Grendel treaty allowed Imperial citizens to leave Afarjasse expired and the borders closed, leaving those remaining trapped without outside help.

Feroz/Morajasse.t: The six-month window for Imperial citizens to leave Morajasse ended with the borders closed, making rescue by sea the only way out.

Feroz/Oranseri.t: The formerly Imperial port of Oran, now wholly under Grendel control, stayed open to Imperial fleets and proved especially popular with Wintermark captains.

Holberg/Holmauer.t: The Holmauer Gate was consecrated with true liao, accompanied by powerful spiritual events intended to remind Holberg of its wonders.

Ossium/Bonewood.t: Mentioned in passing: the Bonewood is noted as ceded to the Thule and excluded from Varushkan settlement.

Ossium/Webwood.t: Mentioned in passing: the Webwood is noted as ceded to the Thule and excluded from Varushkan settlement.

Bastion.t: Work on the Lepidean University in Bastion was completed, with the first Lepidean Librarian due to be appointed and a dose of true liao made available to the Synod.

Bay of Catazar.t: Mentioned in passing: Spiral is described as lying across the Bay of Catazar from Feroz, and the Grendel are called the orcs of the Bay.

Feroz.t: The Grendel closed Feroz's borders after the six-month grace period, leaving many Imperial citizens trapped, though a spy network built with Shantarim corsair families offered a way to evacuate them.

Hahnmark.t: Part of Hahnmark was swallowed by Lorenzo's Deep Pockets, and the koboldi warned that trogoni swarming in the sinkhole could pour out at any moment.

Holberg.t: Severin Teyhard von Holberg came to Holberg with true liao to consecrate the Holmauer Gate, amid local fears that the city was cursed.

Karsk.t: Mentioned in passing: a canker lurking in Karsk is noted as a threat the Varushkans must deal with.

Liathaven.t: A large Navarr force volunteered to go to Liathaven to test the theory that the Heirs of Terunael are based there.

Miaren.t: Part of Miaren was swallowed by Lorenzo's Deep Pockets, which the koboldi warned now hid swarming trogoni that could devastate the surrounding lands.

Mournwold.t: Mentioned in passing: the Mournwold's devastation by Imperial curses three years earlier is cited as the root of the thresher debate.

Ossium.t: Backed by two Imperial armies and a host of helpers, the Varushkans carved out vales across Ossium, making it indelibly Varushkan apart from the Bonewood and Webwood.

Redoubt.t: Redoubt received a surprising suggestion for increasing its Prosperity, fortifications were appraised for the Architects of Stone at Delving, and the Broken Shore Mithril Market was completed at Cargo.

Sarvos.t: With the Hag Queen's doom lifted, Sarvos became the City of Masks and was quickly gaining a reputation as the most elegant city in the known world.

Skallahn.t: Marcher raiders, guided by Navarr and Wintermark scouts, prepared to strike targets in Skallahn, with the aims yet to be chosen between military, economic and spiritual.

Spiral.t: Spiral's Urizen cautiously cooperated with the Grendel occupiers, halting the Citadel Guard's decline, though bad feeling over traders robbed at Anvil still had to be addressed.

Temeschwar.t: Part of Temeschwar was swallowed by Lorenzo's Deep Pockets, which the koboldi warned now threatened an outpouring of trogoni.

Upwold.t: Part of Upwold was swallowed by Lorenzo's Deep Pockets, and the koboldi warned that trogoni swarming below could devastate it.

Zenith.t: Three Highborn armies attacked the Druj in Zenith, where some two thousand freed Winter spirits remained, and fortifications proposed for the territory were largely theoretical.

384YE Spring Equinox winds of war.d: The Lasambrian Jotun left Segura, freeing Anduz, then raided Kahraman to secure Gambit. Bregasland stayed quiet as Mathilda Fisher's warband grew. In the Mournwold the Bounders sealed Whittle, admitting only Marchers and angering the magistrates. Eisa Winterborn's Jotun collapsed the western end of Pakaanan's Pass, destroying the Clattering Gulley and the Krampushall, then withdrew into Sermersuaq. There the Empire and Otkodov freed East Floes and pushed the Jotun west. The Druj overran the last Imperial outposts in Ulnak. In Zenith the Empire was about halfway to a beachhead in Clypion, though unliving former Imperials hunted soldiers and the Druj attempted a ritual in Proceris. Four battle opportunities were identified for the summit.

Dawn.t: Dawnish armies had withdrawn from the Forest of Ulnak, and the few outposts they left behind fell silent when the Druj swept back in.

Druj.t: The Druj retook all Imperial-held ground in the Forest of Ulnak. In Zenith they lost ground around Clypion, but they set tormented unliving slaves on the Imperials and began a sinister working in Proceris.

Imperial Orcs.t: The western end of Pakaanan's Pass in their Skarsind homeland was collapsed, and the Clattering Gulley and the Krampushall were destroyed. Movement to Sermersuaq was cut off except through Thule-controlled passes.

Jotun.t: The Lasambrian Jotun abandoned Segura but assaulted Gambit in Kahraman. In the north, Eisa Winterborn's forces completed their mission in Skarsind but were driven west across Sermersuaq.

Navarr.t: Mentioned in passing: the summary describes flying past Navarr hearths on the way to Zenith.

The Brass Coast.t: Segura was fully freed when the Jotun withdrew and Anduz was liberated, but Kahraman then came under Jotun assault aimed at Gambit and the town of Rojota.

The Marches.t: Bregasland had a quiet season as Mathilda Fisher's warband grew. In the Mournwold the Bounders sealed Whittle to all but Marchers, angering the magistrates pursuing the heretics there.

Thule.t: The orcs of Otkodov fought alongside the Empire to free East Floes, but they gave no sign that Imperial troops could move freely through their northern passes.

Urizen.t: Imperial armies, including the Citadel Guard with an ensnaring Autumn working, advanced toward a beachhead in Clypion as the fight for Zenith turned in the Empire's favour.

Varushka.t: Varushkan armies had withdrawn from the Forest of Ulnak, leaving outposts that were overrun by the Druj.

Wintermark.t: Imperial armies and their Thule allies freed East Floes and pushed the Jotun west across the Suaq homeland. The pass between Hahnmark and Skarsind remained open.

384YE Spring Equinox winds of war.o: In the run-up to the 384YE Spring Equinox, the Jotun withdrew from Segura but struck into Kahraman, collapsed part of Pakaanan's Pass in Skarsind, and were pushed back across Sermersuaq. In the east the Druj retook the Forest of Ulnak while Imperial armies made headway in Zenith.

Kahraman/Gambit.t: The Jotun focused their assault on securing Gambit, and the Empire was offered a chance to stop a Yegarra force bound for Rojota.

Sermersuaq/East Floes.t: Imperial and Otkodov forces freed East Floes, though the collapsed pass now blocks direct movement to Skarsind.

Sermersuaq/Silver Peaks.t: Movement between the Silver Peaks and Crow's Ridge depends on the Thule, who gave no indication that Imperial troops could pass freely.

Skarsind/Crow’s Ridge.t: With the pass blocked, the only route from Skarsind to Sermersuaq ran through Thule-controlled passes such as that between Crow's Ridge and the Silver Peaks.

Skarsind/Pakaanan's Pass.t: Eisa Winterborn's Jotun collapsed the western end of the pass and destroyed the Clattering Gulley and the Krampushall, blocking movement to East Floes until it is cleared.

Zenith/Clypion.t: Imperial armies were roughly halfway to a beachhead, and the Citadel Guard's ensnaring Autumn magic restricted the Druj armies there.

Zenith/Proceris.t: The Druj were attempting a terrible magical working in the ruined marshes with ghulai aid, and a battle opportunity was offered to intercept the ghulai supplying the Tainted Basilisk ritualists.

Bregasland.t: Both the Jotun and the Imperial armies stayed on the defensive and no territory changed hands, while disgruntled Bregas quietly swelled Mathilda Fisher's warband.

Brocéliande.t: Mentioned in passing: the summary refers to the twisted madness at the heart of Brocéliande on the way south to Zenith.

Forest of Ulnak.t: A major Druj force from the south overran the remaining Imperial outposts, and there is no longer any Imperial presence in the forest.

Hahnmark.t: The pass between Hahnmark and Skarsind remained open despite the extensive destruction in Pakaanan's Pass.

Kahraman.t: The Lasambrian Jotun launched an assault focused on Gambit, and a battle opportunity was offered to intercept a Yegarra force moving on the town of Rojota.

Morrow.t: Mentioned in passing: the summary passes between Morrow's peaks on its way to Zenith.

Mournwold.t: The Bounders formed a ring of steel around Whittle, letting no one leave and admitting only Marcher magistrates and militia, which angered the magistrates pursuing the sect of Hatred.

Otkodov.t: The orcs of Otkodov fought with the Empire in Sermersuaq but made no indication that Imperial troops could move freely through their passes.

Sarangrave.t: Mentioned in passing: ghulai from the Sarangrave's swamps were aiding the Druj ritual in Proceris.

Segura.t: The Jotun withdrew entirely, allowing Imperial armies to liberate Anduz and remove all trace of the invaders.

Sermersuaq.t: The Empire and Otkodov freed East Floes and drove the Jotun west, and a battle opportunity was offered to destroy a Jotun fortification with Thule ritual magic.

Skarsind.t: The Jotun collapsed the western end of Pakaanan's Pass, destroying the Clattering Gulley and the Krampushall and cutting the direct route to East Floes.

Upwold.t: Mentioned in passing: the Tusks were billeted in Upwold.

Zenith.t: The campaign turned in the Empire's favour, but unliving former Imperials and the miasma complicated the liberation. Two battle opportunities targeted miasma pillars and a Druj ritual.

384YE Summer Solstice Imperial elections.d: National elections returned senators for Bastion (Ehud), Karov (Vuk The Wolfeater), Miaren (Llewellyn Leafstalker), Mitwold (William Lowther), Redoubt (Sejanus), Sarvos (Shauni di Vergo), Sermersuaq (Atte Arrow-Tongue Metsastajason) and Weirwater (Baldwin). The Senate appointed Jarrigk Orzel as Imperial Consul and named generals for ten armies, among other posts. The Synod chose Lady Clarice Novarion as Cardinal of Courage and Hembeneth i Guerra as Cardinal of Wisdom, plus inquisitors and other religious titles. Bourse auctions and votes settled ministries such as the Night Quarry (540 thrones) and the Mistress of the Glass Parador. Cadogan Stranger's Song became Grandmaster of the Order of the Unfettered Mind.

Dawn.t: Dawn returned Baldwin as Senator for Weirwater in its national election at this summit.

Highguard.t: Highguard returned Ehud as Senator for Bastion in its national election at this summit.

Navarr.t: Navarr returned Llewellyn Leafstalker as Senator for Miaren in its national election at this summit.

The League.t: The League returned Shauni di Vergo as Senator for Sarvos in its national election at this summit.

The Marches.t: The Marches returned William Lowther as Senator for Mitwold in its national election at this summit.

Urizen.t: Urizen returned Sejanus as Senator for Redoubt in its national election at this summit.

Varushka.t: Varushka returned Vuk The Wolfeater as Senator for Karov in its national election at this summit.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark returned Atte Arrow-Tongue Metsastajason as Senator for Sermersuaq in its national election at this summit.

384YE Summer Solstice Imperial elections.o: At the 384YE Summer Solstice summit, a wide range of Imperial titles changed hands through national elections, Senate appointments, Synod judgements, Bourse auctions and votes, and other processes, including eight new senators.

Bastion.t: Ehud was elected Senator for Bastion, taking up its seat in the Imperial Senate.

Karov.t: Vuk The Wolfeater was elected Senator for Karov, taking up its seat in the Imperial Senate.

Miaren.t: Llewellyn Leafstalker was elected Senator for Miaren, taking up its seat in the Imperial Senate.

Mitwold.t: William Lowther was elected Senator for Mitwold, taking up its seat in the Imperial Senate.

Redoubt.t: Sejanus was elected Senator for Redoubt, taking up its seat in the Imperial Senate.

Sarvos.t: Shauni di Vergo was elected Senator for Sarvos, taking up its seat in the Imperial Senate.

Sermersuaq.t: Atte Arrow-Tongue Metsastajason was elected Senator for Sermersuaq, taking up its seat in the Imperial Senate.

Weirwater.t: Baldwin was elected Senator for Weirwater, taking up its seat in the Imperial Senate.

384YE Summer Solstice Senate sessions.d: The Senate amended the Liberty Pact to add an embargo on Jarm and free trade between signatories. It created the Imperial Administrator, Imperial Warcaster, Spiral Envoy and Archivist of the Echoing Obelisk titles, and stripped the Warmage of arranging magical assistance for armies. It disbursed 150 thrones for the Towerjacks and 55 thrones 6 crowns for William Lowther's resupply. The first raid motion failed and the second passed; the raid later succeeded. Nine commissions passed, including Ratibor's Gate Shrine, the White Roads and the Zemress Naval Academy, alongside wayleave projects such as Greenwood Manor. An appraisal of a non-human Throne failed.

Dawn.t: Jarrigk Orzel of Dawn was elected Imperial Consul, and Greenwood Manor in Semmerholm creates two titles elected by the Dawnish National Assembly. Astolat secured 150 thrones for the Towerjacks.

Druj.t: Mentioned in passing: the Highwatch Citadel expansion will provide vis and pearls to enchant an Imperial army attacking the Druj.

Highguard.t: The Highguard National Assembly will appoint the new Archivist of the Echoing Obelisk. The White Roads of Virtue's Path and the Garden of the Imperial Auxiliaries were commissioned in Highguard territories.

Imperial Orcs.t: Mentioned in passing: Skarsind's senator seconded the Angelica Memorial House of Healing, and Skarsind is noted as relinquished by Wintermark in 380YE.

Jotun.t: Mentioned in passing: the Pride of Ikka's Tears is noted as having been lost to the Empire in war with the Jotun.

Navarr.t: Navarr gained a bladeroot sinecure in Hercynia, whose Steward of the Nabarr is appointed by Navarr senators, and a fortified steading at Mudlark's Haven in Therunin.

The Brass Coast.t: The Zemress Naval Academy was commissioned in Madruga, and a wayleave created the Crimson Sutannir title, elected by the Brass Coast National Assembly. Brass Coast senators also proposed the Archivist title and the successful raid motion.

The League.t: League senators won commissions for Ratibor's Gate Shrine in Temeschwar, the Blood Red River Museum in Tassato, the walls of Holberg and a House of Healing in Sarvos, creating several League-appointed titles.

The Marches.t: Watt of Lambrook was elected Advisor for the Feni, and 55 thrones 6 crowns went to Senator Mitwold for William Lowther's resupply. The Marchers' proposal to appraise a non-human Throne failed.

Urizen.t: Urizen senators created the Spiral Envoy, though its appointment by them was ruled unconstitutional. A wayleave created the Polemarch of Highwatch, elected by Urizen senators.

Varushka.t: Vaclav Mladenovich Kosti was elected Minister of Historical Research and sent researchers to the Palace of Orieb. Karov's first raid motion failed, while Ossium proposed the Imperial Warcaster.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark was reassigned the territory of Sermersuaq and given the Pride of Ikka's Tears as its sole national bourse seat.

384YE Summer Solstice Senate sessions.o: At the Summer Solstice 384YE the Senate assigned Sermersuaq and the Pride of Ikka's Tears to Wintermark, legalised Imperial participation in a Liberty Pact raid on an Asavean trade centre, declared neutrality between Jarm and the Commonwealth, and passed a long slate of new titles and commissions.

Madruga/Torres.t: A wayleave announced the Crimson Drummers sinecure in Torres, funded by Ahraz i Guerra, to produce liao and Synod votes under a tenured Crimson Sutannir.

Astolat.t: Astolat's senator proposed and received 150 thrones from the treasury to improve the Towerjacks.

Bastion.t: The White Roads of Virtue's Path will run through Bastion, whose senator also proposed amending the Warmage's duties.

Casinea.t: Mentioned in passing: Casinea's senator proposed the White Roads commission and seconded Ratibor's Gate Shrine.

Hahnmark.t: Mentioned in passing: Hahnmark's senator proposed allocating the Pride of Ikka's Tears and seconded assigning Sermersuaq to Wintermark.

Hercynia.t: A bladeroot sinecure was commissioned at Old Ranging in Hercynia, creating the title of Steward of the Nabarr.

Holberg.t: The Senate commissioned fortification of Holberg's walls, funded by its own citizens. Magdalena Teyhard von Holberg also donated 28 thrones to the treasury.

Kahraman.t: Mentioned in passing: Kahraman's senator proposed the Zemress Naval Academy and seconded the Liberty Pact amendment.

Karov.t: Mentioned in passing: Karov's senator proposed the failed first Asavean raid motion and seconded the Minister of Historical Research appointment.

Karsk.t: Mentioned in passing: Karsk's senator proposed the appraisal of an Architectural University and seconded the failed first raid motion.

Madruga.t: The Zemress Naval Academy, a self-funded school of naval warfare, was commissioned in Madruga, and a liao sinecure was announced for its Torres region.

Miaren.t: Mentioned in passing: Miaren's senator seconded the Warmage amendment and proposed the Imperial Consul appointment.

Miekarova.t: Mentioned in passing: Miekarova's senator seconded the Architectural University appraisal and proposed the Minister of Historical Research appointment.

Mitwold.t: Mentioned in passing: Mitwold's senator proposed and received 55 thrones 6 crowns for William Lowther's resupply, and seconded the bladeroot sinecure.

Morrow.t: Mentioned in passing: Morrow's senator proposed ceding the Eleonaris statue and seconded the Spiral Envoy.

Mournwold.t: Mentioned in passing: Mournwold's senator proposed the failed non-human Throne appraisal and seconded the resupply funds.

Necropolis.t: The Garden of the Imperial Auxiliaries was commissioned in Coursmouth, and the White Roads will pass through Necropolis.

Ossium.t: Mentioned in passing: Ossium's senator proposed the Imperial Warcaster and seconded the Sodality, and the Eleonaris statue honours victories in Ossium.

Redoubt.t: Mentioned in passing: Redoubt's senator proposed the Spiral Envoy and seconded ceding the Eleonaris statue.

Reikos.t: The White Roads will extend into Reikos, whose senator also proposed the Liberty Pact amendment and seconded the successful raid motion.

Sarvos.t: A House of Healing sinecure in memory of Angelica Vergo di Sarvos was commissioned in Riposi to grow herbs for the League. It remains under additional scrutiny.

Segura.t: Mentioned in passing: Segura's senator proposed the successful Asavean raid motion and seconded the Archivist title.

Semmerholm.t: Greenwood Manor will be built and the Greenwood Market renovated in Semmerholm. A statue to Eleonaris will stand at its end of the Golden Causeway.

Skarsind.t: Mentioned in passing: Skarsind's senator seconded the Sarvos House of Healing, and Skarsind is noted as relinquished by Wintermark in 380YE.

Tassato.t: The Senate authorised rebuilding the Blood Red River Museum in Tassato, creating the Curator of the Blood Red River. There is concern that the title would grant Synod votes.

Temeschwar.t: Ratibor's Gate was to be consecrated with an inspirational tomb and a Watcher of Ratibor's Torch. An appraisal of an Architectural University in Temeschwar was also commissioned.

Therunin.t: A fortified steading called Mudlark's Haven was commissioned in the Feverwater.

Upwold.t: Mentioned in passing: Upwold's senator proposed the Feni advisor appointment, and the Old Morgan under research may have come from Upwold.

Volodmartz.t: Mentioned in passing: Volodmartz's senator proposed the lineage Sodality and seconded the Holberg walls commission.

Weirwater.t: Mentioned in passing: Weirwater's senator proposed reassuring the Great Forest Orcs over the Heart of Peytaht and seconded the Towerjacks funding.

384YE Summer Solstice interlude.d: The 350-throne Guerdon was shared among units supporting the Green Shield, Wolves of War, Citadel Guard and the Feroz, Isember and Hotters Mire opportunities. Military units and fleets could stealthily evacuate citizens from Feroz to Segura and Madruga, raid Jotun-held Skallahn, fight the Isember bandits troubling southern Karsk and Ossium, surround the Feni settlement of Hotters Mire in Liathaven, or venture into the Twisted Woods. Navarr, Dawn, the Brass Coast, Urizen and Varushka disavowed the Skallahn raid. Other effects included mana site disruption from the hunt for followers of Yaw'nagrah, Highborn congregations aiding the fight against the vallorn, congregation bonuses from the Reject False Gods mandate, and the Sand Fisher tithe in Holberg.

Dawn.t: Dawnish units supporting Dawnish, Highborn or Navarr armies engaged in Dark Ranging gained an extra crown and two herbs until the Winter Solstice 384YE, and were among the most effective in the Twisted Woods. Dawn disavowed the Skallahn raid, halving its units' effectiveness there but sparing the nation any penalty.

Grendel.t: The Grendel held Feroz, and the Imperial evacuation of citizens from the territory was a stealthy mission designed to avoid conflict with them wherever possible.

Highguard.t: Thanks to the Three Watchers, Highborn military units could be upgraded for one fewer wain of mithril until the Autumn Equinox. Highborn congregations produced two fewer votes and one fewer liao but could aid any opportunity to fight the vallorn.

Jotun.t: The Jotun were the target of a surprise Imperial raid on Skallahn. For every 10,000 strength committed, they would be unable to provide emergency resupply to their armies for one season.

Navarr.t: Units that had fought to protect Hercynia and Therunin were still recovering from casualties until the Summer Solstice. Navarr disavowed the Skallahn raid, and Navarr armies engaged in Dark Ranging could draw boosted Dawnish support.

The Brass Coast.t: Imperial units and fleets could help evacuate citizens from Feroz to safety in Segura and Madruga. The Brass Coast disavowed the Skallahn raid.

The League.t: Congregations in Tassato and Temeschwar gained two votes and one liao while the Synod opposed idolatry. Farms in Holberg received herbs from the Sand Fisher orcs.

Urizen.t: Urizen disavowed the Skallahn raid. Aspect of the Mountain, Crown of Phoenix Fire and A Perfect Moment were added to Urizen lore, and congregations in Redoubt gained extra votes and liao.

Varushka.t: The Varushkan National Assembly urged every unit not supporting an army or fortification to tackle the Isember bandits, halving the effectiveness of other actions. Varushkans were also most effective in the Twisted Woods and disavowed the Skallahn raid.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark fleets could support the Skallahn raid at full effectiveness, and congregations in Hahnmark gained two votes and one liao under the Reject False Gods mandate.

384YE Summer Solstice interlude.o: Following the Spring Equinox 384YE, a round-up of effects and opportunities shaping the coming season was set out. These included the Imperial Guerdon allocation, special military and fleet missions in Feroz, Skallahn, Karsk, Liathaven and the Twisted Woods, and various national and Synod-driven effects.

Brocéliande/Dark Ranging.t: Under Ranae deRondell's mandate, Dawnish units supporting a Dawnish, Highborn or Navarr army engaged in Dark Ranging gained an extra crown and two random herbs until the Winter Solstice 384YE.

Brocéliande.t: The vallorn of Brocéliande had become quiescent but remained a threat. Dawnish units supporting armies engaged in Dark Ranging there earned extra rewards, and Highborn congregations were encouraged to keep opposing it.

Feroz.t: Imperial military units and fleets could join a stealthy evacuation of citizens unable to reach the coast, avoiding the occupying Grendel as much as possible.

Hahnmark.t: Congregations in Hahnmark gained two extra votes and one extra liao as long as the Synod stood clearly against idolatry, following the forcible redesign of Asavean-designed buildings.

Hercynia.t: Units that had fought to protect Hercynia suffered a two-rank penalty while recovering, lasting until the start of the Summer Solstice.

Holberg.t: Farms in Holberg received two random herbs each season as a tithe from the Sand Fisher orcs.

Karsk.t: The Isember bandits threatened the vales of southern Karsk, and military units could fight them and claim their loot. Karsk congregations also gained two votes and one liao under the Reject False Gods mandate.

Liathaven.t: Scouts of the Liathaven spy network uncovered an opportunity to surround the Feni settlement of Hotters Mire, rewarding participating units with spring vis.

Madruga.t: Madruga was one of the places of safety for citizens being evacuated from Feroz.

Ossium.t: Settlement of Ossium was being impeded by the Isember bandits. If the Tower of the Manticore were built there, the Into the Twisted Woods action would become permanently available to Dawn and Varushka.

Redoubt.t: Congregations in Redoubt gained two extra votes and one extra liao while the Synod maintained a clear anti-idolatry stance.

Segura.t: Segura was one of the places of safety for citizens being evacuated from Feroz.

Skallahn.t: The Empire could launch a surprise raid into Skallahn, taking metals, forest materials and bourse resources. The Marcher assembly urged raiders to focus on military targets.

Tassato.t: Tassato congregations gained two votes and one liao under the Reject False Gods mandate, enacted by Rafael Barossa di Tassato.

Temeschwar.t: Congregations in Temeschwar gained two extra votes and one extra liao while the Synod maintained a clear stance against idolatry.

Therunin.t: Units that had fought to protect Therunin suffered a one-rank penalty while recovering, lasting until the start of the Summer Solstice.

384YE Summer Solstice winds of fortune.d: Six eternals answered the archmages' plenipotentiary messages, and the Summer tourney for the Icy Crag reached its climax. Imperial fleets and units smuggled trapped citizens out of Feroz, infuriating Governor Rahab. Moonwater Hall's abrogation led to fires and a Faraden coup. An unnatural drought gripped the Empire while Syrene's Wisdom flooded with Winter-tainted water. Dawn pressed into the Barrens, the Zenith crusade continued, and the Skallahn raid yielded only loot. Elsewhere, Bounder's Hall opened in Sarcombe, Isaella's Dance was raised in Miaren, the magistrates crushed the Yaw'nagrah cults, and both thresher mandates took effect. Opportunities arose in Therunin, Redoubt, the Sarangrave and Tsark.

Dawn.t: Dawnish armies led the invasion of the Barrens from north and south after Dawn challenged the Imperial Orcs to a glorious contest, though the General Assembly was displeased; Glory Square also hosted the Summer tourney melee.

Druj.t: The Druj faced pressure on several fronts: an appraisal into stirring an uprising in the Sarangrave, the continuing Highborn crusade in Zenith, and Dawn cutting the Barrens in two.

Grendel.t: Governor Rahab was furious after Imperial forces smuggled citizens out of Feroz, while a Grendel Paymaster planned an audacious raid on Tsark and sanctions continued to penalise Imperial trade with Oran.

Highguard.t: The Citadel Guard and the Highborn crusade drove the Zenith invasion forward, while a Winter-tainted flood devastated Syrene's Wisdom in Casinea.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Imperial Orcs' ambition to claim the Barrens drew a challenge from Dawn, whose armies then moved quickly to seize the advantage there.

Jotun.t: The Imperial raid into Skallahn did little to harm the Jotun war effort, but the Empire could exploit what it learned with a second raid; meanwhile Imperial units lay in wait at Hotter's Mire in Jotun-held Liathaven.

Navarr.t: Navarr gained a third army, Isaella's Dance, in Miaren, while Therunin's brokers put forward new opportunities and Navarr were drawn into the Heirs of Terunael affair at Hotter's Mire and talks with visitors about Terunael relics.

The Brass Coast.t: Freeborn trapped in Feroz were successfully evacuated, Marracossan refugees took up residence in Madruga, and magistrates pursued smugglers operating across Segura and Kahraman.

The League.t: Mentioned in passing: Tassato priests and Rezia di Tassato are tagged in the Faraden developments, and Tassato is named as wealthy trading gateway near Sarcombe.

The Marches.t: The Marcher thresher mandate took effect, a Bounder's Hall opened in Sarcombe to protect Mournwold orcs, and the abrogation of Moonwater Hall in Upwold spiralled into fires and a Faraden coup.

Thule.t: Mentioned in passing: the Ambassador to Otkodov is among those tagged in connection with the drought and the Spring conjunction.

Urizen.t: The Urizen National Assembly warned of dire repercussions should the liberation of Zenith be left unfinished, the Shrine of the Armsmaster in Redoubt sparked new opportunities, and several rituals were added to Urizen lore.

Varushka.t: Mentioned in passing: the Varushkan Assembly is tagged regarding the Barrens, and the liberation of Ossium is cited when comparing the Druj miasma.

Wintermark.t: The Wintermark Assembly's concerns about building a fane prompted a proposal for a Conclave title to oversee them, while Winterfolk worried about their skeins after actions in Sermersuaq were coming to Anvil.

384YE Summer Solstice winds of fortune.o: The Summer Solstice 384YE Winds of Fortune gathered the season's major developments across the Empire, including the covert evacuation of Feroz, a drought and Spring conjunction, a flood at Syrene's Wisdom, Dawn's advance in the Barrens and an opportunity for a Grendel raid on Tsark.

Brocéliande/Terunael.t: Mentioned in passing: the defeat of the Heirs of Terunael in Brocéliande is credited in the Yaw'nagrah investigation, though the region is not named.

Feroz/Afarjasse.t: The grace period for Afarjasse's people to leave Feroz ended at the Spring Equinox, before the covert evacuation of the remaining citizens.

Feroz/Cazar Straits.t: Citizens trapped in the Cazar Straits, given no grace period to leave, were smuggled out under cover of darkness by Imperial fleets and units.

Feroz/Fontargenta.t: Citizens trapped in Fontargenta, denied any grace period, were successfully spirited away in the stealthy Imperial evacuation.

Feroz/Morajasse.t: The grace period for Morajasse's people to leave Feroz ended at the Spring Equinox, before the covert evacuation of those trapped elsewhere.

Feroz/Oranseri.t: Citizens trapped in Oranseri, given no chance to leave legally, were smuggled out from under the Grendel Governor's nose.

Mournwold/Alderly.t: Clearing Alderly to remove an outlaw haven and open up farmland and hardwoods has been discussed for at least a year as a way to boost the Mournwold's prosperity.

Astolat.t: The Free Folk refugees from Arracossa lived in Astolat as guests of the House of the Proffered Hand, with their own ambitions and problems for their neighbours.

Bregasland.t: Mentioned in passing: the trade winds included a demand from the Steward of Bregasland, with Bregas Marchers especially tagged.

Brocéliande.t: Mentioned in passing: the defeat of the Heirs of Terunael in Brocéliande is credited with helping the magistrates break the Yaw'nagrah cults.

Casinea.t: A devastating flood infused with Winter magic burst from the Syrene's Wisdom mine and swept through the town of Syrene, threatening the Bourse seat.

Feroz.t: Imperial fleets and military units secretly smuggled trapped citizens out of Grendel-held Feroz, leaving Governor Rahab furious.

Hercynia.t: Mentioned in passing: the defence of Hercynia is credited with helping make the magistrates' campaign against Yaw'nagrah a success.

Kahraman.t: Magistrates were investigating Faraden and Imperial smugglers evading Senate tariffs across Kahraman's borders, and Kahraman is noted as overlooked by Sarcombe.

Liathaven.t: Elite Imperial units surrounded the Feni settlement of Hotter's Mire to stop the Heirs of Terunael breaking the territory's Winter curse, and Liathaven now holds a relatively stable, openly-living Feni population.

Madruga.t: The Marracossan refugees settled in the abandoned town of Trajadoz, showing little interest in integrating with their Imperial neighbours.

Mareave.t: Mentioned in passing: the Grendel Paymaster planning the Tsark raid belonged to the North Mareave Trading Consortium.

Miaren.t: The third Navarr army, Isaella's Dance, completed its muster in Miaren and awaited its first general.

Mitwold.t: Mentioned in passing: Meade is named as the northern trading centre Sarcombe could one day rival.

Mountains of the Moon.t: A Grendel Paymaster proposed a surprise raid over the peaks to seize Tsark's mithril and white granite, inviting Imperial citizens to join while others vowed to oppose it.

Mournwold.t: Bounder's Hall was completed in Sarcombe to protect the pacifist Mournwold orcs, renewing interest in the territory's prosperity, while Mournwold Marchers accepted their Assembly's lawful approach to sorcerers.

Ossium.t: Mentioned in passing: the miasma of the Sarangrave is compared to that faced during the liberation of Ossium.

Otkodov.t: Mentioned in passing: the Ambassador to Otkodov is tagged in the wind on the drought and Spring conjunction.

Redoubt.t: The newly consecrated Shrine of the Armsmaster on Mount Siluri became a place of pilgrimage and inspired new opportunities, and Redoubt's Grand Harbour is cited as a fruit of the Cardinal of Prosperity's attention.

Sarangrave.t: An appraisal examined how the Imperial spy network might inspire an uprising against the three Druj clans dominating these miasma-choked marshes.

Segura.t: Magistrates were investigating Faraden and Imperial smugglers operating across Segura's borders, armed with a list of suspects recovered from a rescued magistrate.

Sermersuaq.t: Mentioned in passing: Winterfolk visiting Anvil are concerned about their skeins following their dubious actions in Sermersuaq.

Skallahn.t: The Imperial raid into Skallahn gained only some loot, but yielded insight that could support a swift second attack before the Jarls shore up their defences.

Spiral.t: Mentioned in passing: Urizen, especially those in Spiral, are tagged in the trade winds roundup.

Tassato.t: Mentioned in passing: Tassato priests are tagged in the Faraden developments, and the city is named as the wealthy gateway linked to Sarcombe.

The Barrens.t: Dawnish armies drove into the Barrens from north and south, cutting the territory in two amid their contest with the Imperial Orcs, to the displeasure of the General Assembly.

Therunin.t: Therunin's brokers proposed Thornsong House, a major expansion of the Feverwater dredging, and an offer of help from the orcs of the Great Forest to enrich the territory.

Upwold.t: After the Senate abrogated Moonwater Hall, events in Upwold spiralled into fires, accusations and a Faraden coup.

Zenith.t: The Imperial invasion led by the Citadel Guard and the Highborn crusade made progress, aided by the Loyalty assembly, while Urizen warned of repercussions if the liberation is left unfinished.

384YE Summer Solstice winds of war.d: The Lasambrian Jotun, aided by their Mournwold allies, claimed Gambit and later Jade Range. An enchantment and the delay at Rotoga kept them from raiding the Great Mine of Briante and the Damatian Cliffs. Mathilda Fisher pressed her claim to Bregasland with Jotun support, and the Empire ceded Grey Fens and the Ottermire. Imperial and Otkodov forces drove the Jotun from Suaq Fount and Suaq Wastes, leaving Sermersuaq for the Senate to assign. Druj from Ulnak destroyed the Tower of the Scorpion in Echofell. The Empire struck the Carmine Fields and Hope's Rest in a pincer. In Zenith the Druj held the Imperial advance at Clypion. Four battle opportunities and many conjunctions were identified.

Dawn.t: Dawnish armies could not take the Cautious Advance or Give Ground orders, and a horror from the Spring realm threatened them in the Barrens. In Semmerholm the Adamant Gate could not fall below 1,000 strength, and Barien offered an audience to those who completed his Challenge.

Druj.t: The Druj retook Echofell in Ossium and attacked hard in Zenith, holding the Imperial advance. However, they could not stop the Empire carving a Steel Causeway through the Barrens despite the rebuilt Spires of the Dusk.

Highguard.t: Highborn armies gained double natural resupply and could issue the Crusading Storm order. They also received bonuses when attacking into Zenith from Morrow or defending Morrow against attacks from Zenith.

Imperial Orcs.t: A conjunction in Bregasland gave the Imperial Orcs an opportunity to recover the artefact Pilgrim's Shield Oath-Heart.

Jotun.t: The Lasambrian Jotun took Gambit and Jade Range in Kahraman and backed Mathilda Fisher's seizure of Bregasland, but they were driven from Suaq Fount and Suaq Wastes and held only the forts of Tanikipari and Stark.

Navarr.t: Mentioned in passing: a conjunction in Karsk offered a chance to rescue kidnapped Navarr and recover an ancient relic.

The Brass Coast.t: The Brass Coast lost Gambit and Jade Range in Kahraman to the Jotun, though the Great Mine of Briante and the Damatian Cliffs were protected from raids. Wave Riders raided Segura.

The League.t: Mentioned in passing: the Senator for Temeschwar was suggested to lead a mission to recover a Bloodwater Spear orc from the Druj.

The Marches.t: Bregasland was lost to the Jotun-backed Mathilda Fisher, and former Mournwold warriors fought for the Jotun. Marcher armies could not take Give Ground, but any Imperial army could billet in Bregasland, Upwold or Mitwold.

Thule.t: Otkodov allied with the Empire to liberate Sermersuaq, and the Thule garrison of Fljajokep aided Echofell's defenders. A Thule warlock captured by the Jotun awaited rescue.

Urizen.t: Urizen's former territory of Zenith saw a bitter, stalled struggle, and a battle opportunity aimed to inspire Urizen to engage in Iteri. The Citadel Guard would begin to deteriorate again after the Solstice.

Varushka.t: Varushka lost Echofell in Ossium to the Druj, and three conjunctions in Karsk dealt with the self-styled Boyar of Isember and his dark power. Varushkan armies would suffer reduced victory points when campaigning alongside Brass Coast or Wintermark armies.

Wintermark.t: Sermersuaq was liberated from the Jotun, ghosts haunted Bruckland in Hahnmark, and Wintermark armies gained the Fight with Honour order along with modified effects against the Jotun.

384YE Summer Solstice winds of war.o: In the summer of 384YE the Jotun took Gambit and Jade Range in Kahraman and seized Bregasland, while an alliance of the Empire and Otkodov liberated Sermersuaq. In the east the Druj retook Echofell in Ossium, the Empire carved a causeway through the Barrens, and fighting in Zenith ground to a standstill.

Bregasland/Grey Fens.t: The Empire was forced to cede Grey Fens to the Jotun-backed forces.

Bregasland/Ottermire.t: The Ottermire was ceded after Grey Fens, and a conjunction at Greywater Estate offered to help House Greywater escape a Jotun execution squad.

Hahnmark/Bruckland.t: A conjunction at Turelva sought to help the ghostly spirits haunting the area pass on.

Kahraman/Gambit.t: The Lasambrian Jotun claimed the plains of Gambit despite the efforts of Imperial heroes.

Kahraman/Jade Range.t: The defenders of Fort Braydon could not match the orcs' zeal, and the Jotun took control of Jade Range shortly before the Solstice.

Ossium/Echofell.t: The Druj destroyed the Tower of the Scorpion and retook Echofell's forests, and a conjunction aimed to stop them destroying the Bone Hives.

Sarangrave/Bloodwater Marsh.t: A conjunction at Dead Stone Woods sought to recover a Bloodwater Spear orc from the Druj.

Segura/Lucksprings.t: A conjunction at Cereva Hall offered the chance to intercept a raiding party of Wave Riders.

Semmerholm/Causse.t: A grand audience with Barien at the Semmerstones offered rewards to those who completed his Challenge.

Sermersuaq/Stark.t: The Imperial advance faltered at Stark's forts. Conjunctions there sought to free a hylje hostage at White Plume Rocks and retrieve a captured Thule warlock at Flat Hills.

Sermersuaq/Suaq Fount.t: The Empire and Otkodov drove the Jotun out of Suaq Fount.

Sermersuaq/Suaq Wastes.t: The Jotun were driven from Suaq Wastes, and a conjunction at Spirax wood sought to deny them the Spear of Bounty.

Sermersuaq/Tanikipari.t: The forts of Tanikipari halted the allied advance and remained a Jotun stronghold.

The Barrens/Bitter Strand.t: A conjunction at Saltmaw offered the chance to unleash the Barren Sea to flood the Fangs and the Saltmarsh.

The Barrens/Hope's Rest.t: Imperial armies attacked the southern hills of Hope's Rest as one arm of the pincer to cut the Barrens in half.

The Barrens/Saltmarsh.t: The Saltmarsh was a target of a proposed opportunity to flood it with the Barren Sea from Saltmaw.

The Barrens/The Carmine Fields.t: Imperial armies attacked the northern Carmine Fields as part of the pincer, and a conjunction at the Red Plains sought to retrieve cursed treasure threatening the Wolves of War.

Zenith/Clypion.t: Orc and Imperial forces were locked in a bitter struggle for its hills. A battle opportunity aimed to claim a beachhead there, and conjunctions dealt with a malaise and with ex-prisoners in its groves.

Zenith/Iteri.t: A battle opportunity sought to inspire Urizen to engage in Iteri.

Zenith/Lustri.t: A conjunction at Sleetstorm Pass sought to deny the ghulai of Sarangrave a mysterious magical text.

Zenith/Proceris.t: A conjunction at the Golden Cascade sought to recover the Amulet of Truth from a wicked Druj warleader.

Bregasland.t: Bregasland was ceded to Mathilda Fisher and her Jotun allies and was no longer Imperial. Conjunctions there concerned Oath-Heart and House Greywater's escape, and Imperial armies could still billet there.

Forest of Ulnak.t: Mentioned in passing: the Druj invasion of Ossium came out of the Forest of Ulnak.

Hahnmark.t: A conjunction at Turelva in Bruckland sought to help haunting ghostly spirits pass on.

Kahraman.t: The Lasambrian Jotun claimed Gambit and then Jade Range, though raids on the Great Mine of Briante and the Damatian Cliffs were prevented. A battle opportunity aimed to stymie Lasambrian efforts to isolate fortifications.

Karsk.t: Three conjunctions in Lestazny addressed the self-styled Boyar of Isember, his dark power, and kidnapped Navarr with an ancient relic.

Mitwold.t: Mentioned in passing: any Imperial army could take the Billet order in Mitwold.

Morrow.t: Highborn or Urizen armies attacking into Zenith from Morrow, or defending Morrow against attacks from Zenith, gained territory bonuses but inflicted fewer casualties.

Mournwold.t: Mentioned in passing: warriors formerly of Mournwold fought as allies of the Jotun and were expected opponents in the Kahraman battle.

Ossium.t: The Druj invaded, destroyed the Tower of the Scorpion and retook the forests of Echofell, and a conjunction sought to stop them destroying the Bone Hives.

Otkodov.t: Mentioned in passing: the alliance of Empire and Otkodov drove the Jotun from much of Sermersuaq.

Sarangrave.t: A conjunction in Bloodwater Marsh sought to recover a Bloodwater Spear orc from the Druj, and the ghulai of Sarangrave sought a magical text in Zenith.

Segura.t: A conjunction at Cereva Hall in Lucksprings offered the chance to intercept a raiding party of Wave Riders on Imperial soil.

Semmerholm.t: The Adamant Gate could not be reduced below 1,000 military strength, and Barien held a grand audience at the Semmerstones for those who completed his Challenge.

Sermersuaq.t: Sermersuaq became Imperial again after Suaq Fount and Suaq Wastes were freed, though the Jotun held Tanikipari and Stark. The Senate had to assign it to a nation and allocate the Pride of Ikka's Tears.

Temeschwar.t: Mentioned in passing: the Senator for Temeschwar was named as responsible for a conjunction in Sarangrave.

The Barrens.t: After three years the Empire attacked again, carving a Steel Causeway through the heart of the Barrens with barely a casualty. A battle opportunity and several conjunctions aimed to secure the Imperial presence.

Upwold.t: Mentioned in passing: any Imperial army could take the Billet order in Upwold.

Zenith.t: Two massive forces clashed, and the Druj went on the attack but failed to drive out the Empire, though they halted its advance. A battle opportunity aimed to claim a beachhead in Clypion.

384YE Winter Solstice Conclave sessions.d: Precedence went to the Unfettered Mind, with 335 mana distributed among the orders. The Conclave asked for a title to identify sorcerers, told the magistrates that interdicted Urizen lore was illegal to cast but not to learn or teach, and sent the Silver Chalice to Madruga's thirsty grasses. The Flower is Withered on the Stalk and Fire on the Water were added to Imperial lore. The Conclave also endowed Sadogua to help persecuted Iron Confederacy mages flee, welcomed Suranni refugees, approved Claude Videre as a Throne candidate and asked the Rod and Shield to deal with creatures in Metri. Proposals on vigilance, interdicting the potion of bone dust and a Seventh Mist base in Redoubt failed.

Urizen.t: The Conclave told the magistrates that interdicted rituals from Urizen lore should be treated like Imperial lore: illegal to cast but lawful to learn and teach. Their texts, including those in the Grand Library of Canterspire, are not to be seized or destroyed. A separate bid to back a Seventh Mist research base in the Brilliant Star in Redoubt failed.

Wintermark.t: Speaking for the Winterfolk, Aethalstan Korping secured Conclave's agreement that the Shuttered Lantern should investigate blood-on-the-snow cultists tied to Agramant in Sermersuaq.

384YE Winter Solstice Conclave sessions.o: At the 384YE Winter Solstice summit the Conclave passed a string of declarations, among them requests for the Shuttered Lantern to investigate Agramant's influence in Sermersuaq, protection for interdicted Urizen lore texts, acceptance of Tharim's warding of the Hall of Worlds, and an endowment of 150 mana to Sadogua. Andronikos of the Lighthouse of Nikephoros was appointed Imperial Warmage.

Sermersuaq.t: Conclave backed the Shuttered Lantern in investigating blood-on-the-snow cultists and tearing the veil on the Voice in the Pines' activities in Sermersuaq. The outcome is recorded in the Anyone but you Wind of Fortune.

384YE Winter Solstice Imperial elections.d: Senators were chosen for Astolat, Hercynia (twice), Kallavesa, Madruga, Miekarova, Necropolis, Ossium, Skarsind, Temeschwar and Zenith. The Senate appointed four ambassadors, including Abel to the Grendel, and ten generals, among them Aracelis I Erigo of the Burning Falcon and Skywise Rykana of the Winter Sun. It also filled numerous sinecures such as the Grimnir of Wittal Grove. The Synod raised Darian Numbers as Cardinal of Prosperity with 253 votes and Hywel Summer Crow as Cardinal of the Way. Bourse auctions included the Hunt of Alderei the Fair, which went for 575 thrones. Andronikos of the Lighthouse at Nikephoros declared candidacy for Warmage, and Aitana i Riqueza became Prefect of the Conclave.

Dawn.t: Cecilia De Gauvain was elected Senator for Astolat, giving Dawn's territory its voice in the Senate.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: Abel was appointed by the Senate as the Empire's Ambassador to the Grendel.

Highguard.t: Eli of the Cenotaph was elected Senator for Necropolis, representing Highguard's territory in the Senate.

Imperial Orcs.t: Bloodcrow Rasp was elected Senator for Skarsind, and RAKK won the Bourse vote for Preceptor of the Skarsind College of Warcasting.

Navarr.t: Hercynia held two senatorial elections this summit, with Rhisiart Dancewalker the most recent winner after Gelert Ashborn.

The Brass Coast.t: Chiara Zayden Riqueza was elected Senator for Madruga, representing the Brass Coast territory in the Senate.

The League.t: Giuseppe Sanguineo von Temeschwar was elected Senator for Temeschwar, the League territory.

Urizen.t: Cadeus was elected Senator for Zenith, giving Urizen's territory its representative in the Senate.

Varushka.t: Varushka chose two senators: Talvikaarne, The Winter Guest, for Miekarova, and Vesna (Sparrow) Borkovna for Ossium.

Wintermark.t: Rane Shardbearer was elected Senator for Kallavesa, and Branwynn Rynne was appointed Grimnir of Wittal Grove within that territory.

384YE Winter Solstice Imperial elections.o: At the 384YE Winter Solstice summit, Imperial titles across the Empire changed hands through national elections, Senate and Cardinal appointments, Synod judgements, Conclave votes and Bourse auctions and votes.

Kallavesa/Wittal Grove.t: Branwynn Rynne was appointed by the Senate as Grimnir of Wittal Grove.

Astolat.t: Cecilia De Gauvain became Astolat's senator.

Hercynia.t: Hercynia held two senatorial elections at this summit, and Rhisiart Dancewalker, the most recent winner, took the seat after Gelert Ashborn.

Kallavesa.t: Rane Shardbearer was elected Senator for Kallavesa, and the territory's Grimnir of Wittal Grove title went to Branwynn Rynne.

Madruga.t: Chiara Zayden Riqueza was elected as Madruga's senator.

Miekarova.t: Talvikaarne, The Winter Guest, was elected Senator for Miekarova.

Necropolis.t: Eli of the Cenotaph was elected Senator for Necropolis.

Ossium.t: Vesna (Sparrow) Borkovna was elected Senator for Ossium.

Skarsind.t: Bloodcrow Rasp was elected Senator for Skarsind, and RAKK won the title of Preceptor of the Skarsind College of Warcasting with 20 votes.

Temeschwar.t: Giuseppe Sanguineo von Temeschwar was elected Senator for Temeschwar.

Zenith.t: Cadeus was elected Senator for Zenith.

384YE Winter Solstice Senate sessions.d: With 1184 thrones in the treasury, the Senate funded a fourth Wintermark army (400 thrones), Marcher military resupply (500 thrones) and the Black Canal. It ceded Trajadoz to its Marracossans, opened free trade with the Sarcophan Delves and retrained a historical researcher to produce appraisals. It created the Witness of Conclave and gave the Imperial Seer a stipend. Commissions included Thornsong House, the Temeschwar Department of Architecture, Atalaya Harbour, the Golden Cascade, a fortification in Lustri and several Zenith rebuilding projects. The treaty with Kaliact, the Great Chains of Sarvos and the Academy of Arms expansion failed. Ambassadors to the Iron Confederacy, the Grendel, Axos and Jarm were elected.

Dawn.t: Dawn's Senators were active: the Laroc tournament grounds in Astolat received 50 thrones, Semmerholm proposed the Cerevado Nets and Weirwater secured a 40-throne stipend for the Imperial Seer.

Druj.t: Mentioned in passing: the miasma pillars that the Senate began clearing from Zenith are described as Druj miasma.

Grendel.t: Abel of Zenith Ascendant of Urizen was elected as the Empire's Ambassador to the Grendel.

Highguard.t: Highborn Senators proposed an appraisal on encouraging foreign pilgrims of the Way and the retraining of researchers. Reikos's treaty with Salt Lord Kaliact failed.

Imperial Orcs.t: Two orc sept follies were commissioned: the Ossuary Temple in Skarsind for the Illarawm, and an armoury-smithy for the Ethengraw. Research into the orc guards of Empress Ahraz was cancelled.

Navarr.t: Cedric Gallows and Fintan Nighthaven of Navarr were elected ambassadors to the Iron Confederacy and Axos. Navarr Senators secured Thornsong House in Therunin and free trade with the Sarcophan Delves.

The Brass Coast.t: The Freeborn ceded Trajadoz to its Marracossans, creating the Marracossa Sendito. They gained a new ilium bourse seat at Crevado, Atalaya Harbour and a mana ministry in Madruga, and won an appraisal of Kahraman.

The League.t: The League gained an ilium bourse seat in the hills above Tassato and the Temeschwar Department of Architecture. Kleist's Winter Gardens in Holberg ran into complications, and the Great Chains of Sarvos failed.

The Marches.t: The Marches received 500 thrones for military resupply, funds for the Black Canal and 200 thrones for the Golden Cascade. The Imperial Breadbasket aimed at Marcher refugees had no current opportunity to act on.

Thule.t: The new Trading Hall at Wreck is intended to trade food for Thule ilium, helping them feed their people after abolishing slavery.

Urizen.t: Zenith saw extensive investment: miasma clearance, a Lustri fortification, the Golden Cascade, the Crucible of Fate and the Starlight Drift. Urizeni Abel and Ariadne were elected ambassadors to the Grendel and Jarm.

Varushka.t: The Crawling Depths in Ossium was renamed, and Miekarova's Witness of Conclave title was created. Karsk's motion to expand the Academy of Arms failed.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark won funding for a fourth army raising in Sermersuaq, an expansion of the Pride of Ikka's Tears mithril mine and a Trading Hall at Wreck.

384YE Winter Solstice Senate sessions.o: At the Winter Solstice 384YE the Senate passed a wide slate of motions, including raising a fourth Wintermark army, clearing Druj miasma from Zenith and commissioning many new constructions. It also elected several ambassadors, though no one was elected to the Imperial Throne.

Holberg/Holmauer.t: Skathe's Winter curse on Holmauer Park is to be channelled through Marcher menhirs to grow herbs in Kleist's Winter Gardens, a commission now facing complications.

Zenith/Iteri.t: The Crucible of Fate, a foundry rebuilt where the ushabti were first created, is being constructed in Iteri.

Zenith/Lustri.t: The Senate commissioned a fortification in Lustri, requiring Senate funds over the year.

Zenith/Occursion.t: The Starlight Drift of Shimmering Snow, a mana sinecure at Endsmeet, is being reconstructed in Occursion.

Zenith/Proceris.t: The Golden Cascade in Proceris is being reconstructed with 200 thrones from the Senate.

Astolat.t: The Laroc tournament grounds are to be built in Astolat, with 50 thrones disbursed to its Senator.

Bastion.t: The pilgrims appraisal may focus on escalating Bastion and the Bay of Catazar territories to the challenge of Timoj. Bastion's Senator also seconded the Black Canal funding.

Casinea.t: Mentioned in passing: Casinea's Senator proposed retraining a historical researcher and seconded the pilgrims appraisal.

Hahnmark.t: Mentioned in passing: Hahnmark's Senator proposed and received 400 thrones to raise a fourth Wintermark army, which will raise in Sermersuaq.

Hercynia.t: Mentioned in passing: Hercynia's Senator seconded the Imperial Seer stipend and the Iron Confederacy ambassador election, and called the unsuccessful Throne election.

Holberg.t: Kleist's Winter Gardens, a herb sinecure at the Holberg University Duelling Grounds using Skathe's Winter curse, was announced but has run into complications.

Kahraman.t: An appraisal of how to restore Kahraman's recently destroyed infrastructure, including revised Cinnabar Roads proposals, will be published before Spring.

Kallavesa.t: The new Wintermark army is supported by consecrating the Kallavesa marshes. Kallavesa's Senator also proposed the Trading Hall at Wreck.

Karov.t: Mentioned in passing: Karov's Senator proposed ambassador elections for the Iron Confederacy and the Sumaah Republic, and seconded the Trading Hall at Wreck.

Karsk.t: Mentioned in passing: Karsk's Senator seconded the Crawling Depths renaming and proposed the failed Academy of Arms expansion.

Madruga.t: The town of Trajadoz in Madruga was ceded to its Marracossans. The Parador of Salt and Sand, a mana ministry, is being built in Quzar.

Miaren.t: Mentioned in passing: Miaren's Senator proposed free trade with the Sarcophan Delves and seconded the Axos ambassador election.

Miekarova.t: Mentioned in passing: Miekarova's Senator proposed the Witness of Conclave title and seconded the Commonwealth ambassador appointment.

Mitwold.t: Mentioned in passing: 500 thrones for military resupply were disbursed to Mitwold's Senator, who also seconded the Tassato hills motion.

Morrow.t: Mentioned in passing: Morrow's Senator proposed the Zenith miasma clearance and seconded the Lustri fortification.

Mournwold.t: Mentioned in passing: Mournwold's Senator proposed and received 200 thrones to rebuild the Golden Cascade in Zenith, and seconded the Witness of Conclave.

Necropolis.t: Mentioned in passing: Necropolis's Senator proposed the pilgrims of the Way appraisal and seconded the retraining of researchers.

Ossium.t: Ossium's Crawling Depths mine and seat was renamed the Vale of the Sunless Depths, though locals favour simply Sunless Depths. Bones recovered from Ossium will rest in the Ossuary Temple.

Redoubt.t: Mentioned in passing: Redoubt's Senator proposed the Ossuary Temple and seconded the Ethengraw armoury.

Reikos.t: Mentioned in passing: Reikos's Senator proposed the failed treaty with Salt Lord Kaliact and seconded Thornsong House.

Sarvos.t: The proposed Great Chains of Sarvos fortification to protect Sarvos and the south coast failed.

Segura.t: A new Brass Coast bourse seat will net ilium from the Scorrero river at Crevado in Segura, and Segura's Senator secured Atalaya Harbour.

Semmerholm.t: Mentioned in passing: Semmerholm's Senator proposed the Cerevado Nets and seconded the Temeschwar Department of Architecture.

Sermersuaq.t: A fourth Wintermark army will begin to raise in Sermersuaq, and a Trading Hall to buy Thule ilium will be built at Wreck in East Floes.

Skarsind.t: The Ossuary Temple will be built in Southpine, Skarsind, and ceded to the Illarawm sept to house bones recovered from Ossium.

Tassato.t: The hills above Tassato will be exploited for ilium, creating a League bourse seat chosen by business owners.

Temeschwar.t: The University Department of Architecture will be built in Hanuri, Temeschwar, creating the Master of Rings title.

Therunin.t: Thornsong House, a hospital college for potion research overseen by the Thornsinger, will be built in Therunin.

Upwold.t: Mentioned in passing: Upwold's Senator proposed and received 19 thrones and 6 crowns for the Black Canal in the Marches.

Volodmartz.t: Mentioned in passing: Volodmartz's Senator seconded the failed Kaliact treaty and proposed the Jarm ambassador election.

Weirwater.t: Mentioned in passing: Weirwater's Senator secured a 40-throne seasonal stipend for the Imperial Seer and seconded the Cerevado Nets.

Zenith.t: Zenith's miasma pillars will be cleared at 75 thrones a season until it is cleansed. Projects include the Lustri fortification, Golden Cascade, Crucible of Fate and Starlight Drift.

384YE Winter Solstice Synod judgements.d: The change of doctrine to accept Freedom/Anarchy as a virtue failed 18 to 1485. The Assembly of Nine ruled that Anarchy remains a false virtue and that future liberations must be inspired by the Seven Virtues. The General Assembly narrowly refused Lenarius Ankarien's call to exterminate the Druj and instead urged soldiers to question orders to slaughter them. Enacted mandates gave every congregation 36 rings from Free Folk visits, removed the final bar to the Free Folk joining most nations, roused the League and Varushka against the Vyig, and welcomed the Great Forest Orcs into Navarr. True liao went towards rebuilding Zenith, and many appointments, inquisitions and vindications followed.

Dawn.t: Dawn's assembly sent Pelleas Montrose to inspire the Dawnish in the Barrens, which opens a chance for Dawnish generals to meet the Dawnish resistance there at the Spring Equinox. It also proposed Owain of House Wolfbourne as chaplain to its generals and called for a more open, glorious voting system.

Druj.t: The Synod narrowly refused a mandate to exterminate the Druj by any means, condemned 'Death to the Druj' as hateful, and urged soldiers to question orders to slaughter them. Urizen and Varushka nonetheless called for the Druj to be scoured from Zenith and destroyed.

Grendel.t: Highguard urged that Grendel traders in Necropolis who seek lasting ties be welcomed, but the merchants of the Broken Shore would not commit as their treaty nears its end. The League called for debate with Grendel visitors, and the Imperial Spymaster was called to inquisition over spy networks in Grendel territories.

Highguard.t: Highguard's mandates will subtly change how the Highborn view the lineaged and orcs, and they give its assembly the Peerless Kinship and Partner of Greatness abilities for a year. Funding liao tutelage for the Free Folk costs every Highborn business a rank of production for the rest of the year. Several assemblies also named imperial tombs in Necropolis as stops on a pilgrims' trail.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Imperial Orc assembly's mandate stops Stonecliff Brakkalo from affecting the nation further. The virtue fund paid 11 Thrones towards mithril for the Ethengraw Armoury so that the Ethengraw sept can join the nation, and the Winter Sun's march to break shackles in the Barrens was upheld with primacy.

Jotun.t: Mentioned in passing: the Marcher folk hero William Guildenstern was praised for fighting in the Valiant Hurricane Battle, where 12 Marchers faced 50 Jotun and 12 ogres.

Navarr.t: Navarr's mandate welcomes the Great Forest Orcs to make steadings in Miaren and Hercynia, while rival calls to send them on or to throw them a festival failed. Navarr also celebrated rediscovering all the cities of Terunael, urged guides to help the Navarri bandits in Therunin, and elected Teleri Thornweaver as Voice of Barbs.

The League.t: League congregations preaching Ambition gain an extra liao and two extra Synod votes until Winter 385YE, and a mandate rouses the League to end the Vyig. Its assembly also endorsed donations for the chains of Sarvos, called for outreach to the Grendel, and rejected any Highguard mandate to interfere in its virtue.

The Marches.t: The Marcher assembly urged Vigilance to refute Mathilda Fisher's words in Bregasland, resolved to teach the Way to Mournwold orcs who wish to join the Empire, and named William Guildenstern a Marcher folk hero. Bastard Tom was appointed Keeper of the Orchard.

Thule.t: Varushkans freed from Ossium were urged to support the Thule through a harsh winter after they ended slavery, and Wintermark's call for cultural exchange at the Wreck trade hall was withdrawn. Iron Osric and Lofyn Bloodcloak were vindicated over the Thule treaty, while the Ambassador to Otkodov was given penance.

Urizen.t: Mandates without a greater majority have little effect on Urizen. Its assembly urged resistance to Highguard influence, sent sword scholars to cleanse the Druj legacy from Zenith, and invited persecuted Suranni to settle in Urizen. True liao and 30 Thrones were awarded towards rebuilding Zenith.

Varushka.t: Mandates without a greater majority have little effect on Varushka, so the Free Folk mandate does not open the nation to them. Its own mandate rouses Varushkans to end the Vyig, and its assembly welcomed Iron Confederacy refugees, declared that the Druj must be destroyed, and urged recognising virtue in sapient creatures.

Wintermark.t: The caves beneath Runegrott were consecrated as a tomb for the first runesmith so that work on Runesmith's Law can begin. Wintermark priests in Sermersuaq, backed by the Loyalty assembly, will hunt those who accepted Blood-on-the-Snow's aid, and the Assembly of Nine sent the Silent Bell to investigate the cults there. Beodun Snowlock entered the Chronicle of Heroes.

384YE Winter Solstice Synod judgements.o: At the Winter Solstice 384YE summit the Imperial Synod raised 168 judgements. It rejected a proposal to accept Freedom/Anarchy as a virtue, narrowly refused a mandate to exterminate the Druj, and enacted mandates on the Free Folk, the Vyig, the Great Forest Orcs and Blood-on-the-Snow.

Bay of Catazar.t: Mentioned in passing: a note says Grendel merchants grew more eager to trade along the northern coast of the Bay of Catazar in what may be their last chance before the treaty ends.

384YE Winter Solstice interlude.d: The Imperial Guerdon stood at 350 thrones, shared among units supporting Quiet Step, Gryphon's Pride, Valiant Pegasus and the Beacons of Kallavesa. Opportunities opened to explore the heart of Terunael, assault the Aerie of the Slave Lords, venture into the Twisted Woods, explore the sinkhole depths and map the Sea of Snow. Spring-infused rains brought extra herbs to most of the Empire. Semmerlak flotsam enriched Semmerholm and Weirwater. Tharim's black frost drained Dawn in return for aid against the Barrens. Enchantments settled on the Mournwold and Zenith. Congregations swelled under the Reject False Gods mandate. The Empire entered free trade with the Sumaah, the Commonwealth and Axos, while Nemoria closed to Imperial fleets.

Dawn.t: Dawn suffered Tharim's black frost, which cost every Dawnish mana site and farm until the Autumn Equinox 385YE in return for steel-bound knights aiding any Dawnish army attacking the Barrens. Dawnish units gained bonuses for Dark Ranging, exploring Terunael and entering the Twisted Woods.

Druj.t: The Druj-held Barrens faced Dawnish armies reinforced by Tharim's steel-bound knights for the coming year, and the territory was spared the storms' rejuvenation.

Jotun.t: Mentioned in passing: Jotun-held Bregasland and Liathaven were excluded from the storms' herb bounty, and the earlier raid on Skallahn opened new fleet options for Marcher and Wintermark captains.

Navarr.t: With help from the Great Forest Orcs, Navarr in Therunin, Hercynia, Miaren and Brocéliande could improve herb gardens for one fewer wain of weirwood until the Summer Solstice 385YE. Navarr armies engaged in Dark Ranging attracted extra Dawnish support.

The League.t: League congregations in Temeschwar and Tassato swelled under Rafael Barossa di Tassato's anti-idolatry mandate, and Holberg's farms received herbs from the Sand Fisher orcs.

The Marches.t: A Winter enchantment let the people of the Mournwold speak to and lay ghosts to rest. Marcher fleets gained a new Raid along the Gullet Shore action and could map the Sea of Snow at full strength.

Urizen.t: Urizen gained a congregation boost in Redoubt and an Autumn enchantment easing new starts in Zenith, though Zenith missed the storms' herb bounty. New rituals were added to Urizen lore.

Varushka.t: Varushkan units were especially effective Into the Twisted Woods, with permanent access promised should the Tower of the Manticore be built in Ossium. Karsk's congregations were strengthened, but Varushka shunned the Semmerlak flotsam under its Assembly's mandate.

Wintermark.t: The Beacons of Kallavesa shared in the Guerdon, Hahnmark's congregations grew, and Wintermark fleets could Guard the Fisherfolk of Westerhal and map the Sea of Snow at full strength.

384YE Winter Solstice interlude.o: The interlude following the Autumn Equinox 384YE set out the effects shaping the coming season, from the Imperial Guerdon and special expeditions to curses, enchantments, mandates and trade arrangements across the Empire.

Brocéliande/Dark Ranging.t: Dawnish units supporting Dawnish, Highborn or Navarr armies engaged in Dark Ranging earned an extra crown and two herbs under Ranae de Rondell's mandate.

Bregasland.t: Bregasland had been spared the supernatural storms and so received none of the rejuvenating herbs granted elsewhere.

Brocéliande.t: Brocéliande became the focus of an expedition towards Terunael and of Dark Ranging with extra Dawnish rewards. Navarr herb gardens there could be improved more cheaply, though the territory missed the storms' herb bounty.

Hahnmark.t: Congregations in Hahnmark gained additional votes and liao while the Synod stood clearly against idolatry, because a building designed by the Asavean architect stood there.

Hercynia.t: Navarr with herb gardens in Hercynia could improve them for one fewer wain of weirwood thanks to the Great Forest Orcs.

Holberg.t: Farms in Holberg received two random herbs each season from the Sand Fisher orcs' tithe.

Kallavesa.t: Mentioned in passing: the Beacons of Kallavesa were among the efforts sharing in the Imperial Guerdon.

Karsk.t: Congregations in Karsk gained additional votes and liao as long as the Synod clearly opposed idolatry.

Liathaven.t: Liathaven had been spared the storms and so did not benefit from the Spring-infused rains' extra herbs.

Miaren.t: Navarr herb gardens in Miaren could be improved for one fewer wain of weirwood until the Summer Solstice 385YE.

Mournwold.t: A potent Winter enchantment let anyone in the Mournwold freely speak to the shades of the dead and more easily placate and lay them to rest.

Ossium.t: Mentioned in passing: building the Tower of the Manticore in Ossium would give Dawn and Varushka permanent access to the Twisted Woods action.

Redoubt.t: Congregations in Redoubt gained additional votes and liao while the Synod maintained its anti-idolatry stance.

Sea of Snow.t: The Senate funded an attempt to map the Sea of Snow and the western coast, open to fleets with Wintermark and Marcher captains operating at full strength.

Semmerholm.t: Every business in Semmerholm gained extra crowns and rare-metal ingots from strange flotsam washing up from the Semmerlak.

Skallahn.t: Mentioned in passing: the raid on Skallahn led to new fleet actions for Marcher and Wintermark captains.

Tassato.t: Congregations in Tassato swelled with pride under the anti-idolatry mandate enacted by Rafael Barossa di Tassato, gaining extra votes and liao.

Temeschwar.t: Congregations in Temeschwar gained additional votes and liao while the Synod clearly opposed idolatry.

The Barrens.t: The Barrens faced Dawnish attacks backed by Tharim's steel-bound knights and were excluded from the storms' herb bounty.

The Semmerlak.t: Strange flotsam washed up on the Semmerlak's shores, enriching businesses in Semmerholm and Weirwater, though Varushka warned its people away from it.

Therunin.t: Navarr herb gardens in Therunin could be improved for one fewer wain of weirwood with the Great Forest Orcs' help.

Weirwater.t: Every business in Weirwater gained extra crowns and rare-metal ingots from the Semmerlak flotsam.

Zenith.t: An Autumn enchantment helped travellers, traders and settlers in Zenith find their feet and windfalls, though Zenith missed the storms' herb bounty.

384YE Winter Solstice winds of fortune.d: Zenith was wholly reclaimed and its ruined lands awaited restoration. The Jotun left Sermersuaq, leaving fortifications and lingering troubles behind them. Imperial armies in the Barrens held the line rather than seize the Fangs, and tried to win over the territory's inhabitants. Other winds covered Great Forest Orcs seeking homes in Navarr, a Freeborn scheme to steal the Scorrero Nets from Feroz, a runeforge project in Wintermark, ghosts in the Mournwold, new Thule offers, consecrations at the Maze of Zoria and Ratibor's Torch, and Highguard mandates. Shorter notes covered sabotaged Kahraman roads, flooding in Ossium, higher costs to build in marshes, and senatorial election concerns.

Dawn.t: Dawnish enchantresses had until the Summer Solstice to win five Summer eternals as patrons of the Eastern Sky. Dawn had also welcomed the Free Folk, and its glory-seekers were drawn to monster-hunting in Wintermark and Varushka.

Druj.t: The Druj had been driven out of Zenith into Sarangrave and were on the back foot in the Barrens, though they dug in at Ossium's Drownbark Forest and still held captured Navarri vates.

Grendel.t: Grendel Governor Rahab's rule over Feroz was the target of an audacious Freeborn plan to steal the Scorrero Nets. The Grendel port of Oran remained closed to Imperial fleets.

Highguard.t: A surge of Pride in Highguard after the Druj defeats led to three potent mandates that might change how the nation sees itself and the faith. Highguard was also tagged in the Barrens strategy and the Free Folk question.

Imperial Orcs.t: Three proud septs in Skarsind sought reassurance before joining the nation, and the Thule made new offers to the Imperial Orcs. Perhaps half of the Tamazi had already become Imperial citizens.

Jotun.t: The Jotun had left Sermersuaq behind fortifications and a claim on Ikka's Tears, while the Lasambrian Jotun sabotaged Kahraman's mountain roads and raided caravans from Liathaven. They lost an outpost in Bregasland and Jarl Snekmar's warband.

Navarr.t: Some Great Forest Orcs sought new homes in Miaren and Hercynia, a fork in the road that might fundamentally change the nation. Navarri healers calling themselves the vines had to decide who they were.

The Brass Coast.t: The Freeborn weighed Ottilie i Malune i Erigo's scheme to steal the Scorrero Nets from Grendel-held Feroz. Their assembly celebrated the freeing of Thule slaves and voiced concern over Senate elections, while Kahraman caravans faced danger.

The League.t: The Chair of the Wolf was due to be appointed, sparking talk of a contest to name the greatest League city. The consecration of Ratibor's Torch spread an aura of Ambition, and secret chambers beneath the Imperial Mint were being drained.

The Marches.t: Marcher yeomen had to choose where to direct the Breadbasket now that Urizen was mostly whole, amid trouble with the Mournwold orcs. The Greensward's ghosts could be eased, and Sarcombe's growing prosperity offered opportunities.

Thule.t: After the Thule Dragons outlawed slavery and the Senate lifted tariffs, northern trade grew and the Thule made offers to Wintermark and the Imperial Orcs. The Wintermark runesmiths they had enslaved returned home.

Urizen.t: Zenith was again wholly Urizeni, and the Empire set about restoring a territory the Druj had left in ruins, though miasma pillars and the Endless Stalker remained threats.

Varushka.t: The consecration of the Maze of Zoria drew pilgrims and whispers of the sovereign beasts, while lesser beasts stirred and the Varushkan assembly questioned its Senate elections. Flooding in Ossium was worsening.

Wintermark.t: With Sermersuaq freed, Wintermark faced lingering scars, the questions of those who took the Choice, and a Jotun legacy to build on. Returned runesmiths gathered at Runegrott to complete a northern runeforge.
