384YE Winter Solstice winds of fortune.o: The Winter Solstice 384YE winds of fortune set out the Empire's situations and opportunities, including restoring a liberated Zenith, freeing Sermersuaq from the Jotun, and the Imperial strategy in the Barrens. The page also reported the outcomes of the Autumn conjunctions of the Sentinel Gate.

Bregasland/Grey Fens.t: An Autumn attack on a Jotun outpost at Jayne's Top Copse succeeded, and the general of Mandowla's Roar paid a heavy price.

Holberg/Ennerlund.t: Mentioned in passing: the pumps sent to the Imperial Mint resembled those used at the Great Pits of Ennerlund.

Kahraman/Braydon's Jasse.t: Sabotaged roads made travel through Braydon's Jasse extremely difficult, greatly reducing the effectiveness of Fort Braydon.

Kahraman/Gambit.t: The Damatian Cliffs forewoman Catalina i Burna i Riqueza was rescued at Talaeiros and returned to work.

Kahraman/Serra Briante.t: Caravans from the Great Mine of Briante now took longer routes, and the Lasambrian Jotun were already striking at those leaving Serra Briante.

Kahraman/Serra Damata.t: Damaged roads forced white granite caravans from the Damatian Cliffs onto dangerous detours through Madruga.

Madruga/Calvos Sound.t: Imperial heroes in Calvos freed Sumaah pilgrims from a malicious creature and drove it off.

Mournwold/Greensward.t: The permanently haunted Greensward fell under a necromantic enchantment that offered a chance to ease its worst hauntings.

Mournwold/Southmoor.t: Sarcombe in Southmoor was flourishing as a trading town, and some spoke of it as a rival to Meade.

Ossium/Drownbark Forest.t: The Druj dug in around Petka's Path despite Imperial efforts, prompting the Winter Sun to move to Ossium.

Ossium/Nearweald.t: The rivers of Nearweald were rising, partly because of swathes of felled trees, forcing settlers from their homes and possibly threatening the Crawling Depths.

Sarangrave/Whisperwood.t: An attempt to rescue Navarri vates from Karliss failed, and they remained Druj captives.

Sermersuaq/Stark.t: The Jotun escaped from Avointaivas into Skallahn with Tuuli's Eye, but Yantl the Storm Runner was intercepted at Broken Rock Plain and their pursuer presumably dealt with.

Sermersuaq/Tanikipari.t: Jarl Snekmar and his warriors were dealt with at Kilpailuala Bay and no longer threatened Sermersuaq.

Skarsind/Southpine.t: Mentioned in passing: some Tamazi were keen to visit the Illarawm sept in Southpine to share their appreciation of bone.

Spiral/Screed.t: The Archmage of Night's conjunction to Kephalos' Delve had an outcome that was not public knowledge.

The Barrens/Bitter Strand.t: Imperial forces advanced towards the Fangs but chose not to take them, holding the line while scouts carried a message of hope to the inhabitants.

The Barrens/Dawnguard.t: Sorin unleashed his hungry wolves to aid the Imperial armies, and some remained to guard the lands of House Aurelius.

The Barrens/Heart of Peytaht.t: The Senate had reiterated its intent to concede the Heart of Peytaht and its weirwood grove to the Great Forest sept once the Barrens was conquered.

Volodmartz/Brez.t: Fighting took place at Urodli's Fall, but the outcome was not common knowledge.

Zenith/Iteri.t: The miasma pillar at the Pallasian Steps still stood, anchoring the Druj miasma in Iteri.

Zenith/Lustri.t: The Mallum orcs were forced out of Lustri, but its miasma pillars still stood and the Endless Stalker remained a threat to its people.

Zenith/Occursion.t: A miasma pillar at the Field of Celestial Mist was destroyed, but efforts to stop weapons reaching the battle and to disrupt the Druj at the Tower of the Fall failed.

Zenith/Proceris.t: The miasma pillar at the Plantation of Tall Ferns still stood, anchoring the Druj miasma in Proceris.

Bregasland.t: The higher cost of building in marshes applied in Bregasland, where a Jotun outpost in the Grey Fens was eliminated during an Autumn conjunction.

Brocéliande.t: Mentioned in passing: odd fruit gathered on an adventure there was noted as a magical matter, and the higher cost of building in marshes applied there.

Feroz.t: Feroz suffered under Grendel Governor Rahab, and the Brass Coast weighed a daring plan to steal the Scorrero Nets from under his nose.

Hahnmark.t: Many returned master runesmiths gathered at Runegrott in Hahnmark, where only the consecration of a tomb for Isenbrad remained before a runeforge could be built.

Hercynia.t: Some Great Forest Orcs wished to establish new homes in Hercynia, a request with deep implications for Navarr.

Holberg.t: Holberg university's proposed Chair of the Wolf had been established and was due to be appointed at the Solstice. Pumps imported from Holberg were draining the chambers under the Imperial Mint.

Kahraman.t: Jotun sabotage had wrecked roads and bridges in northern Kahraman, so the Cinnabar Roads plans were obsolete. It was proposed that the Senate fund caravan guards to protect the mithril and white granite trade.

Karsk.t: A small group of Varushkans visited the Mir Mozga at Pyotr's Square to investigate the strange behaviour of the Ketsov; the outcome was not common knowledge.

Liathaven.t: The Lasambrian Jotun struck at Kahraman caravans from a base in southern Liathaven, their return there worried the Marches, and the higher cost of building in marshes applied.

Madruga.t: Rerouted Kahraman caravans now passed through Madruga at risk of raiders, a spreading blight troubled the territory, and heroes freed Sumaah pilgrims in Calvos Sound.

Miaren.t: Some Great Forest Orcs wished to establish new homes in Miaren near the weirwood groves.

Mitwold.t: Mentioned in passing: people were beginning to speak of the Mournwold as Mitwold's equal in prosperity and importance.

Mountains of the Moon.t: Mentioned in passing: the Axos were angry about Imperial involvement in the failure of their joint venture with the Grendel into the Mountains of the Moon.

Mournwold.t: A necromantic enchantment offered a chance to ease the Greensward's hauntings, and Sarcombe's booming trade raised prospects for prosperity. There was also worrying trouble with the local orcs.

Ossium.t: Flooding was worsening in southern Ossium, forcing settlers from their homes and possibly threatening the Crawling Depths. The Druj had dug in at Drownbark Forest.

Otkodov.t: Mentioned in passing: it was where the Thule had taken enslaved Wintermark runesmiths, and Thule merchants from Otkodov interested some Tamazi.

Redoubt.t: Mentioned in passing: Senator Sejanus of Redoubt was named among those tagged in the trade winds.

Reinos.t: Mentioned in passing: orc raiders out of Reinos were named as a threat to the rerouted Kahraman caravans.

Sarangrave.t: The Mallum orcs fled from Zenith into Sarangrave, and Navarri vates held at Karliss remained at the mercy of their Druj captors.

Sea of Snow.t: The Imperial project to map the Sea of Snow was completed, and ship captains were returning with news of what they had found.

Sermersuaq.t: Sermersuaq was free of the Jotun, who left fortifications and lingering scars. Autumn conjunctions there dealt with Jarl Snekmar and rescued Yantl, though Tuuli's Eye was lost.

Skallahn.t: Skallahn was raided by the Empire in Spring, which opened the way for the Sea of Snow mapping, and the Jotun escaped into Skallahn with the stolen relic Tuuli's Eye.

Skarsind.t: The Ethengraw, Illarawm and Yerende septs in Skarsind awaited reassurance before joining the Imperial Orcs, while many Tamazi settled there and became citizens.

Spiral.t: The Archmage of Night led a conjunction to Kephalos' Delve in Screed, whose outcome was not public knowledge.

Tassato.t: Flooded secret chambers beneath Tassato's Imperial Mint were being pumped out and explored, and Kahraman caravans could no longer take direct routes to the city.

Temeschwar.t: After Laughlan vi Temeschwar consecrated Ratibor's Torch with true liao, an aura of Ambition spread through Ratibor and perhaps the whole League.

The Barrens.t: Imperial armies held the line in the Barrens rather than take the Fangs, sending scouts to win over inhabitants who hated both the Druj and the Empire. The higher cost of building in marshes applied there.

Therunin.t: Mentioned in passing: Great Forest Orcs had lived among the Navarr in Therunin for some years.

Volodmartz.t: A conjunction at Urodli's Fall in Brez led to fighting whose exact outcome was not common knowledge.

Zenith.t: Zenith was again part of Urizen but lay in ruins. An appraisal, Prosperity priests, a potent enchantment and the armies were all turned to its restoration.

384YE Winter Solstice winds of war.d: The Jotun were expelled from Sermersuaq with Thule help. Lasambrian Jotun pressed into Kahraman, Mathilda Fisher claimed western Bregasland, and war returned to Liathaven. Four armies guarded Kallavesa through an uneventful season. In the east the Druj fought their way out of Zenith to the Sarangrave, with half their armies paying the full price, and Zenith returned to Imperial hands. The push along the Steel Causeway in the Barrens met stiff resistance and achieved no decisive result. The Winter Sun crushed Druj saboteurs in the Drownbark Forest. Liberty Pact forces razed Rachensgrab, and champions used Rhianos's cauldron to reach Terunael. Five battle opportunities and many conjunctions were offered for the coming summit.

Dawn.t: Dawnish armies faced a heavier penalty to conquest in the Barrens, could not take cautious or yielding orders, and gained better resupply at home after Barrens campaigning. One Barrens battle opportunity aimed to capture a Dawnish collaborator.

Druj.t: The Druj were driven out of Zenith into the Sarangrave, with half their fleeing armies paying the full price. They all but held the Imperial advance in the Barrens, while their saboteurs in the Drownbark Forest were routed.

Highguard.t: Highborn armies could no longer issue the Crusading Storm order but might generate mandates for their assembly wherever they campaigned. They also gained advantages when attacking Zenith from Morrow or defending Morrow.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Tusks stood guard in Kallavesa. The Imperial Orc general Rykana led the Winter Sun to smash Druj saboteurs in the Drownbark Forest in support of Varushka.

Jotun.t: The Jotun were driven from Sermersuaq and showed no sign of attacking Kallavesa. They pressed south instead: Lasambrians targeted Kahraman, they honoured Mathilda Fisher's claim to Bregasland, and they fought again in Liathaven.

Navarr.t: Navarr's ancestral heartland of Brocéliande was the target of a daring expedition, backed by Rhianos's cauldron, that reached the walls of Terunael. Navarr was offered conjunctions there to recover the Tairiscint na Foraoise and rescue injured Marchers.

The Brass Coast.t: Lasambrian Jotun sought to seize the hills of Kahraman and its mithril and white granite. A conjunction aimed to stop them ambushing wagon trains in Serra Briante.

The Marches.t: Mathilda Fisher claimed western Bregasland, and the Jotun stood once more at the threshold of the Mourn. Marchers helped man the Wintermark beacons, and Mournwold conjunctions sought to rescue Wise Maggie and stop Little Robin reaching Liathaven.

Thule.t: Mentioned in passing: the Jotun were driven from Sermersuaq by Imperial strength allied with Thule cunning.

Urizen.t: Zenith was returned to Imperial hands after the Druj fled. Urizen was warned that the Citadel Guard would begin to deteriorate again after the Summer Solstice.

Varushka.t: The Winter Sun came to Varushka's aid, blocking Druj attempts to wreck roads and bridges in the Drownbark Forest. Varushkan armies remained hampered when campaigning alongside Brass Coast or Wintermark forces.

Wintermark.t: Sermersuaq was freed of the Jotun, and Kallavesa was guarded all season without incident while Winterfolk stood ready at the beacons. Wintermark armies kept their honour-bound edge against the Jotun.

384YE Winter Solstice winds of war.o: This was the Winter Solstice 384YE summary of the Empire's campaigns. The Jotun were pushed back in the west, the Druj were driven from Zenith but held the line in the Barrens, and Imperial heroes razed the slaver city of Rachensgrab and delved into the vallorn of Brocéliande.

Bregasland/Grey Fens.t: A conjunction to the Orchard of Tom Wiscall, overseen by the General of the Strong Reeds, aimed to deliver resources to the Scraggy Bole.

Bregasland/North Fens.t: A conjunction to the Dry Marsh, overseen by the Blackroot Broker, aimed to rescue Tall George, an apprentice of Mott.

Brocéliande/Elerael.t: A conjunction to the Silent Copse, overseen by Avery Farkas, aimed to rescue a number of injured Marchers.

Brocéliande/Terunael.t: The cauldron-backed expedition penetrated the walls of the city of Terunael, and a conjunction to Kay's Lament sought to recover the Tairiscint na Foraoise.

Kahraman/Serra Briante.t: A conjunction to Isabella's Track aimed to kill Lasambrian Jotun before they could ambush wagon trains.

Kallavesa/Skymark.t: A conjunction to the Cold Path of Kaisa aimed to kill Lasambrians before they slaughtered a group of Hylje.

Mournwold/Southmoor.t: Two conjunctions were offered here: one to rescue Wise Maggie at Tollerton Green, and one at Friar Tommy's Grave to stop Little Robin reaching Liathaven.

Ossium/Drownbark Forest.t: Druj insurgents tried to destroy vulnerable roads and bridges here until the Winter Sun intervened and crushed the Mallum saboteurs.

Sermersuaq/Stark.t: A conjunction to Vahne's Field aimed to force the Jotun to retreat.

Sermersuaq/Tanikipari.t: A conjunction to Siward's Folly aimed to defeat Jarl Roneth and return the sword to Barien.

The Barrens/Farweald.t: A conjunction to the Broken Glade, overseen by the Apothecary of Orieb, aimed to kill the Sleepless Nightmare.

The Barrens/Murderdale.t: Two conjunctions targeted Druj here: killing the Burnt Fist coven at Berena's Tree and Garsnag Mudchurner at his holt.

The Barrens/The Untrod Groves.t: A conjunction to Soulflayer's Refuge, overseen by the Champion of Vigilance, aimed to kill Varag Soulflayer.

Zenith/Iteri.t: A conjunction to the Spire of the Everlasting Dusk, overseen by the High Exorcist, aimed to lay tortured souls to rest.

Zenith/Lustri.t: A conjunction to the Spire of Twisting Shadow, overseen by the Senator of Zenith, aimed to destroy miasma pillars.

Zenith/Occursion.t: A largely peaceful conjunction to the Ring of Solace ruins aimed to lift spirits and investigate.

Bregasland.t: Mathilda Fisher claimed the western marshes as her fiefdom with Jotun backing, though there was resistance. A battle opportunity offered the chance to rouse Old Marjoram and arrest a Marcher traitor.

Brocéliande.t: Champions from almost every nation used Rhianos's cauldron to delve into the vallorn, pressing right to the heart of the forest and through the walls of Terunael.

Kahraman.t: The Lasambrian Jotun sought to claim the hills for their mithril and white granite, following earlier Jotun attempts that had all been thrown back.

Kallavesa.t: The Drakes, the Fist of the Mountains, the Summer Storm and the Tusks held defensive positions in the marshes all season, but the Jotun never came.

Liathaven.t: War came again to Liathaven as the Jotun exploited the weakness of the vallorn. A battle opportunity offered the chance to destroy keystones and use the Spring regio.

Mitwold.t: Mentioned in passing: any Imperial army could take the Billet order in Mitwold.

Morrow.t: Mentioned in passing: Highborn or Urizen armies defending Morrow against an attack from Zenith gained an advantage.

Mournwold.t: With the Jotun once again at the threshold of the Mourn, conjunctions in Southmoor aimed to rescue Wise Maggie and keep Little Robin from reaching Liathaven.

Ossium.t: The Winter Sun blocked Druj insurgents trying to destroy roads and bridges in the Drownbark Forest. Its orcs made short work of the Mallum saboteurs after Imperial heroes failed to win a decisive victory.

Sarangrave.t: The Druj armies fleeing Zenith, slowed by curses and chains of glass, were forced to seek sanctuary here.

Semmerholm.t: Mentioned in passing: the Adamant Gate in Semmerholm could not be reduced below a set military strength.

Sermersuaq.t: The Jotun were driven out by Imperial strength and Thule cunning. Conjunctions were offered in Stark and Tanikipari.

Skallahn.t: A battle opportunity was offered here to save an Imperial spy network from destruction and stop a fane being built.

The Barrens.t: Imperial armies fought savagely to extend the Steel Causeway, but the Druj all but held their advance. Two battle opportunities and several conjunctions were offered here.

Upwold.t: Mentioned in passing: any Imperial army could take the Billet order in Upwold.

Zenith.t: The Druj fought their way out under curses and pursuit, and Zenith was once again in Imperial hands. Conjunctions were offered in Iteri, Lustri and Occursion.

385YE Autumn Equinox Imperial elections.d: National elections returned senators for ten territories, including Solomon for Casinea, Hengest Dun for Hahnmark and two League seats for Spiral and Tassato. The Senate appointed six generals, among them the generals of the Bounders, Eastern Sky and Wolves of War, plus an Ambassador to the Sarcophan Delves. The Synod elected Sabella of the Silent Tide as Cardinal of Loyalty and Zadkiel de Coeurdefer as Cardinal of Pride. The Military Council filled posts including Quartermaster General and Imperial Warcaster. The Conclave chose two grandmasters, and the Bourse awarded seats such as the Fortress of Salt (451 thrones) and Castellan of Spiral Castle (603 votes).

Dawn.t: Dawn's territory of Semmerholm returned Amicia of the Semmerlak as its senator.

Highguard.t: Highguard's territory of Casinea elected Solomon as its senator.

Navarr.t: Navarr's territory of Therunin returned Travid Longest Path as its senator.

The Brass Coast.t: The Brass Coast's territory of Kahraman elected Delara i Fijadoz i Guerra as its senator.

The League.t: The League filled two Senate seats, with Genoveva Barossa d'Apulian elected for Spiral and Cesare Sanguineo Rezia Di Tassato for Tassato.

The Marches.t: The Marches' territory of Upwold elected Johnny Tailor as its senator.

Urizen.t: Urizen's territory of Morrow returned Laelius Archsky as its senator.

Varushka.t: Varushka's territory of Volodmartz elected Desilav Sergeyevich Jesen as its senator.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark's territory of Hahnmark returned Hengest Dun as its senator.

385YE Autumn Equinox Imperial elections.o: At the Autumn Equinox summit of 385YE, the Empire filled a wide range of titles through national senatorial elections, Senate and Military Council appointments, Synod judgements, Conclave votes and Bourse auctions and votes.

Casinea.t: Solomon was elected Senator for Casinea.

Hahnmark.t: Hengest Dun was elected Senator for Hahnmark.

Kahraman.t: Delara i Fijadoz i Guerra was elected Senator for Kahraman.

Morrow.t: Laelius Archsky was elected Senator for Morrow.

Semmerholm.t: Amicia of the Semmerlak was elected Senator for Semmerholm.

Spiral.t: Genoveva Barossa d'Apulian was elected Senator for Spiral, and Mortarion Carver won the Bourse vote for Castellan of Spiral Castle with 603 votes.

Tassato.t: Cesare Sanguineo Rezia Di Tassato was elected Senator for Tassato.

Therunin.t: Travid Longest Path was elected Senator for Therunin.

Upwold.t: Johnny Tailor was elected Senator for Upwold.

Volodmartz.t: Desilav Sergeyevich Jesen was elected Senator for Volodmartz.

385YE Autumn Equinox Senate sessions.d: The treasury stood at 602 thrones and 4 crowns. Administrative motions ruled the Vendarri barbarians under the 379YE war on the orcs of the Barrens, and left the Montanians as barbarians. The Senate declared war on the Grendel, funded military resupply in Karsk (400 thrones) and the Wintermark army (175 thrones), raised a third Imperial Orc army in Skarsind and gave the Quartermaster General a 300-throne stipend. New titles included the Citizens' Voice, the Benefactor of Regalia and the National Strategos. Commissions and announcements created works in Volodmartz, Zenith, Holberg, Tassato, Kahraman, Miaren, Mitwold, Kallavesa, Reikos, Temeschwar, the Mournwold, Hahnmark and Ossium. Thalia of Netherwatch and Xanthius were elected to Imperial titles.

Dawn.t: Dawnish senators drove several motions, with Semmerholm proposing the war on the Grendel, Astolat securing a 300-throne stipend for the Quartermaster General and Weirwater commissioning an appraisal of the damaged Spider's Dream tollbridge.

Druj.t: The Senate confirmed that the Winter 379YE declaration of war on the orcs of the Barrens includes the Vendarri, and its failure to extend the peace treaty left the Montanians active in the Barrens classed as barbarians.

Grendel.t: The Senate declared war on the Grendel, who are now considered barbarians under Imperial law.

Highguard.t: Highborn senators created the Benefactor of Regalia, appointed by their unanimous decision, and the national Strategos titles, and commissioned the Greenwatch ministry in Reikos to aid those fighting the vallorn; a proposed great work in Holberg towards Highguard's debt to the League was withdrawn.

Imperial Orcs.t: A third Imperial Orc army, the Autumn Hammers, began raising in Skarsind from the Ethengraw sept.

Jotun.t: Mentioned in passing: the Jotun are not named; the page's only link is Bregasland, where the Senate sent magistrates to root out traitorous households.

Navarr.t: The Senate built Stones from Blood, a mana ministry in Miaren for the Navarr vates council, while Navarri senators proposed the Throne election and the roads appraisal.

The Brass Coast.t: The Brass Coast gained the Red Depths, a self-funded mithril national bourse seat in Kahraman, and 25 thrones for the Kahraman roads and Kamkrag forts project, while Madruga's senator created the Citizens' Voice.

The League.t: The League gained the Legacy in Spiral as a national bourse seat, the Lakesedge Highway, Holberg's Melodious Cascade and the Gates of Holmauer Park in Holberg, the Five Cities Military Academy in Tassato and the School of Hard Knocks in Temeschwar.

The Marches.t: Marcher senators dredged the Westmere to create a mithril ministry in Meade, and though the Townsend Treasury motion failed it was later announced as a sinecure in Sarcombe; Bambrick's Lament was withdrawn.

Urizen.t: Urizen repaired the Tower of the Fall in Zenith, secured 35 thrones a season for mana to shroud its remaining spires in Spiral, and saw Thalia of Netherwatch and Xanthius elected Ambassador to the Sarcophan Delves and Guildmaster of the Artisans.

Varushka.t: Varushka gained the Deep Place and the Triosk Metal Exchange in Volodmartz and Kurstrozi's Lumbermill in Ossium, plus 400 thrones for military resupply via Karsk's senator; a proposal to drown the condemned in the Semmerlak was withdrawn.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark received 175 thrones towards its half-levied army, the Bright-Threads Brass Works in Hahnmark and an ilium ministry in Fisk, Kallavesa, and Sermersuaq's senator created the Writ of Consecration.

385YE Autumn Equinox Senate sessions.o: At the Autumn Equinox 385YE the Senate passed a heavy programme of motions, declaring war on the Grendel, electing Vesna Borkovna Prochnost as the Throne pending ratification, and commissioning many new ministries, sinecures and great works across the Empire.

Hahnmark/Valasmark.t: The Bright-Threads Brass Works, an orichalcum sinecure, was built in Valasmark.

Holberg/Holmauer.t: Holmauer gained Holberg's Melodious Cascade and the Gates of Holmauer Park, and the Lakesedge Highway begins at the Holmauer Gate.

Astolat.t: Mentioned in passing: Astolat's senator proposed the Quartermaster General's stipend and seconded the Five Cities Military Academy.

Bastion.t: Mentioned in passing: Bastion's senator seconded the war on the Grendel and proposed a withdrawn great work in Holberg.

Bregasland.t: Magistrates were sent in force to root out traitorous households, imposing a one-rank penalty on every personal resource in Bregasland until the Winter Solstice.

Casinea.t: Mentioned in passing: Casinea's senator proposed the National Strategos titles and seconded the Benefactor of Regalia; the Greenwatch was proposed for Casinea but recorded as built in Reikos.

Hahnmark.t: The Bright-Threads Brass Works orichalcum sinecure was built in Hahnmark, and its senator received 175 thrones for the Wintermark army.

Hercynia.t: Mentioned in passing: Hercynia's senator proposed the Throne election and seconded the Greenwatch.

Holberg.t: Holberg gained the Lakesedge Highway sinecure through Rebeshof, Holberg's Melodious Cascade and the Gates of Holmauer Park great work; a motion to make Semmerlak drowning its default execution was withdrawn.

Kahraman.t: The Red Depths mithril bourse seat was created in Kahraman, and 25 thrones went to its roads and Kamkrag forts project.

Kallavesa.t: Dredging the Westmere created an ilium ministry in Fisk held by the Mediator of Fisk.

Karov.t: Mentioned in passing: Karov's senator proposed the withdrawn Semmerlak drowning motion and seconded the Dean of the Academy amendment.

Karsk.t: Karsk's senator received 400 thrones for military resupply.

Madruga.t: Mentioned in passing: Madruga's senator proposed the Citizens' Voice and seconded the Spider's Dream appraisal.

Miaren.t: The Stones from Blood mana ministry for the Navarr vates council was built in Miaren.

Miekarova.t: Mentioned in passing: Miekarova's senator proposed the Sarcophan Delves ambassador election and seconded the Deep Place.

Mitwold.t: Dredging the Westmere at Meade March created a mithril ministry in Meade held by the Alder of Meade.

Morrow.t: Mentioned in passing: Morrow's senator proposed the failed Arcane Architect amendment and seconded the Dean election.

Mournwold.t: After the Senate motion failed, the Townsend Treasury money sinecure in Sarcombe was created by announcement.

Necropolis.t: Mentioned in passing: Necropolis's senator proposed the Benefactor of Regalia and seconded the Strategos titles.

Ossium.t: Kurstrozi's Lumbermill great work was commissioned in Drownbark to increase the prosperity of Ossium's forests.

Redoubt.t: Mentioned in passing: Redoubt's senator proposed the Dean of the Academy amendment and seconded the Spiral mana motion.

Reikos.t: The Greenwatch ministry, supporting those who fight the vallorn, was constructed in Reikos.

Sarvos.t: Mentioned in passing: Sarvos's senator seconded the withdrawn drowning motion and proposed the Dean election.

Segura.t: Mentioned in passing: Segura's senator proposed the Red Depths and seconded the Lakesedge Highway.

Semmerholm.t: Mentioned in passing: Semmerholm's senator proposed the war on the Grendel, and the territory was named in the withdrawn drowning motion.

Sermersuaq.t: Mentioned in passing: Sermersuaq's senator proposed the Writ of Consecration and seconded the Wintermark army funding.

Skarsind.t: The Autumn Hammers, a third Imperial Orc army, began raising in Skarsind from the Ethengraw sept.

Spiral.t: The Legacy was made a League bourse seat, and 35 thrones a season will buy mana to cast Vale of Shadows over the remaining Urizeni spires.

Tassato.t: The Five Cities Military Academy folly was constructed in Tassato.

Temeschwar.t: The School of Hard Knocks sinecure was built in Temeschwar, creating the Maestro of Wolves.

The Barrens.t: The Vendarri were ruled barbarians under the existing war on the orcs of the Barrens, and the Montanians active there remain barbarians.

Therunin.t: Mentioned in passing: Therunin's senator proposed the roads appraisal and seconded the Legacy allocation.

Upwold.t: Mentioned in passing: Upwold's senator seconded the Bregasland investigation and proposed the withdrawn Bambrick's Lament.

Volodmartz.t: The Deep Place mine workings in Brez and the Triosk Metal Exchange were both built as ministries in Volodmartz.

Weirwater.t: Mentioned in passing: Weirwater's senator proposed the Spider's Dream appraisal, and the territory was named in the withdrawn drowning motion.

Zenith.t: The Tower of the Fall in Occursion was rebuilt as a mana sinecure joining the Proffered Hand network.

385YE Autumn Equinox Synod judgements.d: Clarice Novarion's change of doctrine was upheld with a greater majority (3013–159). The Assembly of Nine declined to veto the Throne's election. Aurum's mandate means that any army sent against the Urizeni rebels in Spiral before Autumn 386YE will spread rebellion across Urizen. Herminius's mandate sundered the sword scholars from Sulemaine, shattering the Temple of the Four Winds and weakening Urizen congregations. Navarr, backed by the Eyes of Loyalty, was urged to help the Great Forest Orcs take the Heart of Peytaht. Wintermark and Navarr committed resources to the sacred city in Bastion. The Marches welcomed the Mournwold Orcs, and the Imperial Orcs took the name Unshackled. Jared of the Suns of Couros was revoked as Lepidean Librarian.

Dawn.t: Dawn's assembly crowned its yearly champions, celebrated the return of the Rod of the Sun and set out rules for the girding of Black Knights. It urged vigilance against the Druj and restraint towards the Montanians of the Barrens, and opened Dawnish homes to the Free Folk, while Ser Dindrane's Laroc mandate failed.

Druj.t: The Vigilance assembly advocated cursing the Druj heartland of Sanath. A Highborn mandate set the Valiant Pegasus to limit casualties and open talks with orc septs oppressed by the Druj in the Salt Flats.

Grendel.t: With the Grendel treaty ended, the Freeborn assembly vowed to reclaim Feroz, called for raids on enemy shipping in the Bay of Catazar and urged citizens to root out Grendel spies. Urizen priests warned the Spiral rebels that the Grendel were coming.

Highguard.t: The Highborn invited the Free Folk to settle in Highguard, affirmed that lineage is a matter of the body rather than the spirit, and offered Peerless Kinship to the Imperial Orcs, who accepted it. Their priests also rallied veterans under the Thundering Tide to defend Bastion from the Cold Sun, and Hazelelponi replaced the revoked Jared as Lepidean Librarian.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Imperial Orc assembly claimed the name Unshackled for their nation, accepted Highguard's Peerless Kinship and sent supplies to the Rahvin in Bitter Strand. The Synod's new Doctrine of Enlightenment declares orcs and humans equal in Virtue.

Jotun.t: A Freeborn mandate ensures visiting Jotun ghodi are escorted safely to raise a monument at their burial mound in Kahraman. The General Assembly urged those fighting the Jotun to respect their dead and leave their sacred sites undesecrated.

Navarr.t: A Navarr mandate, supported by the Eyes of Loyalty, lets Navarr armies help the Great Forest Orcs claim the Heart of Peytaht. Another commits every affected Navarr territory to donate 12 wains of white granite and 24 crowns each season for a year towards the sacred city in Bastion.

The Brass Coast.t: The Freeborn assembly vowed to reclaim Feroz, urged raids on enemy shipping and vigilance against Grendel spies, and backed the corsairs' wish for their own leader. It also sent an honour guard to escort the Jotun at Kahraman and called on corsairs to rescue escaping slaves from Marlien.

The League.t: League priests urged sending mana from Lorenzo's Legacies to help the Urizeni spires of Spiral, and called for dialogue with Urizen and the Apulian Orcs rather than warfare. League bishops also offered to show Apulian questioners how to use the Synod's powers.

The Marches.t: The Marcher assembly's mandate declared the former Jotun thrall orcs to be Marchers. It also backed inquisitors hunting supporters of the Fisher rebellion in Bregasland, declared Sadogua a friend to Marcher wizards and warned miners about the Wanderer, while a call to boycott food sales to Urizen failed.

Thule.t: Mentioned in passing: Gisli is praised for raising money to feed the Thule, and Varushkan wardens are asked to protect the caravans of the Thule warlock Orathator of the Hourglass.

Urizen.t: Aurum's mandate threatens nationwide Urizeni rebellion if the Empire sends an army against the rebels in Spiral, though Callista's call to spread the uprising failed. Herminius's mandate shattered the Temple of the Four Winds and cost every Urizen congregation two votes and one liao. The assembly also urged raising a second army and thanked Varushka for helping build the Gardens of Pallas in Zenith.

Varushka.t: Varushkan priests urged fleet owners to prepare for war and asked wardens to strengthen the wards around Tolvoli against the dubik. They also invited Skywise Gralka to the Palace of Orieb, called for pride in the Northern Eagle and were thanked by Urizen for their wayleave gift.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark's assembly added Atte Arrowtongue and Helgunn Chargebringer to the Chronicle of Heroism, called for an artisan academy and sought news of the banner Foeslayer. Its mandate commits each affected territory to 4 wains of white granite and 8 crowns a season for a year towards the sacred city in Bastion.

385YE Autumn Equinox Synod judgements.o: At the Autumn Equinox 385YE the Synod raised 202 judgements, most significantly replacing the Doctrine of Human Destiny with a new Doctrine of Enlightenment that holds Virtue exalts orcs and humans alike. It also passed major mandates on Spiral, the sword scholars of Urizen, the Barrens and the Mournwold Orcs.

The Barrens/Bitter Strand.t: Imperial Orc priests deliver food and supplies to the Rahvin here. This makes the sept well disposed towards the Imperial Orcs and willing to negotiate with them on the Empire's behalf.

The Barrens/Heart of Peytaht.t: Any Navarr army in the Barrens that explicitly attacks the Heart of Peytaht in support of the Great Forest Orcs can help them conquer it. The orcs would then claim the region without needing the Senate to concede it.

Bastion.t: Wintermark and Navarr mandates direct white granite and money to the sacred city being built here, and the Virtue Fund made a partial contribution. Highborn priests also urged its defence against the Cold Sun's forces gathering there and backed an inspirational monument at Berechiah's basilica.

Bregasland.t: The Marcher assembly backed the Senator for Bregasland in sending inquisitors to find those who supported the Mathilda Fisher rebellion. It asked Bregas priests to offer clemency pleas for the virtuous.

Feroz.t: The Freeborn assembly declared Feroz an integral part of the Brass Coast and vowed to reclaim it. Its earlier mandate abandoning the territory makes further opportunities unlikely.

Hahnmark.t: Wintermark's priests urged the courageous to garrison the Beacons of Wintermark, which stand in Hahnmark, against the Cold Sun.

Kahraman.t: A Freeborn mandate provides an honour guard escorting Jotun ghodi to raise a monument at the burial mound here, which prevents their capture. Helgunn Chargebringer, who fell in Kahraman, was added to the Chronicle of Heroism.

Kallavesa.t: Wintermark's priests called for the Beacons of Wintermark, which stand in Kallavesa, to be garrisoned against the Cold Sun. The lost banner Foeslayer was said to have been interred in the Kallavesi swamps.

Mitwold.t: Mentioned in passing: the Marcher assembly exalted Jonathan Piper, who had earlier warned the people of Mitwold about heralds of Siakha.

Necropolis.t: The Highborn assembly praised the Imperial Orcs' campaign to reclaim items of worth in the Necropolis. Wintermark called for Britta's memorial here to be linked as a place of pilgrimage with her pool in the Sovevann.

Ossium.t: The Varushkan assembly invited Skywise Gralka and the Sunstorm sept to seek secrets at the Palace of Orieb in Ossium.

Redoubt.t: Mentioned in passing: the League's mana offer may help the spires of Spiral stay connected to their fellows in Zenith and Redoubt.

Salt Flats of Sanath.t: The Vigilance assembly advocated cursing Sanath while the Citadel Guard are present. A Highborn mandate commits the Valiant Pegasus to minimise casualties and open communication with the orc septs while fighting here.

Sermersuaq.t: Atte Arrowtongue was honoured partly for working to lift up Sermersuaq. Two assemblies warned that three Blood-on-the-Snow cultist leaders remain at large after its liberation.

Spiral.t: Spiral dominated the Synod's business. Aurum's mandate means any army sent against its Urizeni rebels before Autumn 386YE will spread rebellion across Urizen. League and Urizen priests pressed for reckoning and dialogue, and Urizen resumed using the mithril block to protect the spires.

The Barrens.t: Several assemblies debated whether the Empire came to the Barrens as liberators or conquerors, urging restraint towards the Montanians and education in the Way. Mandates were also passed supporting the Great Forest Orcs and the Rahvin.

The Semmerlak.t: A statement defending the drowning of criminals in the Semmerlak to satisfy Dho'uala failed narrowly and was withdrawn.

Zenith.t: Urizen priests noted that Zenith is being rebuilt and thanked Varushka for the wayleave used to build the Gardens of Pallas here. A Marcher inquisition over a curse on Zenith was withdrawn.

385YE Autumn Equinox interlude.d: Dawnish and Navarri units could fight the heralds of Cold Sun. Freeborn and League units could guard Kahraman's caravans at Senate expense. Highborn and Varushkan units could arm and train the Dreamers of the Dark Forest in Echofell. Freeborn corsairs and Highborn fleets could help ships slip through the Asavean blockade of Sumaah ports. Bright Eyes Gleam in the Depths added ingots to every Imperial mine. Dawnish magicians infused their four territories with Summer magic. Tharim began feasting on Brass Coast and Dawnish resources in return for military support. Dho'uala's harassment of Semmerlak fleets eased. The Guerdon stood at 350 thrones, shared among five armies.

Dawn.t: Dawnish units could defend their people against Cold Sun, and all four Dawnish territories were infused with Summer magic. Dawnish mana sites and farms paid a tithe to Tharim in return for support for an army in the Barrens, while Dawnish fleets were temporarily freed from Dho'uala's penalty.

Druj.t: The Dreamers sept were being armed and trained to drive the remaining Druj out of Echofell's forest depths. Tharim's knights would also support a Dawnish army fighting in the Barrens.

Grendel.t: Grendel merchants traded enthusiastically with Highborn businesses in Necropolis under the Wildfyre mandate. Grendel's continued hold on Feroz kept the Atalaya Harbour discount in place for Madruga.

Highguard.t: Highguard faced reduced mana from the hunt for the Whisper Gallery and a production penalty on every business to fund Free Folk tutelage. Against this, its congregations gained liao, votes and income from the Birthplace of the Way, and its units and fleets could train the Dreamers or thwart the blockade.

Navarr.t: With the Navarri assembly's statement reaching their priests in time, Navarri military units could take up the fight against the heralds of Cold Sun.

The Brass Coast.t: Tharim's black frost drained a crystal from every Freeborn mana site and three drams of true vervain from every herb garden, in return for supporting the Fire of the South. Freeborn units could guard Kahraman's caravans, and corsairs could help thwart the Asavean blockade.

The League.t: League units could take paid work guarding Kahraman's caravans, and League congregations preaching Ambition gained liao and Synod votes. League businesses were also cheaper to upgrade during a grand competition.

Urizen.t: Mentioned in passing: no new rituals were added to Urizen lore during the Summer Solstice.

Varushka.t: Varushkan units could help arm and train the Dreamers in Echofell, and Varushkan fleets were temporarily freed from Dho'uala's harassment. The Deadwood Knight's curse did not fall on Karov.

385YE Autumn Equinox interlude.o: Between the 385YE Summer Solstice and Autumn Equinox, a round-up set out the season's special downtime options and large-scale effects. These included adventures against Cold Sun, caravan guarding in Kahraman, training the Dreamers sept and thwarting the Asavean blockade, alongside enchantments, curses and mandates affecting production across the Empire.

Ossium/Echofell.t: The Dreamers of the Dark Forest sept in Echofell were being given weapons, armour and training by Highborn and Varushkan units so they could drive the remaining Druj from the forest.

Astolat.t: Astolat was infused with Summer magic by Dawnish magicians aided by Meraud, likely drawing heralds of that realm to its people.

Feroz.t: Mentioned in passing: the Madruga fleet upgrade discount would last only as long as the Freeborn did not control Feroz.

Holberg.t: Holberg's fleets were freed, for this season at least, from the one-rank production penalty caused by Dho'uala's harassment on the Semmerlak.

Kahraman.t: The Senate paid for guards and mercenaries to give Kahraman's people short-term protection from raiders, smugglers, bandits and accidents, using Freeborn and League units.

Karov.t: Although the Deadwood Knight was defeated, for some reason their curse did not fall on Karov.

Madruga.t: While the Atalaya Harbour remained, fleets in Madruga cost one less wain of weirwood to upgrade.

Necropolis.t: Visiting Grendel traders dealt with Highborn businesses in Necropolis, giving each business an extra 2 crowns a season.

Ossium.t: Training the Dreamers sept to drive out the remaining Druj could, with Senate approval, lift Ossium's under-threat quality.

Semmerholm.t: Semmerholm was infused with Summer magic, likely encouraging heralds of that realm to visit.

The Barrens.t: The Barrens were infused with Summer magic alongside Dawn's other territories. Tharim pledged steel-bound support to a Dawnish army fighting there.

The Semmerlak.t: Dho'uala's harassment of Dawnish, Varushkan and Holberg fleets on the Semmerlak eased this season. However, the Custodian of Ivarsgard Docks and the Harbourmaster of the Semmerlak faced higher prices, and the Harbourmaster lost access to ilium.

Weirwater.t: Weirwater was infused with Summer magic, and every herb garden there would yield an extra dose of bladeroot from the defeated Deadwood Knight's boon.

385YE Autumn Equinox winds of fortune.d: This index introduced eighteen winds of fortune. Among them were eternal plenipotentiary responses, two Senate appraisals on raiding and on Spiral, and new mineral wealth exposed at Redgate Pass. Others covered magicians' unease over Bright Eyes Gleam in the Depths and the murderous Cold Sun heralds, the angry orc septs of the newly Dawnish Barrens, the Sulemaine debate among the sword scholars, three Marcher dilemmas, the Apulian orcs, the League's city competition, Highguard's cities, Jotun envoys and foreign affairs. Shorter notes reported the completed expansion of the Hacynian library and powerful rituals cast. A trade summary followed, with Axos hostile over the Mountains of the Moon. Most conjunction tables record successes, though Fort Braydon collapsed and several missions suffered losses.

Dawn.t: With the Barrens conquered and assigned to Dawn, the nation celebrates while its National Assembly pursues working with the angry orc septs rather than settling the land. The Regents of Summer reportedly ensured no Dawnish citizen fell to the soldiers of Day.

Druj.t: The Druj lost the Barrens for good and suffered defeats at Oakenclough, the Silent Glade, Thicket of Thorns and Broken Clearing, and Varag Soulflayer was slain. Highborn voices also urged a liberating approach on the road to Leen in the Salt Flats.

Grendel.t: Orcs who once followed former Salt Lord Kaliact are joining the League as Apulians, Grendel agents have been uncovered in the League, and war with the Grendel is widely expected. The port of Oran remains closed to Imperial fleets.

Highguard.t: The Highborn helped Dawn make contact with the Barrens septs and supported the Hacynian vallorn research. The Cities and the City covers spies, malevolent heralds and dark powers in Bastion and Necropolis.

Imperial Orcs.t: Mentioned in passing: listed among the interested parties for the When Spring Comes and The Cities and the City winds.

Jotun.t: After Brass Coast respect at Fort Braydon and Wintermark's honourable fighting in Tromsa, a young ghodi and a northern envoy came seeking talks, the latter bearing a request. Elsewhere Jotun forces were slain in Torres, Enterio and Greenwall, Magnus Ironarm and Blade Quencher died, and Jarl Haakon retreated from the Mournwold.

Navarr.t: The expansion of the Great Library at Hacynian is complete, and vallorn research is expected by the Summer Solstice 386YE if invading forces in Northpines do not strike. Navarr scholars were invited to take part, and the Pool of Silver Clouds in Goldglades was protected at heavy cost.

The Brass Coast.t: The Freeborn face the eternal Tharim's raids on mana sites and herb gardens, new mineral opportunities at Redgate Pass in Kahraman, and a Jotun ghodi drawn by their respect at Fort Braydon, which has since collapsed. Their assembly also lifted the Asavean blockade of Zemeh.

The League.t: The League grapples with an appraisal on Urizen loyalty in Spiral, a contested first Senate election for Spiral, and its city competition, now turning towards education. It also faces Grendel agents uncovered in Sarvos and the Sand Fishers' logging of Misericorde.

The Marches.t: Marchers face three dilemmas: Day and Maelstrom heralds in Mitwold, the risk of violence in the Dour Fens of Bregasland, and the question of the Mournwold Orcs coming to a head. Bright Eyes Gleam in the Depths has also raised serious issues in the nation, and Marcher fleets enjoy a bonus trading at Caitun.

Thule.t: Mentioned in passing: Thule warlocks keen to speak with experts on the vallorn are among the visitors expected at Anvil.

Urizen.t: The Urizen of Spiral simmer in open rebellion, a matter the Spiral appraisal tries to untangle. The Urizen Assembly's praise of Sulemaine and a plan to consecrate her tomb have reignited debate over the sword scholars' inspiration.

Varushka.t: The last of the Varushkan vyig was killed at Butterfly Holt in Srodkoja. Varushka is also tagged in The Cities and the City, and the Guardian of the Maze of Zoria in the winds of magic.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark's armies led the charge deep into Tromsa, and their honourable conduct has prompted the Jotun to respond in kind and send an envoy to the generals. A Jotun ghodi also hopes to discuss ancestors with the Winterfolk.

385YE Autumn Equinox winds of fortune.o: The Autumn Equinox 385YE winds of fortune summarised the season's developments across the Empire, from the final Dawnish conquest of the Barrens and rebellion in Spiral to Jotun overtures of honour, Day-realm heralds and new mineral wealth in Kahraman. They also recorded the outcomes of the Summer Solstice Sentinel Gate conjunctions.

Astolat/Winterbourne.t: The Harps of Astolat at the Gardens of House Cadence were eventually protected, though with Imperial losses.

Bregasland/Grey Fens.t: Dripping Echoes of the Fen was cast in the Grey Fens.

Bregasland/Ottermire.t: An attempted meeting with Bushel Sykes at the Ottery Fishing Docks ended with Sykes murdered.

Feroz/Cazar Straits.t: The Archmage of Spring met emissaries of Siakha at Azcara's Field, with results known only to them.

Hercynia/Northpines.t: Invading forces in Northpines threaten the Great Library at Hacynian and the vallorn research timetable.

Holberg/Misericorde.t: The Sand Fishers have begun logging the Misericorde woodlands in earnest.

Kahraman/Serra Briante.t: Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae was cast in Serra Briante.

Kahraman/Serra Damata.t: The passes into Serra Damata from Jotun territory were blocked at Redgate Pass, exposing mineral wealth the Empire might develop.

Kallavesa/Skymark.t: The Aviary of Ishal at Maiko's Copse was protected, Maiko rescued and all the heralds slain.

Madruga/Calvos Sound.t: The Tassatan vyig was ended at Renewal Grove and its documents secured.

Madruga/Torres.t: The Jotun at Fondre's Rest were stopped and all killed.

Miaren/Goldglades.t: The Pool of Silver Clouds at Verdant Grove was protected, with many Imperial losses.

Miekarova/Srodkoja.t: The last of the Varushkan vyig was killed at Butterfly Holt.

Mitwold/Golden Downs.t: Sally Thresher of House Talbot confronted heralds on the Long Road, with the outcome known only to her.

Mournwold/Southmoor.t: Jarl Haakon was confronted at Maggie's Croft but escaped with a small entourage and retreated from the Mournwold.

Ossium/Drownbark Forest.t: Druj and heralds were killed at Broken Clearing with many casualties, and Dripping Echoes of the Fen was cast here.

Ossium/Echofell.t: Forge the Wooden Fastness was cast in Echofell.

Reinos/Bastasor.t: The Jotun at Beatriz's Field were killed and the Overflowing Platter recovered.

Sarangrave/Nesustak Forest.t: The Druj were defeated at the Thicket of Thorns and Decius Frostspire escaped.

Skallahn/Greenwall.t: Jarl Asbjørn Dalgaard's Jotun were all slain at Paegga's Rest.

Skallahn/Iron Stand.t: An attempt to recover the shield of Blerung the Bright Lantern at Kevan's Holt failed, leaving it in Jotun hands.

Spiral/Apulus.t: Many orcs in Apulus are hedging their bets about joining the League, and the senatorial seat once styled Apulus is now contested as Spiral.

Tassato/Enterio.t: Magnus Ironarm and his Jotun died at Duarte's Repose.

Temeschwar/Vardstein Vale.t: The last of the Temeschwari vyig were killed in the Broken Wilds.

The Barrens/Heart of Peytaht.t: The Druj were defeated at the Silent Glade and the elders of Peytaht saved.

The Barrens/Hope's Rest.t: The Druj were broken at Oakenclough, though Circe was killed. The ghosts at the Shrine of Hope were soothed and the shrine consecrated to Ambition.

The Barrens/The Untrod Groves.t: Varag Soulflayer was killed at Garstang Thicket.

Upwold/Tower March.t: Benson's Orchard was consecrated to Vigilance.

Weirwater/Sandling.t: Areloe Larmallevés investigated strange events at Surlac, and what she found is known only to her.

Weirwater/Wickmoor.t: The Champion of Dawn defeated the Deadwood Knight in the woods bordering Karov.

Zenith/Proceris.t: Dripping Echoes of the Fen was cast in Proceris.

Astolat.t: Astolat is expected to celebrate the Barrens' assignment to Dawn, and sword scholars have been invited to teach at Laroc. The Harps of Astolat were protected at the Gardens of House Cadence, though with Imperial losses.

Bastion.t: Bastion is one of four cities whose challenges, including spies and malevolent heralds, are explored in The Cities and the City.

Bay of Catazar.t: Mentioned in passing: the Bay of Catazar is not named directly on this page.

Bregasland.t: The legacy of the Fishers lingers in Bregasland, and the Dour Fens risk erupting into violence at any moment. Bushel Sykes was murdered at the Ottery Fishing Docks, and Dripping Echoes of the Fen was cast in the Grey Fens.

Brocéliande.t: Mentioned in passing: information recovered from Brocéliande is aiding the vallorn research at Hacynian.

Feroz.t: The Archmage of Spring used a conjunction to meet emissaries of Siakha at Azcara's Field; the outcome is known only to them.

Hercynia.t: The expansion of the Great Library at Hacynian is complete, but the invading forces in Northpines threaten the research timetable.

Holberg.t: Sword scholars have been invited to teach in Holberg, and Prince Bishop Jonah von Holberg's statement on scholarship has spurred League interest in education. Meanwhile the Sand Fishers have begun logging Misericorde in earnest.

Kahraman.t: The blocking of Redgate Pass sealed Serra Damata from Jotun territory and exposed mineral wealth the Empire may develop if it can afford to. Fort Braydon, left unaided, collapsed after the Summer Solstice, and Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae was cast in Serra Briante.

Kallavesa.t: The Raven Seer's band protected the Aviary of Ishal at Maiko's Copse, rescuing Maiko and slaying all the heralds.

Karov.t: Mentioned in passing: the Deadwood Knight was defeated in woods on Weirwater's border with Karov.

Madruga.t: The Tassatan vyig was ended at Renewal Grove and the documents secured, and Jotun raiders in Torres were all killed. In the Great Grasses an individual was recovered, but scholars facing the blight and the defenders of the Aldea di Tutamen estate were forced to retreat.

Miaren.t: The Pool of Silver Clouds at Verdant Grove was protected successfully, though at the cost of many Imperial lives.

Miekarova.t: The last of the Varushkan vyig was killed at Butterfly Holt.

Mitwold.t: Attacks by Day heralds in Mitwold were complicated by savage Maelstrom heralds, with an unexpected outcome. Sally Thresher of House Talbot dealt with heralds on the Long Road.

Mountains of the Moon.t: Mentioned in passing: Axos remains furious at Imperial involvement in the failure of its joint venture with the Grendel into the Mountains of the Moon.

Mournwold.t: The question of the Mournwold Orcs is coming to a head with far-reaching implications. Jarl Haakon and a small entourage escaped and retreated from the territory.

Necropolis.t: Necropolis is one of four cities whose dangers and opportunities, such as worries about dark powers, are explored in The Cities and the City.

Ossium.t: Druj and heralds were killed at Broken Clearing in Drownbark Forest with many casualties. Dripping Echoes of the Fen was cast in Drownbark Forest, and Forge the Wooden Fastness in Echofell.

Otkodov.t: Mentioned in passing: Otkodov is listed among the Empire's influential neighbours, and its Ambassador is flagged in Ten Travellers Tales.

Reinos.t: The General of the Red Wind Corsairs' band killed the Jotun at Beatriz's Field and recovered the Overflowing Platter.

Salt Flats of Sanath.t: On the road to Leen, the Highborn urge their fellow nations to remember they come as liberators, not conquerors.

Sarangrave.t: The Druj were defeated at the Thicket of Thorns, allowing Decius Frostspire to escape.

Sarvos.t: Grendel agents have been uncovered in the League, and events in Sarvos are among those covered in The Cities and the City.

Semmerholm.t: Mentioned in passing: Semmerholm is named among the Dawnish territories expected to celebrate and to be looked to for national improvement.

Skallahn.t: Blade Quencher's Hall was severed from the Autumn realm and Blade Quencher killed. Jarl Asbjørn Dalgaard's Jotun were slain at Paegga's Rest, but the shield of Blerung the Bright Lantern remains in Jotun hands.

Spiral.t: Spiral's Urizen simmer in open rebellion, the subject of a Senate appraisal. Human and Apulian orc candidates contest the territory's first League Senate seat, while questions of virtue and religion remain unsettled.

Tassato.t: Magnus Ironarm died along with his Jotun at Duarte's Repose in Enterio.

Temeschwar.t: The last of the Temeschwari vyig were killed in the Broken Wilds.

The Barrens.t: Newly conquered and assigned to Dawn, the Barrens are home to orc septs angered by the decision, whom Dawn hopes to appease rather than displace. The Druj were broken at Oakenclough and defeated at the Silent Glade, Varag Soulflayer was slain, and the Shrine of Hope was consecrated to Ambition.

Therunin.t: Mentioned in passing: the Senator for Therunin led the conjunction that defeated the Druj at the Silent Glade in the Barrens.

Tromsa.t: Wintermark's armies have taken the war deep into Tromsa, and the Jotun there have begun fighting with matching honour and sent an envoy to the generals.

Upwold.t: Benson's Orchard in Tower March, the orchard of Benson the Bellringer, was consecrated to Vigilance.

Weirwater.t: Weirwater is expected to celebrate Dawn's victory. Areloe Larmallevés investigated events at Surlac, and the Champion of Dawn defeated the Deadwood Knight near the Karov border.

Zenith.t: Dripping Echoes of the Fen was cast in Proceris.

385YE Autumn Equinox winds of war.d: The Military Council was to choose two of three battle opportunities: capturing Sarra Grubfeast in the Salt Flats of Sanath, stopping the Druj and their Winter eternal ally securing magical allies in the Barrens, and capturing the Blue Eel banner and ransoming Mathilda Fisher from the Jotun and yegarra in Tromsa. Each battle needed 136 to 145 force weight from the nations listed. Conjunctions included many attempts to stop heralds across Imperial territories, ventures in Tromsa, and encounters with Quiet Charlie, the Drake's Dozen and the Company of the Torch. Standing considerations covered billeting in Upwold and Mitwold, Marcher and Wintermark bonuses, a Varushkan penalty, and modifiers for fighting between Morrow and Zenith.

Dawn.t: Dawn could send a force weight of 49 to the battles, and Dawnish armies remained unable to take the Cautious Advance or Give Ground orders.

Druj.t: The Druj were the opposition in two of the three battle opportunities: protecting Sarra Grubfeast in the Salt Flats of Sanath, and seeking magical allies with their Winter eternal ally in the Barrens.

Highguard.t: Highguard could send a force weight of 22, and Highborn armies gained bonuses when attacking into Zenith from Morrow or defending Morrow against attacks from Zenith.

Imperial Orcs.t: Mentioned in passing: the Imperial Orcs were listed with a force weight of 6 available for the battles.

Jotun.t: The Jotun, alongside yegarra, were the opposition in the Tromsa battle opportunity, where the Empire hoped to seize the Blue Eel banner and ransom Mathilda Fisher from them; Wintermark armies fighting them also had special modifiers.

Navarr.t: Navarr could send a force weight of 51 to the battles, and the Navarr-held territory of Hercynia was the site of a conjunction to stop the heralds.

The Brass Coast.t: The Brass Coast could send a force weight of 20; its armies' presence in a campaign reduced Varushkan victory points, and a conjunction to stop the heralds was set in Segura.

The League.t: The League could send a force weight of 19, and League territories hosted conjunctions to balance a debt in Sarvos and deal with the Company of the Torch in Temeschwar.

The Marches.t: The Marches could send a force weight of 24; Marcher armies could not Give Ground but gained 1000 strength in Upwold, Mitwold and Mournwold, and the Strong Reeds gained 1000 strength in Bregasland until the Winter Solstice.

Urizen.t: Urizen could send a force weight of 15, and Urizen armies gained bonuses when attacking Zenith from Morrow or defending Morrow against attacks from Zenith.

Varushka.t: Varushka could send a force weight of 14; its armies generated fewer victory points when campaigning alongside Brass Coast or Wintermark armies, but could take the Hospitality of the Boyars order in Ossium.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark had the largest force weight at 61; its armies could take Fight with Honour and, when fighting the Jotun, gained more victory points and took fewer casualties but inflicted fewer.

385YE Autumn Equinox winds of war.o: The Autumn Equinox 385YE Winds of War summarised the Imperial military situation, setting out three possible battle opportunities through the Sentinel Gate against the Druj and the Jotun, twenty smaller conjunctions across the Empire, and the special military considerations then in force.

Bastion/Sybella Cross.t: Sixty Imperial heroes could travel to the Broken Holt on Saturday to stop the heralds, under the oversight of the Senator for Bastion.

Bregasland/Gravenmarch.t: Up to 65 heroes could travel to Harry's Field on Friday night to stop the heralds, with the Keeper of the Dour Fens responsible.

Hahnmark/Kronemark.t: Sixty heroes could travel to White Owl Fields on Saturday evening to stop the heralds, with the Imperial Seer responsible.

Hercynia/Northpines.t: Sixty heroes could travel to Danwyn's Coppice on Saturday to stop the heralds, with the Spear of the Seven responsible.

Karov/Wieliczka.t: Sixty heroes could travel to the Thicket of Nieshka on Saturday to stop the heralds, with the General of the Eastern Sky responsible.

Karsk/Nitrost.t: Thirty heroes could travel to Gulgisaz on Friday to stop the heralds, with the Warden of the Trees and Hills responsible.

Morrow/Peregro.t: Thirty heroes could travel to Seneca's Meadow on Friday to stop the heralds, with the Churnspire Adjutor responsible.

Mournwold/Green March.t: A small group of seven could travel to Golden Hoof Farm on Saturday to talk to Hap the Soft, with Bloodcrow Knott responsible and combat unlikely.

Mournwold/Southmoor.t: Thirty heroes could travel to the Crowned Trees on Friday night to confront Quiet Charlie, with Brother Martin Orchard responsible.

Redoubt/Tomari.t: Sixty heroes could travel to Magnus' Thicket on Saturday to stop the heralds, with the Grandmaster of the Unfettered Mind responsible.

Sarangrave/Nesustak Forest.t: Sixty heroes could travel to the Queen's Claim on Saturday night to reclaim the Vate's Shelter, with the Advisor on the Vallorn responsible.

Sarvos/Cigno.t: Fifty citizens could travel to Bertram's Square late on Friday to balance the debt, with the Dramaturgists of the League responsible and combat unlikely.

Segura/Lucksprings.t: Up to 70 heroes could travel to the Path to Cerevado on Friday night to stop the heralds, with the Custodian of the Cerevado Nets responsible.

Skarsind/Gildermark.t: Thirty heroes could travel to Oathwright's Glade on Friday to stop the heralds, with the Weigher of Worth responsible.

Temeschwar/Vardstein Vale.t: Thirty heroes could travel to Polseg Woods on Saturday to deal with the Company of the Torch, with the Custodian of the Assayer's Guild responsible.

The Barrens/Murderdale.t: Sixty heroes could travel to Hugh's Sward on Saturday night to slay the Lady of the Dappled Trees, with the Knight-protector of Spring responsible.

Tromsa/Icewood.t: Sixty heroes could travel to the Grove of Einar on Friday to claim Grimnir's Glass, with the Grimnir of Wittal Grove responsible.

Tromsa/Rikskog.t: Fifty heroes could travel to Fniskard Copse on Friday to claim the Jotun cache, with the Champion of Prosperity responsible.

Tromsa/Tromsdalen.t: Fifty heroes could travel to Nordbotn on Friday to hold the palisade, with the Champion of Pride responsible.

Upwold/The Heath.t: Twenty-five heroes could travel to Tom's Dale on Saturday to deal with the Drake's Dozen, with the Bailiff of the Grand Market responsible.

Bastion.t: A Saturday conjunction at the Broken Holt in Sybella Cross sought to stop the heralds, with the Senator for Bastion responsible.

Bregasland.t: A Friday conjunction at Harry's Field in Gravenmarch sought to stop the heralds, and the Strong Reeds gained 1000 strength while fighting in Bregasland.

Hahnmark.t: A Saturday conjunction at White Owl Fields in Kronemark sought to stop the heralds, with the Imperial Seer responsible.

Hercynia.t: A Saturday conjunction at Danwyn's Coppice in Northpines sought to stop the heralds, with the Spear of the Seven responsible.

Karov.t: A Saturday conjunction at the Thicket of Nieshka in Wieliczka sought to stop the heralds, with the General of the Eastern Sky responsible.

Karsk.t: A Friday conjunction at Gulgisaz in Nitrost sought to stop the heralds, with the Warden of the Trees and Hills responsible.

Mitwold.t: Any Imperial army could take the Billet order in Mitwold, and Marcher armies fighting there gained an additional 1000 strength.

Morrow.t: A conjunction at Seneca's Meadow in Peregro sought to stop the heralds, and Highborn or Urizen armies defending Morrow against attacks from Zenith gained a defensive bonus.

Mournwold.t: Two conjunctions were set here, one to confront Quiet Charlie in Southmoor and one to talk to Hap the Soft in Green March, and Marcher armies fighting in Mournwold gained 1000 strength.

Ossium.t: Varushkan armies in Ossium could take the Hospitality of the Boyars order.

Redoubt.t: A Saturday conjunction at Magnus' Thicket in Tomari sought to stop the heralds, with the Grandmaster of the Unfettered Mind responsible.

Salt Flats of Sanath.t: A Saturday-only battle opportunity offered Imperial heroes the chance to capture Sarra Grubfeast from the Druj here.

Sarangrave.t: A Saturday conjunction at the Queen's Claim in Nesustak Forest aimed to reclaim the Vate's Shelter, with the Advisor on the Vallorn responsible.

Sarvos.t: A Friday conjunction, with combat unlikely, at Bertram's Square in Cigno aimed to balance the debt, with the Dramaturgists of the League responsible.

Segura.t: A Friday conjunction for up to 70 people on the Path to Cerevado in Lucksprings sought to stop the heralds, with the Custodian of the Cerevado Nets responsible.

Skarsind.t: A Friday conjunction at Oathwright's Glade in Gildermark sought to stop the heralds, with the Weigher of Worth responsible.

Temeschwar.t: A Saturday conjunction at Polseg Woods in Vardstein Vale aimed to deal with the Company of the Torch, with the Custodian of the Assayer's Guild responsible.

The Barrens.t: A battle opportunity sought to stop the Druj and their Winter eternal ally securing magical allies here, and a conjunction in Murderdale aimed to slay the Lady of the Dappled Trees.

Tromsa.t: A Sunday battle opportunity against the Jotun and yegarra aimed to capture the Blue Eel banner and ransom Mathilda Fisher, alongside three Friday conjunctions in Tromsdalen, Rikskog and Icewood.

Upwold.t: A conjunction at Tom's Dale in The Heath aimed to deal with the Drake's Dozen; any Imperial army could Billet in Upwold, and Marcher armies there gained 1000 strength.

Zenith.t: Highborn or Urizen armies attacking into Zenith from Morrow gained a 20% bonus to territory captured but inflicted 10% fewer casualties.

385YE Spring Equinox Imperial elections.d: National elections returned senators for Astolat, Bregasland, Holberg, Karsk, Mournwold, Reikos, Segura and Semmerholm. The Senate appointed generals for seven armies, including Isaella's Dance, the Bloodcloaks and the Tusks, along with ambassadors to Faraden, Otkodov, the Commonwealth and the Sumaah Republic, and Bernard Dugdale as Imperial Spymaster. The Synod chose Jared as Lepidean Librarian with 363 votes, among other judgements, and cardinals named gatekeepers and a Chaplain Consular. Rahmah i Darwisj i Erigo became Imperial Fleet Master. Bourse auctions and votes allocated seats such as the Master of the Imperial Mint and the Marracossa Sendito. The Imperial titles list was updated with these results.

Dawn.t: Dawn returned two senators: Bohemond De Rondell for Astolat and Amicia of the Semmerlak for Semmerholm.

Highguard.t: Highguard's Reikos elected Cyrus, of Ebon's Hall as its senator.

Jotun.t: Lizzie Stamp of Bildewold was returned as senator for Bregasland, a territory then held by the Jotun.

The Brass Coast.t: The Brass Coast elected Diego i Del Toro i Erigo as senator for Segura.

The League.t: The League returned Kaspar Yakovich von Holberg as senator for Holberg.

The Marches.t: The Marches elected Willum of Goatsbridge as senator for Mournwold.

Varushka.t: Varushka returned Yegor as senator for Karsk.

385YE Spring Equinox Imperial elections.o: At the 385YE Spring Equinox summit, elections and appointments filled a wide range of Imperial titles, including eight territorial senators, generals, ambassadors, Synod and Conclave positions, and Bourse seats.

Astolat.t: Bohemond De Rondell was elected Senator for Astolat.

Bregasland.t: Lizzie Stamp of Bildewold was elected Senator for Bregasland, while the territory was held by the Jotun.

Holberg.t: Kaspar Yakovich von Holberg was elected Senator for Holberg.

Karsk.t: Yegor was elected Senator for Karsk.

Mournwold.t: Willum of Goatsbridge was elected Senator for Mournwold.

Reikos.t: Cyrus, of Ebon's Hall was elected Senator for Reikos.

Segura.t: Diego i Del Toro i Erigo was elected Senator for Segura.

Semmerholm.t: Amicia of the Semmerlak was elected Senator for Semmerholm.

385YE Spring Equinox Senate sessions.d: The treasury stood at 1990 thrones. The Senate ratified the treaty with Salt Lord Kaliact and declared war on Asavea, making the Asavean Archipelago barbarians. It disbursed 500 thrones to Morrow for military resupply and moved the Master of Works to the Military Council. The Urdur spy network was approved, then abrogated. Funded commissions included the Smokehouse of Atalaq (215 thrones), the roads of Kahraman (200) and support for Caitun (70). Further works were announced, including a Temeschwar mana exchange and the Steel Rings of Sarvos. Appointments included Bernard Dugdale as Imperial Spymaster and ambassadors to the Sumaah Republic, the Commonwealth, Otkodov and the Faraden. The Constitutional Court ruled that an ambassador's election season cannot simply be moved.

Dawn.t: Dawn gained the Barrens as a Dawnish territory able to appoint a senator, on a motion proposed by the senator for Astolat.

Druj.t: The Barrens, held by the Druj that season, were assigned by the Senate to Dawn.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: a failed naval supply appraisal hoped to avoid technically breaking the Grendel treaty.

Highguard.t: Highborn senators amended the Witness of Conclave's duties and the Sevenfold Path's manifesto, and the Necropolis senator proposed the Throne election, which elected nobody.

Imperial Orcs.t: Skarsind gained the Palace of Flowers folly, ceded to the Yerende sept, and the announced Kragg's Hollow mana sinecure, while the Lepidean Library was set to research Jaggah, mother of Thrace.

Jotun.t: Jotun-held Bregasland was assigned to the Marches, and the Smokehouse of Atalaq was commissioned to help Sermersuaq recover from Jotun invasion.

Navarr.t: Navarr gained a House of Healing and the Garden of Glory in Therunin, and the Hall of the Seven was announced in Miaren, creating the Spear of the Seven.

The Brass Coast.t: The Madruga senator's motion to declare war on Asavea passed, and the roads of Kahraman are to be rebuilt with Kamkrag, with 200 thrones of support.

The League.t: The League saw the Temeschwar Otkodov Mana Exchange, the Steel Rings of Sarvos and the Anvil Library Scriptorium announced, but the Holberg cascade and Temeschwar University funding failed. Two citizens of Tassato became ambassadors.

The Marches.t: The Marches gained Bregasland as a Marcher territory, and Lowther's Lift was commissioned in Mournwold to extract more mithril.

Urizen.t: Morrow received 500 thrones for military resupply, the Gardens of Pallas in Zenith are to be appraised, and the Academy of Arms expansion passed.

Varushka.t: Ossium is to be appraised for lifting the under-threat status of Echofell and the Drownbark Forest. Fania Vessely-Vanek became Ambassador to Otkodov, and Varushkan senators raised and then abrogated the Urdur spy network.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark gained a runeforge in Hahnmark, plus the Smokehouse of Atalaq and Hall of the Hunters in Sermersuaq, and Kallavesa secured support for the Faraden expansion of Caitun.

385YE Spring Equinox Senate sessions.o: At the Spring Equinox 385YE the Senate assigned Bregasland to the Marches and the Barrens to Dawn, declared war on Asavea, and passed a raft of commissions across the Empire. It also made several appointments, though nobody was elected to the Throne.

Kallavesa/Wittal Grove.t: The Healing House of Wittal Grove will grow cerulean mazzarine until its Grimnir announces otherwise.

Sarvos/Foracci.t: The Anvil Library Scriptorium, a liao and Synod-vote sinecure, is to be built in Rodez in Foracci.

Sermersuaq/Suaq Wastes.t: The Hall of the Hunters sinecure was announced at Lake Atkonaroq, creating the Banner-bearer of Atkonaroq.

Temeschwar/Hanuri.t: The Temeschwar Otkodov Mana Exchange, a mana ministry overseen by the Keeper of the Tome, was announced in Hanuri.

Astolat.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator proposed assigning the Barrens to Dawn and seconded the Garden of Glory commission.

Bastion.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator proposed the failed Holberg cascade and seconded the Witness of Conclave amendment.

Bregasland.t: Bregasland was assigned to the Marches and can now appoint a senator, who proposed the election of the Ambassador to the Faraden.

Casinea.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator proposed amending the Sevenfold Path's manifesto and seconded the withdrawn Hall of the Seven motion.

Hahnmark.t: A runeforge was commissioned in Hahnmark, tied to the Snow might fall wind of fortune.

Hercynia.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator proposed the Imperial Spymaster election and seconded the unsuccessful Throne election.

Holberg.t: A self-funded mana sinecure, Holberg's Melodious Cascade in Holmaeur, failed to pass, though Holberg's senator successfully proposed ratifying the Kaliact treaty.

Kahraman.t: The roads of Kahraman are to be rebuilt, with Kamkrag across the territory for troop movement and defence, with 200 thrones from the treasury.

Kallavesa.t: Wittal Grove's healing house will grow cerulean mazzarine, and Kallavesa's senator secured 70 thrones to send weirwood for the expansion of Caitun.

Karov.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator proposed the Urdur spy network, later abrogated, and seconded the Orieb improvement.

Karsk.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator seconded abrogating the Urdur spy network and proposed the Ambassador to Otkodov election.

Madruga.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator proposed the successful declaration of war on Asavea and seconded the Academy of Arms expansion.

Miaren.t: The Hall of the Seven ministry was announced in Miaren, creating the Spear of the Seven to explore Terunael ruins held by the vallorn.

Miekarova.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator seconded the declaration of war on Asavea and proposed a failed naval supply appraisal.

Mitwold.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator proposed Lowther's Lift in Mournwold and seconded support for Caitun.

Morrow.t: The senator for Morrow received 500 thrones for military resupply.

Mournwold.t: Lowther's Lift was commissioned in the Singing Caves near Overton to extract greater quantities of mithril.

Necropolis.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator proposed the Throne election, which elected nobody, and seconded the Master of Works amendment.

Ossium.t: An appraisal of removing the under-threat quality from Echofell and the Drownbark Forest is due by Summer, and an improvement of Orieb in the Drownbark passed but will not begin.

Redoubt.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator proposed the Academy of Arms expansion and seconded ratifying the Kaliact treaty.

Reikos.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator proposed the Witness of Conclave amendment and seconded the House of Healing.

Sarvos.t: The Steel Rings of Sarvos were announced to protect Sarvos from naval attack, and the Anvil Library Scriptorium will be built in Rodez, Foracci.

Segura.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator proposed abrogating the Urdur spy network and seconded a failed naval appraisal.

Semmerholm.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator proposed the ambassador election-season amendment and seconded the Gardens of Pallas appraisal.

Sermersuaq.t: Sermersuaq received 215 thrones for the Smokehouse of Atalaq to restore its farms and hunters, and the Hall of the Hunters was announced at Lake Atkonaroq.

Skarsind.t: The Palace of Flowers folly in Solvihill will be ceded to the Yerende sept, and Kragg's Hollow was announced as a mana sinecure.

Tassato.t: Mentioned in passing: a failed Black Canal appraisal named Tassato as a preferred site, and its senator proposed the Garden of Glory.

Temeschwar.t: The Temeschwar Otkodov Mana Exchange was announced in Hanuri, but funds for the University Department of Architecture failed and the Master of Rings title was amended.

The Barrens.t: The Barrens were assigned to Dawn and can now appoint a senator.

Therunin.t: Therunin gained the House of Healing, creating the Hand of the Healing, and the Garden of Glory liao sinecure, overseen by the Navarr National Assembly.

Upwold.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator proposed the failed Black Canal appraisal and seconded the assignment of Bregasland to the Marches.

Volodmartz.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator proposed the Orieb improvement and seconded the rebuilding of Kahraman's roads.

Weirwater.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator seconded a failed appraisal on increasing Imperial navies.

Zenith.t: The Gardens of Pallas in Zenith are to be appraised for restoration, and Zenith's senator moved the Master of Works to the Military Council.

385YE Spring Equinox interlude.d: The League and Varushkan assemblies urged the destruction of the Vyig, opening an adventure for League, Imperial Orc and Varushkan military units. Rising Wolf activity in Varushka created paid monster-hunting work for Varushkan and Dawnish forces. The Imperial Guerdon stood at 350 thrones, shared among six named armies. Free Folk visits gave every congregation 36 extra rings but removed earlier liao and vote bonuses in five territories. Highguard businesses suffered to fund Free Folk tutelage. Tharim's Black Frost withered Dawnish farms and mana sites in return for aid against the Barrens. Hallow of the Green World was cast, Thunderous Tread of the Trees struck Liathaven, and Regrow the Land's Heart was cast in Madruga. Two rituals entered Imperial lore.

Dawn.t: Tharim's Black Frost cost every Dawnish farm 36 rings and every mana site one crystal until the Autumn Equinox, in exchange for steel-bound knights to aid any Dawnish army attacking the Barrens. Dawnish knights-errant could also seek glory hunting monsters in Varushka.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: Grendel held Feroz, where Imperial fleets could support the Osseini spy network.

Highguard.t: Highborn congregations gained extra liao, two Synod votes and a crown of income from the Birthplace of the Way. Every Highguard business suffered a -1 rank production penalty to fund tutelage of Free Folk priests.

Imperial Orcs.t: Imperial Orc thief-takers were among those hired against the Vyig, and Imperial Orc military units could join the Break the Vyig adventure.

Jotun.t: Thunderous Tread of the Trees was cast in Liathaven, where possessed plants attack armies and fortifications, and the Jotun there were expected to bear the brunt.

Navarr.t: At the national assembly's welcome, Great Forest Orcs settled in Miaren and Hercynia, aiding weirwood groves. Navarr herb gardens in four territories could be improved for one wain less weirwood until the Summer Solstice.

The Brass Coast.t: Regrow the Land's Heart was cast in Madruga to help contain the desiccating blight on the Great Grasses.

The League.t: The League assembly enacted a mandate to destroy the Vyig, funding bounty hunters and opening an adventure for military units. League Ambition congregations gained extra liao and votes, Holberg farms received Sand Fisher herbs, and Tassato and Temeschwar lost earlier congregation bonuses.

Urizen.t: Urizen congregations shared in the Free Folk donations, but Redoubt lost its earlier extra liao and votes. New rituals had also been added to Urizen lore.

Varushka.t: Varushka's assembly joined the mandate against the Vyig, and growing Wolf activity led boyars to pay monster hunters well, opening an Adventure in Varushka for its units. Varushkan congregations received the Free Folk donations, though Karsk lost its earlier bonus.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark's Hahnmark lost the extra liao and Synod votes it had gained from an earlier judgement as a side effect of the Free Folk mandate.

385YE Spring Equinox interlude.o: Ahead of the Spring Equinox 385YE, an interlude summarised the effects shaping the coming season.
