These included mandates against the Vyig, monster-hunting work in Varushka, the Black Frost in Dawn, Great Forest Orc settlement among the Navarr, Spring magic across the Empire and changes to congregation income.

Brocéliande.t: Navarr with herb gardens in Brocéliande could improve them for one wain less weirwood than normal until the Summer Solstice 385YE.

Feroz.t: Mentioned in passing: Imperial fleets were offered the option to support the Osseini spy network in Feroz.

Hahnmark.t: Congregations in Hahnmark lost the additional liao and votes granted by an earlier judgement.

Hercynia.t: Great Forest Orcs began settling in Hercynia, and Navarr herb gardens there could be improved at reduced weirwood cost.

Holberg.t: Sand Fisher orcs provided two random herbs to each farm in Holberg every downtime.

Karsk.t: Congregations in Karsk lost the additional liao and votes granted by an earlier judgement.

Liathaven.t: Thunderous Tread of the Trees sent possessed plants against armies, fortifications and the few remaining steadings in Liathaven, with loss of life expected and the Jotun bearing the brunt.

Madruga.t: Regrow the Land's Heart was cast in Madruga to contain the desiccating blight on the Great Grasses.

Miaren.t: Great Forest Orcs began settling in Miaren, and Navarr herb gardens there could be improved at reduced weirwood cost.

Redoubt.t: Congregations in Redoubt lost the additional liao and votes granted by an earlier judgement.

Tassato.t: Congregations in Tassato lost the additional liao and votes granted by an earlier judgement.

Temeschwar.t: Congregations in Temeschwar lost the additional liao and votes granted by an earlier judgement.

Therunin.t: Navarr with herb gardens in Therunin could improve them for one wain less weirwood thanks to Great Forest Orc expertise.

385YE Spring Equinox winds of fortune.d: The Brass Coast's Sails of the First Flame cast the Hallow of the Green World, flooding the Empire with Spring magic, blooms and boggarts, while Lord Rain aided farmers and healers. The Senate's appraisals covered Kahraman's broken roads and Bastion's challenge of Timoj. Grendel envoys were expected at Anvil to discuss extending the peace treaty. Varushka completed Kostjyas Respite and the Iron Roads, and Zenith's Crucible of Fate was finished. Other entries covered the Whisper Gallery, a blight in Madruga, Suranni wizards, the vyig and Metri, and Mournwold orcs seeking to join the Marches. The Civil Service also corrected rumours about storm deaths and Thule slavery, and the outcomes of Winter Sentinel Gate conjunctions were reported.

Dawn.t: Dawnish heroes saw the traitor Renee du Loire captured in the Barrens and executed, Dawn may share in the trade of Kostjyas Respite, and Summer patronage of the Eastern Sky was among the magical matters raised.

Druj.t: Imperial raiders destroyed the Sleepless Nightmare and the scorched liege in the Barrens, though Garsnag Mudchurner, Varag Soulflayer and Serra Grubfeast survived, and the Synod debated what the Empire should ultimately do with the Druj.

Grendel.t: Salt Lord delegations were expected at Anvil to negotiate a possible extension of the two-year peace treaty, as Grendel merchants sought to trade on the uncertainty, while the port of Oran stayed closed to Imperial fleets.

Highguard.t: The Highborn Assembly passed three mandates, one granting new powers to support other nations, while Highborn generals helped rebuild Zenith and backed the liberation of the Barrens; meanwhile Bastion faced the appraised challenge of Timoj.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Ethengraw Armoury and Illarawm Ossuary neared completion, quietening Stonecliff Brakkalo's criticism, and the Illarawm offered meditative techniques to help orcs ignore the voices of angry ancestors.

Jotun.t: Jotun forces were driven back in Sermersuaq, Jarl Roneth was defeated and Lasambrian raiders were beaten in Kahraman and Kallavesa, but they reinforced Skallahn, raised a fane in Greenwall, threatened Oddmire and continued fortifying Liathaven.

Navarr.t: The Navarr Assembly welcomed Great Forest Orcs to settle in Miaren and Hercynia, prepared for vallorn stirrings caused by the Spring enchantment and reclaimed many bandits in Therunin, while Imperial heroes recovered the Tairiscint na Foraoise in Brocéliande.

The Brass Coast.t: Freeborn magicians unleashed the Hallow of the Green World, an appraisal proposed ways to restore Kahraman's sabotaged roads and bridges, and a creeping ash blight was found in Madruga's Great Grasses.

The League.t: A new sword academy in Holberg drew Urizen sword scholars and some controversy, the Empire moved to drive the vyig from Temeschwar and Hag Queen servants from Metri, and a hidden chamber was discovered beneath the Mint in Tassato.

The Marches.t: Most former Mournwold thralls asked to become Marchers but would not give up their belief in reincarnation; meanwhile Faraden harbourmasters at Caitun offered trade to the Marches, and Jotun threatened Oddmire from Bregasland.

Thule.t: The Civil Service confirmed that the Thule truly had freed their slaves, though Otkodov remained a harsh authoritarian society struggling with food shortages.

Urizen.t: The Crucible of Fate was completed in Zenith to restore hope there, though Urizen scorned further help from Highguard, its sword scholars were invited to Holberg, and its priests still would not welcome the Free Folk.

Varushka.t: Varushka completed Kostjyas Respite and the Iron Roads, linking nearly every major settlement, but awakening monsters threatened the Semmerlak ports and the Lord of the Broken Barrow offered friendship to its people.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark confronted the people of Sermersuaq who had accepted boons from Blood-on-the-Snow, saw Jotun pushed back in Stark and Tanikipari, and gained a possible trade opening with the Faraden at Caitun.

385YE Spring Equinox winds of fortune.o: The Spring Equinox 385YE winds of fortune summarised a season shaped by the Hallow of the Green World, Grendel treaty talks, new Varushkan roads and ports, the restoration of Zenith, and many Sentinel Gate missions against the Druj and Jotun.

Bregasland/Grey Fens.t: Supplies were successfully delivered to the Scraggy Bole at the Orchard of Tom Wiscall.

Bregasland/North Fens.t: Tall George, an apprentice of Mott, was rescued at the Dry Marsh and the Jotun stymied.

Brocéliande/Elerael.t: Injured Marchers were rescued at the Silent Copse and the threat addressed.

Brocéliande/Terunael.t: The Tairiscint na Foraoise was recovered at Kay's Lament.

Holberg/Misericorde.t: Mentioned in passing: the Merchant Prince of Misericorde Market was listed among those concerned in the fight against the vyig.

Kahraman/Serra Briante.t: Most of the Lasambrian jotun waiting to ambush wagon trains on Isabella's Track were defeated or driven off.

Kallavesa/Skymark.t: Lasambrian jotun on the Cold Path of Kaisa were dealt with before they could slaughter a group of hylje.

Mitwold/Oddmire.t: Oddmire was left under threat from the Jotun in Bregasland.

Mournwold/Southmoor.t: Wise Maggie was not rescued at Tollerton Green, and the traitor Little Robin escaped at Friar Tommy's Grave despite the Jotun being engaged.

Ossium/Bittershore.t: Mentioned in passing: the Merchant-boyar of the Bittershore was listed among those concerned with events around the Semmerlak.

Sermersuaq/Stark.t: Many Jotun scouts were defeated at Vahne's Field and the Jotun driven back.

Sermersuaq/Tanikipari.t: Jarl Roneth was defeated at Siward's Folly and the sword recovered for Barien.

Skallahn/Greenwall.t: The Jotun established a fane in Greenwall after the conjunction to stop it went untaken.

Spiral/Ossuary.t: Mentioned in passing: the region is not named directly; the page refers only to Spiral as a whole through Salt Lord Kaliact.

Temeschwar/Metri.t: The haunting presence in the forests around the Fortress of Salt proved to be Hag Queen servants, and Imperial magicians led by the Rod and Shield set out to drive them back to Winter.

The Barrens/Farweald.t: The Sleepless Nightmare was destroyed at the Broken Glade along with most of its Druj escort.

The Barrens/Murderdale.t: The scorched liege and most of the Burnt Fist coven were destroyed at Berena's Tree, but Garsnag Mudchurner fled his holt.

The Barrens/The Untrod Groves.t: Varag Soulflayer and the tormented spirits at Soulflayer's Refuge survived the Imperial attempt to kill him.

Therunin/East Ashes.t: A rise in bandit activity was largely defused as Navarr guides and brands persuaded many bandit steadings to come home, though some outlaws remain.

Zenith/Iteri.t: A gate anomaly left the tortured souls at the Spire of the Everlasting Dusk unrested, and the outnumbered heroes retreated in good order.

Zenith/Lustri.t: A miasma pillar at the Spire of Twisting Shadow was destroyed, but its guardians remained because of a gate anomaly.

Zenith/Occursion.t: The tormented spirits at the Ring of Solace ruins were laid to rest with minimal harm to the heroes.

Bastion.t: An appraisal considered how Bastion and the Bay of Catazar territories might rise to the challenge of Timoj, starting with a competition and ending in a vast commission.

Bay of Catazar.t: Mentioned in passing: the territories of the Bay of Catazar were named in the appraisal on rising to the challenge of Timoj.

Bregasland.t: Imperial heroes delivered supplies to the Scraggy Bole and rescued Tall George from the Jotun, but the chance to rouse Old Marjoram was not taken and the Jotun there threatened Oddmire.

Brocéliande.t: Imperial heroes recovered the Tairiscint na Foraoise at Kay's Lament and rescued injured Marchers at the Silent Copse.

Hercynia.t: Great Forest Orcs began settling near its weirwood groves, and a slight upsurge in vallorn activity caused by the Spring enchantment was contained by well-prepared Navarr.

Holberg.t: The new Holberg Scholars of the Sword Academy invited Urizen sword scholars to teach, drawing interest, opposition and worries about one of Holberg's infamous sons.

Kahraman.t: An appraisal set out how its Jotun-sabotaged roads and bridges might be restored, and Imperial heroes drove off Lasambrian jotun threatening wagon trains in Serra Briante.

Kallavesa.t: Imperial heroes dealt with Lasambrian jotun in Skymark and protected a group of hylje.

Karsk.t: Mentioned in passing: the recent troubles in Karsk were cited as the scale the Therunin bandit problem will no longer reach.

Liathaven.t: The regio at Broker's Wynd was used to unleash devastating Spring magic on the Jotun, though work continued on their fortification there.

Madruga.t: A strange blight of ash and dust was growing at the heart of the Great Grasses, contained but not removed by Spring magic despite the Silver Chalice's investigation.

Miaren.t: Great Forest Orcs were welcomed by the Navarr Assembly to establish steadings near the weirwood groves.

Mitwold.t: Oddmire was left under threat from the Jotun in Bregasland after the conjunction to rouse Old Marjoram went untaken.

Mountains of the Moon.t: Mentioned in passing: Axos anger at Imperial involvement in the failure of their joint venture with the Grendel into the Mountains of the Moon damaged trade.

Mournwold.t: Most of its former thrall orcs asked to become Marchers while others left for Jotun lands, a Summer enchantment fell over the territory, and missions in Southmoor failed to rescue Wise Maggie or stop Little Robin.

Necropolis.t: Mentioned in passing: Grendel questioners had visited the tomb of Emperor Barabbas there on their way to Anvil.

Ossium.t: The completion of Kostjyas Respite helped resolve one of the lingering challenges for the people of Ossium.

Otkodov.t: Its former orc slaves were confirmed as free citizens, though Otkodov remained highly stratified and was suffering food problems from the change.

Sea of Snow.t: A flotilla of more than seventy fleets partly mapped the Sea of Snow and reached the Faraden coast, with monster-hunting opportunities also reported there.

Sermersuaq.t: The Shuttered Lantern, priests and the Silent Bell moved against those who accepted Blood-on-the-Snow's boons, while Imperial heroes drove back Jotun scouts and defeated Jarl Roneth.

Skallahn.t: With the conjunction there not taken, the Jotun reinforced their borders and established a fane in Greenwall.

Spiral.t: Salt Lord Kaliact of Spiral, whose earlier offer of a separate agreement the Senate rejected, might send representatives with the Grendel delegation.

Tassato.t: An incongruous wall beneath the Imperial Mint suggested a hidden chamber, reachable by nine people through a Sentinel Gate conjunction before rising waters reflood it.

Temeschwar.t: The Empire set out to drive the vyig from Temeschwar once more, and the Rod and Shield led efforts against Hag Queen servants in Metri.

The Barrens.t: Imperial heroes destroyed the Sleepless Nightmare and the scorched liege and executed a captured traitor, but several Druj leaders escaped, the Rahvin remained enslaved, and Highborn generals pursued liberation rather than conquest.

The Semmerlak.t: Kostjyas Respite opened on its northern shore, but an awakening sovereign took a particular interest in the Semmerlak ports.

Therunin.t: The Spring enchantment caused a slight, contained vallorn upsurge, and Navarr guides brought many East Ashes bandits back to the Great Dance.

Zenith.t: The Crucible of Fate was completed at the Spire Calator, Highborn generals helped rebuild, and Imperial heroes had mixed results against tormented spirits and miasma pillars.

385YE Spring Equinox winds of war.d: The Jotun took Fort Braydon, dominated Braydon's Jasse and pressed into the Jade Range. Imperial forces freed the Dour Fens, so Bregasland is Imperial again, though Ottermire and Gravenmarch remain in Jotun hands. In the Barrens, eleven Imperial armies defeated eleven Druj armies, drove them from Bitter Strand, Saltmarsh and the Plains of Teeth and took the Spires of Dusk. Tens of thousands died, and the Hounds of Glory were lost. The Granite Pillar cleared two more miasma pillars in Zenith. Spy networks were dismantled in Skallahn and disrupted in Feroz. The page listed three battle opportunities, Jotun and Druj threats in Liathaven, Sarangrave and Sermersuaq, and many conjunctions.

Dawn.t: Dawnish forces shared the costly Barrens victory, in which the knights and yeofolk of the Hounds of Glory made the ultimate sacrifice taking the Spires of Dusk. Dawnish armies suffer a three-tenths penalty to territory conquered in the Barrens, and Dawnish titles were tasked with laying dead knights to rest and slaying a herald of Agramant in Semmerholm.

Druj.t: The Druj lost a clash of eleven armies a side and were driven from Bitter Strand, Saltmarsh and the Plains of Teeth, losing the Spires of Dusk. The Thornwasp clan nonetheless plotted to ambush thorns crossing the Feverwater, and Serra Grubfeast's forces at Dawnguard were named as a battle target.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: the Grendel were thought likely to be behind an attack on Shantarim and other islands in Feroz, but there were no definitive reports.

Highguard.t: Highborn armies can no longer issue the Crusading Storm order but may generate mandates for their assembly while on campaign. They gain bonuses when attacking into Zenith from Morrow or defending Morrow, and Highguard had a force weight of 18 for the battles.

Imperial Orcs.t: Mentioned in passing: the Imperial Orcs were listed with a force weight of 5 for the coming battles.

Jotun.t: The Jotun conquered Fort Braydon in Kahraman but lost the Dour Fens of Bregasland, keeping only Ottermire and Gravenmarch there. The Jarl of Kierheim dismantled the Imperial spy network in Skallahn, Jarl Iduna hunted Navarri in Liathaven, and a herald-backed force marched on the Pride of Ikka's Tears.

Navarr.t: Navarri trapped behind Jotun lines in Liathaven faced slaughter by Jarl Iduna's warband. In Therunin, Eira Larksong's Assembly judgement succeeded in helping former bandits, while Druj threatened Mudlark's Haven. Navarr had a force weight of 50.

The Brass Coast.t: Brass Coast lands in Kahraman suffered the Jotun invasion and lost Braydon's Jasse, and the Jade Range was nearly taken too. A conjunction in Madruga sought to destroy the Dry Patricians.

The League.t: League titles were tasked with recovering Misericorde's Blade and killing the Vyig in Holberg, and with clearing out heralds in Metri in Temeschwar. The League had a force weight of 17.

The Marches.t: Marcher-held Bregasland was liberated from Mathilda Fisher, with the Strong Reeds leading the fight and a battle opportunity offered to end her threat. Marcher armies gain extra strength in Upwold, Mitwold and Mournwold, and the Strong Reeds gain it in Bregasland.

Thule.t: Mentioned in passing: the Pride of Ikka's Tears was described as lying near the borders of the Jotun, the Thule and Tsirku.

Urizen.t: The Granite Pillar, aided by Senate-paid mercenaries, cleared two more miasma pillars in Zenith. The Citadel Guard will begin to deteriorate again after the Summer Solstice, and the Court of the White Fountain cannot fall below 1,000 strength.

Varushka.t: Varushkan armies avoid the general Barrens penalty, but they generate fewer victory points when campaigning alongside Brass Coast or Wintermark armies. Varushka had a force weight of 11.

Wintermark.t: A Jotun force accompanied by heralds of Hayaak marched on the Pride of Ikka's Tears in Sermersuaq and threatened five wains of mithril, and Custodian Tuija Dunning was responsible for stopping it. Wintermark had the largest force weight, at 58.

385YE Spring Equinox winds of war.o: This was the Spring Equinox 385YE summary of the Empire's wars. It covered the Jotun invasion of Kahraman, the liberation of Bregasland and the costly victory over the Druj in the Barrens, along with smaller conflicts, the battle opportunities and the Sentinel Gate conjunctions for the coming summit.

Bregasland/Gravenmarch.t: Gravenmarch remains in Jotun hands despite the liberation of the wider territory.

Bregasland/North Fens.t: A conjunction to the Greywater Estates sought to force the Jotun to retreat, under the General of the Strong Reeds.

Bregasland/Ottermire.t: Ottermire remains in Jotun hands despite the liberation of the wider territory.

Holberg/Misericorde.t: Mentioned in passing: only through the title of the Merchant Prince of Misericorde Market, who was made responsible for a conjunction in Utterlund.

Holberg/The Morass.t: A conjunction to Drusilla's Farm aimed to kill the Vyig, under Irada von Temeschwar.

Holberg/Utterlund.t: A conjunction to Elsbeth's Well aimed to recover Misericorde's Blade.

Kahraman/Braydon's Jasse.t: The Jotun conquered Fort Braydon and now dominate the region, and a battle opportunity offered to discover more about a gathering of champions.

Kahraman/Jade Range.t: The Jotun were well on the way to conquering the region. Conjunctions aimed to stop the Jotun on the Path of the Liscano family and to slay Venator, a herald of Hayaak, on the Sylvan Track.

Liathaven/Liath's Ring.t: A Friday conjunction to the Shattered Glade aimed to rescue the trapped Navarri and kill Jarl Iduna.

Mournwold/Greensward.t: A conjunction to the Overton Ruins, where combat was unlikely, aimed to lay ghosts to rest under the Friar of Honour's Rest.

Sarangrave/Bloodwater Marsh.t: A conjunction to Ormthak's Path aimed to kill the Thornwasp ambushers and their heralds of Arhallogen amid the Druj miasma.

Semmerholm/Axmure.t: A conjunction to Melusine's Field aimed to slay the Amaranthine Devourer, a herald of Agramant.

Sermersuaq/Stark.t: A conjunction to Nestori's Lament aimed to recover a relic from the Ender of Virtue.

Sermersuaq/Suaq Wastes.t: Conjunctions to Ymma's Howe and Ardith's Rest aimed to stop the Jotun advance on the mithril mine and to kill Theodric Irontongue.

Skallahn/Greenwall.t: A recently constructed fane of Estavus here had equipped the Jotun force marching into Sermersuaq, for unknown reasons.

Temeschwar/Metri.t: A conjunction to Agnieszka's Grove aimed to clear out heralds.

The Barrens/Bitter Strand.t: The Druj were driven out, and a conjunction to Spinner's Retreat aimed to slay Venomclaw, a herald of Arhallogen.

The Barrens/Dawnguard.t: A Sunday battle opportunity aimed to break the forces of Serra Grubfeast and claim Dawnguard.

The Barrens/Saltmarsh.t: The Druj were driven out. Conjunctions aimed to recover the relic of Adelmar, recover a stockpile, and meet the Vendarri on Greenstone Isle.

The Barrens/The Bleaks.t: A conjunction to the Blooming Grove aimed to kill tepel Zortog Ashtouch.

The Barrens/The Untrod Groves.t: A conjunction to Jagged Stream aimed to drive off the Druj.

Bregasland.t: Imperial forces freed the Dour Fens and restored the territory to the Empire, though Ottermire and Gravenmarch remain Jotun-held. A battle opportunity offered the chance to end Mathilda Fisher's threat.

Feroz.t: Reports told of an attack on Shantarim and several islands, affecting the naval operations spy network there. The culprit was unclear, though the Grendel were suspected.

Holberg.t: Two conjunctions targeted Holberg: recovering Misericorde's Blade at Elsbeth's Well and killing the Vyig at Drusilla's Farm.

Kahraman.t: The Jotun invaded from Liathaven, conquered Fort Braydon and nearly took the Jade Range. Only armies stationed in the Cinnabar Hills prevented a wider loss, and a battle opportunity offered to investigate a gathering of champions.

Liathaven.t: Jarl Iduna's warband hunted Navarri still in the territory and threatened to uncover the Imperial spy network. The Imperial Spymaster, Bernard Dugdale, was responsible for stopping her.

Madruga.t: A Saturday conjunction to the Dry Patch in the Great Grasses aimed to destroy the Dry Patricians, under the Grandmaster of the Silver Chalice.

Mitwold.t: Mentioned in passing: any Imperial army may billet here, and Marcher armies fighting here gain extra strength.

Morrow.t: Mentioned in passing: Highborn and Urizen armies attacking into Zenith from Morrow, or defending Morrow, gain bonuses.

Mournwold.t: A conjunction to the Overton Ruins in Greensward offered the chance to lay ghosts to rest. Marcher armies fighting here gain extra strength.

Redoubt.t: Mentioned in passing: the Court of the White Fountain here cannot be reduced below 1,000 military strength.

Sarangrave.t: Thornwasp Druj, accompanied by heralds of Arhallogen, prepared to ambush thorns arriving in Bloodwater Marsh, in a fight under Druj miasma.

Semmerholm.t: A conjunction to Axmure aimed to slay the Amaranthine Devourer, a herald of Agramant. The Adamant Gate cannot fall below 1,000 strength.

Sermersuaq.t: A Jotun force marched on the Pride of Ikka's Tears and threatened five wains of mithril. Further conjunctions targeted a relic at Stark and Theodric Irontongue in the Suaq Wastes.

Skallahn.t: The Jarl of Kierheim dismantled the Imperial spy network and rooted out its scouts. A newly built fane of Estavus in Greenwall equipped Jotun warriors.

Spiral.t: Mentioned in passing: the Castellan of Spiral Castle was named as responsible for a conjunction to recover the Gyre's Edge in the Barrens.

Temeschwar.t: A conjunction to Agnieszka's Grove in Metri aimed to clear out heralds, under the Grandmaster of the Rod and Shield.

The Barrens.t: Eleven Imperial armies defeated eleven Druj armies, liberating Bitter Strand, Saltmarsh and the Plains of Teeth and taking the Spires of Dusk at a terrible cost. Many conjunctions and a battle for Dawnguard followed.

Therunin.t: Guides and citizens successfully helped former bandits back into the Great Dance after a Navarr Assembly judgement. Druj scouting threatened future attacks on Mudlark's Haven.

Tsirku.t: Mentioned in passing: the Pride of Ikka's Tears lies near the border with Tsirku.

Upwold.t: Mentioned in passing: any Imperial army may billet here, and Marcher armies fighting here gain extra strength.

Zenith.t: The Granite Pillar and Senate-paid mercenaries cleared two more miasma pillars, and the struggle against the fear was reportedly going well.

385YE Summer Solstice Conclave sessions.d: After the previous summit, 324 mana was shared among the grandmasters, led by the Rod and Shield. New titleholders included Dima Vasilyevna Novosad (Master of the Koboldi), Cassandra i Periera i Erigo (Imperial Censor), Palaphon Ankarien (Dean of the Lyceum) and Izora Highwind (Penumbral Watcher). Raficci Vicente Barossa and Veikko Bondforger won Conclave support for the Throne. Ylenwe was moved to Neutrality and Siakha to enmity. Sadogua agreed to move Damakan's Forge to Zenith, and the bargains with Prospero over Jarm and Skoura were accepted. The Shuttered Lantern was sent to Sarvos and the Silver Chalice to the Barrens. The interdiction of Curse of Gangrenous Flesh failed.

Druj.t: The Conclave sent the Silver Chalice to investigate Druj sites of experimentation with novel diseases in the Barrens, and it rewarded Caleb of the Cenotaph with an artefact ring for destroying the Druj Miasma pillars in Zenith.

Grendel.t: The Shuttered Lantern was tasked with sending agents to Sarvos to discover whether a Grendel espionage ring operates there and, where possible, to neutralise it.

The League.t: Shuttered Lantern agents will search the League territory of Sarvos for Grendel spy networks and other hidden threats to the Empire.

Thule.t: In accepting the ornate wyrmlings' offer, the Conclave nominated the Thule, and the items recovered are to be passed to Tyburn Weaver, Grandmaster of the Shuttered Lantern.

Urizen.t: The eternal Sadogua will move the remains of Damakan's Forge from Spiral to a site beside the Crucible in Zenith, bringing a unique boon to the Urizen territory.

Varushka.t: Mentioned in passing: Dima Vasilyevna Novosad of Varushka claimed the title of Master of the Koboldi.

385YE Summer Solstice Conclave sessions.o: At the Summer Solstice 385YE the Imperial Conclave filled several titles, endorsed two throne candidates, changed its stance towards several eternals and dispatched orders to investigate Grendel spies in Sarvos and Druj disease experiments in the Barrens.

Sarvos.t: Agents of the Shuttered Lantern will go to Sarvos to uncover any Grendel espionage ring or other enemy intelligence-gathering in the territory.

The Barrens.t: Members of the Silver Chalice will travel into the howling wilderness of the Barrens to investigate Druj disease experimentation and the Karass and Yerende septs, with particular interest in illnesses resembling the Reikos flux.

Zenith.t: Damakan's Forge is to be moved by Sadogua to a site beside the Crucible in Zenith, and Caleb of the Cenotaph was honoured for destroying the Druj Miasma pillars there.

385YE Summer Solstice Imperial elections.d: Senators were elected for Bastion, Karov, Miaren, Mitwold, Redoubt, Sarvos, Sermersuaq, the Barrens and Weirwater. The Senate appointed Jarrigk Orzel as Imperial Consul, ten generals and many other officials. In the Synod, Aspar became Cardinal of Wisdom with 253 votes, Melchior of Adina's Charge became Cardinal of Courage, and Tabris, Son of Armisael, won Bishop of the Navigators with 420 votes. Lenarius Ankarien became Imperial Inquisitor with 3 votes. Bourse seats such as the Damatian Cliffs went for up to 285 thrones. Eliza became Grandmaster of the Order of the Unfettered Mind, and Rhydian Iolaire became Knight-protector of Summer.

Dawn.t: Lady Eve Orzel was elected to represent Weirwater, one of Dawn's territories, in the Senate.

Druj.t: Mentioned in passing: the page names no Druj, but the Barrens, then held by the Druj, had a senator elected, Aramis du Froste.

Highguard.t: Suvi Frostbrand was elected Senator for Bastion, Highguard's territory.

Navarr.t: Llewellyn Leafstalker was returned as Senator for Miaren, giving the Navarr territory its voice in the Senate.

The League.t: Uberto Alessandri di Caricomare vacino a Sarvos was elected Senator for Sarvos, the League city-territory.

The Marches.t: Sally was elected Senator for Mitwold, representing the Marcher territory in the Senate.

Urizen.t: Sejanus of the Scarlet Guard was elected Senator for Redoubt, Urizen's territory.

Varushka.t: Myshki Marishka Letuchaya was elected Senator for Karov, Varushka's territory.

Wintermark.t: Atte Arrow-Tongue Metsastajason was elected Senator for Sermersuaq, Wintermark's territory.

385YE Summer Solstice Imperial elections.o: At the 385YE Summer Solstice summit, the Empire filled a broad slate of Imperial titles. Nine senators were returned by national election, alongside Senate appointments, Synod judgements, Bourse auctions and votes, and several other posts.

Bastion.t: Bastion's Senate seat went to Suvi Frostbrand at this summit.

Karov.t: Karov elected Myshki Marishka Letuchaya as its senator.

Miaren.t: Miaren's senator for the season was Llewellyn Leafstalker.

Mitwold.t: Mitwold returned Sally as its senator.

Redoubt.t: Redoubt elected Sejanus of the Scarlet Guard as its senator.

Sarvos.t: Sarvos elected Uberto Alessandri di Caricomare vacino a Sarvos as its senator.

Sermersuaq.t: Sermersuaq's Senate seat went to Atte Arrow-Tongue Metsastajason.

The Barrens.t: A senator for the Barrens, Aramis du Froste, was elected, even though the territory was held by the Druj at the time.

Weirwater.t: Weirwater elected Lady Eve Orzel as its senator.

385YE Summer Solstice Senate sessions.d: The treasury stood at 606 thrones and 6 crowns. Funds went to raise a Dawnish army (250 thrones), resupply the military (275), rebuild Kahraman's roads (70) and build mithril statues watching the Black Plateau. The Senate removed sanctions on the Iron Confederacy, armed the Dreamers of the Dark Forest against the Druj in Echofell, outlawed objects from the Semmerlak and recognised the sept of Karass as foreigners, which is under scrutiny. The Brilliant Star was relinquished. New titles included the Imperial Huntsmarshall, Speaker of the Magpies and Architect of the Crucible. Commissions and announcements produced sinecures, follies, a high path to Otkodov and spy networks in Mareave and the Forest of Ulnak.

Dawn.t: The Senate disbursed 250 thrones and amended the motion to raise a new Dawnish army, while a Challenger in Waiting congregation sinecure was built in Weirwater.

Druj.t: The Empire authorised arming the Dreamers of the Dark Forest to drive the Druj out of Echofell and built a spy network in the Forest of Ulnak to speed the destruction of the fear cult.

Grendel.t: An Imperial spy network was built in the Grendel territory of Mareave, and the Minister of Historical Research began researching that land's Urizen history.

Highguard.t: The Abbey of Reconciliation was commissioned in Necropolis and the Grand Inspiration of the Way in Bastion, but the self-funded Physician's Legacy in Casinea failed.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Legion Engineer built the Open Hand of the Ancestors congregation sinecure in Solvihill, Skarsind, creating the Guide to the Lost, after the Golden Market of Aggido proved restricted to a wayleave bearer.

Jotun.t: Mentioned in passing: the nation is not named, though the senator for Bregasland, which it held, proposed the Speaker of the Magpies title.

Navarr.t: Stones from Blood, a planned mana ministry for the Navarr Vates Council, was withdrawn before a vote.

The Brass Coast.t: Kahraman received 70 thrones for its roads and Kamkrag forts and guards for its bourse seats, while the Parador of the Kindled Flame orphanage was built in Siroc, Madruga.

The League.t: The Garrison of the League sinecure was built in Hanuri, the Steel Rings of Sarvos became the Great Chains of Sarvos, and an appraisal was commissioned on how the League can help the Urizen in Spiral.

The Marches.t: Mentioned in passing: senators for Mournwold, Mitwold and Upwold proposed a raid-defence appraisal and several appointments, but the nation itself is not named.

Urizen.t: Urizen gained the Architect of the Crucible and Oblivion Sentinel titles and the reconstructed Gardens of Pallas, while the Brilliant Star in Redoubt was allocated as a national seat and then relinquished.

Varushka.t: Varushka gained the Offices of the Iron Roads, the Tolvoli Slaughterhouse, an improved Orieb, a high path to Otkodov and the new Imperial Huntsmarshall title proposed by its senators.

Wintermark.t: The Artisans Guild's guildhouse was built near the Runeforge in Hahnmark and Tekkupala's Hives in Kallavesa, while Sermersuaq's amendments to the Liberty Pact passed.

385YE Summer Solstice Senate sessions.o: At the Summer Solstice 385YE the Senate passed a large slate of motions, commissions and appointments, from funding a Dawnish army and lifting sanctions on the Iron Confederacy to new sinecures, follies and spy networks across the Empire.

Skarsind/Solvihill.t: The Open Hand of the Ancestors congregation was built in northern Solvihill, with its Guide to the Lost appointed by the Imperial Orc National Assembly.

Temeschwar/Hanuri.t: The Garrison of the League business sinecure was built in Hanuri, appointed annually by the League generals.

Zenith/Proceris.t: The Gardens of Pallas were reconstructed here, and a mithril statue for the Oblivion Sentinel was commissioned in southern Proceris.

Astolat.t: Its senator received 250 thrones to raise a Dawnish army, and also seconded the Kahraman roads funding.

Bastion.t: The Grand Inspiration of the Way folly was commissioned in Bastion, while its senator's Imperial Warcaster amendment was withdrawn.

Bay of Catazar.t: Mentioned in passing: the Bay of Catazar is not named in any motion this summit.

Bregasland.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator proposed the Speaker of the Magpies title and seconded Stones from Blood.

Casinea.t: The self-funded Physician's Legacy herb sinecure planned for Cantiarch's Hold failed, though Casinea's senator successfully proposed the Grand Inspiration of the Way.

Hahnmark.t: A guildhouse and sinecure for the Artisans Guild was built near Runegrott and the Runeforge.

Hercynia.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator proposed lifting sanctions on the Iron Confederacy, which passed, and seconded the failed Barrens appraisal.

Holberg.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator proposed the mithril sculptures, receiving 11 thrones 6 crowns, and seconded relinquishing the Brilliant Star.

Kahraman.t: 70 thrones went to rebuilding Kahraman's roads and the Kamkrag forts, and a Caravan Guards adventure was funded to protect its bourse seats from raids.

Kallavesa.t: Tekkupala's Hives, a drug-producing sinecure, was commissioned in Wittal with the help of Varushkan bees.

Karov.t: An Office of the Iron Roads was built in Delev, and Karov's senator proposed the Imperial Huntsmarshall title.

Karsk.t: An Office of the Iron Roads was built in Ivarsgard, and Karsk's senator successfully proposed fully improving the town of Orieb.

Madruga.t: The Parador of the Kindled Flame, an orphanage folly, was built in Siroc.

Miaren.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator proposed the withdrawn Stones from Blood and seconded the Speaker of the Magpies.

Miekarova.t: The Tolvoli Slaughterhouse was built to sate the dubik, and an Office of the Iron Roads was built in Essk.

Mitwold.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator proposed the Feni advisor election and seconded the Asavea ambassador election.

Morrow.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator proposed the withdrawn Gardens of Pallas motion and seconded the Liberty Pact amendments.

Mournwold.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator proposed the raid-defence appraisal and seconded the Feni advisor election.

Necropolis.t: The Abbey of Reconciliation, a weirwood sinecure to help ex-slaves and refugees into the Way, was built in Necropolis.

Ossium.t: An Office of the Iron Roads was built in Lomaa, and Ossium's senator proposed arming the Dreamers of the Dark Forest.

Redoubt.t: The Brilliant Star bourse seat in Redoubt was made an Urizen national seat, then relinquished as an Imperial position by a ratified constitutional motion.

Reikos.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator proposed the failed Physician's Legacy and seconded the Semmerlak law.

Sarvos.t: The Steel Rings of Sarvos were renamed the Great Chains of Sarvos, though no funds were disbursed for the fortification.

Segura.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator proposed the Minister of Historical Research election and seconded the Kahraman guards.

Semmerholm.t: A new law made it a crime to own, take or sell any object from the depths of the Semmerlak.

Sermersuaq.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator proposed the Liberty Pact amendments and seconded the Urizen in Spiral appraisal.

Skarsind.t: The Open Hand of the Ancestors was built in Solvihill, but the Golden Market of Aggido in Gildenheim did not go ahead.

Tassato.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator received 275 thrones for military resupply and seconded the Sarvos motion.

Temeschwar.t: The Garrison of the League was built in Hanuri, and the Keeper of the Tome of the Temeschwar-Otkodov Mana Exchange became an annual title.

The Barrens.t: Its senator's motion to recognise the sept of Karass as foreigners passed but is under scrutiny, while an appraisal on integrating local septs failed.

Therunin.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator proposed the Auditor of Senatorial Accountability changes and seconded the Physician's Legacy.

Upwold.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator proposed the Asavea ambassador election and seconded the Mareave spy network.

Volodmartz.t: An Office of the Iron Roads was built in Ruin, and Volodmartz's senator proposed the high path to Otkodov.

Weirwater.t: The Challenger in Waiting, a congregation sinecure holding a Synod vote, was built in Weirwater.

Zenith.t: The Gardens of Pallas were reconstructed in Proceris and a mithril statue was commissioned there, while Zenith's senator seconded lifting the Iron Confederacy sanctions.

385YE Summer Solstice Synod judgements.d: The General Assembly refused to remove the Doctrine of Human Destiny (539–1464). Enacted mandates committed Highguard, the Marches and the Brass Coast to fund the sacred city at Bastion, whose design the Nine chose. Urizeni in Spiral were urged to withhold the secrets of the Block and keep apart until a reckoning, and some spires will secede. Dawn turned inward after freeing the Barrens. Highborn and Varushkans armed Ossium's Dreamers. Highguard spread word of Urizen's veneration of Sulemaine. Claude Videre was vindicated as fit to be Empress, Aspar and Melchior became Cardinals, and priests were warned against the heralds of Cold Sun.

Dawn.t: Enacted mandates turn the Dawnish inward to enjoy the fruits of victory, restore exiles' estates in Dawnguard while new settlers hold back, and shift Dawn towards aiding the Barrens septs. Highguard pledged peerless kinship in the Barrens, and Dawnish knights were urged to fight the heralds of Cold Sun.

Druj.t: The Navarr assembly called on Navarri entering Sarangrave to hunt the Druj Het Sarra Grubfeast, former governor of Dawnguard. The Synod also welcomed Kaela's Gift, already used by captives of the Druj, being extended to those facing the vallorn.

Grendel.t: Priests searched for Grendel spies after an espionage ring was found in Necropolis, and the Seventh Wave can now root out such rings in Highborn lands for a year. Wildfyre was set a penance for urging trade with the Grendel. The Synod also debated the Apulian Orcs' former virtues of Audacity, Fidelity and Retribution.

Highguard.t: Highguard will pour 25 wains of white granite and 50 crowns a season into the sacred city at Bastion, leaving nothing for other projects. Its mandates also spread word of Urizen's veneration of Sulemaine, cost each Highborn mana site a crystal a season to hunt the Whisper Gallery, and arm the Dreamers of Ossium.

Imperial Orcs.t: An enacted mandate forged a Sunstorm sept identity, and the liberated orcs of Dubhtraig and Beoraidh named themselves the Sannite sept. Bloodcrow Rasp was vindicated, and the Imperial Orcs asked Varushka to let their Day magicians study the Palace of Orieb.

Jotun.t: The Freeborn raised a Jotun-style burial mound over the dead of Fort Braydon, earning grudging Jotun respect. Wintermark affirmed it will still give quarter to the Jotun, and Mourn orcs were urged to reject Jotun teachings on the Abyss.

Navarr.t: The Navarr assembly urged growth of Isaella's Dance and honoured Brocéliande's Brokers for regalia made for its generals. It warned of Anarchy around the Gardens of Glory but declined to tear them down, called for the hunt of Sarra Grubfeast, and backed engaging the heralds of Cold Sun.

The Brass Coast.t: Each Freeborn territory affected by an enacted mandate will donate 4 wains of white granite and 8 crowns a season to Bastion's sacred city. Freeborn corsairs were urged to break the Asavean blockade of Sumaah. The assembly also rejected Vengeance and endorsed the Zemress Festival and heritage names.

The League.t: The League assembly unanimously accepted it owes a reckoning to the Urizeni of Spiral, but Urizen's enacted mandates mean the Block is withheld and Spiral's taxation drops sharply. Separately, a loan lets the Sand Fishers finish their Holberg sawmills, and bishops were sent to guide the Apulians.

The Marches.t: Marcher mandates commit white granite and crowns to Bastion, set threshers hunting the Whisper Gallery at the cost of mana crystal, and welcome the Mournwold Orcs north. The assembly also exalted the miners of the Singing Caves and warned of Siakha's heralds hunting Mitwolders.

Thule.t: Wintermark endorsed its mediators trading in good faith with the Thule at the hall of Wreck in Otkodov. Highborn priests urged benefactors to bring trade and aid to the Varushkan regions ceded to the Thule.

Urizen.t: Enacted mandates see Spiral's Urizeni withhold the Block and keep apart from the League in enclaves, with some spires seceding. At home, Urizen rejected Purity and renounced veneration of Sulemaine, while Highguard spread word that will sour Highborn feeling towards Urizen.

Varushka.t: A greater-majority mandate sees Varushkans arm the Dreamers of Ossium, and their units may train them for a year. The assembly also called for a school for Ossium, honoured the completed Iron Roads, and sought access to Varkula's tomb and a pilgrimage to the Cave of Zoria.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark entered Iron Osric into the Book of Heroes and called for Pakaanan's Pass to be rebuilt. It endorsed mediators trading with the freed Thule at Wreck and Otkodov, affirmed giving quarter to the Jotun, and vindicated General Kindra Surefoot.

385YE Summer Solstice Synod judgements.o: At the Summer Solstice 385YE the Imperial Synod raised 217 judgements. It rejected a bid to strike out the Doctrine of Human Destiny and passed a wide range of statements, mandates and sanctions on Spiral, the Apulian Orcs, the Barrens, the sacred city at Bastion, the heralds of Cold Sun and more.

Holberg/Holfried.t: Mentioned in passing: not named directly, though the page covers Holberg's walls and the Sand Fishers' sawmills in Holberg.

Kahraman/Braydon's Jasse.t: A Jotun-style burial mound was raised over the orcs who fell at the Battle of Fort Braydon, not far from the battle site.

Kahraman/Serra Briante.t: Mentioned in passing: the unscalable Gilded Peak between Braydon's Jasse and Serra Briante was named as a Freeborn aspiration.

Karsk/Krevsaty.t: Krevsaty is among the regions ceded to the Thule to which Highborn priests urged benefactors to bring trade and aid.

Miekarova/Miechernya.t: Miechernya is among the regions ceded to the Thule to which Highborn priests urged benefactors to bring trade and aid.

Mournwold/Green March.t: Hap the Soft of the Golden Hoof Farm in the Green March was rewarded with one ring. He was praised for bridging Mournwold Orcs and Marchers.

Mournwold/Ore Hills.t: The Marcher assembly backed Jedediah Boon's research into the Ore Hills Rebellion of 326YE to reveal and perhaps honour its leaders.

Ossium/Bonewood.t: Mentioned in passing: notes suggest the Highborn call for aid to ceded lands might include Bonewood.

Skarsind/Pakaanan's Pass.t: Wintermark's assembly called for the pass, collapsed by the Jotun, to be rebuilt, which would restore the Krampus's home and ease army movement.

The Barrens/Dawnguard.t: Exiles who fled the Barrens will regain their estates in Dawnguard, while Dawnish settlers refrain from settling beyond it. Navarr also called for the hunt of its former Druj governor, Sarra Grubfeast.

Volodmartz/Opascari.t: The bearer of the Staff of Zoria intends a pilgrimage to the Cave of Zoria in the Opascari Mountains to study its stone tablet.

Bastion.t: The Nine chose Millward Cowley's design and Skywise Gralka's art for the sacred city at Bastion. Highguard, the Marches and the Brass Coast now fund it each season, and a Berechiah monument at his basilica was encouraged.

Bay of Catazar.t: Mentioned in passing: a Vigilance call to seek out Grendel spies along the southern coast is linked to the territories around the Bay.

Bregasland.t: The Marcher assembly urged benevolence towards Bregaslanders turned against the Empire by Bushel Sykes, and castigated Sykes as a traitor. It also recognised House Greywater's service alongside the Strong Reeds.

Brocéliande.t: Highborn priests backed building the Greenwatch against the Brocéliande vallorn. Navarr honoured Brocéliande's Brokers for artefacts made as regalia for Navarr generals.

Holberg.t: League bishops endorsed memorial spaces in Holberg's walls, which are being raised. An enacted loan lets the Sand Fishers complete their sawmills in Holberg.

Kahraman.t: An enacted mandate raised a Jotun-style burial mound over the orcs who fell at Fort Braydon. The Freeborn also celebrated the rebuilding of Kahraman's roads and aspired to climb the Gilded Peak.

Karsk.t: Highborn priests urged virtuous benefactors to bring trade and aid to the ceded lands south of the mountains, which appear to include Karsk's Krevsaty.

Madruga.t: Vigilance priests warned of a patrician carrying the 'Endless Thirst'. This appears to relate to the desiccating blight consuming the Great Grasses of Madruga.

Miaren.t: The Synod rewarded Corwyn Heartsbane 10 thrones towards debts from commissioning the Hall of the Seven in Miaren. The Hall will let Navarr captains explore vallorn hearts.

Miekarova.t: Highborn priests urged benefactors to bring trade and aid to the ceded regions south of the mountains, apparently including Miechernya.

Mitwold.t: The Marcher assembly raised the hue and cry because Siakha's heralds have begun hunting Mitwolders, urging priests to anoint, consecrate and hallow.

Mournwold.t: The Marches exalted the Singing Caves miners who fought the Jotun raid, and backed research into the Ore Hills Rebellion. Mournwold Orcs were offered sanctuary and work in the north, and Zephaniah was rewarded for magic letting Mournwold's ghosts speak.

Necropolis.t: Highborn priests will accompany the Seventh Wave to urge Necropolis citizens to reveal what they told the Grendel spy ring. Varushka also sought access to check the seals on Empress Varkula's tomb.

Ossium.t: Highborn and Varushkan mandates arm the Dreamers of the Dark Forest, and Varushka called for a school for Ossium's new citizens. A dose of true liao was granted to consecrate a monument to Kethry, and Yevanshka was rewarded for bringing the Way to Ossium.

Otkodov.t: Wintermark endorsed virtuous mediators travelling to Otkodov and trading at Wreck to help feed the freed slaves and better understand the Thule.

Reikos.t: Mentioned in passing: the Shattered Tower, a Highborn chapter from Reikos, opened itself to inquisition to disprove claims of eternal influence.

Sermersuaq.t: Wintermark called for Pakaanan's Pass, which linked Sermersuaq to Skarsind before the Jotun collapsed it, to be rebuilt.

Skarsind.t: Wintermark called for the rebuilding of Pakaanan's Pass into Skarsind. Skarsind's senator Bloodcrow Rasp was vindicated for building up the territory without Senate funds.

Spiral.t: Spiral's Urizeni will withhold the Block and live apart in enclaves, with some spires seceding. Construction needs mithril and taxation falls sharply, while the League and Urizen have each acknowledged that a reckoning is owed. Priests were urged to bring the Way to the Apulians and liao to the Wolves of War.

The Barrens.t: Dawnish exiles regain estates while new settlers hold back, and Dawn shifts towards aiding the septs. Highguard pledged kinship support, and Navarr and Dawn agreed to walk the trods created by the Dance of Navarr and Thorn.

The Semmerlak.t: The Varushkan assembly called the Semmerlak forbidden and urged its citizens to seek prosperity in other waters. The Senate has recently barred taking things from its depths.

Therunin.t: The Synod urged vigilance against Anarchy fed by liao from the Gardens of Glory in Therunin. The Vigilance assembly called for the gardens to be torn down, though the Navarr assembly rejected doing so.

Upwold.t: An enacted mandate sets Vigilant Upwolders hunting blasphemers and other threats, with a civil service report due at the Winter Solstice. Navarr were urged to visit Joshua Benson's tomb at Pickham.

Volodmartz.t: The Guardian of the Maze of Zoria plans a pilgrimage to the Cave of Zoria in Volodmartz to study the stone tablet from which the Staff of Zoria was believed taken.

Zenith.t: True liao consecrated the Crucible of Fate to Prosperity, drawing architects, crafters and merchants. Botanists at the Bleak Tower were encouraged to return to Zenith if the Gardens of Pallas are rebuilt.

385YE Summer Solstice interlude.d: Military units could join the Break the Vyig adventure or the new War of Whispers. The 350-throne Guerdon went to units supporting the Iron Helms, Citadel Guard, Bounders, Fist of the Mountains and Summer Storm. Dho'uala in the Semmerlak cut fleet production for Dawn, Varushka and Holberg. Tharim's Black Frost drained Dawnish mana sites and farms in return for knights against the Barrens. Highborn and Ambition-preaching League congregations gained liao and votes. Raiders hampered Kahraman's titles. The Mournwold, Necropolis, Navarr herb gardens and League businesses gained boons. Farm and forest diversification became free outside several contested territories. The Assembly of the Nine opened a contest to remake Bastion, and three rituals entered Imperial Lore.

Dawn.t: Dawnish fleets lost a rank of production to Dho'uala's Tithe, and the Black Frost cost every Dawnish mana site a crystal and every farm 36 rings. In return, Tharim's steel-bound knights would support any Dawnish army attacking the Barrens.

Druj.t: Tharim's steel-bound knights were pledged to support Dawnish armies attacking the Druj-held Barrens, where farms and forests were also excluded from free diversification.

Grendel.t: Grendel merchants traded eagerly with Highborn businesses in Necropolis under the Wildfyre mandate. Grendel-held Feroz was excluded from free diversification, and the Atalaya Harbour discount would last only while the Freeborn did not control Feroz.

Highguard.t: Highborn congregations gained extra liao, two Synod votes and a crown of income from the Birthplace of the Way. Every Highborn business suffered a rank penalty to fund Free Folk tutelage, Necropolis businesses gained 2 crowns from Grendel trade, and a contest opened to transform Bastion.

Imperial Orcs.t: Imperial Orc military units could take part, for one more season, in the Break the Vyig adventure to destroy the criminal organisation.

Jotun.t: Jotun-held Bregasland and Liathaven were excluded from free farm and forest diversification. The page noted that Kahraman's troubles might become moot if the Jotun conquered Jade Range.

Navarr.t: Thanks to the Great Forest Orcs, Navarr with herb gardens in Therunin, Hercynia, Miaren and Brocéliande could upgrade them for one fewer wain of weirwood.

The Brass Coast.t: Raiders cut production at the Damatian Cliffs and the Great Mine of Briante and restricted two Kahraman ministries. Regrow the Land's Heart was cast in Madruga against the blight, and Madruga fleets cost one less wain to upgrade.

The League.t: The League assembly's mandate let units join the Break the Vyig adventure, and Ambition congregations run by League citizens gained extra liao and votes. League businesses became cheaper to upgrade, while Holberg fleets suffered under Dho'uala's Tithe.

The Marches.t: Mournwold characters could retrain their skills and Mournwold businesses earned an extra 36 rings, while Marcher farmers could build mana-producing monoliths without the usual diversification cost.

Urizen.t: Mentioned in passing: the page notes that no new rituals were added to Urizen lore during the Spring Equinox.

Varushka.t: Varushkan fleets lost a rank of production to Dho'uala's Tithe, and the Varushkan assembly's mandate let military units join the Break the Vyig adventure.

385YE Summer Solstice interlude.o: Following the Spring Equinox 385YE, the Summer Solstice interlude set out the effects shaping that season's downtime, including military adventures, the Imperial Guerdon, curses and boons on various nations and territories, and a cardinals' contest to transform Bastion.

Kahraman/Jade Range.t: The Dust Parador in Jade Range lost the top two ranks of its ministry because moving metal out of the mountains was too dangerous, a matter that might become moot if the Jotun conquered the region.

Bastion.t: The Assembly of the Nine opened a contest for a construction to turn Bastion into a beacon for pilgrims and supplant Timoj as the centre of the Way of Virtue.

Bregasland.t: Resources in Bregasland were excluded from the waived cost of diversifying farms and forests.

Brocéliande.t: Navarr herb gardens in Brocéliande could be upgraded for one fewer wain of weirwood, though the territory was excluded from free farm and forest diversification.

Feroz.t: Feroz was excluded from free diversification, and the Atalaya Harbour fleet discount depended on the Freeborn not controlling it.

Hercynia.t: Navarr herb gardens in Hercynia could be upgraded for one fewer wain of weirwood with Great Forest Orc help.

Holberg.t: Fleets based in Holberg lost a rank of production as Dho'uala haunted the Semmerlak.

Kahraman.t: Orc and human raiders cut the Damatian Cliffs' output by 7 wains and the Great Mine of Briante's by 6. The Dhomiro of the Cinnabar Hills and the Mistress of the Dust Parador lost access to the top two ranks of their ministries while Senate-commissioned roads and kamkrag were built.

Liathaven.t: Resources in Liathaven were excluded from the waived cost of diversifying farms and forests.

Madruga.t: Regrow the Land's Heart was cast in Madruga to contain the desiccating blight on the Great Grasses, and fleets there cost one less wain of weirwood to upgrade while Atalaya Harbour remained.

Miaren.t: Navarr herb gardens in Miaren could be upgraded for one fewer wain of weirwood with Great Forest Orc help.

Mournwold.t: Summer magic let characters with resources in the Mournwold change their skills, and every business there produced an extra 36 rings as its crafts and wares were in demand.

Necropolis.t: Visiting Grendel traders boosted every business in Necropolis by an additional 2 crowns each season.

Spiral.t: Resources in Spiral were excluded from the waived cost of diversifying farms and forests.

The Barrens.t: Tharim's steel-bound knights would aid any Dawnish army attacking the Barrens, and resources there were excluded from free diversification.

The Semmerlak.t: The sovereign Dho'uala rose in the Semmerlak, haunting fleets with eerie encounters and raising the prices of the Ivarsgard Docks and Harbourmaster of the Semmerlak ministries.

Therunin.t: Navarr herb gardens in Therunin could be upgraded for one fewer wain of weirwood with Great Forest Orc help.

385YE Summer Solstice winds of fortune.d: With allies, Dawn shattered the Druj in the Barrens, and the Senate granted it dominion there. The Jotun quit Kahraman, leaving only champions, and withdrew from Bregasland into Liathaven and Hordalant. A blight continues to ravage Madruga's Great Grasses. The vyig were broken. Through Salt Lord Kaliact's treaty, Spiral passed to the League, leaving its Urizeni inhabitants in turmoil. The Crucible of Fate began transforming Zenith. Further entries covered Autumn magic and eternals, Varushkan dealings with dark powers and orcs, Wintermark judgements, Marcher affairs, Imperial Orc allies and the claim that Navarr and Thorn live within Brocéliande. The page also listed the Spring Sentinel Gate conjunction outcomes and trade conditions.

Dawn.t: With its allies, Dawn conquered the Barrens and was granted dominion by the Senate, a centuries-old dream achieved at great cost, though the fighting is not yet done. Stories of dark happenings also emerged in northern Dawn.

Druj.t: The Druj armies in the Barrens were shattered and routed at Dawnguard, and several warbands and heralds were killed in Spring conjunctions. At the Jagged Stream, however, the Druj drove off Imperial heroes and reclaimed the mithril.

Grendel.t: The Grendel still hold Feroz and the port of Oran remains closed to Imperial fleets. Their own seven virtues, apparently a legacy of ancient Urizen missionaries, raise questions for the Synod.

Highguard.t: The Highborn offered aid to the beleaguered Brass Coast and sent Jared of the Suns of Couros to support Varushkan contact with orcs. Their priests reach outward to the other nations even as the Seventh Wave makes an alarming discovery.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Imperial Orcs completed an armoury for the Ethengraw and an ossuary-temple for the Illarawm and began a garden for the Yerende. Three entire septs are now on the verge of joining them, raising questions about who the Imperial Orcs now are.

Jotun.t: The Jotun left Kahraman without fighting, leaving only their champions, and made an orderly retreat from Bregasland into Liathaven and Hordalant without their usual promise to return. They suffered losses in Spring conjunctions, including the death of Jarl Iduna.

Navarr.t: The Navarr assembly proclaimed that the exemplars Navarr and Thorn still live at the heart of the Brocéliande vallorn and vowed to destroy it and release them. Navarr captives were also rescued in Liathaven.

The Brass Coast.t: The Freeborn risk being squeezed between the Jotun to the east and the Grendel and Asavean-allied Governor Rahab to the west as the peace treaty nears its end. A desiccating blight continues to ravage Madruga.

The League.t: The League gained Spiral through the Kaliact treaty, and its egregores must decide whether its Apulian Orcs can become citizens. Its cities continue their year-long competition, and the vyig have been broken.

The Marches.t: Marchers face the aftermath of the Jotun and Fisher occupation of Bregasland and a phantasmal miner over the Mournwold. In Upwold, an inspirational tomb for Benson the Bellringer is being called for.

Thule.t: Mentioned in passing: Varushkan traders and volhov were encouraged to make peaceful deals with orcs, including the Thule.

Urizen.t: The Crucible of Fate is slowly restoring Zenith, and the Gardens of Pallas may be rebuilt more splendidly than before. The Urizeni of Spiral are reeling from its transfer to the League, and the consecration of Sulemaine's tomb remains controversial.

Varushka.t: Varushka's assembly urged bargains with dark powers and peaceful contact with orcs, and the completed Iron Roads opened new trade between its vales. An appraisal also found ways to lift the Druj threat from Ossium.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark's priests and stormcrows passed three contentious judgements, including one calling for a Varushkan senator to be interred in the Kallavesa marshes, which the Wintermark Assembly may now try to settle. The Net and Vine's Autumn enchantment spread across the Empire.

385YE Summer Solstice winds of fortune.o: The Summer Solstice 385YE winds of fortune gathered the season's major developments across the Empire. Dawn's conquest of the Barrens, the Jotun withdrawal from Bregasland, the breaking of the vyig, the League's acquisition of Spiral and the restoration of Zenith all sat alongside many new opportunities for Imperial citizens.

Bregasland/Grey Fens.t: Dripping Echoes of the Fen were summoned in the Grey Fens last season.

Bregasland/North Fens.t: At the Greywater Estates, Imperial heroes killed all the Jotun but recovered no letter.

Brocéliande/Terunael.t: Heroes who reached Terunael at the heart of Brocéliande found the exemplars Navarr and Thorn still living within the vallorn.

Holberg/Misericorde.t: Mentioned in passing: the Merchant Prince of Misericorde Market led the conjunction that recovered Misericorde's Blade in Utterlund.

Holberg/The Morass.t: Imperial heroes killed all the vyig at Drusilla's Farm.

Holberg/Utterlund.t: At Elsbeth's Well, Misericorde's Blade was recovered and the vyig slain.

Kahraman/Braydon's Jasse.t: Heroes investigating the gathering of champions were driven back, after which champion warbands raided neighbouring territories.

Kahraman/Jade Range.t: The Jotun were defeated on the Path of the Liscano family, and Venator, herald of Hayaak, was stopped on the Sylvan Track so that House Perigord could keep supplying Boar's Market.

Kallavesa/Wittal Grove.t: Forge the Wooden Fastness was cast in Wittal Grove last season.

Liathaven/Liath's Ring.t: At the Shattered Glade, the Navarr captives were rescued and Jarl Iduna was killed.

Mournwold/Greensward.t: The ghosts at the Overton Ruins were laid to rest.

Mournwold/Ore Hills.t: A phantasmal giant, shirtless miner appears above the Ore Hills every night, striking dramatic poses that mine owners and Mournwold Orcs each read as aimed at them.

Ossium/Drownbark Forest.t: Naomi of Virtue's Rest's appraisal found opportunities to remove the Drownbark Forest's under-threat status.

Ossium/Echofell.t: Echofell was appraised for removal of its under-threat status, and Forge the Wooden Fastness was cast there.

Sarangrave/Bloodwater Marsh.t: On Ormthak's Path, the ambush was triggered and a Druj warband killed.

Semmerholm/Axmure.t: The Amaranthine Devourer, herald of Agramant, was slain at Melusine's Field.

Sermersuaq/Stark.t: At Nestori's Lament, the Ender of Virtue was defeated and its relic recovered and destroyed.

Sermersuaq/Suaq Wastes.t: The Jotun were stopped at Ymma's Howe before reaching the Pride of Ikka's Tears, and Theodric Irontongue and the Walkers of the Wastes were killed at Ardith's Rest.

Temeschwar/Metri.t: The Grand Enchantrix and her Spites were defeated at Agnieszka's Grove.

The Barrens/Bitter Strand.t: At Spinner's Retreat, Venomclaw, herald of Arhallogen, was slain along with most of the Druj.

The Barrens/Dawnguard.t: The major conjunction to claim Dawnguard saw Serra Grubfeast's Druj routed and the Dawnish rebels succeed.

The Barrens/Saltmarsh.t: Heroes recovered the relic of Adelmar at Hadrienne's Lament, claimed a stockpile at the Steadfast Pines and negotiated with the Vendarri on Greenstone Isle.

The Barrens/The Bleaks.t: At the Blooming Grove, tepel Zortog Ashtouch was killed and the list acquired.

The Barrens/The Plains of Teeth.t: Ramparts of Ashlar was cast on the Spires of Dusk, dead knights were given succour, the Gyre's Edge was recovered and the Druj were intercepted before they could attack the Rahvin.

The Barrens/The Untrod Groves.t: At Jagged Stream, the Druj drove off the Imperial heroes and reclaimed the mithril.

Zenith/Proceris.t: Dripping Echoes of the Fen were summoned in Proceris last season.

Bay of Catazar.t: Mentioned in passing: those interested in the Bay of Catazar were listed among the audiences for the Rings and Crowns wind of fortune.

Bregasland.t: The Jotun withdrew and Mathilda Fisher's household retreated to Hordalant, leaving grudges between fenlanders over who sided with the Fishers, while Bushel Sykes continues to spread secessionist rhetoric.

Brocéliande.t: The Navarr assembly declared that Navarr and Thorn live on at the heart of this vallorn, holding it open to the trods. Research at the Great Library is expected to reveal a way to destroy it.

Feroz.t: Mentioned in passing: the Grendel still hold Feroz, part of the threat facing the Brass Coast from the west.

Forest of Ulnak.t: Mentioned in passing: a few groups of fleeing vyig were reported slinking through Ossium into the Forest of Ulnak.

Holberg.t: A mandate encouraging bravos to debate the sword scholars and study Emperor Frederick boosted the Scholars of the Sword Academy's stipend by a third. Vyig were also killed in Holberg and Misericorde's Blade recovered.

Hordalant.t: The retreating Jotun pulled back into Hordalant, and the Fishers withdrew to their holdings there.

Kahraman.t: The Jotun left without a fight but their champions remain. Imperial heroes were driven back at Braydon's Jasse, champion warbands raided neighbouring territories and servants of Hayaak reaved across the land.

Kallavesa.t: Forge the Wooden Fastness was cast in Wittal Grove, and a contentious Wintermark judgement called for a Varushkan senator to be interred in Kallavesa's marshes.

Liathaven.t: The Jotun retreating from Bregasland pulled back into Liathaven, where Imperial heroes rescued Navarr captives and killed Jarl Iduna.

Madruga.t: A blight ravages the Great Grasses, held back only by Spring magic that is slowly losing ground. The Dry Patricians survived the Silver Chalice's attempt to destroy them, and a shroud hangs over the territory.

Mountains of the Moon.t: Mentioned in passing: Axos anger over Imperial involvement in the failure of their joint venture with the Grendel into the Mountains of the Moon continues to penalise trade.

Mournwold.t: A phantasmal giant miner appears nightly over the Ore Hills, stirring the mine-owner enfranchisement movement and the Mournwold Orcs. Ghosts were laid to rest in Greensward.

Necropolis.t: Mentioned in passing: Necropolis is listed among the territories over which a shroud hangs.

Ossium.t: An appraisal found opportunities to remove the under-threat status from Echofell and the Drownbark Forest. Forge the Wooden Fastness was cast in Echofell, and some fleeing vyig passed through the territory.

Sarangrave.t: Imperial heroes sprang an ambush on Ormthak's Path in the Bloodwater Marsh and killed a Druj warband.

Sarvos.t: Mentioned in passing: swift ships reportedly left Sarvos carrying suspiciously wealthy vyig passengers, and a shroud hangs over the territory.

Segura.t: Mentioned in passing: the Jotun could return into Segura at any moment, and a shroud hangs over the territory.

Semmerholm.t: Heroes slew the Amaranthine Devourer, herald of Agramant, at Melusine's Field in Axmure.

Sermersuaq.t: In Spring conjunctions, the Ender of Virtue was defeated in Stark, the Jotun were stopped short of the Pride of Ikka's Tears, and Theodric Irontongue and the Walkers of the Wastes were killed.

Skarsind.t: Mentioned in passing: the Tamazi are noted as already settled in their new home in Skarsind.

Spiral.t: Spiral was regained in a single season through the Kaliact treaty and made a League territory, though whether its Apulian Orcs become citizens rests with the League egregores. Its Urizeni inhabitants are in turmoil.

Temeschwar.t: Heroes defeated the Grand Enchantrix and her Spites at Agnieszka's Grove in Metri.

The Barrens.t: The Druj were routed and the Barrens became Imperial under Dawnish dominion. Much work and further fighting remain, alongside numerous conjunction victories across the territory.

The Semmerlak.t: Mentioned in passing: more information about the disruption of the Semmerlak is promised in The Horror and the Wild wind of fortune.

Upwold.t: The Marcher assembly backed an inspirational tomb for Benson the Bellringer, whose legacy survives in Upwold's Pickham Monastery, and a conjunction to visit Benson's Orchard has appeared.

Zenith.t: The completed Crucible of Fate is slowly transforming Zenith, with new spires rising, and the destroyed Gardens of Pallas have been appraised for grander restoration. Dripping Echoes of the Fen were summoned in Proceris.

385YE Summer Solstice winds of war.d: In the east, Imperial armies worked to secure the Barrens despite Druj curses. In the west, the Empire advanced into Kahraman as the main western forces retreated, while Jotun and yegarra raided Madruga, Tassato, Sarvos and the Mournwold, and fighting raged around Fort Braydon. Wintermark and Skarsind warriors invaded Skallahn. Marcher armies and the Urizen-enchanted Granite Pillar were in Bregasland; the Jotun withdrew from the Dour Fens into Liathaven, and Mathilda Fisher returned to Hordalant, though Bushel Sykes remained stirring secessionism. The Wolves of War successfully claimed Spiral. Three possible Jotun battles were identified in Kahraman and Skallahn, alongside many conjunctions across the Empire.

Dawn.t: Dawnish forces (force weight 46) were offered conjunctions to protect the Harps of Astolat, investigate Surlac, challenge the Deadwood Knight in Weirwater and bring peace to the ghosts at the Shrine of Hope, while Dawnish armies could not take the Cautious Advance or Give Ground orders.

Druj.t: The Druj cast malign curses across the Barrens as Imperial armies tightened their grip, and faced conjunctions in the Barrens, Sarangrave and Ossium, though no major battle conjunctions involved them this season.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: a conjunction in Grendel-held Feroz offered a meeting with emissaries of Siakha.

Highguard.t: The Granite Pillar marched across the Empire to Bregasland with Urizen magic, Highborn armies could no longer issue the Crusading Storm order, and Highborn forces had a force weight of 20 for the battles.

Imperial Orcs.t: Warriors from Skarsind joined Wintermark in crossing into Skallahn for the first invasion of the Jotun jarldoms, and the Imperial Orcs had a force weight of 5.

Jotun.t: The Jotun's main western forces retreated from Kahraman while their raiders struck across the west, their armies pulled back from the Dour Fens into Liathaven, and their own jarldom of Skallahn was invaded for the first time, with all three battle opportunities set against them.

Navarr.t: Navarr had a force weight of 52 for the battles and was offered a conjunction to protect the Pool of Silver Clouds in Miaren, with the Senator for Therunin given responsibility for a conjunction against the Druj in the Barrens.

The Brass Coast.t: Imperial forces advanced into Kahraman as Jotun and yegarra raided Madruga, Fort Braydon came under threat, and numerous Freeborn-led conjunctions arose in Madruga and Reinos; the Brass Coast's force weight was 19.

The League.t: The Wolves of War successfully claimed Spiral as agreed with the orcs there, while Tassato and Sarvos were raided and conjunctions targeted Magnus Ironarm and the last Temeschwari vyig; the League's force weight was 16.

The Marches.t: Some Marcher armies aided the Freeborn while others held Bregasland after Mathilda Fisher withdrew, though Bushel Sykes kept spreading secessionist ideas; the Mournwold was raided, and Marcher armies gained extra strength at home but could not Give Ground.

Urizen.t: Urizen magicians enchanted the Granite Pillar's march to Bregasland, Urizen armies gained bonuses in fighting between Zenith and Morrow, the Court of the White Fountain could not be reduced below 1,000 strength, and Urizen's force weight was 15.

Varushka.t: Varushka faced conjunctions to kill the last Varushkan vyig and the Druj in Ossium, could take the Hospitality of the Boyars order there, and generated fewer victory points when campaigning alongside the Brass Coast or Wintermark; its force weight was 11.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark warriors led the first invasion of the Jotun jarldoms in Skallahn, the nation brought the largest force weight of 60, and a conjunction sought to protect the Aviary of Ishal in Kallavesa.

385YE Summer Solstice winds of war.o: The Summer Solstice 385YE summary of the Empire's campaigns recorded Imperial armies consolidating in the Barrens, advancing into Kahraman amid widespread Jotun raids, and launching the first invasion of the Jotun jarldoms in Skallahn. It also set out the season's battle opportunities, conjunctions and military considerations.

Astolat/Winterbourne.t: The High Bard of the Empire was named to organise protection of the Harps of Astolat at the Gardens of House Cadence.

Bregasland/Ottermire.t: A small conjunction at the Ottery Fishing Docks offered a meeting with the secessionist Bushel Sykes.

Feroz/Cazar Straits.t: A conjunction at Azcara's Field offered the Archmage of Spring a meeting with emissaries of Siakha.

Kahraman/Serra Damata.t: A battle opportunity was identified to block the mountain passes out of Serra Damata against the Jotun.

Kallavesa/Skymark.t: A conjunction at Maiko's Copse sought to protect the Aviary of Ishal.

Madruga/Calvos Sound.t: A conjunction at Renewal Grove sought to end the Tassatan vyig and reclaim the documents.

Madruga/Torres.t: A conjunction at Fondre's Rest sought to stop the Jotun.

Miaren/Goldglades.t: A conjunction at the Verdant Grove sought to protect the Pool of Silver Clouds.

Miekarova/Srodkoja.t: A conjunction at Butterfly Holt sought to kill the last of the Varushkan vyig.

Mitwold/Golden Downs.t: A conjunction on the Long Road sought to deal with the heralds.

Mournwold/Southmoor.t: A conjunction at Maggie's Croft sought to stop Jarl Haakon.

Ossium/Drownbark Forest.t: A conjunction at Broken Clearing sought to kill the Druj.

Reinos/Bastasor.t: A conjunction at Beatriz's Field sought to recover the Overflowing Platter.

Sarangrave/Nesustak Forest.t: A conjunction at the Thicket of Thorns sought to rescue Decius Frostpire.

Skallahn/Greenwall.t: A conjunction at Paegga's Rest sought to stop Jarl Asbjørn Dalgaard.

Skallahn/Iron Stand.t: A conjunction at Kevan's Holt sought to recover the shield of Blerung the Bright Lantern.

Tassato/Enterio.t: A conjunction at Duarte's Repose sought to slay Magnus Ironarm.

Temeschwar/Vardstein Vale.t: A conjunction in the Broken Wilds sought to kill the last of the Temeschwari vyig.

The Barrens/Heart of Peytaht.t: A conjunction at the Silent Glade sought to stop the Druj.

The Barrens/Hope's Rest.t: Conjunctions sought to rout the Druj and rescue Circe at Oakenclough and to bring peace to the ghosts at the Shrine of Hope.

The Barrens/The Untrod Groves.t: A conjunction at Garstang Thicket sought to stop Varag Soulflayer.

Upwold/Tower March.t: A conjunction offered a visit to the orchard of Benson the Bellringer.

Weirwater/Sandling.t: A small conjunction sought to find out what was going on in Surlac.

Weirwater/Wickmoor.t: A conjunction in woods on the border of Karov offered a chance to challenge the Deadwood Knight.

Astolat.t: A conjunction was offered to protect the Harps of Astolat in Winterbourne.

Bregasland.t: Marcher armies and the Granite Pillar held Bregasland after the Jotun left the Dour Fens and Mathilda Fisher withdrew, though Bushel Sykes remained active and a conjunction offered a meeting with him.

Feroz.t: A conjunction at Azcara's Field in the Cazar Straits offered a meeting with emissaries of Siakha.

Hordalant.t: Mathilda Fisher, her supporters and household returned to their former domain in Hordalant after quitting Bregasland.

Kahraman.t: Imperial soldiers advanced into Kahraman as the main western forces retreated, with battle opportunities to block the passes out of Serra Damata and to stop Fort Braydon collapsing.

Kallavesa.t: A conjunction was offered to protect the Aviary of Ishal in Skymark.

Karov.t: Mentioned in passing: a conjunction against the Deadwood Knight took place in woods on Weirwater's border with Karov.

Liathaven.t: The Jotun armies pulled back into Liathaven after leaving the Dour Fens shortly after the Spring Equinox.

Madruga.t: Jotun and yegarra raids spread war into Madruga, prompting several conjunctions including stopping the Jotun at Torres and ending the Tassatan vyig at Calvos Sound.

Miaren.t: A conjunction was offered to protect the Pool of Silver Clouds in the Goldglades.

Miekarova.t: A conjunction was offered to kill the last of the Varushkan vyig at Srodkoja.

Mitwold.t: Any Imperial army could Billet in Mitwold, Marcher armies fighting there gained strength, and a conjunction was offered to deal with heralds on the Golden Downs.

Morrow.t: Highborn or Urizen armies defending Morrow against attacks from Zenith gained a bonus to defend territory but inflicted fewer casualties.

Mournwold.t: Jotun and yegarra raids spread into the Mournwold, a conjunction sought to stop Jarl Haakon at Southmoor, and Marcher armies fighting there gained extra strength.

Ossium.t: A conjunction was offered to kill the Druj in the Drownbark Forest, and Varushkan armies could take the Hospitality of the Boyars order here.

Redoubt.t: The Court of the White Fountain in Redoubt could not be reduced below 1,000 military strength.

Reinos.t: A conjunction was offered to recover the Overflowing Platter at Bastasor.

Sarangrave.t: A conjunction was offered to rescue Decius Frostpire from the Nesustak Forest.

Sarvos.t: Jotun and yegarra raids spread war into Sarvos.

Semmerholm.t: The Adamant Gate in Semmerholm could not be reduced below 1,000 military strength.

Skallahn.t: Wintermark and Skarsind warriors invaded Skallahn in the first assault on the Jotun jarldoms, with a battle opportunity against Blade Quencher's Hall and conjunctions at Iron Stand and Greenwall.

Skarsind.t: Mentioned in passing: warriors from Skarsind joined the crossing into Skallahn.

Spiral.t: The Wolves of War entered Spiral to claim it as agreed with the orcs there and succeeded despite the malignancy left by the Black Plateau's awakening.

Tassato.t: Jotun and yegarra raids spread into Tassato, and a conjunction was offered to slay Magnus Ironarm at Enterio.

Temeschwar.t: A conjunction was offered to kill the last of the Temeschwari vyig in Vardstein Vale.

The Barrens.t: Imperial armies worked to secure the Barrens despite Druj curses, with conjunctions against the Druj across Hope's Rest, the Untrod Groves and the Heart of Peytaht.

Therunin.t: Mentioned in passing: the Senator for Therunin was given responsibility for a conjunction in the Barrens.

Upwold.t: Any Imperial army could Billet in Upwold, Marcher armies fighting there gained strength, and a conjunction offered a visit to Benson the Bellringer's orchard.

Weirwater.t: Conjunctions were offered to discover what was happening in Surlac and to challenge the Deadwood Knight in Wickmoor.

Zenith.t: Highborn or Urizen armies attacking Zenith from Morrow gained a bonus to territory captured but inflicted fewer casualties.

385YE Winter Solstice Imperial elections.d: National elections returned senators for Astolat, Bregasland, Hercynia, Kallavesa, Miekarova, Necropolis, Ossium, Skarsind, Temeschwar, Weirwater and Zenith. The Senate named Vesna Borkovna Prochnost to the Throne and appointed ambassadors, the Imperial Administrator, seven generals and many sinecure holders. The Synod elected cardinals including Darian Numbers of Prosperity and Ashborn Atla of the Way, plus inquisitors and champions. Seven Military Council strategoi were appointed. Archmage candidacies were declared for Night and Summer. Bourse auctions sold the Weirwater Vales, Golden Trees of Seren and other seats, while the Chair of the Wolf (1055 votes) and Reeve of Boar's Market (867 votes) were among the Bourse elections.

Dawn.t: Dawn returned Bohemond De Rondell for Astolat and Ser Lucan Mortére for Weirwater, and Mouse of Dawn was appointed Strategos of Dawn.
