Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: the Senate appointed Finna i Fijadoz i Guerra as the Empire's Ambassador to the Grendel.

Highguard.t: Highguard returned Eli of the Cenotaph as Senator for Necropolis, and Seretia was appointed Strategos of Highguard.

Imperial Orcs.t: Bloodcrow Rasp was elected Senator for Skarsind, the territory the Imperial Orcs held at the time.

Jotun.t: Mentioned in passing: the Jotun are not named; they are linked only as holders of Bregasland, for which Lizzie Stamp of Bildewold was returned as senator.

Navarr.t: Navarr returned Rowyn of the Waystone Path as Senator for Hercynia, and Edric Lonestrider was appointed Strategos of Navarr.

The League.t: The League returned Giuseppe Sanguineo von Temeschwar as Senator for Temeschwar and Gabrieli was appointed Strategos of the League, while Valentina von Temeshwar became Master of the Sword Academy of Temeschwar.

Urizen.t: Urizen returned Herminius of the House of the Wanderer as Senator for Zenith.

Varushka.t: Varushka returned Troyan Dobrociech for Miekarova and Marya Zoranova Doubek for Ossium, and Doubravka Nadjaovna Vanek-Vessely was appointed Strategos of Varushka.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark returned Rane Shardbearer as Senator for Kallavesa, Vidarr Rune-Bound was appointed Strategos of Wintermark, and Nora was named Grimnir of Wittal Grove.

385YE Winter Solstice Imperial elections.o: At the Winter Solstice summit of 385YE the Empire filled a wide range of Imperial titles, most notably the Senate's appointment of Vesna Borkovna Prochnost to the Throne, alongside eleven senatorial elections and many Synod, Bourse, military and Conclave posts.

Kallavesa/Wittal Grove.t: The Senate appointed Nora as Grimnir of Wittal Grove.

Astolat.t: Bohemond De Rondell was elected Senator for Astolat.

Bregasland.t: Lizzie Stamp of Bildewold was elected Senator for Bregasland, though the territory was held by the Jotun at the time.

Hercynia.t: Rowyn of the Waystone Path was elected Senator for Hercynia.

Kallavesa.t: Rane Shardbearer was elected Senator for Kallavesa, and the Senate appointed Nora as Grimnir of Wittal Grove within the territory.

Miekarova.t: Troyan Dobrociech was elected Senator for Miekarova.

Necropolis.t: Eli of the Cenotaph was elected Senator for Necropolis.

Ossium.t: Marya Zoranova Doubek was elected Senator for Ossium.

Skarsind.t: Bloodcrow Rasp was elected Senator for Skarsind.

Temeschwar.t: Giuseppe Sanguineo von Temeschwar was elected Senator for Temeschwar, and Valentina von Temeshwar was appointed Master of the Sword Academy of Temeschwar.

Weirwater.t: Ser Lucan Mortére was elected Senator for Weirwater, and the Weirwater Vales seat was won at Bourse auction by Misha Kemi for 440 thrones.

Zenith.t: Herminius of the House of the Wanderer was elected Senator for Zenith.

385YE Winter Solstice Senate sessions.d: The treasury stood at 601 thrones and 4 crowns. The Senate criminalised the Last Resort poisons and Ocean's Caress, and created the Arcane Inquisitor. An Arcane Envoy also passed, though its appointment method needs correcting. It declared the Rahvin foreigners and recognised Thule dominion over Krevsaty, Miechernya, Crow's Ridge, Silver Peak and the Webwood. Funds went to the Wintermark army (200 thrones), Spider's Dream Bridge (240), Dawn's fourth army (55) and Temeschwar great works (44). Commissions and announcements created counting houses, sinecures, bourse seats, ministries and a spy network in Reinos. Ambassadors were elected to the Grendel, Axos, the Iron Confederacy and the Sarcophan Delves.

Dawn.t: Dawn received 55 thrones for its fourth army and gained the Phoenix Flame in Astolat and a Counting House in Semmerholm, and Bridget Talbot de Couerdefer was elected Imperial Administrator. The Rahvin of the Barrens were declared foreigners.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: the Senate elected Finna i Fijadoz i Guerra of the Brass Coast as Ambassador to the Grendel.

Highguard.t: Highguard's senators secured the criminalisation of Ocean's Caress and a Counting House in Reikos creating the Benefactor of High Chalcis. The Senator for Necropolis received 240 thrones for Spider's Dream Bridge, later amended to drop its fortifications.

Imperial Orcs.t: Human prospectors and miners were welcomed into the northern hills of Skarsind to work the Imperial Orc mines, in a motion fully funded by Irontide Flax.

Jotun.t: The Imperial Spymaster built a spy network in Reinos intended to speed the closure of the Jotun war and hamstring the Lasambrians on the western front.

Navarr.t: Navarri citizens were elected Captain of the Senate Guard (Arthur Bannerman) and Ambassador to Axos (Fintan Nighthaven), and Bledri and Siân of the Eternal Family pledged 10 wains to the House of Illumination. A proposed Leviathan's Hall in Miaren failed.

The Brass Coast.t: The Keeper of the Breadbasket halved the armies of the Brass Coast's losses from insufficient supply, and Brass Coast citizens were elected Ambassadors to the Grendel and the Iron Confederacy.

The League.t: The League gained a raft of works: Holberg's walls, Garden City, souvenir stall and weirwood bourse seat, Tassato's Counting House and Office of the Lantern Wolf, and 44 thrones for Temeschwar great works. Its Legacy mana was redirected to Spiral's spires.

The Marches.t: Marcher senators carried the creation of the Arcane Inquisitor and an amendment letting the Legion Engineer build and upgrade fortifications. A historical report on the Ore Hills Rebellion of 326YE was also commissioned.

Thule.t: The Senate recognised Thule dominion over Krevsaty, Miechernya, Crow's Ridge, Silver Peak and the Webwood as part of Otkodov, pledging not to challenge it while bound by the peace it seeks to extend, and the Thule will be informed.

Urizen.t: The Warmage is to be appointed by the Urizen generals, pending further scrutiny. Urizen gained the Gloaming Forum in Morrow, the House of Illumination in Redoubt, a larger Brilliant Star mithril output and A Fair Price in Zenith.

Varushka.t: Varushkan senators won recognition of Thule dominion, and Karsk gained the Leshun Market and an improved Bursar of the Conclave ministry, with a Light Market in Miekarova. Motions on Semmerlak drowning and outlawing privateering failed.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark received 200 thrones to complete its army and gained the Hall of Rund in Kallavesa, and Thanmir Hrafnar was elected Ambassador to the Sarcophan Delves. Research into a vision of Wintermark's Last King, Alof Bearing, was commissioned.

385YE Winter Solstice Senate sessions.o: At the 385YE Winter Solstice the Senate passed a broad slate of motions, appraisals, commissions and appointments, while Imperial title-holders announced further constructions. Highlights included recognising Thule dominion over several territories, creating the title of Arcane Inquisitor and funding Wintermark and Dawnish armies.

Holberg/Holmauer.t: Holberg's Phantasmagorical Mementoes souvenir stall sinecure was established in Holmauer Park, completing its restoration.

Karsk/Moresvah.t: The improved ministry of the Bursar of the Conclave, allowing crystal mana purchases at standard cost, is to be constructed in Moresvah.

Morrow/Operus.t: The Gloaming Forum bourse seat is to be built in Operus.

Mournwold/Ore Hills.t: A historical report on the Ore Hills Rebellion of 326YE, its leaders and their fate is due by the Spring Equinox 386YE.

Zenith/Iteri.t: The A Fair Price farm sinecure is to be built in Iteri, though a Senate motion is needed to give the Champion of Prosperity custody of it.

Astolat.t: The Phoenix Flame sinecure and the title of Tender of the Phoenix Flame are to be built in Astolat, to be ceded to Meraud once constructed. Its senator also received 55 thrones for the fourth Dawnish army.

Bastion.t: Mentioned in passing: Bastion's senator seconded the Ocean's Caress ban and proposed the election of the Ambassador to the Iron Confederacy.

Bregasland.t: A proposed appraisal into using the Otterway military road to better Bregasland and ease its disgruntled mood was withdrawn.

Casinea.t: Mentioned in passing: Casinea's senator proposed criminalising Ocean's Caress and seconded the Reikos Counting House.

Hahnmark.t: The Senator for Hahnmark received 200 thrones to complete the Wintermark army begun in Winter 384YE, in a motion prioritised by the Conscience of the Senate.

Hercynia.t: Mentioned in passing: Hercynia's senator proposed the Arcane Envoy title and seconded the Ambassador to Axos election.

Holberg.t: Holberg's walls gain a deep embankment, and the city is to become the City of Flowers, with a souvenir stall sinecure and a weirwood bourse seat. Its Legacy of Courage mana will now go to Spiral.

Kahraman.t: Mentioned in passing: Kahraman's senator proposed the Ambassador to the Grendel election and seconded the Hall of Rund.

Kallavesa.t: The Hall of Rund, a liao-giving sinecure held by the Speaker of the Crows, is to be built in Rundhal, Kallavesa.

Karov.t: Karov's senator proposed making drowning in the Semmerlak the default execution in Karov and other territories, but the motion failed.

Karsk.t: The Leshun Market ministry is to be built in Karsk, and the Bursar of the Conclave's ministry was improved there. A proposal to make Semmerlak drowning the default execution in Karsk failed.

Miaren.t: Miaren's senator secured an appraisal of using fleets to disrupt enemy operations in the Bay of Catazar, but a proposed Leviathan's Hall in Miaren failed.

Miekarova.t: The Light Market is to be built in Essk in Miekarova, with a Merchant Boyar title, though its senator's motion to outlaw privateering on the Bay of Catazar failed.

Mitwold.t: Mentioned in passing: Mitwold's senator proposed the Arcane Inquisitor title and seconded the withdrawn Otterway appraisal.

Morrow.t: The Gloaming Forum, a weirwood-purchasing bourse seat assigned as an Urizen national position, is to be built in Operus, Morrow.

Mournwold.t: A historical report on the Ore Hills Rebellion of 326YE was commissioned, and Mournwold's senator seconded the Legion Engineer amendment.

Necropolis.t: The Senator for Necropolis received 240 thrones to construct Spider's Dream Bridge; the planned white granite fortifications were later removed.

Ossium.t: Mentioned in passing: Ossium was among the territories named in the failed Semmerlak execution motion, and its senator proposed the Axos ambassador election.

Redoubt.t: The Brilliant Star mithril bourse seat's output rose to 28 wains a season for higher upkeep, and the House of Illumination is to be built in Cargo.

Reikos.t: A Counting House sinecure, funded by Highguard benefactors, is to be built in Reikos, creating the Benefactor of High Chalcis to oversee its herb gardens.

Segura.t: Mentioned in passing: Segura's senator proposed the appraisal of the Dry Patrician problem in Madruga and seconded Spider's Dream Bridge.

Semmerholm.t: A Prosperous Counting House folly is to be built in Semmerholm.

Sermersuaq.t: Mentioned in passing: Sermersuaq's senator proposed removing Spider's Dream's fortifications and seconded the Wintermark army funds.

Skarsind.t: Prospectors and human miners will come to the northern hills of Skarsind to work the Imperial Orc mines.

Spiral.t: The League Legacies will supply mana to Spiral's spires, cutting the Senate's seasonal cost from 35 to 5 thrones, though an appraisal of Urizen–League cooperation in Spiral failed.

Tassato.t: Tassato gains a Counting House folly and the Office of the Lantern Wolf sinecure, and its Legacy of Ambition mana now goes to Spiral.

Temeschwar.t: Temeschwar's senator received 44 thrones for tax-providing great works, and its Legacy of Loyalty mana now goes to Spiral.

The Barrens.t: The Rahvin sept in the fangs of the Saltmarsh region were declared foreigners, protected by Imperial law.

Therunin.t: Mentioned in passing: Therunin's senator seconded the League mana motion and proposed the Sarcophan Delves ambassador election.

Upwold.t: Mentioned in passing: Upwold's senator proposed the Legion Engineer amendment and seconded the withdrawn A Fair Price motion.

Volodmartz.t: Mentioned in passing: Volodmartz's senator proposed recognising Thule dominion and seconded the failed Leviathan's Hall.

Weirwater.t: Mentioned in passing: Weirwater was named in the failed Semmerlak execution motion, and its senator proposed the Phoenix Flame.

Zenith.t: A Fair Price, a farm sinecure for the Champion of Prosperity, is to be built in Iteri, and Zenith's senator carried the Warmage amendment.

385YE Winter Solstice Synod judgements.d: Enacted mandates sent missionaries to Asavea's hidden sects, scattered Urizen's sword scholars across the Empire, created the Imperial Orc Bone Pilgrimage, set Freeborn corsairs to escort shipping on the Bay of Catazar, and committed the League and Dawn to the Grand Inspiration of the Way. Highborn and Varushkan armies gained new orders against Cold Sun. Many statements condemned cruelty in the Barrens and the Iron Helms, and urged help for Brass Coast refugees. Ozren de Orzel was recognised as an Exemplar of Pride. The Senator for Sarvos and Doyen Ioseph were revoked, and the virtue fund closed the summit almost empty at 3 rings.

Dawn.t: The Dawnish assembly backed a new Knight Protector of Day against Cold Sun, praised its fleet captains and the Free Folk who joined the nation, challenged its senators and generals over the Barrens, and enacted a mandate committing Dawn to help build the Grand Inspiration of the Way.

Druj.t: The Varushkan assembly declared it time to destroy the Druj, announcing a new army that would light torches at Ratibor's Gate before marching to end their threat; elsewhere priests asked whether the Empire's conduct in the Barrens was any better than the Druj's.

Grendel.t: The Grendel were the target of several judgements on the Bay of Catazar: the enacted Freeborn mandate removed the penalty they imposed on Imperial fleets, while Navarr and Dawn urged their fleets to strike at them and their Asavean allies. The Shuttered Lantern was also asked to investigate alleged contact between Spiral's Urizeni and the Grendel.

Highguard.t: Highborn mandates let all Highguard armies use the Bring Virtue to the Scions and Defence of the Virtuous orders, and urged support for the Imperial Orc Bone Pilgrimage. The assembly condemned the Iron Helms, offered Peerless Kinship to the Marches and announced new Casinean Games, but a call to raise a Grey Guard army was withdrawn.

Imperial Orcs.t: A General Assembly mandate created the Bone Pilgrimage adventure for Imperial Orcs to bring ancestral bones home to Skarsind, and their own mandate claimed authority over questions of orc souls on behalf of the Mournwold orcs. Their priests pledged a year of liao at 1 ring to the Freeborn, and their assembly spoke out for the Rahvin.

Jotun.t: The Freeborn assembly urged the Empire to let the Jotun raise a statue to Avisena i Kharizmi i Guerra, which would also free seven thralls to join the Empire; the Jotun were also recalled as past occupiers of Bregasland.

Navarr.t: The Navarr assembly asked the people to consult their guides on the newly found answer to destroying the vallorn, turned its oaths against the Cold Sun, pledged to defend the Great Forest Orcs and urged wayhouses to protect roads and trods. Calls to end tenured titles failed, and Aneira Exile's End became Voice of Barbs.

The Brass Coast.t: With blight spreading from the Blightheart of Madruga, the Freeborn assembly urged citizens to flee and accepted refuge offered by other nations, while all three Freeborn armies marched home. Its enacted mandate set corsairs to escort Imperial shipping on the Bay of Catazar, and it accepted cheap liao from the Imperial Orcs.

The League.t: An enacted League mandate urged citizens to fund the Grand Inspiration of the Way but blocks mandates for other building projects for a year, while a Pride mandate raised congregation income in Sarvos, Tassato and Temeschwar. The assembly also backed a temple-orphanage in Holberg, removed the Senator for Sarvos and warned of flooding from a curse on the Bay.

The Marches.t: An enacted Marcher mandate pledged to defend the Mournwold orcs against charges of heresy, and another bound the Strong Reeds to Bregasland, giving them extra strength there unless they fail to defend it. The assembly also proposed the Tusks become the Mournwold army and opened an exchange of priests with Urizen.

Thule.t: Navarr thanked the Otkodov scholars who aided the Hacynian research and shared its results with the Thule, while a Varushkan inquisition vindicated the Volodmartz senator's motion over the regions ceded to the Thule, on the basis that it does not recognise their ownership as permanent.

Urizen.t: An enacted Urizen mandate scattered the sword scholars across the Empire, so those at Anvil will be the last of that tradition in Urizen. The assembly offered refuge to Brass Coast refugees, opened Redoubt's Academy of Arms to refugees, sought exploration of returning Spiral to Urizen and revoked Doyen Ioseph.

Varushka.t: An enacted Varushkan mandate let its armies use Bring Virtue to the Scions in Varushkan territories, but bars the assembly from further mandates until Cold Sun is defeated there. Varushka also backed the Imperial Orc Bone Pilgrimage and a new army against the Druj, while the Iron Helms were widely condemned and a move to revoke their general narrowly failed.

Wintermark.t: Two enacted Wintermark mandates urged the nation through a harsh winter: they reward units fighting at home or hunting the Suaq Wastes, and ensure no Sermersuaq settlement goes hungry. Eska Crowspeaker and Yulia Kasimirova Voronov were added to the Chronicle of Heroes, and a bid to strike the magpie as a virtue bird failed.

385YE Winter Solstice Synod judgements.o: At the Winter Solstice 385YE the Imperial Synod raised 227 judgements, dominated by the crises of the Cold Sun scions, the blight in Madruga, the war with the Grendel on the Bay of Catazar, the aftermath of Imperial actions in the Barrens and the new Doctrine of Enlightenment.

Holberg/Ennerlund.t: Ozren de Orzel's pilgrimage to the Pits of Ennerlund, where he laid unquiet ghosts to rest by hearing their stories, was among the signs that saw him recognised as an Exemplar of Pride.

Holberg/Misericorde.t: The League assembly asked that the new weirwood seat in Misericorde, linked to the newly found flaxen pillars, be allocated by League national auction.

Kahraman/Braydon's Jasse.t: The Azure Chorus at Braydon's Jasse will draw larger audiences under the Pride mandate, gaining an extra 108 rings at the Spring Equinox 386YE.

Skarsind/Crow’s Ridge.t: A bid to recognise Dogri Thulebane, defender of Crow's Keep in Crow's Ridge, as an Exemplar of Loyalty failed for lack of a greater majority. The keep's remnants now lie within a Thule fortification in this region.

Spiral/Ankra.t: Urizen urged the spires of Ossuary to look to their fellows in Ankra on how to pressure the League if it backed appraising Spiral before the Reckoning is settled.

Spiral/Cinion.t: Cinion's spires were named alongside Ankra as the Urizeni that Ossuary should consult on pressing for the Reckoning to be completed faithfully.

Spiral/Ossuary.t: Urizen invited the spires of Ossuary to work with Ankra and Cinion to apply pressure if the League supported appraising Spiral early.

Temeschwar/Hanuri.t: Mentioned in passing: Florion von Temeschwar, described as the pride of Hanuri, received a 2-Throne rewarding for helping break the Vyig.

The Barrens/Heart of Peytaht.t: The Navarr assembly pledged the nation's fury against anyone who endangers the Great Forest Orcs, who recently recovered their homes in the Heart of Peytaht.

Volodmartz/Brez.t: The Varushkan assembly urged the people of Brez to flee the Shepherds of Ash with all speed.

Volodmartz/Livardz.t: The vales of Livardz were called on to offer hospitality to Varushkans fleeing the Shepherds of Ash.

Volodmartz/Opascari.t: The vales of Opascari were asked to shelter refugees from Marupa and Brez fleeing the Shepherds of Ash.

Volodmartz/Suvretz.t: The vales of Suvretz were urged to share all that is worthwhile with kin fleeing the Shepherds of Ash.

Astolat.t: Mentioned in passing: a withdrawn Dawnish judgement praised Lady Leysandra de Rondell for seeking a rose from the gardens of the Castle of Thorns, seat of Dawn's kings and queens.

Bay of Catazar.t: The enacted Freeborn mandate set corsairs to escort merchant ships of every nation, removing the Grendel penalty on fleets here. Navarr and Dawnish fleets were urged to fight the Grendel and Asavean warships, and the League warned that a curse to deny enemy fleets the bay would bring significant flooding.

Holberg.t: The League assembly unanimously called for a grand temple-orphanage in Holberg to welcome those displaced by Imperial action, and asked that the new weirwood seat in Misericorde be allocated by League national auction.

Kahraman.t: Kahraman was described as being under emergency conditions and sheltering many Brass Coast refugees, and Urizen asked to recognise Delara i Fijadoz i Guerra as a sword scholar to support refugees.

Karov.t: Threatened by Cold Sun's Blade of Skies, Karov was urged by the Varushkan assembly to aid Imperial armies, and proposals were invited for a hall of fabric arts there. Dawn also called adventurers to end the Deadwood Knight on the Karov–Weirwater border.

Madruga.t: The Dry Patricians' blight spreading from the Blightheart prompted Freeborn calls for Madruga's people to flee, and the Silent Bell was directed to investigate it and its links to the Tutamen family. The Synod also honoured Commonwealth embassy soldiers who died covering the escape of citizens.

Morrow.t: Urizen offered the Temple of the Four Winds in Morrow as shelter and schooling for Brass Coast refugees, and the Prosperity assembly commended the Rising Tide's plans for Morrow, including a ministry selling weirwood for iridescent gloaming.

Otkodov.t: The Navarr assembly thanked the scholars of Otkodov for aiding the Library of Hacynian's research on behalf of the Dragons and welcomed sharing the results with them.

Redoubt.t: The Prelate of Adelmar's Shrine opened the Academy of Arms in Redoubt to all Imperial refugees, a call the Ambition assembly endorsed, and Urizen invited martial sword scholars to debate the Sentinels there.

Sarvos.t: Sarvos sheltered Brass Coast refugees and was warned of flooding from the Bay curse. Its congregations will earn more from art pilgrims under the Pride mandate, and the League revoked its senator for supporting sacrifices to the Semmerlak sovereign.

Segura.t: Mentioned in passing: listed as one of the places where most Brass Coast refugees are currently sheltering.

Skarsind.t: Under enacted mandates, Imperial Orcs will seek ancestral remains across the Empire and bring them home to the Ossuary Temple in Skarsind on the new Bone Pilgrimage. The Ambition assembly also sought to consecrate a site to Thrace, possibly in Skarsind.

Spiral.t: Urizen warned against appraising Spiral before the Reckoning is settled, asked the Empire to explore returning it to Urizen and invited artists to imagine its future. The Shuttered Lantern was to investigate rumoured contact between Spiral's Urizeni and the Grendel, and the League warned of flooding there.

Tassato.t: Tassato's congregations will earn an extra 36 rings from art pilgrims under the Pride mandate, and it was named the best-returning site for a virtue fund counting house, for which funds were approved.

Temeschwar.t: Temeschwar's congregations gain an extra 36 rings from cultural pilgrims under the Pride mandate. Its exemplar Ratibor inspired a new Varushkan army and a rewarding for those who broke the Vyig, and its former bishop's call to appraise Spiral was opposed.

The Barrens.t: Imperial conduct in the Barrens drew wide condemnation, including the destruction of the Montanians, the threat to the Rahvin in the mithril mines and the position of the Black Wind. Assemblies urged diplomacy, and Dawn called several senators and generals to inquisition over its Barrens strategy.

The Semmerlak.t: The League warned that the sovereign Dho'uala is killing travellers across the Semmerlak, and revoked the Senator for Sarvos for backing a proposal to sacrifice people to it.

Volodmartz.t: With Cold Sun's Shepherds of Ash believed to be assaulting Volodmartz and its trods destroyed, the Varushkan assembly urged people to flee and other vales to take them in. Its senator, Desilav, was inquisited over his motion on the ceded northern regions and vindicated.

385YE Winter Solstice interlude.d: Military units could join the Grand Tour tourneys in Dawn. The Guerdon of 350 thrones went to supporters of five armies. Freeborn corsairs could evacuate rebel slaves from Marlien via the Calatropos coast, and Freeborn, Marcher and Winterfolk fleets could hunt monsters in the Sea of Snow from Caitun. The end of the Grendel peace treaty brought raids on southern shipping, while Dho'uala still troubled Semmerlak fleets. Urizen congregations lost authority over the Paragon of Blades. Magistrates disrupted Bregasland, the Icy Maw halved mana in Redoubt and Morrow, and Casinea was cursed. Tharim feasted on Brass Coast resources in exchange for supporting the Fire of the South.

Dawn.t: Dawn's victory celebrations brought the Grand Tour tourneys to Astolat, Semmerholm and Weirwater, but Dawnish fleets again suffered from the menace of Dho'uala in the Semmerlak.

Grendel.t: With the peace treaty ended, independent Grendel raiders preyed on Imperial shipping along the southern coasts, including around Grendel-held Feroz, for an unknown length of time.

Highguard.t: Highguard felt Grendel raids on its fleets, a Whisper Gallery hunt that cut mana output, and business losses from funding Free Folk priests. Its congregations, however, gained liao, votes and income from the Birthplace of the Way, and Casinea was cursed.

Jotun.t: Mentioned in passing: Jotun is not named, though Bregasland, which it held, was disrupted by magistrates sent by the Senate to root out traitors among the households.

The Brass Coast.t: Freeborn corsairs could rescue Asavean rebel slaves and hunt monsters in the Sea of Snow, and Madruga's Atalaya Harbour made fleet upgrades cheaper. Grendel raids and Tharim's black frost, however, hurt Freeborn fleets, mana sites and vervain harvests.

The League.t: League fleets in Sarvos, Spiral and Tassato faced Grendel raids and Holberg's fleets suffered from Dho'uala. League priests of Ambition gained liao and Synod votes, and League business upgrades were cheaper during a grand competition.

Urizen.t: Urizen congregations lost votes and liao for a year after the Sulemaine repudiation. Its fleets suffered Grendel raids, and the Icy Maw halved mana output in Redoubt and Morrow.

Varushka.t: Varushkan fleets once again lost production to the eerie presence of Dho'uala in the Semmerlak.

Wintermark.t: Winterfolk fleets could now sail from Caitun to hunt monsters in the Sea of Snow for weltsilver and other rewards.

385YE Winter Solstice interlude.o: Ahead of the 385YE Winter Solstice, a summary set out the effects of the Autumn Equinox on Imperial military units, fleets and personal resources. These included special adventures, Grendel raids on shipping, curses and rituals on several territories, and shifts in the fortunes of congregations and businesses.

Astolat.t: Astolat hosted part of the Grand Tour, a series of extraordinary tourneys celebrating Dawn's greatest quest.

Bregasland.t: Magistrates descended in force on Bregasland to investigate its households and root out traitors, disrupting every personal resource there until the Winter Solstice.

Casinea.t: A curse brought bad weather to Casinea and froze still pools into mirrors showing the spectres of those the onlookers had wronged.

Feroz.t: Imperial fleets in Feroz suffered from independent Grendel raids. The Atalaya Harbour discount on fleet upgrades would last only while the Freeborn did not control Feroz.

Holberg.t: Holberg's fleets again lost production to the menace of Dho'uala in the Semmerlak.

Madruga.t: The Atalaya Harbour in Madruga made fleet upgrades cost one less wain of weirwood.

Morrow.t: The Icy Maw Devours the Spark of Essence ritual halved the output of every mana site in Morrow this season.

Redoubt.t: The Icy Maw Devours the Spark of Essence ritual halved the output of every mana site in Redoubt this season.

Sarvos.t: Imperial fleets in Sarvos suffered from independent Grendel attacks on their ships after the peace treaty ended.

Sea of Snow.t: With Caitun's port expanded, Freeborn, Marcher and Winterfolk fleets could hunt the Sea of Snow's monsters for weltsilver and rarer prizes such as kraken's ink.

Semmerholm.t: Semmerholm hosted part of the Grand Tour tourneys celebrating the completion of Dawn's greatest quest.

Spiral.t: Imperial fleets in Spiral suffered from independent Grendel attacks on their ships after the peace treaty ended.

Tassato.t: Imperial fleets in Tassato suffered from independent Grendel attacks on their ships after the peace treaty ended.

The Semmerlak.t: The sovereign Dho'uala continued to haunt the Semmerlak with eerie lights and disappearances, raising prices for the Custodian of Ivarsgard Docks and the Harbourmaster of the Semmerlak.

Weirwater.t: Weirwater hosted part of the Grand Tour tourneys celebrating the completion of Dawn's greatest quest.

385YE Winter Solstice winds of fortune.d: Alongside the coronation, the winds cover Senate appraisals on the Spider's Dream Tollbridge and new roads, and responses from eternals to plenipotentiary missives. Cold Sun's scions struck sites across the Empire, with mixed results. Other entries cover the Marchers embracing the Mournwold Orcs, the Doctrine of Enlightenment, the shattering of the sword scholars and Urizen rebels in Spiral. Night Below stirs beneath Varushkan mountains, the Deadwood Knight and a horror trouble the Semmerlak, and the Great Library of Hacynian has found a way to end the vallorn. Further items cover rewards for those who broke the vyig, a Grendel-hostile Bay, an auction for Emperor Barabbas's fleet, the Free Folk preparing to join the Empire, trade conditions and the outcomes of the Autumn conjunctions.

Dawn.t: Dawn's Lady Clarice Novarion saw the Doctrine of Enlightenment replace Human Destiny. Residents of Weirwater face the Deadwood Knight, and Dawn is named among those offered the General of Day's boons.

Druj.t: The Druj were driven out of the Barrens by the Golden Sun, and their plan at the Well of Tears was foiled. They still hold the Vate's Shelter in Sarangrave and escaped into Brocéliande from Murderdale.

Grendel.t: Grendel armadas have struck back at the Brass Coast in the Bay of Catazar, targeting and boarding fleets, and their port of Oran remains closed to Imperial ships.

Highguard.t: The Highborn are called to arms against Cold Sun around the Granite Pillar in Bastion. Their priests are helping the Imperial Orcs strengthen their nation, and Highguard is among the nations invited to bid for Barabbas's fleet.

Imperial Orcs.t: Highborn priests identified six ways for the septs of Skarsind to strengthen the young nation. The Halls of Worth were saved from the scions, and several Imperial Orcs are named among the champions who broke the vyig.

Jotun.t: Imperial heroes captured the Blue Eel banner and Mathilda Fisher in Tromsa, recovered a Jotun cache and drove off a Jotun warband. Elsewhere, the Lasambrian Jotun have invaded Kahraman.

Navarr.t: The expanded Great Library of Hacynian has revealed a way to destroy the vallorn. Scions ravaged the trods in Hercynia, and the Great Forest Orcs returned home in the Barrens with the Quiet Step's aid.

The Brass Coast.t: The blight has devoured the Great Grasses of Madruga, and Grendel are raiding Freeborn fleets in the Bay. The Freeborn Assembly is seeking to take the fight back, and the nation is invited to bid for Barabbas's fleet.

The League.t: The League saw the end of the great city contest and consolidated its hold on Spiral despite Urizen rebels. Its businesses promise rewards to the League citizens who helped break the vyig.

The Marches.t: The Marches welcomed the first Marcher Orcs and face bad blood in Bregasland as Mathilda Fisher arrives. The heralds have located the Vorpal Sword of Tom Drake.

Thule.t: Mentioned in passing: Thule businesswarlocks are among the visitors to Anvil looking for investors.

Urizen.t: The Urizen assembly shattered the sword scholars and the Temple of the Four Winds, while rebel Urizen hold out in Spiral. A Winter curse has settled on Morrow and Redoubt, and Varushkan miners seek Urizen lightstones.

Varushka.t: Night Below has grown more active beneath Volodmartz and Miekarova and has a proposal concerning the Shepherds of Ash. Karov faces the Deadwood Knight, and several Varushkans are listed among the vyig-breakers.

Wintermark.t: The Wintermark assembly has an opportunity to act against threats from the dark and cold, and Mathilda Fisher is to be delivered to the Wintermark camp. Wintermark fleets gain a bonus trading with Faraden's port of Caitun.

385YE Winter Solstice winds of fortune.o: The Winter Solstice 385YE winds of fortune set out the situations facing the Empire as Empress Vesna Borkovna Prochnost prepared for her coronation. They range from the Madruga blight and Grendel raids in the Bay of Catazar to Cold Sun's attacks, the Barrens bloodletting and a newly found way to destroy the vallorn.

Bastion/Sybella Cross.t: At the Broken Holt, scions claimed the ruins of the White Tower and constructed a fortification.

Bregasland/Gravenmarch.t: At Harry's Field, scions claimed the Still Rock, disrupting Graven Rock and bringing forth another magical army.

Hahnmark/Kronemark.t: At White Owl Fields, scions were prevented from slaughtering the Augurs of the Opalescent Gloaming.

Hercynia/Northpines.t: At Danwyn's Coppice, scions ravaged the trods, cutting Hercynia's vallorn off from the network.

Karov/Wieliczka.t: At the Thicket of Nieshka, scions slaughtered the workers and claimed a large amount of mithril.

Karsk/Nitrost.t: At Gulgisaz, scions were stopped and the vale of Veresk still stands.

Morrow/Peregro.t: At Seneca's Meadow, scions were stopped before they could unleash the destructive power of the Peregro hot springs.

Mournwold/Green March.t: At Golden Hoof Farm, Bloodcrow Knott held a cordial conversation with Hap the Soft.

Mournwold/Southmoor.t: At Crowned Trees, Brother Martin Orchard's meeting with Quiet Charlie was disrupted, and Charlie escaped.

Redoubt/Tomari.t: From Magnus' Thicket, scions entered the Brilliant Star, took a large amount of mithril and permanently altered the mines.

Sarangrave/Nesustak Forest.t: At the Queen's Claim, the attempt to reclaim the Vate's Shelter failed, and it remains with the Druj ghulai.

Sarvos/Cigno.t: At Bertram's Square, the Dramaturgists of the League resolved a debt peacefully.

Segura/Lucksprings.t: On the Path to Cerevado, scions raided the Cerevado Nets and stole a large amount of ilium.

Skarsind/Gildermark.t: At Oathwright's Glade, scions were prevented from destroying the Halls of Worth.

Temeschwar/Vardstein Vale.t: In Polseg Woods, the Company of the Torch was brought decisively to justice.

The Barrens/Murderdale.t: At Hugh's Sward, the attempt to slay the Lady of the Dappled Trees failed as the Druj and Yaw'nagrah's lieutenant escaped into Brocéliande.

Tromsa/Icewood.t: At the Grove of Einar, Grimnir's Glass was recovered.

Tromsa/Rikskog.t: At Fniskard Copse, Imperial heroes recovered a Jotun cache.

Tromsa/Tromsdalen.t: At Nordbotn, a Jotun warband was driven off from the palisade, preventing reinforcements reaching Oksenesfestsal.

Upwold/The Heath.t: At Tom's Dale, heroes went to deal with the Drakes Dozen; the outcome is unknown.

Bastion.t: Highborn armies defend the Granite Pillar against Cold Sun, and scions claimed the ruins of the White Tower and built a fortification there.

Bay of Catazar.t: Grendel are targeting and boarding fleets in the Bay. The Duke of Arbonne will auction rights to Barabbas's fleet, inviting nations bordering the Bay.

Bregasland.t: Bregasland is divided between supporters and opponents of Mathilda Fisher while magistrates hunt collaborators. Scions also seized the Still Rock in Gravenmarch.

Brocéliande.t: Mentioned in passing: the Druj and the lieutenant of Yaw'nagrah escaped into Brocéliande from Murderdale.

Casinea.t: Mentioned in passing: the people of Casinea are among those tagged as affected by the winds of magic.

Hahnmark.t: Scions were prevented from slaughtering the Augurs of the Opalescent Gloaming at White Owl Fields in Kronemark.

Hercynia.t: Scions ravaged Hercynia's trods, cutting the vallorn there off from the network.

Kahraman.t: Mentioned in passing: the Lasambrian Jotun invasion of Kahraman may explain fewer traders arriving from Faraden.

Karov.t: The Deadwood Knight's challenge to Karov has gone wrong, and scions slaughtered workers in Wieliczka to claim mithril.

Karsk.t: Scions were stopped at Gulgisaz in Nitrost, and the vale of Veresk still stands.

Madruga.t: The blight has consumed the Great Grasses, making the region uninhabitable, and the rains containing it may not continue.

Miekarova.t: The sovereign Night Below lurks beneath Miekarova's mountains, threatening miners who seek better illumination.

Morrow.t: A potent Winter curse lies on Morrow. Scions were stopped from unleashing the Peregro hot springs, and an agent of the Rising Tide returned from Morrow with a proposal for the Basilisk of the Bourse.

Mountains of the Moon.t: Mentioned in passing: Axos remain angry about Imperial involvement in the failure of their venture there with the Grendel.

Mournwold.t: The Mournwold Orcs have begun joining the Marches. Quiet Charlie escaped at Southmoor, and a cordial talk took place with Hap the Soft in Green March.

Redoubt.t: A Winter curse weighs on Redoubt, and scions claimed mithril from the Brilliant Star mines in Tomari, permanently altering them.

Salt Flats of Sanath.t: The conjunction to capture Sarra Grubfeast here was not taken, and her fate is unknown.

Sarangrave.t: The Vate's Shelter in Nesustak Forest remains held by the Druj ghulai.

Sarvos.t: A debt was balanced peacefully at Bertram's Square in Cigno.

Segura.t: Scions raided the Cerevado Nets in Lucksprings and stole a large amount of ilium.

Skarsind.t: Highborn priests identified opportunities for each of Skarsind's six septs, and scions were prevented from destroying the Halls of Worth.

Spiral.t: Spiral remains split between the League and Urizen rebels, some of whose demands have been met while others are still being negotiated.

Temeschwar.t: The Company of the Torch was brought decisively to justice in Polseg Woods in Vardstein Vale.

The Barrens.t: The Barrens are soaked in blood after the Druj expulsion and the slaughter of several orc factions, and the Well of Tears was warded against the Druj.

The Semmerlak.t: A horror lurks in the Semmerlak, and her servants exact a grim tithe from those crossing the lake.

Tromsa.t: Imperial heroes captured the Blue Eel banner and Mathilda Fisher here, recovered Grimnir's Glass and a Jotun cache, and drove off a Jotun warband.

Upwold.t: Heroes went to deal with the Drakes Dozen at Tom's Dale on the Heath; the outcome is unknown.

Volodmartz.t: Night Below has grown more active beneath Volodmartz's mountains, endangering miners.

Weirwater.t: The Deadwood Knight's challenge to the people of Weirwater has been met, but something seems to have gone wrong.

385YE Winter Solstice winds of war.d: Peace with the Grendel ended. Sarvos, Redoubt, Necropolis and the City of Masks braced for attack, but the whole Grendel armada fell on Madruga. Siroc was taken, then burned by their Asavean allies, and the territory was lost to the Empire, though not claimed by the orcs. Imperial armies headed for Mareave, four armies pursued separate courses in the Barrens, and the Jotun war in the west continued. Sentinel Gate opportunities included rescuing trapped Dawnish knights-errant in Greenweald, performing the Dance of Navarr and Thorn at the Circle of Rot in Sweetglades, and stopping heralds across several territories. The generals would choose two of three battle opportunities: two in Madruga and one in Mareave.

Dawn.t: The Emerald Dogs, Dawnish knights-errant sent by Earl Phillip Borpusip, were trapped by vallornspawn in Greenweald, and the Knight of the Greenwood, Percival Summerstrong, was charged with their rescue. A further conjunction sought to stop heralds in Astolat.

Grendel.t: Having ended the peace, the Grendel sent their entire armada against Madruga, took Siroc and overran the territory, while Imperial forces prepared to fight them at Coursmouth, Naris, Uccelini and in Mareave.

Highguard.t: The faithful defended the White City in Bastion against Cold Sun's monstrous attackers, and the Necropolis chapters stood ready against the Grendel. The Champion of Loyalty was charged with reclaiming or destroying Oath-heart at Sybella Cross.

Imperial Orcs.t: Mentioned in passing: listed with a small force weight available for the coming battles.

Jotun.t: Jotun warriors continued a tense contest of manoeuvre with Imperial soldiers in the west, and conjunctions were offered to stop the Jarl of Greenwall in Skallahn and Jotun forces in Liathaven.

Navarr.t: After Cold Sun damaged Therunin's trods, the stridings found the Circle of Rot regio in Sweetglades. The Spear of the Seven was charged with distracting the vallornspawn so the Archmage of Spring's coven could perform the Dance of Navarr and Thorn.

The Brass Coast.t: The Freeborn lost Madruga as Siroc, the City of Thousand Sails, was taken by the Grendel and burned by their Asavean allies. The Azure Sutannir was charged with rescuing Erdene Bataguin in Kahraman.

The League.t: Sarvos, reinforced by the Ballagruh garrison, and the City of Masks, guarded by the Wolves of War and the Fire of the South, both braced for Grendel retribution that had not come by the Solstice.

The Marches.t: Marcher lands were the focus of a conjunction to stop heralds at Sammy's Paling in Upwold, and Marcher armies held particular strategic advantages when fighting in their home territories.

Thule.t: Mentioned in passing: the Ambassador to Otkodov was named as responsible for rescuing captives on the Siroc Plains in Madruga.

Urizen.t: Sentinels from Cargo joined the citadels and spires of Redoubt in watching for Grendel ships near the new port at Elos. The Elosian Architect was charged with defeating the Grendel at the Elosian Grove.

Varushka.t: Varushka was named among the lands suffering the destruction wrought by the scions of Cold Sun, and the Senator for Miekarova was charged with returning villagers to their barrow in Perumaki.

Wintermark.t: Cold Sun's assault reached Hahnmark, and conjunctions were offered to stop heralds in Kronemark and Kallavesa Marsh, while Winterfolk armies continued to fight the Jotun with honour.

385YE Winter Solstice winds of war.o: The Winter Solstice 385YE campaign summary recorded the scions of Cold Sun ravaging the heart of the Empire, manoeuvring against the Jotun in the west, Imperial armies in the Barrens and marching into the Broken Shore, and a Grendel armada taking Madruga, where Siroc was burned and the territory lost to the Empire.

Bastion/Sybella Cross.t: The Champion of Loyalty was charged with reclaiming or destroying Oath-heart at Tamar's Stand.

Brocéliande/Greenweald.t: Surviving Emerald Dogs knights-errant were trapped by vallornspawn here, and the Knight of the Greenwood was to lead a rescue to Crangton Copse.

Hahnmark/Kronemark.t: The Caretaker of New Dunhall was charged with stopping the heralds at Dun's Hurst.

Kahraman/Gambit.t: A conjunction to the Path of Idina sought to rescue Erdene Bataguin.

Kallavesa/Kallavesa Marsh.t: A conjunction to the Road to Masi sought to stop the heralds.

Liathaven/Liaven's Glen.t: A conjunction to the Bawn of Daffyd sought to stop the Jotun.

Madruga/Lightsea.t: The Hakima of Salt and Sand was charged with reclaiming an heirloom at Ezmara's Thicket.

Miaren/Goldglades.t: The Spear of the Seven was charged with stopping the heralds at the Golden Meadow.

Miekarova/Perumaki.t: A largely non-combat conjunction to Wilkza sought to return villagers to their barrow.

Necropolis/Coursmouth.t: The Champion of Courage was charged with defeating the Grendel at Hedra's Meadow.

Necropolis/Hedrossan.t: Mentioned in passing: not named directly. The page describes Necropolis as a whole standing vigilant against the Grendel.

Redoubt/Naris.t: Sentinels from Cargo gathered at Naris to watch for Grendel ships, and the Elosian Architect was charged with defeating the Grendel at the Elosian Grove.

Sarvos/Uccelini.t: The Custodian of Glass Point Cove was charged with defeating the Grendel on the Isle of Quiet.

Skallahn/Greenwall.t: Mentioned in passing: appears only in the title of the Jarl of Greenwall, whom Imperial heroes were asked to stop in Iron Stand.

Skallahn/Iron Stand.t: The Imperial Seer was charged with stopping the Jarl of Greenwall at Hralfstor's Orchard.

Spiral/Screed.t: Mentioned in passing: the thing that squats in Screed fed the fears and dark dreams of the Ballagruh garrison.

Therunin/Sweetglades.t: Vallornspawn massed around the Circle of Rot, where heroes were to distract them while a coven performed the Dance of Navarr and Thorn.

Upwold/The Heath.t: The Custodian of Sutton Stone Quarries was charged with stopping the heralds at Sammy's Paling.

Astolat.t: A conjunction was offered to stop the heralds at the Coppice of Roses in Groveyard, under the Knight-protector of Autumn.

Bastion.t: The faithful of the Empire protected the White City from Cold Sun's monstrous attackers, and a conjunction sought to reclaim or destroy Oath-heart at Tamar's Stand.

Bay of Catazar.t: After the peace collapsed, Imperial sentinels across the Bay watched the sea for the Grendel, whose mastery of the waters the new port at Elos could threaten. Orc pirates attacked merchant vessels before the armada struck Madruga.

Bregasland.t: Mentioned in passing: noted as a place where the Strong Reeds held a strategic advantage until they left the territory.

Brocéliande.t: The Emerald Dogs knights-errant were cut off by vallornspawn in Greenweald, and a rescue was to be mounted through the Sentinel Gate.

Hahnmark.t: Hahnmark was among the lands assailed by the scions of Cold Sun, and a conjunction was offered to stop the heralds at Dun's Hurst.

Kahraman.t: A conjunction was offered on the Path of Idina in Gambit to rescue Erdene Bataguin, under the Azure Sutannir.

Kallavesa.t: A conjunction was offered to stop the heralds on the Road to Masi, under the Woundbinder of the Mark.

Liathaven.t: A conjunction was offered to stop the Jotun at the Bawn of Daffyd, under the Imperial Advisor for the Feni.

Madruga.t: The entire Grendel armada assailed Madruga, took Siroc, which their Asavean allies then burned, and looted the territory, leaving it lost to the Empire but unclaimed by the orcs. Battle opportunities targeted the Lyceum and the Shining Pillar.

Mareave.t: Imperial armies marched down the Apulian Way into the Broken Shore, and a battle opportunity was offered to influence Mareave's complex politics.

Miaren.t: A conjunction was offered to stop the heralds at the Golden Meadow, under the Spear of the Seven.

Miekarova.t: A conjunction was offered to return villagers to their barrow at Wilkza in Perumaki, under the territory's senator.

Mitwold.t: Mentioned in passing: listed as a territory where Imperial armies may billet and Marcher armies hold an advantage.

Morrow.t: Mentioned in passing: noted for the defensive advantage Highborn and Urizen armies hold there against attacks from Zenith.

Mournwold.t: Mentioned in passing: listed as a territory where Marcher armies hold an advantage when fighting.

Necropolis.t: Reumah's Rest and the chapters at Crown's Quay stood vigilant against Grendel attack, and a conjunction was offered to defeat the Grendel at Hedra's Meadow in Coursmouth.

Ossium.t: Mentioned in passing: noted as a place where Varushkan armies may call on the hospitality of the boyars.

Otkodov.t: Mentioned in passing: appears only in the title of the Ambassador to Otkodov, named as responsible for a rescue in Madruga.

Redoubt.t: Sentinels from Cargo came to Naris to join Redoubt's citadels in watching for the Grendel near Elos, and a conjunction was offered to defeat the Grendel at the Elosian Grove.

Sarvos.t: Expecting Grendel retribution, the City of Nets was reinforced by the Ballagruh garrison, though no attack had come by the Solstice. A conjunction was offered to defeat the Grendel on the Isle of Quiet.

Semmerholm.t: Mentioned in passing: the Emerald Dogs set out into the forests south of Semmerholm.

Skallahn.t: A conjunction was offered at Hralfstor's Orchard in Iron Stand to stop the Jarl of Greenwall.

Spiral.t: The Ballagruh garrison marched beneath the shadow lying over Spiral to reinforce Sarvos, troubled by dark dreams.

The Barrens.t: Four Imperial armies operated in the Barrens, each pursuing its own course and profoundly affecting the people they passed.

Therunin.t: After Cold Sun damaged its trods, a Spring regio at the Circle of Rot offered a chance to perform the Dance of Navarr and Thorn, if heroes could distract the vallornspawn massed there.

Upwold.t: A conjunction was offered to stop the heralds at Sammy's Paling on the Heath. Imperial armies may also billet in the territory.

Zenith.t: Mentioned in passing: noted for the advantage Highborn and Urizen armies hold when attacking into it from Morrow.

386YE Autumn Equinox Conclave sessions.d: The Conclave renewed amity with Sadogua, Zakalwe and Barien, but an enmity declaration against the Asavean 'Cowled One' failed. It called on the Senate to build a fane of Sung in Apulian and advised avoiding rituals involving Meraud's feral lions. The orders were sent to Faraden, Axos, the flooded Brass Coast and the spreading marshes of Madruga. Serenius Starsong, Alexander Tallstag and Gaius Starfall i Riqueza took titles. Mana reservoirs and Umbar's Exquisite Visage were interdicted. Two dossiers were bought from the City of Locks for 130 tempest jade. The Gift of the Wily Broker was traded to the Black Sand Circle for Eye of Ruby and Sapphire, and Stag Knight's Glory went to the Thule Ambassador.

Druj.t: Mentioned in passing: the Archmage of Day's statement to Zakalwe said every pearl issued by the Polemarch of Highwatch is accounted for and ready for use on the Druj front.

Grendel.t: The Black Sand Circle in Grendel-held Beoraidh received a copy of The Gift of the Wily Broker in exchange for Eye of Ruby and Sapphire, which the Golden Pyramid grandmaster will receive at the Winter Solstice.

Navarr.t: The Archmage of Night confirmed amity with Sadogua and thanked the eternal for continuing to protect the college of the Lyceum and for boons given to Navarr magicians, with interest expressed in more permanent wards.

Thule.t: The Conclave disseminated the Stag Knight's Glory ritual to the Thule Ambassador to the Empire, funded by Rak Who-Speaks-For-The-Dragons-Undivided.

386YE Autumn Equinox Conclave sessions.o: At the 386YE Autumn Equinox the Imperial Conclave, drawing on a font of 239 mana, passed declarations on eternal relations, order expeditions, appointments, interdictions and ritual disseminations, including a trade of ritual texts with the Black Sand Circle in Mareave.

Mareave/Beoraidh.t: The Black Sand Circle in Beoraidh received The Gift of the Wily Broker and is to provide Eye of Ruby and Sapphire to the Golden Pyramid grandmaster at the Winter Solstice.

Mareave.t: A copy of The Gift of the Wily Broker was created and disseminated to the Black Sand Circle in Mareave as part of a ritual-text exchange agreed with the Golden Pyramid.

386YE Autumn Equinox Imperial elections.d: National elections returned senators for Astolat, Casinea, Hahnmark, Kahraman, Karov, Morrow, Semmerholm, Tassato, Upwold and Volodmartz. The Senate appointed generals for nine armies, with two for the Quiet Step, along with many stewards, custodians and other office holders. The Synod chose Sabella of the Silent Tide as Cardinal of Loyalty with 264 votes and Constanza i Kalamar i Guerra as Cardinal of Pride. The Military Council appointed Natalia 'The Falcon' Barossa as Quartermaster General and strategoi for Highguard, Varushka and Wintermark. Bourse auctions and votes allocated mines, wayleaves and other seats. Tallis Hart received 934 votes as Castellan of Spiral Castle, and Torven Krigerson paid 420 thrones for the Great Pits of Ennerlund.

Dawn.t: Dawn returned two senators: Cerys de Rosier for Astolat and Amicia of the Semmerlak for Semmerholm.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: no Grendel senator or national title appears in these results, and no senator is listed for Mareave.

Highguard.t: Highguard returned Solomon as senator for Casinea, and the Military Council appointed Balaam as Strategos of Highguard.

The Brass Coast.t: The Brass Coast returned Ramos I Inigo I Raqueza as senator for Kahraman.

The League.t: The League returned Cesare Sanguineo Rezia Di Tassato as senator for Tassato.

The Marches.t: The Marches returned Johnny Tailor as senator for Upwold.

Urizen.t: Urizen returned Sejanus of the Scarlet Guard as senator for Morrow.

Varushka.t: Varushka returned Myshki Marishka Letuchaya for Karov and Ostrik Vulpe for Volodmartz, and the Military Council appointed Doubravka Nadjaovna Vanek-Vessely as Strategos of Varushka.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark returned Ruana Markling as senator for Hahnmark, and the Military Council appointed Aeolwulf as Strategos of Wintermark.

386YE Autumn Equinox Imperial elections.o: At the 386YE Autumn Equinox summit, Imperial elections and appointments filled a wide range of titles, including ten senatorial seats, army generalships, Synod positions, Military Council posts and Bourse seats.

Astolat.t: Cerys de Rosier was elected senator for Astolat.

Casinea.t: Solomon was elected senator for Casinea.

Hahnmark.t: Ruana Markling was elected senator for Hahnmark.

Kahraman.t: Ramos I Inigo I Raqueza was elected senator for Kahraman.

Karov.t: Myshki Marishka Letuchaya was elected senator for Karov.

Mareave.t: Mentioned in passing: no senator for Mareave is listed among this summit's election results.

Morrow.t: Sejanus of the Scarlet Guard was elected senator for Morrow.

Semmerholm.t: Amicia of the Semmerlak was elected senator for Semmerholm.

Tassato.t: Cesare Sanguineo Rezia Di Tassato was elected senator for Tassato. Magnus Carolus Sanguino Rezia di Tassato was appointed Steward of the Tassato Mana Exchange.

Upwold.t: Johnny Tailor was elected senator for Upwold.

Volodmartz.t: Ostrik Vulpe was elected senator for Volodmartz.

386YE Autumn Equinox Military Council or.d: The Jotun had seized Southmoor, Greensward, Ore Hills and Chalkdowns and reinstated Jarl Haakon. The Marcher Tusks and Highguard's Granite Pillar stood in defence while Highborn, Marcher, Orc, Dawnish, League and Wintermark armies attacked. The Towerjacks, Citadel Guard and Northern Eagle hurried to Redoubt amid rumours of a Children of Wrecks attack. Imperial forces withdrew from the Brass Coast and Ayereed, leaving the Winter Sun alone in Mareave. In Therunin, Navarr, Varushkan and Dawnish armies struck at the Druj after a costly battle to save Feverwater Steading. General Archavion Wolfborne ordered the Gryphon's Pride to seize the Fangs mine from the Rahvin. Only the Wolves of War, Black Thorns and Iron Helms earned the guerdon.

Dawn.t: The Eastern Sky joined the Mournwold offensive and the Golden Sun kept up its grinding advance in Therunin. General Archavion Wolfborne set the Gryphon's Pride to seize the Fangs from the Rahvin, an act that will bring the full force of the law on him and his captains.

Druj.t: Having failed to destroy Feverwater Steading or rouse the Sweetglades vallorn, the Druj in Therunin faced attacks from four Imperial armies. The Gryphon's Pride's strike on the Rahvin was feared to wreck any hope of peace with other Druj slaves.

Grendel.t: The Empire's probing strike into Ayereed fell back, leaving only the Winter Sun in Mareave. A great Grendel force remained camped on the Madruga coast and Commander Gallum Fiersach still held Mora's Rock in Feroz.

Highguard.t: All three Highborn armies marched on the Mournwold in a crusade invoking Synod judgement 117. The Granite Pillar held a strategic defence while the Seventh Wave force-marched from Ayereed and the Valiant Pegasus advanced on Southmoor.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Autumn Hammers and Summer Storm made a steady conquest against the Jotun in the Mournwold. The Winter Sun fell back to give ground in Mareave and was its only defender against the Grendel.

Jotun.t: Tens of thousands of Jotun held four Mournwold regions under Jarl Haakon and now faced a dozen Imperial armies. It was uncertain whether they would stand, sweep into Bregasland or strike toward Tassato.

Navarr.t: The Black Thorns made a balanced attack in Therunin and earned the guerdon, while Isaella's Dance struck through the Barrens into Eastring with poison thorns. The Quiet Step, under Vesna Borkovna Prochnost, mounted a solid defence of Miaren.

The Brass Coast.t: With Feroz freed, the Burning Falcon and Fire of the South left for a desperate reinforcement of Astolat and the Red Wind Corsairs rested in Tassato. That left no Imperial armies on the uncertain Brass Coast.

The League.t: The Towerjacks dug in at Redoubt, their orders mourning the fall of General Barossa. The Wolves of War made a balanced attack on the Mournwold and earned the guerdon.

The Marches.t: The Tusks stood in strategic defence of the Mournwold while the Bounders and Drakes attacked the Jotun. The Strong Reeds lay low in Bregasland and were the only army standing there against the Jotun.

Urizen.t: The Citadel Guard marched from Morrow to a solid defence of Redoubt, reinforced by League and Varushkan armies against a rumoured Wrecker attack. Meanwhile the Golden Axe came to Zenith.

Varushka.t: In his last orders, General Belakov sent the Golden Axe to give ground in Zenith. The Iron Helms, quickened with cold-meat magic, attacked the Druj in Therunin for the guerdon, and the Northern Eagle harried foes in Redoubt.

Wintermark.t: The Narwhal's Spear sought the foe in the Mournwold while the Green Shield billeted in Upwold. The Bloodcloaks tended the fallen and the Fist of the Mountains read the signs, both in Tassato.

386YE Autumn Equinox Military Council or.o: At the 386YE Autumn Equinox the Imperial generals issued their orders, sending a dozen armies against the Jotun in the Mournwold, three to defend Redoubt and four against the Druj in Therunin. The Gryphon's Pride was ordered to attack the Rahvin of the Barrens despite the Senate's protection of those orcs.

Mournwold/Chalkdowns.t: Chalkdowns was among the regions seized by the Jotun, where the Imperial counter-offensive was now directed.

Mournwold/Greensward.t: Greensward lay under Jotun control after their seizure of the Mourn, facing the Imperial armies massing against them.

Mournwold/Ore Hills.t: Though held by the Jotun, the Ore Hills saw a victory by Imperial heroes that inspired the people of the Mourn to rise.

Mournwold/Southmoor.t: Jotun-held Southmoor was the target of the Seventh Wave, Valiant Pegasus and Bounders as they sought to liberate it.

Therunin/Eastring.t: Isaella's Dance was ordered to strike into Eastring through the Barrens with poison thorns against the Druj.

Therunin/Sweetglades.t: Imperial heroes prevented the Druj from rousing the Sweetglades vallorn, though Spring corruption still crept across the territory.

Astolat.t: The Burning Falcon and Fire of the South marched here in desperate reinforcement, while Isaella's Dance left Astolat for Therunin.

Ayereed.t: The Empire's probing strike fell back from Ayereed, with the Seventh Wave, Winter Sun and Golden Axe all departing.

Bregasland.t: The Strong Reeds lay low here as the only army facing the Jotun, whose enchanted castle rose over Gravenrock, and a Jotun sweep into the territory was feared.

Casinea.t: Mentioned in passing: the Granite Pillar marched from Casinea to the Mournwold.

Feroz.t: Feroz was declared freed and the Imperial armies there departed, but Commander Gallum Fiersach still held the fort of Mora's Rock.

Madruga.t: With Imperial forces withdrawn, Madruga remained split between factions, and a great Grendel force was camped on the fens that were once the Siroc Plains.

Mareave.t: The Winter Sun gave ground in Mareave as its sole defender, wary of Grendel armies following from Ayereed.

Miaren.t: The Quiet Step returned from the Mournwold to mount a solid defence of Miaren.

Mitwold.t: Mentioned in passing: the Drakes, who had smashed ships on the river Meade, marched from Mitwold, and the Autumn Hammers passed through it to the Mournwold.

Morrow.t: Mentioned in passing: the Citadel Guard marched from Morrow to defend Redoubt.

Mournwold.t: With the Jotun holding four regions, a dozen Imperial armies converged on the Mournwold, the Tusks and Granite Pillar defending while the rest attacked.

Ossium.t: Mentioned in passing: the Golden Axe's general listed Ossium among the territories his army had fought in.

Redoubt.t: Storm-wracked Redoubt was reinforced by the Towerjacks, Citadel Guard and Northern Eagle amid rumours of a Children of Wrecks attack.

Tassato.t: The Red Wind Corsairs, Bloodcloaks and Fist of the Mountains recuperated in Tassato, which was thought vulnerable to a Jotun strike.

The Barrens.t: The Gryphon's Pride was ordered to seize the Fangs mine from the Rahvin, whom the Senate had declared protected foreigners, and Isaella's Dance passed through on its way to Therunin.

Therunin.t: After a costly battle to save Feverwater Steading, the Golden Sun, Black Thorns, Isaella's Dance and Iron Helms struck at the Druj amid spreading vallorn corruption.

Upwold.t: The Green Shield billeted in Upwold while the Summer Storm left for the Mournwold.

Zenith.t: The Golden Axe moved to Zenith to give ground, rest and celebrate under its departing general.

386YE Autumn Equinox Senate sessions.d: The treasury stood at 751 thrones and two crowns. Feroz was assigned to the Brass Coast. The Watcher of the Semmerlak was created and elected, and the Overseer of the Gloaming Road and the Keeper of the Crystal Vale were abrogated. Proposals to amend the Crystal Architect and the Keeper of the Cox failed, and the Stipulator of Stipends was struck down as unconstitutional. Funds went to the Diplomatenschloss (125 thrones), the Five Cities Military Academy (100) and Temeschwar's great works (200). New works included the Library of Worth, Last Battle Wayhouse, Landskeeper's Study, Curstag's Way and several sinecures. The Reinos spy network was decommissioned and Empress Vesna drew 250 thrones for the Dawnish army.

Dawn.t: The Challenger in Waiting will continue to be appointed by the Dawnish Assembly, with new duties to measure the Throne's Virtue, and Empress Vesna drew 250 thrones through the Hand of the Chancellor for the continued construction of a Dawnish army.

Druj.t: The Last Battle Wayhouse was commissioned in the Bleaks as a strategic tool against the Druj, providing reconnaissance into Sarangrave, while an appraisal on damaging Mallum army supply was withdrawn.

Grendel.t: The Senate assigned Grendel-held Feroz to the Brass Coast and commissioned an appraisal of how to disrupt relations between each Salt Lord and their allies, while an Ambassador to the Grendel will be appointed at the Winter Solstice.

Highguard.t: A monument celebrating the work to end discrimination against the lineaged in Highguard and the wider Empire was built in Bastion, while the proposed conversion of Reikos's Keeper of the Cox into the Keeper of the Watch failed.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Imperial Orcs were given the Bronze Bowls of the Three Seasons, to be first elected at the Winter Solstice, and funded the Library of Worth folly in Skarsind to preserve a word and symbol each season.

Jotun.t: The Imperial Spymaster announced that the Empire's spy network in Jotun-held Reinos would be decommissioned over the coming season, citing leaked secrets.

Navarr.t: The Generals of Navarr will appoint the keeper of the new Last Battle Wayhouse, two artefacts became regalia for the Quiet Step and Black Thorns generals, the Black Thorns received the Guerdon, and Thornsong House began research into a tonic against vallorn miasma.

The League.t: League cities gained substantial investment: 100 thrones for the Five Cities Military Academy, 200 for Temeschwar's great works, Curstag's Way in Spiral, the Open Fan Cicisbeo Academy in Sarvos and continued work on the Garden City of Holberg.

The Marches.t: The Marches gained the Landskeeper's Study in Upwold, the Hartford Brewery in Stockmarch and a Bounders Hall in Meade, with an appraisal passed to expand the Upwold Seed Exchange.

Urizen.t: The Temple of the Four Winds was converted to a monastery, the Cascade of Living Flame was built in Morrow, and the bid to make the Crystal Architect an Imperial title failed, while the Golden Cascade proposal was withdrawn.

Varushka.t: The Varushkan Assembly will now appoint the Grieftender of the Forgotten, the Bone Hives were expanded and volhovs will make bequests to the new Watcher of the Semmerlak, though the Gallery of Memories failed.

Wintermark.t: The Strategos of Wintermark now holds the Vale's Might mana sinecure for ten crystals a season, and new sinecures were built at Floerstrand in Sermersuaq and the Proud Quill Parcel in Hahnmark.

386YE Autumn Equinox Senate sessions.o: At the Autumn Equinox 386YE the Senate passed a large slate of motions, including the assignment of Feroz to the Brass Coast, a ban on hunting turtles in the Bay of Catazar and the creation of the Watcher of the Semmerlak. A long list of new constructions, funding disbursals, appointments and research projects was also passed or announced.

Hahnmark/Wood Heath.t: The Keeper of the Crystal Vale was abrogated and the Vale's Might mana sinecure here now supports the Strategos of Wintermark.

Morrow/Peregro.t: The Cascade of Living Flame, a ten-wain mithril mana sinecure, was constructed in Peregro.

Upwold/Ashbrook.t: The Landskeeper's Study mana ministry was built in Oakwood, its Keeper appointed annually by Marcher senators to spread knowledge of farm enchantment.

Bastion.t: A monument to those who worked against discrimination of the lineaged was constructed in Sybella, Sybella's Cross, to Lady Josephine's design.

Feroz.t: The Senate assigned the territory of Feroz, then held by the Grendel, to the Brass Coast.

Hahnmark.t: The Vale's Might sinecure in Wood Heath passed to the Strategos of Wintermark, and the Proud Quill Parcel herb sinecure was built in Kalpaheim.

Mitwold.t: A Bounders Hall was built in Meade, funded by the houses of Talbot and Mudd, creating the Bailiff of Meade and a place for Marcher beaters to send their units.

Morrow.t: The Cascade of Living Flame, a self-funded mana sinecure appointed by Urizen senators, was built in Peregro.

Reikos.t: A proposal to turn the Keeper of the Cox into the Keeper of the Watch, guarding the Grove of Golden Cox, failed.

Reinos.t: The Imperial Spymaster announced that the spy network in Reinos would be dismantled over the coming season.

Spiral.t: Curstag's Way, a Grand Highway linking Redoubt, Spiral and Mareave, was constructed as a great work in Spiral.

The Barrens.t: The Last Battle Wayhouse was built in the Bleaks, and a statue of the White Bear was raised in the ruins of the Towers of the Dawn in Dawnguard.

Upwold.t: The Landskeeper's Study was built in Ashbrook and the Hartford Brewery in Stockmarch, while an appraisal was passed to expand the Upwold Seed Exchange.

386YE Autumn Equinox Synod judgements.d: The General Assembly upheld Sabella of the Silent Tide's veto (2880-140), so the ban on preaching in Asavea did not become law. Many assemblies pledged support and funds for the Asavean effort. Highguard, the League and Varushka issued mandates committing themselves to Navarr's war on the vallorn. Several nations sent patrols against Druj beachheads. Cardinals who accepted Axou hallowings of false virtues were condemned or called to inquisition. The Ore Hills rebels and Ravadi Founder's Dance were recognised as exemplars. Marcher and Freeborn farmers were sent to help Mareave. Twenty-four appointments were made. Rewardings exhausted the Virtue Fund, leaving several upheld rewards unpaid.

Dawn.t: Dawn's mandate set the Vigilant to patrol the Barrens against the Druj. Its assembly urged troubadours to preach to the Barrens' inhabitants or drive them out, and called on the Dawnish to settle the empty lands. The Highborn invited Dawnish troubadours to teach at Bastion, and the assembly pledged to join Navarr against the vallorn.

Druj.t: Urizen, Dawn, Navarr and Varushka sent patrols that make Druj beachheads in Morrow, Zenith, the Barrens, Therunin and Ossium harder to claim. Navarr's assembly pledged to keep fighting them in Therunin, while the General Assembly told priests to challenge cries of "Death to the Druj".

Grendel.t: Urizen's assembly warned Redoubt to prepare for attack by the Grendel and the Children of Wrecks. The Vigilance assembly urged pilgrims in Mareave to root out those working in Grendel interests. A penance condemned Raine Tealeaf for once conspiring to aid the Grendel against Spiral.

Highguard.t: A Highborn greater-majority mandate committed Highguard to fighting the vallorn: the grey pilgrims stop walking the trods, and the nation can support four armies instead of three. The assembly also offered peerless kinship to help Navarr raise an army, called for the Thundering Tide to be reborn, and summoned several Highborn to inquisition for ignoring field commanders' orders.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Imperial Orc assembly invited Urizen into Mareave to recover lost histories. Its mandate sent the Illarawm to open peaceful talks with the Brine Turtle elders. Marcher and Freeborn farmers were dispatched to help make the territory's land flourish.

Jotun.t: Navarr's assembly rejected two statements refusing to change how they fight the Jotun, but upheld the Black Scar's pride in their deeds. Marcher and Varushkan judgements urged resistance to the Jotun conquest of the Mournwold and the defence of Bregasland.

Navarr.t: Navarr's war on the vallorn drew support from Highguard, the League, Varushka, Dawn and Urizen, and Navarr resolved to stand together on that long road. Its mandate will defend Therunin's borders once the territory is reclaimed. Its assembly embraced the Great Forest Orcs and backed the Throne taking control of the Quiet Step.

The Brass Coast.t: The Freeborn praised their corsairs smuggling preachers into Asavea and asked for safe passage home for the Asavean priests of the Temple of the Black Bull. They warned Quzar to avoid Tharim's heralds and urged that swamped Madruga be mapped first. A mandate sending Freeborn farmers to Mareave costs every Brass Coast congregation a rank of production.

The League.t: The League's mandate committed it to aiding Navarr against the vallorn, and the Highborn invited League bishops to teach at Bastion. The assembly celebrated 250 years of Holberg in the Empire, backed a Faraden trading enclave in Holberg, and invited the Sand Fishers to Anvil. It also castigated Senator Gulia of Sarvos for voting to ban preaching in Asavea.

The Marches.t: Marcher priests urged Bregasland to fortify and offered Alderly's hospitality to soldiers resisting the Jotun. They warned of Agramant's servants in Upwold and Mitwold and revoked Hal Talbot as Senator for Mitwold. Their mandate sent farmers to Mareave at the cost of congregation production at home.

Thule.t: Mentioned in passing: Thule is not named on the page; it is linked only through its hold on part of Ossium, whose borders Varushkan patrols now guard.

Urizen.t: Urizen's mandate set patrols on the borders of Morrow and Zenith against the Druj, reducing taxation by ten thrones. The assembly warned Redoubt of a Grendel threat, accepted the Imperial Orcs' invitation to recover Urizeni histories in Mareave, and pledged magical support for a Navarr army.

Varushka.t: Varushkan mandates committed the nation to aiding Navarr against the vallorn, turned the Iron Helms away from cruelty towards dark magics and curses, and set patrols on Ossium's borders. The assembly also called the Ketsov family to inquisition and urged the faithful not to mourn the mythical Vardas.

Wintermark.t: The Wintermark assembly refused to back Navarr to the exclusion of all else, and instead urged its people to provision their halls for hard winters ahead. Jorma Steelhail and Empress Britta were added to the Chronicle of Heroism, and the Suaq pledged to seek weregild for any harm done to the hylje.

386YE Autumn Equinox Synod judgements.o: At the Autumn Equinox 386YE the Imperial Synod raised 216 judgements, most notably vetoing the Senate's ban on preaching the Way in Asavea by greater majority and stripping Vardas of his recognition as a paragon of Vigilance.

Holberg/Misericorde.t: The Sand Fishers were praised as guardians of the Flaxen Pillars of Misericorde, for repaying their sawmill loan and for making a home there. The Prince of the Misericorde Market joined the invitation for them to come to Anvil.

Holberg/Rebeshof.t: Mentioned in passing: the Rebeshof Roadwarden was among those inviting the Sand Fishers to Anvil.

Mareave/Beoraidh.t: A rewarding to fund a shrine of the Way in Beoraidh, aimed at bringing that small foreign nation to the faith, was not upheld.

Mareave/Icarion.t: Mentioned in passing: the region is not discussed; Icarion appears only in the name of the priest Vigilance Athan Icarion.

Mournwold/Alderly.t: House Leveret and Alderly, never held as thralls under the Jotun, offered a bed and a bowl to any Imperial soldier resisting the Jotun.

Mournwold/Ore Hills.t: The leaders of the 326YE Ore Hills rebellion were recognised as exemplars of Pride, and Varushka celebrated the miners' courage against the Jotun.

Ossium/Webwood.t: The Webwood was excluded from Varushka's border patrols. The Ketsov family were called to inquisition over their actions towards the Trudniki of the Webwood.

Bastion.t: League bishops and Dawnish troubadours were invited to teach at the Holy City in Bastion on its completion. A Marcher mandate urging support for it was not enacted because of the Vardas revelations.

Bregasland.t: The Marcher assembly urged Bregasland's citizens to fortify against the enemy by breaking ditches, flooding fields, blocking roads and spreading the swamp.

Feroz.t: The Freeborn assembly asked their generals to grant the Asavean priests of the Temple of the Black Bull in Feroz safe passage home.

Holberg.t: The League celebrated 250 years of Holberg in the Empire and appointed a new Mistress of Ceremonies. It backed a Faraden trading enclave in the city and invited the Sand Fishers of north-western Holberg to Anvil.

Kahraman.t: The Freeborn welcomed Imperial and Faraden pilgrims to the Azure Chorus and asked the Azure Sutannir to protect travellers there.

Madruga.t: The Freeborn assembly warned the people of Quzar to avoid Tharim's heralds. It also urged that the swamp now covering much of southern Madruga be mapped before anyone tries to reclaim it.

Mareave.t: Marcher and Freeborn farmers were sent to help the territory's agriculture, and Imperial Orc Illarawm were sent to open talks with the Brine Turtles. Urizen was invited to recover Urizeni histories, and the Vigilant were urged to root out Grendel agents.

Mitwold.t: The Marcher assembly warned of Agramant's servants and the Stone Circle in Mitwold, and revoked Hal Talbot as its senator. Its congregations suffer a rank penalty as farmers leave for Mareave.

Morrow.t: An Urizen mandate set the Vigilant to patrol Morrow's borders, making a Druj beachhead harder to claim.

Mournwold.t: Judgements lamented the Jotun conquest of the Mournwold. The leaders of the 326YE Ore Hills rebellion were recognised as exemplars of Pride, and Alderly offered shelter to soldiers resisting the Jotun.

Ossium.t: A Varushkan mandate set patrols on Ossium's borders, other than the Webwood, against the Druj. The Ketsov family were called to inquisition over their conduct in the territory.

Redoubt.t: Urizen's assembly told the people of Redoubt to watch the coast for the Children of Wrecks and the Grendel and to guard the Ribbon of Salt and Evenstar. Adelmar's Shrine there was offered as a teaching place for every weapon style.

Reikos.t: The Highborn resolved to watch for the right moment to repair the Unbound Steel Hall of Lost Chapters, which was destroyed by scions of Cold Sun.

Spiral.t: The Silent Bell was directed to investigate the Hand of Dumon around the Black Plateau. Raine Tealeaf was given penance for plotting to let Spiral fall to the Grendel, and the League's Reckoning negotiation with Urizen over Spiral was put to inquisition.

Tassato.t: Mentioned in passing: donations to the Virtue Fund were received at Tassato's counting house.

The Barrens.t: Dawn's mandate put patrols on the Barrens' borders against the Druj. The Dawnish assembly called for preaching to its inhabitants, or driving them out, and for settling its empty lands, while a penance criticised the Throne's veto of the Rahvin treaty.

Therunin.t: With Therunin under Druj conquest, Highguard offered peerless kinship to help Navarr raise an army there and was asked to guide its restless souls. A Navarr mandate will patrol its borders once it is reclaimed.

Upwold.t: The Marcher assembly raised the hue and cry against Agramant's servants and the Stone Circle in Upwold. Its congregations suffer a rank penalty as farmers leave for Mareave.

Zenith.t: An Urizen mandate set the Vigilant to patrol Zenith's borders, making a Druj beachhead harder to claim.

386YE Autumn Equinox event schedule.d: Eight nations held senatorial elections in their camps on Saturday afternoon, each by its own method. Examples include the Brass Coast auction, the Highguard inquisition of candidates, the Urizen demos and the Wintermark jars. Tally of the Votes elections for national titles ran from 3:30pm to 5:30pm across eight nations. The Marches' Singing Caves Bourse seat had been taken by barbarians, so its winner would serve one season and receive only the production already retrieved. Other scheduled events included battles off Anvil on Saturday and Sunday, several Senate sessions, the Imperial Bourse auction, Grandmaster elections, the Inquisition of Brother Luke and the Balancing of Ephisis' Scale.

Dawn.t: Dawn elected senators for Semmerholm and Astolat at 2:30pm, immediately after the tourney. It also held a Tally of the Votes at Glory Square for the Castellan of Spiral Castle and the Reeve of Boar's Market.

Highguard.t: Highguard began its inquisition of candidates for the Casinea senatorship at 2:00pm.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Imperial Orcs held a Tally of the Votes at the Fire Pit at 5:30pm to elect the Legion Engineer and the Preceptor of the Skarsind College of Warcasting.

Navarr.t: Navarr held a Tally of the Votes at the Standing Circle at 5:30pm to elect the Thornsinger. A Thorns Collective meeting was also scheduled in the Military Council tent.
