The Brass Coast.t: The Brass Coast began its auction for the Kahraman senatorship at 2:00pm. At the Waypoint it held a Tally of the Votes for the Red Depths, the Mistress of the Dust Parador and the Dhomiro of the Cinnabar Hills.

The League.t: The League elected the senator for Tassato, with the presentation of collected bonds at 3:30pm.

The Marches.t: Marcher landowners gathered at 1:30pm to elect Upwold's senator. A Tally at the Community Hall elected the Singing Caves, the Alder of Meade and the Master of the Root and Stem; the Singing Caves seat had fallen to barbarians, so it carried only one season's retrieved production.

Urizen.t: Urizen's demos for the Morrow senatorship ran from 1:00pm to 1:45pm, and the Brilliant Star was elected by Tally near the Net of Heaven. An Urizen Magician's Meeting was also held on Friday.

Varushka.t: Varushka began questioning candidates for the Volodmartz and Karov senatorships at 1:45pm. At the Central Hearth it elected the Eternal Shafts of Time, the Bargainer of the Iron Tower and the Tolvoli Butcher by Tally.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark placed jars down for 30 minutes from 2:00pm to elect Hahnmark's senator. At the Tree of Names it elected the Pride of Ikka's Tears and the Keeper of the Runegrott.

386YE Autumn Equinox event schedule.o: The Civil Service published the timetable for the Autumn Equinox 386YE summit. It listed national senatorial elections, Tally of the Votes elections for national titles, and the Friday-to-Sunday schedule of Senate, Military Council, Conclave, Bourse, Synod, Academy and militia sessions.

Astolat.t: Astolat's senator was elected by Dawn at 2:30pm, ahead of the next regular election for the seat at the Winter Solstice 386YE.

Casinea.t: Casinea's senator was chosen through a Highguard inquisition of candidates beginning at 2:00pm.

Hahnmark.t: Hahnmark's senator was elected by Wintermark's jar vote, with jars placed down for 30 minutes from 2:00pm.

Kahraman.t: Kahraman's senatorship was decided by Brass Coast auction beginning at 2:00pm.

Karov.t: Karov's senator was elected through Varushkan questioning of candidates from 1:45pm, ahead of the next regular election for the title at the Summer Solstice 387YE.

Morrow.t: Morrow's senator was chosen by an Urizen demos held between 1:00pm and 1:45pm.

Semmerholm.t: Semmerholm's senator was elected by Dawn at 2:30pm, immediately after the tourney.

Skarsind.t: Mentioned in passing: the Preceptor of the Skarsind College of Warcasting was among the titles elected in the Imperial Orc Tally of the Votes.

Spiral.t: Mentioned in passing: the Castellan of Spiral Castle was among the titles elected in the Dawnish Tally of the Votes.

Tassato.t: Tassato's senator was elected by the League, with the presentation of collected bonds at 3:30pm.

Upwold.t: Upwold's senator was elected when Marcher landowners gathered at 1:30pm.

Volodmartz.t: Volodmartz's senator was elected through Varushkan questioning of candidates beginning at 1:45pm.

386YE Autumn Equinox interlude.d: Mandates opened opportunities to hunt Agramant followers. League units could do so in Holberg under Kanute Adelaar van Holberg, and units across the Empire under Jared of the Sentinels Tower, though that search cost every business and farm 18 rings. Fleets could race under Rhianos's challenge, smuggle Way missionaries into Asavea, or harass the Asavean blockade of Sumaah. The Guerdon, set at 250 thrones, went only to units supporting the Wolves of War. Urizen citizens went to help the Marcher harvest while Marcher priests travelled to Urizen. The Serpent's Curse weakened Urizen congregations, Sermersuaq prospered, and Dho'uala continued to hinder Dawnish and Varushkan fleets.

Dawn.t: Dawnish fleets continued to suffer a one rank production penalty while the sovereign Dho'uala haunted the Semmerlak.

The League.t: League military units could join Kanute Adelaar van Holberg's hunt for the Agramant cannibal conspiracy in Holberg. Holberg's fleets are now free of Dho'uala's penalty following Ivana Petara Vodjavic's mandate.

Urizen.t: Urizen citizens left their work to help the Marcher harvest, halving the Doyen of the Spires' codification speed. Visiting Marcher priests boosted Urizen congregations, but the Serpent's Curse cost them two votes and one liao each, and Urizen fleets were barred from thwarting the blockade.

Varushka.t: Varushkan fleets continued to suffer Dho'uala's one rank production penalty and were excluded from the effort to disrupt the Asavean blockade of Sumaah.

Wintermark.t: The people of Sermersuaq came together against the harsh winter and Agramant's schemes, so every personal resource there gains 22 extra rings until the Winter Solstice.

386YE Autumn Equinox interlude.o: Between the Summer Solstice and Autumn Equinox 386YE, a summary set out the season's special opportunities and Empire-wide effects. These included hunts for followers of Agramant, fleet adventures, and a series of mandates and curses affecting resources, congregations and fleets.

Holberg.t: League units could hunt the Agramant cannibal conspiracy in Holberg, with a chance to bring it down at the Autumn Equinox if enough strength is committed. Holberg's fleets no longer suffer Dho'uala's penalty.

Sermersuaq.t: Sermersuaq's people united in defiance of winter and Agramant, granting every personal resource there an extra 22 rings until the Winter Solstice 386YE.

The Semmerlak.t: The sovereign Dho'uala continued to haunt the Semmerlak with eerie lights and disappearances. The Harbourmaster of the Semmerlak still cannot buy ilium and pays more for weirwood.

386YE Autumn Equinox winds of fortune.d: Rane Shard-Bearer delivered the Throne's address. Navarr mobilised against the vallorn, with League and Varushkan mandates in support. The Lepidean Library's claim that Vardas never existed provoked a crisis of faith that also stalls the Sandling academy. Naomi of Virtue's Rest reported on a possible Jotun ceasefire, and Eilian Sweetwater appraised Mareave. The Scorrero flooded from Kahraman to Madruga, and a Deadwood Knight threatened Dawn from Weirwater and Karov. The Marcher smiths were reconciled with their nation. Conjunction results included Governor Rahab's assassination, a Jotun Burhfæst established in Gravenmarch, and heavy Imperial losses at Peregro. Oran, Nemoria, Kavor and Vezak stayed closed to Imperial fleets.

Dawn.t: Dawn was offered a Grand Tour tourney and a proposed national fayre at Anvil, while the Deadwood Knight prepared to attack and the fate of the Barrens remained unresolved between the Assembly and the senators.

Druj.t: Synod judgements urged citizens bordering the Druj to act against them. Druj forces were slowed in Lower Tarn Valley and defeated in the Bleaks and Grimfen Mire, but they inflicted heavy Imperial casualties at Peregro.

Grendel.t: Governor Rahab was assassinated in Madruga and Grendel forces were beaten in Siluri and Ayereed. Citizens began cataloguing the weaknesses of Grendel monsters, and the port of Oran stayed closed to Imperial fleets.

Highguard.t: Mentioned in passing: Highborn wayfarers were among those urged to preach in Asavea, and citizens of Casinea were tagged in a winds of magic entry.

Imperial Orcs.t: An appraisal found costly ways to deal with the recalcitrant orcs of southern Mareave, and further investment opportunities emerged there, including from the Tamazi sept.

Jotun.t: Naomi of Virtue's Rest set out what might make a ceasefire with the Jotun more likely. The Jotun established a Burhfæst in Gravenmarch but were defeated in Iron Stand, Meade March and the Suaq Wastes, where Urse Longarm was among the slain.

Navarr.t: Navarr committed to the final battle against the vallorn, recalled its stridings and mobilised for war, with opportunities to raise three new armies.

The Brass Coast.t: The Scorrero rose from Kahraman through Segura to Madruga, washing away the Blight and the Dry Patricians with destructive and transformative force, while several Madrugan conjunctions defeated the nation's foes.

The League.t: The League Assembly gained three mandates on how to support Navarr against the vallorn. Sarvos debated the Sarcophan enclave and Vandersaar investment, and Temeschwar's rat plague was controlled but not ended.

The Marches.t: Marcher friars shared their understanding of virtue in Urizen while Urizeni helped bring in the Marcher harvest, and the lost smiths of Oakwood were reconciled with the nation.

Thule.t: Mentioned in passing: the civil service summarised a report from Otkodov, and Thule watchers were tagged in a winds of magic entry.

Urizen.t: Urizeni helped bring in the Marcher harvest in exchange for Marcher friars preaching in the spires, and Urizen's citizens were stirred by calls to act against the Druj.

Varushka.t: Varushka's Assembly gained three mandates on supporting Navarr against the vallorn, and the Deadwood Knight, a lieutenant of the Howling Queen, gathered strength in southern Karov.

Wintermark.t: Kallavesa's senator Rane Shard-Bearer gave the Throne's address. Ishal mystics sought new ways to protect Kallavesa, and the Rising Tide presented proposals for Wintermark.

386YE Autumn Equinox winds of fortune.o: The Autumn Equinox 386YE winds of fortune gathered the season's developments across the Empire. They covered Navarr's decision to begin the final battle against the vallorn, the crisis of faith over Vardas, the rising of the Scorrero in the Brass Coast, and diplomacy with foreign powers, along with trade conditions and the outcomes of the Summer Sentinel Gate conjunctions.

Ayereed/Gainmeachdubh.t: Grendel and Asaveans were defeated at Dunreagh's Brush, and 12 wains of mithril were delivered to Delora i Sol-Devorador i Erigo.

Bregasland/Gravenmarch.t: With the conjunction at Rock Foot Wood not taken, the Jotun Burhfæst was established here and Svynna of Ldansk survived.

Brocéliande/Boar's Dell.t: The mystery of Starstrand Steading was investigated by the Spear of the Seven, with results known to Corwyn Heartsbane.

Forest of Ulnak/Grimfen Mire.t: Druj and heralds of Surut were defeated at Varnalis' Cache, and its stockpile of 16 wains of white granite was claimed.

Hahnmark/Wood Heath.t: Scions were defeated at Dun's Reach by Tobrytan Dunning's band.

Kallavesa/Wittal Grove.t: Mentioned in passing: the Grimir of Wittal Grove was among those tagged in the Rising in Runegrott wind.

Karsk/Moresvah.t: The Custodian of the Lost investigated events at Gorek's Hollow, with the outcome known to Anthemius Netherwatch.

Madruga/Calvos Sound.t: Tabhorios was revealed to have joined the Children of Wrecks, and all the wreckers at the Orchard of Tabhorios were killed.

Madruga/Free Landing.t: The Champion of Vigilance investigated the Baleen Cave, with results known to Jared.

Mareave/Clisearn.t: Clisearn was one of three southern regions whose uncooperative orc inhabitants Eilian Sweetwater's costly appraisal sought to address.

Mareave/Eoradal.t: Eoradal's recalcitrant inhabitants were among those the Mareave appraisal examined, with expensive options found for at least two of the three regions.

Mareave/Fleisardh.t: Fleisardh's uncooperative inhabitants were a subject of the appraisal, which also offered insight into why they resist Imperial rule.

Miekarova/Srodkoja.t: Scions were defeated at Biljana's Sward by the Master of Ice and Darkness's band.

Mitwold/Meade March.t: Urse Longarm and the other Jotun were killed at Jenny's Copse.

Mitwold/Oddmire.t: All the ghosts at Halebale Farm were exorcised.

Morrow/Peregro.t: The effort to kill the Druj at the Still Glade suffered significant Imperial casualties, and Megaris Sunspire was not recovered.

Mournwold/Southmoor.t: The Friar of Honour's Rest tracked down the ghosts at the Glen of Red Shadow, and all were exorcised.

Necropolis/Longbeach.t: Wreckers were defeated at the Grove of Silence and Kauitalic was rescued.

Redoubt/Naris.t: Scions were defeated at the Tilphussian Pass, with some Imperial casualties.

Redoubt/Siluri.t: Grendel and Asavean forces were defeated at Lucia's Holt.

Sarvos/Bocche.t: The Jade Custodian's band prevented a ritual at Ferocity's Stand and killed all the wreckers.

Sarvos/Foracci.t: A debate between the self-professed best in the world was held at the Solare Estate, with the outcome known to Constanza i Kalamar i Guerra and Marta i Guerra.

Sermersuaq/Silver Peaks.t: Maarik the Golden Tongue was killed at Aino's Rest.

Sermersuaq/Suaq Wastes.t: Jotun were killed and both Big Icebarn and Little Icebarn were dealt with at the Howling Steppe and the Desolate Tarn.

Skallahn/Iron Stand.t: Jotun were defeated at Auguaard's Bluff, and 14 wains of weirwood were delivered.

Spiral/Screed.t: All the citizens near Harrier's Nest were rescued in two separate missions.

Temeschwar/Hanuri.t: The Senator for Temeschwar met the Rat Kings guild at Terrier's Roar, and the Grandmaster of the Unfettered Mind sought Brinton von Temeschwar at the Old Priory; both outcomes are known only to those involved.

The Barrens/The Bleaks.t: The Knight-protector of Winter's band defeated Druj and heralds of Surut at the Hollow Tree.

Therunin/Lower Tarn Valley.t: The Druj advance was slowed at Tarn Bend, but the concoctions of the Sephals Cauldron were unleashed on the region.

Weirwater/Sandling.t: The academy honouring Ozren de Orzel at Belletain has yet to be commissioned, and the Vardas crisis will block any profound effects of its consecration until resolved.

Ayereed.t: The General of the Red Wind Corsairs defeated Grendel and Asavean forces at Dunreagh's Brush and delivered 12 wains of mithril.

Bay of Catazar.t: Citizens around the Bay of Catazar began gathering veterans' knowledge of the Grendel and Children of Wrecks monsters under the Sanguine Shields sodality.

Bregasland.t: The conjunction to stop the Burhfæst was not taken, so the Jotun established it in Gravenmarch and Svynna of Ldansk still lives.

Brocéliande.t: The Spear of the Seven investigated the mystery of Starstrand Steading in Boar's Dell, with the outcome known only to Corwyn Heartsbane.

Casinea.t: Mentioned in passing: citizens of Casinea were tagged in the As it is when it was winds of magic entry.

Feroz.t: Mentioned in passing: the When the River Rises wind included some discussion of the newly liberated Feroz.

Forest of Ulnak.t: At Varnalis' Cache in Grimfen Mire, heralds of Surut and Druj were defeated and 16 wains of white granite were delivered to Hugh Farrier.

Hahnmark.t: Tobrytan Dunning's band defeated the scions at Dun's Reach in Wood Heath.

Kahraman.t: The wild Scorrero rose in Kahraman in response to powerful Imperial magic and swept south towards Segura and Madruga.

Kallavesa.t: Ishal mystics sought new magical protections for Kallavesa, as Dripping Echoes of the Fen is no longer as effective as it once was.

Karov.t: The Deadwood Knight, also called the Schlacta of Rot, gathered strength in the wild places of southern Karov.

Madruga.t: The Scorrero flood cleansed Madruga of the Blight and the Dry Patricians but brought destruction with it. Governor Rahab was assassinated, Dry Patricians were defeated on the Great Grasses, and wreckers were killed in Calvos Sound.

Mareave.t: Eilian Sweetwater's appraisal found expensive ways to deal with at least two of the three uncooperative southern regions, and further investment opportunities were offered.

Miekarova.t: The Master of Ice and Darkness's band defeated the scions at Biljana's Sward in Srodkoja.

Mitwold.t: Urse Longarm was slain at Jenny's Copse and ghosts were exorcised at Halebale Farm, while Faraden involvement in the recent attack on Meade strained relations.

Morrow.t: The attempt to kill the Druj and rescue Megaris Sunspire at the Still Glade in Peregro failed with significant Imperial casualties.

Mountains of the Moon.t: Mentioned in passing: Axos remained annoyed over Imperial involvement in the failure of its joint venture with the Grendel here, and a report from Tsark was summarised.

Mournwold.t: Naomi of Virtue's Rest travelled under a flag of truce to speak with the Jotun in Mournwold, and ghosts were exorcised at the Glen of Red Shadow in Southmoor.

Necropolis.t: The Ambassador to the Sumaah Republic's band defeated wreckers at the Grove of Silence in Longbeach and rescued Kauitalic.

Otkodov.t: Mentioned in passing: the civil service summarised the Empire's latest report from Otkodov.

Redoubt.t: Scions were defeated at the Tilphussian Pass in Naris with some Imperial casualties, and Grendel and Asavean forces were beaten at Lucia's Holt in Siluri.

Sarvos.t: Controversy grew over Sarcophan law and a planned blasphemous cathedral on the nearby Alivetti estates as the Vandersaar sought further investment. Wreckers were stopped in Bocche.

Segura.t: The risen Scorrero swept through Segura on its way from Kahraman to Madruga.

Sermersuaq.t: Jotun were killed and Big and Little Icebarn dealt with in the Suaq Wastes, and Maarik the Golden Tongue was killed at Aino's Rest in the Silver Peaks.

Skallahn.t: The Champion of Ambition's band defeated the Jotun at Auguaard's Bluff and delivered 14 wains of weirwood to Eldrid Vestardottir.

Spiral.t: Two bands rescued all the threatened citizens near Harrier's Nest in Screed.

Temeschwar.t: The Ratkings guild brought the city's rat plague under control, but something malign remains, and conjunctions in Hanuri sought answers.

The Barrens.t: The Barrens remained tense, its fate torn between the Dawnish Assembly and senators, though Druj and heralds of Surut were defeated in the Bleaks.

Therunin.t: Lofyn Blood-cloak's force slowed the Druj advance at Tarn Bend, but the concoctions of the Sephals Cauldron were unleashed on Lower Tarn Valley.

Weirwater.t: The Deadwood Knight gathered strength in northern Weirwater ahead of an attack on Dawn, and the planned academy at Sandling remained uncommissioned.

386YE Autumn Equinox winds of war.d: Asavean ships raided Meade in Mitwold. War broke out over Madruga and Feroz, where the Children of Wrecks had seized the islands. The Tusks led an Imperial push against the Jotun, who had taken Sarcombe in Southmoor. The Druj poisoned Therunin and were rumoured to be meddling with the vallorn, while three Imperial armies marched from Mareave into the Petrified Forest of Ayereed. The Military Council would choose two of three battles: against the Children of Wrecks at Free Landing, the Jotun in the Ore Hills, or the Druj in Sweetglades. Numerous conjunctions were listed across the Empire, along with each nation's force weight and standing military considerations.

Dawn.t: Dawn brought a force weight of 58 to the battle opportunities, its armies still barred from Cautious Advance and Give Ground. Its heroes were called to conjunctions against Druj ritualists in the Barrens and the Speakers of Famine in Astolat.

Druj.t: The Druj invaded Therunin, poisoning the soil and slaughtering humans and orcs alike, with rumours that they sought to tamper with the slumbering vallorn. They faced a possible battle in Sweetglades and conjunctions in Peakedge Song and the Barrens.

Grendel.t: The Grendel faced war on two fronts: the struggle over Feroz and Madruga in 'Glass and flame', and three Imperial armies driving into their Ayereed homelands in 'Steel and salt'.

Highguard.t: Highguard offered a force weight of 21, and the Kruidenkenner Trademaster was named to lead a conjunction against wreckers at Longbeach in Necropolis.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Imperial Orcs contributed a force weight of 5 to the battle opportunities, and their armies could still take the Forge Hammers order in Skarsind.

Jotun.t: Having taken Sarcombe in Southmoor in the summer, the Jotun now faced an Imperial drive led by the Tusks to push them out of the Mournwold. They also faced a possible battle in the Ore Hills and several conjunctions, including one to stop them slaughtering the Feni in Bregasland.

Navarr.t: Navarr's Therunin was invaded and poisoned by the Druj, and its striders and steadings rose to resist in 'Blood and mire'. Navarr brought the largest force weight of all, 61, and was called to a conjunction in Miaren against followers of the Braying Lord.

The Brass Coast.t: The Brass Coast suffered on the Bay of Catazar: Siroc had been burned, the Children of Wrecks held Madruga's islands and Feroz remained under Governor Rahab. The Freeborn offered a force weight of 19, and the Hand of Guerra was named to lead a conjunction against wreckers in Calvos Sound.

The League.t: The League brought a force weight of 21, and its cities faced conjunctions in Holberg, Tassato, Sarvos, Spiral and Temeschwar, including one to slay the Braying Lord in Vardstein Vale.

The Marches.t: The Marches endured an Asavean raid on Meade and torrential rains that threatened the harvest, while the Tusks led the push against the Jotun in Mournwold. Marcher armies kept their home-territory strength bonuses, and the nation brought a force weight of 30.

Thule.t: Mentioned in passing: the Ambassador to Otkodov was named to lead a small conjunction investigating the situation at a mine shaft in Thule-held Nithoggir.

Urizen.t: Urizen brought a force weight of 13, and the Churnspire Adjutor was named to lead a conjunction against the Shuddering Wrast in Morrow.

Varushka.t: Varushka brought a force weight of 15 but still generated fewer victory points when campaigning alongside Brass Coast or Wintermark armies. It was called to conjunctions to soothe the wolves of Nadezhdikov in Volodmartz and to make the vale of Bulgakov in Karov habitable.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark brought a force weight of 59, and its armies kept their Fight with Honour order and their special modifiers against the Jotun. Its heroes were called to conjunctions against the Crimson Band in Hahnmark and against Asaveans threatening the Pilgrim's Trail in Kallavesa.

386YE Autumn Equinox winds of war.o: The Autumn Equinox 386YE Winds of War summarised a turbulent season of campaigning across the Empire, from an Asavean raid on Meade and war over Madruga and Feroz to the Jotun in Mournwold, the Druj in Therunin and the Imperial invasion of Ayereed. It also set out the season's battle opportunities and Sentinel Gate conjunctions.

Astolat/Winterbourne.t: Imperial heroes were called to the Grand Spinney to kill the Speakers of Famine.

Ayereed/Cornaghan.t: A conjunction at Anabla's Orchard sought to stop the Asaveans reinforcing Stormlords Rise, under the General of the Seventh Wave.

Ayereed/Petrified Forest.t: Three Imperial armies advanced into this dry and dangerous region from Mareave.

Bregasland/Grey Fens.t: A conjunction at Hal's Hollow sought to stop the Jotun slaughtering the Feni, under the Imperial Advisor for the Feni.

Hahnmark/Wood Heath.t: A conjunction at the Tainted Bawn targeted the Crimson Band.

Kallavesa/West Marsh.t: A conjunction at Ardith's Holt sought to protect the Pilgrim's Trail from the Asaveans.

Karov/Duzekani.t: Repeated small conjunctions to the vale of Bulgakov aimed to make it habitable.

Madruga/Calvos Sound.t: A conjunction on Santana's Path aimed to kill the wreckers, under the Hand of Guerra.

Madruga/Free Landing.t: The Freeborn Plain was the site of a possible Saturday battle against the Children of Wrecks to break the Gathering Storm.

Miaren/Goldglades.t: A conjunction at the Soured Pasture targeted the followers of the Braying Lord.

Morrow/Peregro.t: A conjunction at Iulia's Grove aimed to kill the Shuddering Wrast.

Mournwold/Chalkdowns.t: Two conjunctions were offered here: one to investigate a disturbance at Tilly's Howe, and one to defeat the Jotun at the Broken Corral.

Mournwold/Ore Hills.t: The Jade Wood was the site of a possible battle against the Jotun to rouse the Mourn's defenders, with Stephen of Sarcombe's warband fighting alongside the orcs.

Mournwold/Southmoor.t: Seized by the Jarl of Jarls along with Sarcombe in the summer, Southmoor saw conjunctions to kill Dalton Royse at Charlie's Coppice and to clear the last Jotun cache at Fecund Boscage.

Necropolis/Longbeach.t: A conjunction on the Magazjin Plain aimed to kill wreckers.

Otkodov/Nithoggir.t: A small conjunction to Shaft #3 at Skarlans was offered to investigate the situation.

Sarvos/Uccelini.t: A conjunction aimed to protect the Isle of the Fox.

Spiral/Apulus.t: A conjunction at Eammon's Bawn aimed to stop the Wailing Gyre.

Tassato/Tassato Mestra.t: A conjunction in the Felladonni Woods sought to stop a warband claiming ilium.

Temeschwar/Vardstein Vale.t: The largest Friday conjunction, at the Putrid Fields, aimed to slay the Braying Lord.

Therunin/Peakedge Song.t: A conjunction at Bronwen's Stand aimed to stop the Druj, under the Eastern Broker.

Therunin/Sweetglades.t: Ashborder was the site of a possible Sunday battle to stop the Druj's plan.

Astolat.t: A conjunction was offered at the Grand Spinney in Winterbourne to kill the Speakers of Famine, with Jared of the Sentinels Tower named as responsible.

Ayereed.t: Three Imperial armies advanced south from Mareave into Ayereed's Petrified Forest to conquer the Grendel homelands. A conjunction was also offered in Cornaghan to stop the Asaveans reinforcing Stormlords Rise.

Bay of Catazar.t: Mentioned in passing: storms continued to wrack the Bay, and the Brass Coast was said to suffer there amid the war over Madruga and Feroz.

Bregasland.t: Imperial armies could Billet in Bregasland, and the Strong Reeds kept their bonus there. A conjunction was offered in the Grey Fens to stop the Jotun slaughtering the Feni.

Feroz.t: Long under the heel of Governor Rahab, Feroz was one of the fronts in the war chronicled in 'Glass and flame'.

Hahnmark.t: A conjunction was offered at the Tainted Bawn in Wood Heath to kill the Crimson Band, under the oversight of the Imperial Huntsmarshall.

Holberg.t: A small conjunction was offered at the Wunderkind Fields in Holmaeur to kill the Feasters of Marrow, assigned to the Custodian of the Bloody Great Sausage.

Kallavesa.t: A conjunction was offered at Ardith's Holt in the West Marsh to protect the Pilgrim's Trail from the Asaveans, assigned to the Speaker of the Crows.

Karov.t: A series of short conjunctions was offered at Bulgakov in Duzekani to make the vale habitable, under the Grieftender of the Forgotten.

Madruga.t: With Siroc burned and the islands seized by the Children of Wrecks, Madruga became a battleground. It hosted a possible battle at Free Landing to break the Gathering Storm and a conjunction against wreckers in Calvos Sound.

Mareave.t: Mentioned in passing: Mareave was the starting point for the three Imperial armies marching south into Ayereed.

Miaren.t: A large conjunction was offered at the Soured Pasture in Goldglades to kill the followers of the Braying Lord, assigned to the Grandmaster of the Rod and Shield.

Mitwold.t: Asavean ships made a surprise raid on Meade, Mitwold's market town, in 'Harvest of infamy'. Imperial armies could Billet there, and the Drakes kept their bonus when fighting in Mitwold.

Morrow.t: A conjunction was offered at Iulia's Grove in Peregro to kill the Shuddering Wrast. Highborn and Urizen defenders in Morrow retained their bonus against attacks from Zenith.

Mournwold.t: The Empire, led by the Tusks, moved to drive out the Jotun who had taken Sarcombe in Southmoor. Mournwold hosted a possible battle in the Ore Hills and several conjunctions in Southmoor and the Chalkdowns.

Necropolis.t: A conjunction was offered at the Magazjin Plain in Longbeach to kill wreckers, assigned to the Kruidenkenner Trademaster.

Ossium.t: Mentioned in passing: Varushkan armies could still take the Hospitality of the Boyars order in Ossium.

Otkodov.t: A small, longer conjunction was offered at Shaft #3 in Skarlans, Nithoggir, to investigate the situation, assigned to the Ambassador to Otkodov.

Sarvos.t: A conjunction was offered to protect the Isle of the Fox in Uccelini, assigned to the Steward of the Sarvos Mana Exchange.

Sea of Snow.t: Mentioned in passing: Asavean ships sailed through the Sea of Snow and down the Gullet to raid the Marches.

Skarsind.t: Mentioned in passing: Imperial Orc armies could still take the Forge Hammers order in Skarsind.

Spiral.t: A conjunction was offered at Eammon's Bawn in Apulus to stop the Wailing Gyre, assigned to the Senator for Spiral.

Tassato.t: A conjunction was offered in the Felladonni Woods of Tassato Mestra to stop a warband claiming ilium, assigned to the Tassatan Hills title.

Temeschwar.t: A large conjunction was offered at the Putrid Fields in Vardstein Vale to slay the Braying Lord, assigned to the Delver of the Depths.

The Barrens.t: A conjunction was offered at Skrengal Copse in the Untrod Groves to kill Druj ritualists, assigned to the Knight-protector of Spring.

Therunin.t: The Druj invaded Therunin, spreading poison through the soil and pools, and were rumoured to be meddling with the slumbering vallorn. The territory hosted a possible battle in Sweetglades and a conjunction in Peakedge Song.

Upwold.t: Mentioned in passing: Imperial armies could Billet in Upwold, and the Bounders kept their strength bonus there.

Volodmartz.t: A conjunction was offered in the Choked Forest of Perumaki to soothe the wolves of Nadezhdikov, assigned to the Grim Gardener.

Zenith.t: Mentioned in passing: a standing rule gave Highborn or Urizen armies attacking into Zenith from Morrow a bonus to territory captured.

386YE Spring Equinox Conclave sessions.d: Raewyn Farkas became Hand of the Healers, Eliina Lailasdottir Archmage of Night, Raficci Vicente Barossa Imperial War Mage and Bella Vicente d'Apulian Arcane Envoy. Skywise Gralka retained Archmage of Day, and a declaration of sorcery against them failed. Concords accepted Wise Rangara's aid for the Bleak Tower and the Tower of the Fall. The Conclave accepted Roshanwe's Netweaver's Eye and Estavus's survey of three Bourse seats, and endowed the Westmere Anvil to Estavus. The Shuttered Lantern, Unfettered Mind and Golden Pyramid were sent to investigate Lorenzo's Deep Pockets, Temeschwar's rats and Mareave respectively. Chastise the Foolish was licensed and Surcease of Sorrow entered Imperial Lore. Assay the Barrens and Seek for Relics failed.

Grendel.t: The Conclave endorsed Foam and Spittle of the Furious Sea across the Bay of Catazar, explicitly as a means to fight the Grendel navies, and warned locals to take precautions.

Imperial Orcs.t: Following successful prospecting in Skarsind, the Golden Pyramid was sent on a similar expedition to the Imperial-controlled regions of Mareave, described as Imperial Orc territory, to discover what resources could be found.

Navarr.t: Surcease of Sorrow was entered into Imperial Lore to preserve it as a legacy for Navarr to use until their founders' dance is complete, with Morwenna Witheredrose providing the 10 thrones.

The League.t: The Order of the Unfettered Mind was sent, at a cost of 20 crystal mana, to investigate a rat problem plaguing the League territory of Temeschwar.

Urizen.t: The Urizen Lore ritual Chastise the Foolish was licensed and is no longer interdicted, while concords committed the Keeper of the Tower of the Fall to protect Urizen from the creatures of Agramant and the Bleak Tower's custodian to protect the herb gardens of Morrow, both with Wise Rangara's aid.

386YE Spring Equinox Conclave sessions.o: At the 386YE Spring Equinox the Conclave, drawing on a font of 190 mana, appointed several titles, approved expeditions and investigations, accepted offers from eternals, licensed an interdicted Urizen ritual and endorsed Foam and Spittle of the Furious Sea against the Grendel navies.

Mareave.t: The Golden Pyramid was dispatched, at a cost of 20 crystal mana, to explore the Imperial-controlled regions of Mareave and discover what resources can be found there.

Skarsind.t: Mentioned in passing: the earlier successful prospecting in Skarsind is cited as the reason for sending the Golden Pyramid to Mareave.

Temeschwar.t: The Unfettered Mind was sent to investigate peculiar events in Temeschwar involving a plague of rats.

386YE Spring Equinox Imperial elections.d: Seven senators were chosen in national elections, for Holberg, Karsk, Mournwold, Reikos, Sarvos, Segura and the Barrens. The Senate filled ambassadorships, generalships and many sinecures, including the Rebeshof Roadwarden. The Synod returned figures such as Hazelelponi as Lepidean Librarian with 224 votes and Ingrid as Speaker of the Crows with 220. The Military Council named Rahmah i Darwisj i Erigo as Imperial Fleet Master and appointed strategoi for the Brass Coast, the Marches and Urizen. Bourse titles went at auction or by vote, with The Red Depths going to Sagremar I Zayden I Guerra on 723 votes. Hildebrand Von Holberg was made Dean of the Academy.

Dawn.t: Dawn's voters elected Aramis du Froste as Senator for the Barrens.

Highguard.t: Highguard elected Cyrus, of Ebon's Hall, as Senator for Reikos.

The Brass Coast.t: The Brass Coast elected Velasco i Guerra as Senator for Segura, and Gael i Guerra was appointed Strategos of the Brass Coast.

The League.t: The League elected Kaspar Yakovich von Holberg as Senator for Holberg and Rosalina Gulia Viola di Sarvos as Senator for Sarvos. Several League-named sinecures were also filled, among them the Rebeshof Roadwarden and the Steward of the Sarvos Mana Exchange.

The Marches.t: The Marches elected Simon "Chordwangler" Willow as Senator for Mournwold, and Aliss Thorn was appointed Strategos of the Marches.

Urizen.t: The Military Council appointed Lanius as Strategos of Urizen.

Varushka.t: Varushka elected Aleksandr Zoravich Novosad as Senator for Karsk.

386YE Spring Equinox Imperial elections.o: At the 386YE Spring Equinox summit, a wide range of Imperial titles changed hands through national elections, Senate and Cardinal appointments, Synod judgements, Military Council appointments, Conclave votes, Bourse auctions and votes, and a Civil Service appointment.

Holberg/Rebeshof.t: The Senate appointed Lia Adelaar as Rebeshof Roadwarden.

Holberg.t: Kaspar Yakovich von Holberg was elected Senator for Holberg. Holberg's Melodious Cascade and Holberg's Phantasmagorical Mementoes received new holders, Lula and Bernhard Kleist von Ennerlund respectively.

Karsk.t: Aleksandr Zoravich Novosad became Senator for Karsk.

Mournwold.t: Simon "Chordwangler" Willow became Senator for Mournwold.

Reikos.t: Cyrus, of Ebon's Hall, became Senator for Reikos.

Sarvos.t: Rosalina Gulia Viola di Sarvos became Senator for Sarvos, and Wolfgang Wilheim Von Vanderghast was appointed Steward of the Sarvos Mana Exchange.

Segura.t: Velasco i Guerra became Senator for Segura.

The Barrens.t: Aramis du Froste became Senator for the Barrens.

386YE Spring Equinox Senate sessions.d: The treasury stood at 1406 thrones. The Senate abrogated the Temple of the Four Winds, made Warmage a national Urizen title and created several new titles, including Mistress of Monuments, Shadowed Torchbearer and the Voices of Virtue. The Guerdon was set at 150 thrones. A treaty with the Rahvin, which would have ceded Barrens regions, passed but was vetoed by Empress Vesna. A one-season peace with the Druj failed. The Beoraidh treaty was passed and then amended to the agreed text. Funds went to Thornsong, the Five Cities College of War, the Caricomare flood defences and the Roads of the Sky. Kindra Surefoot, Accalon, Nikita Teanga Volkov, Lucia Sanguineo Rezia di Tassato and Ebenezer were elected ambassadors.

Dawn.t: A vetoed Rahvin treaty would have ceded the Bitter Strand and Carmine Fields of the Barrens in return for Rahvin mithril trade with Dawn. Dawn's senators also backed the Spires of Dusk remodelling and the Roads of the Sky.

Druj.t: The Senate rejected a one-season peace with the Druj that would have freed their prisoners. It commissioned a smuggler's cove in the Salt Flats of Sanath to strike at the Druj heartland and ordered Druj elements stripped from the Spires of Dusk.

Grendel.t: Under the Beoraidh treaty, Beoraidh denies the Grendel access to its shipyard and gives no direct support to their war. The Urizen of the Silver Flame also agreed to reject Grendel offers.

Highguard.t: Accalon of Highguard became Ambassador to the Sumaah Republic. The Book of the Dead was made regalia of the Custodian of the Imperial War Memorial, and Highborn senators raised the Beoraidh treaty and the Spider's Dream Bridge fortification.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Senate assigned the territory of Mareave to the Imperial Orcs. In Skarsind, the Feldspar Distillery was announced and Snowstorm Henk was sent to investigate the Sorrowful Tunnels.

Jotun.t: Mentioned in passing: the Jotun are not named; they connect to the page only through Bregasland, the territory they held, where the Eels Landing docks were commissioned.

Navarr.t: Navarr secured 50 thrones towards Thornsong, the potion research college. Their proposed Court of the Spider King in Brocéliande, which would have opened communication with Arhallogen, failed.

The Brass Coast.t: Kahraman's motion abrogated the Temple of the Four Winds, and Segura's Druj peace treaty failed. Graciana i Lopez i Guerra was tasked with appraising Sermersuaq's wealth, and Finna i Guerra represented the Empire in the Beoraidh treaty.

The League.t: League cities gained 100 thrones for the Five Cities College of War, 40 thrones for the Caricomare flood defences and 25 thrones for the Roads of the Sky. The Printers Guild Mausoleum and the City of Flowers works were announced, and Lucia Sanguineo Rezia di Tassato became Ambassador to the Commonwealth.

The Marches.t: Funding for the Drakes' drummers gave that army the Pride of the Marches quality, and the Happiston Mana Exchange was commissioned in the Chalkdowns. Ebenezer of the Marches was elected Ambassador to Faraden after the election was escalated to the Empress.

Urizen.t: Warmage became a national Urizen title chosen by Urizen magicians in the Hall of Worlds. The Urizen of the Silver Flame were recognised as foreigners by treaty, and the Roads of the Sky and Nostos Docks were commissioned.

Varushka.t: Varushkan senators won commissions to fortify Delev, build the Inn of the Granite Stag and create the Shchaslyvyy Outpost Sappery in Drownbark Forest. Nikita Teanga Volkov became Ambassador to Jarm, and Empress Vesna vetoed the Rahvin treaty.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark sought an appraisal of Sermersuaq's untapped wealth and gained a mana sinecure and the Iron Grove in Kallavesa. Kindra Surefoot was elected Ambassador to Otkodov.

386YE Spring Equinox Senate sessions.o: At the 386YE Spring Equinox the Senate assigned Mareave to the Imperial Orcs, ratified peace treaties recognising Beoraidh and the Urizen of the Silver Flame as foreigners, and created the Throne power Face of the Empire. It also approved a wide slate of titles, constructions and ambassadorial appointments.

Kallavesa/Skymark.t: The Iron Grove, a herb garden sinecure whose keeper is appointed with tenure by Wintermark's senators, was announced in Skymark.

Mareave/Beoraidh.t: Under the Beoraidh treaty, Ehsan and successors retain Beoraidh for at least five years, paying the Empire 50 crowns per season per region.

Mareave/Fleisardh.t: The Beoraidh treaty commits Beoraidh to lay no claim to Fleisardh.

Mareave/Sinfoyard.t: Under the Beoraidh treaty, Ehsan and successors retain Sinfoyard for at least five years in return for seasonal payments to the Empire.

Mournwold/Chalkdowns.t: The Happiston Mana Exchange ministry was commissioned in the Chalkdowns, paid for by Morgan Townsend through Happiston Bakes.

Ossium/Drownbark Forest.t: The Shchaslyvyy Outpost Sappery, a 12-mithril mana ministry, was announced in Drownbark Forest.

The Barrens/Bitter Strand.t: The Rahvin treaty would have ceded the Bitter Strand, but the Empress vetoed it.

Astolat.t: Mentioned in passing: Astolat's senator seconded the Roads of the Sky commission.

Bastion.t: Mentioned in passing: Bastion's senator proposed the Ambassador to the Sumaah Republic election and seconded the Sermersuaq appraisal.

Bregasland.t: Docks were commissioned at Eels Landing in the North Fens and ceded to House Greywater for their service during the occupation. The town also received a market charter, ratified by the Emperor.

Casinea.t: Mentioned in passing: Casinea's senator proposed the Voices of Virtue titles and seconded the Keeper of the Cox amendment.

Hahnmark.t: Mentioned in passing: Hahnmark's senator proposed the mana sinecure in Kallavesa and received 5 thrones for it.

Hercynia.t: Mentioned in passing: Hercynia's senator proposed the failed Court of the Spider King and seconded the Faraden election and the withdrawn first Karsk counting house motion.

Holberg.t: Work continued on transforming Holberg into the City of Flowers. Holberg's senator also proposed the appraisal of the Dho'uala threat.

Kahraman.t: Mentioned in passing: Kahraman's senator proposed abrogating the Temple of the Four Winds and seconded the Thornsong funds.

Kallavesa.t: A mana sinecure was commissioned in Kallavesa for small halls unable to afford a wayleave, and the Iron Grove herb garden was announced in Skymark.

Karov.t: Mentioned in passing: Karov's senator proposed fortifying Delev and seconded the failed Court of the Spider King.

Karsk.t: A Prosperous Counting House was announced in Karsk, self-funded by Wolfs Hearth and the Embers of Iversgaard; an earlier Senate motion for it was withdrawn.

Mareave.t: Mareave was assigned to the Imperial Orcs, and the Beoraidh treaty set terms for its regions, river access and trade. The Imperial Spymaster announced the dismantling of the Mareave spy network.

Miaren.t: Mentioned in passing: Miaren's senator proposed the amended Beoraidh treaty and seconded the Face of the Empire power.

Miekarova.t: Mentioned in passing: Miekarova's senator proposed the smuggler's cove in the Salt Flats of Sanath and seconded the Otkodov ambassador election.

Mitwold.t: Mentioned in passing: Mitwold's senator proposed funding the Drakes' drummers and seconded the Silver Flame treaty.

Morrow.t: Mentioned in passing: Morrow's senator proposed the treaty with the Urizen of the Silver Flame.

Mournwold.t: The Happiston Mana Exchange, a 16-wain mana ministry, was commissioned in the Chalkdowns. Mournwold's senator also seconded the failed Druj peace treaty.

Necropolis.t: Mentioned in passing: Necropolis's senator proposed fortifying Spider's Dream Bridge and seconded the Nostos Docks.

Ossium.t: The Shchaslyvyy Outpost Sappery mana ministry was announced in Drownbark Forest. Ossium's senator also proposed the Shadowed Torchbearer title.

Redoubt.t: Mentioned in passing: Redoubt's senator proposed the Jarm ambassador election and seconded the Spires of Dusk amendment.

Reikos.t: Mentioned in passing: Reikos's senator proposed the original Beoraidh treaty and seconded the Lepidean true liao amendment.

Sarvos.t: The Senate disbursed 40 thrones for flood defences in Caricomare, to be built with the aid of the Vandersaar.

Segura.t: Mentioned in passing: Segura's senator proposed the failed Druj peace treaty and seconded the Spider's Dream Bridge fortification.

Semmerholm.t: Mentioned in passing: Semmerholm's senator proposed setting the Guerdon and seconded the appraisal of the Dho'uala threat around the Semmerlak.

Sermersuaq.t: Graciana i Lopez i Guerra was commissioned to appraise how Sermersuaq's untapped natural wealth could boost its prosperity, with findings due before the Summer Solstice.

Skarsind.t: The Feldspar Distillery herb garden was announced in Skarsind, and Snowstorm Henk was sent on a year-long investigation of the troll ruins of the Sorrowful Tunnels.

Spiral.t: Spiral received 25 thrones towards the Roads of the Sky, and the Silver Flame Urizen pledged to help defend it against the Druj or Grendel. The Spires of Dusk will be remodelled as a monument to the Hounds of Glory.

Tassato.t: Tassato gained 100 thrones for the Five Cities College of War. The Printers Guild Mausoleum was also announced there, awaiting a choice of region.

Temeschwar.t: Mentioned in passing: Temeschwar's senator proposed the Face of the Empire power and seconded the Beoraidh treaty amendment.

The Barrens.t: A Rahvin treaty ceding the Bitter Strand and Carmine Fields was vetoed, and a Druj peace that would have let the Black Wind leave the Barrens failed. The Barrens senator proposed remodelling the Spires of Dusk.

Therunin.t: Therunin's senator received 50 thrones towards completing Thornsong, the Empire's potion research college.

Upwold.t: Mentioned in passing: Upwold's senator proposed the vetoed Rahvin treaty and seconded the Drakes funding.

Volodmartz.t: Volodmartz's senator secured the self-funded Inn of the Granite Stag in Veltsgorsk, letting the holder of the Granites of Veltsgorsk buy extra white granite, and seconded fortifying Delev.

Weirwater.t: Mentioned in passing: Weirwater's senator seconded the smuggler's cove in the Salt Flats of Sanath.

Zenith.t: Mentioned in passing: Zenith's senator proposed the self-funded Nostos Docks and seconded abrogating the Temple of the Four Winds.

386YE Spring Equinox Synod judgements.d: Enacted mandates consecrated the Legion's Rookery in Skarsind, First Voice Glade in Miaren and Good Walder's Orchard in Mitwold, and bound Navarr by oath to protect the Great Forest Orcs. Other mandates shaped Apulian's culture, sent the Vigilant to Spiral, funded the Library of Worth and the Great Hall of Fabric Arts, and bound three Marcher armies to their home territories. Strong statements backed the Way's spread in Asavea and the fight against the Cold Sun. Hengest Dunn was revoked as senator for Hahnmark. Several figures connected to the Barrens received penances. Dogri Thulebane and Amika Acciai were escalated for exemplar recognition, and the Virtue Fund was almost exhausted by rewardings.

Dawn.t: The Dawnish assembly called its knights against the Deadwood Knight and flatly refused to offer sacrifices to Dho'uala. It also sought memorials for the ruined Towers of Dawn and asked for its fourth army to become an army of Black Knights. Several Dawnish figures received penances over their actions in the Barrens.

Druj.t: Mentioned in passing: named as the destroyers of the Towers of Dawn and, alongside the Grendel, as raiders whom Imperial corsairs and reavers were urged to strike back against.

Grendel.t: Priests were told the Grendel plotted to weaponise the Black Plateau and to destroy a bridge between Redoubt and Necropolis. Coastal Urizen and League citizens were warned that Foam and Spittle of the Furious Sea had been cast on the Bay of Catazar against them.

Highguard.t: The Highborn invited Freeborn and Marcher priests to teach at the Holy City rising in Bastion and recommitted the grey pilgrims to ending the vallorn. They also invited the Imperial Orcs to open the tomb of Emperor Ahraz and celebrated completing their reckoning with the League.

Imperial Orcs.t: Their nation gained a true consecration of Ambition at the Legion's Rookery and committed granite and coin to the Library of Worth each season for a year. Their priests marked Mareave as their second territory and warned Skarsind of a coming avalanche after the Cold Sun destroyed the home of the Storm Shaman.

Jotun.t: Mentioned in passing: a General Assembly statement recalled the Bregaslanders who sided with Mathilda Fisher and her Jotun masters.

Navarr.t: An enacted mandate bound the Navarr by oath to protect the Great Forest Orcs as family, reassuring the orcs settled in Hercynia and Miaren. The assembly also rallied artists and the people of Miaren against the Cold Sun, appointed chaplains to the thorns and scouts, and called for the liberation of Liathaven.

The Brass Coast.t: The Freeborn assembly backed the Mareave allocation on condition their lands are returned, honoured the Marracossans who defended Madruga and urged a corsair search of ruined Free Landing. Its enacted mandate began raising the Burning Falcon to True Conviction, and the Prosperity assembly called for the Freeborn to be defended.

The League.t: An enacted Urizen mandate will slowly shape Apulian into a city of philosophy and learning. League priests were sent to protect Spiral and Apulian from a Grendel plot, and coastal citizens were warned about the curse on the Bay of Catazar. The League also declared its reckoning with Highguard complete.

The Marches.t: Oaths bound the Tusks, Drakes and Bounders to Mournwold, Mitwold and Upwold, and Good Walder's Orchard was consecrated. The assembly called off a farmers' strike, condemned Hugh Farrier's plans to curse Urizen and accepted Highborn help patrolling its borders.

Thule.t: Wintermark's assembly noted that the Thule have granted sanction to hunt the Blood on Snow cult leader Maarik Goldentongue in the Silver Peaks. A proposal to send mediators to guide freed Thule skeins was withdrawn.

Urizen.t: Urizen priests urged Spiralites to return and rebuild their spires and asked the Crucible of Fate's artisans to make heavy armour. They pledged not to retaliate in kind for Marcher curses. A narrowly upheld General Assembly statement opposed making the Warmage a national title, though the Senate made it an Urizen one.

Varushka.t: The Varushkan assembly hailed the defence of Delev and called for Cold Sun remnants to be rooted out and for units to band together against the Schlacta of Rot. It defended the Iron Helms and enacted a mandate funding the Great Hall of Fabric Arts each season. Dawn's assembly rejected Varushkan traditions regarding Dho'uala.

Wintermark.t: The assembly revoked Hengest Dunn as senator for Hahnmark and added Thanmir Hrafnar to the Chronicle of Heroes. It also called on Winterfolk hunters to kill Maarik Goldentongue. Dogri Thulebane's recognition as an exemplar of Loyalty was escalated to the General Assembly.

386YE Spring Equinox Synod judgements.o: At the Spring Equinox 386YE summit the Imperial Synod raised 210 judgements, spanning statements on the Cold Sun, the vallorn, Spiral, Mareave and missionary work in Asavea, as well as enacted mandates, inquisitions, sanctions and appointments.

Brocéliande/Terunael.t: Navarr pledged to guide Highborn exploring the Terunael ruins, and Highguard resolved to send units to explore them after grey pilgrims rescued Navarr thorns.

Karov/Duzekani.t: Varushka's assembly declared that Delev stands and Duzekani is burnt but Imperial. It called for recognition of the Dawnish, Navarr and Varushkan heroes who defended it.

Madruga/Free Landing.t: The Freeborn assembly urged the Red Wind Corsairs to search the ruins of the Shining Pillar for Guerra's crystal. The site is now a maelstrom with no rubble to search.

Skarsind/Crow’s Ridge.t: Crow's Ridge was cited as Dogri Thulebane's legacy, the site of his stand at Crow's Keep before the Thule took it, in the recognition escalating him as an exemplar of Loyalty.

Spiral/Screed.t: The League assembly warned citizens to avoid the Black Plateau in Screed. Urizen and League priests were sent to protect citizens against a Grendel plot to weaponise it.

The Barrens/Heart of Peytaht.t: Under Navarr's enacted oath, most of the Great Forest Orcs sheltering in Therunin will return to the Heart of Peytaht. A rival mandate to protect all who call Peytaht home, orc and human alike, was not enacted.

Bastion.t: The Grand Inspiration of the Way is being raised here. The Highborn invited delegations of Freeborn Sutannir and Marcher monks and friars to teach in Bastion once it is completed.

Bregasland.t: Mentioned in passing: a statement recalled Bregaslanders siding with Mathilda Fisher, and a bid to rename Fisher's Rock as Amberlain's Stand was withdrawn.

Brocéliande.t: The Dawnish assembly urged its knights to quest into the vallorn-infested Greenwood to claim the bounty uncovered by the Emerald Dogs.

Karov.t: Southern Karov is threatened by the Deadwood Knight and its people by remnants of the Blade of Skies. Varushka committed 20 wains of white granite and 40 crowns each season to the Great Hall of Fabric Arts here. Karov's senator was inquisited and given penance.

Madruga.t: The Freeborn thanked the Marracossans of Trajadoz for defending Madruga against the Grendel and warned citizens to avoid the spreading blight. Everburning flames from Madruga are to help raise the Burning Falcon's quality.

Mareave.t: Priests described Mareave as newly under Imperial control and allocated to the Imperial Orcs. They urged pilgrims to spread the Way there, and the Freeborn expected their lands to be returned in time.

Miaren.t: First Voice Glade received a true consecration of Pride. Navarri artists were urged to decorate the trees petrified by the Empty Hands, and an enacted mandate rewards units supporting armies that fight that Cold Sun host here with herbs.

Sea of Snow.t: Mentioned in passing: notes on a Highborn call to breed blood whelks identify them with the frigid waters of the Sea of Snows near Caitun.

Skarsind.t: The Legion's Rookery was consecrated to Ambition, and the septs will fund the Library of Worth. The Imperial Orc assembly warned that the Cold Sun had destroyed the Storm Shaman's home and that an avalanche was coming.

Spiral.t: Urizen priests called exiled Spiralites home to rebuild their spires. An enacted mandate sent the Vigilant here to root out threats, and League and Urizen priests were urged to protect citizens against a Grendel plot involving the Black Plateau.

The Barrens.t: The Great Forest Orcs, reassured by Navarr's oath, are mostly returning home. Several senators and a general received penances over Imperial actions here, and Dawn's assembly sought proposals to memorialise the ruined Towers of Dawn.

The Semmerlak.t: The Assembly of Nine directed the Silent Bell to investigate how to counter the sovereign Dho'uala. Dawn refused any sacrifices to it, and Lady Amicia of the Semmerlak was called to inquisition over the matter.

Therunin.t: The Navarr assembly urged research into how liao was first refined from vinum here. Some Great Forest Orcs will stay in Therunin even as most return to the Heart of Peytaht.

Weirwater.t: Northern Weirwater is terrorised by the Deadwood Knight. The Dawnish assembly called on knights to slay it, and the House of Fools offered it a test of mettle.

Zenith.t: The Urizen assembly asked the artisans of the Crucible of Fate to turn from making light armour to heavy armour. The Golden Pyramid was praised for helping empower the Crucible.

386YE Spring Equinox event schedule.d: Six nations had senatorial elections: the Brass Coast, Dawn, Highguard, the League, the Marches and Varushka. Eight nations held Tally of the Votes elections for national titles. Friday's business included an Imperial Seer scrying, the Muster, Conclave and a 10pm Senate session. Saturday brought a battle off Anvil at 11am, the Bourse auction, the election of the Doyen of the Spires, Grandmaster elections, a Druj Delegation in the Senate Building and further Senate sessions. Sunday featured another battle off Anvil, a Military Council session, an Academy graduation and a final Senate session at 2pm. The Synod was open for judgement at intervals throughout.

Dawn.t: Dawn's new player meeting was set for 2:45pm, and the nation was due to elect a senator for The Barrens.

Druj.t: Mentioned in passing: a Druj Delegation was scheduled in the Senate Building at 5:30pm on Saturday.

Highguard.t: Highguard held its new player meeting at 2pm, elected a senator for Reikos and chose the Bursar of the House of Spirits by Tally of the Votes at the Chapel at 3:30pm.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Imperial Orcs elected the Steel Fist, the Preceptor of the Skarsind College of Warcasting, the Bonesetter of Torfast Trading Post and the Steward of the Mines of Gulhule at the Fire Pit at 5:30pm.

The Brass Coast.t: The Brass Coast held its new player meeting at 2pm, elected a senator for Segura and, at the Waypoint at 4:30pm, chose the Cerevado Nets, The Red Depths, the Marracossa Sendito and the Vizier of the Incarnadine Satchel.

The League.t: The League held its new player meeting at 2:30pm, elected senators for Holberg and Sarvos and chose the Tassatan Hills and Custodian of the Assayer's Guild titles at the Plaza at 5pm.

The Marches.t: The Marches held its new player meeting at 1:30pm, elected a senator for Mournwold and chose the Alder of Meade at the Community Hall at 4:30pm.

Urizen.t: Urizen elected the Gloaming Merchant and the Quaymaster of the Elosian Docks near the Net of Heaven at 5:30pm.

Varushka.t: Varushka held its new player meeting at 1:45pm, elected a senator for Karsk and, at the Central Hearth at 4pm, chose the Gift of the Dwindling Star, the Merchant Boyar of the Bittershore and the Custodian of Ivarsgard Docks.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark elected the Keeper of the Runegrott, the Talon of Kauppahall, the Mediator of Wreck and the Mediator of Fisk at the Tree of Names at 3:30pm.

386YE Spring Equinox event schedule.o: The Spring Equinox 386YE schedule set out the summit's new player meetings, senatorial elections, Tally of the Votes elections and the timetable of official and citizen-organised meetings across the Senate, Military Council, Conclave, Bourse, Synod and Academy.

Holberg.t: The League was due to elect a senator for Holberg at this summit.

Karsk.t: Varushka was due to elect a senator for Karsk at this summit.

Mournwold.t: The Marches was due to elect a senator for Mournwold at this summit.

Reikos.t: Highguard was due to elect a senator for Reikos at this summit.

Sarvos.t: The League was due to elect a senator for Sarvos, with the next regular election for the seat falling at the Summer Solstice 386YE.

Segura.t: The Brass Coast was due to elect a senator for Segura at this summit.

Skarsind.t: Mentioned in passing: the Preceptor of the Skarsind College of Warcasting was among the Imperial Orc titles elected by Tally of the Votes.

The Barrens.t: Dawn was due to elect a senator for The Barrens at this summit.

386YE Spring Equinox interlude.d: Wintermark units were urged to protect their people through a harsh winter and against Agramant. Imperial Orc and Highborn units could join the Bone Pilgrimage, Navarr units could become roadwardens, and any unit could scout the vallorn heart at Bendol. Freeborn fleets could escort shipping in the Bay of Catazar against the Grendel. Icy Maw halved Urizen mana production, the Serpent's Curse weakened Urizen congregations, Tharim's black frost drained the Brass Coast, and Dho'uala hampered Semmerlak fleets. League culture drew pilgrims and enriched congregations and artistic sinecures. Contributions opened for Imperatrix Lisabetta's memorial in Necropolis, and two new rituals entered Imperial Lore.

Dawn.t: Dawnish fleets continued to suffer a one-rank production penalty from Dho'uala in the Semmerlak, while the Queen's Rose sinecure at the Rose Towers gained an extra 108 rings from visitors.

Druj.t: Mentioned in passing: a spy network at Bendol sought to learn how the Druj had contained the vallorn heart in Sarangrave.

Grendel.t: Brass Coast fleets were mandated to protect Imperial shipping in the Bay of Catazar from Grendel ships, and the earlier penalty the Grendel imposed on fleets there was removed.

Highguard.t: Highborn military units could join the Bone Pilgrimage, and contributions opened for Imperatrix Lisabetta's memorial in Necropolis, due for completion by the Summer Solstice.

Imperial Orcs.t: Imperial Orc military units could join the Bone Pilgrimage to find the remains of orc ancestors and return them to the Bone Ossuary in Skarsind.

Navarr.t: A Navarr assembly mandate let Navarr military units become roadwardens, keeping Imperial roads safe from small-scale threats in return for rings and resources.

The Brass Coast.t: Ahraz i Guerra's mandate opened an escort adventure for Brass Coast fleets, but Tharim's black frost cost every Brass Coast mana site and herb garden production until the Summer Solstice in return for knights supporting the Fire of the South. The Azure Chorus and Crimson Drummers each gained 108 rings.

The League.t: Constanza i Kalamar i Guerra's mandate drew art pilgrims to Sarvos, Tassato and Temeschwar, enriching their congregations, while Holberg's fleets continued to suffer Dho'uala's penalty.

Urizen.t: Icy Maw halved mana production in Morrow, Redoubt and Zenith, and the Serpent's Curse cost every Urizen congregation two votes and one liao until the Winter Solstice 386YE. Urizen alone did not recognise the Bone Pilgrimage.

Varushka.t: Varushkan fleets continued to suffer a one-rank production penalty from Dho'uala, and a Varushkan assembly mandate encouraged priests to help with the Bone Pilgrimage.

Wintermark.t: Assembly mandates rewarded Wintermark military units that hunted the Suaq Wastes or defended Wintermark and penalised those that did not, while Sermersuaq farms gained a production bonus through the harsh winter.

386YE Spring Equinox interlude.o: In the interlude after the Winter Solstice 385YE, a range of effects took hold across the Empire ahead of the Spring Equinox 386YE. They included national mandates opening new military adventures, curses and rituals cutting production, and bonuses to congregations, sinecures and farms.

Kahraman/Braydon's Jasse.t: The Azure Chorus at Braydon's Jasse drew more visitors to its performances and gained an additional 108 rings.

Sarangrave/Bendol.t: Any military unit could support a temporary spy network in Bendol scouting the vallorn heart, though without reward.

Sermersuaq/Suaq Wastes.t: Wintermark units based in Sermersuaq that hunted the Suaq Wastes gained a +2 bonus to effective strength.

Bay of Catazar.t: The Grendel penalty on fleets in the bay was lifted, and Brass Coast fleets could take an adventure escorting Imperial shipping while avoiding battle with the Grendel.

Holberg.t: Fleets based in Holberg continued to lose one rank of production to the terror of Dho'uala in the Semmerlak.

Kahraman.t: As Brass Coast land, Kahraman's mana sites and herb gardens suffered Tharim's black frost, while the Azure Chorus at Braydon's Jasse gained extra income from visitors.

Kallavesa.t: The Custodian of the Ivarsgard Docks still faced cerulean mazzarine prices raised by a fifth as Dho'uala's presence disrupted trade.

Madruga.t: The Crimson Drummers of Madruga drew larger audiences and gained 108 rings, though Brass Coast mana sites and herb gardens suffered Tharim's frost.

Morrow.t: Icy Maw halved Morrow's mana site production and its mana-producing sinecures' income this season.

Necropolis.t: Resources could be donated towards Imperatrix Lisabetta's memorial in Necropolis, which would become effectively a folly if at least ten wains were given.

Redoubt.t: Icy Maw halved Redoubt's mana site production and its mana-producing sinecures' income this season.

Sarangrave.t: A temporary spy network at Bendol offered to investigate the vallorn heart, how the Druj had contained it, and the risks of tying it into the network.

Sarvos.t: Art pilgrims flocked to Sarvos, and every congregation there received an additional 36 rings.

Sermersuaq.t: Sermersuaq farms gained a one-rank production bonus, and Sermersuaq-based units hunting the Suaq Wastes gained a +2 strength bonus, as the people kept each other safe through the harsh winter.

Skarsind.t: Orc ancestors' remains gathered on the Bone Pilgrimage were to be returned to Skarsind and interred at the Bone Ossuary.

Tassato.t: Art pilgrims flocked to Tassato, and every congregation there received an additional 36 rings.

Temeschwar.t: Art pilgrims flocked to Temeschwar, and every congregation there received an additional 36 rings.

The Semmerlak.t: The sovereign Dho'uala's presence still hampered fleets on the lake, and the Harbourmaster of the Semmerlak remained unable to buy ilium and paid more for weirwood.

Zenith.t: Icy Maw halved the production of every mana site in Zenith this season.

386YE Spring Equinox winds of fortune.d: Empress Vesna's address coincided with Empire-wide festivities. The Jotun were banished from Bregasland, and Urizeni rebels in Spiral pressed their demands. A curse war between Urizen and the Marches brought storms to the southern coast and snow to Urizen. Imperial victory in Clisearn left the Senate to assign Mareave, where Eoradal was ceded through a conjunction. The Schlacta of Rot rampaged between Karov and Weirwater. The Black Wind returned to the Barrens, and rats plagued Temeschwar. Writs of consecration offered memorials to Gerallt Brackensong, Thrace and Good Walder. Conjunction heroes defeated Grendel raiders and the Scions in many regions. However, the Shining Pillar was destroyed, Oath-heart was corrupted, and Jotun slaughtered Feni in Liathaven.

Dawn.t: Dawnish lands faced the Deadwood Knight's growing undead rampage in Weirwater and a tense standoff in the Barrens, where the Black Wind returned. In Astolat, the Scions were defeated and the Castle of Thorns' rose garden was saved.

Druj.t: In the Barrens, isolated septs began reaching out to one another as Spring arrived, and the Druj were among those approached.

Grendel.t: The Grendel lost Clisearn and ceded Eoradal in Mareave, were beaten by heroes at Coursmouth, Naris, Uccelini and Lightsea, and were stopped from looting the Lyceum. The Senate's appraisal sought ways to strike at their navies, and the port of Oran stayed closed to Imperial fleets.

Highguard.t: Highborn wayfarers spread the Doctrine of Enlightenment abroad, and Highborn priests were active in the Marches. At home, Grendel were defeated in Coursmouth, but Oath-heart in Bastion was corrupted and remained in the Scions' hands.

Imperial Orcs.t: Senate-funded prospecting in Skarsind uncovered lucrative opportunities and mysteries, and the civil service concluded that Thrace's memorial belonged in Skarsind. The orcs also weighed building a cultural monument in defiance of Cold Sun.

Jotun.t: The Jotun were banished from Bregasland and the Jarl of Greenwall was killed at Iron Stand. In Liathaven, however, a Jotun warband went unstopped and is assumed to have slaughtered a Feni settlement.

Navarr.t: The Navarr gained an opportunity for a memorial to Gerallt Brackensong, saw the Dance of Navarr and Thorn performed in Therunin, and had Goldglades' forests protected. Their Black Wind army returned to the Barrens, and they insisted the war with Cold Sun in Miaren was not yet done.

The Brass Coast.t: An appraisal found the Dry Patricians trying to spread their blight beyond Madruga, where the Lyceum was saved but the Shining Pillar was destroyed. Kahraman enjoyed soothing Spring rains, and Erdene Bataguin was rescued there.

The League.t: The League faced open Urizeni rebellion in Spiral and a rat plague in Temeschwar, and Holberg considered building a giant temple-orphanage. Grendel were defeated at Glass Point Cove in Sarvos.

The Marches.t: The Marches celebrated the Jotun's banishment from Bregasland but were embroiled in a curse war with Urizen that risked more Marchers being declared sorcerers. Good Walder memorial sites were identified in Mitwold and Upwold, and assorted developments touched all four territories.

Thule.t: Mentioned in passing: captive Thule warlocks were rescued from the Siroc Plains in Madruga and returned to Anvil.

Urizen.t: Urizeni rebels in Spiral fought the territory's allocation to the League, and Urizen's territories were battered by cursed snow and hail. The sword scholars scattered, ending their tradition, while Grendel were defeated near the Great Harbour of Elos.

Varushka.t: Karov suffered the Schlacta of Rot's growing undead legion. Varushka spoke of building a cultural monument, and in Miekarova the risen villagers returned contentedly to their barrow.

Wintermark.t: Two names added to the Chronicle of Heroes, one of them not from Wintermark, drew outside interest. Heroes saved New Dunhall in Hahnmark and Hufi's Glen in Kallavesa, and Wintermark fleets gained a trade bonus at Faraden.

386YE Spring Equinox winds of fortune.o: The Spring Equinox 386YE winds of fortune gathered the season's news across the Empire. Empress Vesna's inaugural address called for unity, and the round-up also covered curse-driven storms, rebellion in Spiral, the conquest of Clisearn, an undying horror rampaging in the north-east, and the outcomes of the Winter Sentinel Gate conjunctions.

Bastion/Sybella Cross.t: At Tamar's Stand, Oath-heart was corrupted and remained in the Scions' hands.

Brocéliande/Greenweald.t: A knight-errant was rescued from Crangton Copse and returned to Anvil.

Hahnmark/Kronemark.t: The Scions were defeated at Dun's Hurst and New Dunhall stands.

Kahraman/Gambit.t: Erdene Bataguin was rescued on the Path of Idina and returned to Anvil.

Kallavesa/Kallavesa Marsh.t: The Scions were defeated on the Road to Masi, saving Hufi's Glen's apothecaries and herbalists.

Liathaven/Liaven's Glen.t: The Jotun warband at the Bawn of Daffyd was not stopped, and its Feni are assumed slaughtered.

Madruga/Lightsea.t: Grendel were defeated at Ezmara's Thicket and the heirloom was reclaimed.

Mareave/Clisearn.t: Imperial forces conquered Clisearn, turning the tide in Mareave.

Mareave/Eoradal.t: Eoradal was ceded to the Empire after the Grendel warbeasts were slaughtered.

Miaren/Goldglades.t: The Scions were defeated at the Golden Meadow and Goldglades' forests were protected.

Miekarova/Perumaki.t: The risen villagers of Wilkza returned contentedly to their barrow.

Necropolis/Coursmouth.t: Grendel were defeated at Hedra's Meadow and information was uncovered.

Redoubt/Naris.t: Grendel were defeated at the Elosian Grove and the Great Harbour of Elos was unharmed.

Sarvos/Uccelini.t: Grendel were defeated at the Isle of Quiet and Glass Point Cove was unharmed.

Skallahn/Greenwall.t: Greenwall's Jarl was killed by Imperial heroes at Iron Stand.

Skallahn/Iron Stand.t: The Jarl of Greenwall was killed at Hralfstor's Orchard, and Iron Stand's fyrd cannot be raised until Spring Equinox 387YE.

Therunin/Sweetglades.t: At the Circle of Rot, the vallornspawn were distracted and the Dance of Navarr and Thorn was performed.

Upwold/The Heath.t: The Scions were defeated at Sammy's Paling, protecting the Sutton Stone Quarries.

Astolat.t: In Groveyard, heroes defeated the Scions and the rose garden of the Castle of Thorns remained.

Bastion.t: Heroes failed to reclaim Oath-heart at Tamar's Stand, and it was corrupted and remained in the Scions' hands.

Bay of Catazar.t: Graciana i Lòpez i Guerra's Senate appraisal examined how fleet captains could disrupt Grendel naval and logistical operations in the bay.

Bregasland.t: The Jotun were banished and the pretender Mathilda Fisher was dead, though some in the western fens still held grudges. The Loyalty assembly and the matter of Bushel Sykes stirred gossip.

Brocéliande.t: A knight-errant was rescued from Crangton Copse in Greenweald and returned safely to Anvil.

Hahnmark.t: The Scions were defeated at Dun's Hurst and New Dunhall stood.

Holberg.t: Hildebrand von Holberg's judgement called for a giant temple-orphanage to celebrate the greatest city in the world, and Holberg meat entrepreneurs were involved in sausage business at Anvil.

Kahraman.t: Kahraman enjoyed soft rains and verdant growth from a magnitude 40 Spring ritual, most likely Regrow the Land's Heart. Erdene Bataguin was rescued on the Path of Idina.

Kallavesa.t: The Scions were defeated on the Road to Masi, saving the apothecaries and herbalists of Hufi's Glen.

Karov.t: The Schlacta of Rot was rampaging along the Weirwater border with a growing undead retinue of perhaps two hundred or more warriors.

Liathaven.t: A Jotun warband was not stopped at the Bawn of Daffyd, and the Feni settlement there is assumed to have been slaughtered.

Madruga.t: The Dry Patricians were trying to spread their blight to neighbouring territories. The Lyceum was protected from Grendel looting, but the Shining Pillar was destroyed. Thule captives were rescued and an heirloom reclaimed.

Mareave.t: Imperial victory in Clisearn turned the tide and Eoradal was ceded, leaving the Senate to assign the territory to a nation. Conjunction efforts also paid off the Dracaild of Rathmonna and recovered the map to Rucraic's Aerie.

Miaren.t: The Navarr considered the war with Cold Sun in Miaren unfinished, though the Scions were defeated and Goldglades' forests protected.

Miekarova.t: The risen villagers of Perumaki were content that their hospitality had been accepted and returned to their barrow.

Mitwold.t: Mitwold contained locations identified for a Good Walder memorial, and its senator was tagged in Marcher developments.

Mountains of the Moon.t: Mentioned in passing: the Axos remained annoyed at Imperial involvement in the failure of their joint venture with the Grendel into the Mountains of the Moon.

Mournwold.t: The Mournwold Orcs' ongoing transformation into Marcher orcs was among the Marcher developments discussed.

Necropolis.t: Necropolis was affected by the storms of the curse war, and the Grendel were defeated at Hedra's Meadow in Coursmouth, yielding information.

Otkodov.t: Mentioned in passing: the Ambassador to Otkodov was tagged in Wintermark news and led the rescue of Thule captives.

Redoubt.t: Redoubt was pummelled by cursed snow and hail, while Grendel were defeated in Naris and the Great Harbour of Elos was left unharmed.

Sarvos.t: Sarvos was caught up in the curse-war storms, and Grendel were defeated at the Isle of Quiet, leaving Glass Point Cove unharmed.

Sermersuaq.t: Its people were tagged as especially concerned by the Chronicle of Heroes news and Wintermark's harsh winter.

Skallahn.t: The Jarl of Greenwall was killed at Hralfstor's Orchard, and the fyrd of Iron Stand cannot be raised until the start of Spring Equinox 387YE.

Skarsind.t: Prospecting in Skarsind's mountains proved potentially lucrative, and it was judged the only reasonable site for Thrace's memorial.

Spiral.t: Urizeni rebels were in open revolt against the territory's allocation to the League, and the Empire sought to meet their demands.

Tassato.t: Mentioned in passing: the Steward of the Tassato Mana Exchange was tagged as affected by the curse-war storms.

Temeschwar.t: Fearless rats were biting people, dogs and cats across the city, and something was rumoured to be amiss at Lorenzo's Deep Pockets.

The Barrens.t: The Black Wind returned cautiously amid fear and division, but with Spring the isolated septs began reaching out to each other, including the Druj.

Therunin.t: At the Circle of Rot, the vallornspawn were distracted and the Archmage of Spring performed the Dance of Navarr and Thorn.

Upwold.t: Upwold held possible Good Walder memorial sites, and the Scions were defeated on the Heath, protecting the Sutton Stone Quarries.

Weirwater.t: The Deadwood Knight was rampaging along the Karov border, its undead legion growing and its attacks becoming bolder.

386YE Spring Equinox winds of war.d: The scions of Cold Sun pressed their campaign of oblivion (Eclipse). Imperial armies met the Lasambrian Jotun advance in Kahraman (Below the red rock). The armies in Skallahn withdrew into Sermersuaq, leaving the Jotun to reclaim lost land. Five armies fought in Beoraidh as the Empire pushed to conquer Mareave's Broken Shore (Sea-wood fed with copper), and Imperial forces fought to reclaim Madruga from those who burned Siroc (The cry of gulls). The Military Council would choose two of four battles: Liathaven and Kallavesa against the Jotun, Mareave and Madruga against the Grendel. Conjunctions included vallornspawn in Brocéliande and Hercynia, marked Patricians in Segura and Kahraman, and scions in several territories.

Dawn.t: Dawn could commit substantial forces to the season's battles, though its armies may not take the Cautious Advance or Give Ground orders. The Reeve of Greenforest Fair was asked to lead Dawnish heroes against vallornspawn in Brocéliande, and two conjunctions arose in Weirwater.

Grendel.t: The Grendel were the foe in two of the four battle opportunities, in Mareave and Madruga, as the Empire pressed the Broken Shore and fought to reclaim Madruga. They also faced conjunctions in Spiral, Eoradal and Necropolis, where agents sought to escape with intelligence.

Highguard.t: Highguard faced Grendel incursions in Necropolis and scions in Bastion. If the Champion of Loyalty saved the injured thorns on the Reikos border, Highborn military unit captains would be inspired to explore the ruins of Terunael.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Imperial Orcs could commit a small force to the season's battles, and the Storm Shaman was charged with defeating the scions at Bitter Hollow in Skarsind.

Jotun.t: The Lasambrian Jotun pressed their invasion of Kahraman and were met by Imperial armies, while in the north they reclaimed land in Skallahn after the Imperial withdrawal. They and their yegarra were the foe in two battle opportunities, in Liathaven and Kallavesa.

Navarr.t: Navarr could commit one of the largest forces to the battles. In Hercynia the Spear of the Seven and the Archmage of Spring were called to distract vallornspawn so a coven could perform the Dance of Navarr and Thorn and repair trods damaged by the scions.

The Brass Coast.t: The Brass Coast was the focus of much fighting: Imperial armies met the Jotun invasion of Kahraman and fought to reclaim Madruga, while marked Patricians and a Fire Beacon troubled Segura.

The League.t: The League could commit forces to the battles, and Grendel were reported in Spiral, where the Oblivion Sentinel and the Custodian of the Legacy were called to deal with them.

The Marches.t: Marcher armies may not take the Give Ground order and the Strong Reeds fight harder in Bregasland. Marcher traitors fought alongside Dalton Royse in Liathaven, and creatures needed guiding home in Upwold.

Urizen.t: Urizen could commit forces to the battles and kept its standing advantages for Urizen and Highborn armies fighting between Morrow and Zenith.

Varushka.t: Three conjunctions arose in Karov, against the Festering Warden, the Iron Boyar and the scions. Varushkan armies remained less effective alongside Brass Coast or Wintermark armies but could take the Hospitality of the Boyars order in Ossium.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark could commit the largest force to the battles. Its armies withdrew from Skallahn into Sermersuaq, the Jotun threatened Kallavesa and Sermersuaq, and Winterfolk armies kept their honour-bound advantages against the Jotun.

386YE Spring Equinox winds of war.o: At the Spring Equinox of 386YE the Empire's war continued on several fronts: against the Cold Sun's scions, the Lasambrian Jotun invading Kahraman, and the Grendel in Mareave and Madruga, while Imperial armies withdrew from Skallahn. Four major battle opportunities and dozens of Sentinel Gate conjunctions were identified for Imperial heroes.

Bastion/Sybella Cross.t: The Knight-protector of Spring was charged with performing Regrow the Land's Heart and defeating the scions at the Disordered Expanse.

Brocéliande/Black Boughs.t: Tancred of the Emerald Dogs found a herb trove guarded by vallornspawn, and the Reeve of Greenforest Fair, Arlen Foreman-Smith, was asked to slay them. Success would yield extra herbs for units questing against the vallorn for two seasons.

Brocéliande/Vale's Lament.t: A vallornspawn horde moved towards the Tamarbode border, and the Champion of Loyalty, Dagon, was asked to slay it and save the injured thorns.

Feroz/Morajasse.t: The Champion of Wisdom was called to intercept a suspicious Faraden agent in Taziolar's Woods.
