Hercynia/Deer's Folly.t: The Spear of the Seven, Corwyn Heartsbane, was to distract vallornspawn at the Toxic Dell so that a coven organised by the Archmage of Spring, Ibiss Briarheart, could perform the Dance of Navarr and Thorn.

Hercynia/Summersend.t: The Granger of the Golden Orchard was called to guide creatures home from Merel's Glade.

Kahraman/Gambit.t: The Dhomiro of the Cinnabar Hills was called to stop the Jotun on the Path of Sofia.

Kahraman/Jade Range.t: The Mistress of the Dust Parador was called to deal with a Lasambrian champion and destroy an Irremais-marked Patrician in the Parched Range.

Karov/Duzekani.t: The Overseer of the Westward Road was called to defeat the Festering Warden at the Broken Copse.

Karov/Malimorzi.t: The Boyar of the Iron Roads was called to defeat the Iron Boyar on the Granite Path.

Karov/Wieliczka.t: The Champion of Courage was called to defeat the scions at the Glade of Haamrikoht.

Liathaven/Liath's Ring.t: A battle opportunity arose on the Wyndyn Path to thwart Beater Royse's Jotun and yegarra, joined by Marcher traitors.

Madruga/Free Landing.t: A battle opportunity arose to stop Siakha's cults at Siakha's Maw, fought against the Grendel.

Mareave/Beoraidh.t: Five armies fought here as the Empire pursued the conquest of the Broken Shore.

Mareave/Eoradal.t: Vitore Van Temeschwar was named responsible for preventing the Grendel escaping from the Old Skouran Orchard.

Mareave/Fleisardh.t: A battle opportunity arose at Brine Blood Bay to capture the Grendel's Brine Turtles.

Miaren/Goldglades.t: Aniera Exiles End was named responsible for a meeting with the Burning Vine at the Old Green Fort.

Necropolis/Highrod.t: The High Exorcist was called to defeat the Grendel and put the ghosts to rest at the Coppice of Athaliah.

Necropolis/Longbeach.t: The Imperial Spymaster was called to stop the Grendel escaping with intelligence from Ada's Woods.

Reikos/Tamarbode.t: Vallornspawn advanced towards the border, threatening injured thorns sheltering at a wayhouse on the Reikos side.

Segura/Burnish.t: The High Bard of the Empire was called to perform Align the Celestial Net at the Ring of Dust and Glass to neutralise the Fire Beacon.

Segura/Lucksprings.t: Bakar i Riqueza was named responsible for destroying a Naeve-marked Patrician and recovering dust at the Parched Springs.

Segura/Sobral Grasses.t: The Grandmaster of the Unfettered Mind was called to rescue a magician and destroy a Yoorn-marked Patrician in the Parched Grasses.

Sermersuaq/Suaq Fount.t: The Custodian of the Pride of Ikka's Tears was called to defeat Freydis and the other Jotun in Hanleth's Wastes.

Skarsind/Pakaanan's Pass.t: The Storm Shaman was called to defeat the scions at Bitter Hollow.

Spiral/Ossuary.t: The Custodian of the Legacy was called to stop the Grendel at Lucia's Grove.

Spiral/Screed.t: The Oblivion Sentinel was called to kill the Grendel at Sabina's Sward.

Upwold/Birchland.t: The Keeper of the Golden Fields was called to guide creatures home from James' Orchard.

Weirwater/Weirmoor.t: The Castellan of Spiral Castle was called to defeat the Broken Errant at Roland's Stand.

Weirwater/Wickmoor.t: The Knight-protector of Spring was called to guide creatures home from Regan's Glade.

Bastion.t: The Knight-protector of Spring was charged with performing Regrow the Land's Heart and defeating the scions at the Disordered Expanse in Sybella Cross.

Bay of Catazar.t: Mentioned in passing: the seasonal narrative sweeps over the Bay of Catazar on its way to the Brass Coast.

Bregasland.t: Mentioned in passing: listed among military considerations, as the Strong Reeds gain extra strength when fighting there.

Brocéliande.t: Vallornspawn hordes gathered in two places: around a newly found trove of herbs in Black Boughs, and moving through Vale's Lament towards Reikos. Imperial heroes were called to slay both.

Feroz.t: The Champion of Wisdom was called to intercept a suspicious Faraden agent in Taziolar's Woods in Morajasse.

Hercynia.t: A Spring regio, the Toxic Dell in Deer's Folly, offered a chance to perform the Dance of Navarr and Thorn if the vallornspawn there could be distracted, and creatures needed guiding home in Summersend.

Kahraman.t: The Lasambrian Jotun invasion continued, but this season Imperial armies stood against it. Conjunctions in Gambit and the Jade Range targeted the Jotun, a Lasambrian champion and an Irremais-marked Patrician.

Kallavesa.t: A battle opportunity arose at Hvalgrunn in West March to defeat Jarl Idunn and his Jotun and yegarra.

Karov.t: Three conjunctions arose: against the Festering Warden in Duzekani, the Iron Boyar in Malimorzi, and the scions in Wieliczka.

Liathaven.t: A battle opportunity arose on the Wyndyn Path in Liath's Ring to thwart Beater Royse, whose Jotun and yegarra were joined by Marcher traitors.

Madruga.t: The Empire fought to reclaim Madruga's shores from the forces that burned Siroc, and a Sunday battle opportunity arose to stop Siakha's cults at Siakha's Maw.

Mareave.t: Five armies fought in Beoraidh as the Empire pursued the conquest of the Broken Shore. A battle opportunity arose to capture the Brine Turtles in Fleisardh, and a conjunction to stop Grendel escaping in Eoradal.

Miaren.t: Aniera Exiles End was named responsible for a meeting with the Burning Vine at the Old Green Fort in Goldglades.

Mitwold.t: Mentioned in passing: listed as one of two territories where any Imperial army may take the Billet order.

Morrow.t: Mentioned in passing: listed among standing military considerations, giving Highborn or Urizen defenders a bonus against attacks from Zenith.

Necropolis.t: Three conjunctions arose: reclaiming an heirloom in Sanctuary Sands, stopping Grendel escaping with intelligence in Longbeach, and defeating Grendel and laying ghosts to rest in Highrod.

Ossium.t: Mentioned in passing: Varushkan armies can take the Hospitality of the Boyars order there.

Reikos.t: Vallornspawn from Brocéliande threatened to spill into Reikos and slaughter injured thorns at a wayhouse near the Tamarbode border, and the Champion of Loyalty was asked to stop them.

Segura.t: Three conjunctions arose: neutralising the Fire Beacon in Burnish, and destroying Yoorn- and Naeve-marked Patricians in the Sobral Grasses and Lucksprings.

Sermersuaq.t: The Imperial armies withdrawing from Skallahn fell back into Sermersuaq, and a conjunction arose to defeat Freydis and other Jotun in Suaq Fount.

Skallahn.t: The armies attacking the Jotun withdrew, leaving no garrisons, and the Jotun turned to reclaiming land the Empire had taken.

Skarsind.t: The Storm Shaman was called to defeat the scions at Bitter Hollow in Pakaanan's Pass.

Spiral.t: Grendel were reported in Screed and Ossuary, and the Oblivion Sentinel and the Custodian of the Legacy were called to deal with them.

Upwold.t: Any Imperial army may billet in Upwold, and the Keeper of the Golden Fields was called to guide creatures home in Birchland.

Weirwater.t: The Castellan of Spiral Castle was called to defeat the Broken Errant in Weirmoor, and the Knight-protector of Spring to guide creatures home in Wickmoor.

Zenith.t: Mentioned in passing: listed among standing military considerations, giving Highborn or Urizen armies attacking from Morrow a bonus to territory captured.

386YE Summer Solstice Conclave sessions.d: On Friday the Sevenfold Path and Rod and Shield sent Hammers of the Brilliant Shore and Stalwart Stand on Solid Ground to the Sumaah ambassador. Areloe Larmallevés, Vanja and Amalia da Regario took titles, and Ibis Briarheart kept the Archmage of Spring post. Winter declared amity for Tharim. On Saturday the Golden Pyramid was asked to keep exploring Mareave and the Sevenfold Path was sent to Asavea. The Circle of Zulgan Tash was reconciled, and Judgement of the Magisters and Netweaver's Eye entered Imperial lore. Lashonar was moved to neutrality, and the casting of Raise the Rivers against the Madruga blight was endorsed. Edmundo kept the Archmage of Autumn post. A 100-mana college endowment failed.

Grendel.t: The Conclave asked the Golden Pyramid to continue exploring Grendel-held Mareave for another year, at a cost of 20 crystal mana to the Conclave.

The Brass Coast.t: The Conclave endorsed the Freeborn casting of the arcane projection Raise the Rivers, which aims to make the River Scorrero burst its banks and wash the blight from Madruga.

Urizen.t: The Conclave recognised Illyses as the new War Mage, a title now appointed as an Urizen national position, and said it looked forward to continuing the relationship.

386YE Summer Solstice Conclave sessions.o: At the 386YE Summer Solstice the Imperial Conclave appointed several titles, sent ritual texts to the Sumaah Republic, endorsed a Freeborn ritual to wash the blight from Madruga, and committed orders to expeditions in Mareave and Asavea. It worked from a font of 246 mana.

Madruga.t: An endorsed Spring ritual, Raise the Rivers, was to flood the River Scorrero so that it would cleanse the blight from the region.

Mareave.t: The Golden Pyramid was asked to carry on exploring Mareave for the next year, following the Digging for fire wind of fortune.

386YE Summer Solstice Imperial elections.d: National elections returned senators for Bastion, Hahnmark, Karov, Mareave, Miaren, Mitwold, Redoubt, Sarvos, Sermersuaq, Spiral and Weirwater. The Senate appointed Jarrigk Orzel as Imperial Consul and Bernard Dugdale as Imperial Spymaster, alongside many generals and other officers. The Throne named Alaina Ferelith Meliora as Queen's Rose. The Synod chose Tulva as Cardinal of Courage and Silas of the Cenotaph as Cardinal of Wisdom. The Military Council appointed Maggie Potts as Imperial Huntsmarshall, with new Strategoi for the League and the Marches. Bourse seats such as Hakima of Salt and Sand were filled by auction and vote, and candidates declared for several archmage posts.

Dawn.t: Dawn's territory of Weirwater sent Ser Lucan Mortére to the Senate.

Grendel.t: Grendel's territory of Mareave elected Gaddak as its senator.

Highguard.t: Highguard's territory of Bastion returned Asael as its senator.

Navarr.t: Navarr's territory of Miaren elected Llewellyn Leafstalker to the Senate.

The League.t: The League elected senators for Sarvos and Spiral, and the Military Council named Gabrieli di Tassato as Strategos of the League.

The Marches.t: The Marches sent Hal Talbot to the Senate for Mitwold, and the Military Council named Aliss Thorn as Strategos of the Marches.

Urizen.t: Urizen's territory of Redoubt elected Thalia of Netherwatch as its senator.

Varushka.t: Varushka's territory of Karov returned Anatoly Vassian Tatishchev to the Senate.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark elected two senators: Ruana Markling for Hahnmark and Fedelmidd Sydanjaa's Heart Floer for Sermersuaq.

386YE Summer Solstice Imperial elections.o: At the 386YE Summer Solstice summit, Imperial elections filled senatorial seats for eleven territories along with a wide range of Senate, Synod, Military Council, Conclave and Bourse titles.

Bastion.t: Asael was elected Senator for Bastion.

Hahnmark.t: Ruana Markling was elected Senator for Hahnmark.

Karov.t: Anatoly Vassian Tatishchev was elected Senator for Karov.

Mareave.t: Gaddak was elected Senator for Mareave.

Miaren.t: Llewellyn Leafstalker was elected Senator for Miaren.

Mitwold.t: Hal Talbot was elected Senator for Mitwold.

Redoubt.t: Thalia of Netherwatch was elected Senator for Redoubt.

Sarvos.t: Rosalina Gulia Viola di Sarvos was elected Senator for Sarvos.

Sermersuaq.t: Fedelmidd Sydanjaa's Heart Floer was elected Senator for Sermersuaq.

Spiral.t: Genoveva Barossa d'Apulian was elected Senator for Spiral.

Weirwater.t: Ser Lucan Mortére was elected Senator for Weirwater.

386YE Summer Solstice Senate sessions.d: The Senate renounced claims to the Silver Peaks, Miechernya, Krevsaty, Crows Ridge, Bonewood and Webwood. It ratified a Skouran treaty recognising the conquest of Mareave and granted the Iron Confederacy free trade. It made the Fundindelve mithril mine a Bourse resource and requested appraisals on Mareave and on peace with the Jotun. The Synod may veto a ban on preaching the Way in Asavea. The Guerdon was raised to 250 thrones. Commissions included the City of Dreams, Drycastle's rebuilding, Journeymage Towers, Reed's Roost, Gildenheim's fortification, a smugglers cove in Ayereed and the Capodomus repairs. Two commissions exceeded the limit and were not enacted. The Throne drew 100 thrones for the Dawnish army.

Dawn.t: The Barrens' commission to rebuild Drycastle in Dawnguard was enacted, and the Throne withdrew 100 thrones for the continued construction of the Dawnish army. The restoration of the Castle of Thorns throne room, funded by the Houses of Dawn, passed but was not enacted.

Druj.t: Mentioned in passing: Drycastle lay in ashes and rubble left by the Druj, and the Druj had sacked the Storm Vault in Zenith, which was now repaired.

Grendel.t: The Skouran treaty celebrated the Grendel's defeat in Mareave, and the new Imperial Spymaster announced a smugglers cove in Grendel-held Ayereed to challenge their grip on the Bay of Catazar.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Skouran treaty welcomed the Imperial Orcs as stewards of Mareave. Skarsind saw its Fundindelve mine made a Bourse resource and Gildenheim fortified.

Jotun.t: The Senate commissioned an appraisal from Naomi of Virtue's Rest on making a peace treaty more appealing to the Jotun, citing the honours they had given Imperial generals.

Navarr.t: Miaren's self-funded commission of the Seren City of Dreams passed, but Hercynia's request to appraise the vale as an armoury for Navarr's war against the vallorn failed.

The League.t: The League gained a new Mistress of Ceremonies title, the Capodomus Cathedral repairs in Sarvos and the Vicente School and Orphanage in Spiral. Its Senators also brokered the Iron Confederacy treaty.

The Marches.t: Marcher Bregasland gained two commissions: the Reed's Roost mana sinecure, with a Roost's Reeve, and a Bounders Hall in Ottery, creating the title Bailiff of the Fens.

Thule.t: The Empire renounced forever any claim to the Silver Peaks, Miechernya, Krevsaty, Crows Ridge, Bonewood and Webwood, recognising them as part of Otkodov.

Urizen.t: The Crystal Architect of the Spires became an Imperial title able to build sinecures anywhere, and the Storm Vault in Zenith was rebuilt. Redoubt's motion created the Astral Arcanist.

Varushka.t: The Master of the Koboldi announced the Great Hall of Fabric Arts in Delev, Karov. Volodmartz proposed the renunciation of claims to the Thule lands, and Varushkan senators backed new mystical titles.

386YE Summer Solstice Senate sessions.o: At the Summer Solstice 386YE the Senate passed treaties with Skoura and the Iron Confederacy, renounced the Empire's claim to several lands now held by Otkodov, and approved or announced a long list of commissions. It also elected several Imperial titles, including Jarrigk Orzel as Imperial Consul and Bernard Dugdale as Imperial Spymaster.

Bregasland/North Fens.t: The self-funded Reed's Roost was built here, a sinecure producing mana crystals with a Roost's Reeve appointed by Marcher senators.

Ossium/Bittershore.t: A Journeymage Tower was built here as part of a series meant to remove the threat Dho'uala posed to shipping.

Ossium/Bonewood.t: The Senate recognised Bonewood as part of Otkodov now and forever and renounced any Imperial claim to it.

Ossium/Galath Fields.t: A statue commemorating the liberation of Ossium and the coming of the Way was built at Lomaa, funded by prosperous Ossian citizens.

Ossium/Webwood.t: The Senate recognised Webwood as part of Otkodov now and forever and renounced any Imperial claim to it.

Skarsind/Gildermark.t: The Legion Engineer fortified Gildenheim with a rank one fortification and runic wards offered by the Tamazi.

Spiral/Apulus.t: The Vicente School and Orphanage was built here, a mana ministry training orphans as reckoners and traders under a League-appointed Custodian.

Ayereed.t: Imperial Spymaster Bernard Dugdale announced a smugglers cove in this Grendel-held territory, declaring the Empire would wrest the Bay of Catazar from the Grendel.

Bregasland.t: Two commissions went ahead here: the Reed's Roost mana sinecure and a Bounders Hall in Ottery. The territory's senator also seconded the change to Virtue Inquisitors' powers.

Mareave.t: An appraisal on removing the uncooperative quality from Mareave's three regions was commissioned. The Skouran treaty renounced all Skouran claim to the territory and acknowledged its conquest by the Empire.

Ossium.t: The Empire renounced its claim to Bonewood and Webwood. A Journeymage Tower was raised at Bittershore and a statue to Ossium's liberation was built in Galath Fields.

Skarsind.t: The Fundindelve mithril mine was made an Imperial Bourse resource, to be auctioned at the Autumn Equinox, and Gildenheim was fortified.

Spiral.t: The Vicente School and Orphanage was built in Apulus. The restoration of the Castle of Thorns throne room passed but was not enacted.

The Barrens.t: Drycastle in Dawnguard was rebuilt with 50 thrones. The commission also created the titles Knight of Dawnguard and Reeve of Drycastle.

386YE Summer Solstice Synod judgements.d: Corey Wayfarer's mandate, which required a greater majority, committed Navarr to fighting the vallorn, and many assemblies pledged support. Mandates sent missionaries and support to Asavea and fleets to aid the Sumaah. They also consecrated the Spires of Dusk to Ambition, sent Urizen magicians to bring in the Marcher harvest, and removed the Black Plateau's penalties in Spiral. Statements warned of the Druj along the eastern border and addressed Mareave, the Rahvin and the paragon Vardas, now found never to have existed. Bohemond de Rondell lost his Astolat seat and Hugh Farrier was removed as Champion of Prosperity. Amika Acciai and Dogri Thulebane were recognised as exemplars. Sabella of the Silent Tide sought a veto of the Senate's ban on preaching in Asavea.

Dawn.t: Dawn lost Bohemond de Rondell as Senator for Astolat, and its assembly rejected a call to settle the Barrens but declared the territory Dawnish forever. The assembly also backed the Rahvin claim to the Fangs and urged Dawn to strike the Druj before turning on the vallorn.

Druj.t: The Synod warned that the Druj were active in Therunin, the Barrens and Morrow. Highborn statements called for their removal from the continent and for Highguard to rebuild the Salt Flats of Sanath afterwards.

Grendel.t: The Wisdom assembly urged veterans to teach the Empire how to kill Grendel sharks and kraken. Other statements called on fleets to train against the kraken the Grendel had loosed, and the Tamazi were sent to Mareave partly to guard it against the Grendel threat.

Highguard.t: The Highborn assembly invited Navarr Guides and Wintermark Stormcrows to teach at Bastion and declared peerless kinship with Navarr in Therunin. It also claimed a destiny to rebuild the Salt Flats of Sanath and sent the unconquered into Southmoor to spoil Jotun caches.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Freeborn and Pride assemblies recognised the nation's chosen name, the Unshackled. Marcher and Freeborn farmers were urged to help cultivate arid Mareave, and an enacted mandate sent the Tamazi there. The Imperial Orc assembly also invited the Rahvin back to help them survive the coming winter.

Jotun.t: Navarr called on its people to prepare to reclaim Liathaven from the Jotun. The Marcher miners of the Mournwold were urged to fight the Jotun invasion, and an enacted mandate set Highborn unconquered to spoiling Jotun supply caches in Southmoor.

Navarr.t: A greater-majority mandate committed Navarr to fighting the vallorn, and nations from Dawn to the League pledged their support. Navarr also swore kinship with the Great Forest Orcs and called for Rhonwen's Fall to be rebuilt.

The Brass Coast.t: The Freeborn assembly sent farmers to help make Mareave fertile and warned those along the Scorrero of flooding from the plan to cleanse the Great Grasses. It also urged captains to explore the east, proposed rebuilding Siroc's orphanage alongside the Sumaah, and castigated Ramos for marching on the dhomiro's meeting.

The League.t: League judgements addressed the rat plague in Temeschwar, the Tassato orphans' rivalry with Sanvar Isk and fair wages for Urizeni workers in Spiral. An enacted mandate urged Apulian to welcome Urizen magicians, and another launched a hunt for cannibal butchers in Holberg.

The Marches.t: A Urizen mandate sent magicians to help bring in the Marcher harvest. A Marcher mandate will add the smith archetype after the Autumn Equinox, and beaters were sent after the traitor Dalton Royse. Marchers were also warned of an Asavean attack on Meade.

Thule.t: Mentioned in passing: the recognition of Dogri Thulebane as an exemplar noted that the Thule took Crow's Ridge after his stand.

Urizen.t: Urizen backed its Skyways project, a higher Arch of the Sky and the new national warmage position. Its magicians were sent to help with the Marcher harvest and to use the mithril block in Spiral again. Urizen fleets were not moved by the general mandate to aid the Sumaah.

Varushka.t: The Varushkan assembly urged the Iron Helms to master curses and warned of wolves crossing the warded roads. It also declared Delev open for trade and honoured the wardens whose deeds had been credited to the fictional Vardas. Separately, the Nine set the Silent Bell to investigate the Warhound Assembly in Karsk.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark's Stormcrows were invited to teach at Bastion, Kindra Surefoot entered the Book of Heroes and Dogri Thulebane was recognised as an exemplar of Loyalty. The Wintermark assembly also denounced Siakha's boons, urged hospitality to the mystics of Ishal and revived talk of Gunnar's Deephall.

386YE Summer Solstice Synod judgements.o: At the Summer Solstice 386YE summit the Imperial Synod raised 216 judgements. Navarr was committed to war against the vallorn, missionaries were sent to Asavea, and Bohemond de Rondell was revoked as Senator for Astolat.

Bastion/Sybella Cross.t: Mentioned in passing: a failed recognition of Doctor Tolame cited the ministry hospital he founded in Sybella Cross.

Casinea/Woodwych.t: Mentioned in passing: Ardeniel of Woodwych Harts was among the Highborn given Loyal Pilgrim testimonies by Navarr.

Holberg/Misericorde.t: The Prosperity and League assemblies invited the Sand Fishers of Misericorde to a cultural exchange at Anvil, praising their work on the Flaxen Pillars weirwood grove.

Madruga/Free Landing.t: The waters around Free Landing, infested with immature kraken in Spring, prompted an Ambition call for fleets to train to slay them.

Mournwold/Ore Hills.t: The Marcher assembly called on the miners of the Mourn to arm and come down the hillside against the Jotun, recalling the Ore Hills rebellion.

Mournwold/Southmoor.t: An enacted Highborn mandate sent vigilant unconquered to root out and spoil the Jotun's hidden supply caches in Southmoor.

The Barrens/Bitter Strand.t: Mentioned in passing: a Dawnish judgement noted the Emperor vetoed the Rahvin treaty because it would have given away Dawnish homes in Bitter Strand.

Astolat.t: Bohemond de Rondell was revoked and removed as Senator for Astolat over his pursuit of the Barrens for Dawn alone.

Bastion.t: Highborn judgements invited Navarr and Wintermark delegations to teach in Bastion once the Grand Inspiration of the Way is complete. A Freeborn mandate to rally support for the holy city failed.

Casinea.t: Mentioned in passing: one judgement wrongly placed the great cathedral in Casinea, when the Grand Inspiration is being built in Bastion.

Hercynia.t: Mentioned in passing: notes record Great Forest Orc steadings around weirwood groves in Hercynia.

Holberg.t: An enacted League mandate sent hunters to root out a conspiracy of cannibal butchers beneath Holberg. The Sand Fishers living in Holberg were invited to Anvil.

Kallavesa.t: Mentioned in passing: Dogri Thulebane's recognition cited the opportunity to build his tomb in the Sovevann in Kallavesa.

Karsk.t: The Council of Nine directed the Silent Bell to investigate the funding of the Warhound Assembly in Karsk. Varushka also recalled Navarr standing with it when Karsk was attacked.

Liathaven.t: The Navarr assembly called on the few remaining steadings, and any willing stridings, to prepare provisions and weapons for thorns marching to reclaim Liathaven from the Jotun.

Madruga.t: An Ambition statement cited the kraken the Children of Wrecks had loosed in Madruga's waters and called on Marcher and Wintermark fleets to train to face them.

Mareave.t: The League welcomed Mareave's assignment to the Imperial Orcs and encouraged trade through Spiral. Marcher and Freeborn farmers were urged to help cultivate its arid land, and an enacted mandate sent the Tamazi there.

Miaren.t: Navarr called for Rhonwen's Fall to be rebuilt after the Cold Sun's scions desecrated it. Highborn who defended Miaren with the Granite Pillar were given Loyal Pilgrim testimonies.

Mitwold.t: The Marcher assembly warned that Asavean forces sought to sack Meade and promised that the Drakes were coming home. Mitwold's new senator, Hal Talbot, was called to inquisition.

Mournwold.t: Mournwold miners were urged to rise against the Jotun invaders, and unconquered were sent to spoil Jotun caches in Southmoor. The Pride assembly also called artisans to build the Orchard of the Watch memorial in the ruins of Overton.

Ossium.t: The Synod warned that the Druj threaten the eastern border from Ossium to Zenith. Vasili, the Pride of Ossium, was called to inquisition over his past life vision.

Salt Flats of Sanath.t: The Highborn assembly declared that once the Druj are defeated, Highguard should govern the Salt Flats of Sanath and rebuild Leen as a beacon of the Way.

Spiral.t: An enacted Urizen mandate removed the Black Plateau's penalties on Spiral's economy through use of the mithril block. Urizeni were urged to explore its vacant spires, and the League warned that Black Plateau tours were a scam.

Tassato.t: The League assembly challenged the orphans of Tassato to pitch a plan to rival Sanvar Isk's college, promising its support.

Temeschwar.t: The League assembly urged vigilance against the rat plague in Temeschwar, and its bishops opened their doors to the sick.

The Barrens.t: An enacted mandate consecrated the Spires of Dusk to Ambition. A Dawnish call to settle the Barrens failed, but the Dawnish assembly declared the territory Dawnish forever and pledged to defend its foreign peoples too. 'Race for the Barrens' was put forward as the winning song in the Weavers of Culwich's contest, though it fell short of the greater majority needed.

Therunin.t: With the Druj invading Therunin, Highguard pledged support under peerless kinship and Navarr guarded against hatred. Navarr also warned that Agramant preys on the desperate in the territory now outside the Empire.

Zenith.t: Urizen recognised the plan to raise a higher Arch of the Sky for Zenith's prosperity, while the Synod warned that the Druj threaten the border reaching to Zenith.

386YE Summer Solstice event schedule.d: Nine nations held senatorial elections in their camps on Saturday afternoon, each by its own custom. Tally of the Votes elections for national titles followed from 3:30pm. The Senate sat on Friday night, Saturday afternoon and evening, and Sunday afternoon, with deadlines for motions before each session. The Military Council met after the Saturday and Sunday battles off Anvil. Conclave convened on Friday and Saturday evenings, and the Saturday events included Grandmaster elections and the auction for Imperial Bourse positions. The Synod was open for judgements throughout. Citizen-organised meetings appeared alongside official ones, including a Friday meeting on the Thule, the Vallorn Guard meeting and a Senate Motions dance.

Dawn.t: Dawn elected the senator for Weirwater at 2:30pm on Saturday in its camp, immediately after the tourney.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: Grendel is not named, but Mareave, which it held, appears in the schedule's senatorial election listings under the Imperial Orcs.

Highguard.t: Highguard began its inquisition of candidates for the Bastion senatorship at 2:00pm. It elected the Vigilant Swan, the Cinderpath Custodian and the Golden Fleet Salvagemaster by Tally of the Votes at 5:00pm in the Chapel.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Imperial Orcs were listed to hold a senatorial election for Mareave at 2:15pm, with candidates presenting items of worth. They elected the Preceptor of the Skarsind College of Warcasting at the Fire Pit at 4:30pm.

Navarr.t: Navarr elected the Miaren senator at 1:30pm, immediately after standing. It chose the Broker of Treji Wayhouse at the Standing Circle at 5:00pm.

The League.t: The League elected senators for both Sarvos and Spiral at 2:30pm through the presentation of collected bonds. It chose the Northbound Trademaster, the Keeper of the Tome and the Master of Rings at the Plaza at 5:30pm.

The Marches.t: The landowners of the Marches gathered at 1:30pm to elect the Mitwold senator. The Reeve of the Happiston Mana Exchange and the Master of the Root and Stem were chosen at the Community Hall at 3:30pm.

Thule.t: Mentioned in passing: a citizen-organised Friday-evening meeting about the Thule was booked in the Hall of Worlds.

Urizen.t: Urizen's demos for the Redoubt senatorship began at 2:00pm. The Quaymaster of the Elosian Docks, the Architect of the Crucible and the Architect of the Conscious River were elected near the Net of Heaven at 4:00pm.

Varushka.t: Varushka began questioning candidates for the Karov senatorship at 1:45pm. It elected the Granites of Veltsgorsk, the Boyar of the Iron Roads, the Burgher of Ketsov and the Custodian of the Shchaslyvyy Spile at the Central Hearth at 5:30pm.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark elected senators for Sermersuaq and Hahnmark at 2:00pm, with the jars placed down for 30 minutes. It chose the Kalpaheim Tradeholder at the Tree of Names at 3:30pm.

386YE Summer Solstice event schedule.o: The Civil Service published the timetable for the Summer Solstice 386YE summit at Anvil. It set out senatorial elections, Tally of the Votes elections for national titles, and the sessions of the Senate, Military Council, Conclave, Synod, Bourse, Academy and Militia across the weekend.

Bastion.t: Bastion's senator was elected by Highguard, beginning with the inquisition of candidates at 2:00pm on Saturday.

Hahnmark.t: Hahnmark's senator was elected by Wintermark at 2:00pm, although the next regular election for the seat was due at the Autumn Equinox 386YE.

Karov.t: Karov's senator was chosen by Varushka, with questioning of candidates beginning at 1:45pm.

Mareave.t: A senatorial election for Mareave was listed under the Imperial Orcs at 2:15pm, with candidates presenting items of worth.

Miaren.t: Miaren's senator was elected by Navarr at 1:30pm, immediately after standing.

Mitwold.t: Mitwold's senator was chosen by the Marcher landowners, who gathered at 1:30pm.

Redoubt.t: Redoubt's senator was elected through a Urizen demos beginning at 2:00pm.

Sarvos.t: Sarvos's senator was elected by the League at 2:30pm through the presentation of collected bonds.

Sermersuaq.t: Sermersuaq's senator was elected by Wintermark at 2:00pm, with jars placed down for 30 minutes.

Skarsind.t: Mentioned in passing: the Preceptor of the Skarsind College of Warcasting was among the Imperial Orc titles elected by Tally of the Votes.

Spiral.t: Spiral's senator was elected by the League at 2:30pm alongside Sarvos's, through the presentation of collected bonds.

Weirwater.t: Weirwater's senator was elected by Dawn at 2:30pm, immediately after the tourney.

386YE Summer Solstice interlude.d: Military units and fleets could send aid to Rachensgrab after Eska Crowspeaker's addition to the Chronicle of Heroism. League units could hunt rats in Temeschwar, Wintermark units could pursue Maarik the Golden Tongue in the Silver Peaks, and Imperial Orc and Golden Pyramid units could clear trogoni from Crimson Peak Mining. Those carrying Siakha's boons were offered a chance to slaughter Druj, Grendel or Jotun civilians. The Guerdon was set at 150 thrones, shared by units supporting the Valiant Pegasus and Wolves of War. Madruga suffered two Siakha-empowered curses and Sermersuaq prospered. Shifts in religious fortune touched Vigilance, Loyalty, the Way and Urizen's congregations. Contributions were invited for Imperatrix Lisabetta's memorial.

Dawn.t: Dawnish fleets continued to suffer reduced production because of the sovereign Dho'uala's rise in the Semmerlak.

Druj.t: Druj civilians were named among the targets that Siakha-blessed Imperial units and fleets might slaughter for their wealth, if enough captains took the adventure.

Grendel.t: Grendel civilians were named among the targets that Siakha-blessed Imperial units and fleets might slaughter for their wealth, if enough captains took the adventure.

Highguard.t: Prosperity and Ambition congregations in Necropolis gained income from Sarcophan visitors. Necropolis was also chosen as the site of Imperatrix Lisabetta's memorial, to be completed by the Summer Solstice.

Imperial Orcs.t: Imperial Orc military units, alongside the Golden Pyramid, were invited to clear the trogoni from Crimson Peak Mining so the prospectors could claim it, earning orichalcum in the process.

Jotun.t: Jotun civilians were named among the targets that Siakha-blessed Imperial units and fleets might slaughter for their wealth, if enough captains took the adventure.

The Brass Coast.t: Madruga was wracked by storms from two Siakha-empowered curses. Tharim's black frost drained Brass Coast mana sites and herb gardens until the start of the Summer Solstice, in return for steel-bound knights aiding the Fire of the South.

The League.t: Temeschwar reeled from its rat crisis as people fled the city: farms and paid-work units profited, while Lorenzo's Great Game and the Bloody Great Theatre lost their benefits. Tassato and Sarvos congregations gained income, but Holberg fleets suffered under Dho'uala.

Thule.t: After one of the Winterfolk was elected Ambassador to Otkodov, the Thule allowed Wintermark's military units to hunt Maarik the Golden Tongue in Sermersuaq's Silver Peaks.

Urizen.t: Urizen's congregations lost two votes and one liao each until the start of the Winter Solstice, a consequence of the repudiation of Sulemaine. Meanwhile, Prosperity and Ambition congregations in Redoubt gained income from Sarcophan visitors.

Varushka.t: Varushkan fleets continued to suffer reduced production from Dho'uala. Prosperity and Ambition congregations in Karsk gained income thanks to the Sarcophan Mooring.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark's military units were permitted to hunt Maarik the Golden Tongue in the Silver Peaks, with a chance for heroes to bring him to justice if a thousand force was committed. The Winterfolk of Sermersuaq also shared in the territory's newfound prosperity.

386YE Summer Solstice interlude.o: Ahead of the Summer Solstice 386YE, a set of opportunities and ongoing effects shaped the Empire's coming season. These included new tasks for military units and fleets, rat-plagued Temeschwar, storms over Madruga, Dho'uala's grip on the Semmerlak and shifts in congregation fortunes.

Sermersuaq/Silver Peaks.t: The Silver Peaks became the hunting ground for Maarik the Golden Tongue, where Wintermark heroes would have a chance to bring him to justice if at least a thousand force was assigned.

Holberg.t: Fleets based in Holberg continued to lose a rank of production to the terror of Dho'uala in the Semmerlak.

Karsk.t: Thanks to the Sarcophan Mooring, Prosperity and Ambition congregations in Karsk received an extra 18 rings from curious Sarcophan visitors.

Madruga.t: Storms wracked Madruga after the cults of Siakha performed both Foam and Spittle of the Furious Sea and Thunderous Deluge, which the heroes of Anvil failed to prevent.

Necropolis.t: Prosperity and Ambition congregations in Necropolis gained extra income from Sarcophan visitors. Imperatrix Lisabetta's memorial was being raised there, to become a folly if at least ten wains were contributed.

Otkodov.t: Mentioned in passing: the election of one of the Winterfolk as Ambassador to Otkodov prompted the Thule to permit the hunt for Maarik.

Redoubt.t: Prosperity and Ambition congregations in Redoubt received an extra 18 rings from Sarcophan visitors.

Sarvos.t: Prosperity and Ambition congregations in Sarvos received an extra 18 rings from Sarcophan visitors.

Sermersuaq.t: Having endured the harsh winter and Agramant's machinations, the people of Sermersuaq saw every personal resource produce an extra 22 rings until the start of the Winter Solstice. Wintermark units were also free to hunt Maarik in its Silver Peaks.

Tassato.t: Prosperity and Ambition congregations in Tassato received an extra 18 rings from Sarcophan visitors.

Temeschwar.t: With rats plaguing the city and the Unfettered Mind investigating, people left or avoided gatherings. Farms, paid-work military units and the Reapers' Repose profited, and League units could earn rings hunting rats in the sewers.

The Semmerlak.t: Dho'uala's presence in the Semmerlak continued to plague fleets with eerie encounters. It also kept prices raised for the Custodian of the Ivarsgard Docks and the Harbourmaster of the Semmerlak.

386YE Summer Solstice winds of fortune.d: Winds included Emperor Vesna's address and diplomatic updates on the Commonwealth, Jarm, the Delves, Sumaah, Asavea, Axos, Faraden and neighbouring orc nations. Appraisals covered the Sovereign Dho'uala and Sermersuaq's prosperity. Navarr and Highguard faced a final choice about the vallorn. The Children of Wrecks seized Free Landing. Holberg uncovered a cannibal conspiracy, Temeschwar's rat plague continued, and Mareave's development began. Of the major conjunctions, Wintermark defeated Jarl Idunn in Kallavesa and an Urizen-led force struck Siakha's cults in Madruga. Liathaven was left unchallenged, leaving the Green March under Jotun threat. Many lesser conjunctions defeated husks, Grendel, Jotun, vallornspawn and Dry Patricians, though scions survived in Skarsind and Karov.

Dawn.t: Dawn faced opportunities as its legacy took root in the Barrens, and Dawnish military units gained access to a vallorn-guarded trove in Brocéliande. Sites were also proposed for a memorial to the troubadour Ozren de Orzel.

Druj.t: Mentioned in passing: named among the four orc nations surrounding the Empire, and recalled as the besiegers of the Gates of Ipotavo.

Grendel.t: Grendel raiders were slain in Spiral, Necropolis and Mareave, and the former Grendel priestess Shivaarn now leads the Children of Wrecks. The Grendel port of Oran remained closed to Imperial fleets.

Highguard.t: Highguard was called to make its choice over the final destruction of the vallorn and to pursue its peerless kinship with the Marches. Grendel were driven out of three Necropolis sites, and salvage auction rights in Arbonne were bought on Highguard's behalf.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Imperial Orcs began transforming newly assigned Mareave, where the Golden Pyramid struck gold. At Pakaanan's Pass in Skarsind, Imperial heroes suffered heavy casualties and most of the scions survived.

Jotun.t: Jotun forces lost Jarl Idunn's fight in Kallavesa and were defeated in Kahraman and Sermersuaq. Their Liathaven conjunction went unchallenged, leaving them with increased resupply there and threatening the Green March.

Navarr.t: The Navarr faced the profound decision over the vallorn and an opportunity to explore the power of wayhouses. Their efforts in the south of the Barrens began to bear fruit, and the Dance of Navarr and Thorn was performed in Hercynia.

The Brass Coast.t: The Freeborn confronted the Children of Wrecks off Madruga and a curse on their hakima. Three Dry Patricians were destroyed in Segura and Kahraman, opening a chance to end the Blight decisively.

The League.t: The League confronted a cannibal conspiracy tied to Agramant in Holberg and the continuing rat plague in Temeschwar. It must also decide the future of Apulian, where Urizeni settlers are growing in number.

The Marches.t: The Marcher Assembly faced a growing rift with its people and continued to seek rapprochement with Urizen. It also had to deal with the cursed Anvil of Silence. Marcher armies were bound by oaths to defend their home territories, and the Green March was left under Jotun threat.

Thule.t: Mentioned in passing: listed among the orc nations with which the Empire keeps careful diplomatic relations, covered further in The Price of Peace.

Urizen.t: Urizen continued its exchange of ideas with the Marches, and the rebellion in Ankra and Cinion was stabilised. Urizeni settlers are increasingly shaping Apulian, and an Urizen field marshal led the strike on Siakha's cults.

Varushka.t: A Varushkan cabalist conducted the appraisal into the Sovereign Dho'uala around the Semmerlak. In Karov, the Festering Warden and Iron Boyar were defeated, but the Haamrikoht Stone was sundered.

Wintermark.t: Iron Osric of Wintermark led the victory over Jarl Idunn, claiming the Banner of the Bear Who Swims and recovering the Sibling Swords. An appraisal proposed ways to make Sermersuaq more prosperous.

386YE Summer Solstice winds of fortune.o: The Summer Solstice 386YE winds of fortune gathered the season's briefings on foreign diplomacy, eternals, appraisals, national opportunities and threats. They also recorded the outcomes of the Spring Equinox Sentinel Gate conjunctions and the current state of foreign trade.

Bastion/Sybella Cross.t: Regrow the Land's Heart was performed at the Disordered Expanse.

Brocéliande/Black Boughs.t: Vallornspawn were slain at the Trove of Gral'athet, and Dawnish military units were given access to the trove.

Brocéliande/Vale's Lament.t: Vallornspawn were slain at Cara's Thicket and the thorns were saved.

Feroz/Morajasse.t: A suspicious Faraden agent was targeted at Taziolar's Woods. The outcome is uncertain, though Valens Leos may know more.

Hercynia/Deer's Folly.t: Vallornspawn at the Toxic Dell were distracted while the Dance of Navarr and Thorn was successfully performed.

Hercynia/Summersend.t: Most of the boggarts at Merel's Glade were killed.

Kahraman/Gambit.t: The Jotun were defeated on the Path of Sofia, and Escuta was denied extra resupply.

Kahraman/Jade Range.t: An Irremais-marked Patrician was destroyed. Nemi i Riqueza may know more about the Lasambrian champion.

Karov/Duzekani.t: The Festering Warden was defeated and its husks slain at the Broken Copse.

Karov/Malimorzi.t: The Iron Boyar was defeated and its husks slain on the Granite Path.

Karov/Wieliczka.t: Imperial heroes took heavy casualties, most of the scions survived and the Haamrikoht Stone was sundered.

Liathaven/Liath's Ring.t: The chance to thwart Beater Royse at Wyndyn Path was not taken.

Madruga/Free Landing.t: The Children of Wrecks have taken Free Landing. At Siakha's Maw, kraken eggs were released and Sea Mage Tuairisc survived.

Mareave/Eoradal.t: The Grendel were stopped from escaping the Old Skouran Orchard, and treasure was retrieved.

Mareave/Fleisardh.t: The opportunity to capture the Brine Turtles at Brine Blood Bay was not taken, and the situation there is unclear.

Miaren/Goldglades.t: Imperial heroes met the Burning Vine at the Old Green Fort. The outcome is uncertain, though Aniera Exiles End may know more.

Mournwold/Green March.t: The Green March is under threat from the Jotun after the Liathaven conjunction went untaken.

Necropolis/Highrod.t: The Grendel at the Coppice of Athaliah were slain and both ghosts were put to rest.

Necropolis/Longbeach.t: All the Grendel at Ada's Woods were slain and their intelligence recovered.

Segura/Burnish.t: Align the Celestial Net was performed at the Ring of Dust and Glass, neutralising the remnants of the Fire Beacon.

Segura/Lucksprings.t: A Naeve-marked Patrician was destroyed at the Parched Springs, and dust was recovered.

Segura/Sobral Grasses.t: Gideon of the Farthest Shore was rescued and a Yoorn-marked Patrician destroyed.

Sermersuaq/Suaq Fount.t: Freydis and her Jotun were defeated at Hanleth's Wastes.

Skarsind/Pakaanan's Pass.t: At Bitter Hollow, Imperial heroes suffered heavy casualties, most of the scions survived and the force of Storm Pass was channelled.

Spiral/Ankra.t: The Urizen rebellion here was largely resolved or stabilised by the treaty with the Silver Flame.

Spiral/Cinion.t: The Urizen rebellion here was largely resolved or stabilised by the treaty with the Silver Flame, though some rebels remain irreconcilable.

Spiral/Ossuary.t: The Grendel at Lucia's Grove were all slain and the Legacy protected.

Spiral/Screed.t: The Grendel at Sabina's Sward were all slain.

Upwold/Birchland.t: All the boggarts at James' Orchard were rescued.

Weirwater/Weirmoor.t: The Broken Errant was defeated and its husks slain at Roland's Stand.

Weirwater/Wickmoor.t: All the boggarts at Regan's Glade were rescued.

Bastion.t: Imperial heroes successfully performed Regrow the Land's Heart at Sybella Cross.

Bay of Catazar.t: The Children of Wrecks, a coalition inspired by Siakha, formed in the bay and made it impossible to challenge them without a navy.

Bregasland.t: Mentioned in passing: the situation there gave the Highborn pause over kinship aid, and General Amberlain has sworn the Strong Reeds will defend it.

Brocéliande.t: Vallornspawn were slain at Black Boughs and Vale's Lament, saving thorns and opening a trove to Dawnish units.

Feroz.t: Heroes moved to intercept a suspicious Faraden agent at Morajasse, with an uncertain outcome.

Hahnmark.t: Mentioned in passing: a Hahnmark magician with a peculiar boon is seeking herbalists and stormcrows at Anvil.

Hercynia.t: Vallornspawn were distracted and the Dance of Navarr and Thorn performed at Deer's Folly, but most of the boggarts at Summersend were killed.

Holberg.t: A cannibal conspiracy linked to Agramant was exposed in Holberg just as a gourmet enchantment settled over the territory.

Kahraman.t: The Jotun were defeated at Gambit and kept from resupplying Escuta, while an Irremais-marked Patrician was destroyed in the Jade Range.

Kallavesa.t: Jarl Idunn was defeated at Hvalgrunn, where the Banner of the Bear Who Swims was claimed and the Sibling Swords recovered.

Karov.t: Husk leaders were defeated at Duzekani and Malimorzi, but at Wieliczka the scions largely survived and the Haamrikoht Stone was sundered.

Liathaven.t: The chance to thwart Beater Royse was not taken, so the Jotun gained increased resupply in Liathaven and the fate of the Feni remains unknown.

Madruga.t: The Children of Wrecks hold Free Landing. A strike on Siakha's cults saw kraken eggs released along the coast and two storm curses cast on Madruga.

Mareave.t: Newly assigned to the Imperial Orcs, Mareave faces transformation, and the Golden Pyramid has struck gold there. Grendel were stopped at Eoradal, though the Brine Turtles were left alone.

Miaren.t: A meeting with the Burning Vine at Goldglades had an uncertain outcome, and a mystery of art and magic touches the territory.

Mountains of the Moon.t: Mentioned in passing: Axos remains angry over Imperial involvement in the failure of its joint venture with the Grendel into these mountains.

Mournwold.t: The Green March was left under threat from the Jotun because the Liathaven conjunction went untaken.

Necropolis.t: Grendel were wiped out at Sanctuary Sands, Longbeach and Highrod, with an heirloom and intelligence recovered and two ghosts laid to rest.

Otkodov.t: Mentioned in passing: the Ambassador to Otkodov is among those addressed by The Price of Peace.

Sea of Snow.t: Mentioned in passing: those travelling the Sea of Snow are flagged as interested in the Tales of Mystery.

Segura.t: Dry Patricians were destroyed at Sobral Grasses and Lucksprings, with a magician rescued and dust recovered, and the Fire Beacon remnants at Burnish were neutralised.

Sermersuaq.t: An appraisal proposed ways to make Sermersuaq more prosperous, Freydis and her Jotun were defeated at Suaq Fount, and Cathan Canae has made an offer to its people.

Skarsind.t: At Pakaanan's Pass, Imperial heroes suffered significant casualties, most of the scions survived and the force of Storm Pass was channelled.

Spiral.t: The rebellion in Ankra and Cinion was stabilised and Grendel were slain at Screed and Ossuary, while Apulian's future draws League and Urizeni interest.

Temeschwar.t: The rat plague continued as the Unfettered Mind gathered leads, leaving the Chamber of Commerce to decide how to proceed.

The Barrens.t: The Dawnish legacy is taking root amid an uneasy calm as the fate of the remaining orc septs is settled.

Upwold.t: All the boggarts at Birchland were guided home safely.

Weirwater.t: The Broken Errant was defeated at Weirmoor and all the boggarts at Wickmoor were rescued.

386YE Summer Solstice winds of war.d: The Empire moved to destroy the last two Cold Sun armies, in Miaren and Hahnmark. Lasambrian Jotun pressed on in Kahraman, and other Jotun armies marched from Liath's Ring into Gravenmarch and Southmoor, where they besieged Sarcombe to restore Jarl Haakon. In Madruga, Empire, Grendel and children of wrecks fought amid a century-worst hurricane raised by Siakha's followers in Free Landing. In Mareave, a Senate compromise saw the Brine Turtles withdraw, Fleisardh claimed and Beoraidh neutral. Two Dawnish armies watched the Black Wind in the Barrens while a Druj host ravaged Therunin. Three battle opportunities were identified: Therunin, Madruga and Bregasland.

Dawn.t: Two Dawnish armies watched the Black Wind in the Barrens as its sept sought to flee. Dawn brought the largest force weight (54), and its armies cannot take the Cautious Advance or Give Ground orders.

Druj.t: A great Druj host poured out of the Sarangrave into Therunin, burning and killing. Druj forces also faced Imperial conjunctions in the Barrens, the Forest of Ulnak and Morrow.

Grendel.t: The Grendel fought the Empire and the children of wrecks for Madruga during a cataclysmic hurricane. Imperial heroes could attempt to assassinate Rahab and Questioner Polh, and face Grendel forces in Ayereed and Siluri.

Highguard.t: Mentioned in passing: listed with a force weight of 18 for the summit's battles; a conjunction to stop wreckers was also offered in Necropolis.

Imperial Orcs.t: Imperial Orc control of Mareave became uncontested after the Brine Turtles withdrew. An Imperial Orc army in blizzard-struck Skarsind can take the Forge Hammers order.

Jotun.t: The Jotun attacked on three fronts: the Lasambrian Jotun in Kahraman, two armies into Gravenmarch, and western orc armies into Southmoor to besiege Sarcombe for Jarl Haakon. Imperial heroes could try to stop the Burhfæst in Bregasland.

Navarr.t: The Cold Sun's Empty Hands army remained in Miaren as the Empire moved against it, while the Druj ravaged Navarr's Therunin. Navarr brought a force weight of 50.

The Brass Coast.t: The Brass Coast faced the Lasambrian Jotun in Kahraman and a storm-wracked war with the Grendel and children of wrecks in Madruga, where many conjunctions were offered.

The League.t: Mentioned in passing: listed with a force weight of 20; conjunctions were offered in League territories of Temeschwar, Sarvos and Spiral.

The Marches.t: Jotun armies marched into Southmoor in Mournwold, besieging Sarcombe. Marcher armies cannot Give Ground but gain strength fighting in their home territories, and any army may billet in Bregasland, Upwold or Mitwold.

Thule.t: Mentioned in passing: the Ambassador to Otkodov was named responsible for a conjunction to kill Maarik the Golden Tongue in Sermersuaq.

Urizen.t: Mentioned in passing: listed with a force weight of 13, with conjunctions in Redoubt and Morrow and standing rules for fighting between Zenith and Morrow.

Varushka.t: Varushkan armies generate fewer victory points when campaigning alongside Brass Coast or Wintermark armies, and can take Hospitality of the Boyars in Ossium; a conjunction against the scions was offered in Miekarova.

Wintermark.t: The Cold Sun's Silence Arc remained in Hahnmark as the Empire moved to end it. Wintermark brought a force weight of 53, and its armies can Fight with Honour and fight under special modifiers against the Jotun.

386YE Summer Solstice winds of war.o: The Summer Solstice 386YE Winds of War summarised a stormy season of fighting across the Empire, against the Cold Sun's scions, the Jotun, the Grendel and the Druj, and listed the battle opportunities and Sentinel Gate conjunctions for the coming summit.

Ayereed/Gainmeachdubh.t: The General of the Red Wind Corsairs was named responsible for a conjunction to kill the Grendel at Dunreagh's Brush.

Bregasland/Gravenmarch.t: Two Jotun armies marched in from Liath's Ring, and a battle to stop the Burhfæst at Rock Foot Wood was offered.

Brocéliande/Boar's Dell.t: The Spear of the Seven was named responsible for a conjunction to resolve the mystery of Starstrand Steading.

Forest of Ulnak/Grimfen Mire.t: A conjunction was offered to claim the stockpile at Varnalis' Cache.

Hahnmark/Wood Heath.t: Tobrytan Dunning was named responsible for a conjunction to stop the scions at Dun's Reach.

Kahraman/Braydon's Jasse.t: Two Jotun armies marched south from Liath's Ring into Braydon's Jasse.

Karsk/Moresvah.t: The Custodian of the Lost was named responsible for a conjunction at Gorek's Hollow.

Liathaven/Liath's Ring.t: Four Jotun armies marched out of Liath's Ring, two towards Kahraman and two towards Bregasland.

Madruga/Calvos Sound.t: The Strategos of the Brass Coast was named responsible for a conjunction at the Orchard of Tabhorios.

Madruga/Free Landing.t: Siakha's followers who held Free Landing evoked the hurricane that struck Madruga; a conjunction to the Baleen Cave was offered.

Mareave/Beoraidh.t: The orcs of Beoraidh established their neutrality as the Brine Turtles retreated south with much of their sept.

Mareave/Fleisardh.t: Imperial armies claimed Fleisardh without a fight.

Miekarova/Srodkoja.t: A conjunction was offered to stop the scions at Biljana's Sward.

Mitwold/Meade March.t: A conjunction was offered to slay Urse Longarm at Jenny's Copse.

Mitwold/Oddmire.t: A conjunction was offered to make sure the ghosts at Halebale Farm were exorcised.

Morrow/Peregro.t: A conjunction was offered at the Still Glade to kill the Druj and, if possible, rescue Megaris.

Mournwold/Ore Hills.t: Mentioned in passing: the sixtieth anniversary of the Ore Hills rebellion falls next season.

Mournwold/Southmoor.t: Western orc armies besieged Sarcombe to restore Jarl Haakon, and a conjunction to trace ghosts at the Glen of Red Shadow was offered.

Necropolis/Longbeach.t: A conjunction was offered to stop the wreckers at the Grove of Silence.

Redoubt/Naris.t: A conjunction was offered to stop the scions at the Tilphussian Pass.

Redoubt/Siluri.t: A conjunction was offered to defeat the Grendel at Lucia's Holt.

Sarvos/Bocche.t: A conjunction was offered to stop the wreckers at Ferocity's Stand.

Sarvos/Foracci.t: Constanza i Kalamar i Guerra and Marta i Guerra were named responsible for a large conjunction to join a debate at the Solare Estate.

Sermersuaq/Silver Peaks.t: A conjunction was offered to kill Maarik the Golden Tongue at Aino's Rest.

Sermersuaq/Suaq Wastes.t: Conjunctions were offered to kill the Jotun and deal with Big Icebarn and Little Icebarn.

Skallahn/Iron Stand.t: A conjunction was offered to kill the Jotun at Auguaard's Bluff.

Spiral/Screed.t: Two conjunctions were offered to rescue citizens near Harrier's Nest.

Temeschwar/Hanuri.t: Conjunctions were offered to meet the Rat Kings guild at Terrier's Roar and to speak with Brinton von Temeschwar at the Old Priory.

The Barrens/The Bleaks.t: A conjunction was offered to stop the Druj and the heralds of Surut at the Hollow Tree.

Therunin/Lower Tarn Valley.t: A battle to prevent the Druj slaughter at Tarn Bend was offered.

Ayereed.t: A conjunction was offered to kill the Grendel at Dunreagh's Brush in Gainmeachdubh.

Bay of Catazar.t: Mentioned in passing: the narrative crosses the Bay of Catazar to Mareave, noting the absence of storms there.

Bregasland.t: Two Jotun armies marched north from Liath's Ring into Gravenmarch. Imperial heroes could try to stop the Burhfæst at Rock Foot Wood, and Imperial armies may billet here.

Brocéliande.t: A conjunction was offered to resolve the mystery of Starstrand Steading in Boar's Dell.

Forest of Ulnak.t: A conjunction was offered to claim the stockpile at Varnalis' Cache in Grimfen Mire.

Hahnmark.t: The Cold Sun's Silence Arc remained here as the Empire moved to end the invasion, with a conjunction to stop the scions at Dun's Reach.

Kahraman.t: The Lasambrian Jotun continued trying to conquer the cinnabar hills, as Imperial reinforcements arrived and two more Jotun armies marched into Braydon's Jasse.

Karsk.t: A conjunction was offered to find out what was happening in the vale of Gorek's Reach.

Liathaven.t: Jotun armies marched out of Liath's Ring, two south into Kahraman and two north into Bregasland.

Madruga.t: The Empire, Grendel and children of wrecks fought here as the worst storm in a century reshaped the land. Battle and many conjunctions were offered, including to assassinate Rahab.

Mareave.t: There was no fighting: the Brine Turtles retreated south, Imperial armies claimed Fleisardh, Beoraidh became neutral and Imperial Orc control became uncontested.

Miaren.t: The Cold Sun's Empty Hands army remained here as the Empire moved to end the invasion.

Miekarova.t: A conjunction was offered to stop the scions at Biljana's Sward in Srodkoja.

Mitwold.t: Conjunctions were offered to slay Urse Longarm and to exorcise ghosts. Imperial armies may billet here, and the Drakes gain strength fighting in Mitwold.

Morrow.t: A conjunction was offered to kill the Druj and, if possible, rescue Megaris in Peregro. Urizen and Highborn armies defending Morrow from Zenith gain a bonus.

Mournwold.t: Western orc armies marched into Southmoor and besieged Sarcombe to restore Jarl Haakon, ahead of the Ore Hills rebellion's sixtieth anniversary.

Necropolis.t: A conjunction was offered to stop the wreckers at the Grove of Silence in Longbeach.

Ossium.t: Mentioned in passing: Varushkan armies can take the Hospitality of the Boyars order here.

Otkodov.t: Mentioned in passing: the Ambassador to Otkodov was named responsible for a conjunction in Sermersuaq.

Redoubt.t: Conjunctions were offered to stop the scions in Naris and defeat the Grendel in Siluri.

Sarangrave.t: A great Druj host poured out of the Sarangrave to ravage Therunin.

Sarvos.t: Conjunctions were offered to stop wreckers in Bocche and to take part in a debate at the Solare Estate in Foracci.

Sermersuaq.t: Conjunctions were offered to kill the Jotun and deal with Big and Little Icebarn in the Suaq Wastes, and to kill Maarik the Golden Tongue in the Silver Peaks.

Skallahn.t: A conjunction was offered to kill the Jotun at Auguaard's Bluff in Iron Stand.

Skarsind.t: Skarsind suffered unseasonable blizzards; Imperial Orc armies there can take the Forge Hammers order.

Spiral.t: Two conjunctions were offered to rescue citizens near Harrier's Nest in Screed.

Temeschwar.t: Conjunctions were offered to meet the Rat Kings guild and to speak with Brinton von Temeschwar in Hanuri.

The Barrens.t: Two Dawnish armies watched the Black Wind as its sept sought to flee, and a conjunction was offered to stop the Druj and the heralds of Surut.

Therunin.t: A great Druj host poured in, burning and killing; Imperial heroes could fight to prevent the slaughter at Tarn Bend.

Upwold.t: Mentioned in passing: Imperial armies may billet here and the Bounders gain strength fighting in Upwold.

Zenith.t: Mentioned in passing: Highborn or Urizen armies attacking Zenith from Morrow gain a bonus to territory captured.

386YE Winter Solstice Imperial elections.d: Thirteen territories elected senators, among them Éamon Ashenmourn de Cordraco for Astolat, Rane Shardbearer for Kallavesa and Herminius of the House of the Wanderer for Zenith. The Senate appointed ambassadors to Axos, Jarm, the Grendel and the Iron Confederacy, eight generals and many title-holders, including the Grimnir of Wittal Grove. The Synod chose Luca i Taziel i Riqueza as Cardinal of Prosperity with 258 votes and Tabris, Son of Armisael, as Cardinal of the Way. The Military Council named strategoi for Highguard and Navarr. Bourse auctions and votes allocated numerous seats, such as Master of Rings, which went to Laughlan Vi Temeschwar with 680 votes.

Dawn.t: Dawn's territories of Astolat and Weirwater gained new senators: Éamon Ashenmourn de Cordraco and Tristan du Lac respectively.

Grendel.t: Garviel i Abrira i Erigo was elected Senator for Feroz, a territory Grendel held that season, and the Senate appointed Finna as Ambassador to the Grendel.

Highguard.t: Kish of the Flame Beneath the Earth became Senator for Necropolis, and the Military Council appointed Arlandria of the Sentinels Tower as Strategos of Highguard.

Imperial Orcs.t: Bloodcrow Rasp was elected Senator for Skarsind, the Imperial Orcs' territory.

Jotun.t: Willem Tarne was elected Senator for Bregasland, a territory the Jotun held that season.

Navarr.t: Rowyn of the Waystone Path became Senator for Hercynia, and the Military Council appointed Gryiff Embercast as Strategos of Navarr.

The League.t: Giuseppe Sanguineo von Temeschwar was elected Senator for Temeschwar, the League's territory.

The Marches.t: Hal Talbot was elected Senator for Mitwold, the Marcher territory.

Urizen.t: Herminius of the House of the Wanderer was elected Senator for Zenith, the Urizen territory.

Varushka.t: Varushka's two territories gained senators: Vaclav Mladenovich Kosti for Miekarova and Velko Perunovich Razoradze for Ossium.

Wintermark.t: Rane Shardbearer was elected Senator for Kallavesa, and Theowold Vakarsson was appointed Grimnir of Wittal Grove.

386YE Winter Solstice Imperial elections.o: At the 386YE Winter Solstice summit, Imperial elections and appointments filled a wide range of titles. These included senators for thirteen territories, Senate-appointed ambassadors and generals, Synod and Bourse positions, and several Military Council and Conclave offices.

Kallavesa/Wittal Grove.t: The Senate appointed Theowold Vakarsson as Grimnir of Wittal Grove.

Astolat.t: Éamon Ashenmourn de Cordraco was elected Senator for Astolat.

Bregasland.t: Willem Tarne was elected Senator for Bregasland while the territory was held by the Jotun.

Feroz.t: Garviel i Abrira i Erigo was elected Senator for Feroz while the territory was held by Grendel.

Hercynia.t: Rowyn of the Waystone Path was elected Senator for Hercynia.

Kallavesa.t: Rane Shardbearer was elected Senator for Kallavesa, and the territory's Wittal Grove received a new Grimnir.

Miekarova.t: Vaclav Mladenovich Kosti was elected Senator for Miekarova.

Mitwold.t: Hal Talbot was elected Senator for Mitwold.

Necropolis.t: Kish of the Flame Beneath the Earth was elected Senator for Necropolis.

Ossium.t: Velko Perunovich Razoradze was elected Senator for Ossium.

Skarsind.t: Bloodcrow Rasp was elected Senator for Skarsind.

Temeschwar.t: Giuseppe Sanguineo von Temeschwar was elected Senator for Temeschwar.

Weirwater.t: Tristan du Lac was elected Senator for Weirwater, and Bartimaeus won the Weirwater Vales title at Bourse auction for 250 thrones.

Zenith.t: Herminius of the House of the Wanderer was elected Senator for Zenith.

386YE Winter Solstice Military Council o.d: The accompanying wind, Rippling Stones, reported that Jarl Haakon was dead in the Mournwold, though his champions fought on. The Druj held eastern Therunin, and Grendel navies had been routed from Redoubt. The Children of Wrecks' Gathered Storm lay in Free Landing, threatening the Bay of Catazar. After the Senate rejected a peace treaty, the Autumn Hammers, Summer Storm, Bounders, Bloodcloaks and Fist of the Mountains crossed into Reinos. The Winter Sun, Towerjacks, Golden Axe and Citadel Guard struck the Sarangrave, the Citadel Guard under Winter's Mantle. The Drakes and Tusks pressed on into the Ore Hills. Only the Summer Storm and Golden Axe would see their supporting units share the guerdon.

Dawn.t: All three Dawn armies gathered in Astolat to defend and resupply. The Gryphon's Pride left Bitter Strand under orders to let the Rahvin go home, and the Eastern Sky held an arcane consolidation.

Druj.t: The Druj held eastern Therunin, but four Imperial armies struck into the Sarangrave to break the Mallum and threaten any Druj forces left in Therunin.

Grendel.t: Grendel navies had been routed from Redoubt and forced back to sea, though the wind stressed they were not defeated.

Highguard.t: The Granite Pillar resupplied in Astolat, while the Seventh Wave and Valiant Pegasus billeted on the Marchers in Upwold to rest after a year of crusade.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Autumn Hammers and Summer Storm attacked Reinos, the Hammers plundering and the Summer Storm earning the guerdon. The Winter Sun began a steady conquest of Bloodwater Marsh in the Sarangrave.

Jotun.t: With Jarl Haakon dead, Jotun champions still fought in the Mournwold while the bulk of their armies waited in Liathaven. After the Senate rejected peace, five Imperial armies invaded Reinos.

Navarr.t: Both Navarr armies went to Reikos: the Black Thorns reinforced it while aiding kin evacuating from Therunin, and the Quiet Step mounted a solid defence.

The Brass Coast.t: The Burning Falcon and Red Wind Corsairs defended Tassato and the Fire of the South held Astolat, while allied armies invaded Reinos partly to protect the freeborn.

The League.t: The Towerjacks joined the Sarangrave offensive, seeking allies among the Druj-ruled people there, while the Wolves of War withdrew to rest in Astolat.

The Marches.t: The Drakes and Tusks pressed a steady conquest into the Ore Hills after Haakon's death. The Bounders advanced into Reinos via Burnish, and the Strong Reeds lay low in Bregasland, amid early rumblings of dissent over new exemplars.

Thule.t: Mentioned in passing: the wind notes that time is running out on the treaty with the orcs of Otkodov.

Urizen.t: Urizen's coast was still lashed by storms after the Redoubt raid, and its Citadel Guard crossed into the Sarangrave wrapped in Winter's Mantle.

Varushka.t: The Golden Axe led the charge to take land in the Sarangrave and earned the guerdon, while the Northern Eagle went to Astolat to rest and grieve.

Wintermark.t: The Bloodcloaks and the Fist of the Mountains, the latter enchanted with Quickening Cold Meat, invaded Reinos, while the Green Shield and Narwhal's Spear billeted in Upwold.

386YE Winter Solstice Military Council o.o: After the 386YE Winter Solstice, Imperial generals launched two offensives, sending five armies into Jotun-held Reinos and four into the Druj-held Sarangrave. Most other armies regrouped in Astolat, Upwold, Reikos, Tassato and Bregasland.

Bregasland/Gravenmarch.t: Mentioned in passing: Imperial armies in Bregasland were described as guarding against Gravenmarch.

Madruga/Free Landing.t: The Gathered Storm, a full navy backed by pirates and murderers, was believed to be anchored at Free Landing.

Mournwold/Ore Hills.t: The Drakes and Tusks advanced into the Ore Hills to clear out the Jotun and rebuild after Haakon's death.

Sarangrave/Bloodwater Marsh.t: The Winter Sun began a steady conquest into Bloodwater Marsh, seeking to make its first mark on the Sarangrave.

Segura/Burnish.t: Mentioned in passing: the Bounders marched through Burnish on their way into Reinos.

The Barrens/Bitter Strand.t: The Gryphon's Pride withdrew from Bitter Strand to let the Rahvin go home and to block any who would prevent them.

Therunin/East Ashes.t: East Ashes remained in Druj hands as part of their hold on eastern Therunin.

Therunin/Greenheart.t: The wind warned that nothing stood between the Druj Ghulai and the warped secrets of the Greenheart.

Therunin/Lower Tarn Valley.t: Mentioned in passing: the wind speaks only of a valley the Druj poisoned with their own corrupted apothecary, without naming the region directly.

Astolat.t: Seven Imperial armies gathered in Astolat to defend, resupply and rest, among them three from Dawn, the Granite Pillar, the Fire of the South, the Wolves of War and the Northern Eagle.

Bay of Catazar.t: At least half the Bay of Catazar was judged to lie within reach of the Children of Wrecks' Gathered Storm, which was expected to strike next in full force.

Bregasland.t: The Strong Reeds lay low in the Bregasland marshes, harrying Jotun remnants and guarding against Gravenmarch.

Feroz.t: Mentioned in passing: the Wolves of War's general recalled that the army had stormed Feroz.

Liathaven.t: Mentioned in passing: the southern and northern Jotun armies, including the Hierro and Corazón, had withdrawn to the eaves of Liathaven.

Madruga.t: The Children of Wrecks' Gathered Storm, a full navy backed by pirates, was believed to be in Free Landing, though unlikely to stay.

Mareave.t: Mentioned in passing: the Winter Sun set out from Mareave for the Sarangrave.

Miaren.t: Mentioned in passing: the Quiet Step left Miaren for Reikos, and the Wolves of War marched through it on their way to Astolat.

Mournwold.t: Jarl Haakon was dead, and the Drakes and Tusks stayed to drive his remaining champions from the Ore Hills. Several other armies left the territory.

Otkodov.t: Mentioned in passing: the wind notes that the sands are running fast on the treaty with the orcs of Otkodov.

Redoubt.t: Grendel navies were routed from Redoubt and only one of the traitors who led the raid was found, dead on the battlefield. Storms and flash floods continued, but Visten endured.

Reikos.t: The Navarr armies Black Thorns and Quiet Step took up position in Reikos to reinforce, defend and aid kin evacuating from Therunin.

Reinos.t: Five Imperial armies invaded Reinos after the Senate rejected the peace treaty, facing fortified passes and the castles of Getshal and Yegarra's Proof.

Sarangrave.t: The Winter Sun, Towerjacks, Golden Axe and Citadel Guard crossed into the Sarangrave to break the Mallum, under the shadow of the Tower of the Skink.

Segura.t: Mentioned in passing: the Bounders' route into Reinos ran through Burnish in Segura.

Tassato.t: The Burning Falcon and Red Wind Corsairs mounted a solid defence of Tassato, where the dead were said to rise alongside the Fist of the Mountains.

The Barrens.t: The Gryphon's Pride quit the Fangs and left Bitter Strand to let the Rahvin go home, and the Barrens' Dawn armies withdrew to Astolat.

Therunin.t: Druj armies held the east of Therunin after heavy Imperial losses. The Golden Sun and Black Thorns withdrew as Navarr kin evacuated, and the Sarangrave attack aimed to cut off the Druj remaining there.

Upwold.t: Four armies billeted in Upwold on Marcher hospitality: the Seventh Wave, Valiant Pegasus, Green Shield and Narwhal's Spear.

Zenith.t: Mentioned in passing: the Golden Axe marched from Zenith to the Sarangrave.

386YE Winter Solstice Senate sessions.d: The Senate abrogated the Imperial Administrator and created the Stipulator of Stipends, to which Benedict Urban Di Tassato was elected. He then cut the High Exorcist's stipend to four thrones. Tolls on the Blood Red and White Roads will bring in an extra hundred thrones a season, while broader road tolls and the Lasambrian treaty failed. A third Navarr army was rejected. Commissions passed included a citadel in Peregro, the Gallery of Memories and a remodelled Virtue's Rest. Title-holders announced further works, among them Sergio's Kitchen and improvements to the Great Chain in Sarvos and a timbermill in Temeschwar. Several ambassadors were elected, and Empress Vesna drew 227 thrones through the Hand of the Chancellor.

Dawn.t: Bitter Strand in the Barrens, including the Fangs mithril mine, was ceded to the Rahvin sept, and the Fangs could be allocated as a Dawnish national seat. Finna of Dawn was re-elected Ambassador to the Grendel.

Druj.t: The Imperial Apothecaries Guild was instructed to spread an antidote to the Druj poison in Therunin's Lower Tarn Valley. A citadel was commissioned in Peregro to watch the Therunin border, where the Druj hold sway.

Grendel.t: Finna of Dawn, the incumbent, was re-elected as the Empire's Ambassador to the Grendel.

Highguard.t: Virtue's Rest is to be remodelled to help soldiers of the War of Thorns and Flowers recover, with its Exarch elected by the Highborn assembly. A Church of the Roads sinecure was announced in Bastion, appointed by the Highguard National Assembly.

Navarr.t: The motion to raise a third Navarr army in Hercynia failed. Micah's Stand wayhouse was commissioned in Reikos, and Navarri citizens were elected Ambassador to Axos and Captain of the Senate Guard.

The League.t: The Senate allowed a third League army to be raised, and Benedict Urban Di Tassato became the first Stipulator of Stipends. League works were announced in Tassato, Sarvos and Temeschwar, while the Tassatan Hills bourse amendment was withdrawn.

The Marches.t: Mournwold was assigned to the Marches, with its senator to be elected at the Spring Equinox 387YE. Marcher farm owners will be able to drive cattle to market for cattle-bonds under the new Shepherd of the Southern Herd.

Urizen.t: Mentioned in passing: Xanthius of Urizen was elected Guildmaster of the Artisans, and Urizeni senators proposed or seconded several motions.

Varushka.t: A third Varushkan army is to be raised, and an appraisal will look at drawing displaced Varushkans to Delev. The Gallery of Memories was commissioned in Ossium, with its Curator appointed by the Varushkan National Assembly.

386YE Winter Solstice Senate sessions.o: At the Winter Solstice 386YE the Senate assigned Mournwold to the Marches, ceded Bitter Strand to the Rahvin, raised third League and Varushkan armies, and levied tolls on the Blood Red and White Roads. It also created the Imperial Apothecaries' Guild and the Stipulator of Stipends, and set the Imperial Guerdon at 150 thrones.

Sarvos/Cigno.t: Cigno will host the new sinecure of Sergio's Kitchen, and its Great Chain fortification is to be improved.

Temeschwar/Vardstein Vale.t: A timbermill and sorting yard is to be built here, creating the Vardstein Vandal to oversee the vale's resources and its wolves.

The Barrens/Bitter Strand.t: Bitter Strand, with the Fangs mithril mine, was ceded to the Rahvin sept by vote of the Senate.

Mournwold.t: The Senate assigned Mournwold to the Marches, and the election for its senator will take place at the Spring Equinox 387YE.

Sarvos.t: Sergio's Kitchen was announced as a League sinecure in Cigno, and an improvement to the Great Chain fortification was announced, its cost yet to be determined.

Temeschwar.t: The Temeschwar Drovers' Guild Timbermill and Sorting Yard was announced as a great work in Vardstein Vale. The Temeschwar senator also secured the Torch Eternal as regalia for the Watcher of Ratibor's Torch.

The Barrens.t: The Senate ceded Bitter Strand, including the Fangs mithril mine, to the Rahvin sept. A motion was raised to allocate the Fangs, now claimed by the Empire.

386YE Winter Solstice Synod judgements.d: The General Assembly excommunicated Archavion Wolfborne, and the Dawnish Assembly revoked him as General of the Gryphon's Pride. A Dawnish veto of the ceding of the Fangs failed, while the General Assembly urged returning the mine to the Rahvin. Zoran de Orzel and Spymaster Bernard Dugdale were revoked. Viviane Barossa resigned as Cardinal of Ambition. Assemblies across the Empire offered refuge to Navarr and Great Forest Orcs fleeing Therunin. Other judgements condemned cruel armies, warned of the Children of Wrecks, Agramant's cults and the Claw, backed dams in Spiral, and recognised several exemplars. Mandates sent priests to Solokha, Asavea and Astolat, and true liao consecrated Hacynian and Capodomus.

Dawn.t: The Dawnish Assembly revoked Archavion Wolfborne as General of the Gryphon's Pride and condemned his name to infamy, though its veto of the ceding of the Fangs failed. It also urged the nation to help rebuild Drycastle, proposed a Test of Devotion and opened the Barrens to refugees from Therunin.

Druj.t: The Druj conquest of Therunin drove Navarr and Great Forest Orcs to flee into neighbouring nations. The Navarr Assembly committed to the Druj's destruction, and the Highborn urged defence of the Reikos–Therunin border.

Grendel.t: The General Assembly urged citizens of the southern shores to prepare against the Grendel's return, and the Assembly of Nine castigated over Pickers Goldleaf's admitted treason with the Grendel. The Prosperity Assembly demanded fair pay for labourers in Grendel-held Feroz.

Highguard.t: The Highborn Assembly pledged further Peerless Kinship, opened Reikos to refugees from Therunin and warned that Siakha will attack Necropolis. It also declared 387YE the year of certainty, and a penance sought to heal the feud that split Highborn forces at the Autumn battle.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Imperial Orc Assembly asked to send bonetenders to recover and name their dead at Solen's Doubt in any Spiral dam. It mandated the Sunstorm sept to aid Feroz and revoked MemoryKeeper Ikhan's title.

Jotun.t: The Freeborn Assembly vowed to veto any ceding of Segura under the proposed Lasambrian treaty, which the Senate rejected. The Marcher Assembly called for repairing Fisher's Rock against the Jotun.

Navarr.t: The Navarr Assembly urged Therunin's people to fight as guerrillas or seek refuge and committed to destroying the Druj. It mourned Isaella's Dance, sought to preserve Thornbound knowledge, and backed a fane to Arhallogen for the war on the vallorn. A bid to revoke Rhisiart Dancewalker failed.

The Brass Coast.t: The Freeborn Assembly vowed to veto any ceding of Segura and called for Siroc to be rebuilt in Madruga. It also urged that all Freeborn senatorial election bids be kept by the nation.

The League.t: The League Assembly endorsed the Chamber of Eyphony in Spiral, backed damming the river Doubt for its fallen, and welcomed Commonwealth visitors. It also announced Holberg's 250th anniversary celebration and warned of Agramant cultists in Holberg and a traitor threatening Sarvos.

The Marches.t: The Marcher Assembly called on Marchers to repair Fisher's Rock and stood with the Mournwold miners, and the leaders of the Ore Hills rebellion were recognised as exemplars of Pride. It exalted Gerraint Black and warned against the Husks of the Deep on the Gullet coast.

Thule.t: The Courage Assembly urged that negotiations with the Thule proceed as the Otkodov ceasefire ends, to avoid renewed war on the northern border. The Varushkan Assembly cited the Thule in calling for the Volodmartz citadel to be funded.

Urizen.t: The Urizen Assembly opened its spires to refugees from Therunin and warned Redoubt to prepare for the storms of Siakha's cultists. It also urged support for anchoring the Way in Asavea and vigilance over the cattle drive through Spiral.

Varushka.t: The Varushkan Assembly backed a warded reservoir over its fallen in Spiral and confirmed that Empress Vesna has no ties to Blood on Snow. It also warned of husks and of the traitor Zavetta Voglanova, and the Navarr honoured the sacrifice of the Iron Helms. Its call to destroy the Orieb shrines failed.
