Wintermark.t: The Wintermark Assembly backed a fane to Sadogua over Kallavesa, added Kali Keeneye and Gisli the Provider to the Chronicle of Heroes, and welcomed the Great Forest Orcs. It castigated Lodwick Hardin over the attack on the Rahvin, but its support for Navarr's vallorn plan failed.

386YE Winter Solstice Synod judgements.o: At the Winter Solstice 386YE the Imperial Synod raised 212 judgements, dominated by the Druj conquest of Therunin, the fallout from General Archavion Wolfborne's attack on the Rahvin at the Fangs, and the crisis over cardinals carrying a hallow of the false virtue of Peace.

Mareave/Icarion.t: The Icarion Qanat was not commissioned at the Winter Solstice, so the Sunstorm sept has not yet set out to aid Feroz. They will go if it is commissioned before the end of the Autumn Equinox 387YE.

The Barrens/The Bleaks.t: The Navarr Assembly urged travellers to show the Karass sept that the Last Battle wayhouse in the Bleaks stands against the Druj, not against them.

Therunin/Peakedge Song.t: The Navarr Assembly praised Thornsong House and urged that its knowledge be spread along the trods. A later judgement called for its work to be carried to safety from the Druj.

Bastion.t: Judgements urged continued work on the Grand Inspiration of the Way and affirmed the hostels of Virtue's Rest as places to restore both body and soul. Marcher monasteries were asked to go to Bastion and take on work the Lepidean librarians would not.

Bregasland.t: The Marcher Assembly lamented that Bregasland has been left unfortified and called on all Marchers to give coin, labour and resources to repair Fisher's Rock.

Feroz.t: The Prosperity Assembly warned those commissioning work in impoverished Feroz to pay its labourers fairly. An Imperial Orc mandate asked the Sunstorm sept to aid Feroz, though they have not yet set out because the Icarion Qanat was not commissioned.

Holberg.t: The League Assembly named Holberg as the hub of Agramant's cannibal cults and called for the sect to be rooted out. It also announced a grand celebration of 250 years since Holberg joined the Empire.

Kallavesa.t: The Wintermark Assembly supported casting an arcane projection over Kallavesa as part of the oath for a fane to Sadogua, sought by the Ravenseer to protect the territory.

Madruga.t: The Navarr Assembly urged its people to help the Freeborn adapt to the strange new marshes rising in Madruga, and the Freeborn Assembly called for Siroc to be rebuilt there once reclaimed. Bakar was vindicated over his choices during the flooding.

Mareave.t: The Prosperity Assembly warned against expanding the Yellow Fist Adit to take water from Skouran Jadefall. Urizeni priests urged vigilance over a planned cattle drive to Mareave through Spiral.

Necropolis.t: Both the Highborn and Vigilance Assemblies warned that Siakha's Children of Wrecks will attack Necropolis next season and called for its defence.

Redoubt.t: The Urizen Assembly warned Redoubt to prepare for storms brought by Siakha's cultists and to shelter with neighbours if needed. Other judgements recalled the Children of Wrecks raid there and condemned Imperials who aided it.

Reikos.t: The Highborn Assembly asked Reikos's chapters to shelter Navarr and Great Forest Orc refugees and called for the Reikos–Therunin border to be defended against the Druj.

Spiral.t: Assemblies endorsed building the Chamber of Eyphony in Spiral and backed damming the river Doubt. The Imperial Orc and Varushkan Assemblies asked that their fallen at Solen's Doubt be honoured, and Urizen urged vigilance over the coming cattle drive through Spiral.

Tassato.t: Mentioned in passing: donations made at Tassato's counting house added two thrones to the Virtue Fund.

The Barrens.t: Archavion Wolfborne was excommunicated and revoked for attacking the Rahvin at the Fangs, the veto of ceding the Fangs failed, and the General Assembly urged returning the mine. The Dawnish Assembly also opened the Barrens to Therunin's refugees and urged the rebuilding of Drycastle.

Therunin.t: With Therunin falling to the Druj, the Navarr Assembly urged those who could not fight to flee and those who could to harass the invaders. Urizen, Dawn and Highguard opened their doors to Navarr and Great Forest Orc refugees.

386YE Winter Solstice event schedule.d: Ten nations were scheduled to elect senators in their camps on Saturday afternoon, each by its own method. Tally of the Votes elections for numerous national titles followed from 3:30pm. Senate sessions were set for Friday at 10pm, Saturday at 4pm and 9pm, and Sunday at 1:30pm. The Military Council would sit on Saturday and Sunday, with battles off Anvil at 11am both days. The Hall of Worlds was to host Conclave sessions, Grandmaster elections and parleys with Meraud and Sorin. The schedule also included an auction for Imperial Bourse positions, trials of four individuals for blasphemy and heresy, and regular Synod judgement deadlines.

Dawn.t: Dawn's senators for Astolat and Weirwater were to be chosen at 2:30pm, immediately after the tourney, and Dawnish Fleet Captains were to meet in the Military Council tent at 1pm on Saturday.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: Grendel is not named; the Feroz senatorial seat is listed as a Brass Coast auction election.

Highguard.t: Highguard's Necropolis senator election was to open with the inquisition of candidates at 2pm.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Imperial Orcs were to elect Skarsind's senator from 2:15pm as candidates presented items of worth. At 4pm at the Fire Pit they would elect the Keeper of the Bronze Bowls, the Steward of the Mines of Gulhule and the Four Seasons' Boneweaver.

Jotun.t: Mentioned in passing: the Jotun are not named; the Bregasland senatorial seat is listed among the Marches elections.

Navarr.t: The Navarr were to elect Hercynia's senator at 1:15pm, immediately after the standing, and to elect the Broker of the Invisible Cord at the Standing Circle at 4:30pm.

The League.t: The League's Temeschwar senator election was to begin at 3:30pm with the presentation of collected bonds. The Master of Rings and the Chair of the Wolf were to be elected at the Plaza at 5pm.

The Marches.t: Marcher landowners were to gather at 1:30pm to elect senators for Bregasland and Mitwold. At 5pm at the Community Hall the Marches would elect the Steward of Good Leaf Gardens, the Bailiff of the Grand Market and the Reeve of the Happiston Mana Exchange.

Urizen.t: Urizen's Zenith senator was to be chosen by a demos running from 1pm to 2pm. The Gloaming Merchant and the Architect of the Conscious River were to be elected near the Net of Heaven at 3:30pm, and the nation's magicians were to meet on Friday evening.

Varushka.t: Varushka's senator elections for Ossium and Miekarova were to begin with questioning of candidates at 1:45pm. At 4pm at the Central Hearth it would elect five titles, among them the Harbourmaster of the Semmerlak and the Speaker to the Leshun.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark's Kallavesa senator election was to begin at 2pm, with jars placed down for 30 minutes.

386YE Winter Solstice event schedule.o: The civil service published the timetable for the Winter Solstice 386YE summit at Anvil. It set out national senator elections, Tally of the Votes elections and the weekend's official and citizen-organised meetings.

Astolat.t: Astolat's senator was to be chosen in the Dawnish camp at 2:30pm, immediately after the tourney.

Bregasland.t: Bregasland's senator election is listed under the Marches, with landowners gathering at 1:30pm.

Feroz.t: The Feroz senator election is listed as a Brass Coast auction beginning at 2pm. The next regular election for the seat is due at the Summer Solstice 387YE.

Hercynia.t: Hercynia's senator was to be elected in the Navarr camp at 1:15pm, immediately after the standing.

Kallavesa.t: Kallavesa's senator was to be chosen from 2pm, with Wintermark's jars placed down for 30 minutes.

Miekarova.t: Miekarova's senator election was to begin with questioning of candidates in the Varushkan camp at 1:45pm.

Mitwold.t: Mitwold's senator was to be elected by Marcher landowners from 1:30pm. The next regular election for the seat is due at the Summer Solstice 387YE.

Necropolis.t: Necropolis's senator election was to open with the Highborn inquisition of candidates at 2pm.

Ossium.t: Ossium's senator election was to begin with questioning of candidates in the Varushkan camp at 1:45pm.

Skarsind.t: Skarsind's senator election was to begin at 2:15pm, with Imperial Orc candidates presenting items of worth.

Temeschwar.t: Temeschwar's senator election was to begin at 3:30pm with the presentation of collected bonds in the League camp.

Weirwater.t: Weirwater's senator was to be chosen in the Dawnish camp at 2:30pm, after the tourney. The next regular election for the seat is due at the Summer Solstice 387YE.

Zenith.t: Zenith's senator was to be chosen by a Urizen demos running from 1pm to 2pm.

386YE Winter Solstice interlude.d: General Archavion Wolfborne ordered the Gryphon's Pride to seize the Fangs mithril mine from the Rahvin, whom the Senate had declared foreigners. Supporting the army would mean a murder trial. A Save the Rahvin adventure could spare the sept if units with a combined strength of 2,000 joined it. Other adventures covered exploring transformed southern Madruga and the Untrod Groves. Robec began offering Kobol's Vigour, and the Iron Confederacy lifted its sanctions. Further effects included farmers travelling to Mareave, Temeschwar priests sheltering the needy, Sorin's boon in Hahnmark, curses on Redoubt, Summer magic over Dawn, Regrow the Land's Heart on Upwold and Feroz, and a Penumbral Veil over every Imperial territory except Casinea.

Dawn.t: A Dawnish army, the Gryphon's Pride, was marching illegally on the Rahvin in the Barrens, and Dawnish knights could explore the Untrod Groves. The whole nation was enchanted with Summer magic that draws Summer eternals and stirs a love of showy magic.

Druj.t: Mentioned in passing: the attack on the Rahvin was expected to damage future chances of the Empire cooperating with the slaves of the Druj.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: Grendel is not named, though Feroz and Mareave, listed here as Grendel-held, are treated on the page as Imperial lands receiving magic and aid.

Highguard.t: The consecrated basilica of Berechiah in Bastion still gave Vigilance preachers extra liao and votes. The Penumbral Veil covered Bastion, Necropolis and Reikos but conspicuously not Casinea.

Imperial Orcs.t: Brass Coast and Marcher farmers were trekking to Mareave to help the Imperial Orcs cope with the arid conditions of their new territory. The Penumbral Veil covered both Mareave and Skarsind.

Jotun.t: Mentioned in passing: the Penumbral Veil covered only those Marcher lands where the Jotun were not in control.

Navarr.t: The Penumbral Veil was drawn over Miaren and Hercynia, the two territories still held by the nation.

The Brass Coast.t: Brass Coast congregations lost a liao and two Synod votes as their farmers travelled to aid the Orcs. Military units could explore the flood-transformed south of Madruga, and the Veil covered Kahraman, Segura and Feroz.

The League.t: Temeschwar priests preaching Vigilance or Loyalty gained votes but lost liao while sheltering those troubled by the rat-plague. The Veil covered all five cities, and over Sarvos it was more than three times as strong.

The Marches.t: Congregations in Mitwold and Upwold lost a liao and two votes as farmers trekked to Mareave. Upwold was enchanted with Regrow the Land's Heart, and the Veil covered the Marcher lands outside Jotun control.

Urizen.t: Redoubt was cursed with Foam and Spittle of the Furious Sea, which cut fleet production, and with Rivers of Life. The Veil covered all three Urizen territories.

Varushka.t: Fleets crossing the Semmerlak from Varushka were no longer penalised, thanks to the journeymage towers. The Veil covered all five Varushkan territories.

Wintermark.t: Sorin's boon strengthened Hahnmark's herb gardens, and Sermersuaq's personal resources gained 22 extra rings. The Veil covered all three Wintermark territories.

386YE Winter Solstice interlude.o: The Winter Solstice interlude opened downtime after the 386YE Autumn Equinox. It set out the Gryphon's Pride's illegal attack on the Rahvin in the Barrens, new adventures for military units and fleets, changes to foreign trade, and a range of magical and religious effects across the Empire.

Karov/Malimorzi.t: Mentioned in passing: Malimorzi is not named; it shares only in the Veil drawn over Karov as a whole.

Semmerholm/Lacuve.t: Mentioned in passing: Lacuve is not named; it shares only in the Summer enchantment and Veil over Semmerholm.

The Barrens/The Untrod Groves.t: Dawnish knights could send military units to explore the Untrod Groves for wealth, with reports promised if 1,000 strength or more was sent. The enchanted fortification summoned there would not stop the Gryphon's Pride's attack.

Astolat.t: Astolat lay under the Summer enchantment covering all of Dawn and under the Penumbral Veil.

Bastion.t: The consecrated but still dangerous basilica of Berechiah continued to inspire Vigilance preachers, and Bastion was covered by the Penumbral Veil.

Bay of Catazar.t: Mentioned in passing: farmers were trekking around the Bay to Mareave, and the eternal Siakha's growing influence over it could affect the Redoubt curse.

Bregasland.t: The page listed Bregasland among the Marcher territories covered by the Penumbral Veil.

Casinea.t: Casinea was the only Imperial territory left out of the Penumbral Veil, a pointed exception suggesting dozens of deliberate castings.

Feroz.t: The reclaimed Feroz was enchanted with Regrow the Land's Heart, bringing soft rain, new growth over war scars and more briar births. It was also covered by the Veil.

Hahnmark.t: Heralds of Sorin culled the weak plants in Hahnmark's herb gardens, adding herbs and bladeroot. Residents felt possessive and suspicious of strangers, and the eternal's price was unknown.

Hercynia.t: Hercynia, still held by Navarr, was covered by the Penumbral Veil.

Holberg.t: Fleets crossing the Semmerlak from Holberg no longer suffered a production penalty, and the city lay under the Veil.

Kahraman.t: Kahraman was covered by the Penumbral Veil, and its congregations were among those losing liao and votes as farmers left to aid the Orcs.

Kallavesa.t: Kallavesa was covered by the Penumbral Veil.

Karov.t: Karov was covered by the Penumbral Veil, and Varushkan fleets crossing the Semmerlak were no longer penalised.

Karsk.t: Karsk was covered by the Penumbral Veil.

Madruga.t: Military units could take the Explore the Southern Reaches adventure in the flood-reshaped south of Madruga. If 5,000 strength was committed in one season, the Empire could remap the territory and scry it again.

Mareave.t: Brass Coast and Marcher farmers were travelling to Mareave to help the Imperial Orcs deal with its arid conditions, and the territory was covered by the Veil.

Miaren.t: Miaren, still held by Navarr, was covered by the Penumbral Veil.

Miekarova.t: Miekarova was covered by the Penumbral Veil.

Mitwold.t: Congregations in Mitwold lost a liao and two Synod votes as their farmers trekked to Mareave, and the territory lay under the Veil.

Morrow.t: Morrow was covered by the Penumbral Veil.

Necropolis.t: Necropolis was covered by the Penumbral Veil.

Ossium.t: Ossium was covered by the Penumbral Veil.

Redoubt.t: Redoubt was battered by the storms of Foam and Spittle of the Furious Sea, which cut fleet production by two ranks, and was also under the opposing Rivers of Life curse. The full consequences were left to the Winter winds.

Reikos.t: Reikos was covered by the Penumbral Veil.

Sarvos.t: The Penumbral Veil over Sarvos was more than three times as powerful as elsewhere in the Empire.

Segura.t: Segura was covered by the Penumbral Veil, and its congregations were among those losing liao and votes as farmers left to aid the Orcs.

Semmerholm.t: Semmerholm lay under Dawn's Summer enchantment and the Penumbral Veil, and fleets crossing the Semmerlak from Dawn were no longer penalised.

Sermersuaq.t: Having defied a harsh winter and Agramant's schemes, Sermersuaq's people prospered, and every personal resource there produced an extra 22 rings.

Skarsind.t: Skarsind was covered by the Penumbral Veil.

Spiral.t: Spiral was covered by the Penumbral Veil.

Tassato.t: Tassato was covered by the Penumbral Veil.

Temeschwar.t: Temeschwar's churches opened to those suffering from the rat-plague. Priests preaching Vigilance or Loyalty gained two votes but spent a liao on consecrations for the needy.

The Barrens.t: The Gryphon's Pride was attacking the Rahvin to seize the Fangs mithril mine, and the Houndsgate fortification would not oppose it. The sept could survive, though it would lose the mine, if units with 2,000 combined strength came to its aid.

The Semmerlak.t: Journeymage towers lessened Dho'uala's influence, so fleets crossing the lake were no longer penalised. Removing things from the Semmerlak remained illegal, and the Harbourmaster still could not buy ilium.

Upwold.t: Upwold was enchanted with Regrow the Land's Heart, its congregations lost liao and votes to the farmers' trek, and it lay under the Veil.

Veroigne.t: The Duke of Veroigne lifted the ban on selling Kobol's Vigour to Imperial traders at Robec, and the Iron Dukes ended their sanctions, though trade in Veroigne still faced delays and scrutiny.

Weirwater.t: Weirwater lay under Dawn's Summer enchantment and the Penumbral Veil.

Zenith.t: Zenith was covered by the Penumbral Veil.

386YE Winter Solstice winds of fortune.d: Emperor Vesna addressed all citizens about the Barrens, where the attack on the Rahvin divided Dawn and the Fangs passed to Imperial control. Highguard, the League and Varushka began preparing to support the Navarr against the vallorn. Senate appraisals examined Feroz and the Grendel salt lords, and a treaty with the Lasambrian Orcs awaited a constitutional vote. Four Synod cardinals faced heresy trial over an aura of Peace. The Thule warned of war after Summer 387YE without agreement. Madruga was transformed by marsh, Mareave's development was discussed, and twenty-three normal and three major conjunctions were resolved, mostly in the Empire's favour.

Dawn.t: Dawn was polarised over General Achavion Wolfborne's attack on the Rahvin, while questing knights prepared an expedition into the Untrod Groves and Imperial heroes killed Druj ritualists there and the Speakers of Famine in Astolat.

Druj.t: The Druj suffered defeats in Therunin, Morrow and the Barrens, with the Blood Drainers coven and Cintra Blackstaff stopped in Sweetglades and the Shuddering Wrast slain.

Grendel.t: An appraisal studied ways to disrupt the Salt Lords Council and its allies, the damage left by Governor Rahab in Feroz was assessed, and Grendel forces were killed at Ayereed, Sarvos and Kallavesa.

Highguard.t: Highborn pilgrims used their final peerless kinship to seek healing for Therunin, the grey pilgrims were called home to raise an army against the vallorn, and ghosts gathered at High Chalcis in Reikos.

Imperial Orcs.t: The nation's people weighed ways to bring water and prosperity to arid Mareave and plan for a possible Grendel return, and were approached by emissaries of the Autumn realm.

Jotun.t: Jotun warbands were beaten across Mournwold, Tassato and Bregasland, losing their last cache in Southmoor, though Liath's Ring gained the under threat quality.

Navarr.t: Highborn pilgrims worked with the Navarr on Therunin's ghosts and taint, three nations rallied to their war on the vallorn, the vine movement found its purpose, and a new wayhouse was completed in the Bleaks.

The Brass Coast.t: A peace treaty with the Lasambrian Orcs awaited Senate approval, an appraisal proposed measures for ruined Feroz, and Madruga was transformed into marsh while the Children of Wrecks formed a navy.

The League.t: The League set its innovators to study the vallorn, the Assembly of Ambition sought true consecration of Capodomus Cathedral, and Imperial heroes protected Holberg, Sarvos, Tassato and Temeschwar.

The Marches.t: Marchers were stirred by the Pride assembly seeking recognition for the Ore Hills Rebellion ringleaders and the revocation of a Marcher senator, while the Miners of the Mourn were rescued in the Ore Hills.

Thule.t: The long peace with the Thule was close to ending, with war due after the Summer Solstice 387YE if no agreement is reached.

Urizen.t: Former Urizen renegades in Ankra began attacking Imperial citizens, Urizen was tagged in developments in Mareave, and the Shuddering Wrast was killed in Morrow.

Varushka.t: The Varushkans sought to draw on dark powers against the vallorn, the wolves of Nadezhdikov were soothed in Volodmartz, and Bulgakov in Karov was made habitable.

Wintermark.t: The Icebarn artok, bound by runes, awaited new tasks for Wintermark, beasts grew wild in Sermersuaq, and heroes killed the Crimson Band in Hahnmark and guarded the Pilgrim's Trail in Kallavesa.

386YE Winter Solstice winds of fortune.o: The Winter Solstice 386YE winds of fortune gathered dozens of developments across the Empire, from Emperor Vesna's message on the Barrens and the coming war with the vallorn to foreign diplomacy and the results of the Autumn Equinox Sentinel Gate conjunctions.

Astolat/Winterbourne.t: The Speakers of Famine were all killed at the Grand Spinney.

Ayereed/Cornaghan.t: At Anabla's Orchard the Asaveans and Grendel were killed, stopping reinforcement of Stormlords Rise.

Bregasland/Grey Fens.t: The Jotun were defeated at Hal's Hollow and the Feni protected.

Hahnmark/Wood Heath.t: The Crimson Band were all killed at the Tainted Bawn.

Holberg/Holmauer.t: The Feasters of Marrow were all killed at Wunderkind Fields.

Kallavesa/West Marsh.t: At Ardith's Holt the Grendel and most Asaveans were killed, but High Voice Chiara survived and her whereabouts are unknown.

Karov/Duzekani.t: The black glass at Bulgakov was cleansed and the vale made habitable.

Liathaven/Liath's Ring.t: Liath's Ring gained the under threat quality following the Jotun attack on the Feni.

Madruga/Calvos Sound.t: Wreckers were defeated on Santana's Path, with some Imperial casualties.

Madruga/Free Landing.t: The opportunity to break the Gathering Storm on the Freeborn Plain was not taken, and the Children of Wrecks formed a navy.

Miaren/Goldglades.t: The followers of the Braying Lord escaped from the Soured Pasture.

Morrow/Peregro.t: The Shuddering Wrast and the Druj at Iulia's Grove were defeated.

Mournwold/Chalkdowns.t: The Jotun were defeated at Broken Corral, while the outcome of the disturbance at Tilly's Howe is known only to Tilly of Chalkdown.

Mournwold/Ore Hills.t: Under Jedediah Boon the Miners of the Mourn were rescued and the Summerborn Champions defeated, and the Pride assembly sought recognition for the Ore Hills Rebellion ringleaders.

Mournwold/Southmoor.t: The last Jotun cache was claimed at Fecund Boscage and Dalton Royse was found and executed by beaters.

Necropolis/Longbeach.t: Imperial heroes killed some wreckers on Magazjin Plain but retreated after casualties.

Otkodov/Nithoggir.t: The situation at Skarlans Shaft #3 was investigated, with the outcome known to Ambassador Kindra Surefoot.

Reikos/Tamarbode.t: Mentioned in passing: recalled as the place from which the rot eternal Llofir was expelled, as ghosts now gather around High Chalcis.

Sarvos/Uccelini.t: The Isle of the Fox was protected and the Grendel all killed.

Spiral/Ankra.t: A renegade faction of former Urizen who stayed in Ankra, harbouring corruption, began attacking Imperial citizens.

Spiral/Apulus.t: The Wailing Gyre was destroyed at Eammon's Bawn, with some Imperial casualties.

Tassato/Tassato Mestra.t: A Jotun warband was defeated in Felladonni Woods and the ilium protected.

Temeschwar/Vardstein Vale.t: The Braying Lord and its followers were slain in the Putrid Fields.

Therunin/Peakedge Song.t: The Druj at Bronwen's Stand were all killed.

Therunin/Sweetglades.t: Under Cadwell Waystone the Blood Drainers coven and Cintra Blackstaff were stopped, though the fate of the Beasts of Sweetglades is unknown.

Astolat.t: The Speakers of Famine were all killed at the Grand Spinney in Winterbourne.

Ayereed.t: Imperial heroes stopped the Asaveans reinforcing Stormlords Rise, killing them and the Grendel and claiming a chest.

Bay of Catazar.t: Mentioned in passing: not named directly, though the page touches on Imperial fleets and overseas trade.

Bregasland.t: The Jotun were defeated at Hal's Hollow and the Feni protected from slaughter.

Brocéliande.t: An emissary of the Green Mother offered a boon to remove the malign curse over Brocéliande, though accepting any of her boons is illegal.

Feroz.t: A Senate appraisal presented proposals for ruined Feroz and began assessing the damage done by Grendel Governor Rahab.

Hahnmark.t: The Crimson Band were all killed at the Tainted Bawn, and Hahnmark farmers were tagged in Sarcophan trade developments.

Holberg.t: The Feasters of Marrow were all killed at Wunderkind Fields, and the Holberg Chamber of Commerce was tagged in Faraden diplomacy.

Kallavesa.t: Heroes protected the Pilgrim's Trail from the Asaveans, though High Voice Chiara survived and vanished, and Kallavesi mystics were offered vision quests in the swamps.

Karov.t: The deadly black glass in the vale of Bulgakov was cleansed, making it habitable.

Liathaven.t: After the fighting in Bregasland, Liath's Ring gained the under threat quality.

Madruga.t: The southern reaches became a strange star-metal-infused marsh, the Children of Wrecks formed a navy and a Thunderous Deluge was unleashed across the territory.

Mareave.t: Options to address the arid climate, including Skouran aqueduct ruins, were laid out, alongside diplomacy with the Golden Pyramid, the Skourans and the Brine Turtles.

Miaren.t: The followers of the Braying Lord escaped from the Soured Pasture and their whereabouts are unknown.

Mitwold.t: Mentioned in passing: Marcher experts from Mitwold were invited to help bring prosperity to Mareave.

Morrow.t: The Shuddering Wrast was killed and the rest of the Druj defeated at Iulia's Grove.

Mountains of the Moon.t: Mentioned in passing: Axos remains annoyed at Imperial involvement in the failure of its joint venture with the Grendel into the Mountains of the Moon.

Mournwold.t: The Miners of the Mourn were rescued, the Jotun lost their last cache and several battles, and the traitor Dalton Royse was executed by beaters.

Necropolis.t: An attempt to kill wreckers at Magazjin Plain ended in an Imperial retreat after casualties.

Otkodov.t: Diplomacy with the Thule continued, with war looming after Summer 387YE, and the situation at Shaft #3 in Nithoggir was investigated.

Reikos.t: Ghosts gathered in the shadows of High Chalcis as the Highborn year drew to a close, and volunteers were sought.

Sarvos.t: The Assembly of Ambition sought true consecration of Capodomus Cathedral, and the Grendel were all killed on the Isle of the Fox.

Sermersuaq.t: Livestock, birds and pets in Sermersuaq and neighbouring territories became inexplicably wilder.

Skarsind.t: Mentioned in passing: Mareave's prosperity could attract more Imperial Orcs from distant Skarsind.

Spiral.t: Renegade former Urizen in Ankra began attacking Imperial citizens, while the Wailing Gyre was destroyed in Apulus.

Tassato.t: The Jotun were defeated at Felladonni Woods and the ilium there protected.

Temeschwar.t: The Braying Lord and its followers were slain in the Putrid Fields, at some cost in Imperial casualties.

The Barrens.t: Emperor Vesna addressed the Empire on the Barrens, the Fangs came under Senate control, a quest into the Untrod Groves was planned and a Navarr wayhouse completed in the Bleaks.

Therunin.t: Highborn and Navarr sought to lay its ghosts to rest and heal the Sephals Cauldron's taint, while Druj plans in Sweetglades and Peakedge Song were thwarted.

Upwold.t: Mentioned in passing: the Upwold Seed Exchange inspired a Senate appraisal, and Upwold experts were invited to Mareave.

Volodmartz.t: The wolves of Nadezhdikov were soothed in the Choked Forest of Perumaki.

386YE Winter Solstice winds of war.d: As winter storms swept the Empire, the Brass Coast knew rare peace while the Grendel commander Gallum Fiersach still held Morajasse. Imperial armies pursued a three-fold strategy against the Jotun in the Mournwold, Urizen's shore faced a Grendel armada and Children of Wrecks pirates bent on Elos, and four armies fought the Druj in Therunin. The Gryphon's Pride marched to seize the Rahvin mithril mine in the Fangs, a crime under Imperial law, and other captains opposed them. Four battle opportunities were offered: Visten in Redoubt, Isaella's Dance and the Iron Helms in Therunin, and Jarl Haakon in the Mournwold. Skirmishes at Charoko and the Iron Grove headed a long list of conjunctions.

Dawn.t: Dawn fielded a force weight of 60, its armies were barred from Cautious Advance and Give Ground, and citizen patrols forced the Druj to need 25 victory points for a beachhead in the Barrens, where several conjunctions were also offered.

Druj.t: The Druj faced four Imperial armies in tainted Therunin, were the foe in two Therunin battle opportunities, and were targeted by conjunctions in the Forest of Ulnak, the Salt Flats of Sanath and Therunin's East Ashes.

Grendel.t: The Grendel kept Gallum Fiersach in Morajasse but stood on the defensive in Ayereed and Mareave while their retreating armada struck at Redoubt, and conjunctions targeted their forces in Icarion and Maistir Varden in the Petrified Forest.

Highguard.t: Highguard contributed a force weight of 23, its High Exorcist was named for a ghostly conjunction in Reikos, and Highborn armies retained bonuses for fighting between Morrow and Zenith.

Imperial Orcs.t: Mentioned in passing: listed with a force weight of 5 and noted as able to take the Forge Hammers order in Skarsind.

Jotun.t: The Jotun faced a three-fold Imperial strategy to hold Marcher land and cut them off from their Liathaven base, with Jarl Haakon a battle opportunity and conjunctions against their yegarra and Halbera Strongarm in the Mournwold.

Navarr.t: Navarr fielded a force weight of 60 and Navarr-held lands drew conjunctions, including stopping a horde at Deer's Folly in Hercynia and rescuing a treetender in Therunin, where Imperial armies fought the Druj.

The Brass Coast.t: The Brass Coast enjoyed a rare peace across Kahraman, Madruga and Feroz, with the kamkrag deterring raiders and Wind Lord Saoirse burning Morajasse's battlements with Sand lore ahead of an assault that never came.

The League.t: The League contributed a force weight of 22, the Mayor of Caricomare was charged with saving Charoko in Sarvos from a sea beast, and conjunctions threatened Spiral's Block and Screed.

The Marches.t: Marcher land was the prize in the war against the Jotun over western hills, while Marcher armies kept their home-territory strength bonuses, could billet in Bregasland, Upwold and Mitwold, and fielded a force weight of 34.

Thule.t: Mentioned in passing: a conjunction in the East Floes of Sermersuaq asked the Mediator of Wreck to soothe the Thule of Volham.

Urizen.t: Urizen's Redoubt shore faced the Grendel armada and Children of Wrecks pirates targeting Elos, with Visten a battle opportunity, while patrols in Morrow and Zenith forced the Druj to need 25 victory points for a beachhead.

Varushka.t: Varushka fielded a force weight of 17, kept patrols in Ossium raising the Druj beachhead threshold, could use Hospitality of the Boyars there, and was offered a conjunction to find the Chosen of Samkǒma in Brez.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark had the largest force weight at 63, kept its Fight with Honour order and special modifiers against the Jotun, and faced conjunctions in Kallavesa and Sermersuaq including the Redshal farmers' threat to the Iron Grove.

386YE Winter Solstice winds of war.o: The Winter Solstice 386YE winds of war summarised a stormy season of campaigning: battles against the Jotun in the Mournwold, the Grendel and Children of Wrecks in Redoubt, the Druj in Therunin, and Imperial fighting Imperial over the Fangs. The page also set out the battle opportunities and Sentinel Gate conjunctions for the coming summit.

Ayereed/Petrified Forest.t: Imperial gains here went unchallenged, and a conjunction to Saoirse's Fields tasked the Imperial Spymaster with killing Maistir Varden.

Bregasland/North Fens.t: A conjunction to the Swollen Fens asked the Roost's Reeve to deal with an unspecified threat.

Brocéliande/Dark Ranging.t: A conjunction to the Broken Stand tasked the Knight of the Greenwood with recovering chests.

Feroz/Morajasse.t: Gallum Fiersach still held the rock, and Wind Lord Saoirse set its battlements crackling with colourless fire ahead of an assault that never came.

Feroz/Oranseri.t: A conjunction to Rahab's Orchard asked the Strategos of the Brass Coast to protect the Celesti Lighthouse.

Forest of Ulnak/Grimfen Mire.t: A conjunction to the Crimson Boscage tasked the Champion of Prosperity with killing the Druj.

Hercynia/Deer's Folly.t: A conjunction to the Shattered Pines asked the Spear of the Seven to stop a horde.

Kallavesa/Skymark.t: The farmers of Redshal marched on the Iron Grove, threatening to halve its herb production, and the Keeper of the Iron Grove was asked to uncover what was wrong with them.

Kallavesa/West Marsh.t: A conjunction to the Forlorn Bogs asked Kjellen Saltmire to deal with a threat.

Madruga/Crucible.t: A conjunction to Larroc Corral tasked Sakari Nightscale with killing mage-killers.

Mareave/Icarion.t: A conjunction to the Plains of the Courath asked the Minister of Historical Research to kill the Grendel and claim their loot.

Mareave/Sinfoyard.t: A conjunction aboard the Salt Shaker asked the Senator for Mareave to ensure the safety of its crew.

Mournwold/Alderly.t: A conjunction to the Walters' Clearing asked Bryce the Hare to rescue a herbalist and stop the yegarra.

Mournwold/Greensward.t: A conjunction to Big Boar's Sty asked Determination of Ice Kaisa to answer the challenge of Halbera Strongarm.

Redoubt/Ventosi.t: A conjunction to the Oathspawned Copse asked Halkyon of the Myriad Stream to kill the wreckers and recover their loot.

Reikos/Chalcis Mount.t: A conjunction to the High Arboretum asked the High Exorcist, Alessi of the Basilisks of the Labyrinth, to deal with ghosts.

Salt Flats of Sanath/Beladrarsh.t: A conjunction to the Drained Woods tasked Lady Laudine du Lac with killing the Druj and claiming their goods.

Sarvos/Bocche.t: A beast threatened Charoko, and Aloysius di Sarvos, likely joined by the Imperial Huntsmarshall, was asked to defend the Grove of Charoko for a reward from Allesio van Trivento.

Sermersuaq/East Floes.t: A conjunction to Crow's Rest asked the Mediator of Wreck to soothe the Thule of Volham.

Sermersuaq/Stark.t: A conjunction to the wreck of the Screaming Mammoth asked Cora's Claviger to help the injured.

Spiral/Cinion.t: A conjunction to the Valley of Loss asked the Senator for Spiral to protect the Block.

Spiral/Screed.t: A conjunction to Marco's Pass asked the Oblivion Sentinel to stop the Spire of Black Glass.

The Barrens/The Bleaks.t: Two conjunctions were offered here: the Hand of the Healers giving succour to Therunin's survivors at the Last Battle Wayhouse, and the General of the Golden Sun protecting a baggage train at the Golden Thicket.

Therunin/East Ashes.t: A conjunction to the Splintering Jetty asked Neala Blackhawk to rescue a treetender and kill the Druj.

Volodmartz/Brez.t: A conjunction to the Woods of the Quiet Road asked the Custodian of the Gift of the Dwindling Star to find and help the Chosen of Samkǒma.

Ayereed.t: There was no movement in Ayereed; Imperial gains in the Petrified Forest went unchallenged as the Grendel stayed on the defensive, and a conjunction tasked the Imperial Spymaster with killing Maistir Varden.

Bay of Catazar.t: Mentioned in passing: storms across the Bay heralded the war in Redoubt, and the Children of Wrecks were described as fighters from across the Bay.

Bregasland.t: Imperial armies could billet in Bregasland and the Strong Reeds gained strength fighting there, while a conjunction in the North Fens asked the Roost's Reeve to deal with a threat.

Brocéliande.t: A conjunction to the Dark Ranging tasked the Knight of the Greenwood with recovering chests at the Broken Stand.

Feroz.t: Feroz saw no fighting, though Gallum Fiersach still held Morajasse and Wind Lord Saoirse burned its battlements with Sand lore; a conjunction sought to protect the Celesti Lighthouse in Oranseri.

Forest of Ulnak.t: A conjunction to the Grimfen Mire tasked the Champion of Prosperity with killing the Druj at the Crimson Boscage.

Hercynia.t: A conjunction to Deer's Folly asked the Spear of the Seven to stop a horde at the Shattered Pines.

Kahraman.t: Kahraman saw no fighting; with the kamkrag marching across it, few raiders came down from the mountains and those who did were easily driven back.

Kallavesa.t: The farmers of Redshal turned hostile and marched on the Iron Grove, threatening to halve its herb production, and a second conjunction in the West Marsh asked Kjellen Saltmire to deal with a threat.

Liathaven.t: The forests of what was once Liathaven served as the Jotun base that Imperial armies sought to cut off from the fighting in the Marches.

Madruga.t: Madruga was quiet and remained uncontrolled as Imperial scouts explored it and the Grendel armada withdrew, while a conjunction to the Crucible tasked Sakari Nightscale with killing mage-killers.

Mareave.t: Mareave saw no movement as the Grendel stayed on the defensive, though conjunctions sought to kill Grendel in Icarion and secure a ship's crew in Sinfoyard.

Mitwold.t: Mentioned in passing: Imperial armies could billet in Mitwold and the Drakes gained strength fighting there.

Morrow.t: Mentioned in passing: citizen patrols meant the Druj needed 25 victory points for a beachhead, and Highborn or Urizen armies defending against attack from Zenith kept a bonus.

Mournwold.t: The Mournwold was the heart of the war over western hills against the Jotun, with Jarl Haakon a battle opportunity, the Tusks strengthened there and conjunctions in Alderly and Greensward.

Ossium.t: Mentioned in passing: citizen patrols meant the Druj needed 25 victory points for a beachhead, and Varushkan armies could take Hospitality of the Boyars there.

Redoubt.t: Imperial forces met the Grendel armada on Redoubt's shore while Children of Wrecks pirates sought to loot Elos, with saving Visten a battle opportunity and wreckers targeted at Ventosi.

Reikos.t: A conjunction to the High Arboretum on Chalcis Mount asked the High Exorcist to deal with ghosts.

Salt Flats of Sanath.t: A conjunction to Beladrarsh tasked Lady Laudine du Lac with killing the Druj and claiming their goods at the Drained Woods.

Sarvos.t: A sea beast threatened the fishing village of Charoko, and the Mayor of Caricomare was asked to protect its people, with a reward promised by the Mayor of Trivento.

Sermersuaq.t: Conjunctions sought help for the injured at the wreck of the Screaming Mammoth in Stark and to soothe the Thule of Volham in the East Floes.

Skarsind.t: Mentioned in passing: an Imperial Orc army in Skarsind could take the Forge Hammers order.

Spiral.t: Two conjunctions threatened Spiral, asking the Senator for Spiral to protect the Block in Cinion and the Oblivion Sentinel to stop the Spire of Black Glass in Screed.

The Barrens.t: The clash over the Fangs was listed under the Barrens, where patrols raised the Druj beachhead threshold to 25 victory points and conjunctions offered aid to Therunin's survivors, a baggage train defence and a meeting with the Rahvin.

Therunin.t: Four Imperial armies fought the Druj in tainted rain in Therunin, with two battle opportunities and a conjunction there, while the Gryphon's Pride marched north out of the territory to take the Fangs.

Upwold.t: Mentioned in passing: Imperial armies could billet in Upwold and the Bounders gained strength fighting there.

Volodmartz.t: A conjunction to Brez asked the Custodian of the Gift of the Dwindling Star to find and help the Chosen of Samkǒma.

Zenith.t: Mentioned in passing: citizen patrols meant the Druj needed 25 victory points for a beachhead, and Highborn or Urizen armies attacking from Morrow kept a bonus.

387YE Autumn Equinox Imperial elections.d: Nine territories returned senators, including Asael for Casinea and Ramos I Inigo I Raqueza for Kahraman. The Senate appointed ambassadors to Axos, the Grendel and the Sarcophan Delves, plus generals for nine armies including the Autumn Hammers and Eastern Sky. The Synod chose Dagon as Cardinal of Loyalty with 414 votes and Olyvar of Esther's Sanctum as Cardinal of Pride. The Military Council named Natalia 'The Falcon' Barossa Quartermaster General and appointed strategoi for Navarr, the Imperial Orcs, Varushka and Wintermark. Bourse seats, including the Fortress of Salt and the Great Pits of Ennerlund, went at auction, while others such as the Reeve of Boar's Market were decided by vote.

Dawn.t: Dawn's territory of Semmerholm returned Aurianna du Meravon as its senator.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: the Senate appointed Starlight Starchaser as Ambassador to the Grendel.

Highguard.t: Highguard's territory of Casinea elected Asael as its senator.

Imperial Orcs.t: Bloodcrow Ruk was appointed Strategos of the Imperial Orcs, giving the nation a new voice on the Military Council.

Navarr.t: Mouse Ddawnswraig was appointed Strategos of Navarr on the Military Council.

The Brass Coast.t: The Brass Coast returned two senators: Ramos I Inigo I Raqueza for Kahraman and Eulàlia i Phovas i Riqueza for Madruga.

The League.t: The League's territory of Tassato elected Cesare Sanguineo Rezia Di Tassato as its senator.

The Marches.t: The Marches' territory of Upwold returned Henry Birchsmith as its senator.

Urizen.t: Urizen's territory of Morrow elected Sejanus of the Scarlet Guard as its senator.

Varushka.t: Varushka gained a new senator for Volodmartz, Ostrik Vulpe, and a new Strategos of Varushka, Grymnir "Gallows".

Wintermark.t: Wintermark returned Bronn Dunwolf as Senator for Hahnmark, and Verdehil was appointed Strategos of Wintermark.

387YE Autumn Equinox Imperial elections.o: The Autumn Equinox summit of 387YE saw a wide round of Imperial elections and appointments, filling Senate seats, generalships, Synod titles, Military Council posts, Conclave offices and Bourse seats.

Casinea/Woodwych.t: Mentioned in passing: the new General of the Pilgrim's Defiance is named as Nathaniel of the Woodwych harts.

Casinea.t: Casinea elected Asael as its senator.

Hahnmark.t: Hahnmark elected Bronn Dunwolf as its senator.

Kahraman.t: Kahraman elected Ramos I Inigo I Raqueza as its senator, with a winning bid of 10 thrones and 1 ring.

Madruga.t: Madruga elected Eulàlia i Phovas i Riqueza as its senator, with a winning bid of 5 thrones and 1 ring.

Morrow.t: Morrow elected Sejanus of the Scarlet Guard as its senator.

Semmerholm.t: Semmerholm elected Aurianna du Meravon as its senator.

Tassato.t: Tassato elected Cesare Sanguineo Rezia Di Tassato as its senator.

Upwold.t: Upwold elected Henry Birchsmith as its senator.

Volodmartz.t: Volodmartz elected Ostrik Vulpe as its senator.

387YE Autumn Equinox Military Council or.d: Sarangrave had been captured from the Druj during the summit and made part of Urizen by the Senate. Five armies stayed there to assault the Tower of the Skink, which Druj forces were reported to be reinforcing. Four armies moved against the Jotun in Bregasland and six struck into Skallahn towards Kierheim. Three armies each moved into Mareave and Redoubt against the Grendel. The Red Wind Corsairs pursued the Children of Wrecks from Sarvos towards Feroz. Several weary armies rested, resupplied or consolidated in Astolat, Semmerholm, Bastion, Holberg and Upwold. Many armies were enchanted, and the Quartermaster General granted a share of the guerdon to supporters of six armies.

Dawn.t: The Lions of Adelmar stayed in Sarangrave for the final push, while the Golden Sun withdrew from Therunin to defend Astolat. The Eastern Sky and Gryphon's Pride returned to Semmerholm to recover and train.

Druj.t: Having lost Sarangrave, the Druj faced five Imperial armies converging on their remaining stronghold, the Tower of the Skink, which some Druj armies had reportedly moved to reinforce.

Grendel.t: Grendel forces in Mareave faced the Seventh Wave, Winter Sun and Towerjacks. In Redoubt they faced the Pilgrim's Defiance, Black Thorns and an Argent Sword ordered to plunder their supplies and riches.

Highguard.t: The Granite Pillar advanced on the Tower of the Skink and the Pilgrim's Defiance went to defend Redoubt. The Seventh Wave attacked into Mareave, with its supporters earning a share of the guerdon, and the Valiant Pegasus joined the assault on Skallahn.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Autumn Hammers were ordered to storm the walls of Kierheim and the Summer Storm to cut down Druj overseers in Thornfen. The Winter Sun marched south to defend the orcs' lands in Mareave; supporters of both of these last two armies earned a share of the guerdon.

Jotun.t: The Jotun faced a four-army counter-attack aimed at breaking their hold on Bregasland, and six Imperial armies striking into Skallahn towards the fortress of Kierheim.

Navarr.t: With Therunin fallen under the sway of the Vallorn, the Black Thorns marched to aid Urizen in Redoubt and the Quiet Step retired to Astolat to rest and rebuild.

The Brass Coast.t: The Burning Falcon and Fire of the South joined the northern assault on Skallahn. The Red Wind Corsairs sailed from Sarvos to engage the Children of Wrecks at sea in Feroz.

The League.t: The Towerjacks advanced on Mareave to drive out the Grendel, remembering the Imperial Orcs' relief of Holberg. The Wolves of War withdrew from Therunin to resupply at Virtue's Rest in Bastion.

The Marches.t: The Bounders, Drakes and Strong Reeds launched a combined effort to free Bregasland from the Jotun, with guerdon granted to supporters of the Drakes and Strong Reeds. The Tusks billeted in Upwold to take on new troops before winter.

Urizen.t: Urizen had gained Sarangrave by Senate decision. The Argent Sword was ordered to plunder the Grendel in Redoubt, aided by Highguard and Navarr, while the Citadel Guard rested and consolidated in Semmerholm.

Varushka.t: The Boyar's Hasta and Golden Axe attacked the Tower of the Skink alongside their Axou allies, with Golden Axe supporters earning a share of the guerdon. The Northern Eagle withdrew to Holberg to resupply and train.

Wintermark.t: The Bloodcloaks went to Bregasland to recover the lost and aid the Marchers. The Green Shield and Narwhal's Spear joined the assault on Skallahn.

387YE Autumn Equinox Military Council or.o: At the 387YE Autumn Equinox the Imperial generals issued their orders. Major offensives were launched against the Jotun in Bregasland and Skallahn, against the Grendel in Mareave and Redoubt, and against the Druj at the Tower of the Skink in newly Imperial Sarangrave.

Bregasland/Gravenmarch.t: The Bounders were ordered to make an overwhelming assault into Gravenmarch, part of a wider push from Mitwold to Gravenmarch to support the Strong Reeds against the Jotun.

Casinea/Woodwych.t: Mentioned in passing: the Pilgrim's Defiance general is styled Nathaniel of the Woodwych harts.

Sarangrave/Kroll.t: Mentioned in passing: the Eastern Sky's general jokingly sent regards from the beast of Kroll.

Sarangrave/Thornfen.t: The Summer Storm was ordered to cut down Druj overseers and slave makers in Thornfen, letting freed slaves make their way to safety.

Skallahn/Bjarkey.t: The Autumn Hammers were ordered to storm the walls of the Jotun fort of Kierheim in Bjarkey.

Astolat.t: The Golden Sun and Quiet Step arrived from Therunin and Sarangrave to mount a solid defence of Astolat and rest.

Bastion.t: The Wolves of War came to Virtue's Rest in Bastion to resupply and heal after fighting in Therunin.

Bay of Catazar.t: Mentioned in passing: the Grendel were noted to have unmatched manoeuvrability around the bay thanks to their ships.

Bregasland.t: The Bounders and Drakes launched overwhelming assaults and the Strong Reeds rose from the reeds, while the Bloodcloaks sought to recover the lost. Together they aimed to break the Jotun stranglehold on the Dour Fens.

Casinea.t: Mentioned in passing: the Seventh Wave and Pilgrim's Defiance marched out of Casinea, bound for Mareave and Redoubt.

Feroz.t: The Red Wind Corsairs sailed to Feroz to challenge pirate control of the eastern islands and engage the Children of Wrecks at sea.

Holberg.t: The Northern Eagle came to Holberg to resupply and train in hit-and-run tactics. The Towerjacks also recalled the earlier siege of Holberg.

Liathaven.t: Mentioned in passing: Liathaven is not named in the orders, and no Imperial army was sent there this season.

Mareave.t: The Seventh Wave and Winter Sun made balanced attacks and the Towerjacks a steady conquest, all aimed at driving the Grendel out of land claimed by the Imperial Orcs.

Mitwold.t: Mentioned in passing: the Drakes, Bloodcloaks, Valiant Pegasus and Autumn Hammers all set out from Mitwold for Bregasland and Skallahn.

Mournwold.t: Mentioned in passing: the Mourn was described as fully Imperial again, and the Burning Falcon and Tusks departed from there.

Ossium.t: Mentioned in passing: the Gryphon's Pride recalled its past victories in Ossium.

Redoubt.t: The Pilgrim's Defiance and Black Thorns made steady conquests to defend Redoubt against the Grendel. The Argent Sword was ordered to plunder Grendel supply lines and caches.

Sarangrave.t: Now part of Urizen, Sarangrave remained a battleground. The Lions of Adelmar, Granite Pillar, Summer Storm, Boyar's Hasta and Golden Axe moved against the Druj-held Tower of the Skink in the south.

Sarvos.t: Sarvos was declared safe, and the Red Wind Corsairs sailed from it in pursuit of the Children of Wrecks lurking off its coast.

Semmerholm.t: The Eastern Sky and Citadel Guard carried out arcane consolidation in Semmerholm and the Gryphon's Pride mounted a solid defence there while training.

Sermersuaq.t: Mentioned in passing: the Narwhal's Spear marched from Sermersuaq to Skallahn, its general addressing the territory's suffering.

Skallahn.t: Six Imperial armies drove into the heart of Skallahn towards Kierheim, domain of the late Jarl, hoping to catch the Jotun off guard while their attention was in the south.

Therunin.t: The Golden Sun and Wolves of War withdrew from Therunin, which the Black Thorns' general lamented had fallen to the sway of the Vallorn.

Upwold.t: The Tusks billeted in Upwold to take on new troops and celebrate the harvest, while the Bounders and Green Shield marched out to war.

Zenith.t: Mentioned in passing: the Towerjacks and Argent Sword set out from Zenith for Mareave and Redoubt.

387YE Autumn Equinox Senate sessions.d: The Singing Caves were allocated to the Marches and the Arch of the Sky to Urizen. Trade with Zemelslo was confirmed. The Spymaster gained the power to grant foreign access to spy networks, but not sole control over them. The Senate assigned the Sarangrave to Urizen and declared the Bloodwater Spears foreigners, but failed to do the same for the Grynbor. Membership of the Disciples of Sulemaine became punishable by death. Bids to establish the Sword Scholars and to ban the potions of the Broken Shore failed. Ambassadors were appointed to Axos, the Grendel and the Sarcophan Delves. The Throne declared war on the Brine Turtle sept, and the Ayereed smugglers' cove was decommissioned.

Druj.t: Mentioned in passing: the Grynbor are described as former slaves of the Druj in a failed motion to recognise them as foreigners.

Grendel.t: Starlight Starchaser was appointed Ambassador to the Grendel, and a motion to outlaw the potions of the Broken Shore, said to fund the Grendel war effort, failed. The Spymaster also decommissioned the Imperial smugglers' cove in Grendel-held Ayereed.

Navarr.t: The Voice of Barbs was made responsible for supporting the Navarr National Assembly. The Dancer's Rest in Miaren creates a Hand to the Dance appointed by that Assembly, and the First Voice Glade in Oakways is to be rebuilt to honour the Navarr bard Gerallt Brackensong.

Urizen.t: Urizen was assigned the Sarangrave and allocated the Arch of the Sky, and Urizen units driving out the Disciples of Sulemaine will not be prosecuted for their deaths. Starlight Starchaser of Urizen became Ambassador to the Grendel.

Wintermark.t: Thanmir Hrafnar of Wintermark became Ambassador to Axos. The Senate expanded the Pride of Ikka's Tears and commissioned the Forge of Bonds in Hahnmark and the Sorrowful Tunnels mithril mine in Skarsind.

387YE Autumn Equinox Senate sessions.o: At the 387YE Autumn Equinox the Senate passed a wide range of motions: it assigned the Sarangrave to Urizen, ratified a treaty with Axos, criminalised the Disciples of Sulemaine and set the Guerdon at 500 thrones. Eight commissions were also passed and several titles appointed.

Ayereed.t: The Imperial Spymaster announced the decommissioning of the smugglers' cove in Ayereed, which will take place over the season at an increased upkeep of five thrones.

Sarangrave.t: The Sarangrave was assigned to Urizen, and its senator will be elected for a shortened term at the Winter Solstice 387YE. Of its septs, the Bloodwater Spears were recognised as foreigners but the Grynbor were not.

Tsirku.t: Hahnmark proposed an appraisal of the obstacles to exploring the wastes of Tsirku, but the motion was withdrawn.

387YE Autumn Equinox Synod judgements.d: Assemblies honoured the Wintermark Fist of the Mountains, who died defending Elos, and an Imperial Orc call for an Assembly of Ancestors passed with a greater majority. Urizen and Varushkan mandates against the Disciples of Sulemaine and false virtues were enacted. A Wintermark mandate invited the Jotun to Gull Island, while a writ to consecrate the Meeting Place failed. Fintan Nighthaven, Sam Wych-Elm and Yosephus Morningson were condemned. Dagon of the Shattered Tower became Cardinal of Loyalty and Olyvar of Esther's Sanctum Cardinal of Pride. The Virtue Fund made seven rewardings, and seven doses of true liao were disbursed.

Dawn.t: The Dawnish Assembly called for the recovery of artefacts stolen from the Barrens, offered friendship to the Great Forest Orcs there and to the septs who rose in Sarangrave, and warned Semmerholm's mine owners against Dho'uala. It also urged support for the Red Wind Corsairs and appointed several Dawnish posts.

Druj.t: The Druj were the target of many judgements, including a Navarr condemnation of their tortured souls, a Highborn call to study their Black Lotus, and Wintermark's call to send military units east. A Navarr highest calling to destroy them was withdrawn.

Grendel.t: Assemblies urged vigilance against two Grendel spy networks in Sarvos and against Grendel attempts to rebuild their spy network in Redoubt. Prosperity condemned trade with the Grendel on Mora's Rock, and Urizen vowed to build a navy rather than be cowed.

Highguard.t: The Highborn Assembly worked through the rift over Achseh's dedication to a false virtue with several penances and vindications. It also celebrated Ehud and Asael for funding the fourth army, Pilgrim's Defiance, and pledged its inquisitors to help the League against spies in Sarvos. Urizen awarded Highguard the benefice of the Golden Cascade.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Imperial Orc Assembly's highest calling for an Assembly of Ancestors passed with a greater majority, though a call to scrap the doctrines of the Ancestors and the Howling Abyss failed. Navarr pledged to help defend Skarsind while its artisans forge a new Navarr army.

Jotun.t: Wintermark enacted a mandate inviting the Jotun to a meeting at the Gull Island hall at the Winter Solstice. A writ to consecrate the jointly rebuilt Meeting Place to Loyalty was not upheld.

Navarr.t: Navarr's sacrifice of Therunin was honoured, and the Navarr Assembly backed the Vallornguard and urged captains to rescue Thornsong House's research into a shield against vallorn miasma. It apologised to the Great Forest Orcs, but its highest calling to destroy the Druj was withdrawn.

The Brass Coast.t: The Freeborn Assembly warned against the false virtue of Anarchy and called for investigation of strange occurrences at Ghita's Veil. It also urged vigilance over a threatened attack on the Azure Chorus and called for the Firebrands to be revived.

The League.t: The League declared its reckoning with Urizen complete, warned of Grendel spies and Siakha cultists in Sarvos, and praised the Great Chains of Sarvos. Its mandate restricting engagement with the Silent Manse was enacted.

Thule.t: Statements lamented the land Varushka renounced to make peace with the Thule and the magical fortress expected to follow. They vowed to give up no more ground and urged defences to be built over the next five years.

Urizen.t: An enacted Urizen mandate let its military units hunt down the Disciples of Sulemaine, and the nation honoured the Fist of the Mountains for saving Elos. Urizen also declared its reckoning with the League complete and committed to work with Navarr against the vallorn in Sarangrave.

Varushka.t: The Varushkan Assembly vowed to cede no more land to the Thule and enacted a mandate against blasphemy and heresy. It also urged the Senate to accept Oksana's offer of 900 thrones to help nationalise the Hunt of Alderei the Fair.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark mourned the Fist of the Mountains and urged its military units to go east against the Druj. It enacted mandates to invite the Jotun to Gull Island and to bring Valdr Grieversonn before the Assembly, and Kaisa Last-Lantern was condemned as an idolator of the Falconer.

387YE Autumn Equinox Synod judgements.o: At the Autumn Equinox 387YE the Imperial Synod raised two hundred and nine judgements, covering statements of principle, mandates, inquisitions, sanctions, appointments and rewardings. Major themes were the war against the Druj and the vallorn, false virtues, Grendel espionage and the rift within Highguard.

Casinea/Mareholm.t: The Highborn Assembly urged that the empty Greenwatch tower in Mareholm be repurposed, perhaps as a pilgrim's rest, after Ossegrahn turned away and the ministry fell.

Casinea/Woodwych.t: Mentioned in passing: the Woodwych Harts appear only in the names of priests who raised General Assembly judgements.

Segura/Sobral Grasses.t: The Freeborn Assembly called for urgent investigation of strange occurrences at Ghita's Veil, a mana site in northern Sobral Grasses.

Casinea.t: The Highborn Assembly called for the abandoned Greenwatch tower to be turned into a pilgrim's rest or wayfarers' house, after the Greenwatch ministry fell.

Karsk.t: Mentioned in passing: a donation of one throne and four crowns to the Virtue Fund was made at the counting house of Karsk.

Redoubt.t: Urizen and Vigilance judgements urged the citizens of Redoubt to watch for the Grendel rebuilding their spy network. Redoubt was also named as where Sacharissa founded the Spider's Vantage Press.

Reikos.t: Mentioned in passing: a note recalls that tortured souls were first used during the Reikos campaign, and a donation was made at the Reikos counting house.

Sarangrave.t: Dawn invited the septs who rose against the Druj in Sarangrave to meet their Imperial neighbours. Urizen committed to work with Navarr against the vallorn there, as the Senate had assigned the territory to Urizen.

Segura.t: The Freeborn Assembly called for urgent investigation of strange occurrences at the mana site of Ghita's Veil.

Semmerholm.t: The Dawnish Assembly warned Semmerholm's mine owners not to deal with the sovereign Dho'uala or the eternal Jaheris. Vigilance also warned Dawnish mine owners of unexpected flooding in their mines.

Tassato.t: League and Navarr judgements invited Miaren's brokers to trade with the cities of Tassato to fund the war on the vallorn. The League Assembly also sought records of Tassato-born Sacharissa of Spider's Vantage.

The Barrens.t: Dawn called for the recovery of artefacts stolen in the Druj invasion and invited the Great Forest Orcs in the Barrens to work with them. A ritual had already been performed there to increase the prosperity of all inhabitants.

387YE Autumn Equinox event schedule.d: Eight nations held senatorial elections in their camps on Saturday afternoon, each by its own method, while nine nations elected national titles by Tally of the Votes from 3:30pm. Friday brought an Imperial Seer scrying, Sun Chamber, Ambassador and Senate sessions and a Vallornguard strategy meeting. Saturday included a battle off Anvil, an Axou delegation to the Senate, the Bourse auction, Grandmaster elections and a midnight parley with an unknown Eternal of Winter. Sunday held another battle, the Balancing of Ephisis' Scale, Academy graduation and final Senate and Military Council sessions.

Dawn.t: Dawn elected Semmerholm's senator at 2:30pm, immediately after the tourney, and at 5pm in Glory Square elected the Castellan of Spiral Castle, Reeve of Boar's Market, Merchant of the Fangs, Warden of the Weary and Envoy to the Karass; a Dawnish Fleet Captains' Meeting was also held on Saturday.

Highguard.t: Highguard elected Casinea's senator, with the inquisition of candidates beginning at 2pm in the Highborn camp.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Imperial Orcs elected the Legion Engineer, the Preceptor of the Skarsind College of Warcasting and the Bonesetter of the Delving Market at the Fire Pit from 3:30pm.

Navarr.t: Navarr elected the Thornsinger at the Standing Circle at 4pm.

The Brass Coast.t: The Brass Coast auctioned the senatorial seats for Kahraman and Madruga from 2pm, and at 4:30pm at the Waypoint elected the Red Depths, the Mistress of the Dust Parador and the Dhomiro of the Cinnabar Hills.

The League.t: The League elected Tassato's senator through the presentation of collected bonds at 3:30pm, and elected the Vardstein Vandal at the Plaza at 5pm.

The Marches.t: The Marches elected Upwold's senator when the landowners gathered at 1:30pm, and at 4:30pm in the Community Hall elected the Alder of Meade, the Master of the Root and Stem and the Stone Smith.

Urizen.t: Urizen held a demos for Morrow's senator from 1pm to 1:30pm, elected the Brilliant Star near the Net of Heaven at 3:30pm, and held a Urizen Magician's Meeting in the Hall of Worlds on Friday evening.

Varushka.t: Varushka began questioning candidates for Volodmartz's senator at 1:45pm, and at 4pm at the Central Hearth elected the Eternal Shafts of Time, the Bargainer of the Iron Tower and the Tolvoli Butcher.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark elected Hahnmark's senator with jars placed down for 15 minutes from 2pm, and at 5:30pm at the Tree of Names elected the Pride of Ikka's Tears, the Keeper of the Runegrott and the Kalpaheim Tradeholder.

387YE Autumn Equinox event schedule.o: This was the published schedule for the Autumn Equinox summit of 387YE, setting out the times of senatorial elections, national title elections by Tally of the Votes, and the meetings of the Senate, Military Council, Conclave, Bourse, Synod and Academy across the weekend.

Casinea.t: Casinea's senator was chosen by the Highborn, with the inquisition of candidates beginning at 2pm.

Hahnmark.t: Hahnmark's senator was elected by the Wintermark jar vote, with jars placed down for 15 minutes from 2pm.

Kahraman.t: Kahraman's senatorial seat went to auction in the Brass Coast camp from 2pm.

Madruga.t: Madruga's senatorial seat was auctioned from 2pm, though its next regular election was not due until the Winter Solstice 387YE.

Morrow.t: Morrow's senator was chosen by an Urizen demos held between 1pm and 1:30pm.

Semmerholm.t: Semmerholm's senator was elected in the Dawnish camp at 2:30pm, immediately after the tourney.

Skarsind.t: Mentioned in passing: the Imperial Orcs elected the Preceptor of the Skarsind College of Warcasting among their Tally of the Votes titles.

Spiral.t: Mentioned in passing: Dawn elected the Castellan of Spiral Castle among its national titles.

Tassato.t: Tassato's senator was elected by the League through the presentation of collected bonds at 3:30pm.

Upwold.t: Upwold's senator was elected when the Marcher landowners gathered at 1:30pm.

Volodmartz.t: Volodmartz's senator was chosen after the questioning of candidates began in the Varushkan camp at 1:45pm.

387YE Autumn Equinox interlude.d: The Guerdon stayed at 150 thrones, shared among units supporting the Boyar's Hasta and Citadel Guard in Sarangrave, the Wolves of War in Therunin, and the fortification Schogsfestnir in Liathaven. Marcher and Orc units could escort the Southern Herd's cattle through Spiral to Mareave, and Freeborn units could scout southern Madruga. Fleets could trade with several foreign ports. Congregations could preach Wisdom by encouraging pilgrimage to Hacynian. Other effects included a Navarr wayhouse in Ossium, the loss of the League's gallery liao bonus in favour of a bequest to the Vallornguard, and extra rings for Highborn businesses and mines. Rivers of Life was laid on Mournwold, fortification rituals were cast on several regions, and Day-magic beacons appeared in Madruga.

Dawn.t: Dawn's 88% battle-monstering rate was singled out as below standard, and Phoenix Rising cast the Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae on Hope's Rest in the Barrens.

Druj.t: Mentioned in passing: two Imperial armies in Druj-held Sarangrave, the Boyar's Hasta and the Citadel Guard, were named to receive shares of the Guerdon.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: Mareave, partly held by Grendel, is the destination of the Southern Herd, and fortification rituals were cast on its regions of Eoradal and Icarion.

Highguard.t: A deal between Highborn benefactors and a Sarcophan sect gave every Highguard business and mine an extra 18 rings a season until the Spring Equinox 388YE. Highguard's monstering rate was 104%.

Imperial Orcs.t: Orc military units could join the escort of the Southern Herd's cattle through Spiral to Mareave, and the nation recorded a 108% monstering rate.

Jotun.t: Mentioned in passing: Schogsfestnir in Jotun-held Liathaven was named as a fortification eligible for Guerdon shares.

Navarr.t: Navarr could take a free new resource in Ossium thanks to the Nearweald wayhouse, and could still vote as if in Therunin, where the Wolves of War received Guerdon support.

The Brass Coast.t: Freeborn units could dare the southern reaches of Madruga for vis, herbs and possibly marsh flowers. Day-magic beacons appeared on Madruga's coasts, and Serra Damata was fortified with the Frozen Citadel.

The League.t: League congregation owners lost their bonus liao from the Blood Red institutions after a seasonal bequest of ten thrones was redirected to the Vallornguard. The League's monstering rate was 104%.

The Marches.t: Marcher units could escort the cattle drive, and the Goatsbridge Coven laid Rivers of Life on Mournwold and Forge the Wooden Fastness on Alderly. The Marches' 71% monstering rate was criticised.

Urizen.t: Urizen topped the monstering rates with 111%, and the Sussivari Frost Coven cast Dripping Echoes of the Fen on Proceris in Zenith.

Varushka.t: Varushka's Boyar's Hasta in Sarangrave received Guerdon support, Navarr were encouraged to settle in Varushkan Ossium, and the nation recorded a 106% monstering rate.

Wintermark.t: The Sussivari Frost Coven cast Dripping Echoes of the Fen on West Marsh. Wintermark fleets gained a bonus trading at Caitun, but its 89% monstering rate was criticised.

387YE Autumn Equinox interlude.o: This interlude after the 387YE Summer Solstice set out the downtime opportunities and seasonal effects across the Empire. It covered the Imperial Guerdon, new military unit and fleet options, a special Wisdom lecture, and a range of enchantments and economic changes.

Kahraman/Serra Damata.t: Serra Damata was enchanted with the Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae by the Voices of the Unbound Storm.

Kallavesa/West Marsh.t: West Marsh had Dripping Echoes of the Fen cast on it by the Sussivari Frost Coven.

Madruga/Calvos Sound.t: A huge, painfully bright sphere of Day-magic light appeared at the highest point beside the sea in Calvos Sound, visible for miles at night.

Madruga/Free Landing.t: A shimmering sphere of white light appeared on Free Landing's coast, plainly the result of Day magic.

Madruga/Lightsea.t: Lightsea gained one of the brilliant Day-magic spheres, shining for miles across land and sea after dark.

Madruga/Siroc Bayou.t: A blazing sphere of light appeared at Siroc Bayou's highest point by the sea, with further effects still to come.

Mareave/Eoradal.t: The Heralds of the Reaper cast the Basalt Citadel on Eoradal.

Mareave/Icarion.t: Phoenix Rising cast the Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae on Icarion.

Mournwold/Alderly.t: The Goatsbridge Coven cast Forge the Wooden Fastness on Alderly, alongside the Rivers of Life laid across the whole Mournwold.

Ossium/Nearweald.t: A wayhouse was completed in Nearweald, allowing Navarr to move to Ossium without the usual two crown cost.

The Barrens/Hope's Rest.t: Hope's Rest was enchanted with the Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae by Phoenix Rising.

Zenith/Proceris.t: Proceris had Dripping Echoes of the Fen cast on it by the Sussivari Frost Coven.

Kahraman.t: The Voices of the Unbound Storm cast the Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae on Kahraman's region of Serra Damata.

Kallavesa.t: Dripping Echoes of the Fen was cast on Kallavesa's region of West Marsh by the Sussivari Frost Coven.

Liathaven.t: The fortification Schogsfestnir in Liathaven was named to receive a share of the Imperial Guerdon from units defending it.

Madruga.t: Freeborn units could scout its strange southern regions after the Rod and Shield took responsibility for the Camp of the Sand Crab, and blazing Day-magic spheres appeared in all four coastal regions.

Mareave.t: The Southern Herd's cattle could reach Mareave shortly before the Autumn Equinox if escorts committed at least fifteen hundred strength. Eoradal and Icarion were also fortified with rituals.

Mournwold.t: The Goatsbridge Coven wove Rivers of Life over the Mournwold, reducing army losses, healing wounds overnight and making people, animals and plants healthy and fertile.

Ossium.t: A completed wayhouse in Nearweald let Navarr take a new resource in Ossium for free this season.

Sarangrave.t: The Boyar's Hasta and the Citadel Guard, both campaigning in Sarangrave, were named to receive shares of the Guerdon.

Sarvos.t: Congregation owners in Sarvos lost the two extra doses of liao they had received from the Blood Red institutions.

Spiral.t: The Southern Herd's cattle had to be escorted through the dangerous wilds of Spiral on the second leg of their journey to Mareave.

Tassato.t: Congregation owners in Tassato no longer received the additional two doses of liao each season after the Blood Red Bequest.

Temeschwar.t: Congregation owners in Temeschwar lost their seasonal liao bonus as patronage was redirected to the Vallornguard.

The Barrens.t: Phoenix Rising cast the Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae on the Barrens region of Hope's Rest.

Therunin.t: The Wolves of War in Therunin were named for Guerdon shares, and Navarr resettling in Ossium kept their Therunin vote in senatorial elections.

Zenith.t: The Sussivari Frost Coven cast Dripping Echoes of the Fen on Zenith's region of Proceris.

387YE Autumn Equinox winds of fortune.d: The winds covered eternal responses to plenipotentiaries, Empress Vesna's address calling for the conquest of Sarangrave, foreign diplomacy, a proposed port for Holberg, the Disciples of Sulemaine and the Falconer cult. The Free Folk pledged to strengthen the Proffered Hand. The Silent Bell lost over a hundred members spying on the Druj, and their report is due at the Winter Solstice. The Southern Herd of 272 cattle reached Nadir. Dawn and Navarr stopped Yaw'nagrah lifting Brocéliande's curse. Big Icebarn will stay in the Suaq Wastes if enough Wintermark strength supports it. Summer conjunctions destroyed the Mountain Bulwark in Bregasland and poisoned a Druj egg sac in Zenith. They also settled many smaller clashes.

Dawn.t: Dawnish units helped stop Yaw'nagrah's heralds in Brocéliande, and the Earl of the Groves invited Dawn's nobles to a banquet. The Dawnish Assembly can call on the Free Folk's aid for the Proffered Hand with a greater majority judgement.

Druj.t: The Silent Bell lost over a hundred agents spying on how the Druj wield Fear, and the Empress called for the Druj's defeat. Druj forces were beaten in several conjunctions, though the Palace of Sleepers escaped in Kroll.

Grendel.t: A Grendel surprise attack complicated the hunt for enemies in Redoubt, and the Empire had earlier penetrated a Grendel espionage outpost in Apulian. Grendel were defeated at Halkrin's Orchard, and a Grendel wind lord met the Imperial ambassador at Black Sand Tower.

Highguard.t: Highguard was tagged in winds on the Falconer cult and on Sarcophan investment. Its Champion of Pride killed servants of the Red God in Necropolis.

Imperial Orcs.t: Ten Imperial Orc warbands escorted 272 cattle of the Southern Herd safely to Nadir and had their units upgraded as a reward. The title Shepherd of the Southern Herd becomes available at the Winter Solstice.

Jotun.t: The Jotun lost the Mountain Bulwark at Cinder Drove in Bregasland and completed a fortification in West Ranging. They also featured in that season's diplomatic dealings.

Navarr.t: Navarri units joined Dawn in defeating Yaw'nagrah's heralds in Brocéliande, which prevents any attempt to lift its curse until Winter 388YE.

The Brass Coast.t: The Zemress Naval Academy has almost finished researching swift sails, and the next research project will be chosen at the Winter Solstice.

The League.t: Holberg was the focus of an appraisal into building a port and of a Commonwealth study into securing its food and water against siege and refugees.

The Marches.t: Three Marcher forces helped escort the Southern Herd and were upgraded as a reward. Ulvenwar were killed and Marcher orcs rescued in the Mournwold.

Thule.t: Mentioned in passing: the Thule are listed among the neighbours discussed in the Bedight in veils diplomacy wind.

Urizen.t: Urizen faces the hidden Disciples of Sulemaine. Its Field Marshal Nicassia Avicia led the poisoning of a Druj egg sac in Proceris.

Varushka.t: Delev's new Great Hall of Fabric Arts prompted a national fabric-art competition at the Winter Market. Varushkans were also tagged in the Holberg port appraisal and the mining winds.

Wintermark.t: More than twelve thousand Wintermark strength kept Big Icebarn hunting in the Suaq Wastes. Eisa Ironlungs led the destruction of the Mountain Bulwark in Bregasland.

387YE Autumn Equinox winds of fortune.o: For the 387YE Autumn Equinox, twenty-three winds of fortune were released, alongside reports on the Free Folk, the Silent Bell's costly spying on the Druj, the Southern Herd, Big Icebarn's hunt and the outcomes of the Summer Solstice conjunctions across the Empire.

Bregasland/Ottermire.t: The Cadet Commander's band rescued a magician from Picklers Marsh and escorted them back to Anvil.

Bregasland/The Rushes.t: At Cinder Drove, Field Marshal Eisa Ironlungs led the destruction of the Mountain Bulwark and the Clakes were rescued; Sammy Clake was executed in Anvil.

Brocéliande/Dark Ranging.t: The cult's leaders at the Darkened Glade were killed under the Speaker of the Vallornguard.

Brocéliande/Vale's Lament.t: Heralds of the Green Mother working to spread Spring magic from Vale's Lament were defeated by ten Dawnish and Navarri units.

Feroz/Morajasse.t: Mentioned in passing: the new Protectorate of Morajasse is among those discussed in the Bedight in veils wind.

Hahnmark/Valasmark.t: Cultists at Dunhall Copse were killed under the Senator for Hahnmark.

Hahnmark/Wood Heath.t: A murderer troubling Dunfrith was identified and escorted out of the village, though no trial has been reported.

Kallavesa/Kallavesa Marsh.t: The Crow Keeper of the Rest's band destroyed all the coral husks at Mjod's Glen.

Liathaven/Liath's Ring.t: The construct and heralds of Eleonaris at Sigryn's Bawn were killed under the Champion of Ambition.

Liathaven/Liaven's Glen.t: At Freydi's Meadow the heralds of Eleonaris were killed and the construct recovered.

Liathaven/West Ranging.t: Halbera Strongarm was killed at her stockade. The Far Steading conjunction went untaken, however: a Jotun fortification was completed, two Feni died and Forge's Aegis was lost.

Mareave/Beoraidh.t: The Ambassador to the Grendel met a visiting Grendel wind lord at Black Sand Tower; the outcome is unclear, though Finna should know more.

Mareave/Fleisardh.t: Grendel were defeated at Halkrin's Orchard and their cache of resources was recovered.

Mareave/Icarion.t: The Courath of Icarion was defeated at its hold and Stormcaller was recovered.

Mareave/Nadir.t: The Southern Herd of 272 cattle arrived safely in Nadir after a two-season escort by orc and Marcher forces.

Miaren/Serenael.t: An effort to ease the passing of ghosts at the Seren Temple building site had an unclear result.

Miekarova/Mieriada.t: Cultists at the Painted Clearing were killed.

Mournwold/Greensward.t: Ulvenwar were killed and Marcher orcs rescued at both Honour's Rest Fields and Farstrider Approach.

Mournwold/Southmoor.t: The yegarra in Warthill Woods was defeated and eight wains of mithril were delivered to Jonah John.

Necropolis/Coursmouth.t: Servants of the Red God at Broken Grove were killed under the Champion of Pride.

Ossium/Bittershore.t: Mentioned in passing: the Merchant Boyar of the Bittershore is tagged in the Holberg port appraisal wind.

Sarangrave/Bendol.t: The Knight of the Greenwood's band recovered Vate's Shelter at Ghulai's Rest.

Sarangrave/Kroll.t: The Palace Expanse conjunction went untaken, so the Palace of Sleepers escaped, Het Trakaa lives and the Krollthorned remain a threat.

Sermersuaq/Suaq Wastes.t: Big Icebarn kept hunting Agramant's monsters and could draw out a guardian if thirteen thousand Wintermark strength supports it. Typhawn was killed at its pen.

Skallahn/Fareskov.t: Eerikki Korpi entered the Dark Woods for the Toad King, with the outcome unclear.

Skarsind/Estermark.t: Cultists in the Mormyk Woods were killed.

The Barrens/The Bleaks.t: Heralds of Arhallogen and Druj were killed at Last Battle's Field.

The Barrens/The Untrod Groves.t: The manticore calling itself Earl of the Groves, which claims Dawnish lineage, has invited Dawn to a banquet on its lands.

Therunin/Eastring.t: The Druj and heralds of Arhallogen were defeated at the Toxic Sward, and the lantern at Glimmerwater was basked in.

Therunin/Greenheart.t: The Druj were defeated in the Untrod Wilds and resources were recovered.

Zenith/Lustri.t: The Druj were defeated at Danwyn's Path under the Champion of Vigilance.

Zenith/Proceris.t: At the Plantation of Tall Ferns, Nicassia Avicia's force poisoned the Druj egg sac, though Orbubus' Weepers survive.

Bregasland.t: Imperial heroes destroyed the Jotun's Mountain Bulwark and rescued the Clakes at Cinder Drove. A magician was also rescued from Picklers Marsh.
