Brocéliande.t: Yaw'nagrah's attempt to lift the territory's curse was thwarted until Winter 388YE, and a cult's leaders were killed in the Darkened Glade.

Casinea.t: Mentioned in passing: citizens of Casinea are tagged as interested in the Volumes of forgotten lore wind.

Feroz.t: Mentioned in passing: the new Protectorate of Morajasse is among the neighbours covered in the Bedight in veils diplomacy wind.

Hahnmark.t: A murderer was identified and escorted out of Dunfrith, and cultists were killed at Dunhall Copse.

Holberg.t: An appraisal examined building a port for Holberg, and Commonwealth scholars studied how to secure its food and water against sieges and refugees.

Kallavesa.t: All the coral husks at Mjod's Glen were destroyed.

Karov.t: Mentioned in passing: people who spent time in Karov and its mine owners are tagged in the astronomancy and magic winds.

Karsk.t: Mentioned in passing: Karsk's mine owners are tagged in the Upon a midnight dreary wind.

Liathaven.t: Halbera Strongarm was killed, a construct was recovered and heralds of Eleonaris were slain. However, the unanswered Far Steading conjunction let the Jotun complete a fortification and Forge's Aegis was lost.

Madruga.t: Mentioned in passing: Madruga is not named on the page; the only Brass Coast item is the Zemress Naval Academy's swift sails research.

Mareave.t: The Southern Herd arrived in Nadir. The Courath of Icarion was defeated and Grendel were beaten at Halkrin's Orchard. A Grendel wind lord met the Imperial ambassador at Black Sand Tower.

Miaren.t: Imperial heroes tried to ease the passing of ghosts at the Seren Temple building site. The outcome is unclear, though Tanwen should know more.

Miekarova.t: Cultists at the Painted Clearing were killed under the Senator for Miekarova.

Mournwold.t: A yegarra was defeated, freeing eight wains of mithril for Jonah John. Ulvenwar were killed and Marcher orcs rescued at two sites in Greensward.

Necropolis.t: Servants of the Red God were killed at Broken Grove, and the folk of Necropolis are tagged in the eternals wind.

Ossium.t: Mentioned in passing: Ossium's mine owners and the Merchant Boyar of the Bittershore are tagged in the mining and Holberg port winds.

Otkodov.t: Mentioned in passing: the Ambassador to Otkodov is tagged in the Bedight in veils diplomacy wind.

Redoubt.t: Followers of Berechiah hunting enemies of the Empire in Redoubt were hampered by a Grendel surprise attack, but they had a stroke of luck at the last moment.

Sarangrave.t: The Empress called for Sarangrave's conquest and liberation. Vate's Shelter was recovered in Bendol, but in Kroll the Palace of Sleepers escaped and Het Trakaa lives.

Semmerholm.t: Mentioned in passing: Semmerholm's mine owners and visitors are tagged in the eternals and astronomancy winds.

Sermersuaq.t: Big Icebarn continued hunting Agramant's monsters in the Suaq Wastes, and Typhawn was killed.

Skallahn.t: Eerikki Korpi entered the dark woods of Fareskov on behalf of the Toad King, with the outcome unclear.

Skarsind.t: Cultists in the Mormyk Woods were killed under the Shepherd of the Great Herd.

Spiral.t: Mentioned in passing: people from Spiral are tagged in the astronomancy and magic winds, and travellers from there may have seen the Southern Herd.

The Barrens.t: The manticore Earl of the Groves invited Dawn to a banquet, and Druj and heralds of Arhallogen were killed at Last Battle's Field.

Therunin.t: The Druj and heralds of Arhallogen were defeated at the Toxic Sward and the Untrod Wilds, and Eanna Glimmerwater's lantern was basked in.

Upwold.t: Mentioned in passing: people living in Upwold are tagged in the Upon a midnight dreary wind.

Volodmartz.t: Mentioned in passing: Volodmartz's mine owners are tagged in the Upon a midnight dreary wind.

Weirwater.t: Mentioned in passing: Weirwater's mine owners are tagged in the Upon a midnight dreary wind.

Zenith.t: A Druj egg sac was poisoned in Proceris, although Orbubus' Weepers survive, and the Druj were defeated at Danwyn's Path.

387YE Autumn Equinox winds of war.d: Marcher armies breached Landskeeper's Bulwark and drove out the Jotun, leaving the Mournwold wholly Marcher. In Bregasland, the Strong Reeds evaded the Lion of the North while Jotun champions raided Mitwold. Eight Jotun armies shattered Schogsfestnir and retook all of Liathaven, scattering Imperial mercenaries. The Grendel were welcomed into southern Mareave by the Brine Turtles and captured Elos in Redoubt, though the Fist of the Mountains' sacrifice saved the town. A second Children of Wrecks attack on Sarvos proved indecisive. Two armies held back the vallorn in Therunin, and the conquest of the Sarangrave continued. Generals were to choose two of four battle opportunities, alongside many conjunctions.

Dawn.t: Dawn's borders in the Barrens were patrolled under Ser Tunic's mandate, so the Druj needed 25 victory points to claim a beachhead there. The Nobles of Dawn had a feast conjunction in the Barrens, and Dawn's Victors shared a challenge in Semmerholm.

Druj.t: The Druj were said to be in disarray as the Empire pressed its conquest of the Sarangrave, where an opportunity to claim Whisperwood was offered against them. Their unleashing of the Therunin vallorn continued to tie down two Imperial armies.

Grendel.t: The Grendel returned after months away. Their armies were welcomed into southern Mareave by the Brine Turtles sept, and an armada captured the Urizen port-city of Elos in Redoubt.

Highguard.t: Highborn armies could take the Protect the Innocent order and gained bonuses when attacking into Zenith from Morrow. A conjunction was offered to stop wreckers at Longbeach in the Necropolis.

Imperial Orcs.t: Husks rampaging in Solvihill, apparently the remains of a Temeschwar mercenary guild, fell to the Broken Shield Guardian Redhand Gezzar to defeat for a bounty of herbs. The nation had only 5 force weight available for the battles.

Jotun.t: The Jotun lost the Mournwold when Landskeeper's Bulwark fell, but eight armies smashed Schogsfestnir and retook all of Liathaven. The Lion of the North hunted the Strong Reeds in Bregasland, and Jarl Gorm Gillasbairn's warband raided Kahraman.

Navarr.t: Navarr among the mercenaries fleeing Liathaven faced summary execution by the Jotun. Navarr's 61 force weight could be committed to the summit's battles, and conjunctions were offered to the vallorn nests of Therunin and the Singing Circle in Brocéliande.

The Brass Coast.t: The families of Gambit in Kahraman were raided by a Jotun warband, and the Dhomiro of the Cinnabar Hills was charged with killing its jarl. Red Wind corsairs fought the Children of Wrecks off Sarvos, and wreckers threatened Calvos Sound in Madruga.

The League.t: League garrisons in Sarvos fought off a second Children of Wrecks attack, which proved indecisive. The Champion of Prosperity was charged with stopping the wreckers in Riposi.

The Marches.t: The Tusks and the Burning Falcon won back the whole Mournwold, while the Strong Reeds played cat-and-eel with the Lion of the North in Bregasland. An exhibition foot-the-ball match for the Reconquest Cup was arranged near Meade to lift Marcher spirits.

Urizen.t: Urizen lost the port-city of Elos to a Grendel armada, and only the Fist of the Mountains' sacrifice prevented its destruction. A battle opportunity to protect the Tower of Light and Shadow in Naris was offered, while patrols in Morrow and Zenith hindered Druj beachheads.

Varushka.t: Varushkan citizens patrolled Ossium under Velko Perunovich Razorasza's mandate, and Varushkan armies there could take the Hospitality of the Boyars order. Varushka had 16 force weight available for the battles.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark had the largest force weight for the battles at 66, and its armies gained honour-related bonuses against the Jotun. Conjunctions in Sermersuaq targeted the Voices of Tanikipari, the Wastes and the Fount and their pillars, and Eanwyn Dunning was to bring Thurwolf to justice in Hahnmark.

387YE Autumn Equinox winds of war.o: The Autumn Equinox 387YE Winds of War summarised a season in which the Marches retook all of the Mournwold, the Jotun destroyed Schogsfestnir and reclaimed Liathaven, and the Grendel returned to seize Elos in Redoubt. It also set out the battle opportunities and Sentinel Gate conjunctions for the coming summit.

Bregasland/Grey Fens.t: A battle opportunity against the Jotun at Leakey Moss was offered so that Imperial heroes could intervene for the Strong Reeds.

Brocéliande/Vale's Lament.t: Up to 600 people could visit the Singing Circle by conjunction, under Nathair Autumngale's responsibility.

Hahnmark/Northspires.t: Thurwolf was cornered by roving bandits in Greyhearth Woods, where a conjunction sought to bring him to justice.

Kahraman/Gambit.t: Jarl Gorm Gillasbairn's warband struck Gambit's families for wealth. If he were killed at Golden Copse, the Jarl of Alftanes would withdraw in grief for at least a season.

Liathaven/Liaven's Glen.t: The Jotun reclaimed Liaven's Glen and Jarl Heivar hunted Schogsfestnir's survivors. The Quartermaster General Natalia 'The Falcon' Barossa was charged with rescuing them.

Madruga/Calvos Sound.t: Wreckers at Mawrig's Point were to be stopped by a conjunction under the Champion of Vigilance.

Mitwold/Meade March.t: The New Old Sports Field outside Meade hosted the Reconquest Cup between the Eels-in-Exile and the Old Pigs, overseen by the Bailiff of the Grand Market.

Mournwold/Freemoor.t: Mentioned in passing: Freemoor is home to the Old Pigs, the foot-the-ball team playing in the Reconquest Cup.

Necropolis/Longbeach.t: The Champion of Loyalty was charged with stopping the wreckers at Abigal's Orchard.

Redoubt/Naris.t: A battle opportunity was offered on the Tilphussian Approach to protect the Tower of Light and Shadow from the Grendel and winter husks.

Sarangrave/Kroll.t: Conjunctions were offered to destroy tortured souls at the Haunted Copse and to end Flavia of the Guiding Lights and Dmitriy Innokentievich.

Sarangrave/Turan Flats.t: Two low-combat conjunctions were offered to treat the wounded, at Lamorak's Rest and Ormgore's Spinney.

Sarangrave/Whisperwood.t: A battle opportunity to claim Whisperwood from the Druj at the Uklead Groves was offered for Saturday.

Sarvos/Riposi.t: The Champion of Prosperity was charged with stopping the wreckers at the Circle of Savagery.

Semmerholm/Axmure.t: A challenge at the Grove of the Thousand was offered to the Victors of Dawn and Wintermark.

Sermersuaq/Stark.t: The Woundbinder of the Mark was asked to help wounded merchants at the Iron Crossroads.

Sermersuaq/Suaq Fount.t: A conjunction at Icelveld sought to kill the Voice of the Fount and destroy its pillar, under the Speaker of the Highborn Assembly.

Sermersuaq/Suaq Wastes.t: A conjunction at Wulfhere's Meadow sought to kill the Voice of the Wastes and destroy its pillar, under the Counsel of the Sun Chamber.

Sermersuaq/Tanikipari.t: Corrin Arrowsbane was charged with killing the Voice of Tanikipari and destroying its pillar on the Plains of Cyneswith.

Skarsind/Solvihill.t: Rampaging husks in the Broken Forest were to be defeated by the Broken Shield Guardian, with local coteries offering a bounty of herbs.

Therunin/Greenheart.t: The Archmage of Spring was given responsibility for a visit to the Three Stones by conjunction.

Therunin/Peakedge Song.t: A battle opportunity was offered to disrupt the Ettercap Nest in the Thorngroves against vallornspawn.

Therunin/Sweetglades.t: A vallorn nest here drew an Apothecaries' investigation and two conjunctions to disrupt it, at the Squamous Woods and the Twitching Grove.

Bregasland.t: The Strong Reeds evaded the Queen of Kalsea's army, the Lion of the North, in the Jotun-held marshes. A battle opportunity was offered to intervene on their behalf in the Grey Fens.

Brocéliande.t: A large, low-combat conjunction under Nathair Autumngale was offered to visit the Singing Circle in Vale's Lament.

Hahnmark.t: Thurwolf, the confessed murderer linked to the dark deeds at Dunfrith, was reported hiding in Northspires woodland amid roving bandits. Eanwyn Dunning was charged with bringing him to justice.

Kahraman.t: Jotun returned for the first time in two years when Jarl Gorm Gillasbairn's warband raided Gambit for wealth. Imperial mercenaries fleeing Liathaven scattered here.

Liathaven.t: A Jotun host of eight armies shattered the fortification of Schogsfestnir and drove every trace of Imperial presence out of the territory. Survivors, including several generals, remained trapped behind Jotun lines.

Madruga.t: Wreckers threatened Calvos Sound, and the Champion of Vigilance was charged with stopping them via a conjunction.

Mareave.t: Grendel armies marched into southern Mareave and were welcomed with open arms by the Brine Turtles sept.

Mitwold.t: Jotun champions raided into Mitwold to test its defenders. A conjunction near Meade hosted the Reconquest Cup foot-the-ball match, and the Drakes gained extra strength when fighting here.

Morrow.t: Citizen patrols under Herminius of the House of the Wanderer raised the Druj beachhead threshold to 25 victory points. Highborn and Urizen armies attacking Zenith from Morrow, or defending Morrow, gained bonuses.

Mournwold.t: Landskeeper's Bulwark was breached and the Jotun fell, leaving the Mournwold entirely in Marcher hands once more. Imperial Summer magic saved the fortification itself.

Necropolis.t: Wreckers threatened Longbeach, and the Champion of Loyalty was charged with stopping them at Abigal's Orchard.

Ossium.t: Citizen patrols under Velko Perunovich Razorasza's mandate meant the Druj needed 25 victory points for a beachhead. Varushkan armies here could take the Hospitality of the Boyars order.

Redoubt.t: A Grendel armada captured the port-city of Elos, though the Fist of the Mountains' sacrifice stopped the town being destroyed. A battle opportunity to protect the Tower of Light and Shadow in Naris was offered.

Sarangrave.t: The Imperial conquest of the territory continued against disorganised Druj. Opportunities included a battle to claim Whisperwood, conjunctions in Kroll against tortured souls and named foes, and treating the wounded in the Turan Flats.

Sarvos.t: The Children of Wrecks launched a second attack on the coast against League garrisons and Red Wind corsairs, and the fighting was indecisive. A conjunction to stop the wreckers in Riposi followed.

Semmerholm.t: The Victors of Dawn and Wintermark were invited to complete a challenge at the Grove of the Thousand in Axmure.

Sermersuaq.t: Conjunctions targeted the Voices and pillars in Tanikipari, the Suaq Wastes and the Suaq Fount. The Woundbinder of the Mark was asked to help wounded merchants in Stark.

Skarsind.t: Husks with dreadful wounds rampaged around Solvihill after screams from the Cerise Harvesters' camp. The Broken Shield Guardian was charged with defeating them.

Temeschwar.t: Mentioned in passing: the Cerise Harvesters, apparently from Temeschwar, were the mercenary guild whose camp in Solvihill gave rise to the husks.

The Barrens.t: Citizen patrols under Ser Tunic's mandate raised the Druj beachhead threshold to 25 victory points. A feast at the Red Hall in Untrod Groves was offered as a conjunction.

Therunin.t: Two Imperial armies, backed by thousands of captains and adventurers, fought to hold back the vallorn the Druj had unleashed. A battle against the Ettercap Nest and several conjunctions in Sweetglades and Greenheart were offered.

Upwold.t: Imperial armies could billet in Upwold, and the Bounders gained extra strength when fighting here. Upwolders were welcome to join a side in the Reconquest Cup.

Zenith.t: Zenith shared a Wind of War with the Sarangrave, and citizen patrols raised the Druj beachhead threshold to 25 victory points. Highborn and Urizen armies attacking into Zenith from Morrow gained bonuses.

387YE Spring Equinox Imperial elections.d: National elections returned senators for Hahnmark, Holberg, Karsk, Mareave, Mournwold, Reikos, Segura and the Barrens. The Senate appointed ambassadors, the Imperial Spymaster Rahmah i Darwisj i Erigo and generals of seven armies, among other posts. The Synod chose figures such as the Lepidean Librarian Hazelelponi (330 votes) and the Cardinals of Ambition and Vigilance. The Military Council named Giovanni von Temeschwar Imperial Fleet Master and Sibylla Strategos of Dawn. Conclave orders chose grandmasters and Ibiss Briarheart declared for Archmage of Spring. Bourse auctions and votes allocated titles including Master of the Imperial Mint and the Tassatan Hills, won by Serafina di Sarvos with 1103 votes.

Dawn.t: Lady Gwendoloena de Sarroi was elected Senator for the Barrens, and Sibylla was appointed Strategos of Dawn by the Military Council.

Grendel.t: Pathfinder Gaddak was elected to represent Mareave in the Senate.

Highguard.t: Cyrus was elected Senator for Reikos.

The Brass Coast.t: Velasco i Guerra was elected to speak for Segura in the Senate.

The League.t: Kaspar Yakovich von Holberg was elected Senator for Holberg.

The Marches.t: Simon "Chordwangler" Willow was elected Senator for the Mournwold.

Varushka.t: Sirka Parakgoosier Bashnya was elected Senator for Karsk.

Wintermark.t: Runa was elected to represent Hahnmark in the Senate.

387YE Spring Equinox Imperial elections.o: At the 387YE Spring Equinox summit, a wide range of Imperial titles were filled by election and appointment, including senators for eight territories, Senate-appointed generals and ambassadors, Synod positions, Bourse seats and Military Council posts.

Hahnmark.t: Hahnmark's Senate seat went to Runa at this summit's national election.

Holberg.t: Holberg elected Kaspar Yakovich von Holberg as its senator.

Karsk.t: Karsk returned Sirka Parakgoosier Bashnya as its senator.

Mareave.t: Mareave's senatorial election was won by Pathfinder Gaddak.

Mournwold.t: The Mournwold chose Simon "Chordwangler" Willow as its senator.

Reikos.t: Reikos elected Cyrus to its Senate seat.

Segura.t: Segura's senator for the coming term is Velasco i Guerra.

The Barrens.t: The Barrens elected Lady Gwendoloena de Sarroi as their senator.

387YE Spring Equinox Military Council or.d: The Jotun had overrun almost all of Bregasland, but Imperial heroes held the Sallow Way and saved Ottery, for now. A raid on Grismont Township in Reinos failed and the armies withdrew from the hills. Seven armies then marched on Liathaven, which the Jotun have remade as Ashvale. Nine armies and sixteen thousand Summer knights converged on Sarangrave, six of them through the Barrens. The Tusks fought on in the Chalkdowns, and the Burning Falcon and Fist of the Mountains moved to tame Madruga. In Therunin the vallorn stirred against the Lord Rain ward. Only the Autumn Hammers and Northern Eagle drew the guerdon.

Dawn.t: The Eastern Sky, Gryphon's Pride and Lions of Adelmar left Astolat to attack Sarangrave alongside Summer knights. The Golden Sun stayed in Astolat on solid defence, its general warning against the self-styled Earl of Groves.

Druj.t: The Druj faced a pincer invasion of Sarangrave by nine Imperial armies. Their great host in Therunin may stay or move as the vallorn stirs there.

Grendel.t: The Grendel still held Mora's Rock. The fate of the Imperial campaign in Madruga was said to depend heavily on where their armada is.

Jotun.t: The Jotun were narrowly denied Ottery after conquering most of Bregasland. They now face seven Imperial armies in Liathaven and the Tusks' continued fighting in Mournwold, though they held Grismont Township in Reinos.

Navarr.t: The Black Thorns withdrew to resupply at Virtue's Rest in Bastion while the Quiet Step joined the Sarangrave invasion. Seven armies marched to reclaim Liathaven, once Navarr land.

The Brass Coast.t: The Burning Falcon made a triumphant charge into Madruga and the Fire of the South reinforced Tassato. The Red Wind Corsairs billeted in Mitwold as their general prepared to step down.

The League.t: The Towerjacks dug in at Morrow to help build a citadel in Peregro, and the Wolves of War gave ground there to prepare for the next season.

The Marches.t: The Bounders and Drakes joined the conquest of Liathaven and the Tusks pressed on in the Chalkdowns. The Strong Reeds lay low in Bregasland as Ottery clung on.

Urizen.t: The Citadel Guard marched in Sarangrave to raise a glass labyrinth around the Druj while letting their subjects slip to safety.

Varushka.t: The Golden Axe pressed on to take land in Sarangrave and the Northern Eagle joined the attack there. The Northern Eagle's supporters were granted a share of the guerdon.

Wintermark.t: The Bloodcloaks, Green Shield and Narwhal's Spear marched into Liathaven against the Jotun, while the Fist of the Mountains began a steady conquest of Madruga.

387YE Spring Equinox Military Council or.o: At the Spring Equinox 387YE the Imperial generals sent nine armies against the Druj in Sarangrave and seven against the Jotun in Liathaven. Two more armies pushed into Madruga, while others defended, dug in or rested elsewhere.

Bregasland/North Fens.t: Jotun warbands picked their way east out of the North Fens as they pressed to finish the conquest of Bregasland.

Bregasland/Ottermire.t: Ottery held, thanks to heroes who beat the Bounds at Sal-Ott meet and roused the Marcher army. The town will fall if the Jotun keep advancing.

Morrow/Peregro.t: The Towerjacks were ordered to put their engineering skills to helping their friends in Peregro build a citadel.

Mournwold/Chalkdowns.t: The Tusks marched in steady conquest to reclaim the Chalkdowns, home of their former general Stanley of Chalkdown.

Mournwold/Greensward.t: Mentioned in passing: the Tusks were told not to advance into Greensward, leaving it as work for the Summer.

Reinos/Bastasor.t: The strike on Grismont Township was meant to break Lasambrian control of Bastasor but failed when the orcs held the town. The captured Faraden trader perished in the fighting.

Astolat.t: The Golden Sun held Astolat on solid defence, while five armies marched out towards Sarangrave and the Wolves of War and Fire of the South departed.

Bastion.t: The Navarr Black Thorns arrived to resupply and reposition at Virtue's Rest.

Bay of Catazar.t: Mentioned in passing: the shores of the Bay are named among the places of coming chaos, and the Grendel armada's position is a concern.

Bregasland.t: The Jotun held almost all of Bregasland, but heroes kept Ottery, the Otterway and the Sallow Way Imperial for now. The Strong Reeds lay low there.

Casinea.t: The Valiant Pegasus and Summer Storm took up solid defence in Casinea to rest and resupply.

Feroz.t: Mentioned in passing: the Grendel are noted as remaining in command of Mora's Rock; no Imperial army was sent there.

Kahraman.t: Mentioned in passing: the Red Wind Corsairs' general recalls having kept watch on Kahraman.

Liathaven.t: Seven Imperial armies descended on Jotun-held Liathaven, now Ashvale, to break the barbarian hold. Among them, the Autumn Hammers moved to storm the fort in Liath's Glen.

Madruga.t: The Burning Falcon charged into Madruga and the Fist of the Mountains began a steady conquest, seeking to tame the transfigured territory.

Mitwold.t: The Red Wind Corsairs billeted in Mitwold, and the Otterway into Mitwold remained in Imperial hands.

Morrow.t: The Towerjacks dug in to help build a citadel, while the Wolves of War gave ground there to make ready for the next season.

Mournwold.t: The Tusks continued a steady conquest against the Jotun warbands. Farstrider's Watch remained a hall of Jotun champions.

Reikos.t: The Black Thorns and Quiet Step marched out of Reikos, bound for Bastion and Sarangrave respectively.

Reinos.t: An Imperial strike on Grismont Township failed when the orcs held it. The Imperial armies withdrew from the Lasambrian Hills, though some warbands may remain.

Sarangrave.t: Nine Imperial armies and sixteen thousand Summer knights launched a pincer invasion, three continuing in the south and six striking the northern borders.

Skallahn.t: Mentioned in passing: the Summer Storm seeks to learn more of an ancestor discovered in Skallahn, and the Corsairs recall a foray there.

Tassato.t: The Fire of the South marched swiftly to reinforce Tassato with a solid defence, while the Burning Falcon and Red Wind Corsairs departed.

The Barrens.t: Six armies smashed through the Barrens into northern Sarangrave, and the Gryphon's Pride general called it a land starting to heal.

Therunin.t: The vallorn began to rouse across the Druj-held forests, held back only by the Lord Rain ward. A great Druj host there might stay or move.

Upwold.t: The Valiant Pegasus, Seventh Wave, Green Shield and Narwhal's Spear left Upwold, bound for Casinea and Liathaven.

387YE Spring Equinox Senate sessions.d: Administrative motions created the Synod judgement of Exaltation and the Singer of the Silence, and amended the Apothecaries Guild and Keeper of the Breadbasket. The Senate raised the third Navarr army in Hercynia, the second Urizen army (the Argent Sword) in Redoubt and a fourth Highborn army in Casinea. It ratified the Rahvin and Thule treaties, though a Synod veto of the latter was announced. The Declaration of Remorse and the Toadstone failed. Rahmah i Darwisj i Erigo became Imperial Spymaster and built a smugglers cove in Ayereed. Commissions included a Jotun meeting hall on Gull Island and a wayhouse in Ossium. The treasury stood at 1287 thrones and 6 crowns.

Dawn.t: A Dawnish memorial garden in Weirwater honouring the Sweetglade Massacre dead was commissioned then abrogated, the Castle of Thorns throne room restoration was withdrawn, and a memorial hospital was built in Winterbourne, Astolat.

Druj.t: The Senate commissioned an appraisal of how to disrupt Druj operations and resupply in the Forest of Ulnak, with results due before the Summer Solstice 387YE.

Highguard.t: A fourth Highborn army was raised in Casinea, a Steward of the Ossuary title was created for the Grand Ossuary, and the generals of the Granite Pillar, Seventh Wave and Valiant Pegasus received artefacts as regalia.

Imperial Orcs.t: A dolmen was built in Skymark so the Hylje can return the bones of Imperial Orc heroes who fell defending Sermersuaq, to be collected by the orcs for proper funerary care.

Jotun.t: The Senate commissioned a feasting hall on Gull Island, Kallavesa, as a new diplomatic meeting place between the Empire and the Jotun, built jointly with Jotun contributions.

Navarr.t: A third Navarr army was commissioned to muster in Treji, Hercynia, and a wayhouse in Ossium was approved to house refugees from Therunin and help fund the Navarr army.

Thule.t: The Senate ratified a treaty with the Thule of Otkodov and appointed an ambassador to them, but a Synod veto of the treaty was to be sought at the Summer Solstice.

Urizen.t: The second Urizen army, the Argent Sword, was raised in Redoubt, and the Beneficiary of the Golden Cascade sinecure was built with a title appointed by the Urizen Assembly.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark citizens Finn Pridetalker and Kindra Surefoot became ambassadors to the Commonwealth and Otkodov; Lumi's Legacy was built in Sermersuaq, while the Toadstone fane in Kallavesa failed.

387YE Spring Equinox Senate sessions.o: At the Spring Equinox 387YE the Senate passed a large slate of motions, raising new Navarr, Urizen and Highborn armies, ratifying treaties with the Rahvin and the Thule of Otkodov, establishing the Magpies and Vallornguard sodalities, and commissioning numerous sinecures, edifices and appraisals.

Sarangrave.t: The Imperial Spymaster formally decommissioned the Imperial spy network in Sarangrave, which the Druj had already destroyed a year earlier.

387YE Spring Equinox Synod judgements.d: The General Assembly rejected removing the Doctrine of the Creator (120-952). Viviane Barossa's mandate warning against malign spiritual presences defeated Fintan Nighthaven's rival call to explore them. Corey Wayfarer's mandate to put destroying the vallorn above all else failed. A statement urging the Empire to defeat the Druj before turning on the vallorn passed overwhelmingly. The Synod pledged not to preach to the Thule while Kindra Surefoot's treaty stands. General Rhisiart Dancewalker of the Black Thorns was revoked. Alberto Acciai and Eleanor Novarion were recognised as exemplars of Loyalty and Pride. The Council of Nine set the Silent Bell to investigate the Falconer's cult of the Claw.

Dawn.t: The Dawnish Assembly refused to give up a Dawnish fifth army to win the Thule's peace terms (354-0). It praised Dame Katelyn Cordraco, condemned mass spells in tourneys, debated the Earl of the Groves, and narrowly backed returning goods taken from the Rahvin.

Druj.t: The Synod backed defeating the Druj before turning on the vallorn. The Navarr Assembly called for resistance and sabotage against Druj occupation in Therunin, and Druj who fled into Dark Ranging were marked for hunting.

Highguard.t: The Highborn Assembly charged its newly raised fourth army to bring salvation, not hatred. It enacted a mandate of peerless kinship to support other nations, rejected a call to crusade until the last war is won, and warned its Necropolis chapters against cults of the Wastewalker.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Imperial Orc Assembly challenged the Synod to prove that exorcising orc ghosts does not destroy their one chance to cross the Abyss. It warned of an old terror rising in the Bay of Catazar and named Sunstorm Nirrin for recognition by all Imperial Orcs.

Jotun.t: The Marcher Assembly vowed to fight on with General Stanley to drive the Jotun from the Mourn. It praised the Marcher orcs who took up arms against the Jotun.

Navarr.t: Navarr's assembly urged resistance in Therunin, championed Thornsong House and potioncraft, and rallied the nation behind the City of Dreams in Seren. Its general, Rhisiart Dancewalker of the Black Thorns, was revoked by the General Assembly over losses in Therunin.

The League.t: The League Assembly backed building trading posts across Temeschwar and urged citizens of Sarvos and Apulian to keep lights burning after the last lighthouse on the Bay of Catazar fell. It also rewarded Gabrieli di Tassato and Novella di Sarvos.

The Marches.t: The Marcher Assembly pledged to keep fighting until the Mourn is free and honoured the Marcher orcs who fought the Jotun. It recognised Navarr's loyalty and enacted a mandate letting Marcher fleets support the Red Wind Corsairs.

Thule.t: The General Assembly pledged not to preach to the Thule while Ambassador Kindra Surefoot's treaty stands. Dawn rejected the Thule's latest demand for Imperial land, calling it blackmail.

Urizen.t: The Urizen Assembly praised the Ashen Flame coven's defence of Redoubt and supported saving Solen's Doubt's library as the dam rises. It warned Redoubt's coastal people of a winter eternal and asked the Citadel Guard to bring salvation rather than curses to Sarangrave.

Varushka.t: Varushka's assembly backed its new army and enacted wards to protect the Apstrus dam from restless spirits. It set the Kestov a penance to help rebuild Ossium, warned of Webwood creatures on Ossium's borders, and condemned idolatrous Bone Serpent shrines.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark's assembly backed a fane to Sadogua to protect Kallavesa and added Kaisa Denmother to the Chronicle of Heroism. It enacted a mandate shielding Wintermark from mandates without a greater majority, and warned against the cult of the Claw and two Blood on Snow cultists fleeing to Hahnmark.

387YE Spring Equinox Synod judgements.o: At the Spring Equinox 387YE the Imperial Synod raised 191 judgements. Dominant themes were the false virtues, the wars against the Druj and the vallorn, preaching in Faraden and Asavea, and the hallowing of the seven coronation bells.

Brocéliande/Dark Ranging.t: Dark Ranging was named as the refuge of Druj who fled there with heralds of Yaw'nagrah, and Imperial captains were urged to search it.

Casinea/Woodwych.t: Mentioned in passing: Destin of the Woodwych Harts raised a Vigilance judgement supporting the pilgrimage of the hallowed coronation bells.

Brocéliande.t: The Navarr Assembly urged military captains reinforcing the Broch to hunt down the Druj who fled into Brocéliande, aided by heralds of Yaw'nagrah.

Casinea.t: Highguard's fourth army was being raised in Casinea, and the Highborn Assembly charged it to bring salvation rather than mere conquest.

Miaren.t: The Navarr Assembly urged the nation to finish the City of Dreams in Seren before the great work lapses, recalling the Cold Sun's destruction of Rhonwen's Falls.

Reikos.t: Mentioned in passing: donations to the Synod's Virtue Fund were received at the counting house of Reikos.

Sarangrave.t: The Ambition Assembly urged help for Sarangrave's oppressed septs to explore the Way. The Urizen Assembly asked the Military Council to summon Irra Hara's Wooden Fastness there instead of targeting curses through the Citadel Guard.

Semmerholm.t: Mentioned in passing: donations to the Synod's Virtue Fund were received at the counting house of Semmerholm.

Tassato.t: The League Assembly narrowly called on Tassato's citizens to recognise Gabrieli di Tassato as rightful challenger to Gabriel Barossa's legacy. Donations to the Virtue Fund were also received at Tassato's counting house.

Upwold.t: Two Blood on Snow cultists behind a recent attack in Upwold were reported fleeing north to Hahnmark. Upwold's senator was praised for voting against road tolls.

387YE Spring Equinox event schedule.d: Eight nations held senatorial elections in their camps on Saturday afternoon: the Marches for Mournwold, Varushka for Karsk, the Brass Coast for Segura, Highguard for Reikos, Wintermark for Hahnmark, the Imperial Orcs for Mareave, Dawn for the Barrens and the League for Holberg. Six nations elected national titles by Tally of the Votes. The timetable included Senate, Military Council, Conclave and Synod sessions with their deadlines, battles off Anvil on Saturday and Sunday mornings, the Bourse auction and Grandmaster elections, militia meetings, and gatherings such as the Imperial Economics Conference. It also included a vote of Urizen magicians on an offer from the Thule.

Dawn.t: Dawn elected the senator for the Barrens at 2:30pm, immediately after the tourney, and Dawnish fleet captains met in the Military Council tent on Saturday.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: Grendel is not named on the schedule, though the Mareave senatorial election appears under the Imperial Orcs.

Highguard.t: Highguard began its inquisition of candidates for the Reikos senator at 2:00pm and elected the Bursar of the House of Spirits at the Chapel at 3:30pm.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Imperial Orcs elected the senator for Mareave from 2:15pm, with candidates presenting items of worth. At the Fire Pit at 4:00pm they also elected the Steel Fist, the Bonesetter of Torfast Trading Post and the Preceptor of the Skarsind College of Warcasting.

The Brass Coast.t: The Brass Coast began its auction for the Segura senator at 2:00pm and elected the Cerevado Nets and the Dhomiro of Afar at the Waypoint at 3:30pm.

The League.t: The League elected the Holberg senator at 3:30pm through a presentation of collected bonds, then elected the Tassatan Hills title and the Custodian of the Assayer's Guild at the Plaza at 4:30pm.

The Marches.t: Marcher landowners gathered at 1:30pm to elect the senator for the Mournwold.

Thule.t: Mentioned in passing: the schedule listed a vote of Urizen magicians on an offer from the Thule.

Urizen.t: Urizen magicians held a meeting in the Hall of Worlds on Friday evening and a vote on an offer from the Thule on Saturday afternoon.

Varushka.t: Varushka began questioning candidates for the Karsk senator at 1:45pm and elected the Gift of the Dwindling Star, the Merchant Boyar of the Bittershore and the Custodian of Ivarsgard Docks at the Central Hearth at 4:00pm.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark set out jars for thirty minutes from 2:00pm to elect the Hahnmark senator, and elected the Mediator of Wreck, the Talon of Kauppahall and the Mediator of Fisk at the Tree of Names at 4:30pm.

387YE Spring Equinox event schedule.o: The schedule for the Spring Equinox 387YE summit listed the times for senatorial elections, Tally of the Votes elections for national titles, and the timetable of meetings, sessions, battles and deadlines across the weekend at Anvil.

Hahnmark.t: Hahnmark's senator was elected by Wintermark at 2:00pm with jars placed down for thirty minutes. The page notes the next regular election for the seat falls at the Autumn Equinox 387YE.

Holberg.t: Holberg's senator was chosen by the League at 3:30pm through a presentation of collected bonds.

Karsk.t: Varushka elected Karsk's senator, with questioning of candidates beginning at 1:45pm.

Mareave.t: An election for Mareave's senator was listed under the Imperial Orcs at 2:15pm, with candidates presenting items of worth.

Mournwold.t: The Marches elected the Mournwold's senator when the landowners gathered at 1:30pm.

Reikos.t: Highguard elected the senator for Reikos, beginning with an inquisition of candidates at 2:00pm.

Segura.t: The Brass Coast held an auction from 2:00pm to choose Segura's senator.

Skarsind.t: Mentioned in passing: the Imperial Orcs elected the Preceptor of the Skarsind College of Warcasting by Tally of the Votes.

The Barrens.t: Dawn elected the senator for the Barrens at 2:30pm, immediately after the tourney.

387YE Spring Equinox interlude.d: The Senate set the Imperial Guerdon at 150 thrones, shared only by units supporting the Golden Axe in Sarangrave and the Summer Storm in Reinos. Military units could explore the flood-transformed southern Madruga. Priests were offered four lectures: supporting, studying or watching the Solokha effort, or preaching Prosperity in the Sarcophan Delves. The Blood Red Roads and the White Roads became toll roads, ending their benefits to citizens. Enchantments and curses fell on Redoubt, Feroz, Karov, Necropolis, Kallavesa and all of Dawn. Rivers of Life covered Mournwold, Kahraman and the Barrens. The Penumbral Veil remained over every Imperial territory except Casinea and Mournwold.

Dawn.t: All of Dawn was enchanted with Summer magic that eased Summer creatures' passage and gave everyone there a fascination with showy magic. The Barrens gained Rivers of Life, and all four Dawnish territories lay under the Penumbral Veil.

Druj.t: Navarr warbands raiding the Druj gained a production bonus using rafts the Druj themselves had prepared. Imperial units fighting the Druj with the Golden Axe in Sarangrave earned Guerdon shares.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: Axos remained annoyed about Imperial involvement in the failure of its joint venture with the Grendel into the Mountains of the Moon.

Highguard.t: The White Roads became toll roads and no longer benefited Highborn citizens. The Virtues of Autumn coven shielded Necropolis with the Hand of the Dhomiro, and Casinea alone was left outside the Penumbral Veil.

Imperial Orcs.t: Mentioned in passing: Mareave and Skarsind were listed among the territories under the Penumbral Veil.

Jotun.t: Mentioned in passing: units supporting the Imperial army Summer Storm in Reinos, a territory Jotun held, received Guerdon shares.

Navarr.t: Navarr warbands raiding the Druj gained a production bonus after Neala Blackhawk's rescue of an orc treetender. Navarr could also move resources to the Barrens for free thanks to the Last Battle wayhouse.

The Brass Coast.t: Imperial units could explore the reshaped southern Madruga, and the Freeborn coven The Sails of the First Flame wove Rivers of Life over Kahraman. The Sunset Roads kept their usual benefits.

The League.t: The Senate adopted Else von Temeschwar's proposal to turn the Blood Red Roads and White Roads into toll roads. All five League cities lay under the Penumbral Veil, Sarvos most strongly of all.

The Marches.t: Marcher farms blessed with Blessing of New Spring could yield black Shinemoon mushrooms, and Mournwold received Rivers of Life. Marcher fleets gained a bonus trading at Caitun.

Urizen.t: Redoubt was battered by Spring curses yet protected by the Ashen Flame's Pillars of Adamant. Urizen congregations were barred from the Support and Watch Solokha lectures but could Study Solokha.

Varushka.t: The Lyktan coven's Hammers of Fury sped a new army's mustering in Karov, and the Iron and Crow Roads kept their benefits. Varushkan congregations could only take the Study Solokha option among the Solokha lectures.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark fleets escorting the fisherfolk of Westerhal suffered a penalty after Kjellen Saltmire's expedition was driven off by coral husks. Kallavesa was enchanted with a Night feast, and Wintermark fleets gained a bonus at Caitun.

387YE Spring Equinox interlude.o: The Spring Equinox 387YE interlude set out the opportunities and effects in play after the Winter Solstice 386YE. These included Guerdon shares, new ventures and lectures, toll roads, and many enchantments and curses across the Empire.

The Barrens/The Bleaks.t: The Last Battle wayhouse, completed in the Bleaks as a reconnaissance base against the vallorn, let Navarr take resources in the Barrens for free this season.

Astolat.t: Mentioned in passing: Astolat was listed under the Penumbral Veil and cited as an example of a move that would still cost the usual fee.

Bastion.t: Mentioned in passing: Bastion was listed among the Highborn territories under the Penumbral Veil.

Bay of Catazar.t: Mentioned in passing: the growing influence of the eternal Siakha over the bay was said to make the curses on Redoubt unpredictable.

Bregasland.t: Mentioned in passing: Bregasland was listed among the Marcher territories under the Penumbral Veil.

Casinea.t: Casinea was the only Imperial territory exempt from the Penumbral Veil, a specificity suggesting dozens of deliberate castings.

Feroz.t: Feroz was again enchanted with Regrow the Land's Heart, healing war scars, aiding fertility and favouring the briar lineage. It also lay under the Penumbral Veil as reclaimed Brass Coast land.

Hahnmark.t: Mentioned in passing: Hahnmark was listed among the Wintermark territories under the Penumbral Veil.

Hercynia.t: Mentioned in passing: Hercynia was listed among the Navarr territories under the Penumbral Veil.

Holberg.t: Mentioned in passing: Holberg was listed among the League cities under the Penumbral Veil.

Kahraman.t: The Sails of the First Flame wove Rivers of Life over Kahraman, reducing army casualties and filling its waters with restorative Spring power.

Kallavesa.t: A Night enchantment filled Kallavesa with vivid dreams of feasting, encouraging people to create and share fine food, drink and company until the Spring Equinox.

Karov.t: The Hammers of Fury sped the mustering of a new Imperial army in Karov. Its mines lost two ingots each but gained a pawn of Autumn vis.

Karsk.t: Mentioned in passing: Karsk was listed among the Varushkan territories under the Penumbral Veil.

Madruga.t: Imperial military units could take the Explore the Southern Reaches venture in the flood-transformed south of Madruga, earning herbs and Adversity Vis until the Spring Equinox.

Mareave.t: Mentioned in passing: Mareave was listed as an Imperial Orc territory under the Penumbral Veil.

Miaren.t: Mentioned in passing: Miaren was listed among the Navarr territories under the Penumbral Veil.

Miekarova.t: Mentioned in passing: Miekarova was listed among the Varushkan territories under the Penumbral Veil.

Mitwold.t: Mentioned in passing: Mitwold was listed among the Marcher territories under the Penumbral Veil.

Morrow.t: Mentioned in passing: Morrow was listed among the Urizen territories under the Penumbral Veil.

Mountains of the Moon.t: Mentioned in passing: the failed Axou and Grendel venture into the Mountains of the Moon was still souring Axos trade with the Empire.

Mournwold.t: Rivers of Life were cast over Mournwold, reducing army casualties and healing wounds. It was one of the few territories exempt from the Penumbral Veil.

Necropolis.t: The Hand of the Dhomiro protected Necropolis's coast and tombs from raiders. Personal resources there could not be harmed by plundering armies this season.

Ossium.t: Mentioned in passing: Ossium was listed among the Varushkan territories under the Penumbral Veil.

Redoubt.t: Redoubt was cursed with storms costing its fleets two ranks and its farms and businesses 72 rings. Meanwhile the Pillars of Adamant shielded its structures and fortifications from damage.

Reikos.t: Mentioned in passing: Reikos was listed among the Highborn territories under the Penumbral Veil.

Reinos.t: Military units supporting the Summer Storm in Reinos were one of only two groups to share the Imperial Guerdon.

Sarangrave.t: Units supporting the Golden Axe in Sarangrave shared the Imperial Guerdon. Navarr warbands raiding the Druj gained a bonus from recovered Druj rafts.

Sarvos.t: Sarvos lay under the Penumbral Veil, and the shroud there was more than three times as powerful as elsewhere.

Segura.t: Mentioned in passing: Segura was listed among the Brass Coast territories under the Penumbral Veil.

Semmerholm.t: Mentioned in passing: Semmerholm was listed among the Dawnish territories under the Penumbral Veil.

Sermersuaq.t: Mentioned in passing: Sermersuaq was listed among the Wintermark territories under the Penumbral Veil.

Skarsind.t: Mentioned in passing: Skarsind was listed as an Imperial Orc territory under the Penumbral Veil.

Spiral.t: Mentioned in passing: Spiral was listed among the League cities under the Penumbral Veil.

Tassato.t: Mentioned in passing: Tassato was listed among the League cities under the Penumbral Veil.

Temeschwar.t: Mentioned in passing: Temeschwar was listed under the Penumbral Veil, and the toll-road proposal came from Else von Temeschwar.

The Barrens.t: Rivers of Life were cast over the Barrens. Navarr could move resources there for free thanks to the new Last Battle wayhouse, counting as Therunin for voting.

Therunin.t: Mentioned in passing: Navarr with resources in the Barrens counted as being in Therunin for senatorial and similar elections.

Upwold.t: Mentioned in passing: Upwold was listed among the Marcher territories under the Penumbral Veil.

Volodmartz.t: Mentioned in passing: Volodmartz was listed among the Varushkan territories under the Penumbral Veil.

Weirwater.t: Mentioned in passing: Weirwater was listed among the Dawnish territories under the Penumbral Veil.

Zenith.t: Koboldi from Zenith, servants of the King Under the Mountain, travelled to Redoubt to examine the Pillars of Adamant. Zenith itself lay under the Penumbral Veil.

387YE Spring Equinox winds of fortune.d: Emperor Vesna addressed the Empire about Therunin. Appraisals covered destroying the Jotun Kongegőr bridge and resettling displaced Varushkans around Delev. Diplomatic winds addressed the Commonwealth, Thule, Sarcophan Delves, Faraden, Axos, Asavea and Sumaah, and the Iron Confederacy, Grendel and Jotun. Other winds dealt with Dawn's Summer enchantment and new army, Marcher cattle markets and freed smiths, Spiral's troubles and a proposed dam on the Doubt, and an Autumn offer concerning Urizen. Further notes reported the Rahvin taking Bitter Strand, road tolls raising Senate income by one hundred thrones, Spring storms on Redoubt, Hammers of Fury in Karov and Big Icebarn hunting in the Suaq Wastes. A table recorded the results of twenty-eight conjunctions.

Dawn.t: A Summer enchantment over Astolat, Semmerholm, Weirwater and the Barrens drew boons from Summer heralds, and Senator Éamon Ashenmourn de Cordraco must name the new army mustering in Astolat. Debate also continued over the manticore Earl of the Groves, and Morrigan Mortére was asked to host the Charnel Lord's envoy.

Druj.t: The Druj kept the Barrow Axe and the standard of Isaella's Dance after two Eastring conjunctions went untaken. They survived Imperial attacks in Grimfen Mire and Beladrarsh but lost most of their force at the Splintering Jetty.

Grendel.t: The Shuttered Lantern laid the groundwork for a Regario Dossier office in the Grendel-held settlement of Vorlach, and the Grendel figured in the Keep Talking diplomacy. Imperial attacks on the Grendel in Icarion and on Maistir Varden in Ayereed both ended in retreat.

Highguard.t: The Highborn assembly and Benefactors' Council faced choices in A Peerless Sacrifice, and the Hand of the Dhomiro reduced crime in Necropolis. Tolls were imposed on the White Roads, and Jack Flint of Highguard led as Field Marshal at Visten Head.

Imperial Orcs.t: Imperial Orcs were tagged as interested parties in the new Marcher cattle markets, the plan to dam the Doubt to relieve Icarion in Mareave, and the eternals' plenipotentiary responses.

Jotun.t: An appraisal set out how the Kongegőr between Skallahn and Hordalant might be destroyed to hamper Jotun cooperation. In the Mournwold, Jarl Haakon was killed with honour, though the Jotun prevailed in Halbera Strongarm's challenge.

Navarr.t: Navarr settled in the Barrens shared in Dawn's Summer enchantment, and the Rahvin sept took Bitter Strand and the Fangs, provisionally accepting a treaty. In Therunin a treetender was rescued, and Navarr were among those whose acceptance of Yaw'nagrah's boons the Silent Bell investigated.

The Brass Coast.t: The Silver Chalice's plans for a grand lodge, the Well of Life, were completed for Madruga, where mage-killers were also routed. Spring magic touched Feroz and Kahraman, and the Strategos protected the Celesti Lighthouse and claimed a fleet.

The League.t: The Archbishop of Capodomus preached an inspiring sermon in Sarvos, where a dire astacid and wreckers were defeated at Charoko. League interests also featured in Spiral's troubles and in Holberg's dealings with Faraden and the Delves.

The Marches.t: The freed Marcher smiths were ready to share their lost art, and the new cattle markets produced 818 cattle bonds. The Husks of the Deep still threatened the Gullet coast, Jarl Haakon fell in the Mournwold, and the Silent Bell investigated Marchers who accepted Yaw'nagrah's boons.

Thule.t: With the peace treaty with Otkodov due to expire after the Summer Solstice, negotiations were under way, and the Archmage of Autumn invited the City of Gold and Lead to make trade more appealing to the dragons. The Mediator of Wreck also sought to soothe the Thule of Volham.

Urizen.t: The Silver Flame offered a trade ministry in Cinion, or failing that foci for Urizen's senators, while the City of Lead and Gold made a remarkable offer concerning the nation. Spring storms hit Redoubt's fleets, farms and businesses, though the Pillars of Adamant protected its great works.

Varushka.t: Naomi of Virtue's Rest presented proposals for resettling displaced Varushkans around Delev, and the Hammers of Fury sped the mustering of an army in Karov. The Charnel Lord sought a meeting on military arrangements with Varushka, and odd disappearances were reported in the east.

Wintermark.t: More than ten thousand strength of Winterfolk joined Big Icebarn's hunt in the Suaq Wastes, and it will stay if at least three thousand support it next season. Enchanted feasts were reported in Kallavesa, and Wintermark heroes took on threats at West Marsh, Stark and East Floes.

387YE Spring Equinox winds of fortune.o: The Spring Equinox 387YE winds of fortune gathered the season's news for the Empire's champions. They covered diplomacy with foreign powers, appraisals, magical developments, opportunities and threats, and the outcomes of the Winter Solstice conjunctions.

Ayereed/Petrified Forest.t: The Imperial Spymaster's attempt to kill Maistir Varden at Saoirse's Fields ended in Imperial retreat.

Bregasland/North Fens.t: The Roost's Reeve's conjunction at the Swollen Fens suffered casualties against the husks of the deep and was driven off, though it uncovered their weaknesses.

Brocéliande/Dark Ranging.t: All the chests at the Broken Stand were recovered by the Knight of the Greenwood.

Feroz/Oranseri.t: The Strategos of the Brass Coast protected the Celesti Lighthouse at Rahab's Orchard and claimed a fleet.

Forest of Ulnak/Grimfen Mire.t: An attack on the Druj at the Crimson Boscage brought Imperial casualties, and the Druj survived.

Hercynia/Deer's Folly.t: The Spear of the Seven stopped a horde at the Shattered Pines.

Holberg/Misericorde.t: Mentioned in passing: the Merchant Prince of Misericorde Market was tagged in the cattle-market wind.

Kallavesa/Skymark.t: The investigation into what is wrong with the farmers of Redshal Grove had an uncertain result, which the Keeper of the Iron Grove may know more about.

Kallavesa/West Marsh.t: Kjellen Saltmire's force was driven off by the husks in the Forlorn Bogs, though it learned of their weaknesses.

Madruga/Crucible.t: Sakari Nightscale's force routed the mage-killers at Larroc Corral.

Mareave/Icarion.t: A dam on the Doubt was proposed to relieve Icarion's aridity, and an attack on the Grendel at the Plains of the Courath ended in retreat.

Mareave/Sinfoyard.t: The effort to ensure the safety of the crew at the Salt Shaker had an uncertain result, known perhaps to the Senator for Mareave.

Mournwold/Alderly.t: Bryce the Hare's attempt to rescue a herbalist from the Yegarra at the Walters' Clearing failed, with Imperial casualties.

Mournwold/Greensward.t: Jarl Haakon was killed with honour at Old Tam Shaffer's Farm and his spoils claimed, but the Jotun won Halbera Strongarm's challenge at Big Boar's Sty.

Necropolis/Hedrossan.t: Mentioned in passing: one of the traitors slain at Visten Head was named Ezhabbenar of Hedrossan.

Redoubt/Optarion.t: At Visten Head, three timbers of the Astral Phoenix were recovered and one traitor slain, but the Jaws of Selachan remained with the wreckers.

Redoubt/Ventosi.t: Halkyon of the Myriad Stream's force killed the wreckers at Oathspawned Copse and recovered their loot.

Reikos/Chalcis Mount.t: Ghosts at the High Arboretum were dealt with.

Salt Flats of Sanath/Beladrarsh.t: Lady Laudine du Lac's attack at the Drained Woods suffered casualties and the Druj survived.

Sarvos/Bocche.t: The Mayor of Caricomare's force defeated a dire astacid and wreckers to protect the people of Charoko.

Sermersuaq/East Floes.t: The Mediator of Wreck's attempt to soothe the Thule of Volham at Crow's Rest had an unclear outcome.

Sermersuaq/Stark.t: The injured at the Wreck of the Screaming Mammoth were helped and the dead laid to rest.

Sermersuaq/Suaq Wastes.t: Big Icebarn hunted the monsters of the wastes, backed by over ten thousand strength of Winterfolk, and will remain if at least three thousand support it.

Spiral/Ankra.t: The Urizeni rebels in Ankra were among the three threats in Spiral investigated by the Vigilant.

Spiral/Apstrus.t: A dam was proposed on the Doubt here, which would turn parts of eastern Spiral into a sizeable reservoir.

Spiral/Cinion.t: The Silver Flame offered a mithril-columned market here and the title of Architect of Cinion, Urizeni rebels were reported here, and the Block was protected at the Valley of Loss.

Spiral/Screed.t: The malign presence at the heart of Screed remained the obvious threat, but the Spire of Black Glass was killed at Marco's Pass.

The Barrens/Bitter Strand.t: The Rahvin took control of Bitter Strand and its mithril mine, and the Earl of the Groves courted minor Dawnish houses here.

The Barrens/Hope's Rest.t: The manticore Earl of the Groves reached out to minor Dawnish houses here, speaking of glory and Ambition.

The Barrens/The Bleaks.t: Survivors of Therunin were treated and counselled at the Last Battle Wayhouse, and bandits threatening the baggage train were defeated at the Golden Thicket.

Therunin/East Ashes.t: Neala Blackhawk's force rescued a treetender at the Splintering Jetty and killed most of the Druj.

Therunin/Eastring.t: Neither conjunction here was taken, so the Barrow Axe and the standard of Isaella's Dance remained with the Druj, while the Krollthorned remained a threat.

Volodmartz/Brez.t: The search for the Chosen of Samkǒma in the Woods of the Quiet Road had an uncertain outcome.

Astolat.t: A new Dawnish army was being mustered here, awaiting its name and quality from the Senator for Astolat, and the territory shared in the Summer enchantment that drew boons from Summer heralds.

Ayereed.t: An attempt led by the Imperial Spymaster to kill Maistir Varden at Saoirse's Fields ended in Imperial retreat.

Bay of Catazar.t: Mentioned in passing: the Keep Talking diplomacy wind on the Iron Confederacy, Jotun and Grendel was labelled with the Bay of Catazar.

Bregasland.t: The Roost's Reeve's conjunction at the Swollen Fens took casualties and was driven off by the husks from the Gullet, though the warnings it prompted have helped contain the danger.

Brocéliande.t: The Knight of the Greenwood recovered all the chests at the Broken Stand.

Feroz.t: Regrow the Land's Heart continued its gentle rains here, soothing those caught in the fighting at Oran but achieving little else, while the Celesti Lighthouse was protected and a fleet claimed.

Forest of Ulnak.t: The Champion of Prosperity's attack on the Druj at the Crimson Boscage suffered casualties and left the Druj alive.

Hahnmark.t: Mentioned in passing: listed among the north-western territories touched by a wave of violence in the Stars and Sigils wind.

Hercynia.t: The Spear of the Seven stopped a horde at the Shattered Pines, and the territory was named among those affected by violence sweeping the north-west.

Holberg.t: Mentioned in passing: the Holberg Chamber of Commerce, Holbergers and the Merchant Prince of Misericorde Market were tagged in the Faraden, Sarcophan and cattle-market winds.

Hordalant.t: An appraisal examined destroying the Kongegőr, the land bridge linking Hordalant to Skallahn, to disrupt Jotun cooperation.

Kahraman.t: The Rivers of Life flowed here, healing injuries swiftly but boosting the growth of weeds, pests and predators as much as crops and livestock.

Kallavesa.t: Enchanted feasts were reported here, Kjellen Saltmire's force was driven off by the husks in the Forlorn Bogs, and the trouble at Redshal Grove remained uncertain.

Karov.t: The Hammers of Fury sped the mustering of a new army here, though each mine produced two fewer ingots and gained a pawn of Autumn vis in their place.

Madruga.t: The Silver Chalice's plans for the Well of Life grand lodge were completed here, partly to help those displaced by the flooding of the Scorrero, and mage-killers were routed at Larroc Corral.

Mareave.t: New cattle markets were established at Stockland and Wayford, and a dam on the Doubt was proposed to relieve Icarion's aridity. An attack on the Grendel ended in retreat, and the fate of the crew at the Salt Shaker remained uncertain.

Miaren.t: Mentioned in passing: northern Miaren was listed among areas affected by the north-western violence in Stars and Sigils.

Mitwold.t: Mentioned in passing: the earlier revocation of Hal Talbot as Senator for Mitwold was recalled in the Loyalty Assembly's statement.

Morrow.t: Senator Sejanus of the Scarlet Guard may request a realm-focused foci from the Silver Flame if their trade ministry is not commissioned.

Mournwold.t: The Rivers of Life brought indiscriminate fertility here, and Jarl Haakon was killed with honour, though the Jotun won Halbera Strongarm's challenge and the herbalist at the Walters' Clearing was not rescued.

Necropolis.t: The Hand of the Dhomiro protected personal wealth here; no raids came, and theft declined, though thieves also found it easier to evade capture.

Ossium.t: Mentioned in passing: people from Ossium, especially volhov and wardens, were tagged as interested in the Stars and Sigils wind.

Otkodov.t: Negotiations were under way to extend the peace with the Thule of Otkodov before it expires after the Summer Solstice, with Autumn heralds invited to make trade more appealing to the dragons.

Redoubt.t: Spring storms and a Thunderous Deluge struck here, imposing a two-rank fleet penalty and costing farms and businesses 72 rings, though the Pillars of Adamant protected great works. Wreckers were killed at Oathspawned Copse, and timbers of the Astral Phoenix were recovered at Visten Head.

Reikos.t: Ghosts were dealt with at the High Arboretum by Alessi of the Basilisks of the Labyrinth.

Reinos.t: Mentioned in passing: the Faraden were said to be excited about the invasion of Reinos.

Salt Flats of Sanath.t: Lady Laudine du Lac's attack on the Druj at the Drained Woods suffered casualties and the Druj survived.

Sarvos.t: The Archbishop of Capodomus preached an inspiring sermon at the newly consecrated cathedral, and a dire astacid and wreckers were defeated at the Grove of Charoko.

Semmerholm.t: The territory was among those under the lingering Summer enchantment that drew boons from almost every Summer eternal interested in the Empire.

Sermersuaq.t: Big Icebarn hunted the monsters of the Suaq Wastes with strong Winterfolk support, the injured at the Screaming Mammoth were helped, and the effort to soothe the Thule of Volham had an unclear result.

Shayeel.t: The Shuttered Lantern prepared the ground for a Regario Dossier office in Vorlach, Shayeel's wealthiest settlement, though a Senate motion is still required.

Skallahn.t: An appraisal examined destroying the Kongegőr, the land bridge linking Skallahn to Hordalant, to hamper the Jotun kingdoms of Kalsea and Narkyst.

Skarsind.t: Mentioned in passing: listed among the north-western territories touched by the wave of violence in Stars and Sigils.

Spiral.t: Spiral faced a proposed dam in Apstrus, strange dramaturgical effects in Apulian and Vigilant reports on three threats. The Silver Flame offered a market in Cinion, the Block was protected and the Spire of Black Glass was killed in Screed.

Temeschwar.t: Mentioned in passing: listed among areas affected by the north-western violence, and home to the accountant Else Van Temeschwar who proposed the road tolls.

The Barrens.t: The Rahvin took Bitter Strand and the Fangs, raising hopes of peace, and the Earl of the Groves courted minor Dawnish houses here. The Barrens also shared in the Summer enchantment and the Rivers of Life, and survivors of Therunin were treated at the Bleaks.

Therunin.t: The Emperor addressed the Empire about Therunin. Two Eastring conjunctions went untaken, leaving Druj trophies in their hands, while a treetender was rescued and most Druj killed at the Splintering Jetty.

Upwold.t: Mentioned in passing: not named directly, and touched only by Marches-wide matters such as the cattle markets and the freed smiths.

Volodmartz.t: The effort to find and help the Chosen of Samkǒma in the Woods of the Quiet Road had an uncertain outcome.

Weirwater.t: Weirwater was under the lingering Dawnish Summer enchantment that drew heralds' boons, and was named among areas affected by the north-western violence.

Zenith.t: Senator Herminius of the House of the Wanderer may request a realm-focused foci from the Silver Flame if their trade ministry is not commissioned.

387YE Spring Equinox winds of war.d: The Druj overran Therunin's Tarn Valley and entered Peakedge Song, while the Ghulai of the Tainted Basilisk woke the vallorn of Tharunind. Four armies attacked the Sarangrave from Lustri and won, but have no beachhead yet. Grendel land-troops ended the Imperial presence in Ayereed. The Grendel of Mora's Rock helped repel a Children of Wrecks raid on Oran in Feroz. In the Marches, the Ore Hills were freed, but a Jotun host from Liathaven took nearly all of Bregasland. Five armies invaded Reinos and took Ribeira and most of Bastasor. Battle opportunities were offered in Bregasland, Reinos and the Sarangrave. Conjunctions included threats from wreckers, bandits and cultists.

Dawn.t: Dawnish forces readied themselves in Astolat with a force weight of 61, and the Barrens offered conjunctions to exorcise tortured souls and to attend the Earl of the Groves' tournament. Border patrols there mean the Druj need 25 victory points to claim a beachhead.

Druj.t: The Druj overran Therunin's Tarn Valley and pushed into Peakedge Song, and their Ghulai woke the vallorn of Tharunind. In the Sarangrave, though, their resting armies were disrupted and defeated by four Imperial armies.

Grendel.t: Grendel land-troops drove the Empire out of Ayereed and regained the southern borders of Mareave. The Mora's Rock garrison under Commander Fiersach helped turn back the Children of Wrecks at Oran, out of hatred for the wreckers.

Highguard.t: Highborn armies spent the season in Reikos preparing for the year ahead, and Highguard was listed with a force weight of 26 for the coming battles.

Imperial Orcs.t: In Skarsind, cultists of the Claw stole wains of white granite bound for the Brilliant Shore and fled for Pakaanan's Pass, and a conjunction offered a bargain with Tuki of the Little Bones. The nation was listed with a force weight of 5.

Jotun.t: The Jotun lost the Ore Hills in Mournwold but swept across Bregasland from Liathaven, leaving only Otterly in Marcher hands. In Reinos they lost Ribeira and almost all of Bastasor, while the Lasambrians refused to surrender.

Navarr.t: Imperial armies withdrew from Therunin, leaving the Druj to conquer the Tarn Valley and assault Peakedge Song, where defenders and the Tarnfather's blessings preserved the ancient houses of healing. Several conjunctions in Therunin were offered to the Navarr, who were listed with a force weight of 58.

The Brass Coast.t: The Children of Wrecks raided Oran in Feroz, and the raid was repelled only with Grendel help. Five armies marched out of Segura into Reinos, and Burnish hosted conjunctions to name constellations.

The League.t: League armies prepared in Tassato, where wreckers guided by the traitor Maurizia Spada di Sarvos threatened to curse the territory. Conjunctions were also offered in Sarvos, Spiral and Holberg.

The Marches.t: Two armies freed the Ore Hills of Mournwold, but the Jotun overran Bregasland despite the Strong Reeds, leaving only Otterly in Marcher hands. Yegarra also threatened Meade March in Mitwold.

Urizen.t: Four armies passed through Lustri into the Sarangrave, wreckers under Tuomas of Pirenea looted ilium in Zenith, and the Ward of the Black Waste was to be performed in Altis. Border patrols mean the Druj need 25 victory points to claim a beachhead in Morrow or Zenith.

Varushka.t: Wreckers serving the traitor Zavetta Voglanova landed in Bittershore and headed to pillage Marshstand Skerry, and the Cabalist of the Hollow Stone was called to stop them. Patrols in Ossium make a Druj beachhead harder.

Wintermark.t: Kallavesa faced bandits threatening Salagiin traders and yegarra raids, and offered a meeting with the ghodi, while a body awaited investigation in Stark. Wintermark was listed with a force weight of 61.

387YE Spring Equinox winds of war.o: In the Spring Equinox of 387YE, Imperial armies withdrew from Therunin and lost the Ayereed beachhead and most of Bregasland, but advanced into Reinos, freed the Ore Hills and won ground-level victories in the Sarangrave. The page also listed three battle opportunities and many Sentinel Gate conjunctions for the coming summit.

Bregasland/Gravenmarch.t: The Jotun host poured through their magical fortifications at Gravenmarch to invade the fens.

Bregasland/Grey Fens.t: A conjunction was offered to kill all the greenteeth at Drowner's Dell, the responsibility of the Keeper of the Breadbasket.

Bregasland/Ottermire.t: The battle opportunity to block the Jotun path at Sal-Ott Meet was offered here.

Bregasland/The Rushes.t: The General of the Strong Reeds was responsible for recovering plundered goods at Sallow's Shallows.

Holberg/Misericorde.t: The Red-Eyed Reaper was responsible for killing all the greenteeth at Sacrifice Point.

Kallavesa/Kallavesa Marsh.t: After yegarra struck Hufi's Garden, the Woundbinder of the Mark was called to defeat them at Hufi's Glen.

Kallavesa/West Marsh.t: The Imperial Consul was invited to meet the ghodi at Gull Isle.

Kallavesa/Wittal Grove.t: Strategos Aeolwulf was asked to intercept, at Whittling Grove, bandits who had trapped Salagiin ships to slaughter their merchants for ilium.

Mitwold/Meade March.t: The Bailiff of Meade was responsible for defeating yegarra at John's Holt.

Morrow/Altis.t: The Archmage of Winter was responsible for performing the Ward of the Black Waste in the Canticulous Valley.

Mournwold/Alderly.t: Stanley of Chalkdown was responsible for killing Einar the Cunning at Boar's Hall.

Mournwold/Ore Hills.t: Two Imperial armies freed the Ore Hills from the Jotun once again.

Ossium/Bittershore.t: Wreckers posing as Varushkan merchants docked in southern Bittershore before attacking travellers on the Iron Roads.

Ossium/Drownbark Forest.t: Cabalist Vasili Zoryakovich Zverokaz was called to ambush the wreckers at Makgore's Grove before they reach Marshstand Skerry.

Reinos/Bastasor.t: Imperial armies conquered almost all of Bastasor, and a battle opportunity to seize the township at Grismont Road was offered.

Reinos/Pedreira.t: The Champion of Prosperity was responsible for recovering Bulangiin Karadghra at Getshold.

Reinos/Ribeira.t: The Empire quickly conquered Ribeira's olive groves and fig orchards, and a conjunction targeted Carmo Stoneblade at Carmo's Sheepfold.

Sarangrave/Bendol.t: A battle opportunity against the Druj to influence the vallorn at Mirereach was offered.

Sarangrave/Bloodwater Marsh.t: Imperial armies won a slow victory against the Druj in the bloodthirsty, teeming marsh.

Sarvos/Uccelini.t: Cadets were offered the chance to interrogate a Grendel captain at Smugglers Copse.

Segura/Burnish.t: Two conjunctions at the Meadow of Dust and Glass invited Imperials to draw and name constellations and to create lore for them.

Sermersuaq/Stark.t: The Grandmaster of the Unfettered Mind was responsible for investigating a body at Njord Beach Hut.

Skarsind/Pakaanan's Pass.t: Cultists of the Claw were fleeing through the pass with stolen granite, and a conjunction at the Cave of Bones offered a bargain with Tuki of the Little Bones.

Spiral/Apulus.t: The Voice of Vigilance was responsible for meeting followers of Berechiah at The Cellar Below.

Tassato/Madeiras.t: Wreckers led by Maurizia Spada were heading to the Circle of Decay regio to curse Tassato, and Tongs Barossa was to stop them at Lucrezia's Orchard.

The Barrens/Hope's Rest.t: The High Exorcist was responsible for exorcising tortured souls at the Field of Triumph.

The Barrens/The Untrod Groves.t: Enchanter Morien de Carsenere was responsible for attending the tournament of the Earl of the Groves at Tournament Square.

Therunin/Eastring.t: Blaze Dunning was responsible for destroying a miasma pillar at the Tainted Meadow.

Therunin/Peakedge Song.t: The Druj poured in, but defenders and the Tarnfather's blessings preserved the houses of healing. The Eastern Broker was responsible for rescuing an Axou warrior at Catrin's Glade.

Therunin/Sweetglades.t: The Champion of Vigilance was responsible for killing the Lord of Thorns at Broken Copse.

Zenith/Iteri.t: Tuomas of Pirenea's wreckers sailed up the Couros into Iteri to loot ilium, and the Warmage was called to retrieve it at Lutum Woods.

Zenith/Lustri.t: Four Imperial armies marched through Lustri's night-haunted forests to attack the Sarangrave.

Astolat.t: Mentioned in passing: Imperial armies in Astolat readied themselves for the year to come.

Ayereed.t: The Imperial beachhead in the petrified forest ended when Grendel land-troops swept in, and soldiers who did not retreat were slain or captured.

Bay of Catazar.t: Defences around the Bay were bolstered against seaborne invasion, while the Empire lost Ayereed and Grendel help repelled a wrecker raid on Feroz.

Bregasland.t: A Jotun host from Liathaven swept across the fens, and despite the Strong Reeds only the town of Otterly remained in Marcher hands. A battle opportunity and conjunctions there were offered at the summit.

Feroz.t: The Children of Wrecks attacked the battered town of Oran seeking Governor Rahab's imagined treasure, but the raid was turned back with the help of the Mora's Rock garrison.

Holberg.t: A conjunction was offered to kill all the greenteeth at Sacrifice Point in Misericorde.

Kallavesa.t: It was a tumultuous season: yegarra crossed the Westmere to strike Hufi's Garden, and bandits threatened Salagiin traders on the Gullet, as a strange toad creature warned. Conjunctions there included meeting the ghodi.

Liathaven.t: A Jotun host erupted out of Liathaven to invade Bregasland.

Mareave.t: With the Ayereed beachhead gone, the Salt Lords once again control Mareave's southern borders.

Mitwold.t: Yegarra threatened John's Holt in Meade March, and the Drakes and other Imperial armies may billet here.

Morrow.t: The Archmage of Winter was responsible for performing the Ward of the Black Waste in Altis. Border patrols raise the Druj beachhead threshold.

Mournwold.t: Two armies fought Jotun champions and freed the Ore Hills once again, and a conjunction targeted Einar the Cunning at Alderly.

Ossium.t: Wreckers disguised as merchants landed in Bittershore, butchered travellers on the Iron Roads, and moved to pillage Marshstand Skerry.

Reikos.t: Mentioned in passing: Imperial armies in Reikos readied themselves for the coming year.

Reinos.t: Five Imperial armies invaded, conquering Ribeira and almost all of Bastasor, while the Lasambrian Jotun fought on. A battle opportunity and conjunctions there were offered.

Sarangrave.t: Four armies from Lustri defeated Druj armies and the Tower of the Skink garrison in the Bloodwater Marsh, but had yet to claim a beachhead.

Sarvos.t: Officer cadets were offered the chance to interrogate a Grendel captain at Uccelini, and the traitor Maurizia Spada was said to plan raids on Sarvos.

Segura.t: Five armies marched out of Segura into Reinos, and conjunctions in Burnish invited Imperials to draw and name constellations.

Sermersuaq.t: A body awaited investigation in Stark, and cultists of the Claw headed back into Sermersuaq through Pakaanan's Pass.

Skarsind.t: Cultists of the Claw stole almost a dozen wains of white granite from a Brilliant Shore caravan and fled towards Pakaanan's Pass. If they are not stopped, the Brilliant Shore will yield only 17 wains at Summer.

Spiral.t: A small conjunction was offered to meet followers of Berechiah in Apulus.

Tassato.t: Imperial armies prepared here, while wreckers headed for the Circle of Decay regio in Madeiras to curse Tassato with Thunderous Deluge.

The Barrens.t: Conjunctions offered the chance to exorcise tortured souls at Hope's Rest and to attend the tournament of the Earl of the Groves. Border patrols mean the Druj need 25 victory points for a beachhead.

Therunin.t: With the Imperial armies withdrawn, the Druj conquered the Tarn Valley, assaulted Peakedge Song and woke the vallorn of Tharunind. Several conjunctions were offered here.

Upwold.t: Mentioned in passing: Imperial armies in Upwold prepared for the year ahead, and armies may billet here.

Zenith.t: Wreckers under Tuomas of Pirenea fled through western Zenith with ilium looted from the Alliance of the Sky, and the Warmage was called to stop them.

387YE Summer Solstice Imperial elections.d: National elections returned senators for ten territories, including Bastion, Feroz, Karov, Miaren, Mitwold, Redoubt, Sarvos, Sermersuaq, Spiral and Weirwater. The Senate appointed Atte Arrow-Tongue Metsastajason as Imperial Consul, along with ambassadors, the Voice of Liberty, a dozen generals and many other title-holders. The Synod chose Cardinals of Courage and Wisdom, inquisitors and religious titles. The Military Council named the Strategoi of the Brass Coast, the League and Urizen. Bourse auctions and votes allocated mines, quarries and commercial posts, among them Keeper of the Tome and Steward of the Ossuary. The current Imperial titles were updated to reflect these results.

Dawn.t: Dawn's territory of Weirwater returned Tristan duLac as its senator.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: Grendel is not named, but it held Feroz, for which an Imperial senator, Garviel i Abrira i Erigo, was still elected.

Highguard.t: Highguard's territory of Bastion returned Merari Navigators of Virtue as its senator.

Navarr.t: Navarr's territory of Miaren returned Asthore Embracing Fold as its senator.

The League.t: The League saw senators elected for both its territories, Laurencio Lemmini di Sarvos for Sarvos and Genoveva Barossa d'Apulian for Spiral. Gabrieli di Tassato was appointed Strategos of the League.

The Marches.t: The Marches' territory of Mitwold returned Sally B-Baker as its senator.

Urizen.t: Urizen's territory of Redoubt returned Thalia of Netherwatch as its senator, and Lanius was appointed Strategos of Urizen.

Varushka.t: Varushka's territory of Karov returned Svathnev Bronislaw Baruska Navrátil as its senator.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark's territory of Sermersuaq returned Fedelmidd Sydanjaa's Heart Floer as its senator.

387YE Summer Solstice Imperial elections.o: At the 387YE Summer Solstice summit, a large round of Imperial elections and appointments filled senatorial seats, Senate-appointed posts, Synod titles, Military Council positions, Bourse seats and various other offices across the Empire.

Spiral/Ossuary.t: Nemuel was chosen as Steward of the Ossuary by Bourse vote, with 81 votes.

Bastion.t: Merari Navigators of Virtue was elected Senator for Bastion.

Feroz.t: Garviel i Abrira i Erigo was elected Senator for Feroz, although the territory was then held by Grendel.

Karov.t: Svathnev Bronislaw Baruska Navrátil was elected Senator for Karov.

Miaren.t: Asthore Embracing Fold was elected Senator for Miaren.

Mitwold.t: Sally B-Baker was elected Senator for Mitwold.

Redoubt.t: Thalia of Netherwatch was elected Senator for Redoubt.

Sarvos.t: Laurencio Lemmini di Sarvos was elected Senator for Sarvos.

Sermersuaq.t: Fedelmidd Sydanjaa's Heart Floer was elected Senator for Sermersuaq.

Spiral.t: Genoveva Barossa d'Apulian was elected Senator for Spiral, and Nemuel won the Bourse seat of Steward of the Ossuary in the territory.

Weirwater.t: Tristan duLac was elected Senator for Weirwater.

387YE Summer Solstice Military Council o.d: Twelve armies from Dawn, Highguard, the Imperial Orcs, Navarr, the Brass Coast, Urizen and Varushka converged on Sarangrave, most enchanted with Knights of Glory. The Burning Falcon and Tusks attacked in Mournwold to drive out the Jotun. The Towerjacks and Urizen's newly raised Argent Sword struck at the Druj in Zenith. The Golden Sun and Wolves of War made a Grinding Advance against the vallorn in Therunin's Peakedge Song. Elsewhere armies rested in Mitwold, guarded Casinea and Sermersuaq against cults, watched Upwold's passes, laid low in Bregasland and took to sea from Sarvos. Only the Wolves of War, Citadel Guard and Boyar's Hasta offered a share of the Guerdon to supporting units.

Dawn.t: Three Dawn armies attacked in Sarangrave, with the Gryphon's Pride hunting the god-beast of Kroll, while the Golden Sun marched from Astolat into Therunin to fight the vallorn.

Druj.t: The Druj faced twelve Imperial armies in Sarangrave and a two-army assault on their positions in Zenith, including the Towerjacks storming their magical fortress.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: Melkior's farewell recalled the Seventh Wave taking Mareave and pushing into Ayereed.
