Highguard.t: The Granite Pillar mounted a Strategic Defence in Sarangrave, the Seventh Wave guarded Casinea hunting cults and spies under Melkior's last orders, and the Valiant Pegasus tended the fallen in Mitwold.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Summer Storm and Winter Sun fought the Druj in Sarangrave, the latter freeing the enslaved, while the Autumn Hammers pulled back to Mitwold to gather mana.

Jotun.t: The Tusks and Burning Falcon moved to drive the Jotun from Mournwold, the Strong Reeds hid from Jotun hunters in Bregasland, and seven Imperial armies withdrew from Jotun-held Liathaven.

Navarr.t: The Black Thorns rested in Astolat and urged Navarr to join the fight against the vallorn in Therunin, while the Quiet Step made a Cautious Advance in Sarangrave under Vesna's last orders.

The Brass Coast.t: The Burning Falcon charged into Mournwold to aid the Marches, the Fire of the South force-marched into Sarangrave via the Turan Flats, and the Red Wind Corsairs took to sea from Sarvos.

The League.t: The Towerjacks stormed Druj walls in Zenith and the Wolves of War joined the Golden Sun's Grinding Advance against the vallorn in Therunin, with a Guerdon share for supporters.

The Marches.t: The Tusks pressed a Steady Conquest of Mournwold, the Strong Reeds laid low in Bregasland, the Drakes rested in Mitwold and the Bounders searched Upwold for cultists.

Urizen.t: Urizen's second army, the Argent Sword, marched for the first time to attack the Druj in Lustri, while the Citadel Guard struck deep with an Irresistible Spear in Sarangrave.

Varushka.t: All three Varushkan armies fought in Sarangrave, two under new generals, with the Golden Axe and Crimson Schlacta seeking to take Druj land and the Boyar's Hasta offering a Guerdon share.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark's armies turned inward: the Bloodcloaks tended the fallen in Mitwold, the Fist of the Mountains moved to Redoubt, the Green Shield billeted in Upwold and the Narwhal's Spear guarded Sermersuaq against Falconer cultists.

387YE Summer Solstice Military Council o.o: At the Summer Solstice 387YE the Imperial generals issued orders to thirty armies, concentrating twelve of them against the Druj in Sarangrave. Others pressed the Jotun in Mournwold, fought the Druj in Zenith and the vallorn in Therunin, or rested and guarded the Empire's interior.

Mitwold/Golden Downs.t: The Valiant Pegasus moved into Forte Fidelis in the Golden Downs to defend its wall and tend the fallen.

Sarangrave/Kroll.t: The Gryphon's Pride was ordered to slay the god-beast of the lake of Kroll and destroy its idolators.

Sarangrave/Turan Flats.t: The Fire of the South planned to enter Sarangrave from the Barrens through the Turan Flats.

Therunin/Peakedge Song.t: The Golden Sun and Wolves of War made their Grinding Advance against the vallorn into Peakedge Song.

Zenith/Lustri.t: The Argent Sword marched into Lustri to meet and drive out the Druj invaders.

Astolat.t: The Golden Sun marched out of Astolat for Therunin, while the Navarr Black Thorns arrived from Bastion to rest and recuperate there.

Ayereed.t: Mentioned in passing: Melkior recalled the Seventh Wave having pushed into Ayereed.

Bastion.t: Mentioned in passing: the Black Thorns set out from Bastion for Astolat.

Bregasland.t: The Strong Reeds laid low for another season in Bregasland, defying the Jotun searching for them and vowing that Bregasland stands.

Casinea.t: The Seventh Wave resupplied in Casinea and sent scouts to search for tulpa cults, idolators, heretics and enemy spies, while the Valiant Pegasus and Summer Storm departed.

Karov.t: Mentioned in passing: the Boyar's Hasta set out from Karov for Sarangrave.

Liathaven.t: Seven Imperial armies, including the Seventh Wave, Drakes and Bloodcloaks, withdrew from Jotun-held Liathaven to other territories.

Madruga.t: With Madruga described as liberated, the Burning Falcon and Fist of the Mountains both left for campaigns elsewhere.

Mareave.t: Mentioned in passing: Melkior recalled the Seventh Wave taking Mareave.

Mitwold.t: Four armies gathered in Mitwold: the Valiant Pegasus and Bloodcloaks tended the fallen, the Autumn Hammers sought mana and the Drakes drummed up support with a foot-the-ball challenge.

Morrow.t: Mentioned in passing: the Towerjacks and Wolves of War set out from Morrow, and the Argent Sword marched through it into Zenith.

Mournwold.t: The Tusks made a Steady Conquest and the Burning Falcon a Triumphant Charge to drive every last Jotun from the Mourn.

Redoubt.t: The Fist of the Mountains arrived to Read the Signs, pausing at the court of the white fountain to pen in their Husks, as the Argent Sword left for Zenith.

Reinos.t: Mentioned in passing: Melkior recalled the Seventh Wave keeping the Jotun on their toes in Reinos.

Sarangrave.t: Twelve Imperial armies committed to Sarangrave with orders ranging from defence and chain-breaking to taking Druj land and striking deep with an Irresistible Spear.

Sarvos.t: The Red Wind Corsairs marched to Sarvos to take to the sea against the children of Wrecks.

Sermersuaq.t: The Narwhal's Spear returned to guard Sermersuaq and subdue, without bloodshed, followers of the Falconer building obelisks there.

Tassato.t: Mentioned in passing: the Fire of the South set out from Tassato for Sarangrave.

Therunin.t: The Golden Sun and Wolves of War made a Grinding Advance into Therunin to fight the vallorn, burning its thickets.

Upwold.t: The Bounders watched the passes and searched for cultists in Upwold, while the Wintermark Green Shield billeted there.

Zenith.t: The Towerjacks stormed the Druj's magical fortress and the Argent Sword launched a Balanced Attack to drive the Druj out of Zenith.

387YE Summer Solstice Senate sessions.d: The Senate redefined the Advisor on the Vallorn as a Vallornguard-appointed title and assigned the Sand Crab Camp in Madruga to the Rod and Shield. It amended several titles, recognised Gallum Fiersach's protectorate of Morajasse and the Water Walkers sept as foreigners, and ordered the Grendel espionage ring in Spiral destroyed. The Coiled Krait treaty and both proposed sodalities failed. A Senate commission to upgrade the Grimhold was abrogated, but the Master of the Koboldi announced the upgrade anyway. Announced constructions included the Dreaming Spire in Ankra and a dramaturgy university in Apulian. Highguard bestowed the Imperial Crown upon the Throne, and Emperor Vesna drew 219 thrones 4 crowns through the Hand of the Chancellor.

Dawn.t: Jarrigk Silktongue of Dawn was appointed Voice of Liberty. A commission funded with help from the houses of Dawn will restore the throne room of the Castle of Thorns in Astolat, and once consecrated it will generate historical research into Dawn's early monarchs.

Druj.t: The Senate failed to ratify a treaty with the Druj sept known as the Coiled Krait. It did recognise the Water Walkers, a sept of the Sarangrave, as foreigners.

Grendel.t: The Senate ordered the outpost of the Grendel espionage ring in Spiral destroyed, halting it for one season. It also recognised Gallum Fiersach as a foreigner commanding the protectorate of Morajasse for as long as they remain independent of the Grendel.

Highguard.t: In gratitude for Emperor Vesna's help in securing true liao for the hallowing of banners, Highguard's Benefactor of Regalia bestowed the Imperial Crown upon the Throne. The Highborn title of Golden Fleet Salvagemaster will now be appointed by the Magpies.

Jotun.t: Mentioned in passing: the Imperial Spymaster is decommissioning the smugglers' cove in Tromsa, a territory then held by the Jotun.

Navarr.t: The Advisor on the Vallorn became a Vallornguard-appointed Imperial title, and the Singer of the Silence took over protection of the Great Library at Hacynian. Syn Truth-Walker Returned was appointed Imperial Advisor for the Feni, and new Navarr-senator-appointed titles were created at the Crystal Fruit Garden in Miaren and the Ashen Tears wayhouse in Skarsind.

The Brass Coast.t: Madruga was assigned to the Brass Coast, with its senator to be elected for a shortened term at the Autumn Equinox. Freeborn units gained access to the Dare the southern reaches venture through the Sand Crab Camp, and Asier i Elia i Guerra and Kezandro i Riqueza were appointed ambassadors to Asavea and Axos.

The League.t: A Master of Rings announcement founded the Barossa University of Dramaturgical Arts in Apulian, along with an auctioned League title, Reapers Gift. Red Raven Holdings funded the Dreaming Spire as a gift to the Urizen of Spiral, and the Silver Fox Mines great work was commissioned in Temeschwar.

Urizen.t: The Dreaming Spire in Ankra will house the Omphalos of Urizen and the Library of Solen's Doubt, with a Custodian of the Omphalos appointed by the Urizen Assembly. The new university in Apulian is meant to foster collaboration between Urizen and League magicians.

Varushka.t: The Burgher of Ketsov became a Varushkan title appointed by the Vallornguard, and the Keeper of the Bonehives will now be chosen by a Varushkan tally of the votes. The Senate abrogated the Grimhold upgrade commission, but the Master of the Koboldi announced the upgrade anyway.

Wintermark.t: Atte Arrow-Tongue Metsastajason of Wintermark was appointed Imperial Consul, and the Remembrancer of Blood and Salt sinecure was given tenure. The Imperial Spymaster commissioned a spy network in Sermersuaq to watch for the growing threat of the claw.

387YE Summer Solstice Senate sessions.o: At the Summer Solstice 387YE the Senate assigned Madruga to the Brass Coast, outlawed the Cult of the Falconer and cannibalism, accepted the Empire's responsibility for its conduct in the Barrens, made several appointments and approved or announced numerous constructions.

Miekarova/Perumaki.t: The Grimhold, a fortification in Perumaki, was upgraded through an announcement by the Master of the Koboldi.

Spiral/Ankra.t: The Dreaming Spire was to be built upon Mount Cinnius in Ankra as a home for the Omphalos of Urizen and for Urizen Spiralites.

Spiral/Apulus.t: The Barossa University of Dramaturgical Arts, a college of magic studying dramaturgy, was to be built in Apulian.

Madruga.t: Madruga was assigned to the Brass Coast, with a senator to be elected at the Autumn Equinox. Its Sand Crab Camp was given to the Rod and Shield, which will receive four Adversity vis each season.

Miekarova.t: The Senate commission to upgrade the Grimhold fortification to level two passed but was later abrogated. The Master of the Koboldi then announced the Grimhold's upgrade by other means.

Sarangrave.t: The Water Walkers, a sept of the Sarangrave, were recognised by the Senate as foreigners.

Spiral.t: The Grendel espionage ring's outpost in Spiral was destroyed for a season. The territory also gained the Dreaming Spire edifice and the Barossa University of Dramaturgical Arts.

Tromsa.t: The Imperial Spymaster's smugglers' cove in Tromsa is to be decommissioned over the season, with upkeep raised by five thrones in the meantime.

387YE Summer Solstice Sodality resolutio.d: The Magpies appointed Morgan Waystone Path as their Speaker, and the Vallornguard appointed Percival Summerstrong as theirs. The Sun Chamber appointed Zoria as its Counsel and made three bequests. The Falling Star (3 rings of ilium) went to Ffion Tendfallen of Navarr, The Line and the Curve (25 mana crystals) to Leo the Rainbow Sage of Urizen, and The Wyrd Stone (30 crowns) to Balaam of Cantiarch's Hold of Highguard. For its Door of the Chamber, the Sun Chamber chose The Hidden Possibilities. This encouraged its members to journey to Sermersuaq and scout for the white granite obelisk of the Cult of the Falconer. No results were recorded for the Apothecaries Guild.

Highguard.t: Mentioned in passing: Balaam of Cantiarch's Hold of Highguard received the Sun Chamber's Wyrd Stone bequest of 30 crowns.

Navarr.t: Mentioned in passing: Ffion Tendfallen of Navarr received the Sun Chamber's Falling Star bequest of 3 rings of ilium.

Urizen.t: Mentioned in passing: Leo the Rainbow Sage of Urizen received the Sun Chamber's Line and the Curve bequest of 25 mana crystals.

Wintermark.t: The Sun Chamber's chosen Door encouraged its members to travel into the Wintermark territory of Sermersuaq to search for a Cult of the Falconer obelisk.

387YE Summer Solstice Sodality resolutio.o: At the 387YE Summer Solstice, the Imperial sodalities recorded their appointments and bequests, and the Sun Chamber chose its Door of the Chamber, The Hidden Possibilities.

Sermersuaq.t: Sun Chamber members were encouraged to journey to Sermersuaq and scout for the white granite obelisk of the Cult of the Falconer.

387YE Summer Solstice Synod judgements.d: Mandates from Dawn, the Marches and Varushka each sent ten wains of mithril towards a new Navarri army, at the cost of runeforge work for four seasons. The Imperial Orcs set the Ethengraw's Black Forge to the same task. A League mandate created a bequest of ten thrones a season for the Vallornguard, and Highborn donations rose to twelve wains. Fintan Nighthaven was condemned for blasphemy and revoked as Ambassador to Axou, and Aunty Hem was condemned for dedication to Freedom. Highguard priests called many of their own to inquisition over the nation's rifts. New cardinals included Skywise Tulva (Courage) and Silas of the Cenotaph (Wisdom).

Dawn.t: Dawnish artisans were mandated to send ten wains of mithril towards the new Navarri army, so Dawn cannot begin a runeforge for four seasons. The assembly also praised and rewarded Juniper Du Froste for restoring Drycastle and called for the Earl of the Groves to be destroyed.

Druj.t: The General Assembly, the Urizen Assembly and the Empress herself named the Druj's destruction the Synod's greatest ambition. The Silent Bell was tasked with infiltrating the Mallum to learn how the Druj use Fear.

Grendel.t: The Freeborn Assembly backed Ambassador Finna's plan to manage the Grendel threat by non-military means. Finna herself was later given penance for erring with the false virtue of Freedom.

Highguard.t: Highborn priests called more than a dozen of their own to inquisition to find the causes of the rifts dividing the nation. Highborn mandates let the nation's generals order their armies to protect the innocent and raised Highborn donations to twelve wains a season.

Imperial Orcs.t: An Imperial Orc mandate sent the Ethengraw's Black Forge to help raise the Navarri army, so Imperial Orc armies cannot take the forge hammers order until that army is complete. The assembly also condemned the warlock practice of creating Hollow Ones.

Jotun.t: The Wintermark Assembly invited the Ghodi to meet the mystics at the Meeting Place being built in Kallavesa. Meanwhile the Marcher Assembly urged its fleet owners to raid the Jotun and called on Bregasland folk to hide the Strong Reeds from the invaders.

Navarr.t: Navarr was the focus of Empire-wide efforts to fund and equip a new army to fight the vallorn, and the founding of the Vallornguard was celebrated. The Navarr Assembly accepted the coming fall of the Ossegrahn wards in Therunin, and Nathair Autumngale challenged his own position as Advisor on the Vallorn.

The Brass Coast.t: The Freeborn Assembly urged citizens to protect the coming construction of the Great Port of Calvos in Madruga and to remember the nation's seers. The Assembly of Nine condemned Aunty Hem for dedication to Freedom and asked that a Freeborn carry out any death sentence.

The League.t: A League mandate created a ten-throne-a-season bequest to the Vallornguard, drawing investment away from the Blood Red Quays galleries, museum and theatre. League bishops urged citizens to turn away the Falconer's cult in Temeschwar and to keep away from the Sarcophan cathedral in Sarvos.

The Marches.t: Marcher artisans were mandated to send ten wains of mithril to the Navarri army, delaying any Marcher runeforge for four seasons. The assembly raised hue and cry against the Agramant cultist Alf Alwen and sought legal recognition for the role of Reeves.

Thule.t: A veto of the Thule treaty failed by 102 votes to 1956, and an exaltation of the Thule treaty's negotiator Kindra Surefoot was not upheld. Separately, the Varushkan Assembly urged Varushkans living under Thule control to come south.

Urizen.t: The Urizen Assembly revoked Octavius of the White Citadel as War Mage and urged study of the influence of Sung and Ylenwe over Spiral. It also warned that Druj infiltrators would hide among Sarangrave refugees.

Varushka.t: Varushkan artisans were mandated to equip the new Navarri army, so Varushka cannot begin a runeforge for four seasons. The assembly castigated the Falconer's cult and called on Varushkans under Thule rule to return south.

Wintermark.t: The Wintermark Assembly sought a site for the Forge of Bonds and urged a search of the sacred swamps for Isenbrad's resting place. It also called heroes to root out the Falconer's cult from the Suaq Wastes and mandated that the faithful take false auras to the Stormcrows.

387YE Summer Solstice Synod judgements.o: At the Summer Solstice 387YE the Imperial Synod raised 255 judgements. A veto of the Thule treaty failed heavily, priests declared the destruction of the Druj the Synod's greatest ambition, and the cult of the Falconer was condemned across the north.

Kallavesa/Kallavesa Marsh.t: The Dream-of-Famine cultist Jem Bribban had gone to ground in the fogs of Kallavesa Marsh. The Wintermark Assembly asked Winterfolk for any rumour, omen or dream that might lead heroes to them.

Kallavesa/Skymark.t: Captain Raal Sealspeaker completed the Custodian of Bones sinecure in Skymark, paying for the dolmen Rikkivesi himself. Under it the hylje will recover the bones and valuables of Imperial Orcs who fell during the Jotun invasion of Sermersuaq.

Hercynia.t: Mithril from Dawn, the Marches and Varushka, and the Ethengraw's forges, were all directed to raising the Third Navarr army in Hercynia. The Navarr Assembly also warned that the Falconer's cult was seeking to spread there.

Kallavesa.t: The Wintermark Assembly welcomed the Meeting Place being built in Kallavesa as a chance for the Ghodi and the mystics to share ideas. The territory was also the scene of a hunt for the cultist Jem Bribban and of the newly completed Custodian of Bones sinecure.

Karsk.t: Mentioned in passing: its counting house contributed 1 throne and 4 crowns to the Virtue Fund.

Reikos.t: Mentioned in passing: its counting house contributed 1 throne and 2 crowns to the Virtue Fund.

Semmerholm.t: Mentioned in passing: its counting house contributed 1 throne and 3 crowns to the Virtue Fund.

Tassato.t: Mentioned in passing: its counting house contributed 2 thrones to the Virtue Fund.

Upwold.t: The Marcher Assembly invited the Faraden to break ground on the Yakholme Grange trade enclave in Upwold, asking that theological debate be left to priests. It also warned Marchers that the Heralds of Tharim were abroad there hunting Jem Bribban and Alf Alwen.

387YE Summer Solstice event schedule.d: Senator elections were held in each nation's camp on Saturday afternoon, from Urizen's demos at 1pm to the League's presentation of bonds at 3:30pm. Tally of the Votes elections followed from 3:30pm to 5:30pm for the Marches, Urizen, the Brass Coast, Varushka, Highguard, the League, Dawn and Navarr. Some of these titles were marked as having their next regular election at a later summit. The timetable also listed Senate, Sun Chamber, Conclave, Military Council, Synod, Bourse, Academy and militia sessions and their deadlines. Other entries included battles off Anvil on Saturday and Sunday, a parley with Hayaak, a delegation from Tharim and the Imperial Economics Conference.

Dawn.t: Dawn elected a senator for Weirwater at 2:30pm, immediately after the tourney. It chose its Reeve of Drycastle and Warden of the Weary in Glory Square at 5:30pm, and a Dawnish Fleet Captains' Meeting was held on Saturday afternoon.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: Grendel is not named in the schedule. The Feroz senator election it lists is assigned to the Brass Coast camp.

Highguard.t: Highguard began its inquisition of Bastion's senatorial candidates at 2pm. At 4:30pm in the Chapel it elected the Vigilant Swan, Cinderpath Custodian, Golden Fleet Salvagemaster, Exarch of Virtue's Rest and Steward of the Ossuary.

Navarr.t: Navarr elected Miaren's senator at 1:15pm, immediately after the standing. It chose the Broker of Treji Wayhouse at the Standing Circle at 5:30pm.

The League.t: The League elected senators for both Sarvos and Spiral at 3:30pm through the presentation of collected bonds. It then elected the Northbound Trademaster, Keeper of the Tome and Vardstein Vandal at the Plaza at 5pm.

The Marches.t: Marcher landowners gathered at 1:30pm to elect Mitwold's senator. At 3:30pm in the Community Hall the nation chose its Reeve of the Happiston Mana Exchange and Bailiff of the Grand Market.

Urizen.t: Urizen held a demos from 1pm to 1:30pm to elect Redoubt's senator. It elected the Quaymaster of the Elosian Docks and Architect of the Crucible near the Net of Heaven at 3:30pm, and a Urizen Magician's Meeting took place on Friday evening.

Varushka.t: Varushka began questioning Karov's senatorial candidates at 1:45pm. At 4pm at the Central Hearth it elected the Granites of Veltsgorsk, Boyar of the Iron Roads, Burgher of Ketsov and Custodian of the Shchaslyvyy Spile.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark elected Sermersuaq's senator at 2pm, with jars placed down for fifteen minutes. No Wintermark titles were listed for the Tally of the Votes.

387YE Summer Solstice event schedule.o: The Civil Service published the timetable for the Summer Solstice 387YE summit at Anvil. It set out when each nation would elect its senators, when national titles would be decided by Tally of the Votes, and when the summit's official and citizen-organised meetings would be held.

Spiral/Ossuary.t: The Steward of the Ossuary was listed for election by Highguard's Tally of the Votes at 4:30pm in the Chapel. A note records that the title's next regular election falls at the Spring Equinox 388YE.

Bastion.t: Bastion's senator was chosen by a Highguard inquisition of candidates beginning at 2pm.

Feroz.t: The schedule listed a senator election for Feroz at 2pm, run by auction in the Brass Coast camp.

Karov.t: Karov's senator was elected after a questioning of candidates in the Varushkan camp beginning at 1:45pm.

Miaren.t: Miaren's senator was elected at 1:15pm in the Navarr camp, immediately after the standing.

Mitwold.t: Mitwold's senator was elected at 1:30pm when the Marcher landowners gathered.

Redoubt.t: Redoubt's senator was elected by a Urizen demos running from 1pm to 1:30pm.

Sarvos.t: Sarvos's senator was elected at 3:30pm through the League's presentation of collected bonds.

Sermersuaq.t: Sermersuaq's senator was elected at 2pm in the Wintermark camp, with jars placed down for fifteen minutes.

Spiral.t: Spiral's senator was elected alongside Sarvos's at 3:30pm through the League's presentation of collected bonds.

Weirwater.t: Weirwater's senator was elected at 2:30pm in the Dawnish camp, immediately after the tourney.

387YE Summer Solstice interlude.d: The Quartermaster General limited the 150-throne Imperial Guerdon to units supporting the Autumn Hammers and Northern Eagle. Marcher and Imperial Orc units could escort the 272-bond Southern Herd from Mareave towards Highguard. Marcher and Wintermark fleets could help the Red Wind Corsairs become a navy, and congregations gained special lectures on Capodomus, Faraden and the Spiral mystagogues. Magical effects included the Silver Magician raising a peak in Occursion, Rivers of Life over Mournwold, Hammers of Fury on Karov and Redoubt, Guardian Gate on the Court of the White Fountain, several regional fortification rituals, a lingering Penumbral Veil over much of the Empire, and a Summer light display over Feroz.

Dawn.t: Heralds of Swiftwind spur Dawnish questing knights and knights-errant to Glory until the Autumn Equinox. Units supporting Knights of Glory-enchanted armies from Astolat earn a golden apple, while Astolat, Weirwater and Semmerholm lie under the Penumbral Veil.

Druj.t: Mentioned in passing: the Druj are not named, but an Imperial coven raised a wooden fastness in Nesustak Forest in Druj-held Sarangrave.

Grendel.t: A Summer-magic display of dancing light creatures, featuring an Urizen changeling and a Navarr man, repeats in the night sky over Grendel-held Feroz, and fortification rituals were cast on Mareave regions the Grendel share with the Imperial Orcs.

Highguard.t: Bastion and Reikos remain under the Penumbral Veil, Navarr are encouraged to settle in Reikos via the Micah's Stand wayhouse, and the Southern Herd should reach Highguard next season if enough soldiers escort it.

Imperial Orcs.t: Imperial Orc units may guard the Southern Herd out of Mareave, League congregations can help recover the bones of orcs who died at Solen's Doubt, and Mareave regions were strengthened with Basalt and Frozen Citadel rituals.

Jotun.t: Mentioned in passing: Marcher and Wintermark fleet owners who want to play out raiding the Jotun along the Gullet are pointed to other actions, as the Assault the Kongegőr only opens when the Red Wind Corsairs take to the sea.

Navarr.t: The Micah's Stand wayhouse in High Chalcis lets Navarr settle in Reikos free of the usual cost and still vote as if in Therunin. Miaren and Hercynia lie under the Penumbral Veil.

The Brass Coast.t: Segura remains under the Penumbral Veil, and the Ashen Flame coven raised a Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae in Braydon's Jasse in Kahraman.

The League.t: All five League cities lie under the Penumbral Veil, and Spiral congregations can protect the mystagogues on the bone pilgrimage. Arsenio Sanguineo Rezia di Tassato put forward Hand of the Dhomiro for Imperial lore.

The Marches.t: Marcher units may escort the Southern Herd, and Marcher fleets can help the Red Wind Corsairs assault the Kongegőr after Fredegar Bloodmouth's judgement. Rivers of Life now blesses Mournwold, two covens raised wooden fastnesses in Alderly, and Marcher fleets gain a bonus trading at Caitun.

Urizen.t: Redoubt is under Hammers of Fury to speed a new army's mustering, Storms End enchanted the Court of the White Fountain with Guardian Gate, and the Silver Magician is raising a great peak in Occursion in Zenith.

Varushka.t: The Lyktan coven's Hammers of Fury speed a new army's mustering in Karov, trading mine ingots for Autumn vis, while every other Varushkan territory lies under the Penumbral Veil.

Wintermark.t: After Hadrick Hardin's judgement, Wintermark fleets can help the Red Wind Corsairs assault the Kongegőr, and they gain a bonus trading at Caitun. Hahnmark and Sermersuaq remain under the Penumbral Veil.

387YE Summer Solstice interlude.o: The Summer Solstice 387YE interlude set out the opportunities open to fleets, military units and congregations after the Spring Equinox, and catalogued the enchantments and other large-scale effects at work across the Empire that season.

Kahraman/Braydon's Jasse.t: The Ashen Flame coven cast the Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae on Braydon's Jasse.

Mareave/Clisearn.t: The Voices of the Unbound Storm cast the Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae on Clisearn.

Mareave/Eoradal.t: The Wolves of the Pale Raven raised a Basalt Citadel in Eoradal.

Mournwold/Alderly.t: Both the Sails of the First Flame and the Goatsbridge Coven cast Forge the Wooden Fastness on Alderly.

Redoubt/Willstone.t: Mentioned in passing: only in the name of Lucius Ankarien Willstone, who raised and funded Gardener's Wheel for Imperial lore.

Sarangrave/Nesustak Forest.t: The Coven of the Horned Hare cast Forge the Wooden Fastness on Nesustak Forest.

The Barrens/Hope's Rest.t: The Phoenix Rising coven cast the Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae on Hope's Rest.

Zenith/Occursion.t: Tremors shake Occursion as the Silver Magician's power, granted in return for almost a thousand tempest jade, permanently raises one of its largest peaks, and Heralds of Meraud are active here.

Astolat.t: Units supporting Knights of Glory-enchanted armies that started the season in Astolat gain a golden apple of Summer vis, and the territory remains under the Penumbral Veil.

Bastion.t: Bastion remains under the Penumbral Veil, its night skies strange and its events hidden from scryers.

Feroz.t: A repeating Summer-magic apparition fills the night sky: a chained bag unlocked by an Urizen changeling and a Navarr man bursts into dancing creatures of light.

Hahnmark.t: Hahnmark remains under the Penumbral Veil, its night skies strange and its events hidden from scryers.

Hercynia.t: Hercynia remains under the Penumbral Veil, its night skies strange and its events hidden from scryers.

Holberg.t: Holberg remains under the Penumbral Veil, its night skies strange and its events hidden from scryers.

Kahraman.t: The Ashen Flame coven raised a Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae in the region of Braydon's Jasse.

Karov.t: Hammers of Fury speeds the mustering of a new army in Karov, while its mines yield two fewer ingots but each gains a pawn of Autumn vis. Karov is the only Varushkan territory outside the Penumbral Veil.

Karsk.t: Karsk remains under the Penumbral Veil, its night skies strange and its events hidden from scryers.

Mareave.t: The 272-bond Southern Herd gathered here waits for Marcher and Imperial Orc escorts. A Basalt Citadel was raised in Eoradal and a Frozen Citadel in Clisearn.

Miaren.t: Miaren remains under the Penumbral Veil, its night skies strange and its events hidden from scryers.

Miekarova.t: Miekarova remains under the Penumbral Veil, its night skies strange and its events hidden from scryers.

Mournwold.t: The Sails of the First Flame wove Rivers of Life over Mournwold, healing wounds, filling its water with Spring power and easing army losses. Two covens raised wooden fastnesses in Alderly.

Ossium.t: Ossium remains under the Penumbral Veil, its night skies strange and its events hidden from scryers.

Redoubt.t: Hammers of Fury speeds the mustering of a new army here, trading mine ingots for Autumn vis, and the Court of the White Fountain's Guardian Gate lets its defenders report hostile spies and armies.

Reikos.t: The newly completed Micah's Stand wayhouse in High Chalcis invites Navarr to settle in Reikos, and the territory remains under the Penumbral Veil.

Sarangrave.t: The Coven of the Horned Hare raised a wooden fastness in Nesustak Forest.

Sarvos.t: Sarvos remains under the Penumbral Veil, its night skies strange and its events hidden from scryers.

Segura.t: Segura remains under the Penumbral Veil, its night skies strange and its events hidden from scryers.

Semmerholm.t: Semmerholm remains under the Penumbral Veil, its night skies strange and its events hidden from scryers.

Sermersuaq.t: Sermersuaq remains under the Penumbral Veil, its night skies strange and its events hidden from scryers.

Spiral.t: League congregations in Spiral can preach Loyalty by protecting the mystagogues on the bone pilgrimage, and the city remains under the Penumbral Veil.

Tassato.t: Tassato remains under the Penumbral Veil, and Arsenio Sanguineo Rezia di Tassato raised Hand of the Dhomiro for Imperial lore.

Temeschwar.t: Temeschwar remains under the Penumbral Veil, its night skies strange and its events hidden from scryers.

The Barrens.t: The Phoenix Rising coven raised a Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae in Hope's Rest.

Therunin.t: Navarr who settle in Reikos through Micah's Stand still count as being in Therunin for senatorial and similar elections.

Volodmartz.t: Volodmartz remains under the Penumbral Veil, its night skies strange and its events hidden from scryers.

Weirwater.t: Weirwater remains under the Penumbral Veil, its night skies strange and its events hidden from scryers.

Zenith.t: Heralds of Meraud are active across Zenith as the Silver Magician's power shakes Occursion.

387YE Summer Solstice winds of fortune.d: The winds included an Imperial address by Emperor Vesna and new armies for Highguard and Varushka. Navarr committed itself to war on the vallorn, and the new Magpies and Vallornguard sodalities were launched. There were appraisals of the Forest of Ulnak and the Bay of Catazar lighthouses, plans to dam the River Doubt in Spiral, and diplomacy with Jarm, the Commonwealth, Axos, Faraden, Asavea, Sumaah and the Sarcophan Delves. Other notices covered Big Icebarn in the Suaq Wastes, the Sorrowful Tunnels mithril mine, the Southern Herd reaching Mareholm, and the completed Great Hall of Fabric Arts and Library of Worth. They also reported killings at Dunfrith and twenty-nine Spring conjunction outcomes, including halting a Jotun advance in Ottermire.

Dawn.t: Dawn's Free Folk, former Asavean slaves now living as yeofolk, set out for Anvil to see Lady Eleanor Novarion honoured. The Barrens saw a failed exorcism at Hope's Rest and an unclear tournament in the Untrod Groves.

Druj.t: The Senate's appraisal of the Forest of Ulnak sought ways to disrupt Druj operations and supply. The conjunction to influence the vallorn at Mirereach in Druj-held Bendol was not taken.

Grendel.t: The Empire negotiated with part of the Grendel, and an infiltrated Grendel espionage ring in Apulian offered a chance to play the players at their own game. A Grendel captain was also interrogated in Uccelini.

Highguard.t: The return of the grey pilgrims let Highguard raise a fourth army bearing hallowed banners, and its senator was still to choose the army's quality. Highborn priests looked for ways to bolster the nation's campaigns.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Library of Worth in Skarsind was completed, and the Weigher of Worth could now choose a word and symbol each summit. Nine orc warbands escorted the Southern Herd, funded largely by orc cattle bonds, to Mareholm.

Jotun.t: The Jotun advance at Sal-Ott-Meet in Ottermire was stopped, and Einar the Cunning and Carmo Stoneblade were killed. However, the Jotun garrison of Grismont Township in Bastasor held.

Navarr.t: Navarr called its stridings home and committed everything to fighting the vallorn. It now faced the urgent task of funding its new army and persuading the rest of the Empire that the time to fight had come.

The Brass Coast.t: Velasco i Guerra led the attempt to seize Grismont Township in Reinos, which failed to defeat the garrison. In Burnish, nine new constellations were drawn, named and given lore.

The League.t: The League was concerned with the planned Apstrus dam, intrigue and Night magic in Apulian, the Vallornguard, and League citizens' appeal to the Constitutional Court over the Empire's finances.

The Marches.t: Amberlain P. Black of the Marches led the battle that stopped the Jotun in Ottermire, and Corazón pennants were presented to the Marcher egregore. Stanley of Chalkdown killed Einar the Cunning in Alderly, and Marcher orcs were to be rescued.

Thule.t: Mentioned in passing: the diplomacy round-up notes peace treaties with the Thule.

Urizen.t: Urizen is named alongside Varushka as a nation that accepts only Synod mandates passed with a greater majority, and Wintermark has now joined them. Two Urizen conjunctions succeeded: the Ward of the Black Waste in Altis and the ilium retrieval in Iteri.

Varushka.t: Varushka's third army was ready to march, though its quality and name remained undecided. The Great Hall of Fabric Arts in Delev was completed, and the Ketsov family withdrew their support from the Burgher of Ketsov.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark joined Varushka and Urizen in accepting only Synod mandates passed with a greater majority. Over four thousand Winterfolk hunted alongside Big Icebarn, and killings at Dunfrith called for the Guardian of Dunfrith to investigate.

387YE Summer Solstice winds of fortune.o: The Summer Solstice 387YE winds of fortune gathered thirty briefings on matters facing the Empire, from new armies, sodalities and appraisals to diplomacy and magic. They also reported further developments and the known outcomes of the Spring Equinox conjunctions.

Bregasland/Grey Fens.t: The Keeper of the Breadbasket's band killed all the greenteeth at Drowner's Dell.

Bregasland/Ottermire.t: Under Field Marshal Amberlain P. Black the Jotun advance at Sal-Ott-Meet was stopped. Corazón pennants were claimed, bounds were beaten and the Strong Reeds inspired.

Bregasland/The Rushes.t: The General of the Strong Reeds recovered the plundered goods at Sallow's Shallows, returning the Lasambrians to Sallow.

Casinea/Mareholm.t: The Southern Herd arrived safely in Mareholm, and needed a fifteen-hundred-strength escort to continue through Spiral to Mareave.

Holberg/Misericorde.t: At Sacrifice Point some greenteeth were killed, but the rest fled into Misericorde.

Kallavesa/Kallavesa Marsh.t: The Woundbinder of the Mark's band defeated the yegarra at Hufi's Glen.

Kallavesa/West Marsh.t: The Imperial Consul met the ghodi on Gull Isle; the outcome was unclear, but a new Meeting Place was commissioned.

Kallavesa/Wittal Grove.t: The Strategos of Wintermark's band intercepted and killed bandits at Whittling Grove.

Mareave/Beoraidh.t: Mentioned in passing: Beoraidh appears in the diplomacy table, with its affairs covered by the I wish you would wind.

Mareave/Icarion.t: Plans to dam the River Doubt in Apstrus aim to relieve Icarion's aridity, though some issues remain before work can proceed.

Mitwold/Meade March.t: The Bailiff of Meade's band suffered casualties at John's Holt, though the yegarra withdrew back to Bregasland.

Morrow/Altis.t: The Archmage of Winter successfully performed the Ward of the Black Waste in the Canticulous Valley.

Mournwold/Alderly.t: Stanley of Chalkdown's band killed Einar the Cunning at Boar's Hall and defeated the Jotun.

Ossium/Drownbark Forest.t: The Cabalist of the Hollow Stone's band defeated the wreckers at Makgore's Grove.

Reinos/Bastasor.t: Velasco i Guerra's force failed to defeat the Grismont Township garrison but captured and safely released Pastor Ximena and killed Nergui Enkhtseg. Fewer than a dozen Imperials joined the Balankas Rush.

Reinos/Pedreira.t: The Champion of Prosperity sought to recover Bulangiin Karadghra at Getshold, with an unclear outcome.

Reinos/Ribeira.t: The General of the Summer Storm's band killed Carmo Stoneblade at Carmo's Sheepfold and defeated his warband.

Sarangrave/Bendol.t: The major conjunction to influence the vallorn at Mirereach was not taken, so Sarangrave remains unconnected to the trods.

Sarvos/Uccelini.t: The Cadet Commander's band interrogated a Grendel captain at Smugglers Copse; the cadets should know the results.

Segura/Burnish.t: At the Meadow of Dust and Glass, nine constellations were drawn and named, and lore and mythology were created for them.

Sermersuaq/Stark.t: The Grandmaster of the Unfettered Mind investigated a body at Njord Beach Hut, with uncertain findings.

Sermersuaq/Suaq Wastes.t: Some four thousand Winterfolk hunted monsters alongside Big Icebarn. It will remain another season if supported by at least six thousand strength of Wintermark military units.

Skarsind/Gildermark.t: Research on the Sorrowful Tunnels was completed, and a mithril mine there could now be commissioned. The upper tunnels would yield eighteen wains of mithril a season, or twenty-seven with the lower tunnels excavated too.

Skarsind/Pakaanan's Pass.t: A cult's vanguard was intercepted and killed at Osweald, while Alistair de Vere's bargain with Tuki of the Little Bones had an uncertain outcome.

Spiral/Apstrus.t: Real progress was made on the proposed dam across the River Doubt, and Amity was granted to the eternal Ylenwe, though some matters remain unresolved.

Spiral/Apulus.t: The Voice of Vigilance met followers of Berechiah in the Cellar Below, with uncertain results.

Tassato/Madeiras.t: Wreckers were killed at Lucrezia's Orchard, including Maurizia Spada di Sarvos.

The Barrens/Hope's Rest.t: The High Exorcist's band suffered casualties and exorcised no tortured souls, which have gathered around the Shrine of Hope.

The Barrens/The Untrod Groves.t: Enchanter Morien de Carsenere attended the Earl of the Groves' tournament at Tournament Square, with unclear results.

Therunin/Eastring.t: Blaze Dunning's band destroyed the miasma pillar at the Tainted Meadow.

Therunin/Peakedge Song.t: The Eastern Broker's band rescued the Axou warrior Menoetius at Catrin's Glade.

Therunin/Sweetglades.t: The Champion of Vigilance's band killed the Lord of Thorns at Broken Copse and recovered the Sprig of Fecundity.

Zenith/Iteri.t: The Warmage's band defeated wreckers in Lutum Woods, retrieved the ilium and killed Tuomas of Pirenea.

Bay of Catazar.t: The bay was the focus of an appraisal proposing to refurbish the Celesti Lighthouse and survey other great lighthouses. The Rhianos Great Race that began with a sponsored race around the bay reached its conclusion.

Bregasland.t: The Jotun advance at Sal-Ott-Meet was stopped and the greenteeth of Drowner's Dell were killed. Plundered Lasambrians were returned to Sallow, and yegarra withdrew back into Bregasland from Mitwold.

Casinea.t: The Southern Herd of two hundred and seventy-two cows arrived safely in Mareholm, a few days' walk from Anvil.

Feroz.t: Mentioned in passing: citizens of Feroz are listed among those with an interest in the Sound and vision wind of magic.

Forest of Ulnak.t: Mladen Escovitch delivered his appraisal of the forest, setting out proposals for disrupting Druj operations and supply.

Hahnmark.t: Missing livestock, damage and three deaths at the village of Dunfrith prompted a conjunction for the Guardian of Dunfrith to investigate. Hahnmark farmers were also tagged in the Sarcophan wind.

Hercynia.t: The Great Library of Hacynian was consecrated to Wisdom with true liao, inspiring visitors and granting the Singer of the Silence new abilities.

Holberg.t: Faraden sought to establish a Faraden Quarter in Holberg. At Sacrifice Point some greenteeth were killed, but the rest fled into Misericorde.

Kallavesa.t: Bandits were killed at Whittling Grove and yegarra defeated at Hufi's Glen. A new Meeting Place was commissioned after the Imperial Consul met the ghodi on Gull Isle.

Karov.t: Mentioned in passing: Karov is not named on the page, and is linked only through the wider Varushkan matters it reports.

Mareave.t: Plans to dam the River Doubt aimed to relieve Icarion's aridity. The Southern Herd needed a fifteen-hundred-strength escort to reach Mareave through Spiral.

Miaren.t: Mentioned in passing: the Eternal Flame of Miaren is tagged as interested in Navarr's war against the vallorn.

Miekarova.t: Mentioned in passing: Vaclav Mladenovich Kosti, now Senator for Miekarova, received the Sorrowful Tunnels research, and the senator is tagged in a wind of magic.

Mitwold.t: The Bailiff of Meade's attempt to defeat yegarra at John's Holt cost Imperial casualties, though the yegarra withdrew into Bregasland.

Morrow.t: The Archmage of Winter successfully performed the Ward of the Black Waste in the Canticulous Valley in Altis.

Mournwold.t: Einar the Cunning was killed and the Jotun defeated at Boar's Hall in Alderly. Sleepers in Mournwold are also mentioned in a wind of magic.

Necropolis.t: Mentioned in passing: sleepers in Necropolis are listed among those concerned by the Sound and vision wind.

Ossium.t: The Ketsov family of Ossium withdrew their support from the Burgher of Ketsov title, and wreckers were defeated at Makgore's Grove.

Otkodov.t: Mentioned in passing: Otkodov's affairs fall under the diplomacy round-up, and the Ambassador to Otkodov is tagged in it and in the Faraden wind.

Reinos.t: The Imperial attempt to seize Grismont Township failed, though Pastor Ximena was captured and released and Nergui Enkhtseg killed. Carmo Stoneblade was slain at Carmo's Sheepfold.

Sarangrave.t: The Emperor's address concerned the assault into Sarangrave. The Mirereach conjunction was not taken, leaving Sarangrave unconnected to the trods.

Sarvos.t: Eilian Sweetwater convened the lighthouse symposium at Sarvos, and cadets interrogated a Grendel captain at Smugglers Copse with unclear results.

Segura.t: Imperial heroes at the Meadow of Dust and Glass in Burnish created, named and gave lore to nine new constellations.

Sermersuaq.t: Big Icebarn continued hunting monsters in the Suaq Wastes, and a body was investigated at Njord Beach Hut in Stark with uncertain findings.

Skarsind.t: The Library of Worth was completed and the Sorrowful Tunnels mithril mine in Gildermark could now be built. Cultists were killed at Osweald, while a bargain with Tuki of the Little Bones had an uncertain outcome.

Spiral.t: Progress continued on damming the River Doubt in Apstrus, and Apulian was gripped by Night magic and Grendel intrigue. The Southern Herd needed escort through the territory.

Tassato.t: Wreckers, including Maurizia Spada di Sarvos, were killed at Lucrezia's Orchard in Madeiras. Sleepers in Tassato are also mentioned in a wind of magic.

The Barrens.t: The attempt to exorcise tortured souls at Hope's Rest failed with casualties, and the outcome of the Earl of the Groves' tournament was unclear.

Therunin.t: The Lord of Thorns was killed and the Sprig of Fecundity recovered, a miasma pillar was destroyed, and the Axou warrior Menoetius was rescued.

Zenith.t: The Warmage defeated wreckers in Iteri, retrieving the ilium and killing Tuomas of Pirenea. Citizens of Zenith are tagged in a wind of magic.

387YE Summer Solstice winds of war.d: Five conflicts received their own Wind of War pages. Prognosticators identified four possible Sentinel Gate battles, two of which the generals would choose at the Military Council muster. Two were against the Jotun, at Cinder Drove in Bregasland and Far Steading in Liathaven. Two were against the Druj, at the Palace Expanse in Sarangrave and the Plantation of Tall Ferns in Zenith. Nations' force weights were listed, with Wintermark, Dawn and Navarr the largest. Conjunctions across the Empire pitted Imperial citizens against Jotun, Druj, Grendel, cultists, heralds and other threats, and offered peaceful errands. The page also restated special army orders, territorial bonuses and Druj beachhead thresholds.

Dawn.t: Dawn brought 58 force weight, and its armies still could not take the Cautious Advance or Give Ground orders. Citizens patrolling the Barrens forced the Druj to need 25 victory points for a beachhead there, and the Keeper of the Last Battle was called to fight Druj and heralds of Arhallogen in the Bleaks.

Druj.t: The Druj were the opposition in the proposed battles in Sarangrave and Zenith and in several conjunctions in Therunin, Zenith and the Barrens. Border patrols meant they needed 25 victory points to claim a beachhead in the Barrens, Morrow, Zenith or Ossium.

Grendel.t: Imperial heroes were sent to defeat the Grendel and claim a cache at Halkrin's Orchard in Fleisardh. Separately, the Ambassador to the Grendel was called to meet a visiting Grendel wind lord at the Black Sand Tower in Beoraidh.

Highguard.t: Highguard fielded 23 force weight. Highborn armies attacking into Zenith from Morrow, or defending Morrow against attack from Zenith, retained their bonuses, and the Champion of Pride was asked to lead against servants of the Red God in the Necropolis.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Imperial Orcs contributed only 5 force weight but kept the Forge Hammers order in Skarsind. The Shepherd of the Great Herd was named to deal with cultists in Mormyk Woods, Estermark.

Jotun.t: The Jotun were the enemy in the proposed battles at Cinder Drove in Bregasland and Far Steading in Liathaven. They also faced conjunctions against their yegarra, against Halbera Strongarm and around a construct in Liathaven, while Wintermark armies kept their honour-bound modifiers against them.

Navarr.t: Navarr fielded 55 force weight. Its lands saw conjunctions in Miaren to ease the passing of ghosts and in Therunin against Druj and heralds, and its conflict in Therunin and Liathaven continued.

The Marches.t: The Marches fielded 28 force weight, and its armies could not Give Ground. Its home armies gained extra strength in their own territories, any Imperial army could Billet across Marcher lands, and conjunctions in Mournwold targeted yegarra and Ulvenwar.

Urizen.t: Urizen fielded 12 force weight. Patrols in Morrow and Zenith raised the Druj beachhead threshold to 25 victory points, Urizen armies attacking Zenith from Morrow kept their bonus, and the Champion of Vigilance was named to fight the Druj at Danwyn's Path in Zenith.

Varushka.t: Varushka fielded 16 force weight. Patrols in Ossium raised the Druj beachhead threshold there, Varushkan armies kept the Hospitality of the Boyars order in Ossium, and the Senator for Miekarova was called to fight cultists in Mieriada.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark fielded the largest force weight at 62. Its armies kept the Fight with Honour order and their modifiers against the Jotun, and conjunctions in Sermersuaq, Hahnmark and Kallavesa called on Winterfolk title-holders.

387YE Summer Solstice winds of war.o: The Summer Solstice 387YE Winds of War summarised Imperial military activity, linking to campaign reports for Liathaven, Mournwold and Bregasland, Therunin, the Bay of Catazar, and Sarangrave and Zenith. It also set out four battle opportunities, dozens of Sentinel Gate conjunctions and the standing military considerations affecting the nations.

Bregasland/Ottermire.t: Cadets were sent to rescue magicians at Picklers Marsh.

Bregasland/The Rushes.t: A proposed battle against the Jotun aimed to kill the guardian at Cinder Drove.

Brocéliande/Dark Ranging.t: Up to 80 heroes were sent to kill a cult's leaders at the Darkened Glade.

Hahnmark/Valasmark.t: The Senator for Hahnmark was named to lead a fight against cultists at Dunhall Copse.

Hahnmark/Wood Heath.t: The Guardian of Dunfrith was asked to investigate the source of trouble at Dunfrith.

Kallavesa/Kallavesa Marsh.t: A small band was sent to defeat coral husks at Mjod's Glen.

Liathaven/Liath's Ring.t: The Champion of Ambition was named to lead 65 heroes against heralds at Sigryn's Bawn.

Liathaven/Liaven's Glen.t: The General of the Autumn Hammers was named to recover a construct at Freydi's Meadow.

Liathaven/West Ranging.t: A proposed battle aimed to destroy a Jotun mechanism at Far Steading, and a conjunction sought to kill Halbera Strongarm at Halbera's Stockade.

Mareave/Beoraidh.t: The Ambassador to the Grendel was called to meet a visiting Grendel wind lord at the Black Sand Tower.

Mareave/Fleisardh.t: The Champion of Prosperity was named to lead 70 heroes against the Grendel at Halkrin's Orchard to claim a cache.

Mareave/Icarion.t: The General of the Citadel Guard was named to defeat the Courath of Icarion at the Courath's Hold.

Miaren/Serenael.t: Up to 100 people were called to ease the passing of ghosts at the Seren Temple building site.

Miekarova/Mieriada.t: A small force was sent to defeat cultists at the Painted Clearing.

Mournwold/Greensward.t: Two small conjunctions, at Honour's Rest Fields and the Farstrider Approach, aimed to kill the Ulvenwar.

Mournwold/Southmoor.t: Jedediah Boon was named to lead 60 heroes against the yegarra at Warthill Woods.

Necropolis/Coursmouth.t: Heroes were sent to kill servants of the Red God at the Broken Grove.

Sarangrave/Bendol.t: The Knight of the Greenwood was named to claim Vate's Shelter at Ghulai's Rest.

Sarangrave/Kroll.t: A proposed battle against the Druj aimed to break an enchantment at the Palace Expanse.

Sermersuaq/Suaq Wastes.t: Heroes were sent to kill Typhawn at Typhawn's Pen.

Skallahn/Fareskov.t: A small group was to enter the dark woods of Fareskov on behalf of the Toad King.

Skarsind/Estermark.t: The Shepherd of the Great Herd was named to defeat cultists in Mormyk Woods.

The Barrens/The Bleaks.t: Heroes were called to kill Druj and heralds of Arhallogen at Last Battle's Field.

Therunin/Eastring.t: Eanna Glimmerwater was named for a peaceful visit to bask in the lantern at Glimmerwater, while the Champion of Wisdom was to fight heralds and Druj at the Toxic Sward.

Therunin/Greenheart.t: The Spear of the Seven was named to lead 70 heroes against the Druj in the Untrod Wilds.

Zenith/Lustri.t: The Champion of Vigilance was named to defeat the Druj at Danwyn's Path.

Zenith/Proceris.t: A proposed battle against the Druj aimed to poison the sac at the Plantation of Tall Ferns.

Bay of Catazar.t: The uncontrolled Bay of Catazar was the subject of its own Wind of War, Long grass and stormclouds.

Bregasland.t: Jotun-held Bregasland featured in the Shovels and spades Wind of War and offered a proposed battle to kill a guardian at Cinder Drove. Cadets were sent to rescue magicians in Ottermire, Imperial armies could Billet there, and the Strong Reeds gained 1000 strength fighting there.

Brocéliande.t: The Speaker of the Vallornguard was named to lead 80 heroes against a cult's leaders at the Darkened Glade in the Vallorn-held forest.

Hahnmark.t: Hahnmark saw two conjunctions: an investigation into trouble at Dunfrith in Wood Heath, and a fight against cultists at Dunhall Copse in Valasmark.

Kallavesa.t: The Crow Keeper of the Rest was asked to lead a small band against coral husks at Mjod's Glen in Kallavesa Marsh.

Liathaven.t: Contested Liathaven had its own Wind of War, Axe-bite and ploughshare, and a proposed battle to destroy a Jotun mechanism at Far Steading. Three Friday conjunctions targeted Halbera Strongarm, heralds at Sigryn's Bawn and a construct at Freydi's Meadow.

Mareave.t: Mareave hosted conjunctions to defeat the Courath of Icarion and to defeat the Grendel and claim a cache in Fleisardh. A meeting with a visiting Grendel wind lord was also arranged at the Black Sand Tower.

Miaren.t: The Eternal Flame of Miaren was called to lead up to 100 people in easing the passing of ghosts at the Seren Temple building site.

Miekarova.t: The Senator for Miekarova was named to lead a small force against cultists at the Painted Clearing in Mieriada.

Mitwold.t: Imperial armies could take the Billet order in Mitwold, and the Drakes gained 1000 strength fighting there.

Morrow.t: Citizen patrols meant the Druj needed 25 victory points for a beachhead in Morrow. Highborn and Urizen armies defending Morrow against attack from Zenith, or attacking from it into Zenith, kept their bonuses.

Mournwold.t: Mournwold featured in the Shovels and spades Wind of War, with conjunctions against yegarra at Warthill Woods and two against the Ulvenwar in Greensward. Armies could Billet there, and the Tusks gained 1000 strength fighting there.

Necropolis.t: The Champion of Pride was named to lead heroes against servants of the Red God at the Broken Grove in Coursmouth.

Ossium.t: Citizen patrols meant the Druj needed 25 victory points for a beachhead in Ossium, and Varushkan armies could take the Hospitality of the Boyars order there.

Sarangrave.t: Sarangrave was covered by the Root and branch Wind of War and offered a proposed battle against the Druj to break an enchantment at the Palace Expanse in Kroll. A conjunction also aimed to claim Vate's Shelter in Bendol.

Sermersuaq.t: The Banner-bearer of Atkonaroq was named to lead 60 heroes to kill Typhawn at Typhawn's Pen in the Suaq Wastes.

Skallahn.t: Eerikki Korpi was named to lead a small group into the dark woods of Fareskov on behalf of the Toad King.

Skarsind.t: Imperial Orc armies could take the Forge Hammers order in Skarsind, and a conjunction was set to defeat cultists in Mormyk Woods, Estermark.

The Barrens.t: Patrols in the Barrens forced the Druj to need 25 victory points for a beachhead, and the Keeper of the Last Battle was called to kill Druj and heralds of Arhallogen in the Bleaks.

Therunin.t: Therunin had its own Wind of War, Willow and rain. Three conjunctions were set there: a peaceful visit to bask in the lantern at Glimmerwater, and fights against the Druj in Greenheart and against heralds and Druj at the Toxic Sward.

Upwold.t: Imperial armies could take the Billet order in Upwold, and the Bounders gained 1000 strength fighting there.

Zenith.t: Contested Zenith was covered by the Root and branch Wind of War and offered a proposed battle to poison the sac at the Plantation of Tall Ferns. A conjunction against the Druj was set at Danwyn's Path, and patrols and attack bonuses from Morrow still applied.

387YE Winter Solstice Conclave sessions.d: Aleksandr Zoravich Novosad became Voice of the Horizons, Casimir Pakkanovic Mislova became Imperial Magus, Bloodcrow Arora became Archmage of Winter and Vellenka Vanyanova became Shadowed Torchbearer. The Rod and Shield and Golden Pyramid were sent to the Commonwealth, the Silver Chalice to Lantir, and the Celestial Arch, Sevenfold Path and Shuttered Lantern to Jarm. The Conclave asked the Senate for an Advisor on the Cold Sun and added Viridian's Wildfire Emberstrike to Imperial lore. It declined the Apex Hyperion's offers for the Silver Flame and accepted the Monarchs of the Vast's Gift of Light. The Sevenfold Path received 150 mana crystals for its Grand Lodge.

Druj.t: A Rod and Shield concord declaring the Druj to be collapsing and committing Conclave to averting the doom of the Dying Scorpion above all others failed.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: a Golden Pyramid concord thanking the heralds active in Mareave contrasted the Empire with the Grendel, who it said had not seen Mareave's potential.

The League.t: Conclave condemned the idea of giving Imperial lore to the Silver Flame, the foreigners who control Cinion in the League territory of Spiral.

Thule.t: Mentioned in passing: Thule warlocks provided twenty mana to the Conclave font as part of their treaty obligations with the Empire.

Urizen.t: An endorsement to cast Regrow the Land's Heart on the Sarangrave in Urizen, using the power Llofir had offered, failed.

387YE Winter Solstice Conclave sessions.o: At the 387YE Winter Solstice the Conclave, drawing on a font of 364 mana, elected new title-holders and sent several orders to oppose the Cold Sun in the Commonwealth and the Principalities of Jarm. It also condemned sharing Imperial lore with the Silver Flame and declined commitments regarding the Druj and the Sarangrave.

Spiral/Cinion.t: The Silver Flame's request for Imperial lore was formally condemned by Conclave. A neutral alignment with Sinokenon declined the offers made for the Tribunal of the Silver Flame, citing constitutional freedoms.

Mareave.t: Conclave thanked the heralds of the City of Gold and Lead and the City of Bar and Bond for their intervention during the Mareave campaign. The Golden Pyramid pledged to continue investing there.

Spiral.t: Conclave condemned disseminating Imperial lore to the Silver Flame, who hold Cinion within Spiral, and rejected the Apex Hyperion's offers made on that fledgling nation's behalf.

387YE Winter Solstice Imperial elections.d: National elections returned senators for Astolat, Hercynia, Kallavesa, Madruga, Miekarova, Necropolis, Ossium, Sarangrave, Skarsind, Temeschwar and Zenith. The Senate appointed ambassadors to Beoraidh, Jarm and the Iron Confederacy, several generals, and a range of other titles, including the Grimnir of Wittal Grove. The Synod judged cardinals, inquisitors and other religious posts; the Keeper of Oaths and the Speaker of the Highborn Assembly each received around four hundred votes. The Military Council appointed the Strategos of Navarr and of the Marches. Bourse auctions and votes filled many resource seats, and candidacies were declared for titles such as Imperial Magus and Archmage of Winter.

Dawn.t: Dawn's territory of Astolat chose Éamon Ashenmourn de Cordraco as its senator.

Druj.t: Mentioned in passing: the Druj are not named, though a senator, Bartimaeus, was elected for Sarangrave, a territory they held at the time.

Highguard.t: Highguard's territory of Necropolis returned Kish of the Flame Beneath the Earth as its senator.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Imperial Orcs' territory of Skarsind elected Bloodcrow Rasp as its senator.

Navarr.t: Navarr gained Rowyn of the Waystone Path as Senator for Hercynia. The Military Council appointed Mouse Ddawnswraig as Strategos of Navarr.

The Brass Coast.t: The Brass Coast's territory of Madruga elected Eulàlia i Phovas i Riqueza as its senator.

The League.t: The League's territory of Temeschwar returned Giuseppe Sanguineo von Temeschwar as its senator.

Urizen.t: Urizen's territory of Zenith chose Delara i Fijadoz i Guerra as its senator.

Varushka.t: Varushka elected two senators: Vasilmir Radovanovna Esskivic for Miekarova and Bronimir for Ossium.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark gained Rane Shardbearer as Senator for Kallavesa. Theowold Vakarsson was appointed Grimnir of Wittal Grove.

387YE Winter Solstice Imperial elections.o: At the 387YE Winter Solstice summit, Imperial elections and appointments were held across the Empire's institutions. Eleven territorial senators were chosen, alongside generals, ambassadors, Synod titles, Bourse seats and other offices.

Kallavesa/Wittal Grove.t: The Senate appointed Theowold Vakarsson as Grimnir of Wittal Grove.

Astolat.t: Éamon Ashenmourn de Cordraco was elected Senator for Astolat.

Hercynia.t: Rowyn of the Waystone Path was elected Senator for Hercynia.

Kallavesa.t: Rane Shardbearer was elected Senator for Kallavesa. The Senate also appointed a new Grimnir of Wittal Grove within the territory.

Madruga.t: Eulàlia i Phovas i Riqueza was elected Senator for Madruga.

Miekarova.t: Vasilmir Radovanovna Esskivic was elected Senator for Miekarova.

Necropolis.t: Kish of the Flame Beneath the Earth was elected Senator for Necropolis.

Ossium.t: Bronimir was elected Senator for Ossium.

Sarangrave.t: Bartimaeus was elected Senator for Sarangrave, despite the territory being held by the Druj that season.

Skarsind.t: Bloodcrow Rasp was elected Senator for Skarsind.

Temeschwar.t: Giuseppe Sanguineo von Temeschwar was elected Senator for Temeschwar.

Zenith.t: Delara i Fijadoz i Guerra was elected Senator for Zenith.

387YE Winter Solstice Military Council o.d: Seven armies pushed into Sarangrave against the Druj and the Tower of the Skink. Dawn's Gryphon's Pride sought to help the Bloodwater Spears at Nesustak, and Varushka's Northern Eagle infiltrated the Salt Flats of Sanath. Six armies, three of them by forced march from Skallahn, moved on the Jotun in Bregasland. Five armies held Mitwold at Wayford. The Black Thorns, Wolves of War and Argent Sword launched overwhelming assaults on the Grendel in Redoubt. The Seventh Wave and Winter Sun pressed on in Mareave, and the Red Wind Corsairs landed in Feroz. Other armies rested or tended the fallen. The Towerjacks began a dam in Spiral, and the Pilgrim's Defiance marched into Therunin's East Ashes.

Dawn.t: Dawn's Eastern Sky made a Triumphant Charge on the Tower of the Skink and the Lions of Adelmar used Steel Roses in Sarangrave, while the Gryphon's Pride defended Sarangrave to help the Bloodwater Spears. The Golden Sun went west to defend Mitwold alongside the Marchers.

Druj.t: The Druj faced seven Imperial armies in Sarangrave, all aiming at the Tower of the Skink and the clearing of the swamp. The Northern Eagle infiltrated the Salt Flats of Sanath to burn their granaries and bridges.

Grendel.t: The Grendel faced overwhelming assaults by three armies in Redoubt and steady conquest by two more in Mareave. The Red Wind Corsairs landed in Feroz to challenge their hold on the Bay of Catazar.

Highguard.t: Highguard's Seventh Wave fought on in Mareave and the Valiant Pegasus tended the fallen in Mitwold under its departing general. The Granite Pillar rested in Astolat and sent advisors to the Commonwealth, and the Pilgrim's Defiance entered Therunin to push back the vallorn on Navarr's behalf.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Autumn Hammers force-marched to Bregasland using contracts with the City of Gold and Lead, and the Summer Storm pushed on against the Tower of the Skink. The Winter Sun continued its steady conquest of Mareave, including Fleisardh.

Jotun.t: The Jotun in Bregasland faced six Imperial armies, including three arriving by forced march. The Marchers aimed to drive them out of Gravenmarch and the Ottermire.

Navarr.t: Navarr's Black Thorns joined the overwhelming assault on the Grendel in Redoubt, and the Quiet Step was ordered to do whatever it took to clear the Druj from Sarangrave. Highguard marched into Therunin to help protect it for Navarr.

The Brass Coast.t: The Burning Falcon and Fire of the South force-marched to Bregasland in support of the Marches. The Red Wind Corsairs took to land in Oranseri to deny the Grendel dominion of the Bay of Catazar.

The League.t: The Wolves of War marched from Bastion to join the overwhelming assault on Redoubt. The Towerjacks dug in at Spiral to begin building a dam and reservoir in Apstrus.

The Marches.t: The Bounders and Strong Reeds fought to drive the Jotun out of Bregasland. The Drakes and Tusks held Wayford in Mitwold, and the Tusks' general offered ten thrones for the traitor Stephen of Sarcombe taken alive.

Urizen.t: The Argent Sword launched an overwhelming assault to drive the Grendel from Redoubt, and its supporters were to share the guerdon. The Citadel Guard joined the steady conquest of Sarangrave.

Varushka.t: The Boyar's Hasta gathered intelligence in Sarangrave on Druj vallorn-waking tactics, and the Golden Axe rested in a solid defence of Semmerholm. The Northern Eagle infiltrated the Salt Flats of Sanath.

Wintermark.t: The Narwhal's Spear sought the foe in Bregasland and its supporters were to share the guerdon. The Green Shield fought with honour in Mitwold, and the Bloodcloaks went home to Hahnmark to rest and tend the fallen.

387YE Winter Solstice Military Council o.o: At the 387YE Winter Solstice the Imperial generals issued orders for thirty armies, concentrating forces against the Druj in Sarangrave, the Jotun in Bregasland and the Grendel in Redoubt and Mareave, while also defending Mitwold.

Bregasland/Gravenmarch.t: Gravenmarch was a target of the Marchers' Bounders, and the Autumn Hammers force-marched to reach it in support of the Marches.

Bregasland/Ottermire.t: The Bounders named the Ottermire among the lands they meant to retake from the Jotun by steady conquest.

Feroz/Oranseri.t: The Red Wind Corsairs came ashore in Oranseri to deny the Grendel victory.

Mareave/Fleisardh.t: The Winter Sun's orders named Fleisardh as a target of its steady conquest against the Grendel.

Spiral/Apstrus.t: The Towerjacks planned a dam to create a reservoir in Apstrus.

Therunin/East Ashes.t: The Pilgrim's Defiance marched into East Ashes to confront the vallorn. Its general expected three in ten soldiers to fall and the army to be forced back to Lustri.

Astolat.t: The Granite Pillar held a strategic defence of Astolat while it resupplied, and sent officers from there to advise the Commonwealth. The Golden Sun and Quiet Step marched out of Astolat.

Bastion.t: Mentioned in passing: the League's Wolves of War set out from Bastion to attack Redoubt.

Bay of Catazar.t: Mentioned in passing: the Red Wind Corsairs and the Wolves of War both named the Bay of Catazar in their orders as a prize to be contested with the Grendel.

Bregasland.t: Six armies converged on Bregasland to drive out the Jotun: the Bounders and Strong Reeds, the Narwhal's Spear, and the Autumn Hammers, Burning Falcon and Fire of the South by forced march. The Bloodcloaks and Drakes left the territory.

Feroz.t: The Red Wind Corsairs left the bay and took to land in Feroz at Oranseri to contest Grendel control.

Hahnmark.t: Wintermark's Bloodcloaks returned home to Hahnmark to rest, recover and tend the fallen.

Holberg.t: Mentioned in passing: Varushka's Northern Eagle set out from Holberg to infiltrate the Salt Flats of Sanath.

Mareave.t: Highguard's Seventh Wave and the Orcish Winter Sun continued their steady conquest of Mareave against the Grendel. The Towerjacks' planned dam was meant to make Mareave a finer home.

Mitwold.t: Five armies gathered to defend Mitwold, holding the line at Wayford: the Drakes, Golden Sun, Tusks, Green Shield and Valiant Pegasus.

Ossium.t: Mentioned in passing: the Boyar's Hasta's general raised a toast to Varushkan cousins in Ossium slaying peelers.

Redoubt.t: The Black Thorns, Wolves of War and Argent Sword launched overwhelming assaults to drive the Grendel out of Redoubt. The Pilgrim's Defiance left the territory for Therunin.

Salt Flats of Sanath.t: Varushka's Northern Eagle infiltrated the Salt Flats of Sanath to burn Druj granaries, demolish bridges and terrorise the slave masters.

Sarangrave.t: Seven armies fought in Sarangrave against the Druj and the Tower of the Skink, and the Boyar's Hasta gathered intelligence there. The Gryphon's Pride made for Nesustak to help the Bloodwater Spears raise watchtowers.

Semmerholm.t: Varushka's Golden Axe rested and celebrated while holding a solid defence of Semmerholm. Three armies marched out of the territory for Sarangrave.

Skallahn.t: Mentioned in passing: several armies, including the Autumn Hammers, Narwhal's Spear and Green Shield, left Skallahn for Bregasland and Mitwold.

Spiral.t: The League's Towerjacks dug in at Spiral to begin building a dam that would create a reservoir in Apstrus.

Therunin.t: Highguard's Pilgrim's Defiance marched Armoured by Faith into Therunin's East Ashes to drive the vallorn back to slumber, expecting heavy losses.

Upwold.t: Mentioned in passing: the Marches' Tusks marched from Upwold to defend Mitwold.

387YE Winter Solstice Senate sessions.d: The treasury stood at 1519 thrones and 6 crowns. The Senate abrogated the Grendel embassy in Redoubt, ejecting its staff, and removed embassy upkeep and ministry access in exchange for gifts. It gave 90 thrones to Rhydian de Rondell of Dawn to stop Druj ritualists threatening to loose 25,000 vallornspawn on Therunin. It also created the Broker of Thorns and Stoat of the Sun, switched Thule's food supply from the Marches to Dawn, and renamed Mount Polus 'Kespoena's Reach'. Commissions included the Beacon of Sermersuaq, the rebuilt Great Library of Ankarien, a spy network in Tsirku and a wayhouse in Utterlund. Appraisals were sent to Volodmartz and Nesustak Forest.

Dawn.t: Rhydian de Rondell of Dawn received 90 thrones to defeat Druj ritualists in Therunin, Dawn replaced the Marches as Thule's food supplier, and Weirwater gained the Ozren Orzel tomb and the Story Garden, which offers potions to virtuous Dawnish citizens.

Druj.t: Senate funds were sent to defeat Druj ritualists in Therunin, whose working threatened to unleash 25,000 vallornspawn, and an appraisal was sought into the rebels of Nesustak Forest in Druj-held Sarangrave.

Grendel.t: The Grendel embassy in Redoubt was abrogated and its staff forcibly ejected, although the title of Ambassador to the Grendel was kept.

Highguard.t: Highborn citizens Melchior of Balthazar's Vineyard and Thaumiel of Steeplechase Toll became Ambassadors to Beoraidh and Jarm, and Highguard invited the Commonwealth's scholars to appraise closer military, trade and philosophical ties.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Sorrowful Tunnels were allocated as an Imperial Orc national title, and the Legion Rookery was turned into an edifice that halves the cost of extra mithril for the tunnels' miners.

Jotun.t: The Minister of Historical Research commissioned research into the Dance of Blood and its consequences for relations between the Navarr and the Jotun.

Navarr.t: Navarr gained the Broker of Thorns bourse seat in the Barrens through an accord with the Great Forest Orcs, and Arthur Bannerman of Navarr was appointed Captain of the Senate Guard. Research was also ordered into Dewyn High Thorn Path and the Dance of Blood.

The League.t: The League gave up the Tassatan Hills ilium mine, with 250 thrones repaid to Holberg's senator, and built the Circo del Topo in Temeschwar and a great lighthouse in Kallavesa, though the Rat Garden commission failed.

Thule.t: The nation feeding the Thule was switched from the Marches to Dawn, changing the limits on Imperial forces in Otkodov, and the election of an Ambassador to Otkodov was deferred to Spring 388YE.

Urizen.t: Urizeni senators expelled the Grendel embassy from Redoubt, rebuilt the Great Library of Ankarien, renamed Mount Polus 'Kespoena's Reach' and commissioned several works in Spiral and Zenith. Lightstone trade also brought extra coin to Morrow and Redoubt.

Varushka.t: Mine owners in Volodmartz and Miekarova each gained 36 extra rings a season through the Light Market, an appraisal was sent to restore prosperity to Volodmartz, and Vojsuli Cherenkov was ratified as General of the Golden Axe.

Wintermark.t: The final set of Wintermark's Beacons was commissioned in Sealtoq, Sermersuaq, drawing on a boon from Cathan Canae, completing the network.

387YE Winter Solstice Senate sessions.o: At the Winter Solstice 387YE the Imperial Senate passed a broad slate of motions, including the expulsion of the Grendel embassy from Redoubt, the relinquishing of the Tassatan Hills mine, numerous self-funded commissions, and several appointments of ambassadors and generals.

Holberg/Utterlund.t: A self-funded wayhouse named The Splintered House was built in Utterlund.

Sarangrave/Nesustak Forest.t: The Senate sent Naomi of Virtue's Rest to appraise solutions to the rebels holding out in Nesustak Forest.

Holberg.t: Holberg's senator received 250 thrones to repay the Tassatan Hills investors, a wayhouse was built in Utterlund, and a citizen donated 28 thrones towards the upkeep of Holberg's Walls.

Miekarova.t: Miekarova's mine owners will receive 36 extra rings each season from the Light Market, and its senator seconded the appraisal of Volodmartz's prosperity.

Morrow.t: Morrow's business owners will receive 36 extra rings each season from lightstone sold to Varushka, and the Three Watchers were put forward for re-examination in light of new fortification techniques.

Otkodov.t: Supplies for the Thule in Otkodov will now come from Dawn rather than the Marches, and an Ambassador to Otkodov is to be elected at the Spring Equinox 388YE.

Redoubt.t: The Grendel embassy in Redoubt was shut and its staff expelled, while Redoubt's business owners will receive 36 extra rings each season from the lightstone trade.

Sarangrave.t: Naomi of Virtue's Rest was sent to appraise solutions to the rebels of Nesustak Forest, with results due before the Spring Equinox 388YE.

Tsirku.t: The Imperial Spymaster commissioned an Imperial spy network in Tsirku.

Volodmartz.t: Graciana i Lopez i Guerra was sent to find ways to restore prosperity to the ruins left by the Cold Sun, and Volodmartz's mine owners will receive 36 extra rings each season.

387YE Winter Solstice Synod judgements.d: The General Assembly proscribed as blasphemy the promotion of the false virtues of vengeance, understanding, hatred and freedom. It also proscribed the Excessionist and Yaelian heresies, and service to eternals that subsumes free will. It rejected bans on statues of eternals and on ceding land to them. Highest callings passed for Highguard (completing the Grand Inspiration), Wisdom (testing the Way) and Loyalty (anchoring the Way in Asavea). Those of the Way, Pride and the Freeborn failed. Mandates opened farm and business conversions for Marchers and Leaguers. The Varushkan Assembly revoked the Senator for Karsk. Rane Shardbearer and Veikko Bondforger joined the Chronicle of Heroism. Rewardings funded the Anvil Hospital and the fleet captains.

Dawn.t: The Dawnish Assembly urged settlement of the unceded Barrens except the Bleaks, forbade harassing the Karass, and endorsed Dawn taking over the Marches' obligation to feed the Thule. A Rewarding of weirwood for a Dawnish great work was not upheld.

Druj.t: The Ambition Assembly upheld a call to make defeated Druj septs Imperial vassal-states once the Buruk-Tepel fall, though not with the greater majority a highest calling requires. Highborn and orc assemblies urged the liberation and guidance of orcs enslaved by or escaping the Druj.

Grendel.t: The Silent Bell was sent to the Bay of Catazar to investigate Grendel spy networks, with a report due before the Summer Solstice 388YE. Urizen also named lingering Grendel malice in Spiral as a darkness to be cleared.

Highguard.t: The Highborn Assembly reaffirmed its claim on the Salt Flats of Sanath and a Necropolis–Bastion–Leen pilgrimage. It called for the liberation of enslaved Great Forest Orcs, sent aid to Livardz, and named completing the Grand Inspiration its highest calling (750-0). Berechiah's Basilica in Bastion received five wains of white granite.

Imperial Orcs.t: The orc assembly carved Rahvin words into the Ossuary's annals, urged the Summer Storm's preachers to guide escaped Druj, and sent Jim to learn of the Karass ancestors. Bloodcrow Knott was condemned for heresy, and the law on idolatry was proposed to be reworded to include orc citizens.

Jotun.t: Varushka reported the rebuilt Jotun meeting place as a place of hospitality. Wintermark pledged to show virtue through deeds at Gull Isle, and the Loyalty Assembly consecrated part of the new Gull Island feasting hall to Loyalty.

Navarr.t: Navarr backed rebuilding Thornsong House in Skarsind and urged Hercynia's folk to forswear rebuilding Hacynian. It sent its people to support Urizen's fight against the vallorn and revealed Idwynn Splitroot as the singer of "Painted". Rewardings supplied weirwood for the City of Dreams and mithril for the army mustering in Hercynia.

The League.t: The League Assembly called its bravos and mercenaries to clear the dark places of Spiral, mandated investigations of those betraying Sarvos, and opened conversions to businesses for a year. It also urged Temeschwar to claim Giselle's Tomb as its pride, while a penance was laid on Teodore Dusesna.

The Marches.t: The Marcher Assembly vowed to defend the Marcher Orcs against any proscription and sent the Hallowed Bells across its territories. It called for Bree's Stand to be built at Meade, asked Upwold to shelter Mitwold refugees, and urged Gullet coastal folk to gather coral husk samples. A mandate eased conversions to farms.

Thule.t: Varushka urged the peoples of the north to prepare together for war with the Thule. Dawn endorsed taking over the food owed to the Thule under the treaty so that the Marches could raise a fifth army.

Urizen.t: Urizen's assembly sent seers to locate the miasma pillars in the Sarangrave and called for darkness to be cleared from Spiral. It also affirmed the Spiral "rebels" as Urizen, welcomed Navarr's aid against the vallorn and backed the Gryphon's Pride's outreach to the Sarangrave septs.

Varushka.t: The Varushkan Assembly called for Livardz to rise from ruin, with Highguard answering, urged citizens to re-flower Karov and pressed for northern unity against the Thule. It also revoked the absent Senator for Karsk.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark welcomed Highguard's bell bearers and backed building a Hall of Names and rebuilding the Hall of the Soturi for its Kallavesi army. It also named Rane Shardbearer and Veikko Bondforger to the Chronicle of Heroism.

387YE Winter Solstice Synod judgements.o: At the Winter Solstice 387YE the Imperial Synod raised 160 judgements, among them a wave of proscriptions against false virtues and idolatry, several assemblies' highest callings, and national calls touching the Barrens, Spiral, Livardz, the Jotun border and the Grand Inspiration of the Way.

Karsk.t: The Varushkan Assembly revoked Sirka Parakgoosier Bashnya as Senator for Karsk for abandoning the post without a named proxy (174-0).
