Reikos.t: Mentioned in passing: a small donation reached the Virtue Fund at the counting house of Reikos, and Joran of Reikos led a Highborn mandate.

Semmerholm.t: Mentioned in passing: a donation reached the Virtue Fund at Semmerholm's counting house, and the Senator for Semmerholm's Thule food motion was endorsed by the Dawnish Assembly.

Tassato.t: Mentioned in passing: two thrones were donated to the Virtue Fund at the counting house of Tassato, and several priests named di Tassato raised or featured in judgements.

387YE Winter Solstice event schedule.d: Nine nations held senatorial elections in their camps on Saturday afternoon, each by its own method, from the Brass Coast's auction to Wintermark's jars. Tally of the Votes elections for many national titles followed later that afternoon. The timetable listed Senate sessions on all three days with deadlines for motions, Synod judgement windows, Conclave sessions, Military Council sessions and battles off Anvil on Saturday and Sunday mornings. Notable bookings included a Senate Chamber discussion on peace with the Druj, a Thule delegation, the Auction of the Seats for Imperial Bourse positions, the Callidus auction, a parley with the Whisper Gallery and the Trial of Severus of the Temple of the Blinding Sun.

Dawn.t: Dawn elected the senator for Astolat at 2:30pm, immediately after the tourney, and Dawnish fleet captains met in the Military Council Tent on Saturday.

Druj.t: Mentioned in passing: a discussion on peace with the Druj was booked in the Senate Chamber on Saturday at 1pm, and the Druj-held Sarangrave appeared in Urizen's senatorial election.

Highguard.t: Highguard began its inquisition of candidates for the Necropolis senator at 2pm and elected the Vigilant Swan by Tally of the Votes at the Chapel at 3:30pm.

Imperial Orcs.t: The orcs chose Skarsind's senator from 2:15pm, as candidates presented items of worth, then elected four titles, including the Shepherd of the Southern Herd, at the Fire Pit at 4pm.

Navarr.t: Navarr elected the Hercynia senator immediately after the standing at 1:15pm and the Broker of the Invisible Cord at the Standing Circle at 3:30pm.

The Brass Coast.t: The Brass Coast opened its auction for the Madruga senatorship at 1pm and elected the Vizier of the Incarnadine Satchel and the Marracossa Sendito at the Waypoint at 5pm.

The League.t: The League chose Temeschwar's senator at 3:30pm by presenting collected bonds, elected the Master of Rings and the Chair of the Wolf in the Plaza at 5pm, and hosted the Sarvos Chamber of Commerce on Saturday.

Thule.t: Mentioned in passing: a Thule delegation was booked in the Senate Chamber on Saturday at 6pm.

Urizen.t: Urizen held a demos from 1pm to 1:30pm to elect senators for Zenith and Sarangrave, and elected titles including the Gloaming Merchant and the Arch of the Sky near the Net of Heaven at 5:30pm.

Varushka.t: Varushka began questioning candidates for the Miekarova and Ossium senatorships at 1:45pm and elected seven titles, including the Harbourmaster of the Semmerlak, at the Central Hearth at 4pm.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark elected the Kallavesa senator from 2pm, with jars placed down for fifteen minutes.

387YE Winter Solstice event schedule.o: The Winter Solstice 387YE schedule set out when and where the summit's senatorial elections, Tally of the Votes elections, and official and citizen-organised meetings would take place at Anvil.

Astolat.t: Astolat's senator was elected in the Dawnish camp at 2:30pm, immediately after the tourney.

Hercynia.t: Hercynia's senator was chosen by the Navarr at 1:15pm, immediately after the standing.

Kallavesa.t: Kallavesa's senatorship was decided by Wintermark's jars, set down for fifteen minutes from 2pm.

Madruga.t: Madruga's Senate seat was put to the Brass Coast's auction, beginning at 1pm.

Miekarova.t: Miekarova's senator was elected in the Varushkan camp, with questioning of candidates beginning at 1:45pm.

Necropolis.t: Necropolis's senator was chosen by Highguard, with the inquisition of candidates beginning at 2pm.

Ossium.t: Ossium's senator was elected alongside Miekarova's in Varushka, with questioning beginning at 1:45pm.

Sarangrave.t: Although held by the Druj, Sarangrave's senatorial title was among those elected by the Urizen demos at 1pm; the next regular election for it falls at the Spring Equinox 388YE.

Sarvos.t: Mentioned in passing: a Sarvos Chamber of Commerce meeting was held in the League Plaza on Saturday at 4pm.

Skarsind.t: Skarsind's senator was chosen by the Imperial Orcs from 2:15pm, as candidates presented items of worth.

Temeschwar.t: Temeschwar's senator was elected by the League at 3:30pm through the presentation of collected bonds.

Zenith.t: Zenith's senator was elected by the Urizen demos, running from 1pm to 1:30pm.

387YE Winter Solstice interlude.d: The Imperial Guerdon was set at 500 Thrones and shared only among units supporting the Drakes and Strong Reeds in Bregasland, the Golden Axe and Summer Storm in Sarangrave, and the Seventh Wave and Winter Sun in Mareave. Urizen units could raid the Disciples of Sulemaine. Fleets could map the coast beyond the Salt Flats, raid Asavean shipping, hunt kraken in Free Landing or trade at the Jakhalsmarkt. Congregations could encourage pilgrimage to Capodomus or Hacynian. Rivers of Life protected Redoubt and Sarangrave, and fortification rituals were laid on many regions. The Children of Wrecks' storms struck Feroz, Madruga and Sarvos, while Night and Autumn magic flooded Madruga and the Barrens.

Dawn.t: The Barrens was flooded with Autumn magic, bringing easier travel, fruitful negotiations and strokes of luck for Dawnish citizens, while Phoenix Rising raised a Frozen Citadel over Hope's Rest.

Druj.t: Imperial fleets were offered a voyage to map the coastline beyond the Salt Flats of Sanath while deliberately avoiding the Druj. Meanwhile, Guerdon-backed armies fought in Sarangrave under Rivers of Life.

Grendel.t: Grendel-held Feroz was battered by Spring storms unleashed by the Children of Wrecks, and Imperial fortification rituals were laid across contested regions of Mareave and Redoubt.

Highguard.t: Mentioned in passing: Highguard appears only in the monstering numbers table, at 90%.

Imperial Orcs.t: Mentioned in passing: the Imperial Orcs appear only in the monstering numbers table, at 88%, though the Skarsind wayhouse was built on their lands.

Jotun.t: Mentioned in passing: Jotun-held Bregasland is named as the place where the Drakes and Strong Reeds armies received Guerdon support.

Navarr.t: With the Ashen Tears wayhouse complete in Skogei Glens, Navarr could take a new Skarsind resource for free, and such resources count as Hercynia for elections. The Voice of the Quiet Forest also forged a Wooden Fastness over Eastring.

The Brass Coast.t: Madruga suffered storms and a flood of Night magic, and Frozen Citadel was cast on Braydon's Jasse. Freeborn fleets gained a bonus rank to hunt juvenile kraken in Free Landing.

The League.t: Wreckers used the Circle of Savagery in Sarvos to unleash torrential storms there, cutting the output of the territory's farms and businesses by 72 rings.

The Marches.t: Marcher fleets gained a one-rank bonus when trading at Caitun, and Brother Luke of the Marches funded the Remember the Fallen ritual for Imperial Lore.

Urizen.t: Urizen units were called to raid the Disciples of Sulemaine under a national mandate. The Convocation of the Mistral cast Rivers of Life on Redoubt and Sarangrave, and new fortifications rose in Lustri, Siluri and Tomari.

Varushka.t: Mentioned in passing: Varushka appears in the monstering numbers table at 130%.

Wintermark.t: The Sussivari Frost Coven cast Dripping Echoes of the Fen on West Marsh, and Wintermark fleets gained a one-rank bonus when trading at Caitun.

387YE Winter Solstice interlude.o: After the 387YE Autumn Equinox, a seasonal summary set out the new downtime opportunities and the large-scale magical and political effects shaping the Empire ahead of the Winter Solstice. These included raids on the Disciples of Sulemaine, new fleet voyages, pilgrimage lectures, and many regional enchantments.

Kahraman/Braydon's Jasse.t: Braydon's Jasse was fortified with a Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae by the Voices of the Unbound Storm.

Kallavesa/West Marsh.t: West Marsh received Dripping Echoes of the Fen from the Sussivari Frost Coven.

Madruga/Free Landing.t: Fleets were offered the chance to hunt juvenile kraken driven into the open in Free Landing, with Johann Van Basten promising to buy Ambrellic at two crowns a portion.

Mareave/Eoradal.t: Eoradal received both the Basalt Citadel from the Heralds of the Reaper and a Frozen Citadel from the Voices of the Unbound Storm.

Mareave/Icarion.t: The Voices of the Unbound Storm cast a Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae on Icarion.

Mareave/Nadir.t: The Voices of the Unbound Storm cast a Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae on Nadir.

Redoubt/Siluri.t: The Ashen Flame cast a Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae on Siluri.

Redoubt/Tomari.t: The Ashen Flame cast a Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae on Tomari.

Skarsind/Skogei Glens.t: The Ashen Tears wayhouse was completed in Skogei Glens shortly before the Autumn Equinox, opening Skarsind to Navarr resources.

The Barrens/Hope's Rest.t: Phoenix Rising cast a Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae on Hope's Rest.

Therunin/Eastring.t: The Voice of the Quiet Forest forged a Wooden Fastness over Eastring.

Zenith/Lustri.t: The Goatsbridge Coven forged a Wooden Fastness over Lustri.

Bregasland.t: Military units supporting the Drakes and Strong Reeds in Bregasland were among the few to receive shares of the 500-Throne Guerdon.

Feroz.t: The Children of Wrecks unleashed thunderstorms and torrential rain over Feroz, and farms and businesses there produced 72 rings less.

Hercynia.t: Mentioned in passing: Navarr with a resource in Skarsind count as being in Hercynia for senatorial and similar elections.

Kahraman.t: The Voices of the Unbound Storm raised a Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae over Braydon's Jasse.

Kallavesa.t: The Sussivari Frost Coven cast Dripping Echoes of the Fen on West Marsh.

Madruga.t: Madruga was flooded with Night magic that brought dreams of shifting dark forests, and was lashed by storms that cut farm and business output by 72 rings. Fleets were also invited to hunt kraken in Free Landing.

Mareave.t: Units supporting the Seventh Wave and Winter Sun in Mareave received Guerdon shares. The Basalt Citadel and several Frozen Citadels were cast across Eoradal, Icarion and Nadir.

Redoubt.t: Rivers of Life reduced army casualties and filled Redoubt's waters with life-giving Spring power, while the Ashen Flame raised Frozen Citadels over Siluri and Tomari.

Salt Flats of Sanath.t: Mentioned in passing: fleets were offered a voyage to map the coastline beyond the Salt Flats while avoiding the Druj.

Sarangrave.t: Rivers of Life was woven over Sarangrave, reducing army losses. Units supporting the Golden Axe and Summer Storm there received Guerdon shares.

Sarvos.t: Wreckers used the Circle of Savagery to unleash storms on Sarvos, cutting the territory's farm and business output by 72 rings.

Skarsind.t: The Ashen Tears wayhouse was completed in Skogei Glens, letting Navarr take resources in Skarsind for free this season.

The Barrens.t: The Barrens was flooded with Autumn magic that eased travel and dealings, and Phoenix Rising cast a Frozen Citadel over Hope's Rest.

Therunin.t: The Voice of the Quiet Forest cast Forge the Wooden Fastness on Eastring.

Zenith.t: The Goatsbridge Coven cast Forge the Wooden Fastness on Lustri.

387YE Winter Solstice winds of fortune.d: Vesna celebrated victories over the Druj and urged heroes against the Jotun, especially in Bregasland. The Imperial regio appears to have run dry or been blocked. Several appraisals reported their findings, on a bridge to the Brass Coast islands, Spiral, the ministries and Tassato's printers. The Marcher, Navarr and Imperial Orc highest callings bore fruit. The Walls of Holberg were completed. The Freeborn Assembly faces a perilous choice over a mandate rejecting Anarchy. Kraken hunters brought back valuable ambrellic. Conjunction results included Whisperwood being claimed, Jotun leaders killed in Bregasland and Kahraman, and the Tower of Light and Shadow destroyed in Naris.

Dawn.t: The Barrens is quieter than in living memory, with good and bad news alike. The civil service confirmed that the Druj remnants there are only a skirmish-level threat, and that Calvary's End was an outlier whose people have been rehomed across Dawn.

Druj.t: Vesna celebrated Imperial victories over the Druj, and the Empire claimed Whisperwood after destroying its miasma pillars. The Druj were also among the orc nations engaging in diplomacy, and only small remnant bands remain in former incursion territories.

Grendel.t: The Grendel kept the Pinnacle and claimed Tassatan gravegoods after the Naris conjunction went untaken. The Empire's spies converged on a suspected Grendel espionage ring in Sarvos, and the Grendel were among the orcs pursuing diplomacy.

Highguard.t: A grand lodge for the Sevenfold Path was proposed for Necropolis. The Highborn Assembly urged support for their cousins in Sarvos against espionage, and the Custodian of the Imperial War Memorial will now be elected yearly from Spring 388YE.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Imperial Orcs' highest calling for an Assembly of the Ancestors has stirred many to revive links with their ancestors, aided by the Illarawm. Mareave is reported to be thriving, and husks were defeated in Skarsind.

Jotun.t: Vesna called on Imperial heroes to turn against the Jotun, especially in Bregasland. Eisa Winterborn and Ghodi Melker were killed at Leakey Moss, Jarl Gorm Gillasbairn was slain in Kahraman, and the Jotun were defeated at Schogsfestward. They were also among the orcs pursuing diplomacy.

Navarr.t: The Navarr declared support for the Vallornguard their highest calling, and Llofir offered boons to the Navarr after the Conclave's neutrality. Navarri performed rites at the Singing Circle and the Three Stones, while the vallorn advance in Therunin.

The Brass Coast.t: The nation faces an existential choice over whether to enact a mandate rejecting Anarchy, which divinations say would set the whole Coast on fire. An appraisal explored reconnecting the islands to the mainland, and the Broken Shore Bounty can now be re-established.

The League.t: The Walls of Holberg were completed, and an appraisal proposed ways to boost Spiral's prosperity. Temeschwar faces rumours of an ancient creature beneath its sewers, and the League Assembly urged vigilance against espionage in Sarvos.

The Marches.t: Three eternal kings offered boons to Marcher smiths, landskeepers and mummers, and the highest calling turned attention to the Imperial Breadbasket. A pamphlet sparked wider interest in Marcher maritime traditions.

Thule.t: The latest treaty with Otkodov has been ratified as law, and Thule delegations are expected at Anvil for its formal signing. The peace, secured largely by ceding northern Imperial lands, is not universally popular.

Urizen.t: Sarangrave was assigned to Urizen and faces many deadly challenges. The Disciples of Sulemaine have been unravelled, the Tower of Light and Shadow in Redoubt was destroyed, and an appraisal sought cooperation with the League in Spiral.

Varushka.t: Mentioned in passing: Varushkan military units and the General of the Boyar's Hasta were tagged in the Otkodov diplomacy wind, and Varushkans were among the visitors expected at Anvil.

Wintermark.t: The mystics of Ishal proposed reconvening the Witan to guide the creation of a new Kallavesi army. Wintermark won the grand challenge at Axmure, Thurwolf was executed, and the Voices of Tanikipari and the Wastes were killed in Sermersuaq.

387YE Winter Solstice winds of fortune.o: The Winter Solstice 387YE winds of fortune set out thirty-eight briefings on events across the Empire. They covered Emperor Vesna's call to turn on the Jotun, the new Anvil arena, a failing Imperial regio, diplomacy with foreign powers and orc nations, national highest callings, Sarangrave's assignment to Urizen and the outcomes of the Autumn Equinox Sentinel Gate conjunctions.

Bregasland/Grey Fens.t: At Leakey Moss, under Field Marshal Amberlain P. Black, Eisa Winterborn and Ghodi Melker were killed and their orders claimed, though Seeker Alma survived.

Brocéliande/Vale's Lament.t: The Singing Circle was visited, and several Navarri performed an arcane projection there.

Feroz/Cazar Straits.t: The Iron Confederacy drove the Children of Wrecks out of the Straits, where the Broken Shore Bounty offices were originally located.

Feroz/Morajasse.t: Mentioned in passing: the Protectorate of Morajasse was listed among the nations engaged in orc diplomacy this season.

Hahnmark/Northspires.t: Thurwolf was taken in the Greyhearth Woods, brought back through the Sentinel Gate and executed by magistrates.

Kahraman/Gambit.t: Jarl Gorm Gillasbairn was killed at the Golden Copse.

Liathaven/Liaven's Glen.t: The Jotun were defeated at Schogsfestward and most of the defenders of Schogsfestnir were rescued.

Madruga/Calvos Sound.t: Wreckers were stopped from completing their ritual at Mawrig's Point, though the Imperials then retreated.

Madruga/Free Landing.t: Fleets hunted juvenile kraken in the waters around Free Landing, battling Wreckers and returning with a valuable haul of ambrellic.

Mareave/Beoraidh.t: The independent city-state still prizes its neutrality but is facing the realities of life under Imperial rule. Beoraidh was also among the orc nations engaging in diplomacy.

Mareave/Eoradal.t: Mentioned in passing: the ruins of Eoradal are noted as protected, along with the grand aqueduct, by Ruicraic's Redoubt.

Mitwold/Meade March.t: Mournwold and the Old Pigs won the Reconquest Cup at the New Old Sports Field, and the corpse of Alf Alwen was later identified. The maritime pamphlet was penned in Meade.

Mitwold/Oddmire.t: Mentioned in passing: Oddmire is not named; Mitwold is noted only for its extensive coast and its sailors.

Necropolis/Longbeach.t: Wreckers were stopped from completing their ritual at Abigal's Orchard.

Redoubt/Naris.t: The conjunction was not taken: the Tower of Light and Shadow was destroyed, Winter spirits were left uncontrolled, and the fate of Muirgheal Cuindlis is unknown.

Sarangrave/Kroll.t: Three Imperial efforts ended in retreat: only half the tortured souls were exorcised, and neither Flavia of the Guiding Lights nor Dmitriy Innokentievich was ended.

Sarangrave/Turan Flats.t: Wounded were successfully treated at both Lamorak's Rest and Ormgore's Spinney.

Sarangrave/Whisperwood.t: Under Field Marshal Eisa Ironlungs, the miasma pillars were destroyed and Whisperwood was claimed from the Druj.

Sarvos/Riposi.t: Wreckers at the Circle of Savagery were not stopped, and a Thunderous Deluge was unleashed on Sarvos.

Semmerholm/Axmure.t: Wintermark beat Dawn in the grand challenge at the Grove of the Thousand.

Sermersuaq/Stark.t: Wounded merchants were saved at the Iron Crossroads.

Sermersuaq/Suaq Fount.t: The pillar at Icelveld was destroyed, but the Voice of the Fount survived.

Sermersuaq/Suaq Wastes.t: The Voice of the Wastes was killed and its pillar destroyed at Wulfhere's Meadow.

Sermersuaq/Tanikipari.t: The Voice of Tanikipari was killed and its pillar destroyed on the Plains of Cyneswith.

The Barrens/The Bleaks.t: Mentioned in passing: monsters in the Bleaks are noted as part of the noise in an otherwise quieter Barrens.

Therunin/Greenheart.t: The Three Stones were visited and the Dance of Navarr and Thorn performed there.

Therunin/Sweetglades.t: Of three ettercap nests, one was investigated and a treatment identified, one was poisoned, and at the third the Imperials were repulsed.

Bay of Catazar.t: The Children of Wrecks had seeded the bay with kraken larvae, and the civil service suggested that an appraisal could explore securing a lasting supply of valuable ambrellic from them.

Bregasland.t: Vesna singled out Bregasland as the focus against the Jotun, and Imperial heroes killed two Jotun leaders at Leakey Moss. Support for the Greywaters there is noted as ongoing.

Brocéliande.t: Navarri visited the Singing Circle in Vale's Lament and performed an arcane projection there. Small Druj remnant bands are also noted in the territory.

Feroz.t: The Iron Confederacy drove the Children of Wrecks from the Cazar Straits. The Celesti Lighthouse, repaired at the urging of Feroz's senator, now enables the Broken Shore Bounty to be restored.

Hahnmark.t: Imperial heroes brought Thurwolf back from Northspires to be executed. Remnants of Cold Sun's forces are noted as a lingering skirmish threat in Hahnmark.

Holberg.t: The excavation of Holberg's embankment was completed after a year and 500 thrones, cementing its walls as a wonder of the known world.

Kahraman.t: Jarl Gorm Gillasbairn was killed at the Golden Copse in Gambit.

Kallavesa.t: The mystics of Ishal have been working towards a new Kallavesi army to take up the blade laid down by the Fist of the Mountains, and propose involving the Witan to do more.

Liathaven.t: Imperial heroes defeated the Jotun at Schogsfestward and rescued most of the defenders of Schogsfestnir.

Madruga.t: Madruga gave a fairly clear response to the judgement against Anarchy. Wreckers were stopped at Calvos Sound, and kraken hunters off Free Landing gathered a haul of ambrellic.

Mareave.t: Mareave is thriving: the grand aqueduct and the Golden Pyramid's grand lodge are complete. Skoura seeks closer ties, and Beoraidh adjusts to Imperial rule.

Mitwold.t: The Reconquest Cup exhibition was played at Meade March, where the corpse of Alf Alwen was later identified. The maritime traditions pamphlet was penned in Meade.

Morrow.t: Mentioned in passing: named as one of the Urizen heights to which Sarangrave must now be raised.

Mournwold.t: Mentioned in passing: Mournwold and the Old Pigs won the Reconquest Cup 5-4, and the late Quay Stone of the Mournwold was credited with inspiring the maritime pamphlet.

Necropolis.t: An ambitious grand lodge for the Sevenfold Path has been proposed here, and wreckers were stopped from completing a ritual at Longbeach.

Ossium.t: Mentioned in passing: listed among territories with small remnant Druj groups since recent incursions.

Otkodov.t: The latest treaty between the Empire and Otkodov has been ratified, with delegations to come to Anvil for a formal signing.

Redoubt.t: The shroud over the Tower of Light and Shadow in Naris was pierced and the tower destroyed, leaving Winter spirits uncontrolled and the Pinnacle still in Grendel hands.

Sarangrave.t: Newly assigned to Urizen, Sarangrave faces many deadly challenges. Whisperwood was claimed and wounded were treated in the Turan Flats, but three efforts in Kroll ended in retreat.

Sarvos.t: Sarvos is the focus of efforts to root out a suspected espionage ring, and wreckers unleashed a Thunderous Deluge at Riposi.

Sea of Snow.t: Mentioned in passing: the Sea of Snow is not named on this page.

Semmerholm.t: Wintermark were victorious in the grand challenge at the Grove of the Thousand in Axmure.

Sermersuaq.t: After years of invasion and the Cult of the Falconer, Sermersuaq has a chance to recover. Heroes killed the Voices of Tanikipari and the Wastes, destroyed three pillars and saved wounded merchants in Stark.

Skarsind.t: Rampaging husks were defeated at the Broken Forest in Solvhill.

Spiral.t: An appraisal proposed ways to blend League innovation and Urizen wisdom here. The Silver Flame claim Spiral's heritage, and a Grendel espionage ring remains, though damaged.

Tassato.t: The Printers' Guild of Tassato received appraisal findings on expanding its reach. Tassatan gravegoods were claimed by the Grendel in Naris, and brigands roam Tassato's wilds.

Temeschwar.t: The rat plague has calmed under the Rat Kings' contract, but rumours persist of an ancient creature dating from Varushkan times living below the city's sewers.

The Barrens.t: The Barrens is unusually quiet, with good and bad news alike. The civil service clarified that Druj remnants pose only a skirmish threat, and that Calvary's End has been resolved and its people rehomed.

Therunin.t: Ettercap nests in Sweetglades had mixed results, and the vallorn continued to advance after the Thorngroves conjunction went untaken. The Dance of Navarr and Thorn was performed at the Three Stones.

Tsirku.t: Mentioned in passing: those interested in Tsirku were tagged in the Sermersuaq wind of fortune.

Zenith.t: Mentioned in passing: cited as a Urizen height for Sarangrave to aspire to, and as home to lingering Druj partisans.

387YE Winter Solstice winds of war.d: The Druj still held Therunin, and their malice had woken the vallorn of Tharunind, which was swelling beyond the Sweetglades and Greenheart. The Imperial armies had withdrawn but the fighting was not over. Four battle opportunities were identified: against Wayford rebels in Mitwold, the Druj in Sarangrave, the Jotun in Skallahn and the Grendel in Mareave. The generals would pick two at the Military Council muster. Conjunctions pitted Imperial heroes against wreckers, Grendel, Druj, Jotun, coral husks and the Disciples of Sulemaine. One sent help to Varushkan wagon raiders stranded in Ayereed. A list of military considerations set out national order rules, border patrol mandates and territorial bonuses.

Dawn.t: Dawn brought a force weight of 58, its armies still cannot take Cautious Advance or Give Ground, and patrols under Ser Tunic's mandate mean the Druj need 25 victory points for a beachhead in the Barrens. The Envoy to the Karass was offered a meeting with Anka Karass in the Bleaks.

Druj.t: The Druj still occupied Therunin, where their malice had woken the vallorn. They were the foe in the Sarangrave battle opportunity and in conjunctions at Peakedge Song, Eastring and Whisperwood.

Grendel.t: The Grendel were the opposition in the Mareave battle opportunity to deny the Haulers of the Tide. They were also the target of conjunctions in Spiral, Redoubt, Necropolis and Ayereed, where they were pursuing Varushkan wagon raiders.

Highguard.t: Highguard brought a force weight of 26, and its armies may take Protect the Innocent and gain bonuses attacking Zenith from Morrow. Conjunctions called its people to Fishguard to fight the Grendel and to Casfall to rescue mendicant Garev.

Imperial Orcs.t: Mentioned in passing: the Imperial Orcs are listed with a force weight of 6 for the battle opportunities.

Jotun.t: The Jotun were the opposition in the Skallahn battle opportunity to intercept Ghodi Uksahkka, and were targeted by conjunctions to kill Eluf Asbjørnsson in Greenwall and a warband in Ottermire. Wintermark armies gain special bonuses when fighting them.

Navarr.t: Navarr brought a force weight of 61 while Therunin, held by the Navarr for centuries, remained under Druj occupation with the vallorn spreading. Several conjunctions there and in Hercynia fell to Navarri offices, including talks on relocating the Glimmerwater steading.

The Brass Coast.t: The Brass Coast brought a force weight of 17. Conjunctions in Madruga called for defeating wreckers at the Crucible and protecting the House of Guerra in Torres.

The League.t: The League brought a force weight of 20. Conjunctions in Sarvos targeted wreckers and threats to the Library Scriptorium, and those in Spiral targeted the Grendel and the Disciples of Sulemaine.

The Marches.t: Rebel Marchers, the Wayford Traitors, were the foe in the Mitwold battle opportunity, and the Marches brought a force weight of 27. Marcher armies cannot Give Ground but gain strength in their home territories, where any army may Billet, and conjunctions sought to protect Benson's Orchard and rescue shipwrecked Marchers in Skallahn.

Urizen.t: Urizen brought a force weight of 11, and its armies gain bonuses attacking Zenith from Morrow. Patrols under Herminius's mandate mean the Druj need 25 victory points for a beachhead in Morrow and Zenith, while conjunctions in Redoubt, Morrow and Sarangrave fell to Urizeni offices.

Varushka.t: Varushka brought a force weight of 15, Ossium's borders are patrolled under Velko Perunovich Razorasza's mandate, and its armies may take Hospitality of the Boyars there. Varushkan wagon raiders stranded in Ayereed appealed for help through Mother Varushka.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark brought the largest force weight at 72, can take Fight with Honour, and gains special bonuses against the Jotun. Conjunctions called its people to Sermersuaq, Kallavesa and Skallahn.

387YE Winter Solstice winds of war.o: The Winter Solstice 387YE Winds of War summarised Imperial military activity, pointed to seven conflicts with their own Winds, and set out four battle opportunities and dozens of conjunctions through the Sentinel Gate for the coming summit.

Ayereed/Gainmeachdubh.t: A conjunction at Dunreagh's Mead sought to kill the Grendel guards hunting the stranded Varushkan wagon raiders.

Bregasland/North Fens.t: A conjunction at Gorum's Toe sought to stop the coral husks.

Bregasland/Ottermire.t: A conjunction at Abigail's Green sought to kill a Jotun warband.

Casinea/Casfall.t: A conjunction at Casca's Doom aimed to heal and rescue mendicant Garev.

Hercynia/Northpines.t: A conjunction at Starwood Roots Steading sought to investigate strange rumours.

Kallavesa/West Marsh.t: A conjunction at Ingrid's Rock sought to stop the coral husks.

Madruga/Crucible.t: A conjunction at Draws Sward sought to defeat wreckers.

Madruga/Torres.t: A conjunction on the Corsair's Road sought to protect the House of Guerra.

Mareave/Fleisardh.t: A battle opportunity at Capstone Veld offered the chance to deny the Grendel Haulers of the Tide.

Mitwold/The Meadows.t: A battle opportunity at Two Barrel Field offered the chance to defeat the rebel Wayford Traitors.

Morrow/Altis.t: A conjunction on the Path to Highwatch sought to stop the Disciples of Sulemaine.

Morrow/Peregro.t: A conjunction on Xavier's Path sought to defeat wreckers.

Mournwold/Alderly.t: A conjunction at the Hare Stone responded to the call of Warrenwise.

Mournwold/Greensward.t: Mentioned in passing: the region is not named in any event here; the Mournwold appears only through the Alderly conjunction and billeting and Tusks rules.

Necropolis/Fishguard.t: A conjunction at Myfanwy's Rest sought to defeat the Grendel.

Redoubt/Limus.t: A conjunction at the Temple of the Stinging Blade sought to deal with the Disciples of Sulemaine.

Redoubt/Siluri.t: A conjunction at Lucia's Moor sought to defeat the Grendel.

Redoubt/Tomari.t: A conjunction at Magnus' Clearing sought to defeat the Grendel.

Sarangrave/Thornfen.t: A battle opportunity at Camp Askoun Orama offered the chance to protect the Shield against the Druj.

Sarangrave/Whisperwood.t: A conjunction at Skinflawed's Corral sought to defeat the Druj.

Sarvos/Foracci.t: A conjunction on Vintner's Way sought to protect the Library Scriptorium.

Sarvos/Uccelini.t: A conjunction at Antonio's Glebe sought to defeat wreckers.

Sermersuaq/Stark.t: A conjunction at Scop's Lookout, suitable for cadets, sought to clear out coral husks.

Sermersuaq/Suaq Wastes.t: Conjunctions at Verdant Lea and Taiva's Pen sought to kill the Ceaseless Hunter and the Feasting Lord.

Skallahn/Greenwall.t: A conjunction at Paegga's Rest sought to kill Eluf Asbjørnsson.

Skallahn/Mindrkyst.t: A conjunction at Drekatangi sought to rescue shipwrecked Marchers.

Skallahn/Ulfrsmoor.t: A battle opportunity at Eagle Scour offered the chance to intercept Ghodi Uksahkka, and a conjunction on the Nordrborg Approach sought to stop a construct reaching Kierheim.

Spiral/Apulus.t: Conjunctions sought to defeat the Grendel at Aphelion Cape and intercept the Disciples of Sulemaine on Hadrian's Path.

The Barrens/The Bleaks.t: A conjunction at the Execution Field offered talks with Anka Karass on the intricacies of Imperial law.

Therunin/Eastring.t: Conjunctions sought to end the suffering of those who fought the vallorn, discuss relocating the Glimmerwater steading, and clear out the Druj at Greensward Lea.

Therunin/Greenheart.t: The awakened vallorn of Tharunind was swelling and blooming beyond Greenheart.

Therunin/Peakedge Song.t: A conjunction on Hywel's Track sought to defeat the Druj.

Therunin/Sweetglades.t: The awakened vallorn of Tharunind was swelling and blooming beyond the Sweetglades.

Upwold/Tower March.t: A conjunction at Benson's Bawn sought to protect Benson's Orchard.

Ayereed.t: Varushkan wagon raiders searching for the isle of Dunreagh were run aground and pursued by Grendel. A conjunction tasked the Bargainer of the Iron Tower, Vladimir Sasha Volkov, with defeating the guards so they could escape.

Bay of Catazar.t: Mentioned in passing: the Bay of Catazar is listed as a conflict with its own Wind, Red skies.

Bregasland.t: Conjunctions sought to kill a Jotun warband in Ottermire and stop coral husks in the North Fens. Imperial armies may Billet here and the Strong Reeds gain 1000 strength fighting here.

Casinea.t: A conjunction at Casca's Doom in Casfall offered a chance to heal and rescue mendicant Garev.

Hercynia.t: A conjunction at the Starwood Roots Steading in Northpines asked the Archmage of Winter to investigate strange rumours.

Kallavesa.t: A conjunction at Ingrid's Rock in West Marsh sought to stop the coral husks.

Madruga.t: Conjunctions called for defeating wreckers at Draws Sward in the Crucible and protecting the House of Guerra on the Corsair's Road in Torres.

Mareave.t: Mareave offered a battle opportunity to deny the Haulers of the Tide at Capstone Veld, and had its own Wind, Scarlet sands. Varushkan wagon raiders had been exploring its coasts.

Mitwold.t: Mitwold offered a battle opportunity against the rebel Wayford Traitors at Two Barrel Field. Imperial armies may Billet here and the Drakes gain 1000 strength fighting here.

Morrow.t: Conjunctions targeted wreckers in Peregro and the Disciples of Sulemaine in Altis, and citizen patrols mean the Druj need 25 victory points for a beachhead. Highborn and Urizeni armies gain bonuses attacking Zenith from here and defending here.

Mournwold.t: A conjunction at the Hare Stone in Alderly responded to the call of Warrenwise. Imperial armies may Billet here and the Tusks gain 1000 strength fighting here.

Necropolis.t: A conjunction at Myfanwy's Rest in Fishguard called on the Abbess of Reconciliation to defeat the Grendel.

Ossium.t: Citizen patrols under Velko Perunovich Razorasza's mandate mean the Druj need 25 victory points for a beachhead here. Varushkan armies may take Hospitality of the Boyars here.

Redoubt.t: Redoubt had its own Wind, Blood-red blooms. Conjunctions targeted the Grendel in Siluri and Tomari and the Disciples of Sulemaine in Limus.

Sarangrave.t: Sarangrave had its own Wind, Fire and the flood, and offered a battle opportunity to protect the Shield at Camp Askoun Orama. A conjunction in Whisperwood fell to the Strategos of Urizen.

Sarvos.t: Conjunctions targeted wreckers in Uccelini and sought to protect the Library Scriptorium in Foracci.

Sermersuaq.t: Conjunctions in the Suaq Wastes sought to kill the Ceaseless Hunter and the Feasting Lord, and cadets were invited to clear coral husks in Stark.

Skallahn.t: Skallahn had its own Wind, Rubies in the snow, and offered a battle opportunity to intercept Ghodi Uksahkka. Conjunctions targeted Eluf Asbjørnsson, a construct heading for Kierheim and shipwrecked Marchers in need of rescue.

Spiral.t: Conjunctions in Apulus called for defeating the Grendel at Aphelion Cape and intercepting the Disciples of Sulemaine on Hadrian's Path.

The Barrens.t: Citizen patrols under Ser Tunic's mandate mean the Druj need 25 victory points for a beachhead here. A conjunction in the Bleaks offered talks with Anka Karass on Imperial law.

Therunin.t: The Druj still held Therunin and the vallorn was swelling across its marshes and forests after the Imperial armies withdrew. Several conjunctions in Eastring and Peakedge Song offered ways to fight back.

Upwold.t: A conjunction at Benson's Bawn in Tower March sought to protect Benson's Orchard. Imperial armies may Billet here and the Bounders gain 1000 strength fighting here.

Zenith.t: Citizen patrols mean the Druj need 25 victory points for a beachhead here. Highborn and Urizeni armies attacking into Zenith from Morrow gain bonuses.

388YE Autumn Asavean ambassador briefing.d: Lady Madrianna rejected the Ambassador's portrayal of the Plenum's relationship with the Salt Lords, calling the Grendel model allies whom Asavea would support for as long as the war with the Senate continued. She conceded that Asavean backing for the Empire's enemies, such as the Faraden Cinders and hired privateers, had been ineffective, and implied that the Plenum would now mobilise many fleets and warbands, echoing the burning of Chalonsio. Her minimum terms for peace were an apology and reparations for Chalonsio, an end to missionary work and Synod-backed rebellion with the names of contacts, the handing over of Rafael Barossa, and an end to the trade embargo with favourable tariffs.

Grendel.t: The Plenum declared the Grendel steadfast allies politically, economically and militarily, and pledged to keep supporting them while the war with the Empire lasts, though it is rethinking how that support is given.

388YE Autumn Asavean ambassador briefing.o: At the Autumn Equinox 388YE Ambassador Herminius received a reply from Lady Madrianna of the Blue Stones in which the Asavean Plenum reaffirmed its support for the Grendel, hinted at a far larger military involvement in the Bay of Catazar, and set out peace demands the civil service judged tantamount to unconditional surrender.

Bay of Catazar.t: The civil service read Madrianna's note as a threat that the Plenum is exploring ways to send large numbers of fleets and military warbands into the Bay of Catazar instead of a handful of warships and mercenaries.

388YE Autumn Axos ambassador briefing.d: The Shield of Ipotavo contained Winter spirits in northern Sarangrave but resents defending it alone and will give ground unless Imperial armies fight alongside. The Axou are turning the Tower of the Skink into a settlement, possibly to be renamed New Solokah, at the cost of its defences, and offered 65 Thrones for 20 wains of weirwood. They declined to join a Sanath campaign unless promised land such as Leen Rarckan, but offered mercenaries. They suggested an appraisal for Axou-designed fortifications, sought action against trods in Sarangrave, refused help on a past-life vision, revealed Convocation interest in true liao for a Fintan Nighthaven consecration, and demanded an apology for an insulting letter.

Dawn.t: Mentioned in passing: the Castle of Thorns is used as a benchmark for the reduced strength the Tower of the Skink is expected to have by Spring.

Druj.t: The collapse of Druj armies had unleashed Winter spirits in Sarangrave, the Axou resent protecting freed Druj slaves, and the Grand Ilarchs praised the Empire's planned drive into the Salt Flats of Sanath to end the Druj threat, without committing armies of their own.

Navarr.t: Axou fear of the vallorn led them to plan a ritual to sever trods in their lands and Sarangrave, and to ask the Empire to interdict the Dance of Navarr and Thorn or outlaw trods there; the Unified Convocation also sought true liao to consecrate a shrine to the executed Navarr Fintan Nighthaven.

The League.t: Mentioned in passing: the Walls of Holberg are named as the only Imperial fortification the Tower of the Skink currently falls short of.

Urizen.t: The Axou are more willing to defend the Urizen in Sarangrave than the former slaves, though they would prefer them gathered in one place rather than across new spires, and Axou engineers might be commissioned to help expand the Walls of Cargo.

388YE Autumn Axos ambassador briefing.o: Prepared for Ambassador Thanmir Hrafnar at the Autumn Equinox 388YE, this briefing set out Axou positions on the defence of Sarangrave, the remodelling of the Tower of the Skink, a possible role in conquering Sanath, fortification work, the vallorn and several diplomatic grievances. Asthore Autumngale succeeded Thanmir as ambassador during the summit.

Salt Flats of Sanath/Leen Rarckan.t: The civil service judged that Axos might join a Sanath campaign only if promised a region such as Leen Rarckan, where they would likely exile the inhabitants and rebuild it to their own design.

Sarangrave/Bendol.t: Bendol is visible from the highest towers of the new Axou citadel, sharpening Axou anxiety about the vallorn on their doorstep.

Sarangrave/Thornfen.t: The Axou are rapidly remodelling the Tower of the Skink into a citadel-settlement, possibly to be renamed New Solokah, sacrificing much of its defensive strength, while constant fighting slows its garrison and Skopos insists Thornfen matters go through his office.

Astolat.t: Mentioned in passing: the Castle of Thorns is the fortification the remodelled Tower of the Skink is expected to equal by the Spring Equinox.

Holberg.t: Mentioned in passing: the Walls of Holberg are cited as the one Imperial fortification stronger than the Tower of the Skink as it currently stands.

Redoubt.t: The ambassador had asked for Axou help improving the Walls of Cargo, and Skopos suggested a Senate appraisal involving the engineers of the Gates of Ipotavo, an opportunity open until the end of the Summer Solstice 389YE.

Salt Flats of Sanath.t: Axos would commit no armies to the planned Imperial conquest unless offered land, but up to 10 Axou mercenary warbands could be hired to fight there for 100 crystal mana or 130 crowns.

Sarangrave.t: The Shield of Ipotavo held back Winter spirits and saved many former slaves, but the Axou resent defending the territory alone, will give ground under attack, and want trods there forbidden for fear of the vallorn.

388YE Autumn Beoraidh ambassador briefin.d: Beoraidh's ambassador, Rubhart (Kaltrin), declined to introduce the Empire to Sarcophan diplomats working the Delves. Rubhart corrected the view that the Grendel are 'old oppressors': Beoraidh has no wish to rejoin them, but they are not enemies. Beoraidh welcomed the General Assembly's support for a basilica, though the civil service suspect Sarcophan money behind the Aghnayadh Apothecaries' offer to buy the land. Beoraidh tolerates Imperial spying only on outsiders. Rubhart asked for written assurance that no large-scale curse except Rivers of Life will be cast on Mareave without Beoraidh's consent, and promised the same in return. Three thrones would buy six magical plants from Sinfoyard. Without Senate funding for an embassy, future briefings cannot continue.

Grendel.t: Beoraidh insisted the Grendel are not its enemies even though it will not rejoin them, and Rubhart hinted that Grendel and Sarcophan agents already spy on each other in the city. The civil service suggested Beoraidh could become a vantage point for watching Grendel politics while the Grendel keep trading there.

388YE Autumn Beoraidh ambassador briefin.o: The civil service prepared an Autumn Equinox 388YE briefing for Melkior of Balthazar's Vineyard, Ambassador to Beoraidh. It covered the city-state's replies on Sarcophan diplomats, the planned basilica, espionage, a requested assurance on curses, and an offer of magical plants from Sinfoyard.

Mareave/Beoraidh.t: The city-state welcomed the planned basilica and wants espionage there aimed only at outsiders. The civil service warned that Sarcophan and Grendel agents are already active in the city and will likely watch Imperial fleets once the dock investment draws more of them.

Mareave/Sinfoyard.t: Since recent Spring magic, Sinfoyard's farms and herb gardens have begun producing magical plants, giving this long-arid region valuable produce that farmers now sell in Beoraidh. Six of these plants were offered to the Ambassador for three thrones.

Mareave.t: Beoraidh asked that no large-scale curse other than Rivers of Life be raised over Mareave without its prior agreement. It named Rivers Run Red, Winter's Ghosts and Naeve's Twisting Blight as examples that would harm relations and lead to claims for reparations.

388YE Autumn Commonwealth ambassador bri.d: Ludkhannah Schöningen resigned in disgrace. Her successor, Militärattache Otto Fuchsbach, accused the Empire of betraying the Commonwealth's trust by spying on it and exposing Cold Sun's origins to Jarm. He gave the Empire one season before sharing proof with Jarm that Imperial citizens supplied the mana Eva Giersan used. The Commonwealth will stay in the Liberty Pact but attend no meetings. It accepted a forced ceasefire with Jarm and began offering contracts to Imperial captains against Cold Sun. Commonwealth magicians trapped at the Lyceum have gone home, though few new ones came. Highguard may strengthen ties, possibly at Cyrus's expense.

Grendel.t: The Grendel still hold Professor Gelberg prisoner. Freeing him would help Highborn–Commonwealth ties, but the Grendel know his worth, so ransoming him would be costly and he is now well guarded.

Highguard.t: Highguard has a chance to strengthen ties with the Commonwealth military, building on Professor Gelberg's work. A Highborn Assembly statement condemning Ambassador Cyrus in virtuous terms would secure this, as would securing Gelberg's release.

The Brass Coast.t: Mentioned in passing: the nation is not named directly, but the Lyceum discussed in the briefing lies in Madruga, which it holds.

388YE Autumn Commonwealth ambassador bri.o: An ambassadorial briefing for Cyrus of Ebon's Hall at the Autumn Equinox 388YE set out the Commonwealth's furious response to the Empire's revelation of the source of Cold Sun in Lantir. It also covered a threatened leak about Imperial mana, the Liberty Pact, the ceasefire with Jarm, the Lyceum and Highborn ties.

Madruga.t: Through the Gates of Shadow, the Commonwealth magicians trapped at the Lyceum in Madruga have gone home, though few new ones have arrived. The civil service warned that the Commonwealth's privileged access could allow espionage or sabotage, while noting there is no evidence of such plans.

388YE Autumn Equinox Imperial elections.d: Senators were chosen for Casinea, Hahnmark, Kahraman, Morrow, Semmerholm, Tassato, Upwold and Volodmartz. The Senate appointed ambassadors to Axos, the Grendel and the Sarcophan Delves, nine army generals and many other stewards and keepers. The Synod returned Dagon Barossa as Cardinal of Loyalty with 304 votes and Jedediah Boon as Cardinal of Pride, along with several inquisitors and other judgements. The Military Council named Arturo di Sarvos Imperial Warcaster and filled the strategos posts for the League, Varushka and Wintermark. Bourse seats were auctioned or voted on, with Edd taking the Singing Caves on 882 votes. Ashborn Trosk and Nos Umbral Path declared candidacy for Archmage of Autumn and Imperial Censor.

Dawn.t: Aurianna du Meravon was elected to represent Dawn's territory of Semmerholm in the Senate.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: the Senate appointed Damian den Mhuir di Tassato-Mestra as the Empire's Ambassador to the Grendel.

Highguard.t: Asael was elected Senator for Highguard's territory of Casinea.

The Brass Coast.t: Velasco i Guerra was elected Senator for Kahraman, representing the Brass Coast in the Senate.

The League.t: Narciso Sybilo di Nessuno won the Senate seat for Tassato, and Vincenzo d'artevier de sarvos was appointed Strategos of the League.

The Marches.t: Honest Bobby Boarbridge was elected Senator for the Marcher territory of Upwold.

Urizen.t: Ismene of the Scarlet Guard was elected Senator for Urizen's territory of Morrow.

Varushka.t: Desilav Sergeyevich Jesen was elected Senator for Volodmartz, and Milo Caslav was appointed Strategos of Varushka.

Wintermark.t: Bronn Dunwolf was elected Senator for Hahnmark, and Verdehil was appointed Strategos of Wintermark.

388YE Autumn Equinox Imperial elections.o: At the 388YE Autumn Equinox summit, the Empire filled a wide range of Imperial titles, including eight territorial Senate seats, Senate-appointed generals and ambassadors, Synod and Military Council positions, and Bourse seats and offices.

Casinea.t: Asael was elected as Casinea's Senator.

Hahnmark.t: Bronn Dunwolf was elected as Hahnmark's Senator.

Kahraman.t: Velasco i Guerra was elected as Kahraman's Senator.

Morrow.t: Ismene of the Scarlet Guard was elected as Morrow's Senator.

Semmerholm.t: Aurianna du Meravon was elected as Semmerholm's Senator.

Tassato.t: Narciso Sybilo di Nessuno was elected as Tassato's Senator.

Upwold.t: Honest Bobby Boarbridge was elected as Upwold's Senator.

Volodmartz.t: Desilav Sergeyevich Jesen was elected as Volodmartz's Senator.

388YE Autumn Equinox Military Council or.d: Thirty-two armies received orders. In the Salt Flats, the Towerjacks sought to be first through the gates of Iskrid, the Druj capital, and the Northern Eagle moved to secure Beladrarsh. In Reinos, Brass Coast, League, Imperial Orc, Navarr and Wintermark armies attacked the Jotun, with the Red Wind Corsairs raiding Ribeira. In Mareave, seven armies stood against the Grendel, led by the Eastern Sky calling on the Mistress of Blizzards. In Bregasland, Marcher armies stood shoulder to shoulder, supported by healers and the Golden Sun's heroic stand. Elsewhere, the Granite Pillar defended Zenith, the Black Thorns reinforced Astolat and the Drakes stayed in Madruga. Only the Seventh Wave and Golden Axe offered supporting units a share of the Guerdon.

Dawn.t: Dawn split its four armies: the Eastern Sky defended Mareave under its new general Olivia Lucentia, and the Golden Sun made a heroic stand in Bregasland. The Gryphon's Pride and Lions of Adelmar pressed the Druj in the Salt Flats, the Lions with the aim of letting Dawn see the sea again.

Druj.t: Nine Imperial armies descended on the Druj-held Salt Flats of Sanath. They included overwhelming assaults aimed at Iskrid and a Varushkan push to end the Skinweavers' rule in Beladrarsh.

Grendel.t: Seven Imperial armies gathered in Mareave to meet an expected Grendel invasion, with Orc generals vowing to bleed the Grendel for every inch they tried to claim.

Highguard.t: The Granite Pillar held Zenith and the Pilgrim's Defiance protected innocents in the Salt Flats. The Seventh Wave defended Mareave with a share of the Guerdon, and the Valiant Pegasus tended the fallen in Bregasland.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Summer Storm and Winter Sun defended the Orc homeland of Mareave against the Grendel, the latter with hit-and-run tactics. The Autumn Hammers marched through Kahraman to conquer Jotun land in Reinos.

Jotun.t: Seven Imperial armies attacked Reinos, including a Brass Coast raid on Ribeira, while six armies held Bregasland against Jotun counterattack.

Navarr.t: The Black Thorns withdrew to reinforce Astolat, leaving Therunin to wait, and the Quiet Step joined the overwhelming assault on the Salt Flats. The Star Forged fought alongside Wintermark's Narwhal's Spear in Reinos.

The Brass Coast.t: Aracelis i Erigo handed the Burning Falcon to Shivana i Erigo for a triumphant charge into Reinos, and the Red Wind Corsairs raided Ribeira's wagons. The Fire of the South stood in defence of the Unshackled in Mareave.

The League.t: The Sparrows Reckoning sought conquest in Reinos and the Towerjacks aimed to be first through the gates of Iskrid in the Salt Flats. The Wolves of War defended Mareave.

The Marches.t: The Bounders, Strong Reeds and Tusks stood shoulder to shoulder to hold Bregasland against the Jotun. The Drakes remained in Madruga while their general urged them to come home.

Urizen.t: The Argent Sword marched from Zenith to defend Mareave. The Citadel Guard called down Winter's Mantle on the Druj in the Salt Flats.

Varushka.t: All three Varushkan armies struck the Salt Flats: the Boyar's Hasta plundered, seeking a black lotus, and the Golden Axe joined the overwhelming assault with a share of the Guerdon. The Northern Eagle moved to secure Beladrarsh.

Wintermark.t: The Bloodcloaks tended the fallen in Bregasland. The Green Shield and Narwhal's Spear fought with honour in Reinos, the latter partnering Navarr's Star Forged.

388YE Autumn Equinox Military Council or.o: At the Autumn Equinox 388YE the Imperial generals sent nine armies to assault the Druj in the Salt Flats of Sanath and seven to attack the Jotun in Reinos. They also massed seven armies to defend Mareave against an expected Grendel invasion and kept six holding Bregasland.

Mareave/Icarion.t: The Summer Storm's general warned that the Grendel were trying to get into Icarion and marched back to defend it.

Reinos/Ribeira.t: The Red Wind Corsairs targeted Ribeira's Jotun wagon raiders, and the Sparrows Reckoning named Ribeira as a goal of its conquest.

Salt Flats of Sanath/Beladrarsh.t: Varushka's Northern Eagle moved to secure Beladrarsh and end the rule of its Skinweavers.

Astolat.t: Navarr's Black Thorns marched from the Salt Flats to give Astolat a desperate reinforcement.

Bregasland.t: Six armies held Bregasland: three Marcher armies shoulder to shoulder, Dawn's Golden Sun in a heroic stand, and Highguard's Valiant Pegasus and Wintermark's Bloodcloaks tending the fallen.

Feroz.t: Mentioned in passing: Aracelis i Erigo recalled the Burning Falcon claiming Feroz from Rahab in a single season.

Holberg.t: Mentioned in passing: the Towerjacks' general recalled the long march since they retook their homes in Holberg.

Kahraman.t: Mentioned in passing: the Autumn Hammers marched south through Kahraman on their way to Reinos.

Madruga.t: The Marcher army the Drakes remained in Madruga, standing shoulder to shoulder there, while the Star Forged left Madruga for Reinos.

Mareave.t: Seven armies defended Mareave against the expected Grendel invasion: five in solid defence, the Winter Sun with hit-and-run tactics and the Eastern Sky embracing the storm.

Mournwold.t: Mentioned in passing: the Granite Pillar's general recalled fighting from the Mournwold, and the Bounders invoked John of the Mourn.

Ossium.t: Mentioned in passing: the Boyar's Hasta marched from Ossium to plunder the Salt Flats.

Reikos.t: Mentioned in passing: the Seventh Wave's general urged the army to remember the refugees of Reikos.

Reinos.t: Seven armies attacked Jotun-held Reinos, combining steady conquest, a triumphant charge, a daring raid and Wintermark fighting with honour.

Salt Flats of Sanath.t: Nine armies converged on the Salt Flats: overwhelming assaults aimed at Iskrid, Dawnish pushes, plunder, Winter's Mantle, protection of innocents and an attempt to secure Beladrarsh.

Sarangrave.t: Mentioned in passing: the Granite Pillar's general recalled fighting as far east as the Sarangrave.

Semmerholm.t: Mentioned in passing: the Eastern Sky's previous general is referred to as the Star of Semmerholm.

Sermersuaq.t: Mentioned in passing: Aracelis i Erigo recalled the Burning Falcon running across the ice of Sermersuaq.

Therunin.t: Mentioned in passing: the Golden Axe marched from Therunin, and the Black Thorns' general said Therunin would wait.

Zenith.t: Highguard's Granite Pillar mounted a strategic defence of Zenith, while four other armies departed Zenith for Mareave and the Salt Flats.

388YE Autumn Equinox Senate sessions.d: The treasury stood at 834 thrones. Treaties ceded the Bleaks to the Karass, committed five armies to the Suranni conquest at Reinos, and, as amended, pledged war on the vallorn within five years to claim Bendol, with Bloodwater Marsh then ceded to the Nesustak rebels. Weirwater Vales was relinquished and reassigned as a Dawnish Bourse seat. The Palace of Orieb was ceded to Azoth for a year and Remember Exile was sold to Ephisis. Passed commissions included the Hall of the Soturi, the Kallavesa Marshways and the First Voice Glade gardens. Announcements included the Spark of Ignition in Whisperwood, Reeds Redoubt in Bregasland and an Apothecaries Guild effort to cleanse the Lower Tarn Valley.

Druj.t: The Nesustak rebels agreed to root out the remaining Druj hiding among Sarangrave's refugees and later to aid the Empire against them, and Remember Exile was sold to Ephisis on condition it never passes to the Druj.

Grendel.t: Damian den Mhuir di Tassato-Mestra of the League was appointed Ambassador to the Grendel, and Remember Exile was sold to Ephisis on condition it is not sold on to the Grendel.

Imperial Orcs.t: The expansion of Marr's Mine in Mareave, which would have created the Imperial Orc title Patron of Nadir, passed but was later abrogated. The Legion Engineer announced the Garden of Hope, giving the orcs of the Empire a new way to reach Hearkener's Hope.

Jotun.t: Bregasland, held by the Jotun that season, was assigned to the Marches, and an Imperial fortification called Reeds Redoubt was commissioned at Fishers Rock there, though it cannot be funded until the Empire controls the North Fens.

Navarr.t: Asthore Autumngale of Navarr became Ambassador to Axos, and the Senate commissioned the restoration of the Botanical Gardens at the First Voice Glade in Miaren, which the Cat's Graces also refined.

Thule.t: A motion that came from a Thule proposal, requiring the civil service to consult foreign powers holding Imperial land before beneficial magic is used there, failed.

Urizen.t: The Spark of Ignition, a mana sinecure and memorial to those who fell defending Sarangrave, was announced in Whisperwood. The Senate also passed the rebuilding of the Binding Oak Spire and the construction of Kespoena's Nadir in Zenith, and the Breadbasket was pledged to support Urizen's people in Sarangrave.

Varushka.t: The Merchant Boyar kept the Light Market mines at their current level, so mine owners in Miekarova and Volodmartz keep 36 extra rings a season. A Varushkan-funded upgrade of Aleksandra's Watch in Karsk failed, and Emperor Vesna Borkovna Prochnost ratified the relinquishing of Weirwater Vales.

Wintermark.t: The Senate commissioned the Hall of the Soturi in Kallavesa, which will let a new Wintermark army with the unique fearless quality be raised. It also passed the Kallavesa Marshways and the Atalaq Tradehall in Sermersuaq.

388YE Autumn Equinox Senate sessions.o: At the Autumn Equinox 388YE the Senate assigned Bregasland to the Marches, ratified treaties with the Karass, the Iron Confederacy and the Nesustak Forest rebels, and passed a long run of commissions, amendments and appointments, while Imperial title-holders made many announcements.

Bregasland/North Fens.t: Funding for the Reeds Redoubt commission cannot be provided until the Empire controls the North Fens, and the commission lapses if that condition and a season's funding are not met by the stated deadline.

Sarangrave/Bendol.t: The rebels pledged to support the conquest of Bendol, and the amended treaty commits the Empire to begin war against the vallorn within five years with the aim of claiming Bendol.

Sarangrave/Bloodwater Marsh.t: Under the amended treaty, Bloodwater Marsh will be ceded to the Nesustak Forest rebels once Bendol is claimed, provided this does not cost the Empire dominion.

Sarangrave/Nesustak Forest.t: The rebels of Nesustak Forest became treaty partners of the Empire, promising to secure Sarangrave against the Druj and to leave Imperial movement through their regions unimpeded.

Sarangrave/Thornfen.t: The Imperial Breadbasket's produce will go to feeding the people forced out of Thornfen by the Axou.

Sarangrave/Whisperwood.t: The Spark of Ignition, a mana sinecure with the title Lighter of the Forge, was announced in Whisperwood as a memorial to Sarangrave's fallen, funded by Sarangrave Reforged.

Therunin/Lower Tarn Valley.t: Members of the Apothecaries Guild with physick or apothecary skill can join an undertaking to cleanse the poison from the Lower Tarn Valley, supported by herbs redirected from Reikos.

Bregasland.t: Bregasland was assigned to the Marches, with its senatorial election set for the Winter Solstice 388YE, and Reeds Redoubt was commissioned at Fishers Rock with Adamant's promised boon.

Miekarova.t: Miekarova's mine owners will keep receiving 36 extra rings a season from the Light Market, and its senator's proposed appraisal with Sadogua failed.

Sarangrave.t: The Empire treated with the Nesustak Forest rebels and declared the Druj's former subjects in Sarangrave foreigners. The Breadbasket will feed Sarangrave for two seasons, and the Spark of Ignition sinecure was announced in Whisperwood.

Therunin.t: The Apothecaries Guild voted unanimously to begin treating the poison in Therunin, with the Benefactor of High Chalcis covering the first season's cost.

Volodmartz.t: Volodmartz's mine owners will keep receiving 36 extra rings a season from the Light Market, and its senator's appraisal of repairs to the Blood Red Roads and Sunset Roads passed.

388YE Autumn Equinox Synod judgements.d: Skywise Rykana's change of doctrine passed 2733-54. Navarr's attempt to veto ceding the Last Battle Wayhouse in the Barrens to the Karass failed 0-112. Enacted mandates consecrated Rebellion's Ridge in the Mournwold to Pride, ended the abandoned state of two Feroz regions, sent League bravos to court the Protectorate of Morajasse, staked a Marcher claim to Liathaven and reassured the Freeborn about the Marracossan exiles. A writ to consecrate the Beacons of Sermersuaq to Vigilance was upheld. Many statements of principle were passed, including several seeking friendship with Faraden. The Assembly also issued numerous inquisitions, sanctions and appointments, and the Virtue Fund distributed rewards such as Library funds and weirwood.

Dawn.t: The Dawn Assembly named its Champions of Virtue and asked the civil service to restart the Barrens Roads appraisal, covering the Rahvin and the Great Forest Orcs but not the Karass. It also appointed Tren Meals as Reeve of Greenforest Fair and Tristan Donatien Nicholas Reynauld as Lady of the Proffered Hand.

Druj.t: Mentioned in passing: the Druj are named as the enslavers of the Great Forest Orcs whose rescue was praised, and as former patrons of the Karass.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: the Freeborn Assembly thanked the Varushkan fleets and vowed to defy the Grendel threatening the Bay.

Highguard.t: The Highborn Assembly sought military advice for a Benefactors Court at Virtue's Rest and pledged support to Great Forest Orcs settling in Reikos. It also entrusted the Relic of Rhonwen to Dagon Nighthaven and backed an effort to destroy the labyrinth spirit threatening Necropolis.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Doctrine of the Final Challenge, raised by the orc exemplar Skywise Rykana, replaced the Howling Abyss, and the Imperial Orc Assembly urged its people to reject reincarnation. It also sent Firesong Galath to learn about the Jotun ancestors, while a Navarr mandate pledged to share all it could with the orcs for the Vallornguard.

Jotun.t: Judgements celebrated the Jotun retreat from Bregasland and William Guildernstern's slaying of the Summerborn champion Sigrun. A Marcher mandate stirred ambitions to take Liathaven from the Jotun, and an Imperial Orc delegation set out to study their ancestors.

Navarr.t: Navarr's veto of the Karass cession failed, and the Navarr Assembly sent Father Dagda to help the Imperial Orcs prepare for the Vallorn fight. The Courage Assembly honoured the 433 Navarr who helped free the Great Forest Orcs, and Oleander Dreamsreach became Dreamspeaker of Seren.

The Brass Coast.t: A Freeborn mandate reassured the nation about trading with the Marracossan exiles, who will be defended in Madruga if they are persecuted. The Assembly also sought the Kohan's aid against the tyrants at its borders and called Gisli the Provider to inquisition after the magics on Madruga.

The League.t: A League mandate sent bravos to woo the Protectorate of Morajasse, while a rival bid to court Leen failed. The Pride Assembly recognised Lorenzo von Temeschwar as an Exemplar of Pride, pending the General Assembly, and the League Assembly celebrated Sarvos's five sacred sites.

The Marches.t: Rebellion's Ridge was consecrated to Pride, bringing disruption to the Mourn but letting its mine owners elect the next senator, and a Marcher mandate staked a claim to Liathaven. The Marcher Assembly also honoured William Guildernstern as a folk hero and proposed teaching foot-the-ball to Tsark.

Thule.t: Mentioned in passing: the Thule are noted as having held the Bloodcloak for a century and as currently holding Varushkan regions.

Urizen.t: The Urizen Assembly welcomed the Proffered Hand's work with the displaced septs of Sarangrave and exalted Orson BogMyrtle, calling for old grudges with the Marches to be buried. It also called Vespasian of Tropaion and Tiberius Stormspire Cascade to inquisition.

Varushka.t: The Varushkan Assembly urged the nation to prepare for war while the Thule hold its regions, and imposed penance on Sigismund for a failed command. Its mandate to gather treasures in Tsirku was upheld but had no effect, as it lacked the greater majority Varushka requires.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark entered Nora Falcon's Light into the Chronicle of Heroes and Amberlain's oath into the Forge of Bonds, and celebrated the fearless army to be raised from the Hall of the Soturi. The Synod also upheld a writ to consecrate the Beacons of Sermersuaq, and the Assembly named new places in Tsirku.

388YE Autumn Equinox Synod judgements.o: At the Autumn Equinox 388YE the Imperial Synod raised 169 judgements, most notably replacing the Doctrine of the Howling Abyss with the Doctrine of the Final Challenge by a greater majority of the General Assembly.

Feroz/Afarjasse.t: Afarjasse lost the abandoned quality as a result of the Prosperity mandate encouraging investment in Feroz.

Feroz/Morajasse.t: League bravos will reach out to the Protectorate of Morajasse to try to bring it closer to the League.

Feroz/Oranseri.t: Oranseri lost the abandoned quality as a result of the Prosperity mandate encouraging investment in Feroz.

Mournwold/Alderly.t: Mentioned in passing: Harry the Axe of Alderly was called to inquisition over Pride, Loyalty and five wains of weirwood.

Mournwold/Ore Hills.t: Mentioned in passing: Rebellion's Ridge was consecrated in memory of the Ore Hills Rebels.

The Barrens/Bitter Strand.t: The Dawn Assembly asked that the restarted Barrens Roads appraisal include a road to the Rahvin here.

The Barrens/Heart of Peytaht.t: The Dawn Assembly asked that the restarted Barrens Roads appraisal include a road to the Great Forest Orcs here.

Tsirku/Warriors' Gate.t: Claude Deeds led a band to Warriors' Gate to free the trapped ghost of the scop Theodric Mooting, a deed rewarded with ten thrones.

Bregasland.t: Amberlain P. Black's oath that the Strong Reeds will never abandon Bregasland was entered into the Forge of Bonds. William Guildernstern's victory over Sigrun in the marshes was celebrated as Marcher folklore.

Feroz.t: A Prosperity mandate lifted the abandoned quality from Afarjasse and Oranseri, but new commissions here will cost four crowns a wain in labour until no region is impoverished. The League also began reaching out to the Protectorate of Morajasse.

Kallavesa.t: The Wintermark Assembly praised the Hall of the Soturi, commissioned to host the army to be raised here, and denied rumours of cruel training. The drum of the scop Theodric Mooting was laid to rest in Kallavesa.

Liathaven.t: A Marcher mandate created an opportunity for the Marches to work towards conquering Liathaven from the Jotun once Bregasland is secure. It also raised a popular expectation that the Marchers will get first claim, though the Senate is not legally bound.

Madruga.t: The Marracossan exiles in Madruga can trade as before, and its people will resist any move against them as if it targeted their Freeborn neighbours. Magics on Madruga prompted inquisitions of Gisli the Provider and Bakar i Riqueza.

Miaren.t: Mentioned in passing: Asthore Autumngale is to face inquisition over his time as Senator for Miaren.

Mournwold.t: Rebellion's Ridge was consecrated with true liao to Pride, so personal resources in the Mourn suffer a two-rank penalty for a season, but its mine owners will elect the next senator. Hamma the Lame and Harry the Axe were also called to inquisition.

Ossium.t: Mentioned in passing: Bronimir, Senator for Ossium, was issued a writ of inquisition over mustering an army in two seasons.

Sermersuaq.t: The Synod upheld a writ to permanently consecrate the Beacons of Sermersuaq to Vigilance, which the Stormcrows backed in memory of the Jotun invasion. The Wintermark Assembly called for a mediator for the Atalaq tradehall.

The Barrens.t: A veto against ceding the Last Battle Wayhouse to the Karass failed, and a mandate sent pilgrims to the Barrens, creating an opportunity to restore its people's dignity and prosperity. The roads appraisal was ordered to restart, and the Hounds of Glory's final path was recognised as a pilgrimage route.

Tsirku.t: Wintermark named a newly scouted region the Fractured Silence and the Great Pit Firefall. A Varushkan mandate to gather Tsirku's treasures was not enacted, and a condemnation of the Whisper Gallery's agents there was withdrawn.

388YE Autumn Equinox event schedule.d: Eight nations held Saturday afternoon Senate elections in their camps. Urizen, Wintermark, Dawn, the League, the Marches, the Imperial Orcs, Varushka and the Brass Coast held Tally of the Votes elections for national titles between 3:30pm and 5:30pm. Dusk ran from 19:00 to 20:00. Bows and crossbows were barred in Anvil after 20:00, and Whispers through the Black Gate could only be performed in that hour. The timetable listed Senate, Military Council, Conclave and Synod sessions and deadlines, alongside battles, the Gilded Hammer Auction, a Bond Auction, the Grand Tourney to elect the Knight-protector of Autumn and many citizen-organised meetings.

Dawn.t: Dawn elected Semmerholm's senator at 2:30pm on Saturday, after returning from the grand tourney. At 4pm in Glory Square it elected the Castellan of Spiral Castle, Reeve of Boar's Market, Merchant of the Fangs and Warden of the Weary.

Highguard.t: Highguard elected Casinea's senator at 2pm on Saturday, beginning with an inquisition of the candidates.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Imperial Orcs held their Tally of the Votes at the Fire Pit at 5pm. They elected the Sorrowful Tunnels, Legion Engineer, Preceptor of the Skarsind College of Warcasting and Bonesetter of the Delving Market titles.

The Brass Coast.t: The Brass Coast began its auction for Kahraman's senator at 1pm. At 5:30pm at the Waypoint it elected six titles, including the Quaymaster of the Municipal Docks and Hakima of the Rippling Marshes outside their regular cycles.

The League.t: The League elected Tassato's senator at 3:30pm with a presentation of collected bonds. It elected the Vardstein Vandal at the Plaza at 4pm.

The Marches.t: Upwold's landowners gathered at 1:30pm to elect their senator. At 4:30pm in the Community Hall the Marches elected the Singing Caves, Alder of Meade and Master of the Root and Stem.

Urizen.t: Urizen held a demos from 1pm to 1:30pm to elect Morrow's senator. At 3:30pm near the Net of Heaven it elected the Brilliant Star and Architect of Hammers.

Varushka.t: Varushka began questioning candidates for Volodmartz's senator at 1:45pm. At 5pm at the Central Hearth it elected five titles, including the Bargainer of the Iron Tower and Volhov of the Wyrding Tower.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark placed jars down for 15 minutes at 2pm to elect Hahnmark's senator. At 3:30pm at the Tree of Names it elected the Pride of Ikka's Tears, Keeper of the Runegrott and Kalpaheim Tradeholder.

388YE Autumn Equinox event schedule.o: This was the published schedule for the 388YE Autumn Equinox summit, setting out the Saturday senatorial elections, the Tally of the Votes for national titles, the definition of dusk and the timetable of meetings across Anvil.

Casinea.t: Casinea's senator was chosen by Highguard at 2pm on Saturday through an inquisition of candidates.

Hahnmark.t: Hahnmark's senator was chosen by Wintermark at 2pm on Saturday, with jars set down for 15 minutes.

Kahraman.t: Kahraman's Senate seat was put to auction by the Brass Coast from 1pm on Saturday.

Morrow.t: Morrow's senator was elected by a Urizeti demos running from 1pm to 1:30pm on Saturday.

Semmerholm.t: Semmerholm's senator was elected by Dawn at 2:30pm on Saturday, following the grand tourney.

Skarsind.t: Mentioned in passing: the Preceptor of the Skarsind College of Warcasting was among the titles the Imperial Orcs elected at 5pm.

Spiral.t: Mentioned in passing: the Castellan of Spiral Castle was among the titles Dawn elected at 4pm.

Tassato.t: Tassato's senator was elected by the League at 3:30pm on Saturday through a presentation of collected bonds.

Upwold.t: Upwold's senator was elected by the Marcher landowners, who gathered at 1:30pm on Saturday.

Volodmartz.t: Volodmartz's senator was elected by Varushka, with the questioning of candidates beginning at 1:45pm on Saturday.

388YE Autumn Equinox interlude.d: The Guerdon stayed at 350 thrones and was shared among units supporting the Burning Falcon, Citadel Guard and Eastern Sky. New or continuing ventures included supporting Thule's White Mountain Fire in Ulnak, rescuing the Great Forest Orcs, scouting Tsirku or sabotaging that scouting for the Whisper Gallery, a treasonous Navarri campaign in Therunin backed by Agramant, a hunt at Treachers Dagger and Swords Against Darkness in Spiral. Fjorknae raiders troubled Marcher and Wintermark shipping, and trade terms with foreign ports were listed. Four lectures were offered to congregations. Enchantments affected Mareave, Ossium, Madruga, Upwold, the Barrens, Sarangrave, Mitwold and Sermersuaq, and three rituals were put forward for Imperial lore.

Dawn.t: Dawnish military units could join the hunt at Treachers Dagger and the Swords Against Darkness venture in Spiral, while an Autumn projection over Dawnguard in the Barrens drew traders and wanderers.

Druj.t: The Druj faced a Thule push into the Forest of Ulnak aimed at Bonewall and the Great Pit, along with a possible Imperial raid to free the Great Forest Orcs. They also faced a Navarri attempt, aided by Agramant, to retake nominally Druj-held Therunin.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: Grendel is not named on the page, but it shared Mareave, where Rivers of Life and three Frozen Citadel enchantments were in place.

Highguard.t: Pilgrims answering the Highborn Assembly's call were urged to travel to Bastion to labour on the Grand Inspiration, and units supporting the Citadel Guard in the Salt Flats of Sanath shared the Guerdon.

Imperial Orcs.t: Imperial orcs could join the effort to rescue the Great Forest Orcs from the Druj, and units supporting the Eastern Sky in Mareave shared the Guerdon.

Jotun.t: The roused Fjorknae harried Marcher and Wintermark shipping in the Gullet. Imperial scouting in Tsirku sought details of any Jotun presence and links to Tromsa and Skallahn.

Navarr.t: Navarri units could support Dochas Weeping Glade's Agramant-backed campaign to retake Therunin, which would be publicised as treason likely to end in execution. Navarr could also join the rescue of the Great Forest Orcs, while Navarr fleets suffered a penalty when trading in Axos.

The Brass Coast.t: Madruga was enchanted with a Night projection that brought strange forest dreams and increased Night activity.

The League.t: League units could fight the threats in Spiral, Temeschwari congregations could preach the Pride of Temeschwar, and Leaguers could convert resources to businesses or upgrade businesses more cheaply.

The Marches.t: Upwold's forges were enchanted with Hammers of Fury to muster a new army and Mitwold was regrown. Marchers could convert resources to farms cheaply, but Marcher fleets suffered from Fjorknae raiders.

Thule.t: Stürmherra's White Mountain Fire pressed into the Forest of Ulnak to claim Bonewall and the Great Pit, and Tathenon the Gyre offered mana crystals to Imperial units supporting it.

Urizen.t: Urizeni units could fight the threats in Spiral, and Urizeni congregations could discuss Prosperity with Adept Camilla and the Adepts of Tsark at Occursion.

Varushka.t: Ossium was enchanted with a Night projection that made its woods disorienting, and Varushkan units avoided the cold penalty when scouting Tsirku.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark units were called to secure Treachers Dagger in the Suaq Wastes, Sermersuaq was regrown and West Marsh received Dripping Echoes of the Fen. Wintermark fleets, however, suffered from Fjorknae raiders.

388YE Autumn Equinox interlude.o: The Autumn Equinox 388YE interlude opened downtime after the Summer Solstice. It set out the season's Imperial Guerdon, new ventures for military units, fleets and congregations, and the enchantments and other effects now at work across the Empire.

Kallavesa/West Marsh.t: The Sussivari Frost Coven cast Dripping Echoes of the Fen on West Marsh.

Mareave/Clisearn.t: Phoenix Rising cast Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae on Clisearn.

Mareave/Icarion.t: Phoenix Rising cast Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae on Icarion.

Mareave/Nadir.t: Phoenix Rising cast Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae on Nadir.

Otkodov/Sküld.t: Mentioned in passing: a ritual called The Arc of Sküld was put forward for Imperial lore by Yarvi Swiftwind for the Silver Chalice.

Sermersuaq/Suaq Wastes.t: Hunters were sent against the servants of Agramant guarding the Winter regio of Treachers Dagger. With 5,000 strength the guardians would be scattered and the regio could be permanently severed.

Tsirku/Warriors' Gate.t: Warriors' Gate had been explored by the Tsirku scouting network, which was now heading north towards Sydanjaa.

Bastion.t: Congregations foretelling the Second Age of Virtue would send pilgrims to Bastion to help raise the Grand Inspiration of the Way.

Bregasland.t: Military units supporting the Burning Falcon in Bregasland received shares of the Guerdon.

Fjorknae.t: The Fjorknae were roused, and their ships were active in the Gullet and the northern Sea of Snow, hampering Marcher and Wintermark voyages and trade with Caitun.

Forest of Ulnak.t: The White Mountain Fire campaigned in Ulnak as part of a wider invasion, with Tathenon the Gyre rewarding Imperial units that supported it.

Kallavesa.t: The Sussivari Frost Coven cast Dripping Echoes of the Fen on the West Marsh region.

Madruga.t: Madruga was enchanted with a magnitude 80 Night projection, bringing dreams of a shifting forest and more Night regio and heralds.

Mareave.t: Rivers of Life made Mareave's waters restorative, Frozen Citadel was cast on three of its regions, and units supporting the Eastern Sky there shared the Guerdon.

Mitwold.t: Regrow the Land's Heart brought soft rains and new growth to Mitwold's war scars, and children born or conceived there became more likely to show the briar lineage.

Ossium.t: A magnitude 80 Night projection made Ossium's woods confusing to travel and brought vivid dreams and more Night activity.

Otkodov.t: Stürmherra invoked the Druj fear of Otkodov's high peaks, and Imperial scouts sought any connections between Tsirku and Otkodov.

Salt Flats of Sanath.t: Units supporting the Citadel Guard there shared the Guerdon. A rescue of the Great Forest Orcs mustering at least 45,000 strength could push into the Salt Flats and the Grove of Woe.
