Sarangrave.t: Sarangrave was enchanted with Hand of the Dhomiro, subtly guiding those fleeing or crossing the territory past enemy patrols and protecting small valuables.

Sea of Snow.t: Fjorknae raiding ships were active in the northern Sea of Snow, though fast Marcher and Wintermark ships could outrun them.

Sermersuaq.t: Sermersuaq was enchanted with Regrow the Land's Heart, and Wintermark and Dawnish units were called to Treachers Dagger in the Suaq Wastes.

Skallahn.t: Mentioned in passing: Tsirku scouts at 3,000 strength would report any connections to Skallahn.

Spiral.t: Urizen, League and Dawnish units could attack the threats in Spiral. One more effective season would beat back the horrors of the Black Plateau, and sustained effort could permanently raise the territory's taxation.

Temeschwar.t: With Virtue's Respite remade and the Pride of Temeschwar raised, Temeschwari congregations could preach Pride in their city's history.

The Barrens.t: A magnitude 80 Autumn projection on Dawnguard drew traders and wanderers to Drycastle and the surrounding region.

Therunin.t: Dochas Weeping Glade's settlement of survivors, aided by Agramant, sought to retake the nominally Druj-held territory with treasonous Navarri support.

Tromsa.t: Mentioned in passing: Tsirku scouts at 3,000 strength would report any connections to Tromsa.

Tsirku.t: The Tsirku scouting network turned north after exploring Warriors' Gate, while the Whisper Gallery paid units to sabotage the scouting.

Upwold.t: Hammers of Fury enchanted Upwold's forges to speed the mustering of a new army, cutting each mine's ingots by two in exchange for warm ashes.

388YE Autumn Equinox winds of fortune.d: Emperor Vesna addressed the Empire, and several assemblies pursued their highest callings. The Marches expanded the Imperial Breadbasket into the Mournwold. The League reached out to the Sand Fishers. The Brass Coast turned to defending its lands. Dawn and Navarr prepared for the final war against the vallorn. An Imperial army vanished in Madruga, while husks, Druj and the Kroll troubled Sarangrave. Night magic washed over Ossium, and a new star appeared above Anvil's regio. Professor Gelberg was kidnapped by Grendel at Couros Field. The Silver Flame abandoned its fane plans and sought farm rituals. Tsark invited Imperials to speak on Prosperity in Zenith. The Blades of the Semmerlak commission was reappraised.

Dawn.t: Dawn's highest calling prepares its people for the final war against the vallorn, and Greenwood Manor has been thrown open to all comers. A Dawnish knightly estate is proposed for the Blades of the Semmerlak.

Druj.t: The Druj are scattered through Sarangrave alongside rampaging husks, threatening to stir the Kroll. Their raiders failed to kidnap Lenna Karass, Prilak Gutdredger was killed, and the Fetid Heart in Ghul'thak Forest was not taken.

Grendel.t: Grendel assassins drove Imperials out of Couros Field and kidnapped Professor Gelberg. Elsewhere, Grendel were wiped out at Isaac's End, poisoned in Fleisardh and defeated at Frithstan's Fen, and they still compete with the Empire for the Bay of Catazar.

Highguard.t: The Highborn Assembly set out its stance on the Grand Inspiration of the Way and offered peerless kinship to Wintermark. Navarr shared its vallorn expertise with Highguard, and Highborn advisors joined the Unshackled approach to the Dreamers of the Dark Forest.

Imperial Orcs.t: Pursuing their highest calling of seeking the ancestors of other septs, an Unshackled delegation led by Bloodcrow Meep received a guarded welcome from the Dreamers of the Dark Forest in Ossium, and with it a new dilemma for the Empire.

Jotun.t: Mentioned in passing: Marcher interest in Imperial steel sweeping into Jotun-held Bregasland is noted, as is a mildly irritating development concerning Liathaven/Ashvale.

Navarr.t: Seren has become the City of Dreams, giving rise to the dreamspeaker calling, and Thornsong refugees propose a new apothecary college. Navarr's highest calling supports the Vallornguard, while Agramant makes a pointed offer over the reconquest of Therunin.

The Brass Coast.t: The Freeborn Assembly made defending their lands their highest calling. Feroz was chosen by the Prosperity Assembly for help, and an Imperial army vanished in the Night-touched marshes of Madruga.

The League.t: The League's highest calling saw its princes reach out to the Sand Fishers of Misericorde. Apulian orcs and League Synod members made a pilgrimage to the Mournwold and were warmly welcomed.

The Marches.t: The Marcher Assembly completed its highest calling by expanding the Imperial Breadbasket into the Mournwold and now weighs how to own and defend land. It also hosted League pilgrims and awaits the General Assembly's decision on Rebellion's Ridge.

Thule.t: The Thule of Otkodov remain at uneasy peace with the Empire while warring on the Druj and conquering western Ulnak. Their envoys negotiate over upcoming events in Ossium, and an attempt by the Eyes of the Dragon to use a boon of Kimus at Islet of Calm was prevented.

Urizen.t: Urizeni captains and Sarangrave residents face husks, Druj, famine and the threat of the Kroll. Members of the Urizen Assembly helped persuade the Tsarkoi adept Camilla of the value of Prosperity.

Varushka.t: Varushkan Ossium was washed by mixed Night magic blessings, and Varushkan advisors aided the Unshackled. A wardenhouse is proposed for the Blades of the Semmerlak, and the Sumisev Peegel in Volodmartz was destroyed.

Wintermark.t: Runegrott artisans propose a banner edifice and a new artefact banner to replace Foe-Slayer, and the Mystics of Ishal have reshaped their support for the Raven Seer. Wintermark explorers pressed into Tsirku, where Wemba the Bloody is loose, and Highguard offered peerless kinship.

388YE Autumn Equinox winds of fortune.o: The 388YE Autumn Equinox winds of fortune gathered the season's briefings for the Empire, from national highest callings, eternal offers and diplomatic updates to the results of the Summer Solstice conjunctions.

Astolat/Withy.t: The attempt to stop Igraine's Regio shifting back to Spring had an unclear result.

Feroz/Morajasse.t: Mentioned in passing: a Morajasse section was added to the Grendel diplomatic wind.

Forest of Ulnak/Ghul'thak Forest.t: The raid on the Fetid Heart was not taken, leaving the black lotus and Taramid Skinwreath's treasures of unclear status.

Forest of Ulnak/Gloomsea.t: At the Islet of Calm, Wind of Mundane Silence was cast on the regio and the bodies destroyed, stopping the Eyes of the Dragon from using a boon of Kimus.

Forest of Ulnak/Grimfen Mire.t: Acting on a scouting discovery, Forge the Wooden Fastness was cast at Moss End with eight rings of ilium.

Holberg/Misericorde.t: The League's princes reached out to the Sand Fishers of Misericorde about joining the Empire.

Kallavesa/West Marsh.t: Erlend consecrated the Meeting Place with true liao.

Kallavesa/Wittal Grove.t: The Grendel were defeated at Frithstan's Fen and the Iontach Meddool Miniog was rescued and returned to Anvil.

Karov/Malimorzi.t: The port of Korotny is a candidate site for the Varushkan wardenhouse of the Blades of the Semmerlak.

Madruga/Crucible.t: An Imperial army was claiming the Crucible's marshes, one army has since vanished, and the Snapping Face was retrieved at Talpses Plat.

Madruga/Free Landing.t: The effort to aid a stranded Sumaah ship at Hart's Cove had an unclear result; the Hand of Guerra should know more.

Madruga/Siroc Bayou.t: Imperial armies were claiming the Siroc Bayou's wild marshes, and one of the two never came back out.

Mareave/Beoraidh.t: Movement has been made towards building a temple to the Way in the neutral free port of Beoraidh.

Mareave/Clisearn.t: The Vaults at the Ruins of Sinat were opened, the Saltbound Stone claimed by Terentia of Sarangrave Reforged, and the Ilium Jackals negotiated with.

Mareave/Fleisardh.t: Grendel were poisoned from the Spring regio near Golden Wind's Encampment.

Mareave/Sinfoyard.t: Mentioned in passing: noted as recognised, with Beoraidh, as a neutral state by the Senate.

Mitwold/Maiden Downs.t: Jyll Longleys was killed before cursing the Maiden Stone, and Dusty Cobb's rebels were killed before burning the Golden Fields.

Mountains of the Moon/Visoko.t: Mentioned in passing: shrines to great Tsarkoi sages are built into the Wall of the Luge around the sacred plateau of Visoko.

Mournwold/Ore Hills.t: Mentioned in passing: the Leaders of the Ore Hills Rebellion would be memorialised by the proposed consecration of Rebellion's Ridge.

Necropolis/Coursmouth.t: The waters of Siakha were spilled at the Veiled Garden and the bucket was returned to Anvil.

Ossium/Bittershore.t: The Kostjyas Respite is a candidate site for the Varushkan wardenhouse of the Blades of the Semmerlak.

Ossium/Echofell.t: Heralds were killed at Burned Glade and Ossium was not cursed.

Redoubt/Naris.t: Telemachus's forces killed every Grendel at Isaac's End.

Reikos/Chalcis Mount.t: Mentioned in passing: some Thornsong apothecaries stayed on Chalcis Mount after fleeing Therunin.

Reikos/Haros Water.t: Grendel assassins pushed Imperials out of Couros Field and kidnapped Professor Gelberg.

Sarangrave/Bendol.t: The attempt to drive the vallorn from the Spring regio cost Imperial lives and vallornspawn remain, and Dance of Navarr and Thorn was not performed.

Sarangrave/Bloodwater Marsh.t: Permanent wards were cast at both the Eastern and Western Wards.

Sarangrave/Kroll.t: Heralds at Slow Worm's Hill were killed and Sarangrave was not cursed, though the Kroll's threat looms.

Sarangrave/Nesustak Forest.t: Mentioned in passing: the Empire has been trying to make diplomatic inroads with the rebels of Nesustak Forest.

Sarangrave/Thornfen.t: The Axou eviction of so many from Thornfen has raised the spectre of famine in Sarangrave.

Sarangrave/Turan Flats.t: The spirits at the Fens of Varreth were not trapped, leaving husks and Het Trakaa's tortured souls, but treasure was recovered at the Breakteeth dais.

Sarangrave/Whisperwood.t: Heralds of Surut were killed at Halfweir Grove, raising Fingers of the Devourer production, and the Depths of the Hungry Earth were investigated.

Semmerholm/Lacuve.t: Lacuve near Lacre is a candidate site for the Dawnish knightly estate of the Blades of the Semmerlak.

Spiral/Apstrus.t: A raid on the Legacy at Alba's Lea saw ten wains of mithril claimed by the Haurlatch Iron Consortium.

Spiral/Cinion.t: The Silver Flame of Cinion sent Sinokenon's heralds away and now seek farm rituals, offering their sentinels for Spiral's defence.

Spiral/Ossuary.t: Mentioned in passing: the Steward of the Ossuary is flagged in the Beoraidh diplomatic wind.

Tassato/Cascatas.t: Heralds of Siakha and wreckers were killed at Campo Verdenta.

The Barrens/Bitter Strand.t: Answering General Utmar's call at Saltshore, Imperials killed the manticore's vassals.

The Barrens/Dawnguard.t: Prilak Gutdredger and almost all his allies were killed at Troubadour's Glade.

The Barrens/Saltmarsh.t: All but one of the Servants of the Burnt survived at the Dredging Flats, but Lenna Karass was rescued from Druj raiders at Gardenway.

The Barrens/The Untrod Groves.t: Ser Gawain Amboise's schemes were thwarted at the Glade of the Good Knight.

Therunin/Lower Tarn Valley.t: Reclaimed by the Golden Axe last season, the valley saw the miasma pillar at Rotwood Croft consecrated.

Volodmartz/Livardz.t: The Sumisev Peegel was destroyed by Wind of Mundane Silence.

Weirwater/Sandling.t: Sandling near Culwich is a candidate site for the Dawnish knightly estate of the Blades of the Semmerlak.

Zenith/Occursion.t: The Gardens of the Perfect World will host eleven Imperials and Sage Kristoph to discuss figures of Prosperity with the Tsarkoi.

Astolat.t: An effort to stop Igraine's Regio shifting back to Spring had an unclear result, though Éamon Ashenmourn de Cordraco might know more.

Bastion.t: Mentioned in passing: its senator is flagged over Ephisis' contracts, and its congregations are noted in connection with Gelberg's appraisal.

Bay of Catazar.t: Mentioned in passing: the Grendel are noted as competing with the Empire for dominance of the Bay.

Bregasland.t: Mentioned in passing: Imperial steel is described as sweeping through Mitwold and into Bregasland.

Casinea.t: After the Summer Solstice, an awareness rippled out from the Imperial regio at Anvil, heralding a new star in the sky.

Feroz.t: The Prosperity Assembly chose Feroz, still scarred by Governor Rahab, as the first damaged territory to help, and a Freeborn architect has a pitch for doing so.

Forest of Ulnak.t: Forge the Wooden Fastness was cast at Moss End and the Eyes of the Dragon were thwarted at Islet of Calm, but the raid on the Fetid Heart was not taken. The Thule have been conquering western Ulnak.

Hahnmark.t: Mentioned in passing: not named directly; the territory is linked only through Wintermark's wider national winds.

Hercynia.t: Mentioned in passing: its citizens are flagged as interested in the contracts offered by the City of Gold and Lead.

Holberg.t: The League reached out to the Sand Fishers living on Holberg's northern shores, and the Senator for Holberg is among those expecting visitors in Anvil.

Kahraman.t: Mentioned in passing: its constant invasions by the Lasambrians are cited as a reason for the Freeborn's sense of vulnerability.

Kallavesa.t: The Meeting Place in West Marsh was consecrated with true liao, and an Iontach was rescued from the Grendel in Wittal Grove. The people of Kallavesa are also flagged in offers from Sadogua and Ephisis.

Karov.t: The port of Korotny in Malimorzi is one possible site for the Varushkan wardenhouse of the proposed Blades of the Semmerlak.

Liathaven.t: Mentioned in passing: anyone with an interest in Liathaven/Ashvale is pointed to a mildly irritating development with a former Imperial territory.

Madruga.t: Night magic brought dreams of vanished forests, and one of two Imperial armies claiming the Siroc Bayou and Crucible has disappeared. The Snapping Face was retrieved, and the fate of a stranded Sumaah ship remains unclear.

Mareave.t: The Saltbound Stone was recovered from the Ruins of Sinat and the Grendel were poisoned in Fleisardh. Moves were made towards building a temple to the Way in neutral Beoraidh.

Miaren.t: With the Temple of the Waking Dream complete, Seren has become the City of Dreams and draws dreamers and displaced Thornsong apothecaries.

Mitwold.t: Jyll Longleys was stopped from cursing the Maiden Stone and Dusty Cobb from burning the Golden Fields, as Imperial steel swept through the territory.

Morrow.t: Mentioned in passing: people with congregations in Morrow are flagged as interested in Gelberg's appraisal.

Mountains of the Moon.t: Tsark's Sage's Council has warmed to the idea of Prosperity, and the adept Camilla seeks inspirational Imperial figures to learn from.

Mournwold.t: The Imperial Breadbasket was expanded into the Mournwold, whose orcs welcomed League pilgrims. The General Assembly must now decide on consecrating Rebellion's Ridge as a memorial.

Necropolis.t: The waters of Siakha were spilled at the Veiled Garden and the bucket returned to Anvil, and local congregations are flagged in Gelberg's appraisal.

Ossium.t: Night magic from the Wondrous Forest brought mixed blessings amid lurking monsters, and an Unshackled delegation met the Dreamers of the Dark Forest. A curse on Ossium was prevented at Burned Glade, and Bittershore is a candidate wardenhouse site.

Otkodov.t: The Thule of Otkodov keep an uneasy peace with the Empire and are negotiating deals, including over upcoming events in Ossium.

Redoubt.t: Every Grendel at Isaac's End in Naris was killed. Redoubt congregations are also flagged in connection with Gelberg's appraisal.

Reikos.t: Grendel pushed Imperials out of Couros Field and kidnapped Professor Gelberg. Thornsong apothecaries who fled to Reikos are behind the new college proposal.

Sarangrave.t: Husks remain in the east after spirits at the Fens of Varreth went untrapped, and famine and the Kroll loom. Wards were cast in Bloodwater Marsh, but vallornspawn persist in Bendol.

Segura.t: Mentioned in passing: noted as only recently enjoying quiet after nearly two decades of warfare.

Semmerholm.t: Lacuve near Lacre is a candidate site for the Dawnish knightly estate of the Blades of the Semmerlak, and its senator proposed the Journeymage Towers.

Spiral.t: The Silver Flame of Cinion abandoned its fane for Sinokenon and now asks for farm rituals in return for defending Spiral. Mercenaries' pay at Alba's Lea was raided, with ten wains of mithril claimed.

Tassato.t: Heralds of Siakha and wreckers were killed at Campo Verdenta, and the Senator for Tassato is among those expecting visitors in Anvil.

The Barrens.t: Prilak Gutdredger and the manticore's vassals were killed, Lenna Karass was rescued, and Ser Gawain Amboise's schemes were thwarted. Most of the Servants of the Burnt survived.

The Semmerlak.t: The reappraised Blades of the Semmerlak would create a sodality and a Knight-Warden title to remove the threat of Dho'uala to ships and lakeside communities.

Therunin.t: Agramant still lurks in Therunin with a new offer to aid its reconquest. The miasma pillar at Rotwood Croft was consecrated, and the loss of Thornsong House is recalled.

Tsirku.t: Wintermark-led scouts continued exploring Tsirku, where Agramant's follower Wemba the Bloody is loose and further surprises await.

Upwold.t: Magistrates found no evidence for the rumour that Brother Orchard had put heads on pikes in the Upwold.

Volodmartz.t: The Sumisev Peegel in Livardz was destroyed with Wind of Mundane Silence.

Weirwater.t: Sandling near Culwich is a candidate site for the Dawnish knightly estate of the Blades of the Semmerlak.

Zenith.t: Eleven Imperials are invited to the Gardens of the Perfect World to speak on inspirational figures of Prosperity before the Tsarkoi.

388YE Autumn Equinox winds of war.d: As Summer faded, the Strong Reeds rose against the Jotun in Bregasland. Imperial and Grendel armies kept fighting over Mareave while Beoraidh looked on. The Golden Axe entered Therunin's poisoned Tarn Valley, and the Axou of Thornfen guarded the Sarangrave against Winter spirits. Four battle opportunities were offered, two to be chosen by the Military Council: Mareave against the Grendel, the Forest of Ulnak, Bregasland and the Salt Flats of Sanath. Conjunctions spanned the Empire, from Janon heralds cursing territories to Mirk Lizards and coral husks. Six conjunctions targeted small Druj raiding bands in tunnels, set on poisoning wells, sabotaging a mine and undermining a fortress.

Dawn.t: Dawn brought the second-largest force weight (66). The Strategos of Dawn was charged with stopping Druj well-poisoners at Endsfell, and Dawnish armies could use Triumphant Charge but not Steady Conquest against the Druj until Summer 389YE.

Druj.t: The Druj grew desperate as Imperial armies pushed into the Mallum, sending small suicidal raiding bands through tunnels to poison wells, burn and sabotage. They also faced battle opportunities in the Forest of Ulnak and the Salt Flats of Sanath.

Grendel.t: Grendel armies continued their long struggle with the Empire for Mareave. The Collapse the Tunnels battle opportunity was offered against them at Syagrian Haven in Icarion.

Highguard.t: Highguard's Strategos was tasked with dealing with a strange, ghost-haunted Druj incursion beneath an abandoned chapterhouse in Reikos, and a mysterious tomb in Necropolis was to be investigated. Highborn armies carried special rules, including a penalty for calling eternal heralds to fight alongside them.

Imperial Orcs.t: Mentioned in passing: listed with a force weight of 6 for the battle opportunities and noted as able to take the Forge Hammers order in Skarsind.

Jotun.t: The Jotun faced a Marcher uprising in Bregasland after holding it for some time. They were the opposition for the Treat with Enemies battle opportunity, and conjunctions sought to intercept their supplies.

Navarr.t: With a force weight of 56, Navarr featured in Therunin, where heroes could rescue the popular guide Idwynn Summersong from Druj raiders. Druj raiders also threatened the water of Caedwynn's Hold, the new Navarr Wayhouse in the Barrens.

The Brass Coast.t: Freeborn titles were made responsible for several conjunctions, from stopping Janon heralds cursing Kahraman to raids in Bregasland. The Burning Falcon and Fire of the South carried special order rules tied to the Knights of Glory enchantment.

The Marches.t: The Strong Reeds rose with their allies to try to free Bregasland from the Jotun. Marcher armies kept their strength bonuses in their home territories, and any Imperial army could billet in Mitwold, Mournwold or Upwold.

Thule.t: Mentioned in passing: Imperial soldiers in the north were said to fight alongside the blue-swaddled warlocks of Otkodov, who pursued their own inscrutable goals.

Urizen.t: Urizen interests centred on the Sarangrave, where the Axou of Thornfen guarded the territory and Druj raiders sought to undermine the Tower of the Skink. A cluster of conjunctions also opened in Zenith's Occursion region, and the borders of Morrow and Zenith remained patrolled by their citizens.

Varushka.t: The Golden Axe ventured into Therunin's poisoned Tarn Valley, and the Strategos of Varushka had to stop Druj saboteurs in Ossium's mithril mine. Bandits troubled the Bittershore and Mirk Lizards troubled Karsk.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark brought the largest force weight (69) and kept its special rules for fighting the Jotun honourably. Conjunctions in Kallavesa dealt with strange coral husks, and another in Sermersuaq was a chance to attend the Festival of Autumn's Easing.

388YE Autumn Equinox winds of war.o: The Autumn Equinox 388YE summary of military activity pointed to Winds of War in Bregasland, Mareave, Therunin, Sarangrave, the Salt Flats of Sanath and the Mallum. It also listed four battle opportunities, dozens of Sentinel Gate conjunctions and a wave of desperate Druj tunnel raids.

Bregasland/Gravenmarch.t: Janon heralds attempted to curse Bregasland from Graven Commons, and the General of the Burning Falcon was responsible for stopping them.

Bregasland/Grey Fens.t: Conjunctions offered the chance to intercept Jotun supplies at Old Jill's Fallow and to claim the wealth of the yegarra on the Short New South Road.

Bregasland/North Fens.t: The Treat with Enemies battle opportunity against the Jotun was offered at Whelkquay.

Bregasland/Ottermire.t: Heroes could find out what happened to missing scouts at Potter's Beach and defeat the yegarra at Bella's Bluff.

Forest of Ulnak/Ghul'thak Forest.t: Two conjunctions sent heroes to kill Mirk Lizards at the Butcher Glade and the Razor Thicket.

Forest of Ulnak/Grimfen Mire.t: The Clear the Retreat battle opportunity against the Druj was offered at Reeth Plain.

Kahraman/Braydon's Jasse.t: Janon heralds sought to curse Kahraman from Uthman's Field, with the Azure Sutannir responsible for a response.

Kallavesa/Kallavesa Marsh.t: The Remembrancer of Blood and Salt was responsible for hunting down and destroying lurking coral husks at Freja's Rest.

Kallavesa/West Marsh.t: The Raven Seer was responsible for investigating strange coral husks at the Westerhal Fens.

Karsk/Moresvah.t: Heroes could kill Mirk Lizards in the Mirky Vale.

Mareave/Beoraidh.t: The neutral city-state of Beoraidh looked on as Imperial and Grendel armies clashed around it.

Mareave/Icarion.t: The Collapse the Tunnels battle opportunity against the Grendel was offered at Syagrian Haven.

Mitwold/Oddmire.t: William Guildenstern was named to lead a small party to recover an artifact from Sod's Spelunk.

Necropolis/Coursmouth.t: A mysterious secluded tomb awaited investigation by a party under Danika Valentine.

Ossium/Bittershore.t: Bandits plagued the region, with conjunctions to deal justice at Holstein's Vale, spring a trap at Zhokhov's End and aid an injured patrol at Whisper Copse.

Ossium/Echofell.t: Druj raiders used an old tunnel to sabotage the Vale of Sunless Depths. Failure would kill scores of miners, permanently raise upkeep and cut mithril output by two wains a season until Summer 389YE.

Reikos/Chalcis Mount.t: Druj were discovered in the abandoned underground chapterhouse of Elsbeth's Aegis at Nikal's Redoubt, in a strange encounter where at least one ghost was present.

Salt Flats of Sanath/Lower Saarnath.t: The Break the Shackles battle opportunity was offered at Rivenglade. Conjunctions targeted Huk'nar Skintwister, the Chain of the Hammerwright and Druj poisoners who could cost the Citadel Guard 200 lives.

Sarangrave/Kroll.t: Two conjunctions sent heroes to interact with the sac of Kroll at Snaring Marsh and Shifting Gulch.

Sarangrave/Nesustak Forest.t: The Imperial Spymaster was responsible for identifying and executing a Druj spy at Gizzard's Meadow.

Sarangrave/Thornfen.t: The Axou of Thornfen guarded the territory against Winter spirits, while Druj raiders tried to undermine the Tower of the Skink. Failure to stop them would confine the Axou garrison to this region for the season.

Sarangrave/Turan Flats.t: Eighty heroes under the Senator for Sarangrave could destroy a column at Tercia's Bluff.

Sermersuaq/Tanikipari.t: The Festival of Autumn's Easing was held at the Shaore of Atkonaroq, with the Mediator of Hyljehal responsible for the visit.

The Barrens/Murderdale.t: Druj raiders in the caves of Endsfell sought to poison groundwater serving Caedwynn's Hold. Wealthy locals offered four thrones if they were stopped.

The Barrens/Saltmarsh.t: Janon heralds sought to curse the Barrens from the Glade of the Rising Sun.

Therunin/East Ashes.t: Eskah Swift Hart was named to meet with Dochas Weeping Glade at the Weeping Glade.

Therunin/Lower Tarn Valley.t: The Golden Axe ventured into this poisoned valley. Druj raiders held the Navarr guide Idwynn Summersong hostage in Slatefair Cave, and his rescue would lift Navarr morale.

Zenith/Occursion.t: Seven conjunctions opened here, covering Prosperous inspiration for Tsark, killing Disciples of Sulemaine, fighting bandits and creatures, and helping injured and malaised sentinels.

Bregasland.t: The Strong Reeds and their allies rose against the Jotun occupiers in a season of mud, blood and manacles. A battle opportunity to treat with the enemy was offered here, along with conjunctions against Janon heralds, Jotun supplies and the yegarra.

Forest of Ulnak.t: The Clear the Retreat battle opportunity was offered against the Druj at Reeth Plain, and conjunctions sent heroes to kill Mirk Lizards in Ghul'thak Forest.

Kahraman.t: Janon heralds threatened to curse Kahraman, and the Azure Sutannir was responsible for organising heroes to stop them.

Kallavesa.t: Strange coral husks were lurking in Kallavesa's marshes, with conjunctions to investigate them and to hunt them down.

Karsk.t: A conjunction sent heroes under Romand Reinetova Remislav to kill Mirk Lizards in Moresvah.

Liathaven.t: Mentioned in passing: Liathaven is not discussed directly; the page refers only to the Jotun placing their stamp on conquered land such as Ashvale.

Mareave.t: Imperial and Grendel armies kept clashing over the land that was once Mahal while Beoraidh looked on. The Collapse the Tunnels battle opportunity was offered at Syagrian Haven.

Mitwold.t: Imperial armies could billet in Mitwold, the Drakes gained strength fighting here, and a small conjunction sought to recover an artifact from Sod's Spelunk.

Morrow.t: Morrow's borders remained patrolled by its citizens, so the Druj needed 25 victory points to claim a beachhead, and Highborn or Urizen armies attacking from it into Zenith gained bonuses.

Mournwold.t: Mentioned in passing: listed as a territory where any Imperial army could billet and where the Tusks gained extra strength.

Necropolis.t: A conjunction led by Danika Valentine was offered to investigate a mysterious secluded tomb at Coursmouth.

Ossium.t: Druj raiders tried to sabotage the Vale of Sunless Depths, and bandits troubled the Bittershore. The territory's borders remained patrolled by its citizens.

Otkodov.t: Mentioned in passing: the warlocks of Otkodov were described as battling alongside Imperial soldiers in the north for their own inscrutable goals.

Redoubt.t: Mentioned in passing: Redoubt itself is not discussed on this page.

Reikos.t: A puzzling band of Druj, far from their lands, was found in an abandoned underground chapterhouse haunted by at least one ghost. The Strategos of Highguard was charged with dealing with them.

Salt Flats of Sanath.t: The Empire pushed forward into depthless dark here, with a Sunday battle opportunity against the Druj and conjunctions to kill Huk'nar Skintwister, recover the Chain of the Hammerwright and stop aquifer poisoners.

Sarangrave.t: The Axou of Thornfen protected the territory from Winter spirits loosed by collapsing armies. Conjunctions targeted a Druj column, a Druj spy, the sac of Kroll and raiders beneath the Tower of the Skink.

Sermersuaq.t: Fifty citizens could travel to Tanikipari to attend the Festival of Autumn's Easing.

Skarsind.t: Mentioned in passing: noted as where an Imperial Orc army can take the Forge Hammers order.

The Barrens.t: Janon heralds threatened to curse the Barrens, and Druj raiders sought to poison wells near Caedwynn's Hold. Citizen patrols kept the Druj threshold for a beachhead at 25 victory points.

Therunin.t: The Golden Axe ventured into the poisoned Tarn Valley still held by isolated Druj. Druj raiders took Navarr hostages, and a meeting with Dochas Weeping Glade was offered.

Upwold.t: Mentioned in passing: listed as a territory where any Imperial army could billet and where the Bounders gained extra strength.

Zenith.t: A string of conjunctions in Occursion dealt with bandits, creatures, Disciples of Sulemaine and malaised sentinels. The territory's borders remained patrolled against Druj beachheads.

388YE Autumn Faraden ambassador briefing.d: The Faraden priest families feared renewed Synod persecution of the faith of the five flames, even though the proscription had been repealed. As a result, the proposed Firewind and Moonsong markets were to be treated as on hold, and Yakholme Grange risked becoming a yak market with no yaks. The Tseriyn and Salagiin families, who supply mithril to the Alder of Meade and ilium to the Mediator of Fisk, were under pressure to reconsider their ties. Assembly statements were suggested to reassure them, and the Azure Sutannir might also help, as fewer Faraden pilgrims were attending the Azure Chorus. Faraden had signed peace with the Jotun because Imperial and Suranni support could not be relied upon. The Asaveans had recalled their diplomats over Tomasso Triusti's execution.

Dawn.t: The proposed Moonsong Market in the Barrens, a Dawnish territory, was to be considered on hold until Faraden fears over Synod persecution were resolved.

Jotun.t: The Jotun had signed a peace treaty with Faraden at the Summer Solstice. Under it, neither side would fight the other, borders stayed as they were, and trade provisions were agreed. The Jotun could still take a tithe from Faraden caravans but could not forbid them other routes.

The League.t: The proposed Firewind Market in the League's territory of Holberg was put on hold amid Faraden fears about Synod interference with their traders.

The Marches.t: Two Marcher interests were exposed: the Alder of Meade's mithril supply was under pressure, and Yakholme Grange might lose its Faraden buyers. The civil service suggested that the Marcher assembly reiterate Sister Meredith's earlier statement of principle, while warning that urging defiance of Synod proscriptions would widen the Marches' rift with the General Assembly.

Wintermark.t: The briefing named Wintermark alongside the Marches as a nation whose assembly might be asked to urge people to ignore persecution of Faraden travellers. It warned that this would deepen Wintermark's distance from the General Assembly and could trigger a legal crisis.

388YE Autumn Faraden ambassador briefing.o: The civil service prepared this Autumn 388YE briefing for Mina i Yashum i Riqueza, Ambassador to Faraden. It warned that the Synod's proscription against Justice had damaged Faraden confidence in the Empire, and it reported the new Faraden–Jotun peace treaty and the Asavean withdrawal from Faraden.

Kallavesa/Wittal Grove.t: Mentioned in passing: Wittal Grove is not named on the page, which refers to Wintermark only in general terms.

Holberg.t: The Faraden proposal to build Firewind Market in Holberg was to be considered on hold, as there was no guarantee it would attract Faraden traders in the current climate.

Kallavesa.t: Mentioned in passing: Kallavesa is not named on the page, which refers to Wintermark only in general terms.

Mitwold.t: The Tseriyn family's supply of mithril, bought in Caitun for the market at Meade, was at risk of being reduced as the family came under pressure to reconsider its ties with the Empire.

Reinos.t: Under the new treaty, Faraden caravans will still pay a tithe to pass through Reinos but may use another route if one becomes available. Imperial reluctance to help conquer Reinos was a key reason Faraden chose peace with the Jotun.

The Barrens.t: The Faraden proposal to build Moonsong Market in the Barrens was to be considered on hold until the religious tensions were resolved.

Upwold.t: Construction of Yakholme Grange was still underway, and the Hakhandra family remained keen on Marcher cattle. However, a worsening situation could leave the Empire with a yak market with no yaks.

388YE Autumn Grendel ambassador briefing.d: Prepared for Starlight Starchaser of Urizen, who was succeeded during the summit by Damian den Mhuir di Tassato-Mestra of the League, the briefing relayed Speaker Morna's responses. The Salt Lords refused to let Imperial forces occupy Ayereed but were less definitive about Mareave, where the Fundindelve mithril mine and the Fleisardh-supported Brine Turtles are likely sticking points. Morna suggested a Senate law admitting Grendel pilgrims to sites honouring Barabbas, the Kraken's Bane and newly consecrated Elos might prompt reciprocal invitations, though the civil service warned of espionage. He proposed both sides build embassies in Beoraidh, with the Salt Lords paying for the Imperial one, and asked after the missing iontach Leagsaidh Saim-garoth. Without funding, no further briefings can be prepared.

Grendel.t: The Salt Lords rejected the Empire's demands over Mareave and Ayereed, but offered to fund a matching Imperial embassy in Beoraidh, hinted at reciprocal pilgrimages, and demanded word on their missing healer Leagsaidh Saim-garoth.

Highguard.t: Highguard's Necropolis, home to the tomb of Barabbas, was named as a likely destination for Grendel pilgrims, which the civil service warned could also provide cover for Grendel spies.

The Brass Coast.t: The Brass Coast's Madruga was named among the territories Grendel pilgrims would visit, with the consecration of Elos having left Speaker Morna surprisingly positive, though the civil service warned of espionage risks.

The League.t: Damian den Mhuir di Tassato-Mestra of the League took over as Ambassador to the Grendel during the summit, and the Salt Lords showed little enthusiasm for an embassy in the League city of Sarvos.

Urizen.t: Starlight Starchaser of Urizen presented the proposals as ambassador before being succeeded at the summit, and Urizen's Redoubt was named among the territories Grendel pilgrims might be allowed to visit.

388YE Autumn Grendel ambassador briefing.o: A civil service briefing for the Imperial Ambassador to the Grendel, presented at the Autumn Equinox 388YE, reported that the Salt Lords rejected calls to cede Mareave and Ayereed, floated reciprocal pilgrimages and proposed both powers build embassies in neutral Beoraidh.

Mareave/Beoraidh.t: Speaker Morna proposed that both the Empire and the Grendel build embassies in neutral Beoraidh, an idea Ehsan reportedly embraced to secure his city-state's status and prestige.

Mareave/Fleisardh.t: The Fleisardh sept supports the Grendel army the Brine Turtles, whose future would likely need resolving before the Grendel would consider giving up Mareave.

Ayereed.t: The Salt Lords declared there was absolutely no chance they would allow Imperial forces to occupy Ayereed, calling the request ludicrous.

Madruga.t: Madruga was listed among the territories Grendel pilgrims might freely visit under a proposed Senate law, a prospect the civil service warned would ease Grendel espionage there.

Mareave.t: The Grendel refused to cede Mareave but left the door ajar for negotiation, with the Fundindelve mithril mine and the Brine Turtles likely central, while an iontach healer went missing after Summer fighting there tied to an Uthni contract.

Necropolis.t: The tomb of Barabbas made Necropolis a proposed pilgrimage destination for Grendel, with the civil service cautioning that pilgrims could provide cover for spies.

Redoubt.t: Redoubt was named among the territories Grendel pilgrims might visit if the Senate passed a pilgrimage law, raising concerns about Grendel espionage there.

Sarvos.t: Speaker Morna was notably unenthusiastic about an Imperial offer to build a Grendel embassy in Sarvos, which the civil service took as a sign the Salt Lords now fear Imperial espionage.

388YE Autumn Iron Confederacy ambassador.d: With the Children of Wrecks dealt with, Baroness Lavasse sent Ser Marquette and Marquise Katerine Lavasse to Anvil to negotiate a treaty, which the Senate ratified. Talks were expected to cover Suranni holdings in the Brass Coast, which they would not surrender, and their invasion of the Lasambrian Hills. The dukes offered Imperial warbands a chance to fight alongside Baron Hendrick in Reinos, possibly as a test. Duke Harold Guiscard asked for help against the Hand of Dumon after a further curse on Kalino. Baroness Lavasse asked about Brother Luke, who was later fined ten thrones and branded, an outcome the Suranni may see as a miscarriage of justice.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: Grendel is not named, but Arbonne is described as a wealthy province next to its territory of Feroz.

Jotun.t: Three Jotun armies of the Lasambrian Hills were reportedly putting up significant resistance to the Suranni invasion, which threatened the Hierro and the Corazón. The dukes invited Imperial warbands to fight against them, and the civil service warned of the Suranni's poor record with captured orcs.

The Brass Coast.t: The Iron Confederacy's holdings in the Brass Coast were expected to feature in treaty talks, though the Suranni had made clear they would not give up conquered land. The Freeborn Synod assembly was judged too distracted by its highest calling to help against the Hand of Dumon.

388YE Autumn Iron Confederacy ambassador.o: This civil service briefing was prepared for Tethros i Zuhri i Erigo, Ambassador to the Iron Confederacy, at the Autumn Equinox 388YE. It covered a Suranni treaty delegation, an offer for Imperial warbands to fight in Reinos, the Hand of Dumon in Kalino, and a Suranni inquiry about Brother Luke.

Madruga/Free Landing.t: Brother Luke was accused of encouraging Imperial fleet captains to aid the Children of Wrecks in Free Landing. That accusation prompted Baroness Lavasse to ask what had become of him.

Feroz.t: Mentioned in passing: Arbonne is noted as lying next to Feroz and controlling the overland trade routes into the heart of the Empire.

Kalino.t: Known to the Suranni as Arbonne, Kalino was cursed again by the Hand of Dumon. A warding temple built partly with Imperial ilium spared the Autumn harvest, and Duke Harold Guiscard sought Imperial help to find the culprits.

Madruga.t: The Suranni conquests here were expected to come up in treaty negotiations, but the Iron Confederacy remained unwilling to give up land it had taken.

Reinos.t: The Suranni were trying to conquer the Reinos hills against stiff Jotun resistance. The dukes offered Imperial warbands the chance to fight there alongside the brutal Baron Hendrick of the Black Eagle Banner, with a warning that obviously magical forces would anger the Suranni.

388YE Autumn Jarmish ambassador briefing.d: Lord-Magister Anton Trescher praised the Empire for revealing that Commonwealth agents caused Lantir's destruction. The revelation forced the Commonwealth to accept a Jarmish ceasefire. Trescher proposed that a Senate denunciation of the Commonwealth during the Equinox would likely see Vezak and Kavor reopened to Imperial fleets, provided the Senate lifted its own embargo on Jarmish trade. The House of Princes invited Imperial mercenaries to fight Cold Sun. At least 10,000 effective strength would shorten the campaign by a season. The end of trade with Radosmo drew little reaction beyond Prince Mila, who sought to sell Jarmish goods through the City of Gold and Lead. The Celestial Arch and Sevenfold Path remained tolerated in Jarm, though Trescher had begun asking about the Path.

The League.t: Mentioned in passing: the page raises no League matters, and its only apparent link is that the briefing was prepared for Ambassador Thaumiel of Steeplechase Toll.

388YE Autumn Jarmish ambassador briefing.o: At the Autumn Equinox 388YE the Ambassador to Jarm, Thaumiel of Steeplechase Toll, was briefed on Jarmish reactions to the Empire exposing Commonwealth agents behind the Cold Sun incursion at Lantir. The briefing also covered an invitation for Imperial mercenaries, trade with Zemelslo, and the work of the Celestial Arch and Sevenfold Path in Jarm.

Spiral.t: Mentioned in passing: Spiral is not named; its only apparent link is the name of the Ambassador, Thaumiel of Steeplechase Toll, for whom the briefing was prepared.

388YE Autumn Sarcophan ambassador briefi.d: Annabele de Gouden of the House of the Jackal needs 70 thrones of investment to keep supplying triumph vis and star jewels, and would welcome a trading sodality like the Court of Far Horizons. The Kraft brothers have withdrawn from Hahnmark, ending easy access to vizesmaak, while the Zuredruiven vintners invest in its herb gardens; 5 thrones could secure a sample of an unshared third draaikolkbloem potion. Scholar Catharina Gjullit seeks vallorn-related goods, prompting Sarcophan safety concerns. The Synod's reputation in the Delves is wrecked after Highborn sold religious sculpture, and restoring the Cathedral would be very costly. The Ilium Jackals must be paid by the Boyar's Hasta's general, or passed to the Wolves of War or the Magpies.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: if the Ilium Jackals go unpaid they may seek work around the Bay of Catazar, possibly returning to fight for the Grendel.

Highguard.t: Highborn benefactors' sale of religious sculpture to a heretical Sarcophan group has turned Sarcophan pilgrims against the Synod, and Highguard's plan to send priests to rebuild the Cathedral of the Navigators is regarded by the Sarcophan as a lost cause.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark loses the Kraft brothers' investment and easy access to vizesmaak, but gains Zuredruiven investment in Hahnmark's herb gardens, though the vintners have not shared a third draaikolkbloem potion with Wintermark apothecaries.

388YE Autumn Sarcophan ambassador briefi.o: A civil service briefing was presented to Dino i Riqueza, Ambassador to the Sarcophan Delves, at the Autumn Equinox 388YE, covering trade partners, Sarcophan investors in Hahnmark, the collapse of the Cathedral of the Navigators' reputation, and the Ilium Jackals' mercenary contract.

Bay of Catazar.t: Mentioned in passing: an unpaid Ilium Jackals company would look for other work in the environs of the Bay of Catazar.

Hahnmark.t: Having cut ties with the Kraft brothers in Spring, Hahnmark's farmers saw them withdraw their investment, while the Zuredruiven vintners invest enthusiastically in its herb gardens to grow draaikolkbloem.

388YE Autumn Sumaah ambassador briefing.d: The Republic will answer the Empire's mercantilist tariffs with its own on Imperial imports, felt by the Winter Solstice. Oxtitocszin judged the Wandering Port's prices too high and offered 3 thrones 1 crown a wain for weirwood, 3 thrones 6 crowns for mithril, or one-for-one trades in white granite, for up to 100 wains bought through heralds of the Polyptoton at the Winter Solstice. The High House of Vigilance offered to assess Imperial rituals drawing on eternals; the Conclave instead invited the High House of Wisdom to work with the Celestial Arch. The Commonwealth has effectively left the Liberty Pact, alarming Sumaah. The Cardinal of Prosperity asked why the two Synods differ over Zemress.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: the Cardinal of Prosperity notes that even the Grendel recognise Zemress's inspiration, though in a manner the Sumaah call twisted, heretical and blasphemous.

388YE Autumn Sumaah ambassador briefing.o: At the Autumn Equinox 388YE, Ambassador Accalon of Felix's Watch received a briefing on relations with the Sumaah Republic, covering retaliatory tariffs, a proposed purchase of weirwood and mithril, a Sumaah offer to review Imperial eternal rituals, Sumaah anxiety over the Liberty Pact after the Commonwealth's withdrawal, and questions about Zemress of the Isles.

Bay of Catazar.t: Mentioned in passing: Zemress of the Isles is described as an inspirational figure to many across the Bay of Catazar, especially sailors, corsairs and merchants.

388YE Autumn Thule ambassador briefing.d: The Thule hired Imperial mercenaries for their campaign against the Druj in the Forest of Ulnak but received no Military Council support. They understood this was because the Dragons had offered the Empire too little incentive. Disappointed, though too proud to say so, they negotiated a two-season treaty with the Druj freezing current borders. They appear to have gained some or all of what they sought, and they deliberately kept the treaty short, expecting the Druj to want to extend it. The civil service noted that coordinating magic in shared territories would be imperfect, and warned that asking permission could create grievances. Runa Who-Speaks-For-The-Dragons-Undivided said the masters of Otkodov would handle the Circle of Zulgan Tash, the Painted Caves and the Malachite Casket themselves.

Druj.t: The Druj agreed a two-season peace treaty with the Thule that freezes their shared borders in the Forest of Ulnak, and the Thule expect them to be eager to extend it.

Thule.t: Disappointed by the lack of Imperial military support, the Dragons secured a short, deliberately limited peace with the Druj. They also told the Empire they would deal with the Circle of Zulgan Tash themselves, as a matter for wizards rather than diplomats.

Varushka.t: Mentioned in passing: Ossium, a Varushkan-held territory, is used as an example of where casting Hand of the Dhomiro against Thule wishes could cause offence.

388YE Autumn Thule ambassador briefing.o: An ambassadorial briefing presented at the Autumn Equinox 388YE to Kindra Surefoot, Ambassador to Otkodov, reported that the Thule had agreed a six-month peace treaty with the Druj in Ulnak and that the Dragons would deal personally with the Circle of Zulgan Tash. It also offered guidance on coordinating magic in territories shared with the Thule.

Forest of Ulnak.t: Fighting between the Thule and the Druj was halted by a treaty freezing the current borders in Ulnak for two seasons.

Miekarova.t: Mentioned in passing: not named directly; it is relevant only through the general guidance on coordinating magic in territories shared with the Thule.

Ossium.t: Mentioned in passing: cited as a hypothetical case where the Empire performing Hand of the Dhomiro against Thule wishes would anger them more than not asking at all.

Otkodov.t: The masters of Otkodov announced they would personally resolve the matter of the Circle of Zulgan Tash, the Painted Caves and the Malachite Casket. They gave only an assurance that their response would be for the best and in line with existing treaties.

Verthandi.t: Mentioned in passing: listed in the further reading as a territory in Otkodov.

388YE Spring Equinox Imperial elections.d: Senators were returned for Holberg, Karsk, Mareave, Mournwold, Reikos, Sarangrave, Segura and the Barrens. The Senate appointed ambassadors, an Imperial Spymaster, an Advisor on Orc Affairs and several generals. The Synod elected cardinals, inquisitors and many religious stewards, with Hazelelponi taking the Lepidean Librarian title on 312 votes. The Military Council named the Imperial Fleet Master, the Imperial Huntsmarshall and the Strategos of Highguard. Conclave orders chose grandmasters, the Archmage of Spring and Gloaming Sentinel were declared, and the Bourse saw titles auctioned and voted, including Custodian of the Assayer's Guild for Javor de Holburg on 856 votes.

Dawn.t: The Barrens, held by Dawn, returned Lady Gwendoloena de Ordraig as its senator.

Druj.t: Mentioned in passing: Sarangrave, held by the Druj at the time, still saw an Imperial senator, Bartimaeus, elected for it.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: Mareave, held by the Grendel at the time, still saw an Imperial senator, Pathfinder Gaddak, elected for it.

Highguard.t: Highguard saw Solomon elected Senator for Reikos, and the Military Council appointed Arlandria of the Sentinels Tower as Strategos of Highguard.

The Brass Coast.t: Segura, held by the Brass Coast, returned Ana i Taziel i Riqueza as its senator.

The League.t: Holberg, held by the League, returned Kaspar Yakovich von Holberg as its senator.

The Marches.t: Mournwold, held by the Marches, returned Mel Bleak as its senator.

Varushka.t: Karsk, held by Varushka, returned Belakov Zakharovich Prochnost as its senator.

388YE Spring Equinox Imperial elections.o: The results of the Imperial elections held at the 388YE Spring Equinox summit were recorded, covering new senators for eight territories alongside a wide range of Senate, Synod, Military Council, Conclave, Bourse and other appointments.

Holberg.t: Kaspar Yakovich von Holberg was elected Senator for Holberg.

Karsk.t: Belakov Zakharovich Prochnost was elected Senator for Karsk.

Mareave.t: Pathfinder Gaddak was elected Senator for Mareave, though the territory was held by the Grendel at the time.

Mournwold.t: Mel Bleak was elected Senator for Mournwold.

Reikos.t: Solomon was elected Senator for Reikos.

Sarangrave.t: Bartimaeus was elected Senator for Sarangrave, though the territory was held by the Druj at the time.

Segura.t: Ana i Taziel i Riqueza was elected Senator for Segura.

The Barrens.t: Lady Gwendoloena de Ordraig was elected Senator for the Barrens.

388YE Spring Equinox Military Council or.d: Six armies went to Mitwold, led by the Drakes' Overwhelming Assault and the Golden Sun's Grinding Advance, to reopen Meade, now walled by the Jotun. Five armies took up Solid Defence of Sarangrave to shield the Mallum septs from the Vallorn's Greentide and the Druj Snake and Crane armies. In Mareave, the Summer Storm and Towerjacks defended while the Wolves of War and Argent Sword plundered the Grendel. The Northern Eagle worked to isolate Lower Saarnath ahead of a planned advance. Elsewhere, armies guarded Kallavesa against Fjorknae, raided and rested in Madruga, and many rested in Semmerholm, Zenith, Ossium, Bastion and Upwold.

Dawn.t: The Golden Sun made a Grinding Advance into Mitwold behind the Drakes, while the Eastern Sky and Lions of Adelmar returned home to defend Semmerholm and the Gryphon's Pride, under new general Sebastián Fawnwood, defended Ossium.

Druj.t: Three Imperial armies vowed to break the Druj Snake and Crane armies in Sarangrave, and the Northern Eagle set out to cut off Druj garrisons in Lower Saarnath.

Grendel.t: Grendel forces in Mareave faced two defending Imperial armies and plunder by the Wolves of War and Argent Sword, who aimed to strip them of their property and supplies.

Highguard.t: The Granite Pillar defended Sarangrave against the Vallorn, the Valiant Pegasus tended the fallen in Mitwold, the Pilgrim's Defiance resupplied at Virtue's Rest and the Seventh Wave rested in Zenith.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Summer Storm returned to defend Mareave from the Grendel, the Winter Sun withdrew to rest in Zenith and the Autumn Hammers made an Arcane Consolidation in Mitwold.

Jotun.t: Six Imperial armies moved against the Jotun-held walls of Meade in Mitwold, the Strong Reeds lay low in Jotun-held Bregasland, and two armies guarded Kallavesa against a Fjorknae attack.

Navarr.t: The Black Thorns defended Nesustak Forest in Sarangrave against the Vallorn's Greentide, while the Quiet Step rested and prepared in Zenith.

The Brass Coast.t: The Red Wind Corsairs raided the Siroc Bayou to begin retaking Madruga, the Fire of the South gave ground in Lightsea, and the Burning Falcon resupplied in Upwold.

The League.t: The Towerjacks defended Mareave alongside the Imperial Orcs, while the Wolves of War plundered Grendel baggage there to fund a later fight against the Broken Shore.

The Marches.t: The Drakes led an Overwhelming Assault to reclaim Meade in Mitwold, the Bounders watched the passes in the Mournwold, the Strong Reeds lay low in Bregasland and the Tusks defended Kallavesa.

Urizen.t: The Argent Sword plundered the Grendel in Mareave to reclaim Imperial Orc property, while the Citadel Guard defended Sarangrave against the remaining Druj armies.

Varushka.t: The Boyar's Hasta and Golden Axe defended Sarangrave against the Vallorn and Druj, while the Northern Eagle worked to isolate Lower Saarnath.

Wintermark.t: The Bloodcloaks recovered the lost and the Green Shield fought with honour in Mitwold, while the Narwhal's Spear guarded the gates of Kallavesa against Fjorknae.

388YE Spring Equinox Military Council or.o: At the Spring Equinox 388YE the Imperial generals issued orders to thirty armies, concentrating forces in Mitwold to retake Meade, in Sarangrave against the Druj and the waking Vallorn, and in Mareave against the Grendel.

Madruga/Lightsea.t: The Fire of the South gave ground in Lightsea to rest at Quzar, keeping watch on the sea.

Madruga/Siroc Bayou.t: The Red Wind Corsairs raided the Siroc Bayou to recover lost Freeborn wealth and begin retaking Madruga.

Mournwold/Chalkdowns.t: The Bounders watched the passes in the Chalkdowns, hunting brigands and Red Walder.

Salt Flats of Sanath/Lower Saarnath.t: The Northern Eagle set out to tear down bridges and block roads and passes to isolate Lower Saarnath's Druj garrisons.

Sarangrave/Nesustak Forest.t: The Black Thorns defended Nesustak Forest and its Mallum septs as the Vallorn's Greentide descended.

Astolat.t: Mentioned in passing: the Granite Pillar marched from Astolat to Sarangrave.

Bastion.t: The Pilgrim's Defiance resupplied at Virtue's Rest in Bastion.

Bregasland.t: The Strong Reeds lay low in Jotun-held Bregasland to harry the Jotun, while several other armies left the territory for Mitwold, Kallavesa, Madruga, the Mournwold and Upwold.

Feroz.t: Mentioned in passing: the Red Wind Corsairs set out from Feroz to raid Madruga.

Fjorknae.t: Mentioned in passing: Imperial armies in Kallavesa prepared for a possible attack from Fjorknae.

Hahnmark.t: Mentioned in passing: the Bloodcloaks marched from Hahnmark to Mitwold.

Holberg.t: Mentioned in passing: the Towerjacks' general recalled their thirty years holding Holberg's walls.

Kallavesa.t: The Tusks took up Solid Defence and the Narwhal's Spear guarded the gates of Kallavesa against any attack from Fjorknae.

Madruga.t: The Red Wind Corsairs made a Daring Raid on the Siroc Bayou while the Fire of the South gave ground in Lightsea.

Mareave.t: The Summer Storm and Towerjacks defended Mareave while the Wolves of War and Argent Sword plundered the Grendel there.

Mitwold.t: Six armies converged on Mitwold to retake Meade: the Drakes' Overwhelming Assault, Golden Sun's Grinding Advance and Green Shield, with the Valiant Pegasus, Autumn Hammers and Bloodcloaks in support.

Mournwold.t: The Bounders watched the passes in the Chalkdowns, guarding the Mourn while the Tusks were away.

Ossium.t: The Gryphon's Pride took up Solid Defence of Ossium to rest and recuperate under its new general.

Redoubt.t: Mentioned in passing: the Wolves of War, Argent Sword and Black Thorns all marched out of Redoubt, from which the slavers had fled.

Salt Flats of Sanath.t: The Northern Eagle worked to isolate Lower Saarnath, preparing for an Imperial invasion the following season.

Sarangrave.t: Five Imperial armies took up Solid Defence of Sarangrave to protect the Mallum septs from the Vallorn's Greentide and to break the Druj Snake and Crane armies.

Semmerholm.t: The Eastern Sky and Lions of Adelmar returned home to defend and rest in Semmerholm after a year in the Mallum.

Spiral.t: Mentioned in passing: the Towerjacks marched from Spiral to Mareave.

Therunin.t: Mentioned in passing: the Pilgrim's Defiance left Therunin, remembering its fallen there.

Upwold.t: The Burning Falcon made a Desperate Reinforcement in Upwold to rest and recover.

Zenith.t: The Seventh Wave, Winter Sun and Quiet Step all took up Solid Defence of Zenith to rest and recover.

388YE Spring Equinox Senate sessions.d: The treasury stood at 1726 thrones. The Senate acknowledged the Axou claim to Thornfen, subject to Urizen veto, and abrogated the Astral Arcanist. It created the Herald of the Throne of Glory and established the Cat's Graces sodality. It ratified a treaty returning the Spice Gardens of Feroz and declared that Nesustak Forest belongs to its rebels. Nine Senate commissions were enacted; a tenth, the Barrens Roads, lapsed. Announced works included the Delev Grand Market and several Hahnmark sinecures. Ambassadors were appointed to Otkodov, the Commonwealth, Faraden and the Sumaah Republic. The Imperial Spymaster authorised a raid on Leen and a Thule survey venture, and the Guerdon was set at 350 thrones.

Dawn.t: The Senate created the Herald of the Throne of Glory, appointed by the Dawnish Assembly, to organise the Dawnish National Assembly and crown the Monarch of Dawn. The Senate also commissioned the Mournwold expansion of the Breadbasket.

Druj.t: The Senate declared that the Nesustak Forest rebels had risen against the Druj by their own strength and named a conjunction to treat with them. The Spymaster ordered the smugglers' cove in the Druj-held Salt Flats of Sanath decommissioned after the raid on Leen.

Highguard.t: Cyrus of Ebon's Hall and Accalon of Highguard were appointed Ambassadors to the Commonwealth and the Sumaah Republic. Highguard's Lepidean Librarian began research into a possible new Varushkan exemplar.

Navarr.t: The Wisdom of the Tenebrous Path gained responsibility for guiding the Thorns of Navarr against eternals and other denizens of the realms. A Vallornguard Mustering Ground was commissioned in Holtford, Miaren.

Thule.t: The Spymaster authorised work with the Karass, letting military units survey Thule attempts to claim a Black Lotus plant. The surveying venture received shares of the Imperial Guerdon.

Urizen.t: The Empire conceded the Axou claim to Thornfen, including the Tower of the Skink, subject to a possible veto by the Urizen assembly. Xanthius Storm's End of Urizen became Guildmaster of the Artisans, and the Architects of Urizen self-funded the Eye of Heavens in Zenith.

Varushka.t: The people of Karov self-funded the Golden Bee Assayer's Office and the Delev Grand Market in Duzekani. Highguard's librarians were set to research Kvetmir Kvetmirovic as a possible new Varushkan exemplar.

Wintermark.t: Kindra Surefoot of Wintermark became Ambassador to Otkodov, and three new sinecures were announced in Hahnmark: the Garden of Peaceful Quietitude, Spooner's Rest and Runesmith's Caution. The Banner-bearer of Atkonaroq's remit was extended to aid those fighting the horrors of Tsirku.

388YE Spring Equinox Senate sessions.o: At the Spring Equinox 388YE the Imperial Senate passed a wide slate of motions. These included new and amended titles, a treaty with the Protectorate of Morajasse, a statement on the Nesustak Forest rebels, many commissions and several ambassadorial appointments.

Salt Flats of Sanath.t: The Imperial Spymaster announced that the smugglers' cove here would be decommissioned after the raid on Leen over the coming season.

Tsirku.t: The Banner-bearer of Atkonaroq was given the added responsibility of supporting and aiding those who fight the horrors of Tsirku.

388YE Spring Equinox Synod judgements.d: The General Assembly updated the Doctrine of Seven by greater majority and proscribed Theism, Realmism, ritual death offered to inhuman powers, labyrinth-spirit veneration and preaching against the Virtues, while excommunication with consent was decriminalised. A usury proscription failed. Many assemblies named highest callings, from the Grand Inspiration of the Way to Asavea, the vallorn and damaged territories. Priests urged aid for Therunin's refugees against Agramant, marked six years since the Black Plateau woke, and welcomed the Hallowed Bells pilgrimage. Mandates eased foreign units into Tsirku's wastes and let Dawn and Wintermark raise military units freely. Appointments included new Cardinals of Ambition and Vigilance, and the Virtue Fund made six rewards.

Dawn.t: The Dawnish Assembly condemned the Whisper Gallery, called knights to quest into the Untrod Groves once the Manticore is destroyed, and made aiding all nations against the vallorn its highest calling. A mandate let Dawnish resource owners convert to military units at no cost, and a Way Assembly rebuke of Dawnish 'Vengeance' failed.

Druj.t: The Courage Assembly made it its highest calling to study and counter Druj auras of fear and spiritually liberate the Sarangrave septs from their captors. Other judgements spoke of ending the buruk tepel's tyranny and offering refuge to Nesustak's septs.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: 22 thrones went to citizens who sacrificed to catch Grendel spies, a scheme foiled by three traitors, and a withdrawn judgement listed the Grendel among western-front foes.

Highguard.t: The Highborn Assembly urged its chapters and units to aid Navarri refugees fleeing Therunin and honoured the 20 Pilgrim's Defiance soldiers who fell defeating a vallorn abomination. It also called for reparations to the Imperial Orcs, mourned Olyvar of Esther's Sanctum and shaped plans for the Grand Inspiration of the Way.

Imperial Orcs.t: Bloodcrow Knott's words entered the Annals of the Ancestors and Firesong Galath became Guide to the Lost. The orcs pledged to join Varushka and Wintermark in Tsirku, Skywise Rykana was sent to seek lore of the Great Forest Orcs' ancestors, and Highguard's priests called for reparations to them.

Jotun.t: Mentioned in passing: Wintermark's priests cited reclaiming every slave the Jotun took in Sermersuaq, raiding Skallahn and breaking the Gates of Kierheim, and a Marcher friar noted the Jotun's repulse from the Mournwold.

Navarr.t: Navarr's mandate sent Teleri Thornweaver to rally Navarri support for the League's Vallornguard, backed by a Loyalty mandate. The assembly also urged Navarr to shelter Therunin refugees from Agramant, honoured the Pilgrim's Defiance, warned against threats to the Great Forest Orcs and asked Miaren's citizens to tend their bees.

The Brass Coast.t: Freeborn mandates celebrated profit-seekers, trailblazers and the firebrands' legacy, while the assembly backed the Burning Agora, trade with Morajasse and parleys with Heralds. Highest callings to defend the borders and enshrine contracts passed without the greater majority they need, and the Sail Bell proposal failed.

The League.t: The League Assembly made drawing new peoples into the League its highest calling and welcomed Navarri aid for the Vallornguard. It also welcomed the Tribunal of the Silver Flame's help mapping the City Below, backed a Bill of Mortality and encouraged its orcs to explore hearth magic for reaching the ancestors.

Thule.t: Mentioned in passing: Desilav Sergeyvich Jesen was praised for strengthening trade links with the Thule through tax cuts and food convoy routes.

Urizen.t: Urizen's assembly called its stargazers to seek weaknesses in the Sarangrave vallorn, offered refuge to the septs of Nesustak and accepted Silver Flame help mapping the City Below. Its veto of Thornfen's relinquishment to Axos failed, and a writ was granted for a flame on the docks of Elos.

Varushka.t: The Varushkan Assembly celebrated five years of a free Ossium, praised Mayra Zoronova Prochnost's support against the face-peelers and named Armand Remislav to destroy the Sumisev Peegel regio. A Highborn mandate was enacted to stop the decline of southern Varushka's bees, and the nation backed Wintermark's push into Tsirku.

Wintermark.t: Eisa Iron Lungs was entered into the Chronicle of Heroes, and Wintermark mandates eased other nations' units into the wastes, sent Sermersuaq's provisions to the Tsirku scouts and let owners raise military units freely. Priests also challenged the Agramant cultist Kaarina White-Eye, and the Speaker of the Crows election ended in a tie.

388YE Spring Equinox Synod judgements.o: At the Spring Equinox 388YE the Imperial Synod raised 179 judgements, most notably amending the Doctrine of Seven, adding several new proscriptions of heresy and idolatry, and declaring a wave of assembly 'highest callings'.

Reikos/Broken Ride.t: A writ of consecration to Vigilance was sought for the new edifice in Broken Ride honouring the Sodality of the Silent Bell, built with white granite from the Virtue Fund and Bryce the Hare, but it was not upheld.

Therunin/East Ashes.t: The Highborn Assembly asked that, once the vallorn infestation of East Ashes is cleared, the remains of the 20 Pilgrim's Defiance soldiers who fell there be recovered for the Stewards of the Dead.

Karsk.t: Mentioned in passing: Karsk is named in Mayra Zoronova Prochnost's commendation for backing the campaign against the face-peelers there, and its counting house received a Virtue Fund donation.

Madruga.t: The Vigilance Assembly declared that the tomb of the Ravadi Founders' Dance should be built in Madruga, where they made their last sacrifice and won their eventual victory.

Reikos.t: A writ of consecration to Vigilance for an edifice in Broken Ride honouring the Sodality of the Silent Bell was not upheld, and a Virtue Fund donation was recorded at the Reikos counting house.

Semmerholm.t: Mentioned in passing: a donation to the Virtue Fund was recorded at the counting house of Semmerholm.

Sermersuaq.t: A Wintermark mandate diverted surplus from the Smokehouse of Atalaq to supply the Tsirku scouting network, at a cost to Sermersuaq's farms. Wintermark's priests also challenged Kaarina White-Eye, a ringleader of the Agramant cults most active in Sermersuaq.

Tassato.t: Mentioned in passing: a donation to the Virtue Fund was recorded at the counting house of Tassato.

Therunin.t: Several assemblies urged help for Navarri refugees fleeing Therunin, so Agramant cannot pose as their only rescuer. Priests honoured the Pilgrim's Defiance soldiers who fell against a vallorn abomination there and looked to a day when Therunin is Navarri again.

Tsirku.t: A Wintermark mandate cut the penalty for units from other nations scouting or exploring Tsirku's wastes from three ranks to one, and Sermersuaq's provisions were committed to the scouting network. Varushka and the Imperial Orcs backed the exploration.

388YE Spring Equinox event schedule.d: Eight nations elected senators on Saturday afternoon in their own camps: Segura, The Barrens, Reikos, Mareave, Holberg, Mournwold, Sarangrave and Karsk. Tally of the Votes elections for national titles followed from 3:30pm for Highguard, Navarr, Varushka, the Imperial Orcs, Urizen, the Brass Coast, the League and Wintermark. The timetable listed Senate sessions, Military Council sessions, Field Marshal briefings, Conclave sessions, Synod deadlines and the Saturday and Sunday battles. It also included citizen-organised gatherings such as a Forum on the Iron Confederacy, a Weirwater Forum, Vallorn war discussions, the Tourney for the Rose Throne and a meeting of Hahnmark farmers.

Dawn.t: Dawn elected the senator for The Barrens at 2:30pm on Saturday, immediately after the tourney, and the schedule included a Dawnish Fleet Captains' Meeting and the Tourney for the Rose Throne.

Druj.t: Mentioned in passing: the Druj are not named, but the Sarangrave they held had its senator chosen by Urizen.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: the Grendel are not named, but the Mareave they held had its senator chosen by the Imperial Orcs.

Highguard.t: Highguard began its inquisition of candidates for the Reikos senator at 2:00pm and held Tally of the Votes elections in the Chapel for the Bursar of the House of Spirits, the Exarch of Virtue's Rest and the Steward of the Ossuary.

Imperial Orcs.t: Candidates for the Mareave senator began presenting items of worth at 2:15pm, and the Fire Pit hosted elections for the Steel Fist, the Bonesetter of Torfast Trading Post and the Sorrowful Tunnels.

Navarr.t: Navarr held a Tally of the Votes election for the Broker of Thorns at the Standing Circle at 3:30pm, with the next regular election due at the Winter Solstice 388YE.

The Brass Coast.t: The Brass Coast opened its auction for the Segura senator at 1:00pm and elected the Broken Shore Bounty, the Cerevado Nets and the Dhomiro of Afar at the Waypoint.

The League.t: The League elected the Holberg senator through the presentation of collected bonds at 3:30pm and chose the Custodian of the Assayer's Guild at the Plaza.

The Marches.t: Landowners of the Marches gathered at 1:30pm to elect the senator for Mournwold.

Urizen.t: Urizen held a demos for the Sarangrave senator from 1:00pm to 1:30pm and elected the Architect of Hammers. The schedule also included a Urizen Magician's Meeting and the Challenge of the Boards in the Urizen camp.

Varushka.t: Varushka began questioning candidates for the Karsk senator at 1:45pm and elected the Gift of the Dwindling Star, the Merchant Boyar of the Bittershore and the Custodian of Ivarsgard Docks at the Central Hearth.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark elected the Mediator of Wreck, the Talon of Kauppahall and the Mediator of Fisk at the Tree of Names, where a meeting of Hahnmark farmers was also held on Saturday evening.

388YE Spring Equinox event schedule.o: This was the published schedule for the Spring Equinox 388YE summit, setting out the times of senator elections, Tally of the Votes elections and the meetings held across the Senate, Military Council, Conclave, Synod and other venues.

Hahnmark.t: A meeting of Hahnmark farmers was scheduled for 6pm on Saturday at the Tree of Names in the Wintermark camp.

Holberg.t: The League elected Holberg's senator on Saturday at 3:30pm through the presentation of collected bonds.

Karsk.t: Varushka elected Karsk's senator on Saturday afternoon, with the questioning of candidates beginning at 1:45pm.

Mareave.t: Although Mareave was held by the Grendel, the Imperial Orcs elected its senator, with candidates presenting items of worth from 2:15pm.

Mournwold.t: The Marches elected Mournwold's senator when landowners gathered at 1:30pm on Saturday.

Reikos.t: Highguard elected Reikos's senator on Saturday, beginning with an inquisition of candidates at 2:00pm.

Sarangrave.t: Although Sarangrave was held by the Druj, Urizen elected its senator through a demos held from 1:00pm to 1:30pm.

Segura.t: The Brass Coast elected Segura's senator by auction, beginning at 1:00pm on Saturday.

The Barrens.t: Dawn elected the senator for The Barrens at 2:30pm on Saturday, immediately after the tourney.

Weirwater.t: Mentioned in passing: a Weirwater Forum appeared on the Friday evening timetable.

388YE Spring Equinox interlude.d: The 500-throne Guerdon went to units supporting the Argent Sword, Drakes, Eastern Sky and Narwhal's Spear. Military units were offered ventures to aid the Thule Earthquake Drummers invading the Forest of Ulnak, to root out trudnik in Karsk and Ossium, to fight threats in Spiral, and to exploit the espionage ring in Sarvos. Fleets could escort Sumaah aid to the Brass Coast. Congregations could investigate Sarvos, support the Pilgrim's Defiance, or encourage pilgrimages to Capodomus and Hacynian. Rivers of Life, Frozen Citadel, Dripping Echoes, Regrow the Land's Heart and a Day projection over Sermersuaq were in effect, alongside Marcher and League economic mandates.

Dawn.t: Dawnish military units were among those eligible to join the Swords Against Darkness venture against the threats in Spiral.

Druj.t: The Druj faced a Thule assault on the Forest of Ulnak led by the Earthquake Drummers, which Imperial warbands were invited to join, while the Eastern Sky in Sarangrave drew Guerdon support.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: Grendel luxuries were among the rewards of the Exploit the Espionage venture, and Grendel-held Feroz and Mareave were listed among enchanted lands.

Highguard.t: Highborn congregations could preach Vigilance to investigate Sarvos for traitors or forgo liao to support the Pilgrim's Defiance against the vallornspawn in Therunin.

Imperial Orcs.t: Mentioned in passing: the Imperial Orcs appeared in the monstering table at 96%, and Mareave, which they partly held, was warded with Frozen Citadel magic.

Jotun.t: Mentioned in passing: only through Bregasland, which they held, where units supporting the Narwhal's Spear shared in the Guerdon.

Navarr.t: The Pilgrim's Defiance fighting the vallornspawn in Therunin could be bolstered by Highborn congregations, with ten reducing casualties and twenty increasing territory taken.

The Brass Coast.t: Delayed Sumaash aid bound for the Brass Coast was readying to sail, and the more Imperial fleets escorted it, the more white granite the House of the People would risk sending.

The League.t: League units could fight in Spiral and League congregations investigate Sarvos, while a League Assembly mandate let Leaguers convert resources to businesses freely and upgrade businesses more cheaply until Spring 389YE.

The Marches.t: Units supporting the Drakes in Mitwold shared the Guerdon, Mitwold was under Rivers of Life, and a Marcher Assembly mandate let Marchers convert resources to farms and upgrade farms more cheaply.

Thule.t: The Thule invited Imperial warbands to join the Earthquake Drummers' assault on the Druj in the Forest of Ulnak for mana crystals, and the Claws of the Dragon worked with Varushkans against the trudnik.

Urizen.t: Urizen units could join the Spiral venture, units supporting the Argent Sword in Redoubt shared the Guerdon, Redoubt was enchanted with Rivers of Life and Tomari with Frozen Citadel, and no new rituals entered Urizen lore.

Varushka.t: Varushkan units could raid trudnik lairs in Karsk and Ossium, at the cost of a production penalty for draughir there, while Ossium was enchanted with Regrow the Land's Heart.

Wintermark.t: Sermersuaq was flooded with Day magic, Hahnmark was enchanted with Regrow the Land's Heart, West Marsh in Kallavesa received Dripping Echoes of the Fen, and Wintermark fleets gained a rank trading at Caitun.

388YE Spring Equinox interlude.o: The interlude opened the season's downtime after the Winter Solstice, setting out where the Imperial Guerdon would be paid, special opportunities for military units, fleets and congregations, and the enchantments and mandates shaping the Empire that season.

Kallavesa/West Marsh.t: West Marsh was enchanted with Dripping Echoes of the Fen by the Sussivari Frost Coven.

Mareave/Clisearn.t: Clisearn was enchanted with Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae by the Ashen Flame coven.

Mareave/Nadir.t: Nadir was enchanted with Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae by the Phoenix Rising coven.

Redoubt/Tomari.t: Tomari was enchanted with Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae by the Ashen Flame coven.

The Barrens/Hope's Rest.t: Hope's Rest was enchanted with Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae by the Phoenix Rising coven.

Bregasland.t: Military units supporting the Narwhal's Spear in Bregasland were among those sharing the Imperial Guerdon.

Feroz.t: Feroz was woven with Rivers of Life, reducing army casualties there and infusing its waters with restorative Spring power.

Forest of Ulnak.t: The Thule Earthquake Drummers were pushing into the Forest of Ulnak against the Druj, with Imperial warbands invited to join for a reward of mana crystals.

Hahnmark.t: Hahnmark was enchanted with a Llofir-infused Regrow the Land's Heart, turning ruins to gardens and giving farms and herb gardens magical mushrooms in place of some of their usual yield.

Kallavesa.t: The West Marsh region of Kallavesa was enchanted with Dripping Echoes of the Fen by the Sussivari Frost Coven.

Karsk.t: Varushkan units could join the Thule in hunting trudnik nests in Karsk, though suspicion would impose a production penalty on Karsk's draughir.

Mareave.t: Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae was cast on Nadir by Phoenix Rising and on Clisearn by Ashen Flame.

Mitwold.t: Units supporting the Drakes in Mitwold shared the Guerdon, and the territory was woven with Rivers of Life.

Ossium.t: Trudnik lairs in Ossium, one apparently very old and extending into the earth, could be raided, at the cost of a penalty to draughir, while Regrow the Land's Heart overgrew its war-scarred lands.

Redoubt.t: Units supporting the Argent Sword in Redoubt shared the Guerdon, Rivers of Life lay over the territory, and Tomari was enchanted with Frozen Citadel.

Sarangrave.t: Units supporting the Eastern Sky in Sarangrave shared the Guerdon, and the territory was woven with Rivers of Life.

Sarvos.t: If at least 30 congregations investigated Sarvos, the espionage ring might be uncovered via the Sentinel Gate, though Sarvos taxes would fall by four thrones, while units exploiting the ring made investigation harder.

Sermersuaq.t: Sermersuaq was flooded with Day magic, easing entry for Day realm inhabitants and turning minds towards intellectual rather than physical pursuits.

Spiral.t: The Swords Against Darkness venture offered the chance to bring Spiral's threats under control, and if sustained it would permanently raise taxation by six thrones and remove the Black Plateau penalty to military units.

The Barrens.t: The Hope's Rest region of the Barrens was enchanted with Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae by Phoenix Rising.

Therunin.t: The Pilgrim's Defiance fought the vallornspawn in Therunin, and congregation support could reduce its casualties and increase the ground it took.

388YE Spring Equinox winds of fortune.d: Twenty-six winds were released. Among them were appraisals on the Cat's Graces sodality, Livardz, the Nesustak rebels, Tsirku and the Beurteilung, and highest callings for Highguard and Navarr. Others covered the Earl of the Groves' tourney claim to the Rose Throne, the Karass, the bees of Karov, face-peelers, Redoubt after the Grendel withdrawal and Sarangrave's miasma pillars. Diplomatic winds covered eleven foreign powers; the Grendel remained at war and pushed into Mareave. Other events included the disputed Tassatan Hills seat, Hope's Rest becoming rimebound, the Crown of Three Tears being withheld, the Marcher Assembly's defence of Marcher orcs and a failed Vigilance investigation in Sarvos. Results of four major and thirty-four minor conjunctions were also listed.
