Dawn.t: The manticore Earl of the Groves claimed to be Monarch of Dawn, and Dawn's nobles must fight a tourney to decide who, if anyone, sits on the Rose Throne. Dawnish magicians of the Phoenix Rising coven also made Hope's Rest rimebound.

Druj.t: Emperor Vesna readied the Empire for a final push to end the Druj. Druj forces were defeated or cleared at Camp Askoun Orama, Skinflawed's Corral, Hywel's Track and Greensward Lea, and Grettek Skinflawed was killed.

Grendel.t: The Grendel remained at war, abandoned Redoubt, launched a major push into Mareave with Asavean support, and made no formal diplomatic contact. Their suspected espionage ring in Sarvos escaped exposure, while their raiders had mixed results against Imperial heroes.

Highguard.t: Highguard turned to completing the Grand Inspiration of the Way as its highest calling. The Highborn Assembly's peerless kinship offered hope of returning bees to Karov, and the Beurteilung academics reported on ties with the Commonwealth.

Imperial Orcs.t: An Imperial Orc Assembly expedition successfully learned of the Karass ancestors. The Black Tillers offered a Garden of Hope great work in Skarsind, and the Marches pledged to defend Marcher orcs against any Synod proscription.

Jotun.t: The Jotun remained at war with the Empire while their ambassador's hetjuveisla and a Loyalty consecration of the meeting place were pursued. Ghodi Uksahkka reached Kierheim, the Tromsdalen fyrd formed, and Eluf Asbjørnsson survived to raise Greenwall's fyrd.

Navarr.t: Navarr's highest calling to aid Urizen and the Vallornguard bore results, and the Glimmerwater steading agreed to relocate to Miaren. The Greenwatcher title was reinstated without powers.

The Brass Coast.t: With the Freeborn lands no longer immediately threatened, Anduz in Segura sought new opportunities. The Protectorate of Morajasse made a fidelitous offer, and wreckers in Madruga were defeated.

The League.t: The Chamber of Euphony in Apulian was completed, and the Forge and Furnace Fellowship demanded the Tassatan Hills be restored as a League seat. A League and Highborn Vigilance investigation into Grendel spies in Sarvos was thwarted.

The Marches.t: The Marcher Assembly's pledge to defend Marcher orcs opened a Preach Pride action for congregations. At Two Barrel Field Bill of Beatsdown was killed and Jim Moor murdered, but Stephen of Sarcombe survived.

Thule.t: The Thule of Otkodov remained at peace with the Empire and appointed a new ambassador, while focusing on their invasion of the Forest of Ulnak. Their Claws of the Dragon worked with Varushkans against face-peeler nests.

Urizen.t: Urizen faced rebuilding in Redoubt after the Grendel fled and the Tower of Light and Shadow was broken. Its seers reported on countering Sarangrave's miasma pillars, and Navarr's highest calling brought aid to the nation.

Varushka.t: Varushka received an appraisal on restoring Livardz after the Cold Sun attack, and saw the fallout of raids against the face-peelers. Highborn kinship offered a chance to return the lost bees of Karov.

Wintermark.t: The mystics of Ishal advised on scouting Tsirku, and the Crown of Three Tears was withheld until Wemba the Bloody and Kaarina White-Eye are slain. Hahnmark was offered deeper ties with Sarcophan merchant families.

388YE Spring Equinox winds of fortune.o: The Spring Equinox 388YE winds of fortune set out the season's opportunities and problems across the Empire, from a manticore's claim to the Dawnish throne and Emperor Vesna's call for a final push against the Druj to diplomatic updates and the results of the Winter Solstice conjunctions.

Ayereed/Gainmeachdubh.t: Imperials were pushed from the field at Dunreagh's Mead, but wagon raiders killed the remnant Grendel.

Bregasland/North Fens.t: Coral husks were destroyed at Gorum's Toe.

Bregasland/Ottermire.t: Imperials were pushed off the field at Abigail's Green, and the Lion of the North recovered strength.

Casinea/Casfall.t: Mendicant Garev was rescued and healed at Casca's Doom, where strange items were also recovered.

Feroz/Cazar Straits.t: Mentioned in passing: the Suranni conquest of the Cazar Straits was given as context for diplomacy with the Iron Confederacy.

Feroz/Morajasse.t: The Protectorate of Morajasse, holding Mora's Rock with veteran Grendel soldiers, made a fidelitous offer and a request to the Empire.

Hahnmark/Kronemark.t: Mentioned in passing: Kronemark is not named; the Sarcophan merchant interest and Valdr Grieversonn concern Hahnmark generally.

Hercynia/Northpines.t: The Archmage of Winter investigated strange rumours at Starwood Roots Steading.

Kallavesa/Rundhal Marsh.t: Mentioned in passing: Rundhal Marsh is not named; Kallavesa's only event was in the West Marsh.

Kallavesa/West Marsh.t: Coral husks were destroyed at Ingrid's Rock.

Madruga/Crucible.t: Wreckers were defeated at Draws Sward.

Madruga/Torres.t: Cinders were killed and the House of Guerra protected on Corsair's Road.

Mareave/Beoraidh.t: Beoraidh appointed an emissary to the Empire, invited Imperial investment and floated a raid on the Brine Turtle sept.

Mareave/Fleisardh.t: The Capstone Veld conjunction went untaken; Fleisardh gained the coastal quality and the Weltsilver seals remain.

Mareave/Icarion.t: Mentioned in passing: the Dove of the Perfect Morning congratulated those who brought tranquil waters to Icarion.

Mitwold/The Meadows.t: At Two Barrel Field, Bill of Beatsdown was killed and Jim Moor was murdered, while Stephen of Sarcombe survived and three items of worth were lost.

Morrow/Altis.t: Disciples of Sulemaine were slaughtered on the path to Highwatch.

Morrow/Peregro.t: Wreckers were defeated on Xavier's Path.

Mournwold/Alderly.t: Linley Weaver answered the call of Warrenwise at the Hare Stone and solved the problem.

Mournwold/Greensward.t: Mentioned in passing: no event is recorded here; the page's only Greensward reference is Greensward Lea in Therunin.

Necropolis/Fishguard.t: The Grendel pushed Imperials off at Myfanwy's Rest and raided the Abbey of Reconciliation.

Otkodov/Sküld.t: The High Bard exchanged cultural works of storytelling with the Thule at Leopard-Tooth Pass.

Redoubt/Limus.t: Disciples of Sulemaine were slaughtered at the Temple of the Stinging Blade.

Redoubt/Naris.t: Options were laid out for the Tilphussian Reach, where the broken Tower of Light and Shadow stood, along with offers from the realms.

Redoubt/Siluri.t: The Grendel were defeated at Lucia's Moor.

Redoubt/Tomari.t: The Grendel were defeated at Magnus' Clearing.

Sarangrave/Nesustak Forest.t: Naomi of Virtue's Rest identified the key problem with the Nesustak rebels and a possible path to a solution.

Sarangrave/Thornfen.t: At Camp Askoun Orama the Druj were engaged, all ingots and measures were captured and the Rebuker of the Unwanted was recovered.

Sarangrave/Whisperwood.t: Grettek Skinflawed and the rest of the Druj were killed at Skinflawed's Corral.

Sarvos/Foracci.t: Cinders were killed and the Library Scriptorium protected at Vintner's Way.

Sarvos/Uccelini.t: Wreckers were defeated at Antonio's Glebe.

Sermersuaq/Stark.t: Coral husks were cleared from Scop's Lookout.

Sermersuaq/Suaq Wastes.t: The Ceaseless Hunter was killed at Verdant Lea and the Feasting Lord at Taiva's Pen.

Skallahn/Greenwall.t: Eluf Asbjørnsson survived an attempt on his life at Paegga's Rest and will raise the fyrd of Greenwall.

Skallahn/Mindrkyst.t: The shipwrecked Marcher crew of the Old Jim's Ewe were rescued at Drekatangi.

Skallahn/Ulfrsmoor.t: Ghodi Uksahkka passed Eagle Scour unopposed to reach Kierheim, but a construct bound for Kierheim was defeated on the Nordrborg Approach.

Skarsind/Gildermark.t: The Black Tillers proposed a Garden of Hope great work here to supply Hearkener's Hope to Skarsind's congregations.

Spiral/Apulus.t: The Grendel were defeated at Aphelion Cape and shards retrieved, and Disciples of Sulemaine were scattered on Hadrian's Path.

Spiral/Screed.t: The Dove of the Perfect Morning wished to discuss the baleful Black Plateau in Screed.

Tassato/Tassato Mestra.t: The mining guilds disputed the relinquishment of the Tassatan Hills ilium seat as a League position.

The Barrens/Hope's Rest.t: Hope's Rest became rimebound through Phoenix Rising's magic, and servants of the Thane of the Rimebound Shore now shelter travellers in the ruins of Dourfell Keep.

The Barrens/The Bleaks.t: The Karass, who live mainly in the Bleaks, offered suggestions to aid the Empire, and Anka Karass learned of Imperial law at the Execution Field.

The Barrens/The Untrod Groves.t: The manticore Earl of the Groves, who squats at the heart of the Untrod Groves, claimed to be Monarch of Dawn.

Therunin/Eastring.t: Druj were cleared from Greensward Lea, the Glimmerwater steading agreed to relocate to Miaren, and the outcome at Broken Pasture remains unclear.

Therunin/Peakedge Song.t: The Druj were defeated and apothecaries saved at Hywel's Track.

Upwold/Tower March.t: Cinders were killed and Benson's Orchard protected at Benson's Bawn.

Volodmartz/Livardz.t: An appraisal identified three core problems in Livardz after the Cold Sun scions' attack, with proposed solutions.

Ayereed.t: At Dunreagh's Mead, Imperials sent against the Grendel were pushed from the field, but wagon raiders killed the remnant Grendel.

Bregasland.t: Coral husks were destroyed at Gorum's Toe, but Imperials were pushed off at Abigail's Green and the Lion of the North recovered strength. The territory's inhabitants were also flagged as affected by awry Imperial magic.

Casinea.t: At Casca's Doom, mendicant Garev was rescued and healed and strange items were recovered; Garev was then called to inquisition.

Feroz.t: Feroz's inhabitants were warned of awry Imperial magic. Celesti Lighthouse was reviewed as a fortification opportunity, and the Protectorate of Morajasse made an offer from Mora's Rock.

Forest of Ulnak.t: The Thule of Otkodov have turned their focus to invading the Forest of Ulnak, though little is known of the campaign.

Hahnmark.t: Two Sarcophan merchant families offered farm and herb garden owners deeper relations. Valdr Grieversonn agreed to meet Eevi of the Gadrai, and people of Hahnmark were touched by strange magic.

Hercynia.t: Strange rumours at Starwood Roots Steading were investigated by the Archmage of Winter. Hercynia, where Ravadi first fought the vallorn, was also proposed as a site for their tomb.

Holberg.t: Mentioned in passing: Holberg's senator was advised on the Tassatan Hills dispute, and Holberg was listed among possible homes of units involved in the Sarvos counter-espionage.

Kallavesa.t: Coral husks were destroyed at Ingrid's Rock in the West Marsh.

Karov.t: The bees of Karov, missing since the Blade of Skies appeared, might be restored through the Highborn Assembly's peerless kinship.

Madruga.t: Wreckers were defeated at Draws Sward and the House of Guerra was protected on Corsair's Road. Madruga, where Ravadi died, was also proposed as a site for their tomb.

Mareave.t: The Grendel launched a major push into Mareave while Beoraidh explored diplomacy with the Empire. Fleisardh gained the coastal quality after its conjunction went untaken.

Miaren.t: The Glimmerwater steading agreed to relocate from Eastring to Miaren.

Miekarova.t: Mentioned in passing: people from Miekarova, especially mine owners, were tagged as interested in the strange magic described in Ripple of echoes.

Mitwold.t: At Two Barrel Field Imperials fought the Wayford Traitors: Bill of Beatsdown was killed, Jim Moor was murdered and three items of worth were lost. Mitwold's inhabitants were also warned of awry Imperial magic.

Morrow.t: Wreckers were defeated on Xavier's Path, and Disciples of Sulemaine were slaughtered on the path to Highwatch. The Three Watchers fortification was reviewed for renewal.

Mournwold.t: At the Hare Stone, Linley Weaver answered the call of Warrenwise and solved the problem.

Necropolis.t: The Grendel pushed Imperials off at Myfanwy's Rest and raided the Abbey of Reconciliation. The Reumah's Rest fortification was reviewed for renewal.

Ossium.t: Mentioned in passing: the people of Ossium were tagged as interested in the strange magic described in Ripple of echoes.

Otkodov.t: Otkodov stayed at peace with the Empire under a new ambassador, and cultural works of storytelling were exchanged at Leopard-Tooth Pass in Sküld.

Redoubt.t: After the Grendel fled, Redoubt weighed what to do with the Tilphussian Reach where the Tower of Light and Shadow stood, while southern Redoubt suffered from awry magic. Grendel and Disciples of Sulemaine were defeated in Siluri, Tomari and Limus.

Reikos.t: Mentioned in passing: Joran of Reikos led the Highborn Vigilance investigation in Sarvos.

Reinos.t: Mentioned in passing: people interested in Reinos were tagged in the Iron Confederacy diplomatic wind.

Sarangrave.t: Urizen seers reported on targeting the keystone miasma pillars, and an appraisal began on the Nesustak Forest rebels. Druj were defeated in Thornfen and Whisperwood.

Sarvos.t: Highborn and League priests failed to expose a suspected Grendel espionage ring in Sarvos. Wreckers were defeated at Antonio's Glebe, and the Library Scriptorium was protected from Cinders.

Segura.t: With the Brass Coast no longer under immediate threat, Anduz explored building its future on the ruins of its ancient past.

Sermersuaq.t: Agramant's cultists Wemba the Bloody and Kaarina White-Eye still threaten Sermersuaq, but the Ceaseless Hunter, the Feasting Lord and coral husks at Scop's Lookout were destroyed.

Skallahn.t: Ghodi Uksahkka reached Kierheim unopposed and the Tromsdalen fyrd formed, while Eluf Asbjørnsson survived to raise Greenwall's fyrd. Imperials defeated a construct bound for Kierheim and rescued the crew of the Old Jim's Ewe.

Skarsind.t: The Black Tillers proposed a Garden of Hope in Gildermark to supply Hearkener's Hope to every congregation in Skarsind.

Spiral.t: Apulian's Chamber of Euphony was completed and the sewers opened to military units, while the Black Plateau in Screed was discussed by the Dove of the Perfect Morning. Grendel and Disciples of Sulemaine were defeated in Apulus.

Tassato.t: The Forge and Furnace Fellowship demanded the Tassatan Hills ilium seat be returned to the League or that they be invited to discuss terms.

The Barrens.t: The Earl of the Groves claimed the Dawnish throne, the Karass offered suggestions to aid the Empire, and Hope's Rest became rimebound. Barrens resource owners were invited to make their holdings rimebound too.

Therunin.t: Druj were cleared from Greensward Lea and defeated at Hywel's Track, saving the apothecaries, and the Glimmerwater steading agreed to leave Eastring for Miaren.

Tsirku.t: The mystics of Ishal laid out the challenges of scouting and claiming Tsirku and how they might be met.

Upwold.t: Cinders were killed and Benson's Orchard protected at Benson's Bawn.

Volodmartz.t: Graciana i Lòpez i Guerra identified three core problems facing Livardz after the Cold Sun attack, along with possible solutions.

Weirwater.t: Mentioned in passing: Weirwater, where Ravadi was born, was suggested as one possible site for their tomb.

388YE Spring Equinox winds of war.d: The Grendel stirred in the Bay of Catazar and fought on in Mareave. The Jotun had invaded Mitwold and looted Meade, while Imperial forces sought to retake Bregasland, centred on Gravenmarch. In Therunin the Pilgrim's Defiance marched against the vallorn of Tharunind, and the Empire advanced on the Tower of the Skink, the last Druj stronghold in Sarangrave. The Military Council would pick two of five battles: two in Sarangrave, and one each in Mareave, Mitwold and Bregasland. Conjunctions included miasma pillars in Sarangrave, ettercap threats near the vallorn, and Lasambrian and Jotun raiders. The page also listed nation-specific military considerations and force weights.

Dawn.t: Dawn carried a force weight of 63, its armies could not use Cautious Advance or Give Ground, and the Druj needed 25 victory points to claim a beachhead in the patrolled Barrens. Slaying the ettercaps in Brocéliande would boost Dawnish units questing against the vallorn.

Druj.t: The Druj held the Tower of the Skink as their last Sarangrave stronghold, depleted but unbroken, and were the foe in both Sarangrave battle opportunities. A band of Kallad led other Druj through Drownbark Forest after retreating from Thule invaders.

Grendel.t: The Grendel were said to be scheming around the Bay of Catazar and still pressing in Mareave, where a battle opportunity to freeze their advance was offered at Ohwinn Scour.

Highguard.t: Highguard carried a force weight of 27 and could use Protect the Innocent, but would suffer penalties for herald-boosted armies and gain bonuses attacking Zenith from Morrow. Conjunctions in Reikos and Casinea dealt with refugees, ettercap-captured Highborn and the rescue of Mendicant Garev.

Imperial Orcs.t: Mentioned in passing: the Imperial Orcs were listed with a force weight of 7 for the battle muster.

Jotun.t: The Jotun had invaded Mitwold, looting Meade, and occupied Bregasland, though the Mournwold had slipped from their grasp. Lasambrian and Jotun warbands featured in conjunctions in Hahnmark, Sermersuaq and Reinos.

Navarr.t: Navarr, with a force weight of 60, saw the Pilgrim's Defiance fight a hopeless delaying war against the vallorn of Tharunind in Therunin. Ettercap threats emerged in Hercynia and Brocéliande.

The Brass Coast.t: The Brass Coast carried a force weight of 17, and conjunctions in Feroz and Madruga called on its titles to reclaim the Brazen Links, stop the Hand of Dumon and slay dire astacids.

The League.t: The League carried a force weight of 23 and was tasked with conjunctions to claim the Vorlach Adventurers' wage in Spiral and stop the Hand of Dumon in Sarvos.

The Marches.t: The Marches suffered the Jotun invasion of Mitwold and the sack of Meade, while the Empire fought to retake Bregasland. Marcher armies could not Give Ground but gained home-territory bonuses, and any Imperial army could Billet in Marcher lands.

Thule.t: Thule armies invading the Forest of Ulnak had driven a band of Kallad south-west, and a conjunction sought to recover Thule material in Grimfen Mire.

Urizen.t: Urizen carried a force weight of 12. Morrow and Zenith were patrolled so that the Druj needed 25 victory points for a beachhead there, and Urizen armies attacking Zenith from Morrow gained bonuses.

Varushka.t: Varushka carried a force weight of 17 and could use Hospitality of the Boyars in patrolled Ossium. Conjunctions spread across Karov, Karsk, Ossium and Volodmartz.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark brought the largest force weight, 71, and gained honour-based modifiers against the Jotun. Its titles were charged with conjunctions in Hahnmark, Sermersuaq and Kallavesa.

388YE Spring Equinox winds of war.o: The Spring Equinox 388YE Winds of War summarised the Empire's campaigns in the Bay of Catazar, Mareave, Mitwold, Bregasland, Therunin and Sarangrave. It also set out five battle opportunities, of which the generals would choose two, along with a long list of Sentinel Gate conjunctions across the Empire.

Astolat/Withy.t: Igraine's Regio in Withy needed fixing, a task given to the Senator for Astolat.

Bregasland/Gravenmarch.t: Gravenmarch, the only dry land in the marshes, was the focus of the Imperial effort to retake Bregasland from the Jotun.

Bregasland/Grey Fens.t: Drayham Mere in the Grey Fens was the site of a battle opportunity against the Jotun to erect the Mere Stone.

Bregasland/The Rushes.t: A conjunction at Harry's Hole tasked the General of the Narwhal's Spear with killing a yegarra.

Brocéliande/Elerael.t: Ettercaps hunted along the trods of Elerael, including Longberth Trod, and were to be intercepted.

Feroz/Afarjasse.t: A conjunction at Abril's Pasture tasked the Dhomiro of Afar with stopping the Hand of Dumon.

Feroz/Oranseri.t: A conjunction at Sisters' Meadow called on the Corsair of Oran to reclaim the Brazen Links.

Forest of Ulnak/Grimfen Mire.t: A conjunction at the Bound Glade sought to recover Thule material and clear ghosts, and retreating Kallad were trying to return here.

Hahnmark/Kronemark.t: Eevi of the Gadrai was charged with a small conjunction to meet Valdr Grieversonn at Grieversonn Farmstead.

Hahnmark/Valasmark.t: A Lasambrian warband with Jotun among them was linked to Vanya Heartsworn's attacker, and a conjunction at the Fallen Tree sought a letter leading to Avalanche.

Hercynia/Deer's Folly.t: Ettercaps were building a mysterious structure at Greenmount, which the Speaker of the Vallornguard was to destroy.

Kallavesa/West Marsh.t: Gull's Isle Hall hosted a conjunction for Ingrid Talon-of-the-Mark to engage in a hetjuveisla.

Karov/Wieliczka.t: Cultists of the Night Below at Maria's Descent held the Rat Idol, which a conjunction sought to retrieve.

Karsk/Branoc.t: Named persons were to meet Taysa of the Black Feathers at the Hall of the Bloodwise.

Karsk/Crowslook.t: A conjunction at Skylost Clearing tasked the Guild Leader of the Apothecaries Guild with treating the Gregadze.

Madruga/Crucible.t: Dire astacids at the Egnar Range were to be slain under the Grandmaster of the Rod and Shield.

Mareave/Clisearn.t: Ohwinn Scour in Clisearn was the site of a battle opportunity to freeze the Grendel advance.

Mitwold/Meade March.t: Meade had been conquered and looted. A battle opportunity at Meade Meadow and a conjunction at Maggie's Bulwark sought to recover its treasures.

Ossium/Drownbark Forest.t: Kallad leading Druj through the forest threatened the Shchaslyvyy Outpost, and wagon raiders acting strangely at Sarakov Point were to be investigated.

Reikos/Chalcis Mount.t: Ettercaps had captured Highborn gardeners, and a conjunction at the South Downs aimed to rescue them.

Reinos/Bastasor.t: A conjunction at Beatriz's Field offered the chance to claim the Lasambrian banner.

Sarangrave/Bloodwater Marsh.t: Mantifent's Bier was a battle opportunity to hold back the vallorn against the Druj. Conjunctions also targeted the Toxic Pillar and arranged a meeting with rebels at Dandelion Glade.

Sarangrave/Kroll.t: A large conjunction at Kreeflirn aimed to destroy two miasma pillars.

Sarangrave/Nesustak Forest.t: The Feverbank Trees were the site of a battle opportunity to hold back the vallorn against the Druj.

Sarangrave/Thornfen.t: Conjunctions targeted blinded ghosts at Stonesedge and the miasma pillars at Overgrown Pillar and Haunted Pillar.

Sarangrave/Turan Flats.t: Conjunctions sought to rescue sept members from blinded ghosts at Dahis Outskirts and to destroy a miasma pillar and stymie Kull at Kullflirn.

Sarvos/Uccelini.t: A late conjunction at Bertolli's Glebe aimed to stop the Hand of Dumon.

Sermersuaq/Suaq Wastes.t: Hallr Winterborn's yegarra and Jotun raiders were to be confronted at the Desolate Stretch, disturbing the recent calm of the Wastes.

Spiral/Apulus.t: A conjunction at Broken Lea offered the chance to claim the wage of the Vorlach Adventurers.

Volodmartz/Livardz.t: A conjunction at the Sunless Vale sought to end the suffering of the Shadow Fellowship.

Volodmartz/Murupa.t: Academy cadets were sent to find and destroy a "bandit" vale in the Forest of Blades.

Astolat.t: A small conjunction in Withy charged the Senator for Astolat with fixing Igraine's Regio.

Bay of Catazar.t: The Deep blue sea wind told of navies, rocky shores and Grendel machinations on the bay.

Bregasland.t: Imperial forces fought to retake Bregasland from the Jotun, centred on Gravenmarch. A battle opportunity to erect the Mere Stone and a conjunction to kill a yegarra were offered, and the Strong Reeds gained strength here.

Brocéliande.t: Ettercaps hunted along the trods of Elerael, and the Knight of the Greenwood was charged with stopping them.

Casinea.t: A small conjunction at Kaela's Regio in Syrene tasked the Inquisitor of Prosperity with rescuing Mendicant Garev.

Feroz.t: Conjunctions sought to reclaim the Brazen Links in Oranseri and stop the Hand of Dumon in Afarjasse.

Forest of Ulnak.t: Thule armies were invading the forest, Kallad were trying to return to Grimfen Mire, and the High Exorcist was tasked with recovering Thule material and clearing ghosts there.

Hahnmark.t: Conjunctions sent heroes to recover a letter about Avalanche from a Lasambrian warband in Valasmark and to meet Valdr Grieversonn in Kronemark.

Hercynia.t: Ettercaps apparently under the influence of the Phoenix were building an unknown structure, which the Speaker of the Vallornguard was charged with destroying.

Kallavesa.t: A conjunction at Gull's Isle Hall in West Marsh invited Ingrid Talon-of-the-Mark to engage in a hetjuveisla.

Karov.t: A conjunction at Maria's Descent in Wieliczka aimed to retrieve the Rat Idol from cultists of the Night Below.

Karsk.t: Conjunctions offered a meeting with Taysa of the Black Feathers in Branoc and a chance to treat the Gregadze in Crowslook.

Madruga.t: A conjunction in the Crucible tasked the Grandmaster of the Rod and Shield with slaying dire astacids.

Mareave.t: Armies clashed under the Wide azure skies along a coast reshaped by the sea, and a battle opportunity was offered to freeze the Grendel advance in Clisearn.

Mitwold.t: Mitwold had been invaded for the first time in centuries and Meade conquered and looted. A battle opportunity and a conjunction sought to recover Meade's treasures, and the Drakes gained strength here.

Morrow.t: Morrow's borders were patrolled so that the Druj needed 25 victory points for a beachhead. Highborn and Urizen armies gained bonuses attacking Zenith from Morrow or defending Morrow.

Mournwold.t: The Mournwold had slipped from the Jotun's grasp. Imperial armies could Billet there and the Tusks gained strength fighting in it.

Ossium.t: Kallad were leading Druj through Drownbark Forest towards Shchaslyvyy Outpost, and strange wagon raiders were to be investigated. Ossium's patrolled borders meant the Druj needed 25 victory points for a beachhead.

Redoubt.t: Mentioned in passing: the battlefields and mountains of Redoubt appeared only in the poetic opening.

Reikos.t: Conjunctions tasked heroes with assisting refugees at an emergency hospital in High Chalcis and rescuing Highborn captured by ettercaps near Chalcis Mount.

Reinos.t: A conjunction at Beatriz's Field in Bastasor called on the Champion of Ambition to claim the Lasambrian banner.

Sarangrave.t: The Empire advanced on the Tower of the Skink, the last Druj stronghold guarding the pass to Axos. Two battle opportunities to hold back the vallorn were offered, alongside many conjunctions against miasma pillars and blinded ghosts and a meeting with rebels.

Sarvos.t: A conjunction in Uccelini tasked the Ambassador to the Iron Confederacy with stopping the Hand of Dumon.

Sermersuaq.t: Yegarra and Jotun under Hallr Winterborn raided the Suaq Wastes, and the Banner-bearer of Atkonaroq was charged with killing him and claiming his banner.

Spiral.t: A conjunction at Broken Lea in Apulus tasked the Oblivion Sentinel with claiming the wage of the Vorlach Adventurers.

Temeschwar.t: Mentioned in passing: the Senator for Temeschwar was named as responsible for a conjunction in Karov.

The Barrens.t: The Barrens' borders were patrolled under Ser Tunic's mandate, so the Druj needed 25 victory points to claim a beachhead there.

Therunin.t: The Pilgrim's Defiance marched against the vallorn of Tharunind to slow it, and ettercaps were carrying Highborn captives back towards Therunin.

Upwold.t: Mentioned in passing: Upwold was listed as a territory where armies could Billet and where the Bounders gained strength.

Volodmartz.t: Conjunctions sent cadets to destroy a bandit vale in Murupa and others to end the suffering of the Shadow Fellowship in Livardz.

Zenith.t: Zenith's borders were patrolled against Druj beachheads, and Highborn and Urizen armies attacking into Zenith from Morrow gained bonuses.

388YE Summer Solstice Imperial elections.d: National elections returned senators for Bastion, Feroz, Karov, Miaren, Mitwold, Redoubt, Sarvos, Sermersuaq, Spiral and Weirwater. The Senate appointed Slawomir Rabovich Bolotstrazh as Imperial Consul, along with an ambassador to Asavea and the generals of eleven armies. The Synod chose Cardinals of Courage, Pride and Wisdom, an Imperial Inquisitor and many lesser religious titles, and those Cardinals named their Gatekeepers. The Military Council appointed a Strategos of the Brass Coast, and the Conclave elected two grandmasters. Bourse seats and ministries went by auction and vote, with the Envoy to the Karass drawing 1300 votes. Sodalities filled titles including High Bard of the Empire.

Dawn.t: Dawn's senate seat for Weirwater went to Tristan duLac at this summit.

Grendel.t: Garviel i Abrira i Erigo was returned as Senator for Feroz, the territory Grendel held at the time.

Highguard.t: Merari Navigators of Virtue was elected Senator for Bastion, Highguard's territory.

Navarr.t: Rhisiart Dancewalker took the senate seat for the Navarr territory of Miaren.

The League.t: The League saw two senate seats filled: Laurencio Lemmini di Sarvos for Sarvos and Genoveva Barossa d'Apulian for Spiral.

The Marches.t: Mary Birchsmith was elected Senator for Mitwold, the Marcher territory.

Urizen.t: Thalia of Netherwatch won the senate seat for the Urizen territory of Redoubt.

Varushka.t: Morana Vesnayevich was chosen as Senator for Karov, Varushka's territory.

Wintermark.t: Fedelmidd Sydanjaa's Heart Floer was elected Senator for Sermersuaq, Wintermark's territory.

388YE Summer Solstice Imperial elections.o: At the 388YE Summer Solstice summit a wide range of Imperial titles were filled. Senators were chosen for ten territories, and posts were settled through Senate and Throne appointments, Synod judgements, Conclave votes, Bourse auctions and votes, and sodality votes.

Spiral/Apulus.t: Mentioned in passing: Apulus appears only in personal names, such as Paris of Apulus, who won the Second Imperial Wayleave for 15 thrones, and several holders surnamed d'Apulian.

Bastion.t: Bastion returned Merari Navigators of Virtue as its senator.

Feroz.t: Feroz returned Garviel i Abrira i Erigo as its senator.

Karov.t: Karov returned Morana Vesnayevich as its senator.

Miaren.t: Miaren returned Rhisiart Dancewalker as its senator.

Mitwold.t: Mitwold returned Mary Birchsmith as its senator.

Redoubt.t: Redoubt returned Thalia of Netherwatch as its senator.

Sarvos.t: Sarvos returned Laurencio Lemmini di Sarvos as its senator.

Sermersuaq.t: Sermersuaq returned Fedelmidd Sydanjaa's Heart Floer as its senator.

Spiral.t: Spiral returned Genoveva Barossa d'Apulian as its senator.

Weirwater.t: Weirwater returned Tristan duLac as its senator.

388YE Summer Solstice Military Council o.d: Thirty-two armies received orders. Twelve, drawn from the Marches, Brass Coast, Dawn, Highguard, Imperial Orcs, League and Wintermark, converged on Jotun-held Bregasland to reclaim it for the Marchers. Six armies from Dawn, Navarr, Urizen and Varushka struck the Salt Flats of Sanath, with Lower Saarnath and the Sydathian Fens named as targets. Six armies went to Mareave to fight the Grendel. The Drakes and the Star Forged made an overwhelming assault on Madruga, and the Golden Axe did the same in Therunin. Four armies took up positions in Zenith and the Boyar's Hasta rested in Ossium. Dame Aurum De Castellan issued her final orders to the Eastern Sky.

Dawn.t: Dawn's four armies were split across three fronts: the Golden Sun advanced into Bregasland, the Eastern Sky went to Mareave under its general's final orders, and the Gryphon's Pride and Lions of Adelmar attacked the Salt Flats of Sanath.

Druj.t: Six Imperial armies attacked the Druj in the Salt Flats of Sanath, and their generals' orders spoke openly of the end of the Buruk Tepel.

Grendel.t: Six Imperial armies went to Mareave to strike at, wound and hold back the Grendel there.

Highguard.t: The Valiant Pegasus pressed its crusade into Bregasland, while the Granite Pillar and Seventh Wave defended Mareave against the Grendel. The Pilgrim's Defiance gave ground in Zenith on a pilgrimage to Damakan's Forge.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Autumn Hammers raised the Glass Labyrinth in Bregasland, the Winter Sun made hit-and-run attacks on the Grendel in Mareave, and the Summer Storm rested and trained in Zenith.

Jotun.t: Twelve Imperial armies converged on Jotun-held Bregasland to drive them out and reclaim the Marchers' homes.

Navarr.t: The Black Thorns and Quiet Step attacked the Druj in the Salt Flats of Sanath, while the newly raised Star Forged joined the Drakes in an overwhelming assault on Madruga.

The Brass Coast.t: The Burning Falcon made a triumphant charge and the Red Wind Corsairs a daring raid in Bregasland, and the Fire of the South force-marched to Mareave in support of the Imperial Orcs.

The League.t: The Sparrows Reckoning marched from Tassato to Bregasland, the Wolves of War advanced in Mareave, and the Towerjacks held Zenith.

The Marches.t: Three Marcher armies fought to reclaim Bregasland alongside allies from across the Empire, while the Drakes, under a new general, assaulted Madruga in return for Freeborn loyalty.

Thule.t: Mentioned in passing: the Boyar's Hasta's general vowed that the army would spill Thule blood when the time was right.

Urizen.t: The Citadel Guard made an onrushing storm on the Salt Flats of Sanath, aimed at Lower Saarnath, while the Argent Sword held Zenith and sought riches beneath Kaspoena's Reach.

Varushka.t: The Golden Axe assaulted Therunin and the Northern Eagle infiltrated the Sydathian Fens, while the Boyar's Hasta rested in Ossium after the death of General Alderei.

Wintermark.t: All three Wintermark armies went to Bregasland: the Bloodcloaks to recover the lost, the Green Shield to fight with honour and the Narwhal's Spear to seek the foe.

388YE Summer Solstice Military Council o.o: At the Summer Solstice 388YE the Imperial generals sent twelve armies against the Jotun in Bregasland and six against the Druj in the Salt Flats of Sanath. Other armies resisted the Grendel in Mareave, assaulted Madruga and Therunin, and held Zenith.

Bregasland/Ottermire.t: The Golden Sun planned to advance through the Rushes and Ottermire, while the Strong Reeds aimed to push the Jotun back to Ottermire.

Salt Flats of Sanath/Lower Saarnath.t: The Quiet Step and the Citadel Guard made for Lower Saarnath, with the Citadel Guard aiming to soften Leen and ruin the Beacon of Iskrid.

Salt Flats of Sanath/Sydathian Fens.t: The Northern Eagle infiltrated the Sydathian Fens, hunting for the Druj's weakness among their effigies and monuments.

Bastion.t: Mentioned in passing: the Pilgrim's Defiance set out from Bastion for Zenith.

Bregasland.t: Twelve Imperial armies, including the Strong Reeds already in the territory, attacked the Jotun here with a range of actions from steady conquest to the Glass Labyrinth.

Hercynia.t: Mentioned in passing: the Star Forged were ordered to descend from the heights of Hercynia into Madruga.

Kallavesa.t: Mentioned in passing: the Tusks and the Narwhal's Spear marched from Kallavesa to Bregasland.

Madruga.t: The Drakes and the Star Forged made an overwhelming assault to bring Madruga's untamed parts back into the Empire, having been warned of the land's Spring and Night magic.

Mareave.t: Six Imperial armies fought the Grendel here, through strategic defence, guarding the gates, hit-and-run raids, a grinding advance and a traverse of the crossroads.

Mitwold.t: Mentioned in passing: several armies marched from Mitwold to Bregasland and Madruga, and the Burning Falcon's orders spoke of reclaiming it as the Jotun quit Imperial lands.

Mournwold.t: Mentioned in passing: the Bounders marched from the Mournwold, and its earlier liberation was recalled in two generals' orders.

Ossium.t: The Boyar's Hasta rested here under Hospitality of the Boyars, and the Gryphon's Pride set out from Ossium for the Salt Flats.

Reikos.t: Mentioned in passing: the Granite Pillar's orders honoured the Imperial Orcs who bled to reclaim Reikos.

Salt Flats of Sanath.t: Six Imperial armies attacked the Druj here, from pushing the line and steady conquest to an onrushing storm and infiltration.

Sarangrave.t: Mentioned in passing: five armies, including the Granite Pillar, Black Thorns, Citadel Guard and Golden Axe, set out from Sarangrave.

Semmerholm.t: Mentioned in passing: the Eastern Sky and the Lions of Adelmar marched from Semmerholm.

Tassato.t: Mentioned in passing: the Sparrows Reckoning, addressed as Bravos of Tassato, marched from Tassato to Bregasland.

Therunin.t: The Golden Axe made an overwhelming assault on Therunin to show its people they were not forgotten, rejecting the false hope offered by Blood-on-the-Snow.

Upwold.t: Mentioned in passing: the Burning Falcon marched from Upwold to Bregasland.

Zenith.t: The Summer Storm, Towerjacks and Argent Sword held Zenith in solid defence and the Pilgrim's Defiance gave ground here, while three other armies departed for other fronts.

388YE Summer Solstice Senate sessions.d: The Senate raised the fourth Navarr and Varushkan armies and the fifth Marcher army, but the fourth Wintermark army failed. With the Emperor's ratification it created the crime of Moral Injury and limited proscription statements to a Cardinal's elevation. Idolatry was redefined. The Laroc Tourney Grounds were ceded to Rhianos, and tariffs with the Sarcophan Delves and the Sumaah Republic were set to mercantile. Commissions included the Beoraidh Docks, a Barrens wayhouse and the Wrangler's Market. The Palace of Apulian was to be upgraded to the Palace of Mists. Sławomir Rabovich Bolotstrazh became Imperial Consul and embargoed Zemelslo, which closed Radosmo to Imperial fleets in return. The Spark of Ignition sinecure was abrogated.

Grendel.t: The Senate moved to elect an Ambassador to the Grendel, with the title to be appointed at the first Senate session of the Autumn Equinox 388YE.

Highguard.t: The Grand Inspiration of the Way was amended twice, adding seven serene gardens funded with 50 thrones and a Choristers' Balcony meant to bring Highborn cantors to it. Research was also commissioned into the Dauntless Light chapter's conflict with the Child of Faithless Grief.

Navarr.t: The fourth Navarr army was raised in Oakways, Miaren, to fight the vallorn with the support of an eternal, and a Navarr wayhouse was commissioned in Murderdale in the Barrens. The Nightingale Chorus wayhouse was built in Grovesyard, Astolat, and the Dancer's Rest in Serenael, Miaren, was refined with inspirational art.

The League.t: Spiral gained the Palace of Mists upgrade, the Northern Way and new edifices in Apulian. Tassato gained Martim de Tassato's Clattering Curtain Theatre and the proposed Publishing Clearing House in Mestra. Temeschwar's senator also secured mercantile tariffs with the Sarcophan Delves.

Urizen.t: Herminius of Urizen was appointed Ambassador to Asavea. The Spark of Ignition mana sinecure, announced by the Crystal Architect of the Spires with its title to be appointed by Urizen senators, was abrogated by the Senate.

Varushka.t: The fourth Varushkan army was raised in Karsk, and Sławomir Rabovich Bolotstrazh became Imperial Consul and embargoed Zemelslo. Karsk's senator proposed the crime of Moral Injury, and the Wyrding Tower ministry was commissioned in Livardz, Volodmartz.

Wintermark.t: The motion to raise a fourth Wintermark army in Kallavesa failed. However, Bears Rest was built as a mana sinecure in Northspires, Hahnmark, and Wintermark senators secured the Beoraidh Docks commission and appraisals of the Suranni armies and of spreading the Way.

388YE Summer Solstice Senate sessions.o: At the Summer Solstice 388YE the Senate raised new Navarr, Varushkan and Marcher armies, created the religious crime of Moral Injury and redefined idolatry. It also commissioned a range of buildings, docks and great works across the Empire and made several key appointments.

Spiral/Apulus.t: Two edifices were commissioned in Apulus: a statue honouring the researchers killed by the Whisper Gallery, and the Wayward House apartments in the city of Apulian to host Jarmish pilgrims of the Way.

Spiral.t: The Palace of Apulian was to be upgraded to the Palace of Mists, making sea attacks harder and raising Spiral's taxes by five thrones a season. The Northern Way great work was begun to give safe passage from the city of Apulian to Zenith.

388YE Summer Solstice Synod judgements.d: The General Assembly mandated that citizens forgo the Druj secret knowledge of fear, leaving it open only to Urizen, Varushka and Wintermark. It consecrated Elos Harbour and the Great Chain of Sarvos with true liao, and recognised Barabbas as an exemplar of Ambition. The Heresy of the Spawn was proscribed, while bargaining with eternals was declared not idolatry. Highborn efforts focused on completing the Grand Inspiration in Bastion. Wintermark's mandate targeted the servants of Agramant at Treachers Dagger. Many inquisitions were called, new cardinals were appointed for Courage, Wisdom and Pride, and the Virtue Fund was largely spent on rewards.

Dawn.t: The Dawnish Assembly declared that Dawn would spill no more Montanian blood and paused the civil service's Barrens roads appraisal so the three orc septs there could be consulted. Its Greenwood Manor mandate was enacted over a rival mandate, and inquisitions were called on Earl Temperance of the Groves and Earl Estelle de Sanguine.

Druj.t: Navarr and the Imperial Orcs named Ioan Longshadow and Skywise Rykana to lead the rescue of the Great Forest Orcs from Druj enslavement. A mandate also urged most Imperial nations to forgo the Druj's secret knowledge of creating fear.

Grendel.t: The Synod rewarded the Imperial Spymaster with 12 wains of weirwood to build a base for counter-espionage against the four known Grendel spy networks. Freeborn priests also urged the people of Grendel-held Feroz to trade with the Protectorate of Morajasse.

Highguard.t: Highborn priests pressed to complete the Grand Inspiration in Bastion, calling choristers there and granting the inquisitorial court its next rooms. They also took the Seven Bells to the gardens and named Brother Nathaniel as Custodian of the Greenwatch. A Varushkan mandate for a new Holy City at Bastion was not enacted following the crisis of Vardas.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Imperial Orc Assembly sent Skywise Rykana, seconded by Bloodcrow Meep, to lead its forces into the Mallum to save the Great Forest Orcs. It added Udak's words to the Annals of the Ancestors and demanded that the Marchers return the bones of the Autumn Hammers.

Jotun.t: Marcher priests celebrated Mitwold being freed of the Jotun and named the walls of Meade Bree's Stand. They also urged Bregaslanders to rise up and aid the Imperial armies marching to liberate them from Jotun occupation.

Navarr.t: Navarr swore oaths never to rebuild Hacynian and never to use Surut to burn the Great Forest Orcs' groves, and utterly rejected Agramant's offer over Therunin. Ioan Longshadow was named to lead the rescue of the Great Forest Orcs, while the Golden Axe moved to begin reclaiming Therunin.

The Brass Coast.t: The Freeborn Assembly made defending its borders its highest calling after the loss of Feroz and Madruga. It also mandated that the salvage of the Salt Guard in the Bay of Oran honour the dead, defended the Marracossans' tattoos, and challenged the Spider's Tollkeep.

The League.t: League priests urged patience over the Tassatan Hills ilium mine negotiations and called for a pilgrimage to learn from the Marcher orcs in Mournwold. Merchant-princes were sent to court the Sand Fishers, League bravos were cleared to fight the vallorn, and Estella Lucati was appointed Archbishop of Capodomus.

Urizen.t: Urizen welcomed orcs displaced from Thornfen to settle in the nation and asked its sentinels to prepare for the beast Kroll's return to the Sarangrave. The Elos consecration added Hero's Journey to Urizen lore, and Urizen kept access to Druj fear-lore.

Varushka.t: A Varushkan mandate to help Wintermark master Tsirku was not upheld, and another for a new Holy City at Bastion lapsed after the crisis of Vardas. Inquisitions were called on the Ketsov, on Radomir over the Wolf Carousel, and on Boyar Sigismund, and Varushka remained one of the nations allowed to study Druj fear-lore.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark consecrated the memory of the Fist of the Mountains at Elos and entered Nora Falcon's Light in the Chronicle of Heroes. It offered its knowledge of Blood on the Snow to Navarr and to those going to Tsirku, and sent the Banner-bearer of Atkonaroq against Agramant's servants at Treachers Dagger.

388YE Summer Solstice Synod judgements.o: At the Summer Solstice 388YE the Synod considered over 170 judgements, rejecting the attempt to strike the Doctrine of the Howling Abyss and upholding mandates, proscriptions, inquisitions, appointments and rewards across the Empire. The Navarr and Imperial Orc assemblies named the leaders of the raid to rescue the Great Forest Orcs from the Druj.

Feroz/Morajasse.t: Following Spring's guidance, the Freeborn Assembly called on the Freeborn of Feroz to trade with their neighbours in the Protectorate of Morajasse for mutual prosperity.

Reikos/Broken Ride.t: The proposed consecration of the Memorial to the Silent Bell in Broken Ride, honouring those who died learning of Druj fear, was not upheld.

The Barrens/Heart of Peytaht.t: The surviving Montanians remain in the Heart of Peytaht with the Great Forest Orcs. Dawn vowed to answer them with words rather than swords, and the Freeborn pledged to protect their children.

Tsirku/Warriors' Gate.t: Wintermark's mandate turns the Hunt the Suaq Wastes effort against Agramant's servants at Treachers Dagger. If at least 5,000 strength supports it, they will be scattered and a chance to permanently sever the regio will arise.

Bastion.t: The Grand Inspiration in Bastion gains a choristers' balcony and its inquisitorial court rooms, and the Stone Library stands ready to publish the Seven Bells archive. A reward to complete Berechiah's Basilica was upheld but no weirwood remained, and the Holy City mandate was not enacted.

Feroz.t: Pilgrims of Prosperity will travel to Feroz, after which the civil service will present an opportunity to restore its people's dignity, freedom and prosperity. Priests also urged Ferozi not to accept poverty wages and to trade with the Protectorate of Morajasse.

Karsk.t: Mentioned in passing: a donation of 1 throne and 4 crowns was made to the Virtue Fund at the counting house of Karsk.

Madruga.t: Mentioned in passing: the Freeborn Assembly cited the loss of Madruga when declaring border defence its highest calling.

Redoubt.t: Because the Elos consecration was not upheld with a greater majority, Wintermark and Urizen armies and navies will not gain improved natural resupply while in Redoubt.

Reikos.t: A writ to consecrate the Memorial to the Silent Bell in Broken Ride to Vigilance was not upheld. A small donation was also made at the Reikos counting house.

Semmerholm.t: Mentioned in passing: a donation of 1 throne and 3 crowns was made to the Virtue Fund at the counting house of Semmerholm.

Tassato.t: The League Assembly urged patience while the Forge and Furnace Fellowship and the League senators negotiate over the Tassatan Hills ilium mine. It noted that the senators had already given the Tassatan workers an initial recompense.

Temeschwar.t: In a penance, Gancio di Catazar was told to repay the contributors to the Silver Fox mines and to work with the Senator for Temeschwar to commission them again.

The Barrens.t: The Dawnish Assembly paused the Barrens roads appraisal so the three orc septs living there could be consulted. An inquisition was also called on behalf of Dawn and the Barrens into Earl Estelle de Sanguine and the White Butterfly cult.

Tsirku.t: Wintermark dares to master Tsirku and its priests will teach anyone travelling there to resist Blood on the Snow, though Varushka's mandate to help was not upheld. Its mandate also turned the fight against Agramant's servants at Treachers Dagger.

388YE Summer Solstice event schedule.d: On Saturday afternoon, nations held senator elections in their camps: Feroz (Brass Coast auction), Weirwater, Bastion, Sarvos and Spiral, Mitwold, Miaren, Redoubt, Karov and Sermersuaq. Tally of the Votes elections for national titles followed from 3:30pm, including the Vigilant Swan, Arch of the Sky, Stone Smith, Reeve of Drycastle, Northbound Trademaster, Boyar of the Iron Roads and Dean of Runesmith's Caution. The timetable also listed Senate, Conclave, Military Council and Synod sessions and deadlines, symposia, battles, the Grand Tourney to elect the Knight-protector of Summer, the Bourse seat auction and many citizen-organised meetings.

Dawn.t: Dawn chose Weirwater's senator at 2:30pm on Saturday after the grand tourney, and elected the Reeve of Drycastle and Envoy to the Karass at Glory Square at 5pm.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: Grendel is not named; Feroz, which it held that season, appears only as the subject of a Brass Coast senator auction.

Highguard.t: Highguard began its inquisition of candidates for Bastion's senator at 2pm, then elected the Vigilant Swan and Cinderpath Custodian at the Chapel at 3:30pm.

Navarr.t: Navarr chose Miaren's senator at 1:15pm, immediately after the standing, and elected the Broker of Treji Wayhouse at the Standing Circle at 3:30pm.

The League.t: The League elected senators for Sarvos and Spiral at 3:30pm by presentation of collected bonds, and chose the Northbound Trademaster and Keeper of the Tome at the Plaza at 5pm.

The Marches.t: Marcher landowners gathered at 1:30pm to elect Mitwold's senator, and the Stone Smith and Reeve of the Happiston Mana Exchange were elected at the Community Hall at 4:30pm.

Urizen.t: Urizen held a demos for Redoubt's senator from 1pm to 1:30pm, and elected the Arch of the Sky, Quaymaster of the Hesychian Docks, Architect of the Crucible and Custodian of the Bleak Tower near the Net of Heaven at 4pm.

Varushka.t: Varushka began questioning candidates for Karov's senator at 1:45pm, and elected the Granites of Veltsgorsk, Boyar of the Iron Roads, Keeper of the Bonehives and Custodian of the Shchaslyvyy Spile at the Central Hearth at 5:30pm.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark set down jars for fifteen minutes from 2pm to elect Sermersuaq's senator, and elected the Dean of Runesmith's Caution at the Tree of Names at 5:30pm.

388YE Summer Solstice event schedule.o: The schedule set out the senator elections, Tally of the Votes elections and the timetable of meetings and sessions for the Summer Solstice summit of 388YE.

Bastion.t: Bastion's senator was chosen through a Highguard inquisition of candidates beginning at 2pm on Saturday.

Feroz.t: A senator for Feroz was to be chosen by a Brass Coast auction beginning at 1pm on Saturday.

Karov.t: Karov's senator was chosen by Varushka, with questioning of candidates beginning at 1:45pm on Saturday.

Miaren.t: Miaren's senator was chosen by Navarr at 1:15pm on Saturday, immediately after the standing.

Mitwold.t: Mitwold's senator was elected when Marcher landowners gathered at 1:30pm on Saturday.

Redoubt.t: Redoubt's senator was chosen through an Urizen demos held between 1pm and 1:30pm on Saturday.

Sarvos.t: Sarvos's senator was elected by the League at 3:30pm on Saturday through presentation of collected bonds.

Sermersuaq.t: Sermersuaq's senator was elected by Wintermark, with voting jars placed down for fifteen minutes from 2pm on Saturday.

Spiral.t: Spiral's senator was elected by the League at 3:30pm on Saturday alongside Sarvos, through presentation of collected bonds.

Weirwater.t: Weirwater's senator was chosen by Dawn at 2:30pm on Saturday, upon return from the grand tourney.

388YE Summer Solstice interlude.d: The 350-throne Guerdon went to units supporting the Argent Sword and Summer Storm in Mareave, the Drakes in Mitwold and the Red Wind Corsairs in Madruga, and to those spying on the Thule in the Forest of Ulnak. Military units could aid the Thule Earthquake Drummers against the Druj, map the city beneath Apulian or search for Prince Teodore duSesna, scout or sabotage the scouting of Tsirku, adventure there, or fight the threats in Spiral. Freeborn fleets could raid Leen or support the Wings of Kobol at Free Landing. Rivers of Life lay on Mareave, Hammers of Fury on Hercynia and Tassato. Sarangrave, Spiral, Madruga and Miekarova were touched by other magic, and the Omphalos and Splintered House were completed.

Dawn.t: A Dawnish Assembly mandate by Ser Decimus of House de Bastion let Dawnish citizens convert resources into military units at no cost. Dawnish units could also map the city below, fight in Spiral or adventure in Tsirku, though they suffered from the cold there.

Druj.t: The Thule Earthquake Drummers continued their invasion of the Druj-held Forest of Ulnak and invited Imperial mercenaries to join them. Freeborn fleets were offered a raid on Leen to free slaves, though it would not weaken the Druj war effort.

Grendel.t: Grendel Wind Lord Moraith, who hates the Iron Confederacy, secretly arranged for Imperial fleets to illegally help the Children of Wrecks fight the Wings of Kobol at Free Landing.

Highguard.t: Congregations across the Empire could preach the coming Second Age of Virtue, sending pilgrims to Bastion to help raise the Grand Inspiration of the Way, following the Highborn Assembly's highest calling.

Imperial Orcs.t: Mareave, which they shared with the Grendel, was under Rivers of Life. Guerdon shares went to units supporting the Argent Sword and Summer Storm there, and Frozen Citadels were raised in three of its regions.

Jotun.t: Mentioned in passing: well-supported scouting of Tsirku could reveal any significant Jotun presence and connections to Tromsa or Skallahn.

Navarr.t: Hammers of Fury hastened the mustering of a new army in Hercynia at the cost of two ingots per mine, replaced with warm ashes. Navarr could take a free resource in Holberg after the Splintered House was completed, while Navarr fleets faced a two-rank penalty trading with Axos.

The Brass Coast.t: Freeborn fleets could raid Leen to free slaves or support the Wings of Kobol at Free Landing, where 4000 strength would let them reach the ruins of Atalaya and recover relics of the founding. Hammers of Industry sped the Municipal Docks in Calvos Sound, and the Red Wind Corsairs' supporters received Guerdon shares.

The League.t: Spiral saw the Myriad Market opened in Apulian, a Night enchantment of inspiring dreams, and continued efforts against the horrors of the Black Plateau. League units could help map the city below Apulian, Tassato was under Hammers of Fury, and Frideswide Adelaar van Holberg's mandate eased conversion to and upgrading of businesses.

The Marches.t: Marcher congregations could preach Pride in support of the Marcher orcs. Richard Conscience's mandate made it easier to convert to and upgrade farms, Drakes supporters in Mitwold received Guerdon shares, and Marcher fleets gained a bonus trading at Caitun in Faraden.

Thule.t: The Thule Earthquake Drummers pressed their invasion of the Forest of Ulnak, paying Imperial units mana crystals to join them, while the Empire and the Karass spied on Thule attempts to claim a Black Lotus. Mists now barred all but the ritualists from the Painted Caves in Thule-held Mieriada.

Urizen.t: With the Omphalos complete, Urizen characters could take a free resource in Spiral, and Urizen units could map the city below or fight in Spiral. Sarangrave was enchanted and cursed with Autumn magic, and Pillars of Adamant was added to Urizen lore.

Varushka.t: A Night enchantment shrouded the Painted Caves in Mieriada, the Thule-held region of Varushkan Miekarova, and Varushkan units escaped the cold penalty when scouting Tsirku.

Wintermark.t: Yrkja Riansson Sigeing's mandate let Winterfolk convert resources into military units at no cost, and Winterfolk units could adventure in Tsirku without a cold penalty. Kallavesa received several regional rituals, Talon's Alb was added to Runesmith's Law, and Winterfolk fleets gained a bonus at Caitun.

388YE Summer Solstice interlude.o: Downtime after the 388YE Spring Equinox opened, setting out the Imperial Guerdon allocations, new opportunities for military units, fleets and congregations, and the enchantments, curses and other effects at work across the Empire that season.

Kallavesa/Kallavesa Marsh.t: The Sussivari Frost Coven cast Dripping Echoes of the Fen on Kallavesa Marsh twice.

Kallavesa/Rundhal Marsh.t: The Sussivari Frost Coven cast Dripping Echoes of the Fen on Rundhal Marsh.

Kallavesa/Wittal Grove.t: The Coven of the Horned Hare cast Forge the Wooden Fastness on Wittal Grove.

Madruga/Calvos Sound.t: Thanks to Hammers of Industry, the Municipal Docks in Calvos Sound were expected to be completed by the start of the Autumn Equinox 388YE.

Madruga/Free Landing.t: Freeborn fleets could support the Suranni Wings of Kobol attacking Free Landing, with 4000 strength opening the ruins of Atalaya to them, while some fleets were secretly enlisted to aid the Children of Wrecks against them.

Mareave/Clisearn.t: Ashen Flame raised a Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae in Clisearn.

Mareave/Icarion.t: Ashen Flame raised a Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae in Icarion.

Mareave/Nadir.t: Phoenix Rising raised a Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae in Nadir.

Miekarova/Mieriada.t: Mists, illusions and false lights now lead travellers astray from the Painted Caves, which only those who performed the ritual can enter.

Salt Flats of Sanath/Leen Rarckan.t: Freeborn fleets could sail to Leen Rarckan to raid Leen and free slaves, with outcomes ranging from a botched raid to hundreds freed.

Sarangrave/Nesustak Forest.t: The Coven of the Horned Hare cast Forge the Wooden Fastness on Nesustak Forest.

Bastion.t: Pilgrims inspired by congregations preaching the Second Age of Virtue were to travel to Bastion to help build the Grand Inspiration of the Way.

Forest of Ulnak.t: The Thule Earthquake Drummers continued their invasion against the Druj here, while Imperial units working with Karass scouts spied on Thule attempts to claim a Black Lotus. That effort earned Guerdon shares and could enable use of the Sentinel Gate with 4000 strength.

Hercynia.t: Hammers of Fury hastened the mustering of a new Imperial army here, while each mine produced two fewer ingots but gained a pouch of warm ashes.

Holberg.t: The Splintered House wayhouse was completed here, allowing Navarr characters to take a new personal resource in Holberg for free.

Kallavesa.t: Dripping Echoes of the Fen was cast on Kallavesa Marsh and Rundhal Marsh, and Forge the Wooden Fastness on Wittal Grove.

Madruga.t: Hammers of Industry put the Municipal Docks in Calvos Sound on course for completion by the Autumn Equinox. Red Wind Corsairs supporters received Guerdon shares, and Free Landing was the target of the Wings of Kobol.

Mareave.t: Rivers of Life infused the territory's waters with healing power and reduced army casualties. Supporters of the Argent Sword and Summer Storm here received Guerdon shares, and Frozen Citadels were raised in Clisearn, Icarion and Nadir.

Miekarova.t: A Night enchantment wrapped the paths to the Painted Caves in Mieriada in mists and illusions, so that only those who performed the ritual could enter.

Mitwold.t: Mentioned in passing: military units supporting the Drakes in Mitwold received shares of the Guerdon.

Otkodov.t: Mentioned in passing: Tsirku scouting could reveal connections to Otkodov, and the Ambassador to Otkodov was named as one way the Thule might learn of the spying in Ulnak.

Salt Flats of Sanath.t: Freeborn fleets were offered a raid on the Druj city of Leen to free slaves, with greater strength freeing hundreds.

Sarangrave.t: An Autumn arcane projection of unknown effect and an Autumn curse granting an intuitive sense of danger were both laid on the territory, and Forge the Wooden Fastness was cast in Nesustak Forest.

Sermersuaq.t: Mentioned in passing: supernatural beasts of Blood-on-the-Snow are said to come down from Tsirku into Sermersuaq.

Skallahn.t: Mentioned in passing: Tsirku scouting at 3000 strength could reveal any connections to Skallahn.

Spiral.t: Units could fight the Black Plateau threats in Swords Against Darkness, map the city below Apulian or search for Prince duSesna. The Myriad Market opened in Apulian, a Night enchantment brought inspiring dreams, and the Omphalos was completed.

Tassato.t: Hammers of Fury hastened the mustering of a new Imperial army here, while each mine produced two fewer ingots but gained a pouch of warm ashes.

Tromsa.t: Mentioned in passing: Tsirku scouting at 3000 strength could reveal any connections to Tromsa.

Tsirku.t: The Tsirku scouting network could explore one region a season, opposed by units hired through the Whisper Gallery to conceal its secrets, while Dawnish and Winterfolk units could adventure there for treasures of the wasteland.

388YE Summer Solstice winds of fortune.d: The winds included highest callings for Navarr, Dawn, the League, the Imperial Orcs and several Synod assemblies. Two new national armies mustered, one in Tassato and one in Hercynia. Diplomatic winds covered Jarm, the Commonwealth, Sumaah, Axos, the Iron Confederacy and several orc nations. Eighty fleet captains backed a Freeborn armada of almost fifteen thousand ships that raided Leen Rarckan and rescued thousands of slaves. The Barrens roads appraisal awaits guidance from the Dawnish Assembly. Magistrate Abraham apologised to Claudia Varkulova Remislav. A Grendel band threatened Professor Gelberg in Reikos. Thirty-five minor and five major conjunctions from the Spring Equinox were resolved, including miasma pillars destroyed across the Sarangrave.

Dawn.t: Dawn's National Assembly made the fight against the vallorn near the Barrens its highest calling, and Emperor Vesna addressed Dawn after its victory over the manticore. The civil service also awaits Dawnish Assembly guidance on where roads in the Barrens should run.

Druj.t: The Druj lost thousands of slaves when the Freeborn raided Leen Rarckan. The Imperial Orcs also uncovered a chance to free the Great Forest orcs held at Druj weirwood groves, and several Druj forces and miasma pillars in the Sarangrave were destroyed.

Grendel.t: A band of Grendel Wave Riders posing as Unshackled travelled up the Couros to assassinate Professor Gelberg in Reikos. The Grendel also sent messages to the Empire in the Myth makers wind and faced Imperial heroes at Ohwinn Scour in Clisearn.

Highguard.t: The Highborn expressed peerless kinship with the Brass Coast by studying the firebrand movement in Anduz. Highborn wounded were rescued at Chalcis Mount, refugees were treated in High Chalcis, and Grendel assassins threatened a Commonwealth scholar in Reikos.

Imperial Orcs.t: Skywise Rykana led a delegation to the ancestors of the Great Forest Orcs and learned of a threat to orcs enslaved by the Druj. The Imperial Orcs also proposed help for impoverished Feroz, and Rykana served as field marshal at Ohwinn Scour.

Jotun.t: The Jotun sent messages in the Myth makers diplomatic wind. Lasambrian Jotun and Jotun forces were left unopposed at Meade Meadow and Drayham Mere, while the Lasambrian banner was recovered from Beatriz's Field in Reinos.

Navarr.t: The Navarr Assembly's highest calling urged its people to arm and train the League against the vallorn. The third Navarr army mustered in Hercynia, and Rowyn of the Waystone Path is to decide its name and quality.

The Brass Coast.t: Freeborn corsairs and kohan led the overwhelming raid on Leen, and charitable Freeborn families now care for over a thousand freed people. The Freeborn also faced proposals to rebuild the bridges between Madruga and Feroz, the rise of the firebrand movement, and a chance to consecrate Ahraz's Tomb.

The League.t: The League Assembly's highest calling seeks to bring sapient beings of all kinds into the League and the Way. The third League army mustered in Tassato, Navarr offered help against the vallorn, and events in Apulian and at the Chains of Sarvos offered further opportunities.

The Marches.t: The Marches faced troubles in Mitwold, hauntings in Bregasland, questions over Marcher orcs and the scions of Red Walder. The Meade Meadow conjunction went untaken and the foot-the-ball trophy was lost, but a cache at Maggie's Bulwark was recovered.

Thule.t: The Thule sent messages to the Empire in the Myth makers wind. A report on the Thule conquest of the Forest of Ulnak, alongside the Earthquake Drummers, was made public, and Imperial heroes recovered Thule material at the Bound Glade.

Urizen.t: Urizeni stargazers worked in the Sarangrave on defences against the vallorn of Bendol, and Andronikos of the Lighthouse-That-Was led the warding of the Mantifent Stones. The Synod also intends to consecrate the restored Elos docks in Redoubt.

Varushka.t: Varushka was tagged in the Tsirku mapping effort, and conjunctions in Karov, Karsk, Ossium and Volodmartz recovered the Rat Idol, destroyed a bandit vale and killed the Kallad. Magistrate Abraham publicly apologised to the Winter magician Claudia Varkulova Remislav.

Wintermark.t: The Mediator of Hyljehal made contact with the Hylje leader Koskinen. In Hahnmark, Valdr Grieversson was dedicated to Loyalty, and Hallr Winterborn was killed in Sermersuaq. Winterfolk fleet owners were also tagged in the Pride in the Marches wind.

388YE Summer Solstice winds of fortune.o: The Summer Solstice 388YE winds of fortune set out forty situations facing the Empire, from national and assembly highest callings to foreign diplomacy. The page also reported a highly successful Freeborn raid on Leen that freed thousands of Druj slaves, along with the outcomes of the Spring Equinox conjunctions.

Astolat/Withy.t: Igraine's Regio was fixed, and Éamon Ashenmourn de Cordraco should know more.

Bregasland/Grey Fens.t: The Mere Stone was not erected at Drayham Mere and the Ullsmere Rock was stolen. The region gained the haunted quality, Grey Walkers remain, and the fate of Friar Bloughton is unknown.

Bregasland/The Rushes.t: The General of the Narwhal's Spear's band killed the yegarra at Harry's Hole, and the army was resupplied.

Brocéliande/Elerael.t: All the hunting ettercaps at Longberth Trod were killed.

Feroz/Afarjasse.t: The Hand of Dumon was killed at Abril's Pasture, and the herd of Afar is safe.

Feroz/Cazar Straits.t: Mentioned in passing: the Leen raid armada passed out through the straits, careful to avoid the Iron Confederacy.

Feroz/Morajasse.t: Mentioned in passing: the Protectorate of Morajasse wrote the Oran operation appraisal and sent messages in the Myth makers wind.

Feroz/Oranseri.t: The Corsair of Oran reclaimed the Brazen Links at Sisters' Meadow, and the Leen armada set out from and returned to Oran.

Forest of Ulnak/Grimfen Mire.t: All the ghosts at the Bound Glade were exorcised while recovering the Thule's material.

Hahnmark/Kronemark.t: Eevi of the Gadrai's meeting at Grieversonn Farmstead saw Valdr Grieversson dedicated to Loyalty.

Hahnmark/Valasmark.t: The attempt to recover a letter at the Fallen Tree had an uncertain result, and Morgan Drifting Bough should know more.

Hercynia/Deer's Folly.t: The Speaker of the Vallornguard's band killed all the ettercaps at Greenmount and destroyed their structure.

Kallavesa/West Marsh.t: A hetjuveisla took place at Gull's Isle Hall, and those who went should know more.

Kallavesa/Wittal Grove.t: Mentioned in passing: Grimnir of Wittal Grove was tagged in the Keys of blood wind.

Karov/Wieliczka.t: The Rat Idol was recovered from cultists of the Night Below at Maria's Descent.

Karsk/Branoc.t: Named citizens met Taysa of the Black Feathers at the Hall of the Bloodwise, with an uncertain outcome.

Karsk/Crowslook.t: The effort to treat the Gregadze at Skylost Clearing had an unclear result.

Madruga/Crucible.t: The fight against the dire astacids in the Egnar Range cost Imperial casualties and left the Camp of the Sand Crab in ruins.

Mareave/Beoraidh.t: Mentioned in passing: the city-state of Beoraidh sent messages in the Myth makers diplomatic wind.

Mareave/Clisearn.t: At Ohwinn Scour, Iskander's Donjon was summoned and Scutt-Tadgh was taken to Anvil. Some of the Tholdie Rotary were rescued, Fergus Konnaugh was cursed and the Blades of Evdokia were killed.

Mitwold/Meade March.t: Meade Meadow went untaken, so Fjorknae orcs were hired and the foot-the-ball trophy was lost. At Maggie's Bulwark, a yegarra was defeated and the cache was recovered.

Necropolis/Longbeach.t: Mentioned in passing: Longbeach is not discussed directly on this summary page.

Ossium/Drownbark Forest.t: Strange wagon raiders at Sarakov Point were rid of their spiritual ailments, and the Kallad at Nadezhda's Enclosure were all killed.

Reikos/Chalcis Mount.t: The Champion of Loyalty's band killed the ettercaps at South Downs and rescued wounded Highborn, who were treated in Anvil.

Reinos/Bastasor.t: The Lasambrian banner was recovered from Beatriz's Field.

Salt Flats of Sanath/Leen Rarckan.t: The Freeborn armada landed at Leen Rarckan, fought off Druj ambushes in its alleys and freed thousands of slaves.

Sarangrave/Bendol.t: Urizeni stargazers sought ways to defend against the vallorn of Bendol, which had earlier pushed into Nesustak Forest.

Sarangrave/Bloodwater Marsh.t: At Mantifent's Bier the Mantifent Stones were warded, the Bilious Breath's leaders were killed and two Urizen seers were rescued. The Toxic Pillar was destroyed, and named citizens met the rebels at Dandelion Glade.

Sarangrave/Kroll.t: Both miasma pillars at Kreeflirn were destroyed, with some Imperial casualties.

Sarangrave/Nesustak Forest.t: The Feverbank Trees conjunction went untaken, so vallornspawn attacked the forest and the Envenomed Claws remain a threat. The rebels are recovering, and the fate of the hares of Irra Harah is unknown.

Sarangrave/Thornfen.t: The Overgrown and Haunted Pillars were destroyed, but the blinded ghosts at Stonesedge were not eliminated and remain a threat.

Sarangrave/Turan Flats.t: Sept members were rescued from blinded ghosts at Dahis Outskirts. At Kullflirn, the Druj were killed and the miasma pillar destroyed.

Sarvos/Uccelini.t: The Ambassador to the Iron Confederacy's band killed the Hand of Dumon at Bertolli's Glebe.

Sermersuaq/Suaq Wastes.t: Hallr Winterborn was killed at Desolate Stretch and the banner was recovered.

Spiral/Apulus.t: The Imperials at Broken Lea were repulsed, and the Vorlach Adventurers escaped Spiral.

The Barrens/Bitter Strand.t: The Empire ceded Bitter Strand to the Rahvin, so roads through it would need their permission or force. If the Dawnish Assembly stays silent, the default plan would run roads straight through it.

Tsirku/Warriors' Gate.t: The ongoing effort to map the frozen wastes centres on Warriors' Gate, as set out in the wind of the same name.

Volodmartz/Livardz.t: The suffering of the Shadow Fellowship in the Sunless Vale was ended.

Volodmartz/Murupa.t: The Academy found and destroyed the "bandit" vale in the Forest of Blades.

Astolat.t: The Senator for Astolat oversaw the repair of Igraine's Regio in Withy, and the senator was also tagged in the A wizard did it wind.

Bay of Catazar.t: Mentioned in passing: the Leen raid armada sailed out of the bay into the Sea of Sighs and later returned to its western shores at Oran and Calvos.

Bregasland.t: The Drayham Mere conjunction went untaken, so the Ullsmere Rock was stolen and the Grey Fens became haunted. At Harry's Hole, a yegarra was killed and the Narwhal's Spear was resupplied.

Brocéliande.t: The Knight of the Greenwood's band killed all the hunting ettercaps at Longberth Trod in Elerael.

Feroz.t: Feroz was the subject of a Morajassan proposal to reconnect it with Madruga and of an Imperial Orc plan to aid the impoverished territory. The Brazen Links were reclaimed in Oranseri and the Hand of Dumon was stopped in Afarjasse.

Fjorknae.t: Mentioned in passing: because Meade Meadow went untaken, a warband of Fjorknae orcs has been hired.

Forest of Ulnak.t: A report on the Thule conquest of the forest was made public, and the High Exorcist's band cleared the ghosts at the Bound Glade in Grimfen Mire.

Hahnmark.t: Valdr Grieversson was dedicated to Loyalty at his farmstead in Kronemark. The recovery of a letter at the Fallen Tree in Valasmark remains uncertain.

Hercynia.t: The third Navarr army mustered in Hercynia, with lingering effects of the Hammers of Fury on local artisans. All ettercaps at Greenmount were killed and their structure destroyed.

Kallavesa.t: Ingrid Talon-of-the-Mark's band took part in a hetjuveisla at Gull's Isle Hall, and Grimnir of Wittal Grove was tagged in the Keys of blood wind.

Karov.t: The Senator for Temeschwar's band recovered the Rat Idol from cultists of the Night Below at Maria's Descent.

Karsk.t: Named citizens met Taysa of the Black Feathers in Branoc, and the Apothecaries Guild's effort to treat the Gregadze in Crowslook has an unclear outcome.

Madruga.t: The Oran operation proposes restoring the bridges to Feroz that were washed away. At the Egnar Range in Crucible, dire astacids inflicted Imperial casualties and the Camp of the Sand Crab was left in ruins.

Mareave.t: At Ohwinn Scour in Clisearn, Imperial heroes summoned Iskander's Donjon and fought the Grendel advance. Beoraidh sent diplomatic messages, and the Senator for Mareave was tagged in the Myth makers wind.

Mitwold.t: Pride in the Marches took stock of the troubled situation in Mitwold. The untaken Meade Meadow conjunction cost the foot-the-ball trophy, while a cache from Maggie's Bulwark reached the Bailiff of Meade.

Necropolis.t: Mentioned in passing: Necropolis is not discussed directly on this summary page.

Ossium.t: Imperial units supported the Earthquake Drummers in north-eastern Ossium. In Drownbark Forest, wagon raiders were cured of spiritual ailments and the Kallad were killed.

Otkodov.t: Mentioned in passing: Otkodov appears in the Myth makers diplomacy, and its ambassador is tagged in several winds.

Redoubt.t: The Synod intends to consecrate the restored Elos docks as an inspirational location, built around the last banner of the Fist of the Mountains.

Reikos.t: Grendel Wave Riders are hunting Professor Gelberg in southern Reikos, and Nekoda of the Shattered Tower is charged with his defence. Refugees and wounded Highborn were also aided in High Chalcis and Chalcis Mount.

Reinos.t: The Champion of Ambition's band recovered the Lasambrian banner from Beatriz's Field in Bastasor.

Salt Flats of Sanath.t: A Freeborn armada struck Leen Rarckan and rescued thousands of slaves, while Druj garrisons elsewhere in the Salt Flats were occupied.

Sarangrave.t: Urizeni stargazers sought defences against the vallorn of Bendol, and many miasma pillars were destroyed across the territory. The untaken Feverbank conjunction let vallornspawn attack into Nesustak Forest, and blinded ghosts remain in Thornfen.

Sarvos.t: A chance arose to strengthen the consecrated Chains of Sarvos, and the Hand of Dumon was killed in Uccelini. Some freed former Imperials were landed at Sarvos.

Sea of Snow.t: Mentioned in passing: the Sea of Snow is not named directly on this summary page.

Segura.t: Mentioned in passing: the Freeborn welcomed the Highborn delegation exploring the firebrand movement to Anduz.

Sermersuaq.t: Hallr Winterborn was killed and a banner recovered at Desolate Stretch, and fans of Sermersuaq were tagged in the Hylje wind.

Shavronne.t: Mentioned in passing: the Leen raid armada sailed through Shavronne's waters on its way south.

Spiral.t: The confluence in Apulian reached a crescendo as military units helped map the city below. At Broken Lea, Imperials were repulsed and the Vorlach Adventurers escaped.

Tassato.t: The third League army mustered in Tassato under Cesare Sanguineo Rezia Di Tassato. Its rival military academies are also staging a tourney for 14 to 18 year olds.

Temeschwar.t: Mentioned in passing: the Senator for Temeschwar was responsible for recovering the Rat Idol in Karov.

The Barrens.t: The Barrens roads appraisal is stalled until the Dawnish Assembly gives guidance, as roads would cross lands claimed by the Great Forest Orcs, the Karass and the Rahvin. Dawn also aims to fight the three vallorn hearts adjacent to the Barrens.

Tsirku.t: Efforts to map the frozen wastes of Tsirku continue in the Warriors' Gate wind.

Veroigne.t: Mentioned in passing: the Leen raid armada sailed through Veroigne's waters.

Volodmartz.t: The Academy destroyed a "bandit" vale in Murupa, and the suffering of the Shadow Fellowship was ended in Livardz.

388YE Summer Solstice winds of war.d: Separate Winds covered Madruga (Phantasms and foam), Mareave (Mithril and rope), Sarangrave (Thorn and bone) and the Forest of Ulnak (Who can you trust?). Three battle opportunities were identified, two to be chosen by the generals: containing the dead in Sarangrave and raiding the Druj in the Forest of Ulnak, both against the Druj, and opening the vaults in Mareave against the Grendel. Nations' force weights were listed, with Dawn, Wintermark and Navarr the largest contributors. More than thirty conjunctions were scheduled. Three were described in detail: killing a Druj het threatening Dawnguard, slaying the Servants of the Burnt at a herald of Skathe's request, and destroying a Druj miasma pillar in Therunin. Military considerations listed national orders, mandated border patrols and army bonuses.

Dawn.t: Dawn contributed the largest force weight (67), and its Knight of Dawnguard and Knight-protector of Winter were charged with conjunctions against Druj and Surut's servants in the Barrens. Dawnish armies may not take Cautious Advance, Give Ground or, until Summer 389YE, Steady Conquest against the Druj, though they may use Triumphant Charge against them.

Druj.t: The Druj were the opposition in the Sarangrave and Forest of Ulnak battle opportunities and in many conjunctions, including raids and pacts with heralds in the Barrens and a miasma pillar in Therunin. They need 25 victory points to claim a beachhead in the Barrens, Morrow, Zenith or Ossium because of citizen border patrols.

Grendel.t: The Grendel were the opposition in the Mareave battle opportunity at the Ruins of Sinat. Imperial conjunctions targeted them in Fleisardh, Haros Water, Naris and Wittal Grove, including attempts to poison them and to stop their assassins.

Highguard.t: Highguard offered force weight 27. Its armies may take Protect the Innocent, but lose effective strength if supported by heralds under Frater Pontius's mandate, and they gain bonuses when attacking Zenith from Morrow. Highborn-held Necropolis and Reikos faced conjunctions.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Imperial Orcs contributed the smallest force weight (7), and an Imperial Orc army may take the Forge Hammers order while in Skarsind.

Jotun.t: Mentioned in passing: Wintermark armies fighting the Jotun gain extra victory points but inflict fewer casualties and suffer fewer casualties.

Navarr.t: Navarr contributed force weight 59. A conjunction to destroy a Druj miasma pillar in Therunin's Lower Tarn Valley would protect a region Navarr shares with the Druj, and the Archmage of Spring was tasked with casting Dance of Navarr and Thorn in Sarangrave.
