Konstantin Rabovich Bolotnikov gave weirwood and several crowns, Edward Watcher supplied mithril, white granite, weirwood and over two thrones, and Robin Meadowsweet, Hugh Gardener, Isolde of House Elyan, D'Eon, Fintan Nighthaven and Rhys Nighthaven also contributed. The recorded donations appear to cover the listed materials, but the page records no outcome.

Dawn.t: A garden monument was commissioned in the Dawnish territory of Weirwater to honour Lady Eleanor Novarion and the Proffered Hand network she founded. Supporters, including Isolde of House Elyan, contributed materials towards its construction.

Construct Compassion Without Expectation.o: In Winter 386YE the Mistress of Monuments, Konstantin Rabovich Bolotnikov, announced the construction of "Compassion Without Expectation", a restful garden in Applefell, Weirwater, honouring the late Lady Eleanor Novarion for founding the Proffered Hand network.

Weirwater/Garthmoor.t: Applefell in Garthmoor was named as the site of the restful memorial garden to Lady Eleanor Novarion, though the page records no completion.

Weirwater.t: Weirwater was chosen as the site of the "Compassion Without Expectation" garden, to be built in Applefell, with donations of granite, weirwood, mithril and money recorded through to Autumn 387YE.

Construct Crimson Drummers of Madruga.d: The commission was announced in Summer 384YE by Ahraz i Guerra under his Imperial Wayleave rather than passed by a Senate vote. It was to be built in Torres in Madruga at a cost of 12 wains of white granite and 24 crowns in labour, taking three months, with Ahraz funding it in full. After the Summer Solstice he provided 3 thrones and 12 wains of white granite. Once complete, the sinecure would create a new Imperial title, the Crimson Sutannir, with tenure, appointed by judgement of the Brass Coast National Assembly and providing liao and Synod votes.

The Brass Coast.t: A Freeborn citizen funded a new sinecure whose title, the Crimson Sutannir, would be chosen by the Brass Coast National Assembly, giving the Freeborn a tenured position supplying liao and Synod votes.

Construct Crimson Drummers of Madruga.o: Ahraz i Guerra of the Celesti, Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave, announced the construction of the Crimson Drummers of Madruga, a sinecure in Torres producing liao and Synod votes. Its holder, the Crimson Sutannir, would be chosen by the Freeborn National Assembly.

Madruga/Torres.t: Torres was named as the site of the new sinecure, a three-month build of white granite paid for entirely by Ahraz i Guerra.

Madruga.t: The Crimson Drummers of Madruga were commissioned to be built in this Brass Coast territory, with materials for the work provided after the Summer Solstice.

Construct Crucible of Fate.d: Acting on the Write your own ending wind of fortune, Sagua i'Ezmara chose Zenith over Kahraman, arguing that while Kahraman's roads were broken, Zenith's spirits were. The project costs 30 wains of white granite, 20 wains of mithril, 10 rings of ilium and 15 thrones, and takes six months. Funding was organised by Zenith Ascendant from Urizeni donations, and Able the Taller of Sarangrave Reforged provided the full materials after Winter Solstice 384YE. Once complete, the Urizen National Assembly would be able to endorse a mandate encouraging Zenith to embrace a new destiny as the Crucible of Fate, and 140 ingots would be split equally between the businesses of the League.

The Brass Coast.t: Sagua i'Ezmara, as Master of the Koboldi, directed this season's construction effort to Zenith rather than to Kahraman's broken roads.

Urizen.t: The Urizeni gain a rebuilt workshop of spiritual and physical significance, and their National Assembly would be able to endorse a mandate shaping Zenith's identity once it is complete; Zenith Ascendant gathered donations from Urizen's people to fund it.

Construct Crucible of Fate.o: In Winter 384YE Sagua i'Ezmara, Master of the Koboldi, announced that season's project as the reconstruction of the Crucible of Fate, a foundry in Iteri in Zenith where the ushabti were first created. All the required materials were supplied after the Winter Solstice.

Zenith/Iteri.t: The Crucible of Fate foundry, the workshop where the ushabti were first created, is to be rebuilt in Iteri, with all its materials provided after Winter Solstice 384YE.

Kahraman.t: Mentioned in passing: the announcement noted that Kahraman's roads were broken, but the project was directed to Zenith instead.

Zenith.t: Zenith is to regain the Crucible of Fate, described as a focal point for defining the territory's identity, with a mandate offering it a new destiny as the Crucible of Fate once the six-month construction is complete.

Construct Crystal Fruit Garden.d: Proposed by the senator for Hercynia and seconded by Mournwold, the motion commissioned a mana sinecure in Serenael costing 12 mithril and 36 crowns, taking three months, and fully self-funded. Grundfos Thorn's Rest supplied the 12 wains of mithril and 4 thrones 4 crowns after the Summer Solstice 387YE. With the work complete, the Keeper of the Crystal Fruit, responsible for coordinating Navarr farmers, was to be appointed annually by unanimous decision of the Navarr senators. The first appointment was set for the Autumn Equinox 387YE, for a reduced term of six months.

Navarr.t: Navarr gained a new title, the Keeper of the Crystal Fruit, to coordinate its farmers, chosen by unanimous agreement of the nation's senators.

Construct Crystal Fruit Garden.o: The Senate passed a motion to build the Crystal Fruit Garden, a mana sinecure in Serenael, Miaren, creating the title Keeper of the Crystal Fruit to coordinate Navarr farmers.

Miaren/Serenael.t: The Crystal Fruit Garden was constructed in Serenael and completed after Grundfos Thorn's Rest supplied the mithril and crowns.

Miaren.t: Miaren became home to the Crystal Fruit Garden, a new mana sinecure built in the Navarr-held territory.

Construct Curstag's Way.d: Built under the We all stand Wind of Fortune, the highway honoured Curstag von Apulian Crimson Way. It was meant to support the unshackled orcs of Mareave and show its septs how the Empire builds up its people. As the Master of Rings announced it, some citizens of Apulian supported it. It cost 50 wains of white granite, 20 of mithril and 210 crowns, and took six months. Gancio di Catazar, League citizens, the Coalition of Stone and Struggle, Pathfinder Gaddak and others gave materials and money from Autumn 386YE to Summer 387YE. On completion it raised the investment level of Spiral businesses by one, worth 36 rings a season, and removed Icarion's under-developed quality.

Grendel.t: The highway runs into Mareave, which Grendel shared with the Imperial Orcs that season, and its completion removed the under-developed quality from Icarion there.

Imperial Orcs.t: The road was meant to support the unshackled orc cousins of Mareave and show its septs how the Empire builds up its people, and its completion developed Icarion in the territory the Imperial Orcs helped hold.

The League.t: A League undertaking announced by the Master of Rings in honour of a fallen League orc, it was built with League skill and gave Spiral's businesses a higher level of investment, worth 36 rings a season.

Urizen.t: The highway was to be built through Urizen vision and connects the Urizen territory of Redoubt to Spiral and Mareave.

Construct Curstag's Way.o: In Autumn 386YE the Master of Rings, Laughlan Vi Temeschwar, announced a great work in Spiral: Curstag's Way, a Grand Highway linking Redoubt, Spiral and Mareave, named for the first League orc to die in battle for the Empire. It was later completed, boosting Spiral's businesses and developing Icarion in Mareave.

Mareave/Icarion.t: The completion of Curstag's Way removed the under-developed quality from Icarion.

Mareave.t: Mareave is the far end of the highway, and the finished road removed the under-developed quality from its region of Icarion.

Redoubt.t: Redoubt is one of the three territories the Grand Highway was built to connect, linking it to Spiral and Mareave.

Spiral.t: The great work was built in Spiral, and on completion it raised the level of investment in Spiral businesses by one, providing 36 rings a season.

Temeschwar.t: Mentioned in passing: the motion was announced by Laughlan Vi Temeschwar, Master of Rings.

Construct Dancer's Rest.d: Announced at the Autumn Equinox 387YE, the Dancer's Rest was planned as a centre of education and rehabilitation for refugees and ex-slaves, forming part of the Proffered Hand Network, which was to fund it fully. The commission called for 10 wains of weirwood, 30 crowns in labour and three months of work. After the Equinox, Sister Rosa supplied the weirwood and Sufyan i Zuhri i Guerra provided 3 thrones and 6 crowns. The sinecure was completed, and the title of Hand to the Dance became available for the Navarr National Assembly to appoint, with tenure, for the first time at the Winter Solstice 387YE.

Navarr.t: The Navarr National Assembly gained a new tenured title, the Hand to the Dance, which it could appoint for the first time at the Winter Solstice 387YE.

Construct Dancer's Rest.o: The Legion Engineer, Firesong Arachas, announced the construction of the Dancer's Rest, a money sinecure in Seren in Miaren built with 10 wains of weirwood. It was completed, creating the title of Hand to the Dance.

Miaren/Serenael.t: The Dancer's Rest was raised at Seren in Serenael, adding a weirwood sinecure that belongs to the Proffered Hand Network.

Miaren.t: Miaren became home to the Dancer's Rest, a Navarr-held centre of education and rehabilitation for refugees and former slaves.

Construct Defence of the Broch.d: Proposed by Miaren and seconded by Therunin, the motion passed at 150 thrones. It took advantage of an opportunity offered by the people of the steadings and was subject to non-standard costs: 40 wains of weirwood, 80 crowns in labour and three months of construction. Merlin Feyerd provided over nine thrones and 14 wains of weirwood after the Autumn Equinox, alongside small donations. Llewellyn Leafstalker added 10 wains after the Winter Solstice and 16 more after the Spring Equinox 384YE. The completed works were to protect the Broch, give a bounty of 75 bladeroot to every personal resource in Brocéliande except military units and fleets, and serve as a spy network in the territory.
Construct Defence of the Broch.o: In Autumn 383YE the Senate passed a motion to build the Defence of the Broch in Brocéliande, using an opportunity presented by the people of the steadings, to protect the Broch, yield bladeroot and act as a spy network.

Brocéliande.t: Although the Vallorn held Brocéliande at the time, the Defence of the Broch was to guard the Broch there, provide 75 bladeroot to each personal resource in the territory and give the Empire a spy network within it.

Construct Delev Grand Market.d: Dima Vasilyevna Novosad, Master of the Koboldi, announced the great work and described it as time-sensitive. It required 50 wains of white granite, 150 crowns in labour and three months to build. Between Spring and Autumn 388YE, donors including Blazh Zbignev, Triska Markova and Nikolai Yaropolk Borislav contributed 50 wains of granite and coins in total. Once complete, the market would raise investment in Karov's businesses, give citizens a free year's business there, and improve the Iron Tower, Korotny Docks and Delev Market. Karov's taxes would rise by four thrones a season, but only if the Little Boyar's Welcome were also upgraded. The Senate could also let the Boyar of the Iron Roads create a sinecure each season.

Varushka.t: Varushkan citizens led the effort. The market promises Varushkans more profitable businesses in Karov, including a year of free business ownership, and lets the Boyar of the Iron Roads gain a sinecure through Senate motion.

Construct Delev Grand Market.o: In Spring 388YE the Master of the Koboldi announced a commission to build a grand market in Delev, in the Duzekani region of Karov, following the Outside the Wall Wind of Fortune. The people of Karov pledged to fund it themselves, and citizens donated money and white granite over the following seasons.

Karov/Duzekani.t: The grand market was to be built at Delev in Duzekani, and by Autumn 388YE donors had supplied the full 50 wains of white granite it required.

Karov.t: Karov's people offered to fund a grand market in Delev that would raise business investment in the territory. It would also improve the Iron Tower, Korotny Docks and Delev Market, and could add four thrones a season to Karov's taxes if the Little Boyar's Welcome were upgraded too.

Construct Department of Architecture.d: The motion followed the Back in the same place Wind of Fortune. Construction cost 60 wains of white granite, 30 wains of weirwood, 180 crowns and six months. Asael, Giuseppe Sanguineo von Temeschwar, Laughlan Vi Temeschwar and Karo Di Yedinso supplied the money and materials after the Winter Solstice 384YE and Spring Equinox 385YE, and the building was completed. The Master of Rings holds one civilian build commission a season and access to a white granite, mithril and weirwood ministry, and is charged with generating wealth for Temeschwar's merchant-princes and the League. The title was first available by League Tally of the Votes at Summer Solstice 385YE. The Constitutional Court noted that the motion's removal clause was invalid for a Tally-appointed title and sought a clarifying administrative motion.

The League.t: The League gained a new national title, the Master of Rings, appointed by League Tally of the Votes and charged with enriching the merchant-princes and the nation, although the proposed removal by League, General or Assembly of Nine was constitutionally unworkable.

Construct Department of Architecture.o: In Winter 384YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by Temeschwar's senator and seconded by Semmerholm's, to build the Temeschwar University Department of Architecture in Hanuri, creating the Imperial title Master of Rings.

Temeschwar/Hanuri.t: Hanuri was the site of the new Department of Architecture, which was completed after funding arrived following the Winter Solstice 384YE and Spring Equinox 385YE.

Temeschwar.t: Temeschwar's university gained a Department of Architecture, built largely with granite, weirwood and money supplied by Temeschwar citizens, and the motion was proposed by Temeschwar's own senator.

Construct Dima's Light of Ossium.d: The great work, whose plans were first presented by one of the koboldi shortly before the Spring Equinox 387YE, was announced as fully self-funded, with thanks to King-under-the-Mountain and the forekoboldi Drageer. It was costed at 40 wains of white granite, 10 wains of mithril, 5 rings of ilium and 150 crowns in labour, and takes six months to build. Dima, Kostjya and a number of other citizens contributed money, white granite and mithril after the Autumn Equinox. Once complete, the beacon will warn of threats against Kostjyas Respite and increase the investment of fleets in Ossium, giving any fleet there that trades a bonus.

Varushka.t: Varushkan citizens led by Dima Vasilyevna Novosad, Kostjya and others pooled their own money and materials to raise this beacon in Varushkan-held Ossium, strengthening the nation's coastal and maritime interests.

Construct Dima's Light of Ossium.o: Dima Vasilyevna Novosad, Master of the Koboldi, announced the commissioning of Dima's Light of Ossium, a grand beacon on the Bittershore, in Autumn 388YE.

Ossium/Bittershore.t: Bittershore is the site of the new beacon, which will warn of threats against Kostjyas Respite once its six months of construction are finished.

Ossium.t: Once complete, the beacon will raise the investment of fleets in Ossium by one and give any fleet trading from the territory a bonus.

Construct Diplomatenschloss.d: Proposed by the Senator for Casinea and seconded by Reikos, the motion passed and 50 thrones were disbursed to the Senator for Casinea. The project needed 70 white granite, 30 weirwood and 300 crowns, took six months to complete, and carries an upkeep of 5 thrones a season. Materials and money came in gradually from many contributors between Summer 386YE and Summer 387YE, with major donations from Arlais, Daughter of Mari, Solomon, and Naomi of Felix Watch. Once complete, the Ambassador to the Commonwealth again had access to mercantile support, and the Diplomatenschloss serves as a rank one fortification in Hedrossan.

Highguard.t: Highguard gains a fortified Commonwealth embassy in its territory of Necropolis, built on a motion brought by its Senator for Casinea.

Construct Diplomatenschloss.o: In Summer 386YE the Senate passed a motion to build the Diplomatenschloss, a new fortified embassy for the Commonwealth in Hedrossan, Necropolis, following the For the Common Good Wind of Fortune.

Necropolis/Hedrossan.t: The completed Diplomatenschloss stands in Hedrossan as the Commonwealth's fortified embassy and serves as a rank one fortification there.

Casinea.t: Mentioned in passing: Casinea's Senator proposed the motion and received the 50 thrones disbursed for it, but the building stands in Necropolis.

Necropolis.t: Necropolis became home to the Diplomatenschloss, which restores the Commonwealth embassy and adds a rank one fortification to the territory.

Construct Drusila's Obelus.d: Using an Imperial Wayleave, Lukash announced the commission of a sinecure named Drusilla's Obelus in the Morass region of Holberg. The project used standard costs of 10 wains of weirwood and 20 crowns in labour, and would take three months to complete. Lukash Biessek von Temeschwar provided the full weirwood and crowns after the Autumn equinox 382YE. Once complete, the sinecure creates an Imperial title, Drusilla's Obelus, which yields 18 drams of bladeroot per season. The title is to be held for life and allocated by auction through the Bourse.

The League.t: A new League landmark was commissioned in Holberg, and Lukash Biessek von Temeschwar funded it in full to create a lifetime title producing bladeroot.

Construct Drusila's Obelus.o: Lukash, bearer of an Imperial Wayleave, announced the construction of Drusilla's Obelus, a sinecure in the Morass, Holberg, producing 18 drams of bladeroot each season.

Holberg/The Morass.t: The Morass was chosen as the site of Drusilla's Obelus, which would take three months to build once its weirwood and crowns were supplied.

Holberg.t: Holberg was to gain Drusilla's Obelus, a sinecure whose holder receives 18 drams of bladeroot each season.

Construct Dunfrith.d: Ham, son of Brigantia, lead apothecary of Dunhearth, acting with the authority of the Great Thane Tobrytan Dunning, called Spooner, had the foresters of Woodhall fell trees to create carefully placed glades near Dunhearth Hall. Plantings showed that Bladeroot, Cerulean Mazzarine, Marrowort (in glades on sites of skirmishes with the Feni), True Vervain and Imperial Roseweald would all grow there. The balanced herb sinecure, funded by Ham's family, was approved by the Civilian Commissioner using powers delegated by the Senate, at standard cost. Thanmir Hrafnar supplied 12 wains of weirwood and 24 crowns after the Autumn Equinox. Ham was proposed as overseer, but Wintermark's senators are not bound to elect him.

Wintermark.t: Once completed, Dunfrith will give Wintermark a new national position, the Guardian of Dunfrith, elected by Wintermark's senators, who are not bound to choose Ham despite the announcement.

Construct Dunfrith.o: In Autumn 380YE the Civilian Commissioner of Wintermark approved the construction of Dunfrith, a herb sinecure in the forests of Wood Heath in southern Hahnmark, which will create the Wintermark national position of Guardian of Dunfrith.

Hahnmark/Wood Heath.t: Wood Heath is the site of Dunfrith, where purpose-cut glades grow Bladeroot, Cerulean Mazzarine, Marrowort, True Vervain and Imperial Roseweald.

Hahnmark.t: Foresters of Woodhall in the southernmost reaches of Hahnmark cleared glades to establish the Dunfrith herb sinecure near Dunhearth Hall, including on old sites of skirmishes with the Feni.

Construct Eastern Spring Farm.d: Using an Imperial Orc Wayleave, Palerictus Krunk announced in Autumn 382YE the construction of a sinecure in the east of Skarsind, intended for the betterment of spring ritualists within the Imperial Orc nation. The commission used standard costs, though its size was not specified. After the Autumn Equinox, Palerictus Krunk provided 10 wains of mithril and 20 crowns towards the work. When complete, the sinecure will create a new Imperial title, the Farmer of Eastern Spring Farm.

Imperial Orcs.t: An Imperial Orc wayleave was used to commission a sinecure meant to support the nation's spring ritualists, funded with mithril and crowns from Palerictus Krunk.

Construct Eastern Spring Farm.o: Palerictus Krunk, bearer of an Imperial Orc Wayleave, announced the commissioning of a sinecure in eastern Skarsind to benefit the nation's spring ritualists, creating the title Farmer of Eastern Spring Farm.

Skarsind.t: The sinecure is to be built in the east of Skarsind, and once complete it will establish the title Farmer of Eastern Spring Farm there.

Construct Eels Landing.d: Proposed by the senator for Bregasland and seconded by Therunin, the motion took up the New port, old wine Wind of Fortune. It developed the docks at Eels Landing, ceded them to House Greywater in recognition of their service during the occupation of Bregasland, and granted a market charter funded by House Bolholt and the Black Vigil. The work cost 6 wains of weirwood, 6 of white granite and 36 crowns, and took three months. Orrick and Lizzie Stamp of Bildewold each supplied 3 wains of weirwood and 3 of white granite. Willem Tarne, Laughlan Vi Temeschwar and Rhys Nighthaven gave money. Once complete, Eel's Landing began growing into a small town, and taxation drawn from Bregasland fell by two thrones a season.

Jotun.t: Mentioned in passing: the Jotun are not named; the motion refers only to the occupation of Bregasland when recognising House Greywater's service.

The Marches.t: The Marches gained a chartered market town at Eel's Landing, with docks granted to House Greywater, backing from House Bolholt and the Black Vigil, and lighter taxation drawn from Bregasland.

Construct Eels Landing.o: In Spring 386YE the Senate passed a motion to develop the docks at Eels Landing in the North Fens of Bregasland, ceding them to House Greywater and granting the town a market charter. The charter was ratified by Emperor Vesna Borkovna Prochnost.

Bregasland/North Fens.t: New docks and a market charter were built at Eels Landing in the North Fens, and the settlement began expanding into a small town.

Bregasland.t: Bregasland's senator proposed the motion, and its completion established a new market town in the territory and reduced the taxation drawn from Bregasland by two thrones a season.

Construct Effervescent Brook.d: The Effervescent Brook was suggested by Gwinthav who speaks with Majesty, herald of Meraud, and announced under an Imperial Wayleave by Wistan Goodledger. It costs 4 wains of weirwood, 4 rings of ilium and 12 crowns in labour, takes three months to build and carries no upkeep. The cost was to be met by the Tender of the Phoenix Flame and the Vallorn Guard. Enchantress Areloe Larmallevés provided the 4 wains of weirwood and Farren Silver Streams 1 crown after the Autumn Equinox. Custodianship was later amended to rest with the Tender of the Phoenix Flame, who, once the ministry is complete, will be able to buy Vials of Whitesmoke for tempest jade.

Dawn.t: Dawnish figures, including Enchantress Areloe Larmallevés, drove the commission and supplied its weirwood, and the Dawnish Tender of the Phoenix Flame was to gain custody of a new source of tonics against the vallorn.

Construct Effervescent Brook.o: In Autumn 388YE Wistan Goodledger, Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave, announced the construction of the Effervescent Brook, a ministry in Grovesyard, Astolat, commissioned on behalf of Enchantress Areloe. It diverts the Whitesmoke Brook to the Phoenix Flame to provide tonics against the vallorn.

Astolat/Grovesyard.t: Grovesyard is the site of the Effervescent Brook, where the Whitesmoke Brook was to be diverted to the Phoenix Flame to produce Vials of Whitesmoke.

Astolat.t: A new ministry was being raised in Astolat to channel the Whitesmoke Brook to the Phoenix Flame, adding a resource for the territory's struggle against the vallorn.

Construct Embassy to the Thule.d: Proposed by the Volodmartz senator and seconded by the Karsk senator, the motion called for an embassy to the Thule of Otkodov to be built in Miekarova at no cost to the Imperial treasury. After the Summer Solstice, Vuk The Wolfeater provided the materials and funds: 25 wains of weirwood, 25 wains of white granite and 12 thrones. The embassy was due to be complete from the start of the Autumn Equinox. The Senate had already appointed the first Ambassador to Otkodov, who would use the new building.

Thule.t: The Thule of Otkodov were to gain a dedicated Imperial embassy just across their border in Miekarova, housing the Empire's Ambassador to them.

Varushka.t: The embassy was to be built on Varushkan soil in Miekarova, with the motion proposed and seconded by the senators for Volodmartz and Karsk and the materials supplied by Vuk The Wolfeater.

Construct Embassy to the Thule.o: In Summer 381YE the Senate passed a self-funded motion to construct an embassy to the Thule, for the Ambassador to the Thule, in the Varushkan territory of Miekarova.

Miekarova.t: Miekarova was chosen as the site of the new Imperial embassy to the Thule, due for completion by the Autumn Equinox.

Otkodov.t: Otkodov was the destination of the embassy, which was built to serve the Empire's newly appointed Ambassador to Otkodov.

Construct Emilio's Herbarium.d: Palerictus Krunk announced that the Imperial Orcs would use their Imperial Wayleave to build a sinecure in Foracci, Sarvos. It was to be called Emilio's Herbarium, and the announcement linked it to the Anvil hospital. When complete it will create the Imperial title of Keeper of Emilio's Herbarium, a tenure position appointed by the Loyalty assembly. The commission uses standard costs, but its size was not specified. After the Winter Solstice 382YE, Giacomo Corvinoscuro supplied 12 weirwood and 24 crowns towards it. The page does not record the sinecure as finished.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Imperial Orcs spent their Wayleave on this commission, announced by Palerictus Krunk, to establish a weirwood-herb sinecure tied to the Anvil hospital.

The League.t: The sinecure is being raised in the League territory of Sarvos, under an Imperial Wayleave held by another nation.

Construct Emilio's Herbarium.o: The Imperial Orcs used an Imperial Wayleave, announced by Palerictus Krunk, to commission Emilio's Herbarium, a weirwood-herb sinecure in Foracci, Sarvos, in Winter 382YE.

Sarvos/Foracci.t: Foracci is the chosen site for Emilio's Herbarium, which received its first materials after the Winter Solstice 382YE.

Sarvos.t: Sarvos is to host Emilio's Herbarium, a new sinecure whose keeper will be appointed by the Loyalty assembly. Weirwood and crowns were delivered towards it after the Winter Solstice.

Construct Ethengraw Armoury.d: Proposed by the senator for Skarsind and seconded by the senator for Redoubt, the motion commissioned a smithy and armoury in Gildermark, to be given to the Ethengraw. The motion text cited 60 wains of mithril and 120 crowns, while the cost recorded on the page was 60 wains of mithril and 15 thrones, with six months to complete. After the Winter Solstice the full 60 wains and the thrones were provided by many donors, led by Bloodcrow Rasp (19 wains and the 15 thrones) and Tulva (10 wains). Once complete, the Ethengraw will join the Imperial Orcs. They will form the core of any new Imperial Orc army, offer chances to muster one, and allow a unique army quality reflecting their fighting arts.

Imperial Orcs.t: Once the armoury is finished, the Ethengraw will join the Imperial Orcs and form the core of a possible new Imperial Orc army, with the option of a unique quality drawn from their fighting arts.

Varushka.t: The folly is to be raised in Gildermark in Varushkan-held Ossium and ceded to the Ethengraw sept who live there, so it will draw that sept into the Imperial Orcs.

Construct Ethengraw Armoury.o: In Winter 384YE the Senate passed a motion to build a smithy and armoury folly in Gildermark and cede it to the Ethengraw sept of Ossium. This followed the All too well Wind of Fortune.

Ossium.t: A smithy and armoury folly is to be built in Gildermark for the Ossium-based Ethengraw sept, funded with 60 wains of mithril and due to take six months to complete.

Construct Eye of Heavens.d: Proposed by the senator for Zenith and seconded by Feroz, the motion was to be fully self-funded by the Architects of Urizen. It required 30 wains of mithril, 20 of white granite, 10 of weirwood and 225 thrones in labour, with six months to complete. Recorded contributions were small: a crown each from Farren Silver Streams and Rhys Nighthaven after the Spring Equinox, and 5 rings in donations after the Autumn Equinox. Once complete, the observatory would enable study of the stars, conjunctions and astronomancy to rival Spiral's proposed school of dramaturgy, found a new spire letting any Urizen character take a free resource in the territory, and spread one hundred mana crystals through Brass Coast businesses.

Urizen.t: Urizen's Architects undertook to fund the observatory themselves, and on completion its citizens could each claim a new resource in Zenith for free through the new spire it founds.

Construct Eye of Heavens.o: The Senate passed a motion in Spring 388YE to commission the Eye of Heavens, an observatory in Occursion, Zenith, under the Sound and Vision Wind of Fortune, presented as part of the assurance to build the Arch of the Sky and the Skyways.

Zenith/Occursion.t: Occursion is the site chosen for the Eye of Heavens, a six-month construction of mithril, white granite and weirwood dedicated to the study of the stars and conjunctions.

Zenith.t: Zenith's senator proposed the motion, which would give the territory a major observatory for astronomancy and a new spire once building is finished.

Construct Faraden embassy.d: Proposed by Therunin and seconded by Mitwold, the motion sought Senate funds to build a Faraden embassy in Anduz. It passed at 80 Thrones, and the money was paid to Senator Therunin. The project needed 20 wains of weirwood and 20 wains of white granite, less than the standard cost for an embassy, plus one season's work and an upkeep of 5 Thrones. The Faraden would only recognise the embassy once the Towers of Anduz had been rebuilt. Caerwyn supplied 20 wains of weirwood and 18 of white granite after the Spring Equinox 379YE, and the last 2 wains of granite after the Summer Solstice 379YE. On completion the embassy would create the Imperial title of Ambassador to Faraden.

The Brass Coast.t: The Freeborn gain a diplomatic link to the Faraden on their own soil at Anduz, although its recognition depends on the Towers of Anduz being rebuilt first.

Construct Faraden embassy.o: In Winter 378YE the Senate passed a motion, at 80 Thrones, to build an embassy to the Faraden in Anduz in the Freeborn territory of Segura.

Segura.t: The embassy is to be built in Anduz in Segura, which makes the territory the seat of the Empire's future Ambassador to Faraden once the Towers of Anduz are rebuilt.

Construct Feldspar Distillery.d: The commission, linked to the Standing in the sun Wind of Fortune, cost 12 wains of weirwood and 36 crowns and took three months to build. Frith, Rhys Nighthaven and Konstantin Rabovich Bolotnikov donated crowns after the Spring Equinox, and Irontide Flax provided 4 thrones and 12 wains of weirwood after the Autumn Equinox. The completed sinecure produces 3 realmsroot and 3 of each herb every season. Imperial Orcs with herb gardens can also choose to produce realmsroot when upgrading them. The title is intended for a member of the Yerende sept. There is no legal requirement, but the sinecure will not function if held by anyone from another sept.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Imperial Orc senators gained the right to appoint the Wise Arborist from Winter 386YE, a post that only functions for a member of the Yerende sept. Orcs with herb gardens can now choose to produce realmsroot when they upgrade them.

Construct Feldspar Distillery.o: In Spring 386YE the Legion Engineer Groza announced a commission to build the Feldspar Distillery, a herb garden sinecure in Solvihill, Skarsind, creating the title of Wise Arborist. Once funded and completed, the title became available for appointment by the Imperial Orc senators from the Winter Solstice 386YE.

Skarsind/Solvihill.t: The Feldspar Distillery was built in Solvihill. Each season it yields 3 realmsroot and 3 of each herb to the Wise Arborist.

Skarsind.t: The Imperial Orc territory of Skarsind gained the Feldspar Distillery, a herb garden sinecure producing realmsroot and herbs each season.

Construct First Voice Glade.d: Idwyn Splitroot, acting as proxy for Matt Twisted Tree, used an Imperial Wayleave in Autumn 382YE to announce a herb garden sinecure in Miaren. Its inscription honours Gerallt the bard, First Voice of the Navarr nation, who died at Return, and records that the bards of Navarr gather at his Glade. The title is appointed by the Navarr Senators and revocable by the Navarr National Assembly. The sinecure used standard costs, though its size was not specified. Nemae provided 20 weirwood and 40 crowns after the Autumn Equinox. The completed work created a new Imperial title, Dean of the First Voice Glade.

Navarr.t: Navarr gained a memorial glade honouring its fallen First Voice Gerallt and a new title, Dean of the First Voice Glade, appointed by its Senators and answerable to its National Assembly.

Construct First Voice Glade.o: An Imperial Wayleave was used to announce the construction of First Voice Glade, a herb garden sinecure in Miaren commemorating Gerallt the bard, First Voice of the Navarr, who died at Return, and serving as a gathering place for Navarri bards.

Miaren.t: First Voice Glade, a herb garden sinecure and gathering place for the bards of Navarr, was raised in Miaren.

Construct Floerstrand.d: Proposed by the senator for Sermersuaq and seconded by Hercynia, the motion passed with 15 thrones disbursed to the Senator for Sermersuaq. The sinecure required 20 wains of white granite and 60 crowns and took three months to complete. After the Autumn Equinox, Fedelmidd Sydanjaa's Heart Floer provided 7 thrones, 3 crowns and 20 wains of white granite, and Farren Silver Streams gave 1 crown. With Floerstrand complete, the position of Thane of Floerstrand was to be appointed for the first time at the Winter Solstice 386YE, by unanimous vote of the senators of Wintermark.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark gained a new sinecure in its own lands, and its senators would choose the first Thane of Floerstrand by unanimous vote at the Winter Solstice 386YE.

Construct Floerstrand.o: In Autumn 386YE the Senate passed a motion to build Floerstrand, a "Hot Spring Hall", in Tanikipari in Sermersuaq, following the Farm, fur, and fish Wind of Fortune.

Sermersuaq/Tanikipari.t: Tanikipari became the site of Floerstrand, a completed hot spring hall that is home to the new office of Thane of Floerstrand.

Sermersuaq.t: Sermersuaq's senator proposed the motion and received the 15 thrones to build Floerstrand, a hot spring hall that grew out of the earlier appraisal of the territory's prosperity.

Construct Flood Defences in Caricomare.d: Proposed by the senator for Sarvos and seconded by Spiral, the motion needed no commission and was stated to cost 60 thrones. The recorded cost was 12 wains of white granite and 72 crowns, with three months to complete. After the Spring Equinox, Rosalina Gulia Viola di Sarvos provided 8 thrones, 7 crowns and the 12 wains of white granite, and Aloysius di Sarvos gave 1 crown. The defences were to be decorated with an elegant letter B and a rose in honour of their supporters. Once complete, they ensure Sarvos will not suffer unduly from flooding should the territory be cursed with Foam and Spittle of the Furious Sea.

The League.t: League citizens, chiefly Rosalina Gulia Viola di Sarvos and Aloysius di Sarvos, paid for the project. It leaves the League's city of Sarvos protected against future flooding.

Construct Flood Defences in Caricomare.o: In Spring 386YE the Senate passed a motion to build flood defences at Caricomare in Sarvos with the help of the Vandersar, following the Sound the bells Wind of Fortune. The defences were completed.

Sarvos.t: Flood defences were completed at Caricomare with Vandersar aid. They shield Sarvos from undue harm if it is cursed with Foam and Spittle of the Furious Sea.

Construct Forest of Defiance.d: Palerictrus Krunk, describing himself as Bearer of an Imperial Orc Wayleave, announced the Forest of Defiance. It is a mana sinecure costing 10 wains of mithril, 20 crowns in labour and three months to build. Its title, Dauntless Warrior, is to be appointed for life by all Imperial Orc senators and can be revoked by the Imperial Orc national assembly, the General Assembly or the Assembly of Nine. After the Autumn Equinox, Krunk supplied the 10 wains of mithril, Tog gave 2 thrones 3 crowns 19 rings, and small donations added 1 ring. The Speaker's note records that the Wayleave title was vacant when the announcement was made, and the matter is being investigated.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Imperial Orcs stand to gain a mana sinecure whose Dauntless Warrior title would be appointed by their senators and could be revoked by their national assembly. The commission was, however, announced under an Imperial Orc Wayleave title that was vacant at the time, and that is now under investigation.

Construct Forest of Defiance.o: A commission to build a mana sinecure called the Forest of Defiance in Skarsind was announced in Autumn 383YE. It would create the title Dauntless Warrior, though the Speaker noted that the Imperial Orc Wayleave cited by the announcer was vacant at the time and that the matter was under investigation.

Skarsind.t: The Forest of Defiance mana sinecure is to be constructed in Skarsind. Its mithril and some of its labour costs had been provided after the Autumn Equinox 383YE.

Construct Forge of Bonds.d: Proposed by the senator for Kallavesa and seconded by the senator for Temeschwar, the motion took up a time-sensitive opportunity described in the Carved in Stone wind of fortune. The Forge of Bonds lets the Keeper of Oaths carve one oath each season into the Fingers through a statement of principle. It cost 11 wains of white granite and 33 crowns in labour, took three months to build and has no upkeep. After the Autumn Equinox, Veikko Bondforger provided 4 thrones, 1 crown and the 11 wains of white granite. With the work complete, the Loyalty Assembly could appoint the first Keeper of Oaths at the Winter Solstice 387YE.

Wintermark.t: The Forge of Bonds now stands in Wintermark's territory of Hahnmark, where one oath each season will be carved into the Fingers.

Construct Forge of Bonds.o: In Autumn 387YE the Senate passed a motion to construct the Forge of Bonds in the Fingers, Hahnmark. The edifice created the position of Keeper of Oaths, an office elected with tenure by the Loyalty Assembly.

Hahnmark/Wood Heath.t: The Forge of Bonds was constructed in Wood Heath, and the oaths of the Keeper of Oaths are carved into the Fingers there.

Hahnmark.t: Hahnmark gained the Forge of Bonds, built in the Fingers, where the Keeper of Oaths can carve one oath into the stone each season.

Construct Fortification in Peregro.d: Proposed by Morrow and seconded by Skarsind, the motion called for a citadel in Peregro and a disbursement of funds. It cost 80 white granite and 240 crowns and took twelve months to build. After the Spring Equinox 387YE it received support from the Towerjacks. Donations included small sums after the Winter Solstice from Rhys Nighthaven and others, large gifts of thrones and white granite from Sejanus of the Scarlet Guard after the Spring Equinox and Summer Solstice 387YE, granite from Pontus Figures, and money from Corinthia of the Wise Citadel. The result was a fortification named Quicksilver's Flame in Peregro.

Druj.t: The citadel was raised specifically to keep watch over the parts of Therunin where the Druj hold sway, setting a new Imperial bulwark against them on the border.

Navarr.t: The fortification stands watch over the border of Therunin, a Navarr territory where the Druj and the vallorn hold sway.

Urizen.t: Morrow's senator proposed the motion, giving Urizen a new citadel, Quicksilver's Flame, guarding its border with Druj-held and vallorn-blighted Therunin.

Construct Fortification in Peregro.o: In Winter 386YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by the senator for Morrow, to build a citadel in Peregro to stand watch over the border of Therunin, where the Druj and the vallorn hold sway. It was completed as the fortification Quicksilver's Flame.

Morrow/Peregro.t: Peregro became the site of Quicksilver's Flame, a citadel built over twelve months with white granite and crowns to guard the border with Therunin.

Morrow.t: Morrow gained the fortification Quicksilver's Flame in its region of Peregro, built at the motion of its own senator.

Therunin.t: The new citadel was built to watch over Therunin's border, where the Druj and the vallorn hold sway.

Construct Freya's Garden.d: The motion, raised under Tyr Brennan's Imperial Wayleave, commissioned a Great Work in the Wintermark territory of Hahnmark at standard cost, to be named Freya's Garden. After the Winter Solstice 382YE, Tyr Brenna provided 50 wains of weirwood and 100 crowns towards its construction. The recorded outcome is that the work yields a bounty of 84 herbs, divided between the owners of herb gardens in Hahnmark. Its stated purpose is to supply herbs that heal the Empire.

Wintermark.t: A Wintermark-held territory gains a Great Work dedicated to healing herbs, commissioned under a Wintermark wayleave by Tyr Brennan, which enriches the nation's herb garden owners in Hahnmark.

Construct Freya's Garden.o: In Winter 382YE a Great Work named Freya's Garden was commissioned in Hahnmark under an Imperial Wayleave held by Tyr Brennan, to provide herbs to heal the Empire.

Hahnmark.t: Freya's Garden is built in Hahnmark, and its bounty of 84 herbs is shared among the territory's herb garden owners.

Construct Gallery of Memories.d: Proposed by the senator for Ossium and seconded by Karsk, the self-funded motion called for 10 wains of white granite and 30 crowns of labour, on top of standard costs, with three months to complete. After the Winter Solstice, Volya Vychodni Nebov provided 3 thrones, 5 crowns and the 10 wains of white granite, and Konstantin Rabovich Bolotnikov gave a further crown. The Gallery was completed. The Varushkan National Assembly appoints the Curator of Memories with tenure, and could do so for the first time at the Spring Equinox 387YE.

Varushka.t: Varushka gained a new money sinecure, the Curator of Memories, which the Varushkan National Assembly appoints with tenure, starting at the Spring Equinox 387YE. Varushkans Volya Vychodni Nebov and Konstantin Rabovich Bolotnikov paid for its construction.

Construct Gallery of Memories.o: In Winter 386YE the Senate passed a motion to build the Gallery of Memories in Lomaa, Ossium: a permanent exhibition to the former cultures of Ossium's freed peoples, which also creates the money sinecure title of Curator of Memories.

Ossium/Galath Fields.t: The Gallery of Memories was built in Lomaa in Galath Fields from white granite, and the region now houses the exhibition and the Curator of Memories sinecure.

Ossium.t: Ossium's senator proposed the motion, and the territory now holds a permanent exhibition honouring the former cultures of its freed peoples.

Construct Garden City in Holberg.d: Passed in Winter 385YE, the motion was run as a disbursement with increasing numbers of commissions, since the project needed four commissions over a year. It passed at one commission, costing 50 thrones and taking twelve months. Dima Vasilyevna Novosad, as Master of the Koboldi, announced support at the Spring Equinox 386YE, and Gustavus Tolski van Temeschwar, as Chair of the Wolf, did so at the Summer Solstice and Autumn Equinox 386YE. Many citizens, largely of Holberg, donated thrones and crowns towards it across 385YE and 386YE. On completion, Holmauer became a garden city and gained the Uplifting quality.

The League.t: The League's Senator for Holberg proposed the motion, and League citizens, many bearing the name van or von Holberg, provided much of the money that brought the City of Flowers to completion.

Construct Garden City in Holberg.o: The Senate commissioned the transformation of Holberg into the City of Flowers, a folly arising from The greatest city in the world Wind of Fortune, proposed by the Senator for Holberg and seconded by Redoubt. The work was funded and completed, turning Holmauer into a garden city.

Holberg/Holmauer.t: Holmauer was transformed into a garden city and gained the Uplifting quality once the construction was complete.

Holberg.t: Holberg's capital was remade as the City of Flowers, a year-long folly that Holberg's own citizens largely paid for.

Construct Garden of Falling Snow.d: The motion proposed building the Garden of Falling Snow in Hahnmark at no cost to the Senate. It is a sinecure that supplies additional herbs, and its holder, the Gatekeeper of Falling Snow, is to be appointed by unanimous vote of Wintermark's senators. The motion gave neither the size nor the exact location of the sinecure, leaving both for the senator to decide, with standard costs applying. After the Summer Solstice 379YE, Hengest Dun of Wintermark supplied 10 wains of weirwood and 20 crowns. Construction was completed, creating a Wintermark national Imperial title.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark gained a new national Imperial title, the Gatekeeper of Falling Snow, whose holder is chosen by unanimous vote of its senators. The garden was built with weirwood and crowns supplied by Hengest Dun.

Construct Garden of Falling Snow.o: In Summer 379YE the Senate considered a motion from the senator for Hahnmark, seconded by Sermersuaq, to build the Garden of Falling Snow, a herb garden sinecure in Hahnmark. It was later completed, creating the Imperial title of Gatekeeper of Falling Snow.

Hahnmark.t: The Garden of Falling Snow, a herb garden sinecure, was built in Hahnmark. Its exact location within the territory was left for the senator to decide.

Construct Garden of Glory.d: Proposed by the senator for Tassato and seconded by Astolat, the motion used an opportunity from the Long Walk Home wind of fortune (Spring 382YE) to build at reduced cost: 8 wains of weirwood and 2 thrones in labour, with three months to construct. The sinecure produces 6 liao and carries no Synod votes. Eadric Fjellrevening de Rondell Rezia di Tassato provided the weirwood and money after the Spring Equinox. Once completed, the Keeper of the Garden is appointed and revoked by the Navarr National Assembly.

Navarr.t: The Navarr National Assembly gains the power to appoint and revoke the Keeper of the Garden, a new liao-producing sinecure, once the garden is completed.

Construct Garden of Glory.o: In Spring 385YE the Senate passed a self-funded motion to build the Garden of Glory in Therunin, creating a liao sinecure with the title Keeper of the Garden.

Therunin.t: The Garden of Glory is to be raised in Therunin, taking three months to build and yielding 6 liao for its keeper.

Construct Garden of Hope.d: The Garden of Hope was presented as part of the Imperial Orcs' highest calling, and the announcement thanked the Black Tillers for listening to Bloodcrow Meep. It cost 25 wains of white granite, 25 wains of weirwood and 150 crowns in labour, and took three months to build. After the Autumn Equinox Erlend Gunnulfsson supplied all the weirwood and white granite, while Bloodcrow Rasp, Karrak, Farren Silver Streams, Rhys Nighthaven and Konstantin Rabovich Bolotnikov contributed money. Once complete, the garden provides two doses of Hearkener's Hope to each congregation in Skarsind and increases investment in Skarsind's congregations by one.

Imperial Orcs.t: The great work answers part of the Imperial Orcs' highest calling, giving orcs of the Empire a new way to obtain Hearkener's Hope in their own lands, in the spirit of learning from their ancestors.

Construct Garden of Hope.o: In Autumn 388YE the Legion Engineer, Firesong Arachas, announced construction of the Garden of Hope, a great work in Gildermark designed by the Black Tillers of Skarsind to give the Empire's orcs a new way to access Hearkener's Hope.

Skarsind/Gildermark.t: Gildermark is the site of the Garden of Hope, a great work designed by the local Black Tillers and built over three months.

Skarsind.t: Once complete, every congregation in Skarsind receives two doses of Hearkener's Hope and has its investment raised by one.

Construct Garden of Imperial Auxiliaries.d: Proposed by the senator for Necropolis and seconded by Holberg, the motion commissioned a herb garden sinecure in Coursmouth. Once completed it creates the Imperial title of Legate of the Imperial Auxiliaries, elected by the Military Council and able to address it. The Legate is responsible for supporting the Imperial Auxiliaries in helping the Field Marshal communicate on major conjunctions through the sentinel gate, and is revocable by the General and the Assembly of Nine. As no size was specified, the civil service assumed the minimum of 10 wains. Ray Fosterbrooke provided 2 thrones, 4 crowns and 10 wains of weirwood after the Summer Solstice.

Highguard.t: Highguard's Necropolis gains a new Imperial sinecure on its soil, with Highguard's Necropolis senator having proposed the motion.

Construct Garden of Imperial Auxiliaries.o: In Summer 384YE the Senate passed a motion to construct the Garden of the Imperial Auxiliaries, a herb garden sinecure in Coursmouth, Necropolis, which will create the title Legate of the Imperial Auxiliaries.

Necropolis/Coursmouth.t: Coursmouth is the site of the Garden of the Imperial Auxiliaries, a herb garden sinecure whose completion creates the title of Legate of the Imperial Auxiliaries.

Necropolis.t: Necropolis's senator proposed the motion, and the garden is to be built within the territory to support the Imperial Auxiliaries' work at the sentinel gate.

Construct Garden of Peaceful Quietitude.d: Hilda Sirens Scream Ursan, Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave, announced construction of the Garden of Peaceful Quietitude in Kalpamark, Hahnmark, following the opportunity presented in the Poet lights but lamps wind of fortune. The sinecure cost 12 wains of weirwood and 36 crowns in labour, and took three months to build. Hilda provided 4 thrones 4 crowns and the 12 wains of weirwood after the Spring Equinox 388YE. Once complete, it created the tenured title of Seeker of Quietitude, appointed by the Wintermark National Assembly. The Assembly could make the first appointment at the Summer Solstice 388YE.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark gained a new tenured title, the Seeker of Quietitude, which its National Assembly could appoint for the first time at the Summer Solstice 388YE.

Construct Garden of Peaceful Quietitude.o: A sinecure called the Garden of Peaceful Quietitude was commissioned in Kalpamark, Hahnmark, announced by Hilda Sirens Scream Ursan as Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave under the Poet lights but lamps wind of fortune. It was completed, creating the title of Seeker of Quietitude.

Hahnmark/Kalpamark.t: Kalpamark became the site of the completed Garden of Peaceful Quietitude, the sinecure attached to the Seeker of Quietitude.

Hahnmark.t: The Garden of Peaceful Quietitude was built in Hahnmark, paid for with weirwood and coin supplied by Hilda Sirens Scream Ursan.

Construct Garden of the Grim II.d: Proposed by the senator for Miekarova and seconded by Volodmartz, the self-funded motion sought to create a herb sinecure titled "The Grim Gardener", with the holder to be appointed by the Senators of Varushka. It followed an earlier failed motion to build the same sinecure. Although the Senate passed it, the commission was announced only after the maximum number of commissions for the season had been authorised. It was held in reserve in case the Synod vetoed one of the earlier commissions. No veto was used, so the Gardens of the Grim commission was not authorised.

Varushka.t: Varushka's senators would have appointed the Grim Gardener, but because the commission was never authorised, the nation gained no new herb sinecure despite a second attempt.

Construct Garden of the Grim II.o: In Winter 380YE the Senate passed a motion to raise a herb sinecure in Miekarova called the "Gardens of the Grim", but the commission was never authorised because the season's maximum number of commissions had already been reached.

Miekarova.t: The proposed Gardens of the Grim herb sinecure in Miekarova passed the Senate but was not authorised, so nothing was built there.

Construct Gardens of High Chalcis.d: Using construction powers delegated by the Senate, the Highguard Civilian Commissioner approved this great work to seize an opportunity that arose after Reikos was reclaimed. It cost 80 wains of weirwood and six months to build, all supplied by Rhesa in two instalments with 160 crowns in total. Once finished, the gardens yield 120 herbs each season, shared among Reikos citizens who own herb gardens, and increase the prosperity of Reikos. The motion also proposed a ceremonial title, Master Botanist of High Chalcis, appointed by the Highguard Senators. After extensive constitutional scrutiny this was found to exceed a Civilian Commissioner's powers, so the title was not created and responsibility falls to the Senator for Reikos.

Highguard.t: Highguard's Civilian Commissioner and Exarch Rhesa commissioned and personally funded the gardens. However, the proposed title to be appointed by the Highguard Senators was ruled beyond the Commissioner's power and was not created.

Construct Gardens of High Chalcis.o: Rhesa, Exarch of the Scions of Ravensfell and Highguard Civilian Commissioner, commissioned the rebuilding of the Gardens of High Chalcis in Chalcis Mount, Reikos, during Summer 380YE, and the gardens were completed shortly before the Winter Solstice 380YE.

Reikos/Chalcis Mount.t: The Gardens of High Chalcis were rebuilt in Chalcis Mount, with work finished shortly before the Winter Solstice 380YE.

Reikos.t: Reikos gained a great work that increases its prosperity and provides 120 herbs each season to its citizens who own herb gardens. Its Senator holds responsibility for any threats or decisions concerning the gardens.

Construct Gardens of Morrow.d: Acting under the power to commission constructions delegated by the Senate, the Civilian Commissioner of Urizen approved the Gardens of Morrow as a great work in Morrow. It cost 40 wains of weirwood and 10 thrones in labour, and took three months to build. The materials and money were provided by Juliana after the Spring Equinox 381YE. Once complete, the Gardens of Morrow provide 75 herbs, split equally among the citizens who own herb gardens in Morrow.

Urizen.t: Urizen's own Civilian Commissioner approved the great work, and once complete it yields herbs to Urizeni citizens who own herb gardens in Morrow.

Construct Gardens of Morrow.o: In Summer 380YE the Civilian Commissioner of Urizen approved the construction of the Gardens of Morrow, a great work to produce herbs in Morrow.

Morrow.t: Morrow gains the Gardens of Morrow, a great work that provides 75 herbs, shared equally among the territory's herb garden owners.

Construct Gardens of the Grim III.d: Passed in Spring 381YE, this was the third motion to construct the Gardens of the Grim, following two earlier attempts. Once completed, the gardens would create a new Varushkan national title, the Grim Gardener, elected by the Varushkan Senators, and would double as the Courage artefact 'The Chains of Chernebog'. The exact cost is not recorded, but standard costs applied. After the Spring Equinox, Father Drakov provided 20 wains of weirwood and 5 thrones towards construction.

Varushka.t: Varushka's senators backed the project, and once built it would give the nation a new title, the Grim Gardener, chosen by its own Senators.

Construct Gardens of the Grim III.o: The Senate passed a motion, proposed by the senator for Miekarova and seconded by Karov, to build the Gardens of the Grim, a self-funded herb sinecure in Miekarova that would also serve as the Courage artefact 'The Chains of Chernebog'.

Miekarova.t: The Gardens of the Grim were to be built in Miekarova as an herb sinecure and the Courage artefact 'The Chains of Chernebog', with Father Drakov supplying weirwood and thrones towards the work.

Construct Gardens of the Perfect World.d: Proposed by the senator for Sarangrave and seconded by the Conscience of the Senate, the self-funded motion had the approval of the Urizen National Assembly and arose from the Poets light but lamps wind of fortune. Construction required 15 wains of weirwood and 45 crowns in labour costs and took three months. After the Winter Solstice, Abel the Rounder of Sarangrave Reforged provided the weirwood and 5 thrones 2 crowns, with a crown each from Farren Silver Streams, Serenus Starsong and Rhys Nighthaven. Once complete, the Urizen Assembly could appoint the Seeker of the Perfect World for the first time at the Spring Equinox 388YE, opening the way to further trade with Tsark.

Urizen.t: Urizen gains a new ministry whose holder, the Seeker of the Perfect World, is appointed by the Urizen Assembly from Spring Equinox 388YE, giving the nation a channel for trade with Tsark.

Construct Gardens of the Perfect World.o: In Winter 387YE the Senate passed a motion to commission the Gardens of the Perfect World in Occursion, Zenith, a ministry enabling trade with the hermit kingdom of Tsark, exchanging weirwood and/or liao for white granite.

Zenith/Occursion.t: The Gardens of the Perfect World were built in Occursion over three months following the Winter Solstice 387YE.

Zenith.t: Zenith becomes home to the Gardens of the Perfect World, a ministry for trading weirwood and liao with Tsark for white granite.

Construct Garrison of the League.d: Elsha Bertolf, Chair of the Wolf, announced the commission of the Garrison of the League, a business sinecure in Hanuri, Temeschwar, to be appointed annually by League Generals. On top of standard costs, it required 10 wains of white granite, 20 crowns in labour and three months to build. Erikas Van Temeshwar funded it: 2 thrones, 4 crowns and 4 wains of white granite after the Summer Solstice 385YE, then the remaining 6 wains of white granite after the Winter Solstice 385YE. With construction complete, the position of Quartermaster of the Hanuri Garrison was due to be elected for the first time at the Spring Equinox 386YE.

The League.t: The League gained a new sinecure whose holder is chosen annually by its generals. A League citizen, Erikas Van Temeshwar, supplied the money and white granite needed to complete it.

Construct Garrison of the League.o: In Summer 385YE a Senate commission was announced to build a business sinecure, the Garrison of the League, in Hanuri in Temeschwar, with its holder appointed annually by the League's generals. It was later completed.

Temeschwar/Hanuri.t: Hanuri is the site of the completed Garrison of the League, whose Quartermaster of the Hanuri Garrison was to be chosen for the first time at the Spring Equinox 386YE.

Temeschwar.t: The League-held territory of Temeschwar is home to the new Garrison of the League, a business sinecure built with white granite supplied by Erikas Van Temeshwar.

Construct Gate in Semmerholm.d: Proposed by the senator for Semmerholm and seconded by Holberg, the commission drew on an opportunity offered by the Eternal Adamant. It required 160 wains of white granite but no labour, would take twelve months, and carried an upkeep of 18 thrones. It did not count against the Senate's limit on commissions. The granite came largely from Lorenzo "La Volpe" Macelliao von Temeschwar over several seasons, with further contributions from the Silent Sentinel opportunity and a bequest from Ailliena Devereux. The final wains were supplied by over-enthusiastic koboldi, whom Adamant scolded for profligacy. The finished fortification would have 6000 effective strength. The work could falter if the Conclave declared enmity against Adamant.

Dawn.t: Dawn gained the restored Gate in Semmerholm as an Unbreakable fortification worth 6000 effective strength. Its senator proposed the work and Holberg seconded it, adding to the defences of Dawnish lands.

Construct Gate in Semmerholm.o: In Winter 381YE the Senate passed a motion to rebuild the Gate, a fortification in Semmerholm, by accepting the Eternal Adamant's offer to rebuild it and make it Unbreakable. The project was self-funded and needed no Imperial Surveyor.

Semmerholm.t: The Gate was rebuilt in Semmerholm with the Eternal Adamant's aid, using 160 wains of white granite and leaving the territory with a 6000-strength Unbreakable fortification.

Construct General Estana's Repository.d: The motion proposed building a grand library of contracts in the town of Oran, costing one wain of white granite, 2 crowns in labour and three months to construct. It would be dedicated to the Eternal Callidus, whose heralds would in return help the Hakima codify Autumn rituals. The motion sought permission to build in advance, with construction to start only once a contract with Callidus or one of his heralds was signed. Concerns were noted because a Civilian Commissioner cannot commission anything requiring upkeep. If the project seemed to create something with an upkeep, work would stop and the Senate would be consulted. With no contract signed, nothing was built and the commission lapsed.

The Brass Coast.t: The Brass Coast's Civilian Commissioner approved the folly in return for Callidus's heralds helping the Hakima codify Autumn rituals. Because no contract with the Eternal was signed, the nation gained neither the library nor that assistance.

Construct General Estana's Repository.o: In Summer 380YE the Civilian Commissioner of the Brass Coast approved a folly, General Estana's Repository, a grand library of contracts in Oran, Feroz, to be dedicated to the Eternal Callidus. No contract with the Eternal was ever signed, so work never began and the commission lapsed by Summer 381YE.

Feroz.t: The town of Oran in Feroz was chosen as the site for General Estana's Repository, but no construction took place there and the commission lapsed.

Construct Georgies' Home for Goodest Dog.d: Proposed by Tassato and seconded by Morrow, the motion commissioned a business sinecure in Holberg at standard cost, though the size of the commission was not specified. It passed, and the title is to be assigned each year by the League's Senators. After the Winter Solstice 382YE, Victor van Holberg provided 10 wains of white granite and 20 crowns towards its construction. When complete, the sinecure will create a new Imperial title, the Custodian of the Kennels.

The League.t: The League's Senators will choose the holder of the Custodian of the Kennels each year, and Victor van Holberg supplied the first white granite and crowns for the work.

Construct Georgies' Home for Goodest Dog.o: In Winter 382YE the Senate passed a motion to commission a business sinecure in Holberg called "Georgies Home for Goodest Dogs", to be assigned annually by the League Senators.

Holberg.t: Holberg is to host Georgies Home for Goodest Dogs, a new business sinecure whose construction is under way with materials provided by Victor van Holberg.

Construct Giant's Well.d: The motion called for a folly in Mitwold in the Marches, consisting of a white granite standing stone placed over the site known as the Giant's Well. It was passed in principle in Autumn 381YE and was to be self-funded. The minimum cost was 5 wains of white granite and 10 crowns in labour, with construction taking three months. William Guildenstern provided the granite and the crowns after the Autumn Equinox 381YE. The menhir, which came to be known as the Pale Chain, now covers the Giant's Well.

The Marches.t: The Marches gained a new landmark when Mitwold's own senator saw the Giant's Well capped with a white granite standing stone, the Pale Chain, paid for by William Guildenstern.

Construct Giant's Well.o: The Senate passed in principle a motion, proposed by the senator for Mitwold and seconded by Bastion, to build a self-funded folly in Mitwold: a white granite menhir to cap the "Giant's Well".

Mitwold.t: The Giant's Well in Mitwold is now covered by the Pale Chain, a white granite menhir raised as a folly over the site.

Construct Giritane's Gaze.d: Commissioned under the Stone and stone Wind of Fortune, the great work cost 40 wains of white granite and 80 crowns in gold and jewels, and took three months to construct. Enchanter Baldwin, senator of Weirwater, agreed to provide the funding. Contributions came from many donors between Autumn 384YE and Summer 385YE, including all 40 wains of granite from Meliodas Cambrerius. The completed Alabaster Owlbeast stands on a hill in Wickmoor, north-west of the Weirwater Vales, harnessing the power of a Summer regio, with two massive lightstones making it visible at night. It gives every mine in Weirwater a share in a bounty of 900 rings in precious metals and gemstones.

Dawn.t: Dawn's territory of Weirwater gained an immense mandowla colossus, funded with the agreement of its senator, Enchanter Baldwin, and supported by many donors. Its completion brings extra wealth to every Dawnish mine in the territory.

Construct Giritane's Gaze.o: In Autumn 384YE Sagua i'Ezmara, Master of the Koboldi, announced the construction of Giritane's Gaze, a great white mandowla statue with glowing eyes built in Weirwater to support the territory's miners.

Weirwater/Wickmoor.t: The white stone Alabaster Owlbeast was raised on a hill in Wickmoor, north-west of the Weirwater Vales, where it harnesses a Summer regio. Its two great lightstones make it especially visible at night.

Weirwater.t: Every mine in Weirwater now receives a share in a bounty of 900 rings in precious metals and gemstones, on top of the magical materials the mines already produce.

Construct Glen of Shadows Trading Office.d: The motion followed an earlier one to establish a trading post in the town of Torfast, and formed part of an opportunity to improve the wealth of Skarsind. It passed in principle and was then approved at 22 thrones, which were disbursed to the senator for Hercynia. Construction needed 8 wains of white granite, 2 thrones in labour and three months of work. Cenwyn Thorntarry provided the granite and labour costs after the Spring Equinox 380YE. The resulting ministry created a new Imperial title, the Broker of Treji Wayhouse, able to purchase trade goods. The motion lacked some necessary details, which the senator could decide.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Imperial Orcs stood to gain from the new office, which was meant to ease trade with their people in Skarsind and improve the territory's wealth.

Construct Glen of Shadows Trading Office.o: In Winter 379YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by Hercynia's senator and seconded by Feroz, to build a trading office in the Glen of Shadows in Hercynia to help trade with the orcs of Skarsind.

Skarsind.t: Skarsind was the intended beneficiary: the office in neighbouring Hercynia supported trade with it, following on from the planned trading post at Torfast, as part of an opportunity to improve the territory's wealth.

Construct Golden Bee Assayer's Office.d: Proposed by the senator for Miekarova and seconded by the senator for Karov, the motion described the people of Karov as wishing to self-fund the building, and stressed that the opportunity was available that season only. Construction required 14 wains of mithril and 42 crowns in labour, taking three months. After the Spring Equinox Farren Silver Streams and Rhys Nighthaven each contributed a crown. Once complete, taxation from Karov rises by two thrones per season, and a new national position, the Golden Bee Assayer, is appointed by a Tally of the Votes of Varushkan mine and forest owners and receives 5 ingots each of orichalcum, weltsilver and green iron per season.

Varushka.t: Varushka gains a new national sinecure, the Golden Bee Assayer, chosen by the nation's mine and forest owners and receiving orichalcum, weltsilver and green iron each season.

Construct Golden Bee Assayer's Office.o: The Senate passed a motion to construct the Golden Bee Assayer's Office in Duzekani, Karov, taking up the opportunity offered by the Outside the Wall Wind of Fortune.

Karov/Duzekani.t: The Golden Bee Assayer's Office is to be built in Duzekani, costing 14 wains of mithril and 42 crowns in labour over three months.

Karov.t: Karov's senator seconded the motion, and once the office is complete the territory's taxation rises by two thrones per season.

Construct Golden Causeway.d: Proposed by Astolat and seconded by Weirwater, the motion seized an opportunity offered to the Empire by the Lady of the Semmerlak, and it passed at 220 thrones. It used non-standard costs of 25 wains of white granite, 15 wains of mithril and 10 thrones in labour, with no upkeep. Bohemond De Rondell provided all of these materials and funds after the Spring Equinox 382YE. Once complete, the causeway will let the armies of Dawn, and only Dawn, march from Lacuve to the region on the far side of the Semmerlak and return the same way. If the Conclave were to place the eternal the Lady of the Lake serves, currently Eleonaris, under enmity, the causeway could not be used until the enmity was lifted.

Dawn.t: Proposed by Astolat and seconded by Weirwater, the causeway will give Dawn's armies alone a route from Lacuve across the Semmerlak and back, and Bohemond De Rondell supplied the granite, mithril and thrones needed to build it.

Druj.t: The causeway opens a passage across the Semmerlak into Druj-held lands, through which Dawnish armies will be able to march once it is complete.

Construct Golden Causeway.o: In Spring 382YE the Senate passed a motion to build the Golden Causeway across the Semmerlak, a magical golden crossing offered by the Lady of the Semmerlak that gives passage to Druj lands.

The Semmerlak.t: The Golden Causeway will be raised across the uncontrolled Semmerlak at the Lady of the Semmerlak's offer, linking Lacuve to the region on the opposite shore for Dawnish armies.

Construct Golden Orchards of Miaren.d: Proposed by Therunin and seconded by Sarvos, the motion created a sinecure in Miaren that produces mana crystals. Its holder is appointed for life by unanimous decision of the Navarri Senators. The motion passed at 30 thrones, and the senator was left to decide the size of the sinecure. The 30 thrones were disbursed to Senator Therunin, and Caerwyn provided 10 wains of mithril and 20 crowns. The Golden Orchards were completed, creating the Navarri national position of Granger of the Golden Orchard.

Navarr.t: Navarr gained a new national position, the Granger of the Golden Orchard, a lifetime post appointed by unanimous decision of the Navarri Senators that controls a source of mana crystals.

Construct Golden Orchards of Miaren.o: In Winter 379YE the Senate passed a motion to build the Golden Orchards of Miaren, a mana sinecure near Seren that provides mana crystals. It was later completed.

Miaren.t: The Golden Orchards were built in Miaren near Seren, giving the territory a sinecure that produces mana crystals.

Construct Good Leaf Gardens.d: Proposed by Miaren and seconded by Mitwold, the motion arose from a suggestion by Morgan of Brock Bottom Steading following a statement of principle by Corey Brackensong. The accompanying mandate was raised in the Navarr National Assembly, and Brat Umbral Path provided the liao to enact it, allowing the folly to operate as a sinecure. The commission used non-standard costs of 15 wains of weirwood and 30 crowns, taking three months to complete. William Talbot provided the weirwood and crowns after the Autumn Equinox 382YE. Its completion creates a new Imperial title, a national position in the Marches called Steward of Good Leaf Gardens.

Navarr.t: The Navarr, through their National Assembly mandate and liao from Brat Umbral Path, offered their herbs to the Marches as thanks for Marcher support in the fight against the vallorn.

The Marches.t: The Marches gained Good Leaf Gardens, stocked with Navarri herbs, and a new national title, Steward of Good Leaf Gardens, with William Talbot providing the weirwood and crowns to build it.

Construct Good Leaf Gardens.o: The Senate passed in principle a motion to construct Good Leaf Gardens, a wayhouse folly in Upwold that, backed by a Navarr National Assembly mandate, functions as a sinecure sharing Navarri herbs with the Marches in thanks for their support against the vallorn.

Upwold.t: Good Leaf Gardens was commissioned as a wayhouse in Upwold, where it serves as a sinecure sharing Navarri herbs with the Marches.

Construct Good Walder's Orchard.d: The motion was proposed by the senator for Upwold and seconded by Bregasland. It was intended to be entirely self-funded by Bastard Tom of Upwold, with the stated aim of raising an inspirational tomb there in future. The sinecure creates the one-year position of Keeper of the Orchard, appointed and revocable by the Marcher Assembly. Non-standard costs applied: 30 wains of white granite and 60 crowns in labour. After the Autumn Equinox, Tom Appleseed provided 7 thrones 2 crowns and the 30 wains of white granite, and Lieselotte van Holberg provided a further 2 crowns.

The Marches.t: The Marches gained a sinecure, Good Walder's Orchard, that yields apples and liao each season. The Marcher Assembly controls its Keeper of the Orchard, appointing the holder for a year and able to revoke the title.

Construct Good Walder's Orchard.o: In Autumn 383YE the Senate passed a motion to commission Good Walder's Orchard, a sinecure beside the Walder's Oak in Mitwold, to produce apples and liao each season. It was overseen by a new Keeper of the Orchard title appointed by the Marcher Assembly.

Mitwold.t: The orchard was commissioned by the Walder's Oak in Mitwold, with a future inspirational tomb intended at the site.

Upwold.t: Mentioned in passing: Upwold's senator proposed the motion, and it was to be funded by Bastard Tom of Upwold.

Construct Grand Art Gallery of Sarvos.d: Proposed by the senator for Sarvos and seconded by Tassato, the motion sought a grand art gallery dedicated to Pride, in keeping with the Virtuous interest in the League's cultural renaissance. It cost 15 wains of white granite, 5 wains of weirwood and 5 thrones in labour, and took three months to build. Lorenzo "La Volpe" Macelliao von Temeschwar provided all of the materials and money after the Spring Equinox. The finished work, the Blood Red Quays Art Gallery, gives 15 liao and 30 votes in the Imperial Synod each season. These are shared among Sarvos citizens dedicated to Pride who own congregations, following attendance at the Anvil Summit.

The League.t: League senators for Sarvos and Tassato brought forward the motion, celebrating the League's cultural renaissance with a Pride-dedicated gallery, and a League citizen, Lorenzo "La Volpe" Macelliao von Temeschwar, paid for it in full.

Construct Grand Art Gallery of Sarvos.o: In Spring 381YE the Senate passed a motion to build a Great Work in Sarvos: a grand art gallery dedicated to Pride, taking advantage of an opportunity that arose during the recent period of inspiration.

Sarvos.t: The Blood Red Quays Art Gallery was built in Sarvos. Each season it gives liao and Synod votes to Sarvos citizens dedicated to Pride who own congregations.

Construct Grand Conservatory of Music.d: Proposed by Morrow and seconded by Hercynia, the motion sought to build the Grand Conservatory to match the pride Urizen took in creating the Art and Culture enchantment upon the Empire, and to foster that pride in its music and magic. It passed. The work cost 15 wains of white granite, 5 wains of weirwood and 5 thrones in labour, and took three months to build. Ariadne provided all of the materials and money after the Spring Equinox. Once complete, the Conservatory provides 15 liao and 30 Synod votes each season, shared among Redoubt citizens dedicated to Pride who own congregations, following the Anvil summit.

Urizen.t: The Conservatory honours Urizeni pride in their music and magic. Once built, it gives Urizen's Pride-dedicated congregations in Redoubt additional liao and Synod votes each season.

Construct Grand Conservatory of Music.o: The Senate passed a motion in Spring 381YE to build the Grand Conservatory of Music in Redoubt, a great work celebrating Urizeni pride in music and magic, raised during a period of inspiration.

Redoubt.t: The Grand Conservatory of Music was raised in Redoubt. It supplies 15 liao and 30 Synod votes each season to the territory's citizens dedicated to Pride who own congregations.

Construct Grand Guildhouse of the Printe.d: The project was announced by the Chair of the Wolf rather than passed as an ordinary motion. It required 30 wains of white granite and 90 crowns in labour, and would take three months to build. After the Spring Equinox, Jonah Yakovitch provided 11 thrones 2 crowns and the 30 wains of white granite. Once complete, the guildhouse would raise the income of the Curator of the Printers' Guild Museum to 20 crowns a season and of the Custodian of the Printers' Guild Mausoleum to 3 thrones a season. It would also let a key member of the guild spread one publication across the Empire each season for a throne, and let a merchant-prince of the guild make a single address to the Empire after its completion.

The League.t: The League's Chair of the Wolf, Taddea Ginori, announced the grand guildhouse to honour its Printers' Guild. Once finished, it would strengthen the guild's offices and its reach in spreading publications and addresses across the Empire.

Construct Grand Guildhouse of the Printe.o: In Spring 388YE Taddea Ginori, Chair of the Wolf, announced the commissioning of a Grand Guildhouse of the Printers' Guild in Tassato Mestra. The building was meant to cement the guild's legacy as the Torchbearers of Truth, following the opportunity raised by the wind of fortune The truth but tell it slant.

Tassato/Tassato Mestra.t: Tassato Mestra is the site of the new Grand Guildhouse of the Printers' Guild, built of white granite as the guild's monument to truth.

Tassato.t: Tassato, held by the League, was chosen to host the Printers' Guild's grand guildhouse, with materials and funds supplied after the Spring Equinox for its three-month construction.

Construct Grand Inspiration of the Way.d: The motion was proposed by the senator for Casinea and seconded by the senator for Temeschwar. It needed 951 wains of white granite, 49 wains of mithril and 2230 crowns in labour, and three years to build.
