Construct Treasure Ship.o: In Autumn 381YE the Senate passed a motion to build a Folly, an Imperial treasure ship named 'Adventure', laden with valuables in the port of Siroc, to be sailed into a ferocious tempest and scuttled as an offering to Rhianos.

Bay of Catazar.t: The treasure ship Adventure was to set sail from the Bay of Catazar, leaving it behind with any accompanying fleets, before seeking out a tempest to be scuttled in.

Construct Trees and Hills merchant hall.d: Proposed by the senator for Karsk and seconded by Ossium, the motion commissioned a ministry in Karsk to help Ossium's refugees settle and to exchange forest or mine resources for coin. It created the title Warden of the Trees and Hills, elected once a year by the forest and mine owners of Varushka. The commission required 6 wains of white granite, 6 wains of mithril and 24 crowns of labour. After the Autumn Equinox, Vitaly Grigorovich Dukov provided the mithril, the white granite and 3 thrones. Work could not begin, however, because the location of the Warden's offices had not been decided.

Varushka.t: Varushka gained a new elected title, the Warden of the Trees and Hills, chosen each year by the nation's forest and mine owners. Vitaly Grigorovich Dukov supplied the materials for the hall.

Construct Trees and Hills merchant hall.o: In Autumn 383YE the Senate passed a motion to build a merchant hall in Karsk, the Trees and Hills, to organise refugees from Ossium settling there and to trade forest or mine resources for coin.

Karsk.t: Karsk's senator proposed the motion to build the merchant hall in Karsk, which would organise Ossium refugees settling there. Work cannot start until the Warden's office location is decided.

Ossium.t: Ossium's senator seconded the motion, which sought to organise Ossium's displaced people as they settle in neighbouring Karsk.

Construct Trencher's Shining Ambition.d: Proposed by the senator for Kallavesa and seconded by Reikos, the motion commissioned a great work benefitting fleets. It required 20 wains each of white granite and weirwood, 10 wains of mithril and 180 crowns in labour, raised by its marshland site, plus standard costs, with three months to complete. Trencher Smoulder in The Cold supplied all the materials and 21 thrones 2 crowns after the Winter Solstice. Triska Markova, Farren Silver Streams and Rhys Nighthaven added small sums. With the lighthouse complete, all fleets in Kallavesa gain an additional rank when trading.

Wintermark.t: A Wintermark territory gained a great lighthouse that strengthens the trade of its fleets, funded largely by Trencher Smoulder in The Cold, in a bid to revive Westerhal's commerce.

Construct Trencher's Shining Ambition.o: The Senate passed a motion in Winter 387YE to build a great lighthouse, Trencher's Shining Ambition, in West Marsh, Kallavesa, intended to restore Westerhal as a hub of western commerce.

Kallavesa/West Marsh.t: West Marsh is the site of Trencher's Shining Ambition, a great lighthouse whose marshland location raised its labour costs.

Kallavesa.t: Kallavesa's own senator proposed the lighthouse, and now that it is complete every fleet in the territory gains an additional rank when engaging in trade.

Construct Twilight Demesne.d: Palerictus Ka'bal, the Legion Engineer, commissioned a mana sinecure in Skarsind at the standard cost for sinecures. After the Spring Equinox 384YE several donors supplied materials. Bloodcrow Yargol gave 5 wains of mithril and 2 thrones 4 crowns. Ashborn Vana, Ghillihg, Zerk, Ringforge Kerath and Tog each gave a single wain of mithril. Once work on the Demesne is complete, the title of Curator of the Twilight Demesne will become available for appointment. The page is marked as a placeholder still being worked on, so it records the commission and its progress rather than a finished construction.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Twilight Demesne is being built in Skarsind, an Imperial Orc territory, and will create a new Curator title to oversee a mana sinecure in Orc lands.

Construct Twilight Demesne.o: In Spring 384YE the Legion Engineer, Palerictus Ka'bal, announced the commissioning of the Twilight Demesne, a mana sinecure in Skarsind to be overseen by a new Curator of the Twilight Demesne.

Skarsind.t: Skarsind is the site of the Twilight Demesne, a mana sinecure commissioned in Spring 384YE and supplied with mithril by several donors.

Construct Vales Might.d: The Civilian Commissioner of Wintermark approved the construction of Vales Might using the power to commission constructions that the Senate had delegated to them. The sinecure is to produce crystal mana in Wood Heath, Hahnmark. It cost 12 wains of mithril and 3 thrones in labour, and was to take three months to build. Tyr Brenna provided the full 12 wains of mithril and 3 thrones after the Winter Solstice 380YE. Once completed, the construction will create a new national title within Wintermark, the Keeper of the Crystal Vale.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark's Civilian Commissioner commissioned the sinecure and Tyr Brenna funded it, and the nation will gain a new national title, the Keeper of the Crystal Vale, once it is built.

Construct Vales Might.o: In Winter 380YE the Civilian Commissioner of Wintermark commissioned Vales Might, a sinecure in Wood Heath, Hahnmark, to produce crystal mana.

Hahnmark/Wood Heath.t: Wood Heath is the site of Vales Might, a sinecure commissioned to produce crystal mana.

Hahnmark.t: Hahnmark, held by Wintermark, is to gain a new sinecure producing crystal mana once the three-month construction is complete.

Construct Valley of Pride.d: The commission was approved by the Civilian Commissioner of Wintermark, using the power to commission constructions that the Senate had delegated to them. The Valley of Pride is a sinecure costing twelve wains of weirwood and three thrones in labour, and takes three months to build. Thanmir Hrafnar provided the weirwood and the thrones after the Summer Solstice 380YE. Once completed, the sinecure will create the Wintermark national title of Herbalist of the Hearth. The holder is to be appointed by unanimous decision of the Wintermark senators.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark gains a new national title, the Herbalist of the Hearth, chosen by unanimous decision of its senators, with Thanmir Hrafnar meeting the full cost of materials and labour.

Construct Valley of Pride.o: In Summer 380YE the Civilian Commissioner of Wintermark approved the construction of the Valley of Pride, a herb sinecure in Wood Heath, Hahnmark, which will create the national title Herbalist of the Hearth.

Hahnmark/Wood Heath.t: Wood Heath is the chosen site of the Valley of Pride, a herb sinecure taking three months to build.

Hahnmark.t: Hahnmark is to gain a herb sinecure, the Valley of Pride, built within its borders on Wintermark land.

Construct Vallornguard Mustering Ground.d: The motion, proposed by the senator for Ossium and seconded by Hercynia, commissioned the mustering ground for 10 wains of weirwood, 10 wains of mithril and 60 crowns in labour. It took three months to build and needs no upkeep. The project was self-funded. Kevan Heartsbane provided 10 wains of weirwood, 5 wains of mithril and 5 thrones 6 crowns, and Corwyn Heartsbane gave the other 5 wains of mithril. Drysfa Broken Bough, Eleri Bronwen's Rest, Nathair Autumngale, Farren Silver Streams and Rhys Nighthaven made smaller donations of coin. The Vallornguard would appoint the first holder of the new title at the Summer Solstice 388YE, for a shortened term of nine months.

Navarr.t: Navarr gained a new title, the First Thorn of the Vallornguard, appointed by the Vallornguard, and Navarri such as Kevan and Corwyn Heartsbane paid for its construction.

Construct Vallornguard Mustering Ground.o: In Spring 388YE the Senate passed a motion to build the Vallornguard Mustering Ground in Holtford, Miaren, a sinecure offered by the Every path you know wind of fortune. Once it was complete, the Vallornguard could appoint the First Thorn of the Vallornguard.

Miaren/Holtford.t: Holtford is the site of the Vallornguard Mustering Ground, completed after three months of construction.

Miaren.t: Miaren became home to the newly built Vallornguard Mustering Ground, a sinecure for the Vallornguard.

Construct Vicente School and Orphanage.d: The ministry cost 12 mithril and 36 crowns, plus possible Black Plateau costs pending a mandate regarding the Block, and took three months to build. It shelters orphans and trains them as reckoners and traders with help from those across the city, while purchasing mana crystals. It also creates the tenured League title of Custodian of the Vicente School and Orphanage, appointed by the League's Senators and revocable by the League National Assembly. After the Summer Solstice and Autumn Equinox, donors including Bella, Francisco and Fiorente Vicente d'Apulian, Heliodoro Vicente, Otmar van Holberg, Teodore duSesna and Serenus Starsong supplied the mithril and money. The Custodian could first be appointed, by unanimous decision of the League Senators, at the Spring Equinox 387YE.

The League.t: The League gained a new tenured national title, the Custodian of the Vicente School and Orphanage, appointed unanimously by its Senators and revocable by its National Assembly. Members of the Vicente family were among the main funders.

Construct Vicente School and Orphanage.o: Heliodoro Vicente, Bearer of the First Imperial Wayleave, announced the commissioning of the Vicente School and Orphanage, a mana ministry in Apulian, Apulus, combining an orphanage that trains orphans as reckoners and traders with a mana trading house. It was funded by donations and completed.

Spiral/Apulus.t: The Vicente School and Orphanage was built in Apulian in Apulus, giving the city an orphanage for training reckoners and traders and a mana trading house.

Spiral.t: Spiral, held by the League, gained a mana ministry that shelters orphans, trains them as reckoners and traders and purchases mana crystals.

Construct Vigilant Shield.d: Proposed by the senator for Reikos and seconded by the senator for Necropolis, the motion sought to create the Vigilant Shield and the title of Captain of the Throne Guard, charged with organising and leading the Throne Guard at Anvil to protect the Throne. The title is appointed annually by the Throne and recallable by the Assembly of Nine and the General Assembly, and is self-funded. Because a sinecure cannot provide liao without an opportunity, the viable constitutional reading was a sinecure providing both votes and liao. Severin Teyhard von Holberg provided 10 wains of white granite and 20 crowns after the Summer Solstice.

Highguard.t: Highguard's senators for Reikos and Necropolis proposed and seconded the motion, and the new sinecure is to be built on Highborn soil in Casinea.

Construct Vigilant Shield.o: In Summer 383YE the Senate passed a motion to build a liao sinecure called the Vigilant Shield in Casinea, held by a new Imperial title, the Captain of the Throne Guard, responsible for protecting the person of the Throne at Anvil.

Casinea.t: Casinea is to host the Vigilant Shield, a new sinecure providing votes and liao to the Captain of the Throne Guard.

Construct Virtue's Rest.d: Proposed by Bastion and seconded by Bregasland, the motion created a network of hostels offering safety and rest to pilgrims travelling to and from the White City. The work cost 100 wains of white granite and 200 crowns in labour, and took six months. Rhesa of the Scions of Ravenfell provided both halves of the materials and coin, after the Winter Solstice 382YE and the Summer Solstice 383YE. Once finished, it yields 50 liao and 100 Synod votes spread among Bastion's congregations. The hostels were designed to line the proposed Blood Red Roads and gave only half benefit until the White Roads were completed shortly before the Winter Solstice 384YE. Philemon refused to let any League "montebanc" near the scheme.

Highguard.t: The motion called for Highguard's citizens to fund the work themselves, and Rhesa of the Highborn Scions of Ravenfell supplied all the granite and coin, giving the nation a pilgrim network and extra liao and Synod votes for its Bastion congregations.

Construct Virtue's Rest.o: In Spring 382YE the Senate passed a motion to build Virtue's Rest, a Great Work in Bastion made up of seven pilgrim hostels, one for each Virtue, based on plans drawn up by Philemon of the Chapter of Fulmon's Bounty.

Bastion.t: Seven Virtue hostels were built across Bastion to shelter pilgrims to the White City. They provide 50 liao and 100 Synod votes to its congregations, at full strength only once the White Roads reached the territory before Winter 384YE.

Construct Wanderer's Entertainment Socie.d: Announced by Lucrezia Corvinascura, Chair of the Wolf, and organised by Red Ravens Holding, the project required 10 wains of weirwood and 30 crowns (3 thrones and 6 crowns) at standard costs, taking three months to complete. Giacomo Corvinoscuro provided the full materials and money after the Spring Equinox 387YE. Once complete, the Mistress of Festivities, a sinecure providing wealth, became available for the League Assembly to appoint by judgement for the first time at the Summer Solstice 387YE. At the Autumn Equinox 387YE the Senate granted the powers and responsibilities of the Mistress of Festivities to the Mistress of Ceremonies.

The League.t: The League gained a new wealth-producing sinecure, the Mistress of Festivities, appointed by the League Assembly, though its powers were later folded into the Mistress of Ceremonies by the Senate.

Construct Wanderer's Entertainment Socie.o: In Spring 387YE the Chair of the Wolf announced the construction of the Wanderer's Entertainment Society, a self-funded wealth-producing sinecure in Hanuri, Temeschwar, supervised by a League-appointed Mistress of Festivities.

Temeschwar/Hanuri.t: The Wanderer's Entertainment Society was built in Hanuri, completed after three months of construction.

Temeschwar.t: Temeschwar became home to the Wanderer's Entertainment Society, a new Imperial structure funded by Giacomo Corvinoscuro.

Construct Wayhouse in Holberg.d: Using an Imperial Wayleave, Ciapek Splintered Oak announced a wayhouse in the marshes of Utterlund. It required 16 wains of white granite and 1152 rings in labour, a cost raised by building in a marsh, and took three months to complete. Ciapek provided the granite and 6 thrones after the Winter Solstice. Kaspar Yakovich von Holberg, Farren Silver Streams and Fretek Sargava Slavomiryn added smaller sums. Once completed, the wayhouse allowed Navarr to take a personal resource in Holberg without the foreign nation penalty. It also created the title of Keeper of the Splintered House, first appointable at the Spring Equinox 388YE by unanimous decision of Navarr's senators.

Navarr.t: The Navarr gained a wayhouse in Holberg, letting their people take personal resources there without the foreign nation penalty. Their senators can appoint its Keeper by unanimous decision from Spring 388YE.

The League.t: A Navarr wayhouse was raised in the League territory of Holberg, and Kaspar Yakovich von Holberg contributed money towards its construction.

Construct Wayhouse in Holberg.o: In Winter 387YE Ciapek Splintered Oak, Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave, announced the self-funded construction of a Navarr wayhouse, The Splintered House, in Utterlund, Holberg. The wayhouse was later completed.

Holberg/Utterlund.t: The Splintered House was built in Utterlund's marshes, which made the labour more costly. It now stands there as a completed wayhouse.

Holberg.t: Holberg gained The Splintered House, a Navarr wayhouse that opened the territory to Navarr personal resources without the foreign nation penalty.

Construct Wayhouse in Ossium.d: Proposed by Miaren and seconded by Mitwold, the motion commissioned a wayhouse in the Varushkan territory of Ossium, in the region of Nearweald, linked to the Way Home Wind of Fortune. It cost 16 wains of mithril and 6 thrones and was to take three months to construct. After the Spring Equinox, Gryiff Embercast provided the 16 wains of mithril and 5 thrones 7 crowns, and Farren Silver Streams provided 1 crown. Once complete, the Strategos of Navarr gains custodianship of a sinecure, and Navarr can take personal resources in Ossium without the usual foreign nation penalty.

Navarr.t: Navarr gains a wayhouse in Ossium that shelters its refugees from Therunin, gives the Strategos of Navarr custodianship of a sinecure to help fund the army, and lets Navarri take personal resources in Ossium without the foreign nation penalty.

Varushka.t: Varushka's territory of Ossium will host a Navarr wayhouse and Navarri settlers drawing resources there without penalty.

Construct Wayhouse in Ossium.o: In Spring 387YE the Senate passed a motion to build a Navarr wayhouse in Nearweald, Ossium, to shelter refugees from Therunin and help fund the Navarr army, with the title attached to the Navarr strategos.

Ossium/Nearweald.t: Nearweald is the site of the new Navarr wayhouse, which is to take three months to build and will house refugees from Therunin.

Ossium.t: A Navarr wayhouse is commissioned in Ossium, allowing Navarri to hold personal resources in this Varushkan territory without the foreign nation penalty.

Therunin.t: Navarri refugees displaced from Therunin are to be housed at the new wayhouse in Ossium.

Construct Wayward House.d: Paris of Apulus, Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave, announced the commission of the Wayward House in Apulian, in Apulus, Spiral. It was to be built by the Edificer's Guild of Apulian, with funding from Damian i Martan i Erigo. The work required twelve wains of white granite and 36 crowns in labour, and would take three months to build. After the Summer Solstice 388YE, Paris of Apulus provided 4 thrones 4 crowns and the twelve wains of white granite. Once complete, the apartments will house Jarmish pilgrims of the Way who visit the Empire.

The League.t: League citizens drove the project: a Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave, Paris of Apulus, announced it and paid for it, Damian i Martan i Erigo funded it, and the Edificer's Guild of Apulian is building it in a League city.

Construct Wayward House.o: The Wayward House, a block of apartments in the city of Apulian, Apulus, was commissioned to give hospitality to Jarmish pilgrims of the Way visiting the Empire. It was announced by Paris of Apulus, Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave, after the Full circles wind of fortune.

Spiral/Apulus.t: The Wayward House apartments are going up in the city of Apulian in Apulus, using twelve wains of white granite over three months, and will host visiting Jarmish pilgrims.

Spiral.t: Spiral gains a new white granite edifice in Apulian, meant to welcome Jarmish pilgrims of the Way into the territory.

Construct Well of Life.d: The commission required 40 wains each of white granite and weirwood, 20 wains of mithril and 60 crowns in labour, with six months to complete. Donations were recorded after the Winter Solstice 387YE and the Spring Equinox and Summer Solstice 388YE, mostly materials from Fausta Ankarien plus money from many individuals. Once complete, the Well of Life would add 15 mana crystals to the Conclave font each season and provide a large hospital. It would cheapen the Grandmaster's mana purchases and let them buy vital honey. It would also improve local herb gardens, give order members true vervain and the vaults ilium, cut Imperial army casualties in Madruga, Kahraman, Segura and Feroz by a tenth, and create the Freeborn title Hakima of the Rippling Marshes.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: Feroz, then held by Grendel, is one of the territories where Imperial armies would suffer a tenth fewer casualties once the Well of Life is complete.

The Brass Coast.t: The great lodge would stand in Freeborn Madruga, giving Imperial armies fighting across Brass Coast territories reduced casualties and creating a new Freeborn position, the Hakima of the Rippling Marshes.

Construct Well of Life.o: In Winter 387YE the Senate saw a motion, announced by Dima Vasilyevna Novosad, Master of the Koboldi, to commission the Well of Life, a grand lodge and hospital of the Silver Chalice in Lightsea, Madruga, to be funded by the order itself.

Madruga/Lightsea.t: Lightsea is the site chosen for the Well of Life, the Silver Chalice's grand lodge and hospital, which would be overseen by the new Hakima of the Rippling Marshes.

Feroz.t: Imperial armies fighting in Feroz, then in Grendel hands, would suffer a tenth fewer casualties once the Well of Life is complete.

Kahraman.t: Imperial armies fighting in Kahraman would have their casualties reduced by a tenth once the hospital is complete.

Madruga.t: Madruga would host the Silver Chalice's grand lodge, gaining a large hospital, improved herb gardens and reduced casualties for Imperial armies fighting in the territory.

Segura.t: Imperial armies fighting in Segura would suffer a tenth fewer casualties once the Well of Life is complete.

Construct Western Kalsea Spy Network.d: The commission followed up the opportunity created by the successful Skallahn raid, as set out in the Take it further wind of fortune. It required 5 wains of weirwood, 10 crowns and three months to build, with an upkeep of 5 thrones each season. After the Autumn Equinox several Imperial citizens contributed funds: Cpt. Hendrick van Hoven and Tevoro von Ghurayb von Holberg gave 2 crowns 10 rings each, and Ergot Di Cevia, Fintan Nighthaven and Æðelric Dagursson gave 1 crown each. The network did not survive. Jarl Ustigar of Kierheim's forces destroyed it, using information gathered when they destroyed the Skallahn spy network.

Jotun.t: The network was meant to give the Empire an edge in its offensive against the Jotun. Jarl Ustigar of Kierheim's forces destroyed it, turning intelligence from the earlier Skallahn spy network against the Imperial spies.

Construct Western Kalsea Spy Network.o: In Autumn 384YE the Imperial Spymaster, Bernard Dugdale, announced a commission to build a spy network in the territory west of Skallahn to strengthen the offensive against the Jotun. The network was later destroyed by the forces of Jarl Ustigar of Kierheim.

Skallahn.t: The successful raid on Jotun-held Skallahn opened the way for this network further west. Its downfall began in Skallahn, where the destruction of the Skallahn spy network yielded the information the Jotun used to find and destroy the new one.

Construct Wharfage of Oran.d: Proposed by the senator for Feroz and seconded by Kahraman, the motion commissioned the Wharfage of Oran, following the Send for me Wind of Fortune. It cost 15 weirwood and 15 crowns, was fully self-funded and took three months to build. After the Spring Equinox, Esteban I Del Rio Blanco I Guerra provided 1 throne, 6 crowns and 15 wains of weirwood, and Farren Silver Streams gave 1 crown. Once complete, the lawless quality was removed from the Cazar Straits. The new Corsair of Oran receives 216 rings and, if held by a corsair, a yearly base fleet upgrade. It was first appointable by the votes of Freeborn fleet owners at the Summer Solstice 387YE.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: Grendel is not named in the motion and is linked only as one of the powers holding part of Feroz that season.

The Brass Coast.t: The Freeborn gained a new sinecure in Feroz, with Freeborn fleet owners choosing the first Corsair of Oran at the Summer Solstice 387YE, and the motion was proposed by Feroz and seconded by Kahraman.

Construct Wharfage of Oran.o: In Spring 387YE the Senate passed a motion to build the Wharfage of Oran in Oranseri, Feroz, a sinecure that removed the lawless quality from the Cazar Straits and created the title of Corsair of Oran.

Feroz/Cazar Straits.t: With the wharfage complete, the Cazar Straits lost their lawless quality.

Feroz/Oranseri.t: The Wharfage of Oran was constructed at Oran in Oranseri, the seat of the new Corsair of Oran title.

Feroz.t: The Wharfage of Oran was built in Feroz, and its construction ended the lawless state of the territory's Cazar Straits.

Construct White Roads.d: Proposed by Casinea and seconded by Sarvos, the motion called for a single commission based on earlier designs by Johanna of Ravensfell and was described as self-funded. The cost, as set out in the related Wind of Fortune, was 120 wains of white granite and 240 crowns in labour, with six months needed for construction. Rhesa supplied 15 thrones and 60 wains of white granite after the Summer Solstice 384YE, and the same again after the Autumn Equinox. Once complete, the White Roads will act as great works raising the income of farms and businesses in all three territories.

Highguard.t: All three territories to be linked by the White Roads are Highborn lands, so the Highborn stand to gain greater prosperity for their farms and businesses, along with more pilgrims at the hostels of Virtue's Rest.

Construct White Roads.o: In Summer 384YE the Senate passed a motion commissioning the White Roads of Virtue's Path across Bastion, Necropolis and Reikos, great works meant to boost the prosperity of farms and businesses and bring pilgrims to the hostels of Virtue's Rest.

Bastion.t: Bastion is one of the three territories where the White Roads are to be built, raising the income of its farms and businesses once construction is finished.

Necropolis.t: Necropolis will receive a stretch of the White Roads, which will boost the income of its farms and businesses once the six months of construction are complete.

Reikos.t: Reikos is included in the White Roads commission, and its farms and businesses will earn more once the great work is complete.

Construct Wintermark beacons.d: The motion arose from a civil service proposal and was to be funded entirely by Tyr Brenna of Hendall Hearth. The commission used non-standard costs: 40 wains of white granite, 40 wains of weirwood and 160 crowns in labour, taking six months to complete. After the Autumn Equinox, Hengest Dun provided the 40 wains of weirwood, 40 wains of white granite and 20 thrones. Once complete, the beacons would allow military unit commanders to defend Kallavesa and Hahnmark and to offer resistance to invading armies.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark's own senators and a Wintermark hearth championed and funded the beacons. Once built, they would let military unit commanders help defend two of the nation's territories against invasion.

Construct Wintermark beacons.o: In Autumn 382YE the Senate passed in principle a motion, proposed by Hahnmark's senator and seconded by Kallavesa's, to commission a series of beacons and watchtowers across Kallavesa and Hahnmark.

Hahnmark.t: Hahnmark's senator proposed the motion. The territory was to gain a network of beacons and watchtowers that, once complete, would let military unit commanders resist invading armies there.

Kallavesa.t: Kallavesa's senator seconded the motion, and the territory was to receive beacons and watchtowers that would let military unit commanders defend it against invaders.

Construct Wrangler's Market.d: Senator Ana i Taziel i Riqueza of Segura proposed the motion, seconded by Senator Eulàlia i Phovas i Riqueza of Madruga. It sought 14 wains of weirwood or 64 thrones, and passed at 54 thrones, which were disbursed to the Senator for Segura. The work also required 42 crowns in labour and three months to complete. After the Summer Solstice, Tancred Enrico i Taziel i Riqueza provided 5 thrones and the 14 wains of weirwood. Farren Silver Streams and Rhys Nighthaven each gave a crown. Once complete, fleet owners would appoint a Chief Wrangler by Freeborn tally, and Imperial Orc military units could use the market to spy on Arbonne.
Construct Wrangler's Market.o: In Summer 388YE the Senate approved a motion to commission the Wrangler's Market in Arbonne, a spy network built under the opportunity described in the No matter what Wind of Fortune.

Bay of Catazar.t: The market was to be built in Arbonne, beyond Imperial control, so that once finished Imperial Orc military units could use it to spy on Arbonne.

Construct Wyrding Tower.d: Announced by Borys Vardovich Straskovich, Boyar of the Iron Roads, the commission built a ministry proposed in an appraisal by Graciana i Lopez i Guerra, linked to the Sunrise over Livardz wind of fortune. The commission spoke of bringing prosperity to the ruins left by the Cold Sun. It required 12 wains of mithril, 36 crowns in labour and three months' work. After the Summer Solstice, Emil Artemov Lenka and Yaroslav Goraschenko Vernost each supplied six wains of mithril, with coin given by several citizens. On completion, the title Volhov of the Wyrding Tower became available, chosen by tally of Varushkan mine and forest owners from the Autumn Equinox 388YE, and the ashen wind's threat was lifted.

Varushka.t: Varushka gained a new volhov tower and the title Volhov of the Wyrding Tower, to be appointed by the votes of Varushkan mine and forest owners from the Autumn Equinox 388YE.

Construct Wyrding Tower.o: In Summer 388YE the Boyar of the Iron Roads announced the commissioning of the Wyrding Tower, a volhov tower in Livardz, Volodmartz, which was subsequently built and removed the threat of the ashen wind.

Volodmartz/Livardz.t: The Wyrding Tower was raised in Livardz, among the ruins left by the Cold Sun, and its completion ended the threat of the ashen wind there.

Volodmartz.t: The tower's completion in Volodmartz removed the threat of the ashen wind and was meant to bring prosperity to lands ruined by the Cold Sun.

Construct Yakholme Grange.d: The motion arose from the opportunity described in the Wild is the Wind wind of fortune. Yakholme Grange required 50 wains of weirwood, 25 wains of white granite and 225 crowns in labour, and took six months to build. Contributions came in over several seasons through Summer 388YE, including money from Ebenezer, Khutulun Hakhandra and Orrick, white granite from Khutulun Hakhandra, and weirwood from Richard Conscience, Watkin and Henry Birchsmith, plus smaller donations. Once complete, the grange would raise the level of investment for farms in Upwold by one, establish Stockland as the Empire's premier cattle market, and increase Faraden trade with the Marches.

The Marches.t: The Marches undertook to fund the grange themselves, and on completion its farmers would gain greater investment and taxation from their farms and increased Faraden trade.

Construct Yakholme Grange.o: In Autumn 387YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by the senator for Upwold and seconded by Karov, to construct Yakholme Grange in Stockland, Upwold, a great work to be self-funded by the Marches.

Upwold/Stock March.t: Yakholme Grange was to be built at Stockland in Stock March, set to become the Empire's premier cattle market.

Upwold.t: Upwold's senator proposed the motion, and the completed grange would raise the level of investment for farms throughout the territory by one.

Construct Zemress Naval Academy.d: Proposed by Kahraman and seconded by Tassato, the motion commissioned the academy at a cost of 10 wains of white granite, 15 of weirwood, 10 of mithril and 70 crowns in labour, taking six months to build, with 5 thrones in seasonal upkeep. After the Summer Solstice, Esteban I Del Rio Blanco I Guerra provided the mithril, weirwood, white granite and 8 thrones 6 crowns. Once complete, researchers would present three possible qualities for new Imperial navies, and the fleet owners of the Brass Coast would vote on which mattered most; the winning quality would become the focus of a year's research.

The Brass Coast.t: The Brass Coast gained a naval academy on its soil, built with materials and coin supplied by Esteban I Del Rio Blanco I Guerra, and its fleet owners were given the vote on which quality the school's research into new Imperial navies would pursue.

Construct Zemress Naval Academy.o: In Summer 384YE the Senate passed a motion to construct the Zemress Naval Academy, also called the School of Blood and Brass, in Madruga, a self-funded institution open to Imperial students for studying and researching techniques of naval warfare.

Madruga.t: Madruga became the site of the Zemress Naval Academy, a six-month construction that would host Imperial students studying and researching naval warfare.

Construct Zemress seminary.d: Proposed by the senator for Madruga and seconded by Kahraman, the motion commissioned a seminary celebrating the life of the exemplar Zemress, with the help of Prince Jonah von Holberg of the Printer's Guild. It used non-standard costs of 15 wains each of weirwood, white granite and mithril, taking three months to build. Adan i DelToro i Riqueza supplied the weirwood and all 15 wains of mithril across two seasons, the Zemress islanders contributed 45 crowns, and the Sumaah Republic provided the white granite. Although the motion would have lapsed at the Winter Solstice 383YE if unfinished, the seminary was completed after the Summer Solstice 383YE.

The Brass Coast.t: Brass Coast senators and citizens drove the project: Madruga's senator proposed it, Adan i DelToro i Riqueza supplied most of the materials, and a new seminary to the exemplar Zemress now stands in their lands.

Construct Zemress seminary.o: The Senate passed a motion in Winter 382YE to build a self-funded seminary in Madruga honouring the exemplar Zemress and welcoming pilgrims; the Seminary of Zemress was completed after the Summer Solstice 383YE.

Madruga.t: Madruga gained the Seminary of Zemress, completed after the Summer Solstice 383YE, which was built to celebrate the exemplar and welcome pilgrims from around the world.

Construct Zoria's Maze.d: Proposed by the Senator for Weirwater and seconded by Ossium, the commission arose from recent interest in Zoria. It was self-funded by the Vor-Azi at a non-standard cost of 18 wains of white granite and 36 crowns, taking three months to complete. Illya Nikovitch Volkov provided the crowns and Vitaly Grigorovich Dukov the granite after the Summer Solstice. The motion states the work will give 18 additional Synod votes. On completion it creates the title Guardian of the Maze of Zoria. The constitutional court suggested either the Varushkan National Assembly or the Assembly of Wisdom as electors, annually or with tenure, and the Weirwater senator favoured annual appointment by the Varushkan National Assembly.

Varushka.t: Varushkans led the project, with Varushkan individuals supplying the crowns and granite, and the Weirwater senator proposed that the Varushkan National Assembly appoint the new Guardian of the Maze of Zoria each year.

Construct Zoria's Maze.o: The Senate passed a motion in Summer 383YE to enhance Zoria's Maze, the shrine in the vale of Griejezdo in Miekarova recognised as the final resting place of Zoria, Paragon of Wisdom, so that it would house her knowledge and teachings.

Miekarova.t: The maze in the vale of Griejezdo in Miekarova was to be enhanced into a great shrine to Zoria, bringing her recognised resting place new prominence and a new Imperial title.

Construct a Marcher graveyard in Holberg.d: The motion, proposed by the senator for Temeschwar and seconded by the senator for Semmerholm, called for a cemetery in Holberg for the Marchers raised as husks. A Marcher graveyard involves importing soil from the Marches and planting Marcher apple trees. No funds were requested and the motion carried in principle by 26 votes to none. The graveyard was quickly built in the Holfried region of Holberg.

Druj.t: Mentioned in passing: the Druj are not named in the motion; they are linked only because they held part of Holberg, where the graveyard for Marchers raised as husks was built.

The League.t: The motion was brought by the League senators for Temeschwar and Semmerholm, and the graveyard was raised in Holberg, a League territory then partly held by the Druj.

Construct a Marcher graveyard in Holberg.o: In Spring 378YE the Senate approved, unanimously and at no cost, a motion to build a Marcher graveyard in Holberg for Marchers who had been raised as husks. The graveyard was quickly completed in Holfried.

Holberg/Holfried.t: Holfried became the site of the completed Marcher graveyard, built quickly after the Senate approved the motion.

Holberg.t: Holberg, then divided between the League and the Druj, gained a Marcher graveyard planted with Marcher apple trees in imported Marches soil, to lay to rest Marchers raised as husks.

Construct a Trade Hub to Axos.d: Proposed by Tassato and seconded by Sarvos, the motion granted permission to build a Trade Hub to Axos in Necropolis. It was passed. The resulting ministry exchanges liao for mana and other materials from Axos, and its holder is assigned by the Loyalty assembly. After the Summer Solstice 381YE, Tarquinius provided 20 wains of white granite and 5 thrones towards its construction. Completing the ministry automatically created the title of Quaymaster of the Black Sails.

Highguard.t: Highguard gains an Imperial trade link to Axos sited in its own territory of Necropolis, through which liao can be exchanged for mana.

Construct a Trade Hub to Axos.o: In Summer 381YE the Senate passed a motion to commission a Trade Hub to Axos in Necropolis, a ministry that trades liao for mana and other materials from Axos.

Necropolis.t: Necropolis was chosen as the site of the Trade Hub to Axos, which brings an Imperial ministry trading liao for mana into the territory, along with the new title of Quaymaster of the Black Sails.

Construct a reliquary in the mountains o.d: Azzam i Zaydan i Requeza, a holder of an Imperial Wayleave, used the power to commission constructions that the Senate had delegated to them to announce a reliquary in the mountains of Gildermark. It takes the form of a mana sinecure called the Weigher of Worth. The Senator of Skarsind appoints the holder, and the Imperial Orc National Assembly can revoke the title. After the Summer Solstice 381YE, Azzam i Zaydan i Riqueza provided the 10 wains of mithril and 20 crowns needed. The sinecure was completed and automatically created the title Weigher of Worth.

Imperial Orcs.t: The Imperial Orc National Assembly holds the power to revoke the new Weigher of Worth title. The Senator of Skarsind appoints its holder.

Construct a reliquary in the mountains o.o: A reliquary in the mountains of Gildermark was commissioned in Summer 381YE as a mana sinecure in Skarsind, creating the title Weigher of Worth.

Skarsind/Gildermark.t: The completed reliquary stands in the mountains of Gildermark, built using 10 wains of mithril.

Skarsind.t: Skarsind gained a new mana sinecure, the Weigher of Worth. Its holder is appointed by the territory's Senator.

Construct a road connecting the Thule to.d: Proposed by the senator for Skarsind and seconded by the senator for Temeschwar, the motion called for a road connecting the Thule to the Torfast Trading Post. It cost 30 wains of white granite and 60 crowns in labour, and took six months to construct. Both were provided by Irontide Vio. Once complete, the holders of the Bonesetter of Torfast Trading Post, Broker of Treji Wayhouse, Overseer of the Westward Road and Northbound Trademaster became able to trade materials for crystal mana. This trade remains viable only while the Empire stays at peace with the Thule.

Imperial Orcs.t: The road runs from the Torfast Trading Post in the Orc territory of Skarsind, giving the Orc-held trading post a direct route to the Thule for exchanging materials for crystal mana.

Thule.t: The road connects the Thule to the Empire's Torfast Trading Post, establishing a trade in materials for crystal mana that lasts only as long as the Empire and the Thule remain at peace.

Construct a road connecting the Thule to.o: In Summer 381YE the Senate passed a self-funded motion to build a road linking the Torfast Trading Post in Skarsind to the Thule, opening a route for trading materials for crystal mana.

Skarsind.t: The road was built from the Torfast Trading Post in Skarsind, proposed by Skarsind's senator, making the territory the Empire's trading gateway to the Thule.

Construct an inspirational shrine to Cor.d: Proposed by the senator for Reikos and seconded by Bastion, the motion created a memorial shrine to Cora Holdfast, an exemplar of the Virtue of Loyalty, based in High Chalcis. The shrine was established as a self-funded religious sinecure, with its holder appointed by the Assembly of Loyalty. The motion passed in Summer 381YE. After the Summer Solstice, Cadeus provided the materials and costs for its construction: 10 wains of white granite, 10 wains of weirwood, 44 crowns and a dose of true liao.

Highguard.t: Highguard's senators for Reikos and Bastion proposed and seconded the motion, giving the nation a new shrine honouring an exemplar of Loyalty in one of its territories.

Construct an inspirational shrine to Cor.o: The Senate passed a motion to construct an inspirational shrine to Cora Holdfast, exemplar of Loyalty, in High Chalcis in Reikos, serving as a self-funded religious sinecure appointed by the Assembly of Loyalty.

Reikos.t: High Chalcis in Reikos became home to the shrine to Cora Holdfast, with a new religious sinecure based there and appointed by the Assembly of Loyalty.

Construct apothecary clearing house in T.d: The motion called for funds to construct a ministry in Tassato to purchase herbs for making medicinal potions for Imperial warriors. It passed in principle and was costed at 42 Thrones. It did not set the ministry's size, location or how its holder would be chosen, leaving those choices to the proposing senator. After the Spring Equinox 380YE, Cesare Sanguineo Rezia Di Tassato provided 12 wains of weirwood for the work. The clearing house was completed in Mestra in Tassato, and the Imperial title of Master of the Clearing House was made a League national appointment.

The League.t: The League gained a new Imperial title, Master of the Clearing House, which became a League national appointment. Weirwood for the building came from Cesare Sanguineo Rezia Di Tassato.

Construct apothecary clearing house in T.o: In Summer 379YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by Tassato's senator and seconded by Miaren's, to fund a ministry in Tassato that would buy herbs to supply the Empire's warriors with medicinal potions. The clearing house was later built in Mestra.

Tassato.t: Tassato's senator proposed the motion, and the apothecary clearing house was built in Mestra, giving the territory a ministry for buying herbs for the Empire's medicines.

Construct butterfly reserve in Miekarova.d: Using the power to commission constructions that the Senate delegates to holders of an Imperial wayleave, Julianna of Phoenix Reach of Urizen announced a butterfly reserve in Miekarova's forests. It cost 15 wains of weirwood and 30 crowns in labour and takes three months to build, and Julianna supplied the full materials and money after the Spring Equinox 381YE. Once complete it creates a new title, the Gloaming Sentinel, appointed by the Conclave through a Declaration of Candidacy, which yields 20 measures of Iridescent Gloaming.

Urizen.t: A Urizen citizen, Julianna of Phoenix Reach, announced the reserve under her wayleave and personally provided the weirwood and crowns to build it.

Varushka.t: A new Conclave-appointed sinecure producing Iridescent Gloaming is being raised in the forests of the Varushkan territory of Miekarova.

Construct butterfly reserve in Miekarova.o: Julianna of Phoenix Reach, holder of an Imperial wayleave, announced the construction of a butterfly reserve in the forests of Miekarova in Spring 381YE, a sinecure producing Iridescent Gloaming.

Miekarova.t: Miekarova's forests are to host a butterfly reserve, home of the new Gloaming Sentinel title and a source of 20 measures of Iridescent Gloaming.

Construct cargo dock at Caricomare.d: Proposed by Holberg and seconded by Mitwold, the motion sought a dock at Caricomare that would provide 20 white granite per season through trade with the Asaveans. A Synod veto was threatened but was not possible, because the Synod had already used that power earlier in the summit. The project cost 30 wains of weirwood and 10 wains of white granite. Ros Jordan supplied the granite after the Summer Solstice 379YE. The dock's benefit depended on the co-operation of Asavean merchants, and Alonso Tarquinius brought undisclosed Asavean expectations to Anvil. Completion would have created a new Imperial title, though not an extra Bourse seat. Grendel orc pillagers destroyed the partially built docks during their invasion of Sarvos.

Grendel.t: Grendel pillagers invading Sarvos destroyed the partially constructed Caricomare docks, wiping out all progress on the project.

The League.t: The League's Caricomare would have gained a cargo dock and an associated Bourse title through Asavean trade, but its investment was lost when Grendel orcs razed the unfinished docks.

Construct cargo dock at Caricomare.o: In Spring 379YE the Senate approved construction of a cargo dock at Caricomare in Sarvos, meant to bring white granite from the Asaveans and create a new Imperial Bourse title. Construction began, but all progress was lost when the Grendel invaded Sarvos before the Spring Equinox 380YE.

Sarvos.t: The cargo dock was being built on the Caricomare docks in Sarvos until the Grendel invasion of the territory destroyed the partial construction.

Construct cargo dock in Cargo.d: Proposed by Madruga and seconded by Segura, the motion called for a dock costing 10 white granite, 40 weirwood and 12 thrones 4 crowns in labour, taking three months to build. The materials and money were provided by Thanmir Hrafn after the Summer Solstice 381YE. Once complete, the dock creates the title Bewaarder van het Vandersaar dok, which works like a ministry and allows purchase of white granite from the Sarcophan Delves at 32 crowns a wain for the first 8 wains, 29 for the next 8 and 26 for the last 8. The title would normally be appointed through the Bourse. As a ministry it has no upkeep. Some details were left for Senator Madruga to decide.

Urizen.t: The dock was built in Redoubt, a Urizen territory, bringing a Sarcophan white granite trade route through Urizen lands at Cargo.

Construct cargo dock in Cargo.o: The Senate passed a motion in Winter 380YE to construct a cargo dock in Cargo, Redoubt, so that the Empire could buy white granite from the Sarcophan Delves.

Redoubt.t: Redoubt was to gain a cargo dock at Cargo, creating the title Bewaarder van het Vandersaar dok and a way to buy up to 24 wains of white granite a season from the Sarcophan Delves.

Construct college of magic in Morrow.d: Proposed by the senator for Redoubt and seconded by the senator for Kallavesa, the motion sought permission, but no funding, to raise a Summer college in Morrow. Corvus, Archmage of Summer, was called as an expert witness. Because it followed designs from the Eternal Meraud, its cost differed from a standard college: 90 wains of White Granite, 30 wains of Mithril, 20 wains of Weirwood and 35 Thrones in labour, with a year to build and upkeep of 25 Thrones. Had it been completed, it would have created the Imperial title of Dean, filled through a Declaration of Candidacy in the Conclave. The commission lapsed.

Urizen.t: The senators for the Urizen territories of Redoubt and Kallavesa proposed and seconded a Summer college in their nation's land of Morrow, but the commission lapsed before it was built.

Construct college of magic in Morrow.o: The Senate considered a motion in Winter 378YE to build a College of Magic aligned with the realm of Summer in Morrow, to designs provided by the Eternal Meraud, with its Dean appointed by the Conclave. The commission later lapsed without being completed.

Morrow.t: Morrow was the intended site of a Summer College of Magic built to the Eternal Meraud's designs, but the commission lapsed and the college was never constructed.

Construct conservatory for the Anvil Hos.d: Proposed by Segura and seconded by Tassato, the motion passed at a cost of 15 thrones and required 27 wains of weirwood, which Cesare Sanguineo Rezia Di Tassato allocated in Autumn 378YE, with completion due by Winter 378YE. Once complete, the conservatory produces 10 doses of True Vervain and 5 each of Marrowort, Imperial Roseweald, Cerulean Mazzarine and Bladeroot every season. Its creation establishes Origen's Rest as an Imperial title appointed by the Senate. Although the motion intends the herbs to benefit the Anvil Hospital, the citizen holding the sinecure is free to use the bounty as they see fit.

Urizen.t: Urizen hosts the new conservatory, built on the herb garden of the retired speaker Origen, so Urizen land now produces herbs for the Senate-appointed title of Origen's Rest.

Construct conservatory for the Anvil Hos.o: The Senate passed a motion to build a conservatory in Zenith on the foundation of the retired speaker Origen's herb garden, creating the Senate-appointed sinecure of Origen's Rest to benefit the Anvil Hospital.

Zenith.t: The conservatory is built in Zenith, where it is due for completion by Winter 378YE and then produces herbs including True Vervain each season.

Construct expansion of Georgie's House.d: Proposed by Ossium and seconded by Sarvos, the motion sought to exploit increased demand described in the wind of fortune A health to the company. It required no construction slot but counted towards the limit on commissions, and was to be self-funded by the Withering Gaze at a non-standard cost of 23 crowns. The motion passed. Once completed, the expansion would raise the seasonal income of the Custodian of the Kennels by 100 rings to 388 rings. The motion itself declared that no rat would henceforth be safe.

The League.t: A League sinecure, the Custodian of the Kennels, stands to gain once the expansion is complete, with seasonal income rising to 388 rings as Holberg's kennels sell across the Empire.

Construct expansion of Georgie's House.o: In Winter 383YE the Senate passed a motion to expand Georgie's House, the Kennels of Holfried in Holberg, by acquiring adjacent properties so the business could sell its ratting dogs to clients across the Empire.

Holberg/Holfried.t: The Kennels of Holfried were approved to grow into adjacent properties, with construction funded by the Withering Gaze.

Holberg.t: Georgie's House in Holberg was approved for expansion by buying up neighbouring properties, extending the reach of a Holberg business to clients across the Empire.

Construct expansion to Halls of Knowledg.d: Proposed by the senator for Morrow and seconded by Miekarova, the motion sought an Autumn wing for the Halls of Knowledge. The civil service costed it at 25 wains each of mithril, white granite and weirwood plus 150 crowns, taking six months. After the Summer Solstice Agrippa provided 25 wains of mithril, 19 of weirwood, 1 of white granite and 12 thrones. The Druj invasion of Morrow then destroyed the Halls, ending all work; Agrippa received a partial refund. Had it been finished, the Provost would have been able to research Autumn magic at 15 ranks a season and spend money to speed that research.

Druj.t: The Druj invasion of Morrow destroyed the Halls of Knowledge, wiping out all progress on the expansion and making the commission impossible to complete.

Urizen.t: Urizen lost both the planned Autumn wing and the Halls of Knowledge themselves to the Druj, along with the Autumn magic research it would have given the Provost.

Construct expansion to Halls of Knowledg.o: In Summer 382YE the Senate passed in principle a motion to expand the Halls of Knowledge in Peregro with a wing dedicated to researching Autumn magic, but the Druj invasion of Morrow destroyed the Halls and the commission could never be completed.

Morrow/Peregro.t: Peregro was home to the Halls of Knowledge where the Autumn wing was to be built, and the Halls were destroyed there during the Druj invasion.

Morrow.t: Morrow's senator proposed the expansion, but the Druj invasion of the territory destroyed the Halls of Knowledge and ended construction.

Construct folly in Afarjasse.d: Proposed by the senator for Temeschwar and seconded by the senator for Semmerholm, the motion authorised a folly in Afarjasse, Feroz, dedicated to the region itself. It was self-funded, and the senator was permitted to build a folly of any magnitude at standard costs. After the Winter Solstice 379YE, Gant Archama provided 10 wains of white granite and 20 crowns towards the work, and the folly was subsequently recorded as complete.

The Brass Coast.t: A folly celebrating Afarjasse now stands in the Brass Coast territory of Feroz, built through a self-funded Senate motion with materials and money from Gant Archama.

Construct folly in Afarjasse.o: The Senate passed a motion in Winter 379YE to build a self-funded folly in Afarjasse in Feroz, dedicated to that location; the folly was later completed.

Feroz/Afarjasse.t: Afarjasse is both the site and the dedicatee of the new folly, which was completed after Winter Solstice 379YE.

Feroz.t: Feroz gained a completed folly in its region of Afarjasse, paid for by 10 wains of white granite and 20 crowns from Gant Archama.

Construct fortified garrison in Overton.d: Proposed by Upwold and seconded by Feroz, the motion sought funds to buy wains for a blockhouse in the Mourn, with a view to future upgrades. It passed at 15 Thrones. The garrison required 5 wains of white granite for a fortified manor house, to shelter local citizens, and 5 wains of weirwood for a staging house, so military units could base themselves in Overton to protect the citizenry. It carried 2 Thrones upkeep. Silas Merrick of the Marches supplied the granite in Summer 378YE and the weirwood in Autumn 378YE. At the Spring Equinox 380YE, after Orchard's Watch was completed, the Senate disbanded the garrison when it created the Sheriff of Overton title.

Jotun.t: Mentioned in passing: the page does not name the Jotun; the garrison was commissioned in Overton, in the Mournwold, which they held at the time.

Construct fortified garrison in Overton.o: In Summer 378YE the Senate passed a motion, at a cost of 15 Thrones, to build a fortified garrison in the town of Overton in the Mournwold, offering refuge for local citizens and a base for military units.

Mournwold.t: Overton in the Mournwold was to gain a fortified manor house as a refuge for its citizens and a staging house where military units could be based to protect them. The garrison stood until it was disbanded in 380YE to create the Sheriff of Overton title.

Construct fortified manor in Liathaven.d: Proposed by Therunin and seconded by Miekarova, the motion passed in principle in Autumn 378YE. It called for a fortified garrison at Beacon Point, with a view to future upgrades. The work cost 8 wains of white granite and 2 Thrones and took three months. The materials were supplied by Caerwyn after the Summer Solstice 379YE. Once complete, the manor was meant to protect the people of Beacon Point from the worst of Jotun raiding and from bandit attacks in the southern mountains. The fortified steading was lost when the Jotun invaded Liathaven in late 379YE.

Jotun.t: Jotun raiding was one of the threats the manor was built to guard against, and the fortified steading was destroyed during the Jotun invasion of Liathaven in late 379YE.

Navarr.t: The motion sought to protect the Navarr people of Beacon Point with a fortified refuge, but the defence was lost when the Jotun invaded Liathaven in late 379YE.

Construct fortified manor in Liathaven.o: The Senate passed a motion in Autumn 378YE to build a fortified manor at Beacon Point in Liathaven, giving local citizens a place of refuge from raiding.

Liathaven/Beacon Point.t: Beacon Point was the chosen site for the fortified manor, which was funded with Caerwyn's granite and Thrones in 379YE and later lost to the Jotun invasion.

Liathaven.t: Liathaven was to gain a fortified manor as a refuge against Jotun raids and mountain bandits, but it was destroyed in the Jotun invasion of the territory in late 379YE.

Construct herbal great work in Skarsind.d: Proposed by the senator for Skarsind and seconded by Sermersuaq's senator, the motion took advantage of an opportunity that arose after Skarsind was assigned to the Imperial Orcs. The great work cost 45 wains of weirwood and 90 crowns in labour, and would take three months to construct. Bloodcrow Yargol provided the weirwood and the crowns after the Winter Solstice 380YE. Once complete, the work will provide 90 doses of True Vervain, split between the owners of herb gardens in Skarsind who attended the previous Anvil summit.

Imperial Orcs.t: The great work honours those orcs who never got to see a homeland. It was funded by Bloodcrow Yargol and will supply True Vervain to orc herb-garden owners in their newly assigned territory.

Construct herbal great work in Skarsind.o: In Autumn 380YE the Senate passed a motion to commission a great work in Skarsind, dedicated to those orcs who never got to see a homeland, which would produce True Vervain.

Skarsind.t: The great work is built in Skarsind. Once complete, it will distribute 90 doses of True Vervain among the territory's herb-garden owners who attended the previous summit.

Construct mana ministry in Astolat.d: Proposed by the Senator for Astolat and seconded by the Senator for Weirwater, the motion called for a mana ministry in Astolat whose position would be a lifetime appointment made by the Dawnish Senators. It passed in Autumn 380YE at an unrecorded cost, with standard costs applying. Some necessary details were missing from the motion, and the Senator for Astolat was allowed to decide them. Once completed, the ministry would have created a Dawnish national position. However, by the Autumn Equinox 381YE the commission had lapsed, so the ministry was never built.

Dawn.t: Dawn would have gained a national position appointed for life by its Senators, but this was lost when the commission lapsed by Autumn 381YE.

Construct mana ministry in Astolat.o: In Autumn 380YE the Senate passed a motion to construct a mana ministry in Astolat, with its holder appointed for life by the Dawnish Senators, but the commission later lapsed without being built.

Astolat.t: Astolat was the proposed site of the mana ministry, and its Senator proposed the motion and was allowed to settle its missing details, though the commission lapsed before construction.

Construct mana repository in Morrow.d: Proposed by the senator for Morrow and seconded by Karov, the motion sought to develop Morrow's mana crystal capacity by creating a sinecure, the Phoenix Caverns, at a cost of 10 wains of mithril. Its holder, the Augur of the Phoenix Caverns, would have managed the caverns and been appointed unanimously by the Urizen senators, with a greater majority nomination by the Senate as the fallback. The Senate voted 8 for and 18 against in principle, so the motion was defeated and the facility was not built.

Urizen.t: Urizen lost a proposed sinecure that its own senators would have filled, along with a new source of crystal mana in its lands, when the Senate rejected the motion.

Construct mana repository in Morrow.o: At the Spring Equinox 378YE the Senate rejected a motion to build the Phoenix Caverns, a mana crystal facility in Morrow, as a sinecure supplying crystal mana. It failed in principle by 8 votes to 18.

Morrow.t: Morrow's senator proposed the Phoenix Caverns to expand the territory's mana crystal capacity, but the motion failed and no facility was built there.

Construct mana sinecure at New Dunhall.d: Using the Senate's delegated power to commission constructions, Breeta Dunning announced a sinecure at New Dunhall (given as New Dunholm in the announcement) in Hahnmark. Its purpose was to cultivate and collect the mana crystallisations forming around the newly opened hole, Lorenzo's Deep Pockets, for the prosperity of Wintermark. The work was self-funded, costing 10 wains of mithril and 20 crowns, and was to take three months. Balder supplied the materials and money after the Autumn Equinox 381YE. Completing the sinecure would create a new Imperial title, Fallsheart Guardian, whose details and method of appointment were left for Breeta Dunning to determine.

Wintermark.t: The sinecure was explicitly intended to increase Wintermark's prosperity by harvesting mana in one of its own territories, and it would create a new Imperial title, the Fallsheart Guardian.

Construct mana sinecure at New Dunhall.o: Breeta Dunning, holder of an Imperial Wayleave, commissioned a mana sinecure at New Dunhall in Hahnmark to harvest the mana crystallising around Lorenzo's Deep Pockets. It was funded with 10 wains of mithril and 20 crowns after the Autumn Equinox 381YE.

Hahnmark.t: New Dunhall in Hahnmark was to gain a sinecure overseeing the mana crystallising around Lorenzo's Deep Pockets, with construction funded after the Autumn Equinox and due to take three months.

Construct memorial at Anvil.d: Proposed by the Conscience of the Senate and seconded by the senator for Bastion, the motion called for a memorial to the fallen at Anvil. It passed in principle, but no funding was requested at the time. The listed cost was 3 wains of white granite for the monument alone, or 10 white granite for a monument that also served as a sinecure. After the Winter Solstice of 378YE, Ira of Felix's Watch Banner of Highguard provided 10 wains of white granite. Once complete and the title clarified, the sinecure will automatically create the title of Custodian of the Imperial War Memorial.

Highguard.t: Highguard had a hand in the memorial at both ends: Bastion's senator seconded the motion, and Ira of Felix's Watch Banner of Highguard later supplied the 10 wains of white granite needed to build it.

Construct memorial at Anvil.o: In Summer 378YE the Senate passed in principle a motion to build a memorial to the fallen at Anvil, established as a sinecure, without requesting funding.

Casinea.t: Mentioned in passing: Casinea, held by Highguard, is not named on the page; the memorial is to be built at Anvil, not in Casinea.

Construct mithril mine.d: The Civil Service offered two options: 100 Thrones for a six-month build producing a projected 10 wains of mithril each season, or 200 Thrones for a nine-month build producing 15 wains. The motion passed at 330 Thrones, which were disbursed to the Senator for Sermersuaq, and Senator Atte Arrow-Tongue Metsastajason supplied 200 Thrones, choosing the larger mine. Unless something goes wrong, it will be complete and available for allocation at the Autumn Equinox 380YE. On completion it will create a new seat on the Imperial Bourse, and once it produces its first mithril a senator may propose a motion to allocate the seat as either National or Imperial.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark's Senator for Sermersuaq, Atte Arrow-Tongue Metsastajason, proposed the mine and committed 200 Thrones to it, giving the nation a prospective new Bourse seat in its own lands, though whether it becomes National or Imperial will be decided by a later motion.

Construct mithril mine.o: In Winter 379YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by the Senator for Sermersuaq and seconded by Mitwold, to commission a mithril mine exploiting the recent discovery at the Face of Ikka in Suaq Fount.

Sermersuaq/Suaq Fount.t: The mine is to be built at the newly discovered mithril deposit at the Face of Ikka in Suaq Fount, with construction taking nine months.

Sermersuaq.t: Sermersuaq is to gain a mithril mine projected to yield 15 wains a season, expected to be completed by the Autumn Equinox 380YE.

Construct museum.d: The senator for Bastion proposed the motion and the senator for Necropolis seconded it. It called for a museum to store and display Imperial relics and artefacts, to be rebuilt in Bastion after the loss of the Tabernacle museum in Reikos. The proposer offered to fund the work personally but asked the Senate and individual senators to contribute. The motion passed at a cost of 8 Thrones and 10 wains of white granite. Jada of Highguard supplied the granite after the Winter Solstice of 378YE. Once the work was complete, the title of Curator of the White City Museum was created.

Druj.t: Mentioned in passing: the Druj are not named, but the motion followed the destruction of the Tabernacle museum in the fighting over Reikos, which was then in their hands.

Highguard.t: Highguard gained the Empire's replacement museum in its territory of Bastion, and Jada of Highguard supplied the white granite needed to build it. The work led to the creation of the Curator of the White City Museum title.

Construct museum.o: In Summer 378YE the Senate passed a motion to build a new Imperial museum in Bastion, replacing the museum in Tabernacle in Riverwatch, Reikos, which had been destroyed in the recent fighting.

Reikos/Riverwatch.t: The museum in Tabernacle, in Riverwatch, was destroyed in the recent fighting, which prompted the motion to build its replacement in Bastion.

Bastion.t: Bastion's senator proposed the motion, and the new Imperial museum for relics and artefacts was built there, which led to the creation of the Curator of the White City Museum title.

Reikos.t: Reikos lost the Imperial museum at Tabernacle, destroyed in the fighting there, and the Empire chose to rebuild it in Bastion instead.

Construct night mana sinecure in Redoubt.d: Vitore van Temeschwar used the Arcane Architect's power, delegated by the Senate, to commission a night mana sinecure in the Naris region of Redoubt. The page records the total cost as unknown. Vitore supplied the materials personally: 20 ingots of iridescent gloaming, 10 wains of mithril, 10 wains of weirwood, 5 mana crystals and 30 crowns. The completed sinecure, named the Penumbral Watcher, creates a new Imperial title. Its holder is appointed by Declaration of Candidacy in the Conclave rather than by the Senate or any national assembly.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: Grendel is not named on the page, but it held part of Redoubt, the territory where the sinecure was built.

Urizen.t: Mentioned in passing: Urizen is not named on the page, but it held part of Redoubt, the territory where the sinecure was built.

Construct night mana sinecure in Redoubt.o: In Spring 381YE the Arcane Architect, Vitore van Temeschwar, commissioned a night mana sinecure in Naris, Redoubt. The sinecure, the Penumbral Watcher, creates a new Imperial title appointed by Declaration of Candidacy in the Conclave.

Redoubt/Naris.t: Naris is the site of the Penumbral Watcher, a night mana sinecure that carries a new Imperial title appointed through the Conclave.

Redoubt.t: Redoubt gained a night mana sinecure, the Penumbral Watcher, built in Naris with materials supplied by the Arcane Architect.

Construct place of pilgrimage in Casinea.d: Proposed by the senator for Necropolis and seconded by Weirwater, the motion commissioned a grand tower as a place of pilgrimage at the Sentinel in Casinea. It was self-funded, costing 25 wains of white granite and 50 crowns, with three months to complete. Rhesa provided the materials and money after the Winter Solstice 381YE. Construction could only begin once the Silent Sentinel had received a True Liao consecration. On completion it creates a sinecure overseen by the Castellan of the Silent Sentinel, who is also custodian of the fortress. The Highborn National Assembly appoints the title.

Highguard.t: Highborn senators proposed and seconded the motion, and Rhesa funded it. The Highborn National Assembly gains the right to appoint the Castellan of the Silent Sentinel, custodian of the fortress and its pilgrimage tower.

Construct place of pilgrimage in Casinea.o: In Winter 381YE the Senate passed a motion to build a grand tower of pilgrimage at the Silent Sentinel in Casinea, taking advantage of an opportunity and creating the Imperial title Castellan of the Silent Sentinel.

Casinea.t: A grand tower of pilgrimage was to rise at the Silent Sentinel in Casinea once the site had received a True Liao consecration, with a new Castellan overseeing both the sinecure and the fortress.

Construct repairs to Heliopticon.d: Proposed by the Senator for Redoubt and seconded by Astolat, the motion passed at 27 Thrones and 2 Crowns. The work required 12 wains of mithril and 24 Crowns and would take three months. It also adds costs to each Urizen territory and the usual upkeep of a college of magic, currently 25 Thrones. After the Winter Solstice, Andronikos provided 2 wains of mithril and the 24 Crowns, and Edmundo of Damakhan's Forge provided the other 10 wains. The Doyen of the Spires is chosen by a majority of Urizen's magicians and holds the title until they codify one arcane projection. The Synod can revoke it. Research speed depends on how many Urizen territories are connected to the network.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: Grendel is not named, but the commission covers the central heliopticon tower in Spiral, which Grendel held at the time.

Urizen.t: Urizen's Heliopticon is to be rebuilt, giving its magicians the role of a college of magic and the right to choose a Doyen of the Spires. The project also adds costs to each Urizen territory.

Construct repairs to Heliopticon.o: In Winter 382YE the Senate passed a commission to repair and rebuild the Heliopticon in Urizen, restoring its central towers in Morrow and Spiral. Once complete, it would create the Imperial title of Doyen of the Spires and let Urizen's magicians work together as a college of magic.

Morrow.t: Morrow is home to one of the central heliopticon towers that the commission was raised to repair.

Spiral.t: The commission includes repairing the central heliopticon tower in Spiral, although the territory was in Grendel hands at the time.

Construct runeforge in Redoubt.d: The motion was proposed by the senator for Zenith and seconded by Upwold. The runeforge cost 60 wains each of mithril, white granite and weirwood, plus 45 thrones in labour, and needed 12 months to build. Edmundo, Achillies of Damakan's forge, Thomas of Upwold and Asael of Cantiarch's Hold funded it in two stages. After the Spring Equinox they gave 15 wains of each material and 12 thrones, and one season of construction was completed. After the Summer Solstice they gave the remaining 45 wains of each and 33 thrones. An amendment brought in the Asavean architect Almodin Oktístis to carry out the work. Once complete, the forge creates the Seer of the Spiral Sword, elected by the standard Bourse process each Spring.

Grendel.t: Mentioned in passing: Grendel is not named; the only link is the new title, the Seer of the Spiral Sword, which echoes the name of the Grendel-held territory of Spiral.

Highguard.t: Mentioned in passing: the runeforge stands on the road leading to the Highguard town of Hedra.

Urizen.t: Zenith's senator proposed the motion, which gives Urizen's territory of Redoubt a new runeforge and an Imperial title elected through the Bourse.

Construct runeforge in Redoubt.o: In Spring 381YE the Senate passed a motion to build a self-funded runeforge in Limus, Redoubt, on the road between Cargo and the Highguard town of Hedra, with a new title, the Seer of the Spiral Sword, to be appointed through the Imperial Bourse.

Redoubt/Limus.t: Limus is the site of the runeforge, which was fully funded by the Summer Solstice 381YE and had one season of construction completed by then.

Redoubt.t: Redoubt gains a runeforge on the road between Cargo and Hedra, privately funded and built by the Asavean architect Almodin Oktístis.

Spiral.t: Mentioned in passing: Spiral is referred to only through the name of the new title, the Seer of the Spiral Sword.

Construct sausage shop.d: Proposed by the senator for Holberg and seconded by Temeschwar, the motion arose from an opportunity to expand sausage production and distribution in Holberg. It used non-standard costs of 20 wains of white granite and 40 crowns of labour, with no annual upkeep. The materials were to be provided by Lorenzo "La Volpe" Macelliao von Temeschwar of the Bloody Butcher's Guild, who delivered 20 wains of white granite and 5 thrones after the Spring Equinox. Once complete, the work would give a bounty of two thrones and four rings shared among every farm owner in Holberg. It would also spread the distinctive Holberg travelling ration wherever good sausages are sold.

The League.t: The League's senators gain the new Imperial title of Custodian of the Bloody Great Sausage to appoint each year by unanimous decision, and a League guildsman from Temeschwar funded the work.

Construct sausage shop.o: In Spring 382YE the Senate passed a motion to build a Great Work in Holberg honouring the provisioners and victuaries of the siege of Holberg, expanding sausage production and creating the title of Custodian of the Bloody Great Sausage.

Holberg.t: The Great Work is to be built in Holberg to honour the provisioners of its siege. When complete, it will share a bounty among every farm owner there and spread the Holberg travelling ration across the Empire.

Construct seminary in Reikos.d: Proposed by Casinea and seconded by Tassato, the motion called for a Great Work: an artificial lake replacing the drained pools at the Vigilant Swan so the swans might return, a deliberate statement to the Druj that whatever they destroy can be rebuilt better. At its centre would stand a seminary training magisters of Highguard in magic and Virtue. Standard costs applied, and Nira of Cantiarch's Hold supplied 40 wains of white granite and 10 thrones after the Spring Equinox. The seminary was completed and benefits mana site owners in Reikos, though it creates no Imperial title. The exact nature of the benefit was left undefined, pending detail from the senator.

Druj.t: The rebuilt lake and seminary were framed as a direct answer to the Druj, proof that what they destroyed at the Vigilant Swan could be restored and improved.

Highguard.t: Highguard gained a completed seminary to train its magisters in magic and Virtue, funded in part by Nira of Cantiarch's Hold's donation of white granite and thrones.

Construct seminary in Reikos.o: In Spring 382YE the Senate passed a motion to build a seminary in Reikos, set in an artificial lake at the site of the Vigilant Swan, to train Highborn magisters in magic and Virtue and to benefit the territory's mana site owners.

Reikos.t: The drained pools at the Vigilant Swan were replaced by an artificial lake with a seminary at its heart, which now benefits the territory's mana site owners, though the precise benefit remained unspecified.

Construct shrine for Britta's body.d: Proposed by the senator for Necropolis and seconded by Sermersuaq, the motion passed with 7 thrones and 12 votes against, the money going to Necropolis. Construction cost 10 white granite, paid by Adamah, Senator for Necropolis, in the Spring Equinox downtime. The resulting sinecure, Guardian of Britta's Shrine, yields 10 Synod votes and 5 liao. Ruth of the Cenotaph was appointed by the Highborn, and future holders are chosen by unanimous decision of the Highguard senators. Because a Senate-appointed title grants Synod votes, giving the Senate undue influence over the Synod, it is regarded as unconstitutional. The magistrates did not strike it down at the time, and the construction has been completed.

Highguard.t: The Highguard senators control the new Guardian of Britta's Shrine title and must agree unanimously on future holders. Its first holder, Ruth of the Cenotaph, was appointed by the Highborn and gains 10 Synod votes and 5 liao from the sinecure.

Construct shrine for Britta's body.o: In Winter 376YE the Senate passed a motion to lay the late Empress Britta to rest, with her remains interred in the Kallavesi marshes and her effects in Necropolis, and monuments raised in both places. It also created the Imperial title Guardian of Britta's Shrine.

Necropolis.t: Necropolis became the resting place of Empress Britta's effects and the site of a monument. Its senator proposed the motion and paid the 10 white granite for its construction.

Construct shrine to Britta.d: Proposed by the Senator for Hahnmark and seconded by Reikos, the motion passed in principle and at 75 Thrones, which were disbursed to Senator Hahnmark. The Civil Service offered a modest shrine or a major one. The major option, with lodgings and spaces for meditation, prayer and religious ceremonies, was chosen: Hengest Dun supplied 18 wains of white granite and 36 crowns of labour after the Winter Solstice. The finished shrine is a significant religious structure in Kallavesa. It created a sinecure, the Watcher of Britta's Pool, which receives 9 liao and 18 votes in the Imperial Synod. By custom the title is appointed by the Wintermark national assembly from among the Winterfolk, likely for life.

Wintermark.t: Wintermark gained a major shrine honouring its Empress Britta, and its national assembly would customarily appoint one of the Winterfolk as Watcher of Britta's Pool, likely for life, with liao and Synod votes.

Construct shrine to Britta.o: The Senate passed a motion in Winter 379YE to build a shrine in the Kallavesa Marsh celebrating the life and achievements of Empress Britta, whose regalia had been interred in the marshes. The major version of the shrine was completed, creating the Imperial title of Watcher of Britta's Pool.

Kallavesa/Kallavesa Marsh.t: The shrine was built in the Kallavesa Marsh, where Britta's regalia had been interred, providing places for pilgrims to stay, meditate, pray and hold ceremonies.

Kallavesa.t: Kallavesa became home to a significant religious structure, a major shrine to Empress Britta able to host large numbers of pilgrims.

Construct south west road network.d: Proposed by Kahraman and seconded by Kallavesa in Autumn 381YE, the motion described the network as partly self-funded. It would run from Anduz in Segura through Madruga to Tassato, needing 80 wains of white granite, 20 thrones of labour and six months to build. After the Winter Solstice, Lorenzo “La Volpe” Macelliao von Temeschwar gave the 20 thrones and Qusay i Kalamar i Guerra gave 20 wains of white granite. Qusay supplied the remaining 60 wains after the Spring Equinox, covering the full cost. Once complete, the great work will raise the income of farms and businesses in Segura and Madruga.

The Brass Coast.t: Two Brass Coast territories, Segura and Madruga, lie along the road and stand to gain higher farm and business income once the great work is finished.

The League.t: The League's territory of Tassato is the far end of the planned road, which will connect it to Anduz in Segura.

Construct south west road network.o: The Senate passed in principle a motion to build a road network linking Anduz in Segura with Tassato, running through Madruga, at a cost of 80 wains of white granite and 20 thrones in labour.

Madruga.t: The road will pass through Madruga, and once it is complete, farms and businesses there will earn more.

Segura.t: The road will start at Anduz in Segura, and once it is complete, farms and businesses in the territory will earn more.

Tassato.t: Tassato is the destination of the road network. The page lists no direct income benefit for the territory itself.

Construct spy network in Feroz.d: The commission was made by announcement rather than a vote, after the Senate had previously amended the power of the Imperial Orc Wayleave specifically to allow it to commission a spy network. Non-standard costs applied: 5 wains of weirwood and 10 crowns in labour, three months to construct, and an upkeep of 2 thrones per season.
